## Page 6
战役概览

战役背景
数十年来，伊斯嘉一直被切利亚斯以及其本国政府所忽视。一群理想主义者与退伍军人厌倦了人民总要为当权者的糟糕决策承担代价，便建立了“破狱者联盟”，以集结志同道合的反抗者，希望点燃一场革命。在神雨发生之前，他们几乎毫无进展；而在神雨期间，他们成功在布雷奇希尔镇找到了并获得了一枚战片。

然而，伊斯嘉的总督赫德文德六世察觉了他们的活动，并将此事报告给阿布罗盖尔·斯戎。切利亚斯女王阿布罗盖尔二世觊觎这枚战片，又意图扑灭叛乱，便派出刑架骑士团夺取布雷奇希尔，并彻底搜查以获取她的战利品。随后接连不断的公开处决与地狱骑士的残酷统治让城镇日渐凋敝。布雷奇希尔向外界求援的呼声传到了安多安；安多安派出一支外交使团，其中包括退役将军雷吉纳德·科莫斯，试图恳求地狱骑士停止奴役布雷奇希尔的市民。地狱骑士的回应是处决雷吉纳德。

这残暴且毫无必要的暴力行径激起公愤，钢隼鹰骑士遂前往伊斯嘉，发动了“地狱骑士丘之战”。这是一场艰苦卓绝的战斗，最终以鹰骑士的胜利告终。破狱者联盟协助了鹰骑士；战后，安多安承诺以援助作为交换，换取他们手中的战片。

此战的幸存者之一、扈从维罗·阿哈拉在逃离战场前设法弄到一套完整的地狱骑士全身板甲。他向“金伊莉妮丝修女会”求助，而修女们误以为他是一名正式地狱骑士。维罗利用修女会的资源，得知了一项仪式：召唤一名强大的恶魔，以对破狱者联盟展开复仇。

与此同时，在首都艾利迪尔，伊尔凯娜·阿洛诺的一名代理人正准备让伊斯嘉政府陷入混乱，并安排好一切，好让伊尔凯娜轻易接管整个国家。埃齐奥·盖塔计划在总督的私人宴会上刺杀赫德文德，以此分散当局注意力；而伊尔凯娜则准备施行一项强大的仪式，把整个伊斯嘉都转化为她的不死奴仆。

对那些暗中针对他们的阴谋一无所知的破狱者联盟，正在萨林加洛重新集结，以乘胜追击，利用他们近期胜利带来的势头。

关于PC
1级PC是破狱者联盟的低阶成员。各类人群与各种背景的人都会加入破狱者联盟，其中也包括外来者——例如一位心怀悲悯的鹰骑士，或是一名因承诺报酬而参战的德鲁玛佣兵。本冒险路径涵盖多种玩法风格，包含社交、荒野与战斗挑战。务必让你的玩家阅读免费的《玩家指南》，以为冒险做好准备，并创建适合故事的PC。别忘了：他们在2级时可以选择一个全新变体；此外，在第215页还提供了一种新的动物伙伴。

子系统
本战役会使用若干子系统。首先是一个贯穿整场战役的声望系统。在第6章中，会用到多个子系统：胜利点系统、渗透系统，以及追逐（子系统）。第9章则会使用研究（子系统）。

须知术语
切利亚斯：切利亚斯是伊斯嘉的宗主国，崇拜大魔鬼阿斯摩太。
地精血战：在这场战争中，来自咔嗒林木的霍布地精集结了地精军队，并着手摧毁周边聚居地。伊斯嘉在此期间遭受重创，而战争的影响至今仍困扰着其民众。
破狱者联盟：一个致力于将伊斯嘉从切利亚斯的压迫统治中解放出来的反抗组织。
地狱骑士：地狱骑士是切利亚斯的骑士，奉法律与秩序高于一切为信条。地狱骑士存在多个不同的骑士团；与本冒险最相关的是神爪骑士团，其以崇拜神爪诸神而闻名。前文也曾提及刑架骑士团。
战片：当战神戈鲁姆死亡时，他的身体与武器有数个部位化作碎片散落于宇宙之中，这些碎片被称为“战片”。这些物品蕴含着浩瀚的神圣力量。

Campaign Background
Isger has been neglected by Cheliax and its own 
government for decades. A group of idealists and 
former soldiers, sick of the people bearing the brunt 
of the authorities’ poor decisions, founded the 
Hellbreakers League to gather like-minded rebels 
in hopes of sparking a revolution. They made little 
traction until the Godsrain, when they managed 
to locate and obtain a warshard in the town of 
Breachill.
However, Isger’s steward, Hedvend VI, was alerted 
to their activity and reported it to Abrogail Thrune. 
Queen Abrogail II, coveting the warshard and seeking 
to stamp out rebellion, sent the Order of the Rack to 
seize Breachill and scour it for her prizes.
The town withered under the subsequent public 
executions and the Hellknights’ harsh rule. Breachill’s 
cries for deliverance made it to the nation of Andoran, 
who sent a contingent of diplomats, including the 
retired general Reginald Cormoth, to entreat the 
Hellknights to stop subjugating Breachill’s citizens. 
The Hellknights responded by executing Reginald.
Outraged by the brutal and unnecessary act of 
violence, Eagle Knights of the Steel Falcons went to 
Isger and initiated the Battle of Hellknight Hill, a 
grueling fight that ended in the Eagle Knights’ victory. 
The Hellbreakers aided the Eagle Knights, and after 
the battle, they were promised aid from Andoran in 
exchange for their warshard.
A survivor of the battle, the armiger Viro Ahala, 
managed to acquire full Hellknight plate before 
fleeing the battlefield. He sought aid from the Sisters 
of the Golden Erinys, who mistook him for a full-
fledged Hellknight. Viro used the nuns’ resources to 
learn of a ritual to summon a powerful devil to exact 
revenge upon the Hellbreakers League.
Meanwhile, in the capital of Elidir, an agent 
of Illcayna Alonnor prepares to throw Isger’s 
government into chaos and arrange things so Illcayna 
can easily take over the nation. Ezio Gaeta plans 
to assassinate Hedvend at the steward’s own gala, 
distracting the authorities while Illcayna prepares to 
enact a powerful ritual to transform all of Isger into 
her undead thralls.
Ignorant to those who plot against them, the 
Hellbreakers League is reconvening in Saringallow 
to take advantage of the momentum from their 
recent victory.
About the PCs
The 1st-level PCs are low-ranking members of 
the Hellbreakers League. People of all types and 
backgrounds join the Hellbreakers League, including 
outsiders like an Eagle Knight with a bleeding heart 
or a Drumish mercenary promised a reward for 
participation. This Adventure Path caters to a wide 
range of gameplay styles with social, wilderness, and 
combat challenges.
Make sure your players read the free Player’s 
Guide to prepare for the adventure and make PCs 
appropriate for the story. Don’t forget that there’s a 
new archetype they can take at Level 2, and there’s 
also a new animal companion available on page 215.
Subsystems
This campaign makes use of several subsystems. The 
first is a reputation system that’s used throughout the 
entire campaign. In Chapter 6, several subsystems 
are used: the Victory Point system, the infiltration 
system, and the chase subsystem. Chapter 9 uses the 
research subsystem. 
Terms to Know
Cheliax: Cheliax is the patron nation of Isger and 
worships the archdevil Asmodeus.
The Goblinblood Wars: In this war, hobgoblins 
from the Chitterwood raised armies of goblins 
and set about destroying settlements nearby. Isger 
suffered greatly during this time, and the war’s effects 
still haunt its populace.
Hellbreakers League: A rebel organization dedicated 
to freeing Isger from Cheliax’s oppressive rule.
Hellknight: Hellknights are Chelaxian knights 
dedicated to law and order above all else. There 
are several different orders of Hellknights; the most 
relevant to this adventure is the Order of the Godclaw, 
which is known to worship the Godclaw pantheon. 
There are mentions of the Order of the Rack early on.
Warshard: When the god Gorum died, several 
parts of his body and weapons were strewn about the 
Universe in pieces called warshards. These items hold 
immense divine power.

Hellbreakers ADVENTURE PATH

Campaign Overview

Campaign Background
Isger has been neglected by Cheliax and its own government for decades. A group of idealists and former soldiers, sick of the people bearing the brunt of the authorities’ poor decisions, founded the Hellbreakers League to gather like-minded rebels in hopes of sparking a revolution. They made little traction until the Godsrain, when they managed to locate and obtain a warshard in the town of Breachill.
However, Isger’s steward, Hedvend VI, was alerted to their activity and reported it to Abrogail Thrune. Queen Abrogail II, coveting the warshard and seeking to stamp out rebellion, sent the Order of the Rack to seize Breachill and scour it for her prizes.
The town withered under the subsequent public executions and the Hellknights’ harsh rule. Breachill’s cries for deliverance made it to the nation of Andoran, who sent a contingent of diplomats, including the retired general Reginald Cormoth, to entreat the Hellknights to stop subjugating Breachill’s citizens. The Hellknights responded by executing Reginald.
Outraged by the brutal and unnecessary act of violence, Eagle Knights of the Steel Falcons went to Isger and initiated the Battle of Hellknight Hill, a grueling fight that ended in the Eagle Knights’ victory. The Hellbreakers aided the Eagle Knights, and after the battle, they were promised aid from Andoran in exchange for their warshard.
A survivor of the battle, the armiger Viro Ahala, managed to acquire full Hellknight plate before fleeing the battlefield. He sought aid from the Sisters of the Golden Erinys, who mistook him for a full-fledged Hellknight. Viro used the nuns’ resources to learn of a ritual to summon a powerful devil to exact revenge upon the Hellbreakers League.
Meanwhile, in the capital of Elidir, an agent of Illcayna Alonnor prepares to throw Isger’s government into chaos and arrange things so Illcayna can easily take over the nation. Ezio Gaeta plans to assassinate Hedvend at the steward’s own gala, distracting the authorities while Illcayna prepares to enact a powerful ritual to transform all of Isger into her undead thralls.
Ignorant to those who plot against them, the Hellbreakers League is reconvening in Saringallow to take advantage of the momentum from their recent victory.

About the PCs
The 1st-level PCs are low-ranking members of the Hellbreakers League. People of all types and backgrounds join the Hellbreakers League, including outsiders like an Eagle Knight with a bleeding heart or a Drumish mercenary promised a reward for participation. This Adventure Path caters to a wide range of gameplay styles with social, wilderness, and combat challenges.
Make sure your players read the free Player’s Guide to prepare for the adventure and make PCs appropriate for the story. Don’t forget that there’s a new archetype they can take at Level 2, and there’s also a new animal companion available on page 215.

Subsystems
This campaign makes use of several subsystems. The first is a reputation system that’s used throughout the entire campaign. In Chapter 6, several subsystems are used: the Victory Point system, the infiltration system, and the chase subsystem. Chapter 9 uses the research subsystem.

Terms to Know
Cheliax: Cheliax is the patron nation of Isger and worships the archdevil Asmodeus.
The Goblinblood Wars: In this war, hobgoblins from the Chitterwood raised armies of goblins and set about destroying settlements nearby. Isger suffered greatly during this time, and the war’s effects still haunt its populace.
Hellbreakers League: A rebel organization dedicated to freeing Isger from Cheliax’s oppressive rule.
Hellknight: Hellknights are Chelaxian knights dedicated to law and order above all else. There are several different orders of Hellknights; the most relevant to this adventure is the Order of the Godclaw, which is known to worship the Godclaw pantheon. There are mentions of the Order of the Rack early on.
Warshard: When the god Gorum died, several parts of his body and weapons were strewn about the Universe in pieces called warshards. These items hold immense divine power.

## Page 7
【须知人物】
阿布罗盖尔·斯戎：阿布罗盖尔二世是切利亚斯的统治者。她不会在本次冒险中登场，但只要切利亚斯仍有所掌控，她的影响便无处不在。
阿尔瑟奥·德米特里亚斯：地狱破袭者同盟的联合创始人。阿尔瑟奥是女神密拉妮的牧师。
赫德文德六世：赫德文德是伊斯嘉的执政官。他以一贯将切利亚斯的欲求置于伊斯嘉的需求之上而闻名。
伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺：伊尔凯娜信奉女神乌加索娅，她的唯一目的就是把伊斯嘉变成献纳给她女神的贡国。她持有一枚战碎片，并计划用它来实现她的目标。
卡尔泰莎·伊伊斯：卡尔泰莎是大魔鬼玛门那位神秘、存世数百年的高阶女祭司。她只会在本次冒险中短暂露面，但你也许还会再见到她！
菲比·德米特里亚斯：地狱破袭者同盟的联合创始人。菲比曾是士兵，如今担任叛军指挥官。

【重要地点】
喋喋林：一片大型森林，在地精血战期间大多被焚毁。如今主要由类地精占据。
埃利迪尔：该国首都，富裕精英与切利亚斯主要支持者的聚居地。
寻人者峡谷：该镇是伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺的总部，且已被亡灵占据。
萨林加洛：这座小城是地狱破袭者同盟总部所在。

【关系】
切利亚斯几乎遗忘了伊斯嘉；伊斯嘉之所以仍具意义，主要是因为有一条河流贯穿其境，为其带来利润丰厚的运输与贸易。切利亚斯在地精血战期间只提供了有限援助，更多时候任由该国自生自灭。战争结束后，他们派遣修女施行慈善之举并对平民进行教化，因此许多公民对其心怀感激。人们对切利亚斯统治的看法分裂，其中乡间对宗主国的怨恨更甚。

【时间线】
以下事件发生在本战役之前，并促成了本战役。
日期 事件
2133 AR 当塔尔多的第七探索军击败伊斯嘉的原住民伊斯盖里人后，伊斯嘉作为塔尔多的一个行省建立。

Names to Know
Abrogail Thrune: Abrogail II is the ruler of Cheliax. 
She doesn’t make an appearance in this adventure, but 
her influence is felt everywhere Cheliax has a hold.

League, Alceo is a cleric of the goddess Milani.
Hedvend VI: Hedvend is the steward of Isger. He’s 
known to consistently prioritize Cheliax’s wants over 
Isger’s needs.
Illcayna Alonnor: Illcayna is a worshipper of the 
goddess Urgathoa, and her sole purpose is to turn Isger 
into a tribute nation to her goddess. She’s in possession 
of a warshard, which she plans to use to achieve her 
goals.
Kaltessa Iyis: Kaltessa is the mysterious, centuries-
old high priestess of the archdevil Mammon. She only 
makes a cameo in this adventure, but you might be 
seeing her again!
Phoebe Demetrias: Cofounder of the Hellbreakers

the rebels.

Names to Know
Abrogail Thrune: Abrogail II is the ruler of Cheliax. She doesn’t make an appearance in this adventure, but her influence is felt everywhere Cheliax has a hold.
Alceo Demetrias: Cofounder of the Hellbreakers League, Alceo is a cleric of the goddess Milani.

Illcayna Alonnor: Illcayna is a worshipper of the goddess Urgathoa, and her sole purpose is to turn Isger into a tribute nation to her goddess. She’s in possession of a warshard, which she plans to use to achieve her goals.
Kaltessa Iyis: Kaltessa is the mysterious, centuries-old high priestess of the archdevil Mammon. She only makes a cameo in this adventure, but you might be seeing her again!

Important Locations

## Page 8
4081 AR 切利亚斯在“巧舌征服”中宣布脱离塔尔多独立。伊斯嘉在此过程中被并吞，成为切利亚斯的附庸国。

4601 AR 伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺尔，一名年轻的乌加索娅女祭司，将自己献给一群尸妖并被复活，成为乌加索娅之女。她屠杀了觅者峡谷的村民，并将他们转化为自己的不死奴仆。

4638 AR 钉之地狱骑士团成立，并在伊斯嘉、靠近裂隙山镇（Breachill）的地方修建阿尔泰瑞恩要塞。

4697–4701 AR 数百名来自伊斯嘉南部喋喋林（Chitterwood）的地精类生物在全国各地发动袭击，揭开地精血战的序幕。政府对伊斯嘉乡间这场残酷冲突反应迟缓，助长了腹地平民的怨恨。战争在切利亚斯的地狱骑士、安多安的鹰骑士，以及杜鲁玛佣兵同盟一支分遣队的共同努力下结束。

4701 AR 地精血战对伊斯嘉军队造成的破坏极其惨重，伊斯嘉统治者赫德文德六世遂命令其部队将重心放在关键商道上，放任乡间自生自灭。斯戎家族通过阿斯摩蒂斯教会为战争孤儿送来援助，而伊尔凯娜则趁着大量伤亡之机，复苏更多不死生物。

4702 AR 伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺尔诅咒了一名旅行商人；该商人在不知情的情况下，于死后被葬于吉拉穆尔（Gillamoor）时将诅咒带入当地。村民们不久便尽数死亡，并转化为饥渴的亡灵。此地也因此遭到诅咒：任何死在这里的人都会成为伊尔凯娜的不死奴仆。

4711 AR 阿尔泰瑞恩要塞被彻底遗弃。

4717 AR “嗡嗡碎颅者”地精搬入阿尔泰瑞恩要塞。

4719 AR 英雄们肃清阿尔泰瑞恩要塞内的诸多威胁，并将城堡作为行动基地，努力阻止新的“灰烬年代”。在成功完成其使命后，他们将要塞遗赠给裂隙山镇的市民。

阿罗杜斯月 4724 戈鲁姆死亡，神雨倾泻格拉利昂，掀起战刃碎片军备竞赛。地狱破除者同盟、伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺尔与凯尔泰莎·艾伊斯女士各自收集战刃碎片，以达成其目的。

奈斯月 4724 伊斯嘉政府怀疑地狱破除者同盟将战刃碎片藏在裂隙山镇境内，或附近的阿尔泰瑞恩要塞之中。

阿巴迪乌斯月 4725 应总督赫德文德六世之请，女王陛下阿布罗盖尔·斯戎二世派遣刑架地狱骑士团的忠诚成员前往裂隙山镇，肃清叛乱并夺回他们发现的任何战刃碎片。

戈兹兰月 4725 刑架地狱骑士团占领裂隙山镇，将大多数市民软禁在家。尽管进行了数次公开处决，但仍未能在居民中找出地狱破除者同盟的成员。

德斯努斯月 4725 来自切利亚斯的补给使刑架地狱骑士团得以在阿尔泰瑞恩要塞内构筑防御，并以地狱咒卫圣化其建筑，召来一条恶魔巨龙。

萨雷尼斯月 4725 一支由半退役的雷金纳德·科莫斯将军率领的安多安外交团队旅行至裂隙山镇，要求地狱骑士停止奴役镇民。地狱骑士大为震怒，逮捕并公开处决科莫斯将军；其随行人员逃离此地。

埃拉斯塔斯月 4725 因科莫斯将军之死引发强烈民愤，阿尔玛斯召开紧急人民议会，讨论裂隙山镇事件。数日讨论后，“钢隼”鹰骑士团旅行前往伊斯嘉。

阿罗杜斯月 4725 地狱骑士山之战：在多番艰苦交锋后，鹰骑士重新夺回裂隙山镇与阿尔泰瑞恩要塞。一部分刑架地狱骑士被俘，但更多人撤退向切利亚斯。地狱破除者同盟从附近山洞现身，与安多安军会谈。安多安方面承诺提供援助，以交换一枚强大的战刃碎片；该碎片被带回安多安。

罗瓦月 4725 当前月份与年份。

## Page 10
战役概要

地狱骑士山之战结束后，PC们从布雷奇希尔前往萨林加洛，会见地狱破坏者联盟中的上级。他们参与数项任务，并得知有一名“地狱骑士”正在寻求向联盟复仇。PC们被派往乡间执行任务，通过在政府疏于照顾之处伸出援手来赢得民心。在旅行途中，PC们发现了“地狱骑士”维罗·阿哈拉针对伊斯嘉阴谋的证据——始于喋喋林。如今已知维罗的计划，PC们前往喋喋林，恳请当地的地精居民协助阻止这名叛逃的地狱骑士侍从。

当PC们在乡间处理事务时，地狱破坏者的领袖们则在首都筹划行动。在身份暴露、急需后援之际，领袖们召唤PC们顶替他们的身份，作为赫德文六世那场恶魔化装舞会的伪造宾客出席。在舞会上，PC们会见数位重要人物，其中包括地狱骑士副军团长凯托·武劳内克斯——他被安排担任一支追捕地狱破坏者的新特遣队的首脑。然而，庆典被一群假扮成地狱破坏者的袭击者打断。PC们应对这些冒名者，却很快得知有人谋杀了赫德文——而地狱破坏者正被栽赃！随着其他离奇死亡事件接连发生，凯托请求PC们展开调查。真正的凶手是同为宾客的埃齐奥·盖塔，一名吸血鬼（特征），也是伊尔凯娜·阿洛诺的追随者；他打算将伊斯嘉改造为献给乌尔加索娅的不死贡国。

凯托夺取了埃利迪尔的控制权，对全国宣布戒严，并将赫德文之死归咎于地狱破坏者。PC们一边扶植地狱破坏者的一个新地方分会，一边计划逃离城市，但当新分会成员遭到抓捕后，事态急转直下。PC们必须营救新结识的朋友，并大胆逃出埃利迪尔！

PC们返回萨林加洛，却得知伊尔凯娜·阿洛诺的不死军势正在行动，而凯托拒绝处理此事。眼见无人援助伊斯嘉的民众，PC们回到乡间，寻求解决不死问题的办法。当他们抵达吉拉穆尔时，PC们得知该镇曾被伊尔凯娜诅咒：凡死于镇域之内者，都会复起成为她的不死奴仆——而她还计划以仪式在整个国家施放一个强大得多的诅咒版本。PC们必须前往探寻者峡谷镇，彻底击败“尸妖之母”。

击败伊尔凯娜后，地狱破坏者联盟的声望空前高涨，但更高的曝光度也让凯托得以辨明他们在萨林加洛的总部位置。PC们勉强逃过逮捕，随后必须先夺取臭名昭著的萨里尼庄园作为据点，再筹划解救被俘的地狱破坏者同伴。

直面凯托本人的时刻已至。PC们率领集结的军势与盟友围攻萨林加洛，反击以解放朋友、夺回家园，并最终确保自身自由。

进度轨迹
《地狱破坏者》为四名角色设计。

1 PC们以1级开始本冒险。
2 解救罗克拉格并击败切里亚斯效忠派后，PC们应为2级。
3 击败艾莉妮斯修女会后，PC们应为3级。
4 阻止维罗·阿哈拉的仪式并拯救伊斯嘉后，PC们应为4级。
5 潜入赫德文的舞会后，PC们应为5级。
6 侦破赫德文谋杀案并阻止埃齐奥后，PC们应为6级。
7 从埃利迪尔脱身后，PC们应为7级。
8 击败伊尔凯娜及其不死军团后，PC们应为8级。
9 夺回萨里尼庄园后，PC们应为9级。

在冒险结束时，PC们应达到10级。

Campaign Summary
In the aftermath of the Battle of Hellknight Hill, the 
PCs travel from Breachill to Saringallow to meet with 
their superiors in the Hellbreakers League. They partake 
in several missions, learning that there’s a “Hellknight” 
seeking revenge on the League. The PCs are sent on a 
countryside mission to win over the people by aiding them 
where the government has neglected to. As they travel, 
the PCs discover evidence of “Hellknight” Viro Ahala’s 
plot against Isger—starting with the Chitterwood. Now 
knowing Viro’s plans, the PCs journey to the Chitterwood 
to entreat the goblin residents for help in stopping the 
rogue Hellknight armiger.
While the PCs dealt with things in the countryside, 
the leaders of the Hellbreakers were making plans in 
the capital. In need of backup after their identities 
are exposed, the leaders summon the PCs to take 
their place as falsified guests of Hedvend VI’s devilish 
costume gala. At the gala, the PCs meet several 
important figures, including Hellknight paralictor 
Caeto Vulaunex, who’s slated to be the head of a new 
task force to hunt down Hellbreakers. However, the 
festivities are interrupted when fake Hellbreakers 
attack the gala. The PCs deal with their impersonators 
but soon learn that someone murdered Hedvend—and 
the Hellbreakers are being blamed! Caeto asks the PCs 
to investigate as other mysterious deaths continue to 
occur. The real murderer is fellow guest Ezio Gaeta, 
a vampire and follower of Illcayna Alonnor, who has 
grand plans to transform Isger into an undead tribute 
state for Urgathoa.
Caeto takes control of Elidir, declaring martial law 
over the nation and blaming the Hellbreakers for 
Hedvend’s death. The PCs bolster a new local chapter 
of the Hellbreakers while planning to escape the city, 
but things go awry when members of the new chapter 
are captured. The PCs must rescue their new friends 
and make a daring escape from Elidir!
The PCs return to Saringallow only to learn that 
Illcayna Alonnor’s undead forces are on the move, and 
Caeto is refusing to address the issue. With no one 
else to help the citizens of Isger, the PCs return to the 
countryside to seek a solution to the undead problem. 
When they reach Gillamoor, the PCs learn that the 
town was once cursed by Illcayna so that any who died 
within the town’s grounds would rise as her undead 
thralls—and she plans to ritually cast a much more 
powerful version of the curse on the entire nation. The 
PCs must head to the town of Finder’s Gulch to defeat 
the Wight Mother once and for all.
The Hellbreakers League is more popular than 
ever after defeating Illcayna, but their increased 
profile allows Caeto to discern the location of their 
headquarters in Saringallow. The PCs barely escape 
capture and must first take the infamous Sarini Manor 
as a stronghold before planning the liberation of their 
fellow Hellbreakers.
The time has come to face Caeto himself. The PCs 
siege Saringallow with their gathered forces and allies, 
striking back to liberate their friends, reclaim their 
home, and secure their freedom at last.

Hellbreakers
ADVENTURE PATH

Campaign Summary

In the aftermath of the Battle of Hellknight Hill, the PCs travel from Breachill to Saringallow to meet with their superiors in the Hellbreakers League. They partake in several missions, learning that there’s a “Hellknight” seeking revenge on the League. The PCs are sent on a countryside mission to win over the people by aiding them where the government has neglected to. As they travel, the PCs discover evidence of “Hellknight” Viro Ahala’s plot against Isger—starting with the Chitterwood. Now knowing Viro’s plans, the PCs journey to the Chitterwood to entreat the goblin residents for help in stopping the rogue Hellknight armiger.

While the PCs dealt with things in the countryside, the leaders of the Hellbreakers were making plans in the capital. In need of backup after their identities are exposed, the leaders summon the PCs to take their place as falsified guests of Hedvend VI’s devilish costume gala. At the gala, the PCs meet several important figures, including Hellknight paralictor Caeto Vulaunex, who’s slated to be the head of a new task force to hunt down Hellbreakers. However, the festivities are interrupted when fake Hellbreakers attack the gala. The PCs deal with their impersonators but soon learn that someone murdered Hedvend—and the Hellbreakers are being blamed! Caeto asks the PCs to investigate as other mysterious deaths continue to occur. The real murderer is fellow guest Ezio Gaeta, a vampire and follower of Illcayna Alonnor, who has grand plans to transform Isger into an undead tribute state for Urgathoa.

Caeto takes control of Elidir, declaring martial law over the nation and blaming the Hellbreakers for Hedvend’s death. The PCs bolster a new local chapter of the Hellbreakers while planning to escape the city, but things go awry when members of the new chapter are captured. The PCs must rescue their new friends and make a daring escape from Elidir!

The PCs return to Saringallow only to learn that Illcayna Alonnor’s undead forces are on the move, and Caeto is refusing to address the issue. With no one else to help the citizens of Isger, the PCs return to the countryside to seek a solution to the undead problem. When they reach Gillamoor, the PCs learn that the town was once cursed by Illcayna so that any who died within the town’s grounds would rise as her undead thralls—and she plans to ritually cast a much more powerful version of the curse on the entire nation. The PCs must head to the town of Finder’s Gulch to defeat the Wight Mother once and for all.

The Hellbreakers League is more popular than ever after defeating Illcayna, but their increased profile allows Caeto to discern the location of their headquarters in Saringallow. The PCs barely escape capture and must first take the infamous Sarini Manor as a stronghold before planning the liberation of their fellow Hellbreakers.

The time has come to face Caeto himself. The PCs siege Saringallow with their gathered forces and allies, striking back to liberate their friends, reclaim their home, and secure their freedom at last.

ADVANCEMENT TRACK
Hellbreakers is designed for four characters.

1 The PCs begin this adventure at 1st level.
2 The PCs should be 2nd level after rescuing Rhokrag and defeating the Chelaxian loyalists.
3 The PCs should be 3rd level after defeating the Sisters of the Erinys.
4 The PCs should be 4th level after stopping Viro Ahala’s ritual and saving Isger.
5 The PCs should be 5th level after infiltrating Hedvend’s gala.
6 The PCs should be 6th level for solving Hedvend’s murder and stopping Ezio.
7 The PCs should be 7th level for escaping Elidir.
8 The PCs should be 8th level for defeating Illcayna and her undead hordes.
9 The PCs should be 9th level for taking back Sarini Manor.
The PCs should reach 10th level by the end of the adventure.

第1章：对抗地狱

当架刑团的地狱骑士在布雷奇希尔镇公开处决了退役的安多安将军雷金纳德·科莫斯，罪名是所谓“向反王室异见者提供援助，反对切利亚斯王冠”，他们点燃了一桶隐喻的火药——而它在地狱骑士丘之战中爆炸成一场战争。随着安多安的鹰骑士部队进驻伊斯嘉，地狱骑士撤入新近加固的阿尔泰雷因要塞。随后的围攻中，地狱破坏者联盟的叛军也加入战局——这是一群伊斯嘉公民，誓要把切利亚斯的军靴从祖国的咽喉上踢开。

尽管多数围城战都旷日持久、拖泥带水，地狱骑士丘之战的战斗却短促而残酷。许多渴望冲突的地狱骑士从要塞中出击，在布雷奇希尔及其周边与反切利亚斯势力交锋。某一刻，炼狱巨龙基罗萨克斯代表地狱骑士栖于阿尔泰雷因要塞之巅，将地狱之火倾泻到集结的军阵之上。

尽管双方都承受了惨重伤亡，自由与解放的力量最终获胜。他们屠杀了巨龙，击溃了地狱骑士，幸存的切利亚斯军队向西南溃逃，退回切利亚斯方向。鹰骑士、地狱破坏者及其盟友都疲惫不堪，无力追击，转而开始掩埋遍野尸骸、照料活着的伤者，并修复布雷奇希尔的建筑损毁。

retired Andoren general Reginald Cormoth in the 
town of Breachill for the alleged crime of “providing 
succor to dissidents against the crown of Cheliax,” they 
set alight a metaphorical powder keg that exploded 
into war with the Battle of Hellknight Hill. With the 
approach of Eagle Knight forces from Andoran into

their country’s neck.
While most other sieges are long, drawn-out affairs, 
the fighting at the Battle of Hellknight Hill was short 
and brutal. Many Hellknights, eager for conflict, 
ranged out of the citadel and clashed with anti-

their allies were too weary to give chase, and instead 
began the process of burying the fields of the dead, 
tending to the living wounded, and repairing damage 
to Breachill’s buildings.

Hellbreakers
ADVENTURE PATH

Chapter 1:
Against Hell

When Hellknights of the Rack publicly executed retired Andoren general Reginald Cormoth in the town of Breachill for the alleged crime of “providing succor to dissidents against the crown of Cheliax,” they set alight a metaphorical powder keg that exploded into war with the Battle of Hellknight Hill. With the approach of Eagle Knight forces from Andoran into Isger, the Hellknights retreated into a newly fortified Citadel Altaerein. The ensuing siege was joined by rebels of the Hellbreakers League, a group of Isgeri citizens looking to remove the boot of Cheliax from their country’s neck.

While most other sieges are long, drawn-out affairs, the fighting at the Battle of Hellknight Hill was short and brutal. Many Hellknights, eager for conflict, ranged out of the citadel and clashed with anti-Cheliax forces in and around Breachill. At one point, the diabolic dragon Kierothax perched atop Citadel Altaerein on behalf of the Hellknights and rained hellfire down upon the gathered armies.

Though both armies experienced heavy casualties, the forces of freedom and liberty eventually triumphed. They slew the dragon and routed the Hellknights, with the surviving Chelaxian forces fleeing southwest back toward Cheliax. The Eagle Knights, Hellbreakers, and their allies were too weary to give chase, and instead began the process of burying the fields of the dead, tending to the living wounded, and repairing damage to Breachill’s buildings.

## Page 12
每个人都有各自加入联盟的理由——也许他们是受够了切利亚斯统治的伊斯嘉公民，又或者他们是曾在“地狱骑士丘之战”中为联盟而战的雇佣兵。每位玩家都应从《破狱者玩家指南》中选择一个背景，使其角色与该组织建立联系。不论如何，他们都已同意帮助这位鹰骑士联络人——一名名叫伊斯兰·豪威尔（Ethran Howell）的杰出士兵——返回位于萨林加洛（Saringallow）的破狱者总部。

队伍成员是否早已彼此相识（并可能并肩作战过）由你们的团体决定；但他们都会在拉玛山月（Lamashan）4726 ar 的一个清爽秋夜，抵达布雷奇希尔（Breachill）的“凯登之桶”（Cayden’s Keg）。当他们走向这处兼具神殿与酒馆功能的场所时，镇上的总体氛围是欢庆的。

战后余波
布雷奇希尔的人民在鹰骑士与破狱者联盟的协助下，取得了一场重大胜利，将占领的地狱骑士驱逐出去。在压迫者的铁腕下熬过数周后，多数居民都松了一口气，不必再对自己的一举一动、一言一语都战战兢兢。然而，也有一些破狱者叛军很快指出：当他们的国家仍是切利亚斯的附庸国时，他们又能有多自由呢？不过那是改天再烦恼的问题；此刻的布雷奇希尔街头满是庆祝者——人们一边重建毁坏的家园，或悼念逝去的邻里，一边欢呼歌唱。

在凯登之桶，士气高涨更是无以复加——这里是一间酒馆，也是献给酒神凯登·凯琳（Cayden Cailean）的神殿。首席酒保兼女祭司布琳·泰瑟（Brynne Taithe，愉快的女性人类凯登·凯琳牧师 5 级）向许多伤者免费提供治疗服务；若有需要，她也提供食宿。战后以来，许多并肩作战的同袍与本地好心人都与PC们聚在一起，让麦酒不断流淌。酒馆里挤满了交谈饮酒的人群，一名乐手在角落演奏振奋人心的小提琴曲。酒馆壁炉里有一小团火噼啪作响，不过要抵御秋日天气，其实并不太需要这点热量——人潮的拥挤就足以做到这一点。

会见伊斯兰·豪威尔
当PC们踏入凯登之桶时，几名酒馆常客举起酒杯，热情高声向他们致意。PC们可以询问关于他们的联络人，或将目光投向人群；无论哪种方式，他们都会在一张拥挤的桌旁找到伊斯兰·豪威尔（务实的非二元性别人类士兵 4 级）。在“地狱骑士地狱之战”（Battle of Hellknight Hell）末期，伊斯兰的左臂遭受重创，别无选择只能截肢；自那以后，他们一直在凯登之桶休养。在此期间，伊斯兰决定专注于解放伊斯嘉这项重要事业，向破狱者联盟提供自己作为士兵与战术家的服务；鹰骑士方面也非正式地认可了伊斯兰的决定，并在档案中注明这位老兵处于“半永久疗养假”。当PC们接近伊斯兰时，朗读或转述以下内容。

伊斯兰·豪威尔身穿极具辨识度的蓝、黑、金三色胸甲，上面点缀着一枚金色鹰肩章，想不注意到都难。几名镇民挤在他们的桌边，感谢他们的服役，安慰他们失去的左臂，并替他们买酒。面对众人关注，伊斯兰看起来受宠若惊却又有些尴尬，他们对仰慕者说道：“各位，我很感激聊天与酒水，但我得先办正事。”

小人群在最后为伊斯兰欢呼一声后散开，给这名士兵的桌旁留出了充足空间。伊斯兰露出微笑，看起来稍稍松了口气。

“大家都兴高采烈，这也理所应当。要来一杯吗？”

伊斯兰对政治局势很敏感，能够解释任何玩家尚不熟悉、导致“地狱骑士丘之战”爆发的相关因素。若被问及，他们会描述与两名地狱骑士交战并因此负伤的经过。若有任何PC也参与了那场战斗，伊斯兰会举杯简短致敬，肯定他们对胜利的贡献。

在众人尚未来得及讨论即将启程的旅程之前，布琳摇响了吧台后方挂着的一只铃铛，以吸引酒客注意。人群随即安静下来，小提琴手也在半段旋律中停住；铃声清亮，回荡不绝。布琳俯身靠在吧台上，高声招呼：“来吧，朋友们！以我们挚爱的凯登·凯琳所推崇的一切欢乐与美好之名，今晚的比赛时间到了！”

欢呼声爆发开来，本地人兴奋地低声议论，猜测今晚故事比赛的主题会是什么。

漫长的历史
布雷奇希尔曾是《灰烬年代》冒险路径前几册的设定地；该战役中的数个地点与NPC会出现在本章开头。若想进一步了解布雷奇希尔及其居民，你可以阅读《Pathfinder 冒险 Path #145：地狱骑士丘》（Hellknight Hill）第62页的文章“布雷奇希尔：秘密前哨”（“Breachill, Outpost of Secrets”）。

The Aftermath of Battle
The people of Breachill, with the aid of the Eagle 
Knights and the Hellbreakers League, won a major 
victory by driving out the occupying Hellknights. 
After weeks of surviving under the iron fists of their 
oppressors, most residents are relieved to not have 
to watch their every move and word. However, as 
some Hellbreaker rebels are quick to point out: how 
free could they possibly be when their country is 
still a vassal state to Cheliax? But that’s a problem 
for another day, as the streets of Breachill fill with 
celebrants, cheering and singing even as they rebuild 
ruined homes or honor their fallen neighbors.
Nowhere are spirits as high as they are at Cayden’s 
Keg, a tavern and temple to the drunken god Cayden 
Cailean. The primary bartender and priestess Brynne 
Taithe (jovial female human cleric of Cayden Cailean 
5) has offered her healing services for free to many 
of the wounded, as well as room and board if they 
require it. Many comrades-in-arms and various local 
well-wishers congregate alongside the PCs, keeping 
the ale flowing since the battle’s end. The alehouse is 
packed with people chattering and drinking, while a 
single musician plays rousing fiddle tunes from one 
corner. A small fire crackles in the tavern’s fireplace, 
though its heat is hardly necessary to keep out the 
autumnal weather—the press of bodies does that 
particular work.
MEETING ETHRAN HOWELL
Several tavern patrons raise their mugs and loudly 
greet the PCs as they enter Cayden’s Keg. The PCs can 
ask about their contact or cast their eyes across the 
crowd; either way, they find Ethran Howell (pragmatic 
nonbinary human soldier 4) at a crowded table. The 
soldier’s left arm was gravely wounded late in the 
Battle of Hellknight Hell, leaving no choice but for 
it to be amputated, and they’ve been recuperating at 
Cayden’s Keg since then. During that time, Ethran 
decided to focus on the important work of helping to 
liberate Isger by offering their services as a soldier and 
tactician to the Hellbreakers League; the Eagle Knights 
have unofficially approved of Ethran’s decision, 
noting in the records that the veteran is on “semi-
permanent convalescence leave.” Read or paraphrase 
the following when the PCs approach Ethran.
Ethran Howell is difficult to miss in their distinctive blue, 
black, and golden breastplate decorated with a single 
golden eagle epaulet. Several townspeople crowd their 
table thanking them for their service, commiserating 
about their left arm, and buying them drinks. Ethran looks 
flattered but slightly embarrassed by the attention as they 
say to their admirers, “Fellows, I appreciate the chat and 
the drinks, but I must attend to business.” The small crowd 
disperses with a final cheer for Ethran, leaving plenty of 
space at the soldier’s table. Ethran smiles, looking a little 
relieved. “Everyone’s in high spirits, as they’re right to be. 
Would you like a drink?”

factors leading up to the Battle of Hellknight Hill

The crowd hushes and the fiddler stops mid-tune as the

of all things fun and good as our beloved Cayden Cailean 
would have it, it’s time for tonight’s contest!” Cheers erupt

Whether the party has met one another already (and possibly fought together) is up to your group, but they all arrive at Cayden’s Keg in Breachill on a crisp fall evening in Lamashan 4726 ar. As they head to this combination temple and alehouse, the overall mood in the town is celebratory.

The Aftermath of Battle
The people of Breachill, with the aid of the Eagle Knights and the Hellbreakers League, won a major victory by driving out the occupying Hellknights. After weeks of surviving under the iron fists of their oppressors, most residents are relieved to not have to watch their every move and word. Many comrades-in-arms and various local well-wishers congregate alongside the PCs, keeping the ale flowing since the battle’s end. The alehouse is packed with people chattering and drinking, while a single musician plays rousing fiddle tunes from one corner. A small fire crackles in the tavern’s fireplace, though its heat is hardly necessary to keep out the autumnal weather—the press of bodies does that particular work.

MEETING ETHRAN HOWELL

Ethran smiles, looking a little relieved. “Everyone’s in high spirits, as they’re right to be. Would you like a drink?”

Ethran is politically aware and can explain any factors leading up to the Battle of Hellknight Hill that the players aren’t yet familiar with. ## Page 13
布琳妮举起一杯冒着泡沫的酒。“为把镇上的渣滓赶出去的各位干杯，今晚的主题是——过去的战斗！勇敢的战士与狡黠的猎人们，讲出你们的故事吧，让我们看看谁讲得最好！”

## 故事之夜
“凯登之桶”的大祭司会定期举办夜间讲故事比赛，既能提振顾客情绪，也能让酒水源源不断。毕竟人人都爱听好故事，而人们往往也会为了连续听到一串故事而待得更久——同时继续点更多酒。

伊斯兰鼓励PC们参加，但不会逼迫任何角色，尤其当某位角色的过往似乎可能是个痛点时更是如此。这也是玩家更全面介绍自己角色的好机会：分享一点背景故事（或者编出一个巧妙的虚构故事），让队伍关系更紧密。

当PC们决定是否参加时，其他顾客已开始讲起他们的故事。每个人都走到酒馆大厅中央说话，所有目光都注视着、所有耳朵都倾听着。大多数人讲述自己参与“地狱骑士丘之战”的简短经历，也有人编织关于英勇狩猎的传奇，或是与诱惑进行个人搏斗的故事。PC可以在任何时刻走到房间中央开口，从而参加比赛。

每位想讲故事的角色都应尝试一次DC 15技能检定；以表演为默认技能，但若角色是在瞎编乱造，则可以用欺瞒；若角色意在吓唬观众，则可以用威吓。若玩家想讲的故事与其角色的背景直接相关，则可以使用该背景所提供的学识（技能）来进行检定。其他技能是否适用由GM酌情决定。

若失败，人群会给角色些许礼貌的掌声，但显然他们并不买账。若成功，酒馆里会有更热烈的反应：欢呼起哄；若故事悲伤，甚至会有人当众落泪。记录每次技能检定结果中达到或超过DC的数值。夜晚结束时，布琳妮宣布：在这些记录下来的结果中最高者对应的那位角色为胜者。聚集的酒客们欢呼声几乎要掀翻屋顶；布琳妮将“桶”里最上等（也最昂贵）的麦酒以数大杯之多赠与胜者。伊斯兰也赞赏地把自己的酒杯重重敲在桌上。

又狂欢了一个小时后，伊斯兰表示自己累了，并告诉PC们第二天早上再见面，商讨前往萨林加洛的旅程细节。尽管“凯登之桶”不出租房间（房间要留给疗养中的伤者），布琳妮还是告诉PC们可以去“大梦之家”（蝶娜神殿）或“巫师恩典”（当地旅店）投宿。他们也可以在城外扎营，那里有不少来访的军队。

**奖励：**若至少一名PC在讲故事检定中成功，给予PC们30 XP；若成功者超过半数，则额外给予10 XP。此外，若成功者超过半数，布琳妮会感谢他们为酒馆带来精彩表演，并在他们离开前赠予两瓶次级治疗药水，同时表示凯登告诉她，他们在“前方的路上”可能会用得着。

## 来自艾利迪尔的消息
第二天清晨，布里奇尔到处都在谈论拂晓时分传来的、来自艾利迪尔的消息。显然，伊斯格尔政府以一种令人沮丧的含糊方式，对“持异见者与革命者”悬赏大笔赏金。任何读过张贴在布里奇尔市政厅外的那份法令文本的人都看得出来：管家海德文德六世（卑怯的男性人类贵族9级）正试图通过鼓励平民自行采取行动，来压制任何反切里亚克斯的活动。

一名PC若在DC 16社交检定或DC 14法律学识检定中成功，就会意识到：人们可以利用这份悬赏来与邻居清算旧怨——其模式与“猎巫”相似——同时还能赚点钱。

当PC们返回“凯登之桶”与伊斯兰会合时，他们能看出这条消息如何给小镇蒙上阴影，在某种程度上盖过了前一晚的庆祝氛围。街上的人们彼此低声嘀咕，谈论附近城镇在“地狱骑士丘之战”的结果之后会如何对待他们。一小群人聚集在市政厅附近的纪念碑环，抗议这份法令，并公开谴责让布里奇尔居民彼此告发的想法。就目前而言，PC们应当觉得这里仍然安全。

若他们对自身安全表达任何疑虑，伊斯兰会向PC们保证：这里没人会把他们告发出去。不过伊斯兰也指出，离开布里奇尔后情况就不同了。他们原本计划先向南到科涅里卡河，再向西前往萨林加洛，但现在他们认为最好直接前往地狱破坏者联盟总部，

**伊斯兰·豪厄尔**

tonight’s storytelling will be. Brynne raises a frothy glass. 
“In honor of those who drove out the scum from our town, 
the theme of the evening is past battles! Tell us your 
stories, brave warriors and wily hunters, and let’s 
see who tells them best!”
NIGHT OF TALES
The head priestess of Cayden’s Keg 
regularly holds evening storytelling contests 
to both boost the mood of her customers 
and as a way to keep the alcohol flowing. 
After all, everyone loves to hear a 
good story and people usually 
stick around to hear a bunch of 
them told in succession—ordering more 
drinks in the meantime. Ethran encourages 
the PCs to participate but doesn’t pressure any of 
the characters, especially if it seems like a character’s 
history might be a sore subject. This is a good way for 
players to introduce their characters more thoroughly, 
giving a little backstory (or creating a clever fiction) to 
bring the group closer together.
As the PCs decide whether they wish to participate, 
other customers begin to tell their tales. Each one 
steps to the center of the tavern floor to speak, with 
all eyes watching and all ears listening. Most relate 
a brief story about their participation in the Battle of 
Hellknight Hill, while others spin yarns about a heroic 
hunt or a personal battle with temptation. A PC can 
enter the contest by speaking up from the center of the 
room at any point.
Each character who wants to tell a tale should 
attempt a DC 15 skill check; Performance is the 
default skill, but a character could use Deception if 
they are confabulating or Intimidation if they are 
trying to scare the audience. If the player wants to 
tell a story that directly relates to their character’s 
background, they could attempt a check using the 
Lore skill provided by that background. Other skills 
are applicable at the GM’s discretion.
On a failure, the crowd gives the character some light 
applause, but it’s clear that they’re unimpressed. On 
a success, the tavern gives a livelier response, hooting 
with delight or even openly weeping if the tale was a 
sad one. Record the result of each skill check result 
that meets or exceeds the DC. At the end of the night, 
Brynne declares the character whose story represents 
the highest of those results the winner. The assembled 
drinkers cheer loud enough to nearly bring down the 
roof as Brynne presents the winner with several mugs of 
the Keg’s finest (and most expensive) ale. Ethran bangs 
their own mug on the table in appreciation as well.
After another hour of carousing, Ethran declares 
that they’re tired and tells the PCs they’ll meet up 
again in the morning to discuss the details of the 
journey to Saringallow. Though Cayden’s Keg 
isn’t renting out rooms (they’re saved for 
those convalescing), Brynne tells the PCs they 
can find lodging at the Great Dreamhouse, a 
temple to Desna, or Wizard’s Grace, a local 
inn. They can also camp outside, near much 
of the visiting military.
Reward: If at least one PC succeeds at the 
storytelling check, award the PCs 30 XP; if 
more than half the PCs succeed, award them an 
additional 10 XP. In addition, if more than 
half the PCs succeed, Brynne thanks them 
for entertaining the tavern and gives them 
two minor healing potions before they leave, 
noting that Cayden told her they might need them “on 
the road ahead.”
NEWS FROM ELIDIR
The next morning, Breachill is abuzz with talk of news 
out of Elidir that arrived around dawn. Apparently, 
the Isgeri government placed a sizable bounty on 
“dissenters and revolutionaries” in a manner that is 
frustratingly vague. It’s obvious to anyone who reads 
the text of the decree posted outside Breachill’s town 
hall that Steward Hedvend VI (sniveling male human 
aristocrat 9) is trying to squash any anti-Chelaxian 
activities by encouraging private citizens to take 
matters into their own hands. A PC who succeeds at 
a DC 16 Society check or DC 14 Legal Lore check 
realizes that people can use this bounty to settle 
grudges with their neighbors—similar in fashion as to 
what happens during a witch hunt—while collecting 
a bit of coin.
As the PCs return to Cayden’s Keg to meet Ethran, 
they can see how this news has cast a pall over the 
town, somewhat eclipsing the celebratory mood of the 
previous evening. People in the street mutter to each 
other about how nearby towns might treat them after 
the results of the Battle of Hellknight Hill. A small 
crowd has gathered in Monument Circle near town 
hall to protest the decree and publicly decrying the 
idea of Breachill citizens turning on one another. The 
PCs should feel safe here for now.
Should they express any doubts about their safety, 
Ethran assures the PCs that no one here is likely to 
turn them in. They do note that it’ll be a different 
matter outside of Breachill. Their original plan was 
to travel south to the Conerica River and then west 
to Saringallow, but now they think it’s best to head 
directly to the Hellbreakers League headquarters,

## Page 14
……沿陆路向西南方向旅行。埃斯兰还建议他们尽可能低调行事；至少他们打算把自己的鹰骑士制服藏进一只箱子里。若有任何PC佩戴着明显表明自己效忠于“破狱者联盟”（或其他革命团体）的标记，埃斯兰建议把这些标志取下。

## 前往萨灵盖洛
埃斯兰已为这趟旅程买好了一匹马和一辆马车。他们希望在一小时内出发，让PC有机会按自己所需购买旅途物资。他们将在路上走大约半周时间，但埃斯兰说途中大概也会有机会购买更多口粮与其他物品。

这位鹰骑士驾着马车驶离布里奇希尔。PC可以坐在马车里、与埃斯兰的箱子同乘，也可以在旁边骑行或步行跟随。队伍出发时，天空灰暗多云，预示着会有些秋雨。出城的道路先向西延伸，之后渐渐转向西南，路旁经过一片片农场，田地已空，收获早已入仓。马车车轮隆隆作响之中，埃斯兰会与PC闲聊，或许会问起他们前一晚讲过的故事，追问其真实性，或让他们补充更多细节。

第一天结束时，队伍来到一间路边旅店，PC能在外头的告示牌上看到赫德文德的法令抄本。店内的几名客人若有人询问，就会低声抱怨这国家对任何人都不再安全，但他们究竟是指提防切利亚斯的干预，还是提防叛军活动，却并不明确。

接下来两天的旅行中，PC会看到更多赫德文德的法令，被钉在路旁的树干与篱笆柱上。埃斯兰警告众人应当保持低调，不要把这些告示撕下来。

## 德雷穆尔之路（中等1）
离开布里奇希尔旅行的第4天午后，马车进入一座名为德雷穆尔的小型农耕村落。

唯一的一条路两侧只有几栋矮胖的建筑；刚下过雨，道路泥泞不堪。村民照常忙着自己的活计，只偶尔瞥一两眼队伍。埃斯兰把马车驾到一间杂货店旁，小心地下车走入店内。“我去补充些补给，”他们说，“应该只要几分钟。能帮我看着马车吗？”

埃斯兰进去没多久，就有四个满脸怒气的人从德雷穆尔那间小酒馆里晃了出来，朝马车走来。每个人身上都缝着一块仓促裁制的补丁，上面画着切利亚斯的旗帜；他们都带着一把轻型钉头锤与一把十字弩，不过尚未拔出。他们上前盘问PC从哪里来、来镇上做什么。此次遭遇使用第14页的“德雷穆尔之路”地图。

**生物：**这些当地人忠于切利亚斯对伊斯嘉的统治，对所有陌生人都抱持怀疑。PC可以尝试通过完成两次DC 15的【欺瞒】、【交涉】或【威吓】检定，让这些忠诚派别来找麻烦；每次检定可由不同人尝试，且两次可用不同技能或重复使用同一技能。若PC成功，则这些忠诚派会视队伍采取的手段而被安抚或被吓退。

若PC在成功之前先失败两次检定，这些忠诚派便会动武。其中两人用轻型钉头锤近战，另外两人退后以十字弩射击。战斗中，忠诚派会尽量彼此相邻。若PC击倒其中两名忠诚派，剩下两名就会逃跑。若每名忠诚派都降到5生命值以下，他们也会全体逃跑。冲突期间，村里其他居民会躲进屋内。德雷穆尔没有当地执法者，且该地区的治安官要再过四天才会巡到这里，因此一旦忠诚派被赶跑或被杀死，PC在此地便不会再遇到进一步的危险。

traveling southwest overland. Ethran also suggests they 
move as incognito as possible; they, for one, intend to 
hide their Eagle Knight regalia in a trunk. If any PCs 
sport obvious allegiances to the Hellbreakers League 
(or other revolutionary groups), Ethran recommends 
removing those symbols.
Setting out for Saringallow
Ethran has purchased a horse and a wagon for the 
journey. They wish to leave within the hour, giving 
the PCs an opportunity to purchase any supplies 
for the trip as they see fit. They’ll be on the road 
for about half a week, but Ethran says that they’ll 
probably have opportunities to buy more rations and 
other items on the way.
The Eagle Knight drives the wagon out of Breachill. 
The PCs can take seats in the wagon with Ethran’s 
trunk or ride or walk alongside. When the group 
sets out, the sky is gray and cloudy, presaging some 
autumnal rains. The road out of town leads west, then 
eventually turns a bit southwest, passing by farms with 
empty fields, their harvests already collected. Ethran 
makes small talk over the rumbling of the cart’s 
wheels, perhaps asking the PCs about any stories they 
told the night before, inquiring into their veracity or 
asking for more details. At the end of the first day, the 
group comes to a roadside inn where the PCs can spot 
a copy of Hedvend’s decree on a signboard outside. 
The few patrons inside mutter a bit about the country 
not being safe anymore to anyone who asks, but it 
isn’t clear whether they mean safe from Chelaxian 
intervention or from rebel activity.
During the next two days of travel, the PCs spot 
more copies of Hedvend’s decree nailed to trees and 
fence posts along the road. Ethran warns the characters 
that they should keep a low profile and not tear down 
these notices.
DRAYMOOR ROAD	
MODERATE 1
Midafternoon on the fourth day of travel out of 
Breachill, the wagon enters the small farming village 
of Draymoor.
Only a few squat buildings line the single road, which is 
muddy from a recent rain. The villagers go about their daily 
business with only a glance or two at the group. Ethran 
draws the horse alongside a general store and carefully 
climbs down to enter. “I’ll restock our supplies,” they say. 
“It should only take a few minutes. Watch the wagon, 
would you?”
Not long after Ethran heads inside, four angry-
looking individuals saunter out of Draymoor’s small 
tavern and begin to approach the wagon. Each of them 
wears hastily sewn patches depicting the flag of Cheliax 
and are armed with a light mace and a crossbow, 
though they haven’t drawn them. They accost the 
PCs with questions about where they’re coming from 
and what their business is in town. Use the Draymoor 
Road map on page 14 for this encounter.
Creatures: These locals are loyal to Cheliax’s rule 
over Isger and suspicious of all strangers. The PCs 
can try to get these loyalists to leave them alone by 
succeeding at two DC 15 Deception, Diplomacy, or 
Intimidation checks; each check can be attempted by 
a different person and they can use different skills or 
the same skill twice. If the PCs succeed, the loyalists 
are either mollified or scared off depending on the 
group’s tactics.
If the PCs fail two of these checks before they 
succeed, the loyalists get violent. Two of the loyalists 
fight with their light maces while the other two stand 
back and fire their crossbows. The loyalists try to 
remain adjacent to one another as they fight. If the 
PCs knock out two of the loyalists, the other two 
flee. The loyalists all flee if each of them is below 5 
Hit Points. During an altercation, the other village 
residents disappear indoors. Draymoor has no local 
law enforcement and the area’s sheriff won’t make her 
rounds here for another four days, so once the loyalists 
have been driven off or killed, the PCs are in no further 
danger here.

## Page 15
……切里亚克忠党在战斗中。当埃斯兰回到马车旁时，他们把自己买来的强效水晶与次级萎缩炸弹（第209页）交给PC。

RIVER CROSSING 严峻1
一天半之后，队伍在黄昏前抵达北科内里卡河。他们只要渡过这条河，就能进入前往萨林加洛的最后一段路程。

一艘固定班次的渡船来回穿梭于宽阔的河面。另有一大群人比PC早几分钟订下了船位，因此队伍不得不等渡船回来，才能搭上当天傍晚最后一趟。

河对岸能看见一间河畔旅店，而PC所在的这一岸只有一间小棚屋与一处码头。

在他们等待期间，GM应为每名PC进行一次秘密DC 16的察觉检定。检定成功者会在落日映衬下看见两道剪影——似乎是两只大型飞行生物正快速逼近；任何检定成功的PC在即将到来的战斗中，其先攻还会获得+1环境加值。此遭遇使用上方的“河流渡口”地图。

生物：伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺（Illcayna Alonnor，邪恶女性，乌拉戈娅之女 9；第242页）多年来一直在伊斯嘉活动，而这场战争让她得以趁机将夺取该国的计划进一步升级。当她在西方数十里外的“寻者峡谷”积聚力量时，她的死灵造物有时会远离城镇游荡。一对不死巨蝙蝠最近飞上天空寻找受害者，把山坡上各种动物变成丧尸。虽然玩家不太可能得知这些丧尸蝙蝠从何而来，但它们的出现预示了后续章节中等待着的亡灵麻烦。

丧尸蝙蝠会一直战斗到被摧毁为止。若战斗中看起来PC陷入困境，埃斯兰可以给他们一些战术建议。每一轮，他们会尝试以+10调整值进行一次战争学识检定来援助（Aid）一名处境艰难的PC下一次打击（Strike）。除此之外，他们会尽量待在马车附近以安抚马匹；但若受到丧尸蝙蝠的腐烂灵光影响，他们也会移出其范围。

Chelaxian loyalists in combat. When Ethran returns

RIVER CROSSING	
SEVERE 1
A day and a half later, the group arrives at the North 
Conerica River just before dusk. They only have to 
cross the river before the home stretch to Saringallow. 
A regular ferry shuttles travelers back and forth across 
the wide river. Another large group booked passage 
several minutes before the PCs, so the party has to wait 
until the ferry returns for its last trip of the evening. A 
riverside inn can be seen on the far bank, while the side 
the PCs are on features only a small shack and dock.
While they wait, the GM should attempt a secret DC 
16 Perception check for each PC. Those who succeed 
spot a pair of silhouettes against the setting sun that 
seem to be large flying creatures approaching fast; any 
successful PCs also receive a +1 circumstance bonus 
to their initiative in the upcoming fight. Use the River 
Crossing map above for this encounter.
Creatures: Illcayna Alonnor (malevolent female 
daughter of Urgathoa 9; page 242) has been operating 
in Isger for years, and the war has given her the 
opportunity to escalate her plans to take the nation. 
As she gathers her power in Finder’s Gulch dozens of 
miles to the west, her necromantic creations sometimes 
range far from the town. A pair of undead giant bats 
recently took to the skies in search of victims, turning 
various animals across the hillside into zombies. While 
the players are unlikely to learn where these zombie 
bats came from, their appearance foreshadows the 
undead troubles that await in later chapters. The 
zombie bats fight until they are destroyed.
If it looks like the PCs are having trouble during 
this fight, Ethran can offer them some tactical advice. 
Each round, they attempt to Aid a struggling PC’s next 
Strike by attempting a Warfare Lore check with a +10 
modifier. They otherwise try to stay near the wagon to 
keep the horse calm, but they do move out of a zombie 
bat’s rotting aura if subjected to it.

渡船抵达（The Ferry Arrives）：在PC们击败丧尸巨蝠后不久，渡船返回河的这一侧。渡夫乌托（Utto）对队伍的安全十分担忧，迅速把他们和马车催促上船。当船只再次横渡时，乌托询问PC们是什么袭击了他们；若他们如实告知，他便了然地点点头。

“我表亲跟我说，自从那些关于神祇的玩意儿从天上掉下来之后，死人就一直不怎么安分。她觉得这事跟住在恩卡坦湖上的那个巫妖有关。”

一名PC若成功通过DC 18社交或政治学识检定，便听说过“那个巫妖”塔尔-巴风（塔巴丰）最近的行动大多集中在死坟末土，并试图征服贝尔克岑（Belkzen）的兽人。

一名PC若成功通过DC 14宗教或丧尸学识检定，则知道不死生物袭击可能出于多种原因，并非所有情况都与某个阴险的死灵法师试图统治世界有关。

欢迎来到破狱者总部（Welcome to Hellbreakers Headquarters）

乘渡船过河后，PC们可以在旅店过夜，并在次日清晨继续前往萨林加洛（Saringallow）。途中不再发生其他事件；他们在午后抵达城镇东北门。

萨林加洛是一座坐落于科内里卡河（Conerica River）畔的大型城墙城镇，数百年前由切利亚斯贵族萨里尼（Sarini）家族以“萨里尼谷地”（Sarini’s Hollow）之名建立。经历一连串神秘死亡后，镇民起而反抗萨里尼家族，并将其公开绞死，使城镇得到了更为阴郁的绰号。关于该镇的秘学历史与当前居民的更多细节，见第201页。

尽管这座城镇并不喜爱切利亚斯贵族，破狱者联盟在此仍必须保持一定程度的隐秘行动。无论PC们是否来自萨林加洛，或是否曾经造访过此地，他们都知道：联盟总部位于城镇东侧一栋不起眼的两层民宅的地下室。

传言称，这处住所曾是某位炼金术士的家，而他后来被恶魔影响所腐化。其家人此后已迁离萨林加洛；破狱者联盟的创始人买下了这栋房子，并建造了一处大型地下室，以便筹划他们的革命。特工们有时会住在这栋房子里，但这里不足以容纳整个联盟。

为进入总部，PC们知道要敲响前门并宣告自己是“玫瑰之友”。这句话指的是女神密拉妮（密拉妮）——反抗不公与暴政之人的守护者；她的宗教圣徽是一朵浸在血泊中的玫瑰。

一名黑发人类女性开门，微笑着说道：“下午好！玫瑰之友都能在这里找到庇护。”

这正是对PC们那句话的正确回应，指涉密拉妮的天界领域“红玫瑰的庇护所”（Refuge of the Red Rose）。开门的女子是梅尔·费兰（Maire Phelan）（开朗的女性人类说书人3级）；她把PC们招呼进屋后作了自我介绍。

房屋的主室看起来就像典型而温馨的居所：东墙有壁炉，中央摆着一张大餐桌。关上前门后，梅尔走向南墙上一扇朴素的木门，用一把铁钥匙将其打开。门后是一段楼梯，通往破狱者联盟跃动的核心。

楼梯底部前方是一间宽阔的地下室，塞满了几张桌子、几把椅子，几乎每一面墙上都挂着伊斯嘉（伊斯嘉）的地图。桌上堆着文件、账簿以及更多地图。一名高大的霍布地精男子正翻检这些文件，神情严肃。

一间侧室被清空了所有家具，两名年轻士兵正在其中对练。另一处更小的凹室里有一座经魔法加热的铁炉，散发出……

The Ferry Arrives: Shortly after the PCs defeat the 
zombie giant bats, the ferry returns to their side of 
the river. Utto, the ferry operator, is concerned about 
the group’s safety and quickly ushers them and the 
wagon onto his ferry. As the vessel makes its way 
back across, Utto asks the PCs what attacked them 
and if told, he nods his head knowingly. “My cousin 
told me that the dead have been mighty restless ever 
since all that god stuff fell from the sky. She thinks it 
has something to do with that lich what lives on Lake 
Encarthan.”
A PC who succeeds at a DC 18 Society or Politics 
Lore check has heard that “that lich” Tar-Baphon has 
mostly been concentrating his recent efforts on the 
Gravelands and attempting to subjugate the orcs of 
Belkzen. A PC who succeeds at a DC 14 Religion or 
Zombie Lore check knows that undead attacks can 
happen for a number of reasons, not all of which are 
related to a sinister necromancer trying to take over 
the world.
Welcome to Hellbreakers 
Headquarters
After crossing the river on the ferry, the PCs can 
spend the night at the inn and then continue on to 
Saringallow the next morning. There are no further 
incidents, and they arrive in the midafternoon at the 
northeastern gates.
Saringallow is a large walled town on the Conerica 
River that was founded as Sarini’s Hollow by the 
Chelaxian noble Sarini family a few centuries ago. 
After a series of mysterious deaths, the townspeople 
rose up against the Sarinis and publicly hanged them, 
giving the town its more somber sobriquet. More 
details about the town’s occult history and its 
current inhabitants can be found on page 201.
Despite the town having no love for 
Chelaxian nobles, the Hellbreakers League 
must still operate with some modicum of 
secrecy here. Regardless of whether PCs 
are from Saringallow or have visited 
the town before, they know that the 
League’s headquarters is in the basement 
of an unassuming two-story house on 
the eastern side of town. Rumors hold 
that the domicile was once the home 
of an alchemist who was corrupted by 
a demonic influence. His family has since 
moved away from Saringallow, and the founders of 
the Hellbreakers League purchased the house and 
constructed a large basement in which to plan their 
revolution. Agents sometimes stay in the house, but it 
isn’t large enough to lodge the entire League.
To gain entrance, the PCs know to knock on the front 
door and announce that they are “friends of Rose.” This 
is a reference to the goddess Milani, the patron of those 
who fight against injustice and tyranny and whose 
religious symbol is a rose in a pool of blood.
A dark-haired human woman opens the door and says 
with a smile, “Afternoon! Any friends of Rose can find 
refuge here.”
This is the proper response to the phrase the PCs 
gave, a reference to Milani’s celestial domain, the 
Refuge of the Red Rose. The woman answering the 
door is Maire Phelan (jovial female human storyteller 
3), who introduces herself after waving the PCs 
inside. The house’s main room looks like a typical 
cozy residence, with a hearth on the east wall and a 
large dining table in the center. After closing the front 
door, Maire approaches a plain wooden door in the 
southern wall, which she unlocks with an iron key. 
This leads to a set of stairs descending into the beating 
heart of the Hellbreakers League.
A wide basement stretches in front of the bottom of the 
staircase, crammed with several tables, a handful of chairs, 
and maps of Isger hung on nearly every wall. The tables 
are piled with documents, ledgers, and more maps. A tall 
hobgoblin man sorts through the documents, a stern look 
on his face. A side room has been cleared of all furniture, 
and two young soldiers spar within. A second, smaller 
alcove holds a magically heated iron stove that gives off

## Page 17
……散发出温暖与光亮，却没有烟。一名白发的半身人站在炉子旁，手里端着一只装满点心的平底锅。

梅尔提醒聚集在此的众人，他们最新招募的成员已经（或说再次）从布雷奇希尔带着他们的鹰骑士盟友抵达。罗赫克拉格（老练的男性大地精战士 3）第一个上前欢迎PC；他迅速打量众人，似乎很满意。他想立刻向PC进行任务汇报，但泽拉·蓝瓶（和善的性别流动半身人面包师 2）温柔地责怪他太过正式。她把刚在炉子上烤热的肉桂黏面包递给PC，并让他们若是旅途劳累就随意搬椅子坐下。与此同时，两名新兵科尔·阿克顿与“兔子”·德莱登（热切的男性与女性人类新兵 1）也暂停训练，加入泽拉烘焙点心的分享。

这些NPC依次自我介绍，而罗赫克拉格告知PC：地狱破除者联盟的创始人与领袖——阿尔塞奥（睿智的男性艾尤瓦林牧师 7）与菲比·德米特里亚斯（正义的女性人类战士 7）——目前身在埃利迪尔，正竭力从源头阻止赫德文德对异见者悬赏。虽然他们无法直接联系伊斯嘉的总管，但他们正暗中试图影响政府中的其他成员，希望借此迫使赫德文德撤销悬赏。

泽拉告诉PC，如果他们想今晚在这栋房子里休息也没问题，不过二楼的住处会有些拥挤。伊瑟兰也需要暂时留在这里，直到联盟为其找到更长期的居所。多数地狱破除者要么在萨林加洛有自己的住所，要么在任务间隙住在城里的旅店。梅尔告诉PC，他们也可以去“魔鬼终曲”，那里对联盟成员提供折扣价（每晚5银币，可住两人的独立房间）。

但在PC入睡前，罗赫克拉格需要他们先为组织办一件事。

宝藏：在抵达地狱破除者总部后的某个时间点，伊瑟兰会因PC护送其前往萨林加洛而将一把+1巨剑交给PC。伊瑟兰解释说，自己只剩一只手臂，用不上这把剑了。“反正我的工作现在是教导人，”他们微笑着说道。

仓库疑云

随着PC完成他们在地狱破除者联盟的第一次正式任务，组织立刻又交给他们另一项差事。罗赫克拉格解释说：补给——护甲、武器、弹药、口粮等等——就是让革命之火燃烧的燃料，而联盟始终非常缺这些。屋内的总部没有足够空间储存这类物资，因此联盟以“长春花进口商”的名义（一个虚构的贸易公司名，也是对密拉妮的又一次致意）将物资存放在码头的一间仓库里。

一些特工会伪装成商人，带着（通常是偷来的）补给进城，将其转移进仓库，然后再返回乡间执行下一次任务。今天早晨，一艘与联盟有关的船只抵达码头，带来了来自洛加斯的物资。初级地狱破除者格特劳德·米尔登霍尔（自信的女性半身人走私者 –1）本该在仓库与他们碰头并清点货物，但她至今还未回到总部。

罗赫克拉格开始怀疑出了不对劲的事，因为格特劳德以守时闻名。萨林加洛并非完全没有切利亚斯的忠诚派，他们巴不得抓住机会领取一笔丰厚的悬赏。更糟的是，这批来自洛加斯的补给原本要用于支援数个外勤任务，而联盟的武器与弹药也快见底了。PC被派去仓库查看格特劳德是否遭遇了什么。

不幸的是，罗赫克拉格的怀疑是对的。一小撮来自洛加斯的切利亚斯忠诚派伪装成地狱破除者登上了那艘船，并哄骗一名码头工人说出了联盟仓库的位置。他们把船开到仓库，等格特劳德到达后将她掳走并挟为人质，意图抓捕任何前来仓库的其他异见者，以增加他们能拿到的悬赏。

warmth and light but no smoke. A white-haired halfling 
stands next to the stove, holding a pan filled with pastries.
Maire alerts the assembled group that their newest 
recruits have arrived (or returned) from Breachill 
with their Eagle Knight ally. Rhokrag (hardened male 
hobgoblin warrior 3) is the first to step forward and 
welcome the PCs; he quickly sizes them up and appears 
satisfied. He wants to debrief the PCs immediately, 
but Xerra Bluebottle (kind genderfluid halfling baker 
2) gently chides him for being so formal. She offers 
the PCs the sticky buns she was just toasting on the 
stove and tells them to grab chairs if they’re tired from 
the journey. Meanwhile, the two recruits, Cole Acton 
and “Rabbit” Dryden (eager male and female human 
recruits 1), pause their training to also partake of 
Xerra’s baked goods. The NPCs introduce themselves, 
and Rhokrag informs the PCs that the Hellbreakers 
League’s founders and leaders, Alceo (wise male 
aiuvarin cleric 7) and Phoebe Demetrias (righteous 
female human warrior 7), are currently in Elidir, doing 
their best to stop Hedvend’s bounty on dissidents at 
the source. While they don’t have direct contact with 
Isger’s steward, they’re surreptitiously trying to sway 
other members of the government in the hopes of 
pressuring Hedvend to rescind the bounty.
Xerra tells the PCs that if they want to rest in the 
house tonight, they can, though the second-floor 
accommodations will be a little cramped. Ethran needs 
to stay here as well until the League can find them a 
more permanent abode. Most Hellbreakers either have 
their own residences in Saringallow or stay at an inn 
in town between missions. Maire tells the PCs they 
can go the Fiend’s Finale, which gives discount rates 
to League members (5 sp a night for a private room 
that sleeps two).
But before the PCs can sleep, Rhokrag needs them 
to do something for the organization first.
Treasure: At some point after reaching the 
Hellbreakers headquarters, Ethran gives the PCs their 
+1 greatsword for escorting them to Saringallow. 
Ethran explains that with only one arm, they won’t 
have much use for it. “My job is to teach now, anyway,” 
they say with a smile.
Warehouse Mystery
With their first official mission for the Hellbreakers 
League complete, the PCs are immediately tasked 
with another. Rhokrag explains that supplies—armor, 
weapons, ammunition, rations, and so on—are the 
fuel that keeps a revolution’s fire burning, and the 
League is in constant need. There isn’t enough room 
within the house HQ to store all such provisions, so 
the League keeps them in a warehouse at the docks 
under the name of Everbloom Imports, a fictitious 
trading company and yet another reference to Milani.
Agents posing as merchants arrive in town 
with (usually stolen) supplies, move them into the 
warehouse, and then head back out into the country 
for their next mission. This morning, a League-
affiliated vessel arrived at the docks with provisions 
from Logas. Junior Hellbreaker Gertraud Mildenhall 
(confident female halfling smuggler –1) was to meet 
them at the warehouse and inventory the goods, but 
she hasn’t returned to headquarters yet.
Rhokrag is beginning to suspect something untoward 
might have happened, as Gertraud is known for being 
quite timely. Saringallow isn’t totally free of Chelaxian 
loyalists who would jump at the chance to collect a 
generous bounty. To make matters worse, this delivery 
from Logas was meant to help provision several 
missions out in the field and the League is running low 
on weapons and ammunition. The PCs are sent to the 
warehouse to see if anything happened to Gertraud.
Unfortunately, Rhokrag’s suspicions are correct. A 
handful of Chelaxian loyalists from Logas boarded the 
ship posing as Hellbreakers and tricked a dockworker 
into telling them the location of the League’s warehouse. 
They took the ship to the warehouse, grabbed Gertraud 
when she arrived, and are holding her hostage, intending 
to capture any additional dissidents who arrive to 
increase the bounty they’ll earn.

To make matters worse, this delivery from Logas was meant to help provision several missions out in the field and the League is running low on weapons and ammunition. The PCs are sent to the warehouse to see if anything happened to Gertraud.
Unfortunately, Rhokrag’s suspicions are correct. A handful of Chelaxian loyalists from Logas boarded the ship posing as Hellbreakers and tricked a dockworker into telling them the location of the League’s warehouse. They took the ship to the warehouse, grabbed Gertraud when she arrived, and are holding her hostage, intending to capture any additional dissidents who arrive to increase the bounty they’ll earn.

## Page 18
码头街

萨林加洛的码头位于城市南侧，紧邻科涅里卡河。街对面林立着仓库，白天里，装卸工人源源不断地把停泊船只上的货物卸下并搬进这些建筑。小车会定时赶来，将货物运往最终目的地。

长春花进口商（Everbloom Imports）的仓库在街道东端，与其他建筑略有隔离。若PC们监视这里一段时间，他们不会看到任何人进出。他们也许会想在附近打听，看看是否有人注意到可疑情况。一名PC若在DC 16 察觉检定或DC 14 地下世界学识（Underworld Lore）检定中成功，便会发现一个黑发少年在附近徘徊。此人是瓦莱拉·克莱夫（Valerra Clive，街头精明的人类女性流浪儿 0），萨林加洛那些不太走运的青少年之一；他们会为任何愿意付钱的人做零工。若PC们靠近，她会显得满怀期待，以为他们需要她跑腿送信，或帮忙保管些不太合法的东西。

当PC们开始询问仓库的事时，她的兴奋转为失望，随即闭口不言。一名PC若在DC 18 交涉或威吓检定中成功，便能说服她开口；提出至少2银币也能达到同样效果。一旦被充分说服或被收买，瓦莱拉会告诉PC们：今天清晨天还早的时候，她看见三名形迹可疑的人从街道西端过来，撬开侧门进入仓库。中午之前，有个女人沿着北边的街道走来，掏出钥匙打开同一扇门；这名女人似乎没有注意到任何异常。此后再也没人出来。

由于收集到了这些信息，PC们在区域A2（第18页）中察觉“坠落的箱子”陷阱时获得+1环境加值，且对该危害的反射豁免检定也获得+1环境加值。

奖励：如果PC们从瓦莱拉·克莱夫处查明红色避难所（Red Refuge）有些不对劲，奖励他们10 XP。

A1. 长春花进口商仓库外

这座仓库是个巨大的方形建筑，东侧还连着一个较小的附属间。一对与马车同宽的双开门用沉重的铁链与结实的挂锁锁着。另有一扇正常尺寸的门通往附属间。

附属间的门没上锁，微微半掩。一名PC若在DC 17 察觉检定或DC 15 制作或木工学识（Carpentry Lore）检定中成功，便能从门框上轻微的木屑裂痕看出它曾被强行撬开。挂锁是普通锁（需要4次成功的DC 25 盗窃检定才能撬开）；若PC们设法打开它并悄无声息地挪开铁链（DC 20 潜行检定），他们就能出其不意地突袭区域A3的效忠派。

A2. 仓库附属间

琐碎 1

这处连接主仓库的附属间里，东墙边堆着一些看上去较旧的箱子。西侧有一道敞开的门洞通往仓库地面。

地狱破坏者把拆货后留下的旧箱子与闲置箱子存放在这里，以备将来需要用来把货物走私到别处。许多箱子上覆盖着崩碎的伪造提单，以及厚厚一层灰尘。

三位副官

梅尔·费兰、罗克拉格与泽拉·蓝瓶，是除创始人阿尔塞奥与菲比·德米特里亚斯之外，地狱破坏者联盟中军衔最高的三人。直到第4章之前，PC们主要都会与这三位副官打交道。以下描述将帮助你在整部《冒险路径》中塑造这些NPC。

梅尔·费兰负责招募新特工以及联盟的公共关系。她总是很高兴见到PC们，并鼓励他们以更宏大、更华丽的措辞讲述自己的英勇事迹，还会指出伊斯嘉人民将会团结在英雄身边。梅尔很快就会讲个笑话或来点善意的打趣，尤其是面对像罗克拉格这样严肃的人。

罗克拉格通常负责向PC们分派任务，并倾向于保持低调、不在公众视线中露面。他明白，自地精血战以来，许多人仍对类地精怀有偏见；但他相信，摆脱切利亚斯的钳制将有助于伊斯嘉痊愈。罗克拉格相当严肃，也更欣赏那些同样不拖泥带水的PC。

泽拉·蓝瓶负责为联盟提供补给并武装盟员。他们大多数日子都在城另一头的冈蒂的丰盛面包店（Gunty’s Hearty Breads）工作，并常把冈蒂·凯罗娜卖不出去的隔夜点心带来，放在地下室炉子上加热。他们会与任何喜欢烹饪或烘焙的PC立刻建立起投缘的关系。

DOCKSIDE ROW
Saringallow’s docks are located on the south side of the 
city, right on the Conerica River. Warehouses line the 
street opposite, and throughout the day, a steady stream 
of stevedores unload cargo from docked ships and into 
those buildings. Carts arrive periodically to take the goods 
to their final destinations.
The warehouse for Everbloom Imports is at the 
eastern end of the street, partially isolated from the 
other buildings. If the PCs watch it for any period of 
time, they don’t see anyone enter or leave. They might 
want to ask around the area to see if anyone’s noticed 
anything suspicious. A PC who succeeds at a DC 16 
Perception check or a DC 14 Underworld Lore check 
spots a dark-haired youth lingering about. This is 
Valerra Clive (street-smart human female urchin 0), 
one of Saringallow’s less fortunate teens who do odd 
jobs for anyone who’ll pay them. She looks hopeful 
if the PCs approach her, assuming they need her to 
run a message or hold onto something not quite legal. 
When the PCs begin asking her questions about the 
warehouse, her excitement turns to disappointment, 
and she clams up. A PC who succeeds at a DC 18 
Diplomacy or Intimidation check convinces her to 
talk; offering her at least 2 sp achieves the same result.
Once sufficiently persuaded or bribed, Valerra tells 
the PCs that she saw three shifty-looking people come 
from the west end of the street and enter the warehouse 
early this morning after forcing open the side door. 
Before noon, a woman walked down the northern 
street and took out a key to open the same door; this 
woman didn’t seem to notice anything unusual. Since 
then, no one has come out. As a result of collecting this 
information, the PCs gain a +1 circumstance bonus to 
spot the falling crates trap in area A2 (page 18) and to 
the hazard’s Reflex saving throw.
Reward: If the PCs find out that something is odd 
about the Red Refuge from Valerra Clive, award them 
10 XP.
A1. OUTSIDE EVERBLOOM IMPORTS 
WAREHOUSE
The warehouse is a large, square building with a smaller 
annex on the eastern side. Double doors the width of a 
wagon are closed with a heavy chain and sturdy padlock. A 
regular-sized door leads into the annex.
The annex door is unlocked and slightly ajar. A PC 
who succeeds at a DC 17 Perception check or DC 15 
Crafting or Carpentry Lore check can see from a faint 
splintering in the frame that it was forced open. The 
padlock is an average lock (requiring four successful 
DC 25 Thievery checks to pick), and if the PCs 
manage to open it and quietly move the chain (DC 20 
Stealth check), they can catch the loyalists in area A3 
by surprise.
A2. WAREHOUSE ANNEX	
TRIVIAL 1
This attachment to the main warehouse holds some older-
looking crates stacked up against the east wall. An open 
doorway leads onto the warehouse floor to the west.
The Hellbreakers keep old, unused crates here after 
unpacking their contents in case they’re needed to 
smuggle goods elsewhere. Many of the crates are covered 
in crumbling forged bills of lading and a layer of dust.
THE THREE LIEUTENANTS
Maire Phelan, Rhokrag, and Xerra Bluebottle 
are the three highest-ranking members of the 
Hellbreakers League apart from the founders, 
Alceo and Phoebe Demetrias. Until Chapter 4, 
the PCs will be dealing mainly with these three 
lieutenants. The following descriptions should 
help you portray these NPCs over the course of 
the Adventure Path.
Maire Phelan is in charge of recruiting new 
agents and the League’s public relations. She’s 
always pleased to see the PCs and encourages 
them to describe their heroics in greater, more 
florid detail, noting that the people of Isger will 
rally around heroes. Maire is quick to offer a 
joke or some good-natured ribbing, especially to 
somber people like Rhokrag.
Rhokrag generally gives the PCs their missions 
and tends to remain out of the public eye. He 
recognizes that many are still prejudiced against 
goblinoids since the Goblinblood Wars, but he 
believes that getting out from under the thumb 
of Cheliax will help Isger heal. Rhokrag is quite 
serious and tends to appreciate PCs who are 
similarly no-nonsense.
Xerra Bluebottle keeps the League provisioned 
and armed. They work most days at Gunty’s 
Hearty Breads across town and often bring over 
the day-old pastries that Gunty Keronna can’t 
sell, warming them on the basement stove. They 
form an instant rapport with any PC who enjoys 
cooking or baking.

## Page 19
危害：忠诚派计划的第一步，是让任何进入仓库的人先吃些苦头——把沉重的箱子砸到他们身上。在附属间内、靠近一大堆高高垒起的箱子（在地图上以一个方形标示）之后的位置，横跨整个附属间拉着一根细细的绊线；一旦被触发，就会把那些箱子拽倒。

坠落的箱子 危害3
机械 陷阱
隐匿 DC 20（受训）
描述 一座摇摇欲坠地堆叠起来的箱子塔被做了机关：只要有人踩过绊线就会坠落。
解除 DC 17 盗贼（受训），小心移除绊线。

倒塌坠落 [反应动作] 触发 一名生物绊到绊线；效果 数个沉重的箱子轰然坠落到地图上标示的10尺方形区域内，对该区域内的每名生物造成2d10+10钝击伤害（DC 20 基础反射豁免）。若生物的豁免大失败，则陷入倒地。

隐秘接近：若PC触发陷阱或以其他方式制造了巨响（例如呼喊格特劳德），主仓库地面上的忠诚派会自动听见PC接近，并在其先攻检定上获得+1环境加值。若超过半数的PC在进行潜行检定时成功对抗切利亚忠诚派首领的察觉DC 17，且陷阱未被触发，则忠诚派不会察觉PC的接近，并在其先攻检定上承受—1环境减值。若以上两种情况都未发生，则忠诚派既不获得加值也不承受减值。

A3. 主仓库 中等1
这里是“破狱者同盟”在萨林加洛存放大部分补给的地方。这个巨大而开阔的空间里只放着少量箱子。地面是夯实的泥土，偶尔散落些稻草；一对双开门通向南边的道路。仓库中央有一个封闭的箱子，一名女子被绑住并堵住嘴，躺在箱子上。

这名女子是格特劳德·米尔登霍尔，PC的同盟同伴之一，今天早些时候被一群切利亚忠诚派抓住。她一看到PC进入，就扭动身体并发出含糊不清的警告声。PC可以用一个交互动作解开格特劳德的绳索，或用一个交互动作取下她的口塞；不过在这里与忠诚派的遭遇中，她基本上算作非战斗人员。

生物：两名切利亚忠诚派与其鲁莽的首领潜伏在仓库里，打算抓捕更多异见者并领取赏金。抓住格特劳德后他们原本信心十足，但看到PC一行人后便变得有些犹豫。只要至少有一名PC进入房间，他们仍会发动攻击：从箱子后面现身，试图摆出威吓姿态。其中一名忠诚派会躲在箱子后获得掩蔽并用弩射击；另一名忠诚派与首领则近战突入。忠诚派想为了赏金活捉PC，因此会对已受伤的PC施以非致命打击，并因此在该次攻击上承受—2环境减值。

忠诚派首领会狂热战斗，直到其HP降至0。若其他忠诚派受伤且其首领已被制伏，他们会试图逃跑；但PC很可能挡住了唯一可行的出口。若逃跑的忠诚派没有通往自由的路径，则会改为投降。

look intimidating. One loyalist uses a crate for cover

the leader enter in melee. The loyalists want to take the 
PCs alive for the bounty, so they nonlethally strike at 
any PC that has already been wounded, taking the –2 
circumstance penalty to the attack.
The loyalist leader zealously fights until reduced to 0

their leader has been incapacitated, though it’s likely the

While they were confident after capturing Gertraud, they become a bit hesitant when they see the party of PCs. They still attack when at least one PC enters the room, moving out from behind crates and trying to look intimidating. One loyalist uses a crate for cover while firing their crossbow, and the other loyalist and the leader enter in melee. The loyalists want to take the PCs alive for the bounty, so they nonlethally strike at any PC that has already been wounded, taking the –2 circumstance penalty to the attack.

The loyalist leader zealously fights until reduced to 0 HP. The other loyalists try to flee if they’re wounded and their leader has been incapacitated, though it’s likely the PCs are in the way of the only viable exit. If a fleeing loyalist has no path to freedom, they surrender instead.

为了切利亚斯！（For 切利亚斯!）◆◆（听觉、语言、视觉）切利亚斯效忠派首领大步移动，一边高喊切利亚斯的效忠口号。若其在移动结束时与一名敌人相邻，则对该敌人进行一次钉头锤打击。每名听见并看见效忠派首领发起攻击的盟友都可以花费其反应动作（）向该敌人大步移动。

【格特劳德·米尔登霍尔】生物–1
平民（《开拓者NPC核心》66）
先攻 察觉 +3

审问效忠派：如果PC俘虏了任何效忠派，他们会承认：自己在乘坐一艘从洛加斯（Logas）而来、现已离港前往埃利迪尔（Elidir）的商船抵达后，欺骗了一名码头工人指认了这间仓库。一名被俘的效忠派对自己的行为毫无悔意，称PC及其盟友为“渣滓与害虫”。PC如何处置俘虏由他们自行决定；由于PC是在遭到攻击时自卫反击，他们可以把剩余的效忠派移交给萨林加洛（Saringallow）守卫队——不过，作为革命者，他们也许不想与当局扯上关系。若PC给瓦莱拉（Valerra）5银币，她会替他们去叫守卫队，并在PC离开现场时在街上看守任何被俘且被束缚的效忠派。

补给清单：所谓从洛加斯送来的货物似乎是弄错了，或是一场骗局。获救后，格特劳德指出，至少效忠派没有损坏联盟现有的补给——而这些补给本来也不多。仓库里的几只箱子装着的都是最基础的物资：常见款式的护甲、盾牌、简易与军用武器，以及一些弹药（主要是箭矢和弩矢）。格特劳德还很平淡地补充：她会把从效忠派身上缴获的所有武器都一并放进箱子里。

宝藏：箱装武器中有一把低等银制近战武器，其类型与某位PC经常使用的武器相同；此外还有一根低语线（whispering wire，见212页）。格特劳德注意到PC在检查那把武器，便坚持要他们把它当作救她的报酬收下。另外，她还递给另一名PC一条化装围巾（masquerade scarf）。这条围巾曾在数名“破狱者”之间传递使用，用以帮助他们保持低调，尤其是在以不那么合法的方式获取补给时。

为革命筹备（Provisioning the Revolution）
第二天，罗克拉格（Rhokrag）与泽拉（Xerra）会见诸位特工，商议下一步行动。在等待德米特里亚斯家族（Demetriases）的进一步命令期间，泽拉希望驻萨林加洛的破狱者们利用这段时间为组织进一步筹措补给，因为他们从洛加斯来的补给已经暴露。为此，已有数支小队将离开城市，去袭击一些已知亲切利亚斯的目标，以获取护甲、武器、食物及其他必需材料。与此同时，伊斯兰·豪威尔（Ethran Howell）将留在总部，继续训练少数新招募的成员，并等待联盟领袖们的消息。

当他逐条说明各支小队任务的细节时，罗克拉格给出了如下警告。

“我不想撒谎——我们接下来要做的事，会涉及一些违法行为。但你们在报名成为破狱者时，大概也没指望自己会是奉公守法的伊斯嘉（伊斯嘉）好公民。我们只拿走为国家更大利益所必需的东西，而且也不是说我们要下手的那些人，真的损失不起点什么。可他们会拼命反抗，就像事实并非如此一样——谁又不会呢？你们在外面会面临一些危险，主要来自那些受雇的守卫——他们也只是在做自己的工作。所以，正因如此，我怎么强调都不为过：我们必须尽可能避免杀戮。”他简短地依次看过每一位到场的破狱者。

“在接下来的数周与数月里，我们需要伊斯嘉人民站在我们这边。他们必须看到我们是在为一场正当且必要的斗争而战。甚至可能有人会加入我们！但在那之前，我们不能给切利亚斯任何弹药去……”

## Page 21
“把我们描绘成只想惹事的暴力掠夺者。他们多半本来也会这么做，但咱们别一路留下尸体的痕迹，好吗？当然，如果非得动手就自卫；而且我敢说，死上一两个斯戎走狗也不会有人惋惜——但尽量把杀戮降到最低。”

PC们被指派去做些轻度的河上劫掠。罗赫克拉格会给他们指明北科内里卡河上的一处地点，联盟斥候判定那里适合伏击过往的贸易船只。船只常将货物从艾利迪尔运出，运往切利亚斯。若有PC提起切利亚斯的船本就经常从萨林加洛经过（有时还会停靠），罗赫克拉格回答：“那可能会给我们总部所在的城市招来不必要的审查。我们最好在那些袭击能被归咎于强盗的地方行动。至少目前如此。”

小额经费：谢拉给PC们10 gp，让他们购买任何他们认为任务可能需要的东西。这个半身人眨眨眼说道：“最好带着比这更多的补给回来。”

河船伏击
前往侦察出的伏击点大约要两天，途中相对平静无事。PC们一路仍能在经过的村落与农庄里看到赫德文张贴的“所谓叛徒”悬赏告示，但没人拦下他们质问其忠诚。若PC们采取预防措施、让自己看起来像普通旅人，请指出：他们的未雨绸缪正是这次旅行顺利的原因。本遭遇使用左侧地图。

B1. 河岸
PC们在日落时分抵达指定地点——北科内里卡河在此略微收窄，并从一处岩石突出处旁流过；该突出处能为自北方驶来的船只提供极佳的掩蔽。大多数船只夜间很少航行，因此PC们有时间扎营并为伏击做准备。

伏击一艘船——即便是在河上——也不同于公路抢劫。除非把河道彻底堵死，否则没有简单办法让船停下，而这远超PC们的能力。不过，他们应当拟定某种能发挥队伍长处的计划。

当日稍晚，PC们发现“夜之奖赏号”（Night’s Prize）是一艘可能的目标：一艘悬挂切利亚斯旗色的贸易船只。它是相对较小的船，因此需要应付的船员不会太多；其船体在水中吃水很浅，暗示装满了货物。“夜之奖赏号”的船长是尤勒努斯·艾丁（Julenus Aedin，杀手 男性 人类 私掠者1），一位成功的商人，并因残忍而略有恶名。视野中没有其他船只，因此这正是PC们执行计划的绝佳机会。

使用以下范例作为裁定你们队伍具体计划的指南。当然，有些队伍可能会干脆对船员开弓放箭、施放法术！将B2的第一场战斗设定为PC在岸上、擦洗工利用掩蔽。除非PC们有办法阻止或减缓船速，否则他们在水流将船带离触及前有3轮时间登船。在河中游泳需要一次成功的DC 12 运动检定。

伪装求救：狡猾的PC可能想骗一艘驶近的船停下（或放慢）足够久，以便登船。这需要一个令人信服的理由（例如伪造的伤口）；每位参与骗局的PC都必须进行一次DC 18 欺瞒或表演检定。魅力较弱的PC可以尝试以DC 16 潜行检定躲在岩石突出处后。任何未通过其检定者在其先攻掷骰上承受–1环境减值。若所有PC都未通过检定，他们仍可尝试伏击，但船上每名船员（但不包括活化护甲）对PC进行的第一次攻击掷骰获得+1环境加值。

武力展示：暴力威胁或许足以让一艘驶近的船允许……

paint us as violent marauders just looking to cause trouble. 
They’ll probably try to do that anyway, but let’s not leave 
a trail of bodies in our wake, yeah? Defend yourself if you 
must, of course, and I’m sure no one will miss a Thrune 
bootlicker or two, but keep the killing to a minimum.”
The PCs are tasked with some light river piracy. 
Rhokrag gives them directions to a spot on the North 
Conerica River that League scouts have determined 
would be a good place to ambush a passing trade 
vessel. Ships often move cargo out of Elidir bound 
for Cheliax. If a PC brings up the fact that Chelaxian 
ships pass by (and sometimes stop at) Saringallow 
all the time, Rhokrag responds, “That has a chance 
of bringing some unwanted scrutiny on the city in 
which we have our headquarters. Better we operate 
in places where such attacks could be blamed on 
bandits. For now.”
Petty Cash: Xerra gives the PCs 10 gp to buy 
anything they think they might need for the mission. 
“Better come back with more than that in supplies,” 
the halfling says with a wink.
Riverboat Ambush
The journey to the scouted ambush spot takes 
approximately two days and is relatively uneventful. 
The PCs continue to spot copies of Hedvend’s bounty 
on so-called traitors nailed up in the villages and farms 
they pass by, but no one stops them to question their 
loyalty. If the PCs took precautions to appear like 
everyday travelers, note that their thinking ahead is 
the cause of their smooth trip. Use the map to the left 
for this encounter.
B1. RIVERBANK
The PCs arrive at the designated spot—an area where 
the North Conerica River narrows a bit and passes 
by a rocky outcropping that provides excellent cover 
against ships approaching from the north—as the sun 
is setting. Most ships don’t travel much at night, so the 
PCs have time to make camp and prepare the area for 
an ambush.
Ambushing a ship, even one on a river, isn’t like 
committing highway robbery. There’s no easy way to 
stop the vessel’s passage short of completely blocking 
the river, which is well beyond the PCs’ capabilities. 
However, they should come up with some kind of plan 
that uses their party’s strengths.
Later that day, the PCs spot a potential target in 
the Night’s Prize, a trading vessel flying Chelaxian 
colors. It’s a relatively smaller boat, so it won’t have 
a lot of crew to deal with, and its hull sits low in the 
water, suggesting it’s full of cargo. The Night’s Prize 
is captained by Julenus Aedin (cutthroat male human 
privateer 1), a successful merchant who has a minor 
reputation for cruelty. No other boats are in view, 
so this is a perfect opportunity for the PCs to enact 
their plan.
Use the following examples as guidelines for how to 
adjudicate your group’s specific plan. Of course, some 
groups might simply start firing arrows and spells at 
the crew! Run the first combat from B2 with the PCs 
on the banks and the swabbies taking cover. Unless 
they have some way to stop or slow the ship, the PCs 
have 3 rounds to get aboard before the current takes 
the ship out of reach. A successful DC 12 Athletics 
check is required to Swim in the river.
Faking Distress: Tricky PCs might want to fool 
an approaching ship into stopping (or slowing 
down) long enough to be boarded. This requires a 
convincing reason (such as a false wound); each PC 
who participates in the ruse must attempt a DC 18 
Deception or Performance check. Less charismatic PCs 
can hide behind the outcropping by attempting DC 16 
Stealth checks. Anyone who fails their check takes a 
–1 circumstance penalty to their initiative roll. If all 
the PCs fail their checks, they can still attempt their 
ambush, but each member of the ship’s crew (but not 
the animated armor) gains a +1 circumstance bonus to 
the first attack roll they make against a PC.
Show of Force: The threat of violence might be 
enough to get an approaching ship to allow the

1 SQUARE = 5 FEET
B1
B2

paint us as violent marauders just looking to cause trouble. They’ll probably try to do that anyway, but let’s not leave a trail of bodies in our wake, yeah? Defend yourself if you must, of course, and I’m sure no one will miss a Thrune bootlicker or two, but keep the killing to a minimum.”

The PCs are tasked with some light river piracy. Rhokrag gives them directions to a spot on the North Conerica River that League scouts have determined would be a good place to ambush a passing trade vessel. Ships often move cargo out of Elidir bound for Cheliax. If a PC brings up the fact that Chelaxian ships pass by (and sometimes stop at) Saringallow all the time, Rhokrag responds, “That has a chance of bringing some unwanted scrutiny on the city in which we have our headquarters. Better we operate in places where such attacks could be blamed on bandits. For now.”

Petty Cash: Xerra gives the PCs 10 gp to buy anything they think they might need for the mission. “Better come back with more than that in supplies,” the halfling says with a wink.

Riverboat Ambush
The journey to the scouted ambush spot takes approximately two days and is relatively uneventful. The PCs continue to spot copies of Hedvend’s bounty on so-called traitors nailed up in the villages and farms they pass by, but no one stops them to question their loyalty. If the PCs took precautions to appear like everyday travelers, note that their thinking ahead is the cause of their smooth trip. Use the map to the left for this encounter.

B1. RIVERBANK
The PCs arrive at the designated spot—an area where the North Conerica River narrows a bit and passes by a rocky outcropping that provides excellent cover against ships approaching from the north—as the sun is setting. Most ships don’t travel much at night, so the PCs have time to make camp and prepare the area for an ambush.

Ambushing a ship, even one on a river, isn’t like committing highway robbery. There’s no easy way to stop the vessel’s passage short of completely blocking the river, which is well beyond the PCs’ capabilities. However, they should come up with some kind of plan that uses their party’s strengths.

Later that day, the PCs spot a potential target in the Night’s Prize, a trading vessel flying Chelaxian colors. It’s a relatively smaller boat, so it won’t have a lot of crew to deal with, and its hull sits low in the water, suggesting it’s full of cargo. The Night’s Prize is captained by Julenus Aedin (cutthroat male human privateer 1), a successful merchant who has a minor reputation for cruelty. No other boats are in view, so this is a perfect opportunity for the PCs to enact their plan.

Use the following examples as guidelines for how to adjudicate your group’s specific plan. Of course, some groups might simply start firing arrows and spells at the crew! Run the first combat from B2 with the PCs on the banks and the swabbies taking cover. Unless they have some way to stop or slow the ship, the PCs have 3 rounds to get aboard before the current takes the ship out of reach. A successful DC 12 Athletics check is required to Swim in the river.

Faking Distress: Tricky PCs might want to fool an approaching ship into stopping (or slowing down) long enough to be boarded. This requires a convincing reason (such as a false wound); each PC who participates in the ruse must attempt a DC 18 Deception or Performance check. Less charismatic PCs can hide behind the outcropping by attempting DC 16 Stealth checks. Anyone who fails their check takes a –1 circumstance penalty to their initiative roll. If all the PCs fail their checks, they can still attempt their ambush, but each member of the ship’s crew (but not the animated armor) gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the first attack roll they make against a PC.

Show of Force: The threat of violence might be enough to get an approaching ship to allow the

登船。每名PC都应尝试一次DC 20【威吓】检定；若某名PC使用了夸张显眼的能力或施放了具有高度可见效果的法术（如幻术），则其结果提高1个成功等级。若至少一半的PC成功，他们就能迅速登上船；若没有，他们在登船后会更为艰难：船员中的每一名成员（但不包括活化护甲）在其先攻上获得+1环境加值。

**突袭登船：**经过的船只必须贴近岩石突起航行，这给了PC躲藏到合适时机、然后跳下或用绳索下降至船只索具的机会。只要他们伏低藏在岩顶，队伍无需担心进行【潜行】检定，但每名PC都必须尝试一次DC 18【杂技】或【运动】检定，才能安全地从岩石突起抵达船上；能够飞行或漂浮的PC在该检定上自动成功。失败则该PC坠落15英尺至甲板，承受坠落伤害并倒地。大失败则除此之外，在B2区域的第一个遭遇中还会陷入震慑1。若所有PC都成功，则他们在第一个遭遇的先攻上获得+1环境加值。

## B2. 夜之战利品（Night’s Prize） 低危1与中危1

这艘河船主体涂成红色，并以黑色点缀，与桅杆上飘扬的切利亚斯旗帜配色一致。舷缘装有尖刺状突起。船尾有一扇宽门通往船内，另有舱口通向船体内部。

“夜之战利品”是一艘相当典型、只是略小的船只。船长舱门上方挂着一幅装框的阿布罗盖尔·斯戎（Abrogail 斯戎）肖像。

**生物：**当PC登上“夜之战利品”时，大部分船员会举手投降。他们拿的报酬不足以让他们冒着生命危险去击退袭击者，而且其中少数人知道船长的秘密守卫（见“船长的护甲”）。然而，有两名更年轻的水手杂役急于向船长证明自己，便挥舞着酒瓶回应PC的闯入。当他们的生命值降至5点或更低时，每个人都会恳求饶命。

**夜之战利品水手杂役（2）** 生物0
码头工（《Pathfinder NPC Core》66）
先攻 察觉+3

**船长的护甲：**在听闻地狱骑士丘陵之战的消息后，埃丁船长（Captain Aedin）将上一趟货运的大部分利润花在艾利迪尔（Elidir）购买了一套活化护甲。这主要是为了保护自己，防备他认为正在乡间游荡的反切利亚斯叛党，包括对付登船者与海盗。在与水手杂役战斗的第3轮开始时，或两名水手杂役都被击败后的下一轮，埃丁船长会出现在其舱室门口，身旁站着一套精致的黑色护甲，内部空无一人。“你们有5秒钟从我的该死船上滚下去，”他说着，用匕首指向PC。不论PC如何回应，双方都要掷先攻。

B2. NIGHT’S PRIZE LOW 1 AND MODERATE 1
This riverboat is painted mostly red with black accents, 
mirroring the colors of the Chelaxian flag that flies from its 
mast. Spiky protrusions line the gunwales. A wide door leads 
into the ship to the aft, and a hatch leads down into the hull.
The Night’s Prize is a fairly typical, if small, vessel. 
A framed portrait of Abrogail Thrune hangs over the 
door to the captain’s quarters.
Creatures: As the PCs board the Night’s Prize, 
most of the crew throw up their hands and surrender. 
They aren’t paid enough to risk their lives repelling 
attackers, and a few know about the captain’s secret 
guardian (see The Captain’s Armor). However, two 
younger swabbies are eager to prove themselves to 
the captain and brandish bottles in response to the 
PCs’ intrusion. Each of them pleads for mercy when 
reduced to 5 or fewer Hit Points.

on an animated suit of armor in Elidir. This was

beginning of the third round of combat with the

dagger at the PCs. No matter what the PCs reply, 
the two roll initiative.

活化护甲会不惜一切代价保护船长，并试图在其回合结束时始终与他相邻。

艾丁船长会优先对受伤的PC施压进攻。船长会战斗至死，因为他知道自己的活化护甲还藏着最后一招（见“沉船！”）。如果船长在护甲被摧毁之前就被杀死，护甲便会开始行动紊乱。它每回合会花费1个动作，向随机方向【移动】至多10尺，不过它永远不会从船舷边缘跌落。

朱勒努斯·艾丁船长
生物1
弱化的领航员（《Pathfinder NPC Core 5》146页）
先攻 察觉+7

活化护甲
生物2
《Pathfinder 怪物 Core》18页
先攻 察觉+6

沉船！
中等1
当活化护甲的生命值降至0时，船长的最终保险装置被触发。护甲在崩塌时亮起鲜红的符文，PC们听到甲板下传来沉闷的爆炸声。

出于偏执，艾丁船长购买活化护甲时，便用魔法将其符文与船体内部存放的三只炼金火容器链接起来。他原本打算在“夜之奖赏号”抵达目的地时解除符文，但PC们的袭击让安装这些装置显得“正当其时”。

“夜之奖赏号”开始同时燃烧并下沉。若PC们想在物资被毁或沉入河底前打捞任何补给，他们就必须争分夺秒。

本遭遇使用胜利点数子系统（《Pathfinder GM Core》184页）来追踪PC们在这场危机中的表现。每个障碍都有一个需要达到的胜利点数（VP）阈值。行动以阶段进行，每个阶段中每名PC都可以尝试一次检定，为所选障碍的完成赚取胜利点数。若队伍在某个障碍上的VP总数达到或超过该障碍的阈值，他们就克服了该障碍。

除“游向安全”障碍外，PC们可以按任意顺序尝试各个障碍；若愿意，每名PC也可以分别为不同障碍努力。“制服船长”障碍仅在艾丁船长仍然存活时可用。

在“夜之奖赏号”完全沉没前，PC们共有6个阶段。若在那之前PC们尚未完成“游向安全”障碍，则任何未为该障碍的完成贡献过1点VP的PC，都会因奋力游上岸而陷入疲乏。

协助船员　障碍
阈值4；克服 DC 17 运动、交涉或医疗；DC 15 航海学识
“夜之奖赏号”的部分船员在爆炸中受伤，或在船只下沉时陷入恐慌。PC们可以为他们处理伤势、把他们搬运到安全处，或安抚他们。

灭火　障碍
阈值4；克服 DC 18 特技动作或求生
船上多处起火。扑灭火势会让其他任务更容易进行。
特殊 若某PC能以魔法制造水，则其可以使用与该魔法根源相关联的技能来克服该障碍。若某阶段结束时PC们尚未克服该障碍，则每名尚未在“游向安全”障碍的检定中成功的PC受到1d4点火焰伤害。

确保物资　障碍
阈值2；克服 DC 16 运动、制作或巧手；DC 15 商贸学识；DC 17 察觉
数个装有补给的箱子——食物、衣物与炼金物品——存放在船舱货舱中。PC们必须尽可能多地为“破狱者联盟”确保这些物资。
特殊 PC们可以多次尝试克服该障碍。记录PC们克服该障碍的次数以用于计算奖励。若PC们尚未克服“制服船长”障碍（且船长仍然存活），则当船长试图阻止他们偷走其货物时，PC们为克服此障碍进行的检定承受–2环境减值。

制服船长　障碍
阈值3；克服 DC 17 威吓或攻击掷骰
若艾丁船长仍然活着，他可能会成为PC们的麻烦。
特殊 能施放法术的PC可以消耗法术来制服船长。尝试一次DC 17的法术攻击掷骰，或令船长如同该法术通常方式一般尝试一次豁免检定。豁免检定失败给予1点VP，而大失败给予2点VP。由GM酌情决定，某些法术可能会彻底制服船长，立即克服该障碍。

游向安全　障碍
阈值4；克服 DC 15 运动、自然或求生
在“夜之奖赏号”完全沉没之前，PC们必须离开船只并游向岸边。
特殊 一旦PC们决定尝试该障碍，他们就不能同时尝试克服任何其他障碍。一旦他们克服该障碍，本遭遇结束。
