The animated armor protects the captain at all costs 
and attempts to always end its turn adjacent to him. 
Captain Aedin presses his attacks against wounded 
PCs first. The captain fights to the death, knowing 
that his animated armor has a final trick up its sleeve 
(see Sinking Ship!). If the captain is killed before the 
armor is destroyed, the armor begins acting erratically. 
It spends 1 action each turn Striding up to 10 feet in a 
random direction, though it never falls over the edge 
of the ship.
CAPTAIN JULENUS AEDIN	
CREATURE 1
Weak navigator (Pathfinder NPC Core 5, 146)
Initiative Perception +7
ANIMATED ARMOR	
CREATURE 2
Pathfinder Monster Core 18
Initiative Perception +6
SINKING SHIP!	
MODERATE 1
When the animated armor has been reduced to 0 Hit 
Points, the captain’s final failsafe is triggered. Bright 
red runes flare up on the armor as it collapses, and 
the PCs hear muffled explosions from below deck. 
Out of paranoia, when Captain Aedin purchased 
the animated armor, he magically linked its runes to 
three containers of alchemist’s fire stored within the 
hull of the ship. He planned to defuse the runes when 
the Night’s Prize reached its destination, but the PCs’ 
attack has justified their installation.
The Night’s Prize begins to simultaneously burn 
and sink. If the PCs want to salvage any supplies 
before they are destroyed or lost at the bottom of the 
river, they’ll have to act fast. This encounter uses the 
Victory Point subsystem (Pathfinder GM Core 184) 
to track how successful the PCs are during this crisis. 
Each obstacle has a threshold of Victory Points (VP) 
required to overcome it. Actions are made in phases 
where each PC can attempt a check to earn Victory 
Points toward the completion of a chosen obstacle. 
If the group’s VP total for an obstacle equals or 
exceeds the threshold of that obstacle, they overcome 
that obstacle. With the exception of the Swimming 
to Safety obstacle, the PCs can attempt any of the 
obstacles in any order, and each PC can work toward 
a different obstacle if they wish. The Subduing the 
Captain obstacle is available only if Captain Aedin 
is still alive.
The PCs have six phases before the Night’s Prize 
completely sinks. If the PCs haven’t completed the 
Swimming to Safety obstacle before then, any PC who 
didn’t contribute a VP to that obstacle’s completion 
becomes fatigued from their efforts to swim ashore.
AIDING THE CREW	
OBSTACLE
Threshold 4; Overcome DC 17 Athletics, Diplomacy, or 
Medicine; DC 15 Sailing Lore
Some of the Night’s Prize crew were injured in the 
explosions or are panicking as the ship sinks. The PCs can 
either tend to their wounds, carry them to safety, or calm 
them down.
PUTTING OUT FIRES	
OBSTACLE
Threshold 4; Overcome DC 18 Acrobatics or Survival
A multitude of fires have broken out across the ship. 
Putting them out will make other tasks easier.
Special A PC who can magically produce water can use 
the skill associated with the tradition of that magic to 
overcome this obstacle. If a phase ends and the PCs 
haven’t overcome this obstacle, each PC who hasn’t 
succeeded at a check to overcome the Swimming to 
Safety obstacle takes 1d4 fire damage.
SECURING SUPPLIES	
OBSTACLE
Threshold 2; Overcome DC 16 Athletics, Crafting, or 
Thievery; DC 15 Mercantile Lore; DC 17 Perception
Several crates of supplies—food, clothing, and alchemical 
items—are stored in the ship’s hold. The PCs must try to 
secure as much as possible for the Hellbreakers League.
Special The PCs can attempt to overcome this obstacle 
multiple times. Keep track of how many times the PCs 
overcome this obstacle for their rewards. If the PCs have 
yet to overcome the Subduing the Captain obstacle (if 
the captain is still alive), they take a –2 circumstance 
penalty to checks to overcome this obstacle as the 
captain tries to stop them from stealing his goods.
SUBDUING THE CAPTAIN	
OBSTACLE
Threshold 3; Overcome DC 17 Intimidation or attack roll
If Captain Aedin is still alive, he could prove to be a 
nuisance to the PCs.
Special A PC who casts spells can expend them to subdue 
the captain. Attempt a DC 17 spell attack roll or have the 
captain attempt a saving throw as usual for the spell. 
A failure on a saving throw grants 1 VP, while a critical 
failure grants 2. At the GM’s discretion, certain spells 
might completely subdue the captain, immediately 
overcoming this obstacle.
SWIMMING TO SAFETY	
OBSTACLE
Threshold 4; Overcome DC 15 Athletics, Nature, or Survival
Before the Night’s Prize completely sinks, the PCs must get 
off the ship and swim to shore.
Special Once the PCs decide to attempt this obstacle, 
they can’t simultaneously attempt to overcome any 
other obstacles. Once they overcome this obstacle, the 
encounter ends.

Threshold 4; Overcome DC 17 Athletics, Diplomacy, or Medicine; DC 15 Sailing Lore
Some of the Night’s Prize crew were injured in the explosions or are panicking as the ship sinks. The PCs can either tend to their wounds, carry them to safety, or calm them down.

PUTTING OUT FIRES OBSTACLE
Threshold 4; Overcome DC 18 Acrobatics or Survival
A multitude of fires have broken out across the ship. Putting them out will make other tasks easier.
Special A PC who can magically produce water can use the skill associated with the tradition of that magic to overcome this obstacle. If a phase ends and the PCs haven’t overcome this obstacle, each PC who hasn’t succeeded at a check to overcome the Swimming to Safety obstacle takes 1d4 fire damage.

SECURING SUPPLIES OBSTACLE
Threshold 2; Overcome DC 16 Athletics, Crafting, or Thievery; DC 15 Mercantile Lore; DC 17 Perception
Several crates of supplies—food, clothing, and alchemical items—are stored in the ship’s hold. The PCs must try to secure as much as possible for the Hellbreakers League.
Special The PCs can attempt to overcome this obstacle multiple times. Keep track of how many times the PCs overcome this obstacle for their rewards. If the PCs have yet to overcome the Subduing the Captain obstacle (if the captain is still alive), they take a –2 circumstance penalty to checks to overcome this obstacle as the captain tries to stop them from stealing his goods.

SUBDUING THE CAPTAIN OBSTACLE
Threshold 3; Overcome DC 17 Intimidation or attack roll
If Captain Aedin is still alive, he could prove to be a nuisance to the PCs.
Special A PC who casts spells can expend them to subdue the captain. Attempt a DC 17 spell attack roll or have the captain attempt a saving throw as usual for the spell. A failure on a saving throw grants 1 VP, while a critical failure grants 2. At the GM’s discretion, certain spells might completely subdue the captain, immediately overcoming this obstacle.

SWIMMING TO SAFETY OBSTACLE
Threshold 4; Overcome DC 15 Athletics, Nature, or Survival
Before the Night’s Prize completely sinks, the PCs must get off the ship and swim to shore.
Special Once the PCs decide to attempt this obstacle, they can’t simultaneously attempt to overcome any other obstacles. Once they overcome this obstacle, the encounter ends.

返回萨林加洛
即使PC没有停下来救助“夜之奖赏号”的任何船员，其中一些人也成功上岸了。他们已无力战斗，除非PC阻止，否则他们会拖着步子朝埃利迪尔（或附近其他定居点）的方向离去。若被询问或威胁，这些人保证不会向任何当局提起PC。事实上，其中一人很感激PC解决了埃丁船长——他们将其称为“残酷、冷血的男人”。虽然船员中可能有人是切利亚克斯公民，但他们对当前的政治局势并没有强烈看法。若有任何PC表达“一个活口不留”的想法，提醒他们：他们被要求只在自卫时才杀人。

返回萨林加洛需要2天时间，但若PC没能确保一种运输方式（例如用来运送补给的货车），则可能需要更久。若PC在“沉没的船！”遭遇中成功克服了“援助船员”障碍，被他们帮助过的人要么能协助PC搬运补给，要么能为他们弄来一辆手推车。这段旅程波澜不惊，尤其是在角色扮作普通旅行公民时。

失踪
当PC回到“破狱者”总部时，梅尔会对他们进行简短汇报，但她似乎有点心不在焉。她对PC带回来的任何补给都感到满意；若PC询问，她也会简要说明其他小队的成果。之后，伊斯兰会来找PC，告诉他们有人在私下议论：罗克拉格至今未从自己的任务中归来。他原定在前一天报到，而他纪律严明，不可能错过约定时间；若他会迟到，也不可能不捎个信。若PC还未感到担忧，伊斯兰建议他们要么去找梅尔谈谈罗克拉格被俘或死亡的可能性，要么亲自去追查罗克拉格的下落。

一名PC若成功通过DC 15的交涉检定以收集情报，可从其他破狱者那里（或若他们直接去找梅尔，则从梅尔处）得知：罗克拉格在通往洛加斯的道路上独自进行侦察，希望提前获知地狱骑士部队是否已重整到足以再次更深入伊斯嘉活动的程度。具体而言，罗克拉格在“水柱旅店”有一名与联盟无关的本地联络人要会面；该地是一家河畔酒馆兼旅店，位于洛加斯与萨林加洛之间的中途。若PC未通过该检定，他们会从已与梅尔交谈过的伊斯兰那里得到相同信息。同一天稍晚，若PC尚未主动表示要追查这条线索，梅尔会请求他们去做这件事。

罗克拉格的营救
不幸的是，当罗克拉格在“水柱旅店”与联络人会面时，他遭到了背叛。随着伊斯嘉境内关于叛乱者与革命者的流言四起，切利亚克斯海军派出一艘巡逻船沿科内里卡河上行，以向民众表明谁才是掌权者。这艘船“巫火号”由兰佩里娅·贝恩船长指挥（冷酷的女性人类船长3），她是一名坚定的军人，仅在数年前便以将灵魂卖给地狱为代价，换取了军阶的迅速攀升。抵达伊斯嘉后，贝恩船长开始宣称……

Returning to Saringallow
Even if the PCs didn’t stop to rescue any of the Night’s 
Prize crew, some of them made it to shore. They are 
in no shape to put up a fight and, unless the PCs stop 
them, they trudge off in the direction of Elidir (or 
another nearby settlement). If asked or threatened, 
these individuals promise not to say anything about 
the PCs to any authorities. In fact, one of them is 
grateful to the PCs for dealing with Captain Aedin, 
whom they categorize as a “cruel, unfeeling man.” 
While some of the crew might be Chelaxian citizens, 
none of them have strong opinions about the current 
political situation. If any of the PCs express a sentiment 
of leaving no witnesses, remind them that they’ve been 
asked to kill only in self-defense.
It takes 2 days to return to Saringallow, though it 
might take longer if the PCs didn’t secure a method of 
transport such as a wagon for the supplies. If the PCs 
successfully overcame the Aiding the Crew obstacle 
during the Sinking Ship! encounter, those they helped 
can either aid the PCs in carrying the supplies 
or procure a cart for them. The journey is 
uneventful, especially if the characters 
play the parts of simple traveling 
citizens.
GONE MISSING
When the PCs get back to the 
Hellbreakers headquarters, they 
are debriefed by Maire, who seems 
a bit distracted. She’s pleased with 
whatever supplies the PCs return with 
and gives them a brief rundown 
of the other groups’ successes 
if asked. Afterward, Ethran 
approaches the PCs to let them 
know that there are whispers that Rhokrag 
hasn’t yet returned from his own mission. He was 
scheduled to check in the previous day and is far too 
disciplined to either miss an appointed time or neglect 
to send word if he’ll be late. If the PCs aren’t already 
concerned, Ethran suggests that they either talk to 
Maire about the possibility of Rhokrag’s capture or 
death, or track Rhokrag down themselves.
A PC who succeeds at a DC 15 Diplomacy 
check to Gather Information learns from the other 
Hellbreakers (or from Maire if they go right to the 
source) that Rhokrag had gone off on his own for 
some reconnaissance on the road to Logas, hoping 
to get some advance notice if Hellknight forces have 
regrouped enough to range further into Isger again. 
Specifically, Rhokrag had a local non-League contact 
that he was going to meet at the Waterspout Inn, a 
riverside tavern and lodging house halfway between 
Logas and Saringallow. If the PCs fail this check, they 
receive the same information from Ethran, who has 
since spoken with Maire. Later that same day, if the 
PCs haven’t already volunteered to pursue this lead, 
Maire asks them to do so.
Rhokrag’s Rescue
Unfortunately, when Rhokrag met his contact at the 
Waterspout Inn, he was betrayed. With whispers of 
insurgents and revolutionaries in Isger, the Chelaxian 
navy sent a patrol ship up the Conerica to make it 
clear to the citizens who was in charge. This vessel, 
the Witchfire, is captained by Lamperia Bane (ruthless 
female human captain 3), a steadfast military woman 
who signed her soul away to Hell only a few years 
ago in exchange for a rapid rise up the ranks. Upon 
arriving in Isger, Captain Bane began announcing that

……她会将赫德文德（Hedvend）为叛乱分子情报开出的赏金翻倍。她的大多数线人都没有多少真正有用的信息，唯有罗克拉格（Rhokrag）的联络人例外；此人被贪欲所诱，协助在“水柱旅店”（Waterspout Inn）为地狱破坏者（Hellbreaker）设下陷阱。

贝恩船长（Captain Bane）赶走了酒馆里其他客人，并招募当地效忠派来协助在罗克拉格抵达时将他俘虏。随后，她把“巫火号”（Witchfire）停靠在旅店后方，将罗克拉格带上船进行审讯，希望从他口中撬出革命同伴的活动与藏身地点。到PC抵达时，他仍未屈服，但他的决心已开始动摇——尤其是贝恩船长还请来了泽曼尼亚（Zemaniah，施虐成性的男性审讯者，诱捕魔鬼1）。与此同时，巫火号的大部分船员已外出骚扰当地人，期望借此揪出更多地狱破坏者。留在此处的人则在旅店与码头之间扎营守卫。

PC离开萨林加洛（Saringallow）约2天后，于黄昏前不久抵达水柱旅店外。从道路上，他们能看见一艘悬挂切利亚斯（Chelaxian）旗帜的双桅船停泊在旅店后方。此外，旅店后方靠近河岸处还搭起了几顶红黑相间的帐篷，上方同样悬挂着另一面切利亚斯旗帜。显然切利亚斯军队已占领了这间旅店，但并不清楚他们把罗克拉格关押在何处。幸运的是，此刻PC还握有出其不意的优势。

如果他们在远处观察一会儿，会发现没有人进出旅店。若一名PC还成功通过DC 17的察觉检定，他会注意到旅店一楼窗户里有些移动。若一名PC成功通过DC 16的战争学识检定，他会意识到营地在船上甲板可一览无余；除非他们极其隐秘，否则一旦进入营地，很可能就会被发现；营地内的任何战斗也很可能会被船上听见。

PC应决定是立刻展开营救，还是再等待略多于一小时、直到夜幕降临。夜间时，旅店一楼会点亮提灯；切利亚斯士兵会在营地点燃火把，并在巫火号上点亮提灯。这些光源能让许多族裔在短射程内看清周遭，但在其照明半径之外，黑暗的掩蔽可能会让某些角色对毫无戒心的效忠派占到便宜。

she would double the bounty started by Hedvend for

一座小小的石制喷泉立在离道路仅几码远的地方；喷泉的水盆里除了几片落叶外空空如也。喷泉后方的两层旅店曾经被漆成明亮的蓝色，但如今已褪成灰色。前门上方的招牌写着“Waterspout Inn（水花旅店）”，并画着一幅粗糙的向上喷涌的水柱图案。喷泉旁有一条被反复踩踏而翻起的泥土小径，通往一座独立的马厩。

旅店的喷泉在秋冬季节已被放干。马厩无人使用，除了几只老鼠在啃食陈旧的干草。

由于他们不知道旅店里有什么人，PC们可能会试着制造声东击西的佯动，把占据者引出来。为此，一名PC必须进行一次DC 12的技能检定，取决于计策的性质；【欺瞒】与【表演】很可能是最适用的技能。里面的效忠者在抓到罗克拉格后的短暂兴奋过去后已经无聊透顶，因此很乐意去查看任何声响。

C2. 水花旅店（底层） 低威胁 1
这间朴素酒馆的壁炉里燃着火，用以驱散秋日的寒意。壁炉上方挂着一把涂得花里胡哨的三叉戟。几张桌子被推到一侧墙边，配套的椅子胡乱地叠放在桌上。一扇门通往旅店前院，吧台旁还有一扇略小的门通往后方。一段楼梯通向二楼。

数日前贝恩船长到来并包下整栋建筑时，旅店老板文森特因愧疚而把自己灌得酩酊大醉——他知道船长很可能对伊斯嘉怀有不良意图。他目前正昏睡在楼上一间客房的床上。若PC们找到并叫醒他，他会对贝恩船长发出警告：“她和魔鬼勾搭在一起，她就是！”除此之外，被租下的房间都空着。

生物：贝恩船长招募的3名效忠者待在一楼，时不时喝点店里的酒、玩飞镖游戏。他们在等船长终于撬开罗克拉格的嘴，好让他们得到更多目标来发泄他们亲切利亚斯的怒意。他们骨子里是懦夫，所以如果其中一人被击至昏迷，另外两人会试图从最容易到达的门逃走。这可能意味着他们从后门跑出去，从而惊动营地。否则，这些新招募者已经习惯了效忠者在旅店里喧闹作乐，即使听见旅店里有动静也不会去查看。

切利亚斯效忠者（3） 生物 -1
见第13页
先攻 察觉 +5

旅店老板的援助：为了减轻自己协助贝恩的愧疚，文森特会把他库存里的一瓶次级瓶装闪电以及一件迅捷麻雀奇物微缩模型（见第210页）送给PC们。

C3. 岸边营地 中等威胁 1
三顶帐篷搭在旅店与河流之间狭窄的地带上。每顶帐篷都插着印有切利亚斯国徽的三角旗，偶尔在从水面吹来的冷风中拍打作响。帐篷中央有一堆闷烧的营火，旁边围着两把可折叠的布制营凳。

尽管旅店的几间客房已经被包下，贝恩船长仍坚持要她的船员要么留在船上，要么在旅店外扎营。她不想让他们在床上睡了几晚后“变软”。这里的三顶帐篷都染成红黑两色，每顶只睡一人。

生物：两名最近被招募进“巫焰号”的新兵被派来负责营地值守。还有一名本地效忠者也在这里，渴望讨好任何与切利亚斯政府有关的人。尽管新兵们在休息，他们仍是训练有素的士兵。他们坐在营火旁时仍穿着护甲，武器也放在触手可及之处。

若他们在战斗开始前发现PC们，他们会先试图把PC们吓走。当他们发现PC们并非平民后，一名新兵会拿起他的钩镰枪，并要求那名效忠者在近战中支援；另一名新兵会向任何其他远程战斗者或施法者射箭。若任一名新兵被击至昏迷，那名效忠者就会尝试逃跑；但新兵们对切利亚斯与贝恩船长忠心不二，会战斗到生命值降至0。

到现在为止，新兵们已经习惯了旅店内其他效忠者喝酒闹腾造成的嘈杂，因此不会对任何战斗声响作出反应。不过，如果PC们设法潜入巫焰号并挑起战斗，新兵们会花1轮时间收拾武器并冲上船；那名效忠者不会跟去。

切利亚斯效忠者 生物 -1
见第13页
先攻 察觉 +5

C1. INN YARD
A small stone fountain, its basin empty except for several 
fallen leaves, stands just a few yards from the road. The 
two-story inn beyond it was once painted a bright blue, 
but the color has faded to gray. A sign above the front door 
reads “Waterspout Inn” with a crude image of an upward 
spray of water. A path of churned-up dirt by the fountain 
leads to an unattached stable.
The inn’s fountain has been drained for the autumn 
and winter seasons. The stable is unoccupied, apart 
from a few mice nibbling on some old hay.
As they don’t know who’s inside the inn, the 
PCs might try to create a diversion to draw out the 
occupants. To do so, a PC must succeed on a DC 12 skill 
check, depending on the nature of the ruse; Deception 
and Performance are likely the most applicable skills. 
The loyalists inside have grown bored after the brief 
excitement of capturing Rhokrag, so they’re eager to 
investigate any sounds.
C2. WATERSPOUT INN	
LOW 1
A fire burns in the hearth of this simple tavern to ward off 
the autumnal chill. A gaudily painted trident hangs above 
the fireplace. Several tables have been pushed against one 
wall, their accompanying chairs haphazardly stacked on 
top. A door leads out to the inn’s front yard and a slightly 
smaller door next to the bar leads out back. A set of stairs 
leads up to the second floor.
When Captain Bane arrived a few days ago and 
rented out the whole building, Vinzent, the inn’s 
proprietor, guiltily drank himself into a stupor as he 
knows the captain is likely to have ill intentions for 
Isger. He’s currently passed out on one of the upstairs 
room’s beds. If the PCs find and wake him, he gives 
them a warning about Captain Bane: “She consorts 
with devils, she does!” Otherwise, the rented rooms 
are empty.
Creatures: Three of the loyalists recruited by 
Captain Bane are on the first floor, occasionally 
partaking of the inn’s alcohol and playing games of 
darts. They’re waiting for the captain to finally break 
Rhokrag, giving them more targets on which to vent 
their pro-Cheliax ire. They’re cowards at heart, so if 
one of them is knocked unconscious, the other two 
try to flee through the most accessible door. This 
might mean they run out the back, alerting the camp. 
Otherwise, the recruits are used to hearing the loyalists 
carousing and don’t investigate if they hear noises 
from the inn.
CHELAXIAN LOYALISTS (3)	
CREATURE –1
Page 13
Initiative Perception +5
Innkeeper’s Aid: To alleviate his guilt in helping 
Bane, Vinzent offers the PCs a lesser bottled lightning 
and swift sparrow marvelous miniature (page 210) 
that he had in storage.
C3. SHORE CAMP	
MODERATE 1
Three tents have been erected in the narrow stretch 
between the inn and the river. Pennants with the national 
symbol of Cheliax fly from each tent, occasionally flapping 
in a cold breeze coming from off the water. A campfire 
smolders in the middle of the tents, surrounded by a couple 
of collapsible cloth camp stools.
Despite having rented out the inn’s few rooms, 
Captain Bane insists that her crew either remain on 
board the ship or set up camp outside the inn. She 
doesn’t want them “going soft” after sleeping in beds 
for a few nights. The three tents here are dyed red and 
black and each hold one sleeper.
Creatures: Two recent recruits to the Witchfire’s 
crew have been relegated to camp duty. One of the 
local loyalists is also here, eager to curry favor with 
anyone associated with the Chelaxian government. 
Though the recruits are relaxing, they’re still 
disciplined soldiers. They’re wearing their armor and 
have their weapons within arm’s reach as they sit by 
the campfire.
If they spot the PCs before combat starts, they first 
attempt to scare off the PCs. When it becomes clear 
that the PCs aren’t civilians, one recruit takes up their 
guisarme and demands the loyalist backs them up in 
melee combat, while the other recruit fires arrows 
at any other ranged combatant or spellcaster. The 
loyalist tries to flee if either of the recruits are knocked 
unconscious, but the recruits are steadfastly faithful to 
Cheliax and Captain Bane and fight until reduced to 
0 Hit Points.
By now, the recruits are used to commotions 
coming from inside the inn as other loyalists drink 
and get rowdy, so they don’t respond to any sounds of 
combat. However, if the PCs manage to sneak aboard 
the Witchfire and start a fight, the recruits will take a 
round to gather their weapons and rush onto the ship; 
the loyalist doesn’t join them.

C4A. 女巫火号甲板 中等 1
一条短栈桥从河岸通向这艘切利亚克斯船只的甲板。构成甲板与船体的大多数木板都被涂成黑色，不过沿着舷缘与船艏的精致木雕卷草纹描绘着卷曲的火焰灯芯，其末端被染成亮绿色。船上其他细节也涂成同样的颜色，营造出一种阴森的效果。船体前后各有门，另有一架梯子通往下方的货舱。两根桅杆中较高那根的桅顶飘扬着切利亚克斯旗帜。

“女巫火号”的配色旨在震慑敌船，并在必要时帮助船只于夜间隐秘航行。由于贝恩船长的严格要求，这是一艘维护良好的船。船员人数很少，使她能随时将注意力集中在任何一人身上，以惩戒懒散或无能。

此处的索具可通过一次DC 10运动检定攀爬。

生物：船上始终有两名海军陆战队员值守，警戒来自河面的威胁并刷洗甲板。陆战队员会利用自己对船只的熟悉，占据优势，攀上索具并攻击下方的PC。PC在此遇到的任何陆战队员都已随贝恩船长服役数年，因此他们知道她希望他们为她而死；他们会战斗到HP降至0为止。

这些陆战队员有点害怕离开岗位，但也同样担心放任入侵者打断贝恩船长的审讯。若他们注意到C3区域营地发生战斗，他们会等到战斗的第3轮才掷先攻并从船上下船。如此加入战斗时，他们以战栗 1开始。

【切利亚克斯海军陆战队员（2）】 生物 1
索具手（《Pathfinder NPC Core》146页）
先攻 察觉 +10


C4B. 货舱
“女巫火号”的货舱目前空空如也，只有一座人形大小的笼子充作禁闭室，以及另一端的一个箱子。

宝藏：箱中是船只的薪资款，共30 gp。贝恩船长让箱子不上锁，因为船员都清楚不该尝试偷钱。上一个胆敢这么做的刷洗水手被吊死在帆桁上。


C5. 厨房
船尾的门通向船上的厨房，里面存放着淡水与腌肉。船艏附近吊着几张吊床，每张上都盖着一条薄毯。此处是船员吃饭与睡觉的地方。“女巫火号”没有专职厨师，因此新兵们轮流准备简陋的餐食。


C6. 船长舱室 严重 1
这间宽敞的舱室布置得极尽奢华：黑红色天鹅绒帷幕、软垫扶手椅、床铺以及一张桃花心木书桌。架子上摆着几件小饰物。然而，地板上新鲜的血迹破坏了装潢的堂皇感。

房间中央坐着罗克拉格，他几乎失去意识，被绑在一把木椅上；他的脸上布满淤青与伤口。站在他身后的是一名身材高大、气势逼人的女子，她身着切利亚克斯海军制服；旁边还有一名咧嘴狞笑的魔鬼。

船长舱室已被临时改成审讯室，因为贝恩船长与她召唤来的魔鬼帮凶在过去几天里一直在此审问罗克拉格。一名PC可以用单次交互动作解开罗克拉格，但……

C4A. WITCHFIRE DECK	
MODERATE 1
A short gangplank leads up from the riverbank to the deck 
of this Chelaxian vessel. Most of the planks making up the 
deck and hull have been painted black, though elaborate 
wooden scrollwork along the gunwales and across the bow 
depict curling wicks of flame, the tips of which have been 
colored a bright green. Other details around the ship have 
been painted the same color, giving an eerie effect. Doors 
lead fore and aft, and a ladder leads down into the hold. A 
Chelaxian flag flies from top the taller of the two masts.
The Witchfire’s color scheme is meant to intimidate 
enemy vessels and help the vessel move stealthily 
through the night when necessary. It’s a well-
maintained ship, thanks to Captain Bane’s strictness. 
With such a small crew, she can focus her attention 
on any one of them at any point to discipline laziness 
or incompetence.
The rigging here can be climbed with a successful 
DC 10 Athletics check.
Creatures: Two marines are on board at all times, 
keeping watch for threats from the river and scrubbing 
the deck. The marines use their familiarity with the 
ship to their advantage, climbing up into the rigging 
and attacking PCs below. Any marines the PCs 
encounter here have served with Captain Bane for a 
few years, so they know she expects them to die for 
her; they fight until brought down to 0 HP.
These marines are a little afraid to leave their posts 
but are equally worried about allowing intruders to 
interrupt Captain Bane’s interrogations. If they notice 
a fight at the camp in area C3, they wait until the 
third round of combat before rolling initiative and 
disembarking the ship. When they do so, they begin 
the fight frightened 1.
CHELAXIAN MARINES (2)	
CREATURE 1
Rigger (Pathfinder NPC Core 146)
Initiative Perception +10
C4B. HOLD
The Witchfire’s hold is currently empty, save for a 
human-sized cage that acts as a brig and a single chest 
at the other end.
Treasure: Inside the chest is the ship’s payroll, 
consisting of 30 gp. Captain Bane leaves the chest 
unlocked, as the crew knows better than to try to steal 
the money. The last swabbie who tried was hanged 
from the boom.
C5. GALLEY
The aft doors lead into the ship’s galley, which contains its 
stores of fresh water and salted meat. Several hammocks 
hang near the ship’s fore, each covered by a thin blanket.
This area serves as the place where the crew eats and 
sleeps. The Witchfire doesn’t have a dedicated ship’s 
cook, so the recruits take turns preparing meager meals.
C6. CAPTAIN’S QUARTERS	
SEVERE 1
This spacious chamber is lavishly furnished with black 
and red velvet drapes, overstuffed chairs, a bed, and 
a mahogany desk. Several trinkets sit on shelves. The 
grandeur of the decor is marred by fresh bloodstains on the 
floor. Sitting in the center of the room is Rhokrag, barely 
conscious and tied to a wooden chair. His face is a map of 
bruises and cuts. Behind him stands a tall and imposing 
woman dressed in the uniform of the Chelaxian navy, as 
well as a grinning devil.
The captain’s quarters have been temporarily 
transformed into an interrogation room, as Captain 
Bane and her summoned devil accomplice have been 
questioning Rhokrag here for the past few days. A PC

C4A. WITCHFIRE DECK MODERATE 1
A short gangplank leads up from the riverbank to the deck of this Chelaxian vessel. Most of the planks making up the deck and hull have been painted black, though elaborate wooden scrollwork along the gunwales and across the bow depict curling wicks of flame, the tips of which have been colored a bright green. Other details around the ship have been painted the same color, giving an eerie effect. Doors lead fore and aft, and a ladder leads down into the hold. A Chelaxian flag flies from top the taller of the two masts.

The Witchfire’s color scheme is meant to intimidate enemy vessels and help the vessel move stealthily through the night when necessary. It’s a well-maintained ship, thanks to Captain Bane’s strictness. With such a small crew, she can focus her attention on any one of them at any point to discipline laziness or incompetence.

The rigging here can be climbed with a successful DC 10 Athletics check.

Creatures: Two marines are on board at all times, keeping watch for threats from the river and scrubbing the deck. The marines use their familiarity with the ship to their advantage, climbing up into the rigging and attacking PCs below. Any marines the PCs encounter here have served with Captain Bane for a few years, so they know she expects them to die for her; they fight until brought down to 0 HP.

These marines are a little afraid to leave their posts but are equally worried about allowing intruders to interrupt Captain Bane’s interrogations. If they notice a fight at the camp in area C3, they wait until the third round of combat before rolling initiative and disembarking the ship. When they do so, they begin the fight frightened 1.

C4B. HOLD
The Witchfire’s hold is currently empty, save for a human-sized cage that acts as a brig and a single chest at the other end.
Treasure: Inside the chest is the ship’s payroll, consisting of 30 gp. Captain Bane leaves the chest unlocked, as the crew knows better than to try to steal the money. The last swabbie who tried was hanged from the boom.

C5. GALLEY
The aft doors lead into the ship’s galley, which contains its stores of fresh water and salted meat. Several hammocks hang near the ship’s fore, each covered by a thin blanket.

This area serves as the place where the crew eats and sleeps. The Witchfire doesn’t have a dedicated ship’s cook, so the recruits take turns preparing meager meals.

C6. CAPTAIN’S QUARTERS SEVERE 1
This spacious chamber is lavishly furnished with black and red velvet drapes, overstuffed chairs, a bed, and a mahogany desk. Several trinkets sit on shelves. The grandeur of the decor is marred by fresh bloodstains on the floor.

Sitting in the center of the room is Rhokrag, barely conscious and tied to a wooden chair. His face is a map of bruises and cuts. Behind him stands a tall and imposing woman dressed in the uniform of the Chelaxian navy, as well as a grinning devil.

第2章：
为了事业

在将罗克拉格从“女巫之焰”号上救出并返回萨林加洛之后，PC们有1周的休整模式时间，用于处理各自的个人计划。这是角色训练并提升等级、购买或制作装备、或休息并恢复的绝佳时机。

有些角色或许想调查“地狱骑士阿哈拉”这个名字，但能找到的资料并不多。维罗·阿哈拉（心怀复仇的男性人类地狱骑士扈从5；见第246页）几乎一无所有，尽管他正打算改变这一点。作为地狱骑士山之战的幸存者，维罗渴望向破狱者们复仇，并以恶魔般的执念策划着他们的毁灭。

在得知“金色厄里倪厄斯姊妹会”——一个由阿斯莫德斯教会扶植的伊斯嘉修道会——之后，维罗以“刑架骑士团”之名接近那些修女，并以足够的说服力争取到她们的援助。由于被盗的护甲与他自信的傲慢，恩德蕾雅修女（冷峻的女性人类阿斯莫德斯修女4）将他带往一处名为“辉光使命”的隐秘修道院（见第42页）；在那里，他发现了一场宏大的仪式，能够召唤出一名恶魔，从而赐予他击败联盟所需的力量。

当PC们忙于招募伊斯嘉的居民时，维罗同样在招募数名逃亡中的地狱骑士扈从，并一路前往“叽喳林”中的一系列洞穴，在那里他便能施行自己的仪式。

建立一场政治运动

在这一周的末尾，罗克拉格在收到德米特里亚斯家族的消息后，召集组织内部召开一次全体会议。

After rescuing Rhokrag from the Witchfire and returning to Saringallow, the PCs have 1 week of downtime for their own personal projects. This is an excellent time for the characters to train and level up, purchase or craft equipment, or rest and recuperate.

Some characters might want to look into the name “Hellknight Ahala,” but there isn’t much to find. Viro Ahala (vengeful male human Hellknight armiger 5; page 246) has little to his name, though he aims to fix that. A survivor of the Battle of Hellknight Hill, Viro yearns for vengeance against the Hellbreakers and is plotting their destruction with fiendish obsession.

Having learned about the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys, an Isgeri monastic order fostered by the Church of Asmodeus, Viro approached the sisters in the name of the Order of the Rack and was persuasive enough to enlist their aid. Believing him to be a true Hellknight thanks to stolen armor and his confident arrogance, Sister Endreah (steely female human Asmodean nun 4) brought him to a hidden monastery called the Lucent Mission (page 42), where he discovered a grand ritual to summon a devil that could give him the power needed to defeat the League.

While the PCs are busy recruiting the citizens of Isger, Viro is likewise recruiting several other fleeing Hellknight armigers on his way to a series of caves in the Chitterwood where he can enact his ritual.

Building a Political Movement
At the end of the week, Rhokrag calls for an organization-wide meeting after receiving a message from the Demetriases.

## Page 30
地狱破坏者们挤满了地下总部的每个角落，罗克拉格爬上一张桌子，举起一张折叠的纸。“我们刚收到阿尔西奥和菲比的消息，他们对我们迄今为止的成果非常满意！”人群中响起一阵满足的低语。“他们尤其想表彰救了我的那些人。”

“还要告诉你们，从今往后离船远点！”梅尔喊道，引来零星笑声。

“我们都会犯错。”罗克拉格咳嗽一声。“德梅特里亚斯家族报告说，我们对各类贸易船只的补给劫掠在很大程度上迫使杜鲁玛开始限制他们在科涅里卡河上的贸易航线。没错，这对伊斯嘉的经济打击会比对切利亚斯更大，但这只是个开始。赫德文很可能会加强河岸附近的军事巡逻，甚至可能走到向斯戎请求士兵的那一步。”人群发出嘘声。“德梅特里亚斯家族建议我们暂时放缓劫掠。我们需要向伊斯嘉的公民证明，地狱破坏者联盟不只是一帮暴力的叛乱分子。他们需要知道我们关心这片土地与这里的人。这是我们的土地。这些是我们的人。”又一阵欢呼响起，比先前更响亮。

“在接下来的几周里，你们将走入那些人群之中，传播为何伊斯嘉独立如此重要。去跟他们说话。弄清对他们而言什么最重要，并说服他们：对你同样重要。而如果他们需要帮助，就去帮。”

PC被分派到科涅里卡河南侧、奇特伍德北侧的一片伊斯嘉区域，其中包括乌莫克、树桩原与沃迪娅等村庄，以及狼角的驻军。由于另一个小队被分派到阿斯波德尔山脉以东、伊斯嘉东南部区域，PC无需像西到洛加斯或东到尘蹄那样跑得太远。关于这些聚居地的确切位置，见第176页的伊斯嘉地图；你也应与玩家分享这张地图。

PC可以按自己认为合适的任意顺序拜访这些地点，不过狼角离萨林加洛最近。角色可能会询问沿途其他村庄与农场；这些地点在本章未作详述，但你可以将它们描述为总体平静，只是对安多安与切利亚斯之间日益酝酿的敌对关系感到担忧。大多数伊斯嘉公民不想被卷入另一场血腥战争的夹缝之中。PC在每一天的旅行中可以进行一次技能检定，用以代表与这些镇民和农夫说话，从而获得声望点数，详见第30页“乡间旅行”。

这部分冒险没有时间限制；不过，随着PC帮助人们并调查异常事件，他们最终会得到一条线索，指向维罗·阿哈拉为向地狱破坏者联盟复仇而制定的计划。

获得声望点数
在本章中，PC会获得声望点数（RP），它代表伊斯嘉人民对地狱破坏者联盟与“伊斯嘉独立”理念的正面评价与善意。通过击败特定敌人、解决问题，PC会自动获得RP；此外也会有通过技能检定来获得额外RP的机会。记录团队的RP总数：它们不仅会在后续章节中很重要，还会影响随着数周推进，PC需要在多大程度上担心赫德文对叛乱分子悬赏的影响。

如果PC在第1章中拯救了“夜之奖赏号”的船员，他们起始拥有1点RP。

4或更少RP：若PC在某地获得任何RP之前就提到自己隶属于地狱破坏者联盟，或公开表达对切利亚斯政府的蔑视，则进行一次DC 11纯骰检定。失败时，至少该区域仍有少数人对切利亚斯抱有正面看法，并不信任PC的意图。PC在该地点进行以获得声望点数为目的的技能检定时承受–2环境减值。

5–8 RP：同上，但纯骰检定为DC 5。

9–12 RP：同上，但纯骰检定为DC 5，且失败时PC仅承受–1环境减值。

13或更多RP：PC交谈的大多数人都愿意接受摆脱切利亚斯统治枷锁的想法。若PC公开提及自己的隶属关系，则无需进行纯骰检定。

奖励：PC的RP总数第一次达到10或更高时，给予他们10 XP。

发展：当PC达到10点声望点数时，希尔芙修女会前来接触他们（见第41页“悔罪的修女”）。

我们听说了什么？
PC在离开萨林加洛前，可能想先了解自己将被派往的地点。他们可以尝试一次DC 16交涉检定以搜集情报，或对每个地点分别尝试一次DC 16“伊斯嘉学识”或社会检定以回忆知识；成功则得知下文列出的信息。每个地点还会列出一种额外技能，PC可用其对该地点进行回忆知识。

Hellbreakers fill every corner of the basement headquarters 
as Rhokrag climbs onto a table and holds up a folded sheet 
of paper. “We just got word from Alceo and Phoebe, and 
they are quite pleased with our efforts so far!” A general 
murmur of satisfaction runs through the assembled. “They 
especially want to acknowledge the efforts of my 
rescuers.”
“And to tell you to stay away from boats from 
now on!” shouts Maire to some scattered laughter.
“We all make mistakes,” coughs Rhokrag. “The 
Demetriases are reporting that due in large part 
to our supply raids on various trade vessels, 
Druma has begun to limit their trade routes 
on the Conerica. Yes, this will hurt Isger’s 
economy more than Cheliax’s, but it’s a start. 
Hedvend is likely going to increase military 
patrols near the river, maybe even going so 
far as to ask for soldiers from Thrune.” The 
crowd boos. “The Demetriases are suggesting 
that we ease back on the raids for now. We need to show 
the citizens of Isger that the Hellbreakers League is more 
than a band of violent insurgents. They need to know that 
we care about the land and its people. This is OUR land. 
These are OUR people.” Another cheer rises up, louder than 
the first.
“Over the next few weeks, you’ll be going out among 
those people to spread the word of why Isgeri independence 
is so important. Talk to them. Find out what’s important to 
them and convince them it’s important to you as well. And 
if they need help, give it.”
The PCs are assigned an area of Isger south of the 
Conerica River and north of the Chitterwood that 
includes villages like Umok, Stumpfield, and Vordia, 
as well as the garrison at Wolfpoint. The PCs don’t 
need to range as far west as Logas or as far east 
as Dustpawn as another group has been assigned 
the southeast portion of Isger east of the Aspodell 
Mountains. See the map of Isger on page 176 for these 
settlements’ exact locations; you should also share this 
map with the players.
The PCs can visit these locations in any order they 
see fit, though Wolfpoint is the closest to Saringallow. 
The characters might ask about other villages and 
farms along their route; such locations are not detailed 
in this chapter, but you can describe them as being 
generally peaceful, albeit worried about the brewing 
hostilities between Andoran and Cheliax. Most Isgeri 
citizens don’t want to be caught in the middle of 
another bloody war. The PCs can make a single skill 
check during each day of travel to represent speaking 
with these townspeople and farmers to gain Reputation 
Points, as described in Countryside Travel on page 30.
There is no time limit for this portion of the 
adventure, though as the PCs help people and 
investigate unusual goings-on, they will eventually get 
a lead on Viro Ahala’s plans to get revenge against the 
Hellbreakers League.
GAINING REPUTATION POINTS
During this chapter, the PCs gain Reputation 
Points (RP), which represent the positive 
opinion and goodwill that the people of Isger 
have toward the Hellbreakers League and the 
idea of Isgeri independence. By defeating 
certain foes and solving problems, the 
PCs will gain RP automatically, but there 
will also be opportunities for skill checks 
to gain additional RP. Keep track of the 
group’s RP total, as they will be important 
in later chapters, as well as affecting how 
much the PCs will need to worry about 
Hedvend’s bounty on insurgents as the weeks progress. 
If the PCs saved the crew of the Night’s Prize in Chapter 
1, they start with 1 RP.
4 or fewer RP: If the PCs mention that they are 
affiliated with the Hellbreakers League or express open 
disdain for the Chelaxian government before they gain 
any RP at a location, attempt a DC 11 flat check. On 
a failure, at least a few people in the area still have a 
positive opinion toward Cheliax and mistrust the PCs’ 
intentions. The PCs take a –2 circumstance penalty to 
skill checks to gain Reputation Points at this location.
5–8 RP: As above, but the flat check is DC 5.
9–12 RP: As above, but the flat check is DC 5 and 
the PCs only take a –1 circumstance penalty on a 
failure.
13 or more RP: Most of the people the PCs talk to 
are receptive to the idea of throwing off the yoke of 
Chelaxian rule. You don’t need to attempt a flat check 
if the PCs openly mention their affiliation.
Reward: The first time the PCs have a total of 10 or 
more RP, award them 10 XP.
Development: When the PCs reach 10 Reputation 
Points, they’re approached by Sister Sylve (See A 
Repentant Sister on page 41).
WHAT HAVE WE HEARD?
The PCs might want to know about the places they 
are being sent before they head out of Saringallow. 
They can attempt a DC 16 Diplomacy check to Gather 
Information or a DC 16 Isger Lore or Society check 
to Recall Knowledge about each place, learning the 
information listed below on a success. Each location 
also lists an additional skill a PC can use to Recall 
Knowledge about that location.

## Page 31
狼角哨（战争学识）：狼角哨预备驻军营地建于地精血战之前，用于驻扎士兵与军官，其主要目的在于保护科涅里卡河沿岸道路免遭强盗活动侵扰。狼角哨的木制栅栏并非坚不可摧——它在战争期间曾被焚毁殆尽。若为大成功，PC还听说驻扎于此的士兵已被重新调往安多安边境，营地因此无人占用。

沃迪亚（宗教）：沃迪亚是一座位于阿斯波德尔山脉西北的小型、传统的伊斯嘉城镇。在地精血战期间，这里遭受了相当程度的伤害，许多居民被杀。战后，切利亚斯政府协助重建，为其赢得了相当多的民心，这份善意一直延续至今。若为大成功，PC还知道“金色艾琳厄妮丝修女会”自战争以来一直在沃迪亚经营一所孤儿院。

乌莫克（侏儒学识）：乌莫克是一处侏儒定居点，坐落于喋喋林与阿斯波德尔山脉之间。当地居民过去曾与地精有过不幸的纠葛（不包括地精血战），因此他们在村落500码范围内禁止用火。他们转而使用魔法与炼金术来烹饪、取暖与照明。若为大成功，PC听说侏儒村民维持着一张由野生动物组成的网络，用以在危险生物接近时发出警报。他们也知道乌莫克以饲养伊斯嘉獠犬（第215页）而闻名——这是一种偏好追猎异界猎物的犬种。

树桩原（地精学识）：树桩原在伊斯嘉算得上一处奇景：这是一座新近建立的艺术家村落，居民既有地精也有人类。村子位于喋喋林以北不远处，在大多数人眼中，这里的村落与居民“古怪但无害”。若为大成功，PC还知道树桩原与附近的农耕村落蕨斯比之间存在一些紧张关系；后者为树桩原提供了大量日常物资。

乡野旅行
如同大多数国家一般，伊斯嘉各地遍布着未被标在地图上的小路与小径。多数本地人只知道如何前往对自己最重要的三四处地点，因此这些道路缺乏统一的路标。不过，从一处地点前往另一处地点不应成为PC的挑战；甚至可能有角色原本就来自这一带！大多数居民都乐意为队伍指明方向，尤其是在沃迪亚这类较大的城镇。使用第176页的地图来估算各地点之间的距离，并以队伍中最慢的速度来决定他们在1天内能走多少英里。

这些旅程应当相对平稳；不过若你觉得PC的XP不足，一群切利亚斯效忠者或切利亚斯新兵可能会试图在路上阻拦他们通行。或者，一两只野兽也可能因饥饿与绝望而在旅途中尾随PC，并在他们孤立无援时发动攻击。

此外，队伍每天在路上时，可由一名PC尝试一次DC 18的技能检定，以影响他们在途中可能接触到的本地人，使其转而支持“破狱者联盟”与伊斯嘉独立，从而获得RP。交涉是这些检定的默认技能，但PC也可以尝试一次欺瞒检定来捏造切利亚斯政府正计划的可怕行径；一次表演检定来进行演出（并将反切利亚斯或亲伊斯嘉的情绪隐藏在演出之中）；或以伊斯嘉学识或社交检定来讨论市民的日常困境，以及新政府将如何改善这些问题。玩家甚至可能提出其他技能。由你裁定，DC可上调或下调1点，以体现当地人对切利亚斯的忠诚程度。

狼角哨
狼角哨预备驻军营地位于科涅里卡河正南方，建于地精血战之前，可容纳约300名士兵与军官，主要负责保护水路与附近道路免遭强盗活动侵扰。环绕众多营房的木制栅栏在战争期间曾被焚毁殆尽，但此后已修复。随着布雷奇山的紧张局势与后续冲突爆发，原驻扎于此的士兵被重新调往伊斯嘉境内其他地区，使营地在过去数周里一直空无一人。

当PC前往狼角哨时，他们开始从其他旅人和农夫那里听到关于该地区强盗活动增加的传闻。人们抱怨，自从狼角哨的士兵被调离后，当地警长便无法压制路匪犯罪。许多人相信一个名为“钢铁圆环”的强盗团伙已经接管了狼角哨，但也有人坚称有更阴险之物如今占据了这座营地。这些人声称曾看见栅栏墙内有地精出没，点起篝火并为另一场战争做准备。若追问细节，他们会描述一些尖耳朵的小个子，外貌与地精仅有些许相似。实际上，钢铁圆环确实试图将狼角哨作为新的半……

30
Wolfpoint (Warfare Lore): The Wolfpoint reserve 
garrison was built before the Goblinblood Wars to 
hold soldiers and officers with the primary purpose 
of protecting the roads by the Conerica River from 
bandit activity. The wooden palisade of Wolfpoint 
isn’t impenetrable, though, having burned to the 
ground during the war. On a critical success, the PC 
has also heard that the soldiers stationed there have 
been reassigned to the Andoran border, leaving the 
garrison unoccupied.
Vordia (Religion): Vordia is a small, traditional 
Isgeri town northwest of the Aspodell Mountains. 
During the Goblinblood Wars, it suffered a fair amount 
of damage and many of its people were killed. The 
Chelaxian government helped rebuild after the war, 
creating a fair amount of goodwill with the people 
that lasts to this day. On a critical success, the PC also 
knows that the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys has 
run an orphanage in Vordia since the war.
Umok (Gnome Lore): Umok is a gnome settlement 
nestled between the Chitterwood and the Aspodell 
Mountains. The residents have had unfortunate 
dealings with goblins in the past (not including the 
Goblinblood Wars) and have outlawed fire within 
500 yards of the village. They instead use magic and 
alchemy for cooking, warmth, and light. On a critical 
success, the PC has heard that the gnome villagers 
maintain a network of wild animals to warn them of 
a dangerous creature’s approach. They also know that 
Umok is known for raising Isgeri boarhounds (page 
215), a breed of dog with a penchant for hunting 
down extraplanar prey.
Stumpfield (Goblin Lore): Stumpfield is something 
of an oddity in Isger, as a recently established village 
of artists of both goblin and human. Located just 
north of the Chitterwood, the village and its residents 
are considered “weird but harmless” by most. On a 
critical success, the PC also knows that there is some 
tension between Stumpfield and the nearby farming 
village of Fernsby, which provides a lot of Stumpfield’s 
day-to-day goods.
Countryside Travel
Like in most countries, small roads and paths 
crisscross the whole of Isger that aren’t marked on any 
map. Most locals know how to get to the three or four 
places that are most important to them, so these roads 
lack any consistent signage. However, traveling from 
one location to another isn’t meant to be a challenge 
for the PCs; a character might even originally be from 
this area! Most residents are happy enough to point 
the party in the right direction, especially in some of 
the larger towns like Vordia. Use the map on page 
176 to chart approximate distances between locations 
and the party’s slowest Speed to determine how many 
miles they can travel in 1 day.
These journeys should be relatively uneventful, 
though if you feel the PCs are lacking in XP, a group 
of Chelaxian loyalists or Chelaxian recruits might 
attempt to bar their passage on the road. Alternatively, 
a wild animal or two might be hungry and desperate 
enough to stalk the PCs as they travel, attacking when 
they are all alone.
In addition, each day they are on the road, one PC 
can attempt a DC 18 skill check to sway the locals they 
might interact with on their journey into supporting the 
Hellbreakers League and Isgeri independence, earning 
them RP. Diplomacy is the default skill to use for these 
checks, but a PC might attempt a Deception check 
to fabricate terrible acts the Chelaxian government 
is planning, a Performance check to entertain (while 
hiding anti-Cheliax or pro-Isger sentiment within the 
performance), or an Isger Lore or Society check to 
discuss the citizens’ everyday problems and how they 
might be improved with a new government. Players 
might even propose other skills. At your discretion, the 
DC might be 1 higher or lower to represent how loyal 
the locals are to Cheliax.

## Page 32
……把那里当作永久的行动基地，但被德鲁德——一种恶意、能诱发噩梦的妖精——吓退了；那只德鲁德早已在此处安家。

THE STEEL CIRCLE
在前往狼角哨之前，PC们可能想多了解一些钢环帮的情况。一名PC在进行回忆知识时，若在DC 18的社交检定或DC 16的黑社会学识检定中成功，便听说过这支强盗帮派。他们是一群规模颇大、组织严密的窃贼与劫匪，活动范围遍及伊斯嘉南部。这些强盗在乡间四处游荡，不会在同一地点停留太久，以免执法者追踪到他们。

在大成功时，该PC知道钢环帮喜欢扎营的地点类型——山坡洞穴、隐蔽裂缝与废弃农舍——并获得下文“收集情报”成功检定的结果。

一名PC若在DC 18的交涉检定中成功以收集情报，则得知钢环帮目前驻扎在狼角哨东南一里处的一座废弃农场。在大成功时，该PC还会听说这些强盗曾试图在狼角哨立足，但有什么东西把他们赶走了。

若PC们接近农场，会被隐藏极好的哨兵发现，对方会向钢环帮首领发出警告。数名全副武装的强盗会出来，在休耕的田地中央与PC们会面。他们由鲁娜·血锤（多疑的女性矮人强盗4级）带领；她的第一件事就是让PC们明白：若他们对她或她的人动手，几秒之内就会没命。PC们在此处寡不敌众，从附近谷仓与农舍中感受到又有十多双眼睛在盯着他们。

鲁娜以不友善的态度开始这场遭遇，不过PC可以通过一次成功的DC 17交涉检定（留下印象）来改变她的态度。若某名PC拥有能对多人同时留下印象的技能专长（如团体印象），则其为改变鲁娜态度而进行的技能检定获得+1环境加值。若PC们拥有6点或更多声望点数，则其为改变鲁娜态度而进行的技能检定获得+2环境加值，因为钢环帮并非切利亚斯的朋友。

鲁娜愿意与PC们交谈足够长的时间，让他们尝试进行三次检定来动摇她。她会询问他们在此地的目的，并试图在不直接提及的话题下，探测他们对违法行径的观感。

若PC们将鲁娜的态度提升至友善，她会承认她的帮派确实曾在狼角哨内扎营过一晚，但他们做了可怕的噩梦。尽管这些强盗是身经百战的罪犯，他们仍被吓得不敢留在驻地里，转而在这座农场落脚。鲁娜打了个响指，提议如果PC们去调查狼角哨并清除“玷污此地的诅咒或生物”，她就会让钢环帮尽其所能协助破狱者。若鲁娜的态度为乐于助人，她还会同意捐出一些补给支持行动。

若鲁娜的态度变为敌对，她会朝同伙做个尖锐的手势并怒气冲冲地离开。一阵箭雨倾泻到PC们身上：每名PC受到2d8+13点穿刺伤害，DC 20基础反射豁免。若PC们尝试了三次检定后，鲁娜的态度仍仅为冷淡或不友善，她会冷冷地叫PC们滚开，并警告他们不要再接近农场。若PC们拒绝离开或之后试图返回，他们会遭到强盗的怒火，效果如同鲁娜的态度为敌对。

奖励：若将鲁娜的态度变为友善或乐于助人，给予PC们30 XP。

狼角哨木栅栏 低威胁2与中等威胁2
当PC们探索狼角哨时，他们发现此地毫无生命迹象。它最多只被废弃了几周，但甚至连老鼠或流浪的狼都没尝试重新占据这些建筑。活物似乎都会避开这里。这是德鲁德影响所致：德鲁德是一种阴影般的妖精生物，仅仅在附近出没就能引发可怕的噩梦。这只特定的德鲁德会被发生过灾祸之处吸引，并在其造成的梦境中使用那些事件的意象。德鲁德身边还有几只格雷姆林，它们喜爱混乱。

若PC们在此扎营，他们的睡眠会被噩梦折磨：嗜血的地精群落冲击他们的阵地，用锋利的狗切刀与更锋利的牙齿刺穿、撕咬他们。值夜的PC会听到木栅栏附近传来奇怪的响动，像是尖叫与呻吟。

这场遭遇发生在深夜、处于黑暗之中。睡着的PC很可能没有点燃火把或其他光源，因此以光源均已熄灭的状态开始此遭遇。进行此遭遇时，使用第32页的“狼角哨木栅栏”地图。

生物：一小群帕格旺皮格雷姆林与在狼角哨作祟的德鲁德结盟。它们试图用反常的声响与呼救声，把夜里仍清醒的PC引到鲁娜·血锤……

by the drude—a malicious nightmare-inducing 
fey that had already taken up residence

THE STEEL CIRCLE
The PCs might want to learn a little 
more about the Steel Circle before 
heading to Wolfpoint. A PC who 
succeeds at a DC 18 Society check or 
DC 16 Underworld Lore check to Recall 
Knowledge has heard of the bandit gang. 
They are a fairly large and organized 
group of thieves and robbers who operate 
throughout southern Isger. These bandits 
rove about the countryside, not staying in 
a single location long enough for law enforcement to 
track them down. On a critical success, the PC knows 
the type of places—hillside caves, hidden crevices, and 
abandoned farmhouses—the Steel Circle likes to camp 
in, gaining the result of a successful check to Gather 
Information noted below.
A PC who succeeds at a DC 18 Diplomacy check 
to Gather Information learns that the Steel Circle is 
currently camped out in an abandoned farm a mile 
southeast of Wolfpoint. On a critical success, the PC 
also hears that the bandits tried to set up in Wolfpoint, 
but something drove them off.
If the PCs approach the farm, they are spotted 
by well-hidden lookouts, who warn the Steel Circle 
leaders. Several armed bandits go out to meet the PCs 
in the middle of the fallow fields. They are led by Runa 
Bloodhammer (wary female dwarf bandit 4), whose 
first order of business is to let the PCs know that if 
they try anything against her or her people, they’ll be 
dead within seconds. The PCs are outnumbered here, 
sensing a dozen more sets of eyes upon them from the 
nearby barn and farmhouse.
Runa begins the encounter as unfriendly, though a 
PC can change her attitude with a successful DC 17 
Diplomacy check to Make an Impression. If a PC has 
a skill feat that allows them to Make an Impression 
on several people at once (such as Group Impression), 
they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to 
change Runa’s attitude. If the PCs have 6 or more 
Reputation Points, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus 
to skill checks to change Runa’s attitude, as the Steel 
Circle are no friends of Cheliax.
Runa is willing to talk with the PCs long enough 
for them to attempt three checks to sway her. She 
asks them their business in the area and tries to 
gauge their feelings about breaking the law without 
broaching the subject directly. If the PCs increase 
Runa’s attitude to friendly, she admits that her gang 
did spend one night camped inside Wolfpoint, but 
they had terrible nightmares. While the bandits are 
hardened criminals, they were too frightened to 
remain in the garrison and set up on this farm. 
Runa snaps her fingers and proposes that if 
the PCs investigate Wolfpoint and remove 
any “curse or creature befouling the 
place,” she’ll have the Steel Circle 
help the Hellbreakers as best 
they can. If Runa’s attitude is 
helpful, she’ll also agree to donate 
some supplies to the effort.
If Runa’s attitude becomes hostile, she 
gives a sharp gesture to her fellow bandits 
and storms off. A volley of arrows rains 
down on the PCs, dealing 2d8+13 piercing damage 
to each of them with a DC 20 basic Reflex save. If 
Runa’s attitude is only indifferent or unfriendly after 
the PCs attempt three checks, she curtly tells the PCs 
to go away, warning them to not approach the farm 
again. If the PCs refuse to leave or later try to return, 
they suffer the bandits’ wrath as if Runa’s attitude is 
hostile.
Reward: For changing Runa’s attitude to friendly or 
helpful, award the PCs 30 XP.
WOLFPOINT PALISADE
LOW 2 AND MODERATE 2
When the PCs explore Wolfpoint, they find it devoid 
of life. It’s been abandoned for several weeks at most, 
but not even mice or stray wolves have attempted to 
reclaim the buildings. Living creatures just seem to 
avoid the place. This is the result of the influence of a 
drude, a shadowy fey creature whose mere presence in 
the area can invoke terrible nightmares. This particular 
drude is drawn to areas where calamity has occurred 
and uses imagery of those events in the dreams they 
cause. The drude is accompanied by several gremlins 
who delight in the chaos.
If the PCs set up camp here, their sleep is plagued 
with nightmares of bloodthirsty goblin hordes 
attacking their position, stabbing and biting them 
with sharp dogslicers and even sharper teeth. A PC 
on watch hears strange noises by the palisade like 
squawking cries and moans. This encounter takes 
place in the middle of the night, in darkness. Sleeping 
PCs likely don’t have torches or other light sources 
lit, so begin this encounter with them extinguished. 
Use the Wolfpoint Palisades map on page 32 for this 
encounter.
Creatures: A small pack of pugwampi gremlins 
have allied with the drude haunting Wolfpoint. They 
attempt to draw any PCs still awake in the night to

## Page 34
许多居民对切利亚斯怀有相当程度的好感。若PC们公开讨论他们对破狱者同盟（第29页）的效忠，那么当你进行纯骰检定时，掷骰两次并取较差的结果。

沃迪亚是一座拥有数百居民、熙熙攘攘的小镇，外观与伊斯嘉乡野的其他小型聚落并无太大不同。让它格外显眼的细节，是几乎每栋建筑的屋顶或几乎每扇窗户上，都飘扬着数十面旗帜——要么印着切利亚斯的国徽，要么印着阿斯莫德斯的宗教徽记。尽管如此（或许正因如此），居民们日常往来时看上去心情愉快。

这些城镇装饰应当向玩家暗示：他们在这里需要保持低调。他们也许不想久留，但他们的任务至少是尝试悄悄影响民意。鼓励他们倾听并观察，看看居民是否对切利亚斯政府有什么不满——那可能是这层精心维持的愉悦表象上的裂缝。若他们花时间进行“收集情报”（DC 16），很快就会得知：多数镇民都在担忧经营“明烬孤儿院”的修女们。自从几周前小镇被一名古怪的地狱骑士造访后，修女们就很少露面了。

若PC们想进一步了解此事，其中一人必须尝试一次DC 16的交涉检定以“收集情报”，或尝试一次DC 14的书记学识或社会检定以查阅镇上的公共记录。若交涉检定成功，PC得知：两天前夜里，一群本地青少年互相打赌，潜入那座看似废弃的孤儿院，结果被二楼传来的怪声吓跑。若书记学识或社会检定成功，PC会在记录中发现非常近期的条目：明烬孤儿院目前的两名孤儿在那名地狱骑士来访后的第二天，双双被邻镇家庭收养，但这些家庭的名字却诡异地无法辨认。只要简单打听，PC们就能得知孤儿院的位置，以及它由金色厄里倪厄斯修会经营——村民们对该修会尽是溢美之词。

【获得声望点数】
PC们在沃迪亚期间，可以尝试获得声望点数，以提升当地对破狱者同盟的看法。他们当然可以使用该组织的名字，只要不泄露他们与之结盟的事实即可。凭借巧妙或激昂的言辞、关于“真实的”切利亚斯的警示故事，或对同盟所做善举的阐述，一名PC可以尝试一次DC 18的欺瞒、交涉、表演或社会检定。若PC们在没有证据的情况下诋毁金色厄里倪厄斯修会，则该检定承受–1环境减值。成功度使用“乡间旅行”（第30页）的同一套成功度。

D. 明烬孤儿院
金色厄里倪厄斯修会经营明烬孤儿院将近二十年，起初收容地精血战中的孤儿，并为他们在一个由阿斯莫德斯法则统治的国家生活作准备。这包括向孩子们灌输亲切利亚斯的宣传，并通过强调“地精族所钟爱的混乱导致他们的父母丧生”来试图培养对法律与秩序的敬畏——却刻意不提：战争中的许多大地精指挥官，其严苛程度并不亚于某些地狱骑士骑士团。

这些年对孩子们心智的持续情感轰炸，在建筑中留下了灵能印记，导致内部出现异常现象。曾经的住户提到，他们见过门从房间另一头猛然砰地关上；听见墙壁中传出痛苦的惊恐尖叫；感到有看不见的东西在注视自己，等等。修女们会将这些现象解释为恶作剧或胡思乱想，而她们铁一般的意志也阻止孤儿院彻底闹鬼。直到维罗·阿哈拉的到来，这一切才告终结。

当维罗说服恩德蕾娅修女协助他的计划后，她的同僚们也随她一同离开，使孤儿院无人看守。由于明烬不再有修女压制这座建筑的秘教共鸣，过去数十年情绪余波凝聚而成的一小群不稳定灵体便形成了。

由于这所孤儿院是PC们目前唯一能够追查沃迪亚金色厄里倪厄斯修会如何与那名神秘地狱骑士关联的线索，他们将需要探索建筑以查明更多信息。若PC们听过本地青少年的故事，他们的好奇心或许会被勾起。进入闹鬼的孤儿院并非提升同盟在沃迪亚声望的必要条件，但当他们开始听闻其他村落的怪事可能与该修会有关时，或许会想再回来一探究竟。

D1. 孤儿院庭院
明烬位于小镇东侧郊外。PC们接近建筑时，阅读或转述以下内容。

一道围墙圈起的庭院环绕着一座矩形的两层建筑，建筑的棱角看上去略有偏斜，仿佛整座结构都……

many of the residents feel a fair amount of goodwill 
toward Cheliax. When you attempt a flat check if the 
PCs openly discuss their allegiance to the Hellbreakers 
League (page 29), roll twice and take the worse result.
 A bustling town of several hundred people, Vordia doesn’t 
look much different from any other small settlement in the 
Isgeri countryside. The one detail that makes it stand out 
is the dozens of flags bearing either the national symbol 
of Cheliax or the religious symbol of Asmodeus flying atop 
nearly every building or from nearly every window. Despite 
this (or perhaps because of it), the residents look happy as 
they go about their day.
The town decorations should hint to the players 
that they need to keep a low profile here. They might 
not want to stay long, but it’s their mission to at least 
try to quietly sway the populace. It will benefit them to 
listen and observe to see if the residents have any issues 
with the Chelaxian government that could be a crack 
in the pleasantly maintained facade. If they spend time 
Gathering Information (DC 16), they quickly learn 
that most townspeople are concerned about the nuns 
who run the Bright Embers Orphanage. Ever since the 
town was visited by a strange Hellknight a few weeks 
ago, the nuns haven’t been seen much.
 If the PCs want to learn more about this occurrence, 
one of them must attempt a DC 16 Diplomacy check 
to Gather Information or a DC 14 Scribing Lore or 
Society check to look into the town’s public records. 
On a successful Diplomacy check, the PC learns 
that two nights ago, a group of local teens dared 
one another to sneak into the seemingly abandoned 
orphanage and were frightened off by strange noises 
coming from the second floor. On a successful Scribing 
Lore or Society check, the PC finds very recent records 
of Bright Embers’ two current orphan charges both 
finding families in neighboring towns the day after the 
Hellknight’s visit, but the names of these families are 
oddly unreadable. By simply asking around, the PCs 
learn the location of the orphanage and that it is run 
by the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys, for whom the 
villagers have nothing but kind words.
GAINING REPUTATION POINTS
While the PCs are in Vordia, they can attempt to gain 
Reputation Points to bolster local opinion about the 
Hellbreakers League. They can, of course, use the 
organization’s name, as long as they don’t give away 
the fact that they are allied with it. With clever or fiery 
rhetoric, cautionary tales about the “true” Cheliax, or 
explanations of the good the League has accomplished, 
a PC can attempt a DC 18 Deception, Diplomacy, 
Performance, or Society check. If the PCs disparage 
the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys without proof, 
they take a –1 circumstance penalty to this check. Use 
the same degrees of success for Countryside Travel 
(page 30).
D. BRIGHT EMBERS ORPHANAGE
The Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys ran the Bright 
Embers Orphanage for nearly two decades, starting 
by taking in orphans of the Goblinblood Wars and 
preparing them to live in a country governed by the 
rule of Asmodeus. This entailed teaching the children 
pro-Cheliax propaganda and attempting to instill 
a respect for law and order by emphasizing that the 
chaos loved by goblinkind got their parents killed, 
conveniently not mentioning that many of the war’s 
hobgoblin commanders could be as strict as some 
Hellknight orders.
This constant emotional barrage on the children’s 
minds over the years has left a psychic imprint on the 
building, causing unusual phenomena to occur within. 
Former residents have spoken about seeing doors 
slamming from across the room, hearing agonized 
cries of terror coming from the walls, feeling like 
someone unseen is watching, and so on. The Sisters 
would explain these occurrences as pranks or wild 
imaginings, and their iron will stopped the orphanage 
from becoming fully haunted. That ended with the 
arrival of Viro Ahala.
When Viro convinced Sister Endreah to help him 
with his plan, her fellow nuns went with her, leaving 
the orphanage with no staff. With no more nuns 
in Bright Embers to suppress the building’s occult 
resonance, a handful of unstable spirits have formed 
from the emotional fallout of the past decades.
As the orphanage is the only lead the PCs have to 
how the Sisters of the Golden Erinys in Vordia are 
connected to the mystery Hellknight, they’ll need 
to explore the building to find out more. If the PCs 
heard the story of the local teens, their curiosity might 
be piqued. Entering the haunted orphanage isn’t 
necessary to further the League’s reputation in Vordia, 
but they might want to return once they start hearing 
about how the strange occurrences in other villages 
might be related to the sisterhood.
D1. Orphanage Yard
Bright Embers is near the eastern outskirts of the 
town. When the PCs approach the building, read or 
paraphrase the following.
A walled yard surrounds a rectangular two-story building 
whose angles seem slightly off, as if the structure were

## Page 35
……显得蜷缩成一团。所有窗户都拉上了窗帘，但前门微微半掩，偶尔随着一阵阵微风砰地拍打门框。几棵矮小、光秃无叶的树木守望着几片将枯的草地，以及一架孤零零的跷跷板——其红漆斑驳剥落、褪色不堪。通往建筑的石板小径尽头有一扇紧闭的锻铁门，上面钉着一块金属牌匾，写着“明亮余烬孤儿院，建立于4701 AR”。

曾经，孩子们在这片院子里玩耍，笑声传到邻近的街道；如今这里空无一人，寂静无声。队伍接近前门时，若有PC通过DC 18 察觉检定，便注意到楼上一间房的窗帘轻轻抖动（区域D5）。若有PC检查院子并通过DC 16 秘法学检定，便能感知到树木、草地以及一切事物的腐败衰败状态被超自然地加速了。

D2. 门厅
一条宽阔的走廊贯穿整栋建筑。地板磨损严重，所有室内门都歪歪斜斜地挂在铰链上。一段宽阔的楼梯通往二楼。

与前院的恶化相似，建筑内失修的状态也被如今肆虐的灵性能量所加速。PC们听见四周传来脚步声，仿佛孩子们仍在奔跑。透过敞开的门洞，队伍能看见东侧的餐厅与厨房，以及西侧的娱乐室。

D3. 餐厅
微不足道2
这间房里有两套桌椅，其中一套比另一套略小，并配有适合儿童的小椅子。较大的桌子上空无一物，而较小的桌子上摆着四只盘子，却没有餐具。

危害：修女会严苛的纪律使得用餐必须安静稳重，任何孤儿都不被允许胡闹。这种压抑渗入了家具；如今修女们已撤离，它迫不及待要释放出来。任何生物一接近儿童用桌（地图上标示处），一场幽魂般的食物大战便会爆发。

食物大战　危害2
复杂　怨灵
隐匿+8（受训）

描述：幽灵般的食物出现在裂纹斑驳的盘子上方，盘子漂浮在桌面之上。房间里时不时能看到孩子的淡淡轮廓，随着灵质食物被四处掷飞而一闪而逝。

解除：DC 17 秘法学（受训）以削弱房间内的灵性能量；DC 18 特技动作（受训）从空中摘下一个漂浮的盘子；或DC 19 威吓（受训）斥责某个幽灵孩子的不良行为；每次成功的检定都会解除四只盘子中的一只

AC 18；强韧+6，反射+10
硬度5（盘子）；HP 10/每只盘子；免疫 物体免疫，精准伤害

晚餐铃声 反应动作（听觉，秘法，音波）
触发：某个生物移动至摆好餐具的桌子相邻方格；
效果：一声响亮的魅影晚餐铃先行鸣响，随后盘子开始颤抖并悬浮。房间内每个生物受到2d6+2音波伤害（DC 17 基础强韧豁免）。随后怨灵进行先攻。

常规（4动作）：怨灵每有一只盘子被解除或摧毁，便减少1个动作。在每个动作中，一只盘子会向房间内一个不同的活物掷出幽魂食物。此远程打击不会引发反应动作。被掷食物打击重击的生物还会目眩1轮。
远程 掷食物 +11（秘法，灵体），伤害 1d10+4灵体；无射程增量或多重攻击减值

重置：所有生物离开房间1分钟后，或四只盘子全被摧毁后，怨灵停止运作。1小时后，若至少仍有一只盘子存在，怨灵重新运作。若被解除，怨灵在1天后重置，盘子会以魔法重新组装。区域D5的阁楼低语者被摧毁时，此怨灵将被永久摧毁。

D4. 游戏室
低威胁2
这间游戏室的墙上绘着褪色壁画：看起来友善的魔鬼与阿斯莫德斯修女们牵着孩子的手，而他们的神祇对其微笑俯视。那些在其他场景中本该暴戾或恐怖的面孔，在这里却被描绘得顽皮而和善。室内空荡荡的，只有中央放着一个积满灰尘的玩具箱。

hunched in on itself. Curtains have been drawn in all the 
windows, but the front door is slightly ajar, occasionally 
banging against its frame 
with each stray breeze. A few 
stunted trees bare of leaves 
stand watch over patches 
of dying grass and a lone 
seesaw whose red paint is 
chipped and faded. A closed 
wrought-iron gate at the end 
of a stone walkway leading 
to the building features a 
metal 
plaque 
that 
reads 
“Bright Embers Orphanage, 
established 4701 ar.”
Children used to play in this yard, 
their laughter ringing out to the nearby street, but 
now it is empty and silent. As the group approaches 
the front door, a PC who succeeds at a DC 18 
Perception check notices the curtains twitch in one 
of the upstairs rooms (area D5). A PC who examines 
the yard and succeeds at a DC 16 Occultism check 
can sense that the state of decay the trees, grass, 
and everything else is in has been supernaturally 
accelerated.
D2. Entry Hall
A wide hall runs through the building. The floor is scuffed, 
and all the interior doors hang crookedly from their hinges. 
A wide staircase leads up to the second floor.
Similar to the deterioration of the front yard, the 
unkempt state of the building has been hastened by 
the now-rampant spiritual energy. The PCs hear 
footsteps all around them as if children were still 
running around. Through the open doors, the party 
can see a dining hall and kitchen to the east and a 
recreation room to the west.
D3. Dining Hall	
Trivial 2
This room features two table sets, one a bit smaller than 
the other, with accompanying small chairs to accommodate 
children. While the larger table has nothing on it, the 
smaller table is set with four plates but no utensils.
Hazard: The strict discipline of the sisterhood meant 
that meals were sedate affairs where no orphan was 
permitted to act up. This repression steeped into the 
furniture and is eager to be released now that the nuns 
have vacated. A spectral food fight breaks out when 
any creature gets close to the kids’ table (as marked 
on the map).
FOOD FIGHT	
HAZARD 2
COMPLEX
HAUNT
Stealth +8 (trained)
Description 
Ghostly 
food 
appears on cracked plates as 
they float above the table. 
The faint outline of children 
can occasionally be seen as 
the ectoplasmic food is flung 
throughout the room.
Disable DC 17 Occultism (trained) 
to weaken the spiritual energy in 
the room, DC 18 Acrobatics (trained) 
to pluck a floating plate out of the air, or DC 
19 Intimidation (trained) to reprimand one of the ghostly 
children for their poor behavior; each successful check 
disables one of four plates
AC 18; Fort +6, Ref +10
Hardness 5 (plate); HP 10 per plate; Immunities object 
immunities, precision damage
Dinner Bell [reaction] (auditory, occult, sonic) Trigger A creature 
moves adjacent to the set table; Effect A loud phantom 
dinner bell rings before the plates begin to tremble and 
hover. Each creature in the room takes 2d6+2 sonic 
damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save). The haunt then 
rolls initiative.
Routine (4 actions) For each plate disabled or destroyed, 
the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, spectral 
food is flung off a plate at a different living creature in 
the room. This ranged Strike doesn’t provoke reactions. 
A creature critically hit by a flung food Strike is also 
dazzled for 1 round.
Ranged flung food +11 (occult, spirit), Damage 1d10+4 
spirit; no range increment or multiple attack penalty
Reset The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures 
leave the room or after all four plates are destroyed. 
After 1 hour, if at least one plate remains, the haunt 
reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day 
and the plates magically reassemble. The haunt is 
permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area 
D5 is destroyed.
D4. Play Room	
Low 2
Faded murals of friendly looking devils are painted across 
the walls of this playroom, with nuns of Asmodeus holding 
hands with children as their deity smiles down upon them. 
Faces that would normally be violent or gruesome in any 
other scene are depicted as playful and kind. The room is 
empty save for a dusty toy box in the center.

hunched in on itself. Curtains have been drawn in all the windows, but the front door is slightly ajar, occasionally banging against its frame with each stray breeze. A few stunted trees bare of leaves stand watch over patches of dying grass and a lone seesaw whose red paint is chipped and faded. A closed wrought-iron gate at the end of a stone walkway leading to the building features a metal plaque that reads “Bright Embers Orphanage, established 4701 ar.”

Children used to play in this yard, their laughter ringing out to the nearby street, but now it is empty and silent. As the group approaches the front door, a PC who succeeds at a DC 18 Perception check notices the curtains twitch in one of the upstairs rooms (area D5). A PC who examines the yard and succeeds at a DC 16 Occultism check can sense that the state of decay the trees, grass, and everything else is in has been supernaturally accelerated.

D2. Entry Hall
A wide hall runs through the building. The floor is scuffed, and all the interior doors hang crookedly from their hinges. A wide staircase leads up to the second floor.

Similar to the deterioration of the front yard, the unkempt state of the building has been hastened by the now-rampant spiritual energy. The PCs hear footsteps all around them as if children were still running around. Through the open doors, the party can see a dining hall and kitchen to the east and a recreation room to the west.

D3. Dining Hall Trivial 2
This room features two table sets, one a bit smaller than the other, with accompanying small chairs to accommodate children. While the larger table has nothing on it, the smaller table is set with four plates but no utensils.

Hazard: The strict discipline of the sisterhood meant that meals were sedate affairs where no orphan was permitted to act up. This repression steeped into the furniture and is eager to be released now that the nuns have vacated. A spectral food fight breaks out when any creature gets close to the kids’ table (as marked on the map).

修女们明白结构化的游戏对心智发展至关重要，因此允许孤儿们在这里放纵其孩童般的奇思妙想。

危害：尽管这里是幼儿的游戏室，但从不允许喧闹胡闹。把别的孩子推倒或扯头发的孩子会受到严厉斥责（当然是在其他孤儿看不见的地方）。积木、多米诺骨牌、抓子等游戏本该带来的乐趣被白白浪费，令这种情绪浸入房间的玩具箱，使其变成一桶随时会在PC探索此房间时在他们面前“爆炸”的“欢乐”火药。

游戏时间（PLAY 时代） 危害3

解除 DC 19 神秘学（受训）以驱逐玩具箱中的灵体；DC 20 运动（受训）以暂时按住玩具箱不让其打开；或 DC 21 交涉（受训）以说服灵体游戏时间结束；解除该灵异总计需要3次成功。
AC 16；强韧 +12，反射 +7

大失败 同失败，但惊惧4（状态）。

常规（1动作）玩具箱喷吐出一个15尺锥形的玩具洪流，造成3d8钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害（每次随机选择一种），DC 20 基础反射豁免。
重置 当所有生物离开房间1分钟后，或玩具箱被摧毁时，灵异失活。1小时后，若玩具箱仍在，灵异重新活化。若被解除，灵异在1天后重置。当D5区域的阁楼低语者被摧毁时，该灵异被永久摧毁。

D5. 孤儿寝室 严峻2
两排矮小、破败的床沿着房间的墙壁排开。破烂的毯子整齐地铺在床上，每张床旁都有一组小抽屉，其中许多抽屉半开着且空空如也。一张床上放着一只犬科头骨，旁边是一个破旧的绒毛熊。

这里有足够空间让12名孤儿共同睡在一起。孤儿院自建成后的头几年起就再未满员，因此常常只有两三个孤儿独占这间房。由于吞没整栋建筑的神秘能量，这里看起来仿佛多年无人入睡。

危害：修女们确保所有孤儿不论年龄都在同一时间就寝。年长的孩子有时会在黑暗中躺在床上，想着新的家庭，或哄年幼的孤儿入睡。这种独特的静默绝望滋味造就了此一会引发黑暗的灵异。

生物：孤儿院内心灵能量的整体基调，孕育出一种通常与被遗忘、被遗弃的儿童相关的亡灵生物，称为阁楼低语者。当灵异掷先攻时，某张床上的犬科头骨会升起并附着到那只腐朽的泰迪熊上。该生物裹着一条破旧床单，开始回响许多早已长大的孤儿的哭声。此阁楼低语者会战斗至被摧毁。

The Sisters understood that structured play is 
important to developing minds and allowed the 
orphans to indulge their childish whims here.
Hazard: Despite this being a playroom for young 
children, rambunctiousness was never permitted. A 
child who pushed another down or pulled their hair 
was severely reprimanded (out of sight of the other 
orphans, of course). The wasted potential enjoyment 
of blocks, dominoes, jacks, and so forth has infused 
the room’s toy box, making it a powder keg of “fun” 
ready to explode in the PCs’ faces when they explore 
this room.
PLAY TIME	
HAZARD 3
COMPLEX
HAUNT
Stealth +13 (trained)
Description An old, dusty toy box creaks open and 
forcefully expels a series of cracked and broken toys.
Disable DC 19 Occultism (trained) to exorcise the spirits 
of the toy box, DC 20 Athletics (trained) to hold the toy 
box closed momentarily, or DC 21 Diplomacy (trained) 
to convince the spirits that play time is over; three total 
success are required to disable the haunt
AC 16; Fort +12, Ref +7
Hardness 10 (toy box); HP 45; Immunities critical hits, 
object immunities, precision damage
Terrifying Toy Box [reaction] (emotion, fear, mental, occult, visual) 
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the toy 
box; Effect The toy box lid slowly opens with a groan, 
revealing a yawning chasm into nothingness. Each 
creature who can see the toy box must attempt a DC 23 
Will save. The haunt then rolls initiative.
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is frightened 1.
Failure The creature is frightened 2 and can’t reduce its 
frightened condition below 1 while the haunt is active.
Critical Failure As failure, but frightened 4.
Routine (1 action) The toy box belches forth a 15-foot cone 
of toys, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing 
damage (chosen randomly each time) with a DC 20 basic 
Reflex save.
Reset The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures 
leave the room or if the toy box is destroyed. After 1 
hour, if the toy box remains, the haunt reactivates. 
If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is 
permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area 
D5 is destroyed.
D5. Orphans’ Bedroom	
Severe 2
Two rows of small, decrepit beds line the walls of this room. 
Tattered blankets are neatly draped across the beds, and 
each bed has a small set of drawers next to it, many of 
which hang open and empty. A canine skull sits on one bed, 
next to a ratty stuffed bear.
There’s room for 12 orphans to sleep communally 
here. The orphanage hasn’t been at full capacity since 
the first few years after it was built, so often, two or 
three orphans would have this room to themselves. 
Thanks to the occult energy engulfing the building, it 
doesn’t look like anyone has slept here for years.
Hazard: The Sisters made sure that all orphans had 
the same bedtime, regardless of age. Older children 
would sometimes lie in their beds in the dark, thinking 
about new families or soothing the younger orphans 
to sleep. This unique flavor of quiet despair created 
this darkness-inducing haunt.
Creatures: The general tenor of the psychic energy in 
the orphanage has created an undead creature usually 
associated with forgotten and forlorn children, known 
as an attic whisperer. When the haunt rolls initiative, 
the canine skull on one of the beds rises up to attach 
to the rotting teddy bear. The creature is wrapped in 
a tattered sheet and begins echoing the cries of many 
of the orphans who have since grown up. This attic 
whisperer fights until destroyed.

## Page 37
……也必须尝试一次自己的意志豁免，否则同样会陷入目盲。主要生物手持或穿戴的任何非魔法光源，以及1环或更低环阶的魔法光源，会在该持续时间内停止发光。

重置（Reset） 所有活体生物离开房间1分钟后，此怨灵会停止活动，但之后立即重置。若被解除，怨灵会在1天后重置。摧毁此处的阁楼低语者后，该怨灵将被永久消灭。

阁楼低语者（ATTIC WHISPERER） 生物4
《开拓者怪物核心2》47页
先攻 察觉 +10

这所孤儿院已被净化：击败阁楼低语者后，孤儿院中的所有怨灵都会被永久消灭，通往区域D6的门会“砰”地一声自动敞开。

D6. 修女寝室（Nuns’ Quarters）
在区域D5的阁楼低语者被击败之前，通往孤儿院这一部分的门始终顽固地紧闭。对门造成的任何伤害几乎都会立刻复原，使其无法被强行破坏。试图用火或酸摧毁大门，会使该PC手中的东西被超自然力量弹回，迫使其进行一次DC 18反射豁免；若失败，则受到1d4点相应类型的伤害。此类尝试会激怒区域D5的阁楼低语者，它会开始哀号哭泣，试图把PC们从门边引开。成功通过DC 17神秘学或宗教检定的PC，能感知到有一股超自然力量（阁楼低语者）在使门保持关闭。

当PC们能够进入该区域时，宣读或转述以下内容。

走廊旁排列着几间陈设简陋的房间，每间房里除了简易木床外别无他物；床旁还有一根离地仅几英寸的软垫横梁。每个横梁上方的墙面都画着一个红色五芒星。

这些是经营这所孤儿院的“修女们”的私人房间，但几乎看不出任何居住者的个性。成功通过DC 13宗教检定以回忆知识的PC知晓：红色五芒星是阿斯摩蒂斯的象征，而修女们会跪在那根横梁前，定期向地狱之主祈祷以示恳求。

在这些房间里搜索并成功通过DC 15察觉检定的PC，会在某张床下发现一张揉皱的羊皮纸。它似乎是一封写给某个无名城镇另一位修女的信件草稿，说明这些修女将前往一个名为“流辉传教地（Lucent Mission）”的地方执行一项重要任务，“将为阿斯摩蒂斯带来无上荣光”。最后一行写道，收信人将收到“明烬（Bright Embers）”剩余的孤儿，随后以一大片墨渍收尾。

若PC将此证据交给当局，他们无人知晓“流辉传教地”位于何处，但会感谢PC告知剩余孤儿的真实下场；PC获得1点声望点数。

宝藏（宝藏）：某个房间里留有一本关于崇拜阿斯摩蒂斯的不洁典籍，价值50 gp，以及一套整齐折好的艾琳尼斯长袍（robos of the Erinys，见212页）。

魔法炉灶（魔法 Stove）

乌莫克（Umok）
乌莫克由侏儒在数个世纪前建立，作为一处宁静的避风港，供那些希望与附近的奇特林林地（Chitterwood）和谐共处的人居住。多年间，侏儒居民曾多次与附近地精营地因本地资源——尤其是猎物与木材——发生冲突。这些矛盾在地精血战期间走向丑陋的顶点：大地精试图将乌莫克焚为焦土。

一位来访的凯登·凯连信徒侏儒冠军，名为洛里维斯·大理石杯（Loriwyse Marblemug），动员全镇击退大地精掠袭者，拯救了所有人。自那以后，乌莫克周边500码范围内禁止用火；惩罚通常为放逐，但过去有些地精肇事者曾被处决。

乌莫克的市民使用炼金术与魔法为食物加热、为城镇照明。他们还雇用驯化的林地生物，作为镇内外的卫兵与哨兵。这些动物若看见有人携带明火接近，会受训立刻返回镇内向负责的侏儒示警。部分较大的生物（如狼）则会试图吓退这些闯入者，成效因情况而异。

当PC沿道路接近乌莫克时，会在距镇约500码处看到一块告示牌，上面用通用语与侏儒语写着：“即将进入乌莫克无火区。请熄灭所有火焰。”下方画着一幅夸张卡通的火焰图案，上面用一条巨大的黑色X划掉。乌莫克周边乃至附近林地里也立着许多类似的标牌。若PC尚未尝试进行技能检定以回忆知识了解这座城镇，现在他们也许会想这么做，以得知这条警告背后的些许历史。

Until the attic whisperer in area D5 is defeated, 
the doors to this portion of the orphanage remain 
stubbornly closed. Any damage dealt to them is 
repaired almost instantly, making them impossible to 
break down. Attempts to use fire or acid to destroy 
the door result in the PC having it supernaturally 
bounced back at them, forcing them to attempt a 
DC 18 Reflex save and take 1d4 of the appropriate 
damage on a failure. Such attempts raise the ire of the 
attic whisperer in area D5, who begins to wail and 
cry to draw the PCs away from the doors. A PC who 
succeeds at a DC 17 Occultism or Religion check can

keeping the doors shut.
When the PCs are able to access the area, read or 
paraphrase the following.
Several sparse rooms line the hallway here, each containing 
nothing more than a simple wooden cot and a padded beam 
that is only a few inches off the ground. A red pentagram is 
painted on each wall above the beam.
These are the personal rooms of the sisters who 
ran this orphanage, though they show little of any 
inhabitants’ personality. A PC who succeeds at a DC 
13 Religion check to Recall Knowledge knows the red 
pentagram is the symbol of Asmodeus and that the 
nuns would use the beam to kneel in supplication for 
regular prayers to the Lord of Hell.
A PC who searches these rooms and succeeds at 
a DC 15 Perception check finds a crumpled piece of 
parchment under one of the cots. It appears to be a 
draft of a letter to another sister in an unnamed town, 
explaining how these sisters are going to a place called 
the Lucent Mission for an important task that “will 
bring much glory to Asmodeus.” The final line 
explains that the recipient is being sent 
Bright Embers’ remaining orphans 
before ending in a large ink spill. 
If the PCs show the authorities 
this evidence, none of them know 
where the Lucent Mission is, but 
they thank the PCs for informing 
them of the true fate of the 
remaining orphans; the PCs gain 
1 Reputation Point.
Treasure: Left behind in one 
room is an unholy text about the 
worship of Asmodeus worth 50 gp and 
a neatly folded robes of the Erinys (page 212).
Umok
Umok was founded by gnomes several centuries 
ago as a peaceful haven for those looking to live in 
harmony with the nearby Chitterwood. Several times 
over the years, the gnome residents clashed with 
nearby goblin camps over local resources, namely 
game and wood. These conflicts came to an ugly 
head during the Goblinblood Wars, when hobgoblins 
tried to burn Umok to the ground. A visiting gnome 
champion of Cayden Cailean named Loriwyse 
Marblemug rallied the town to push back against the 
hobgoblin raiders, saving everyone. Since then, fire has 
been outlawed within 500 yards of Umok’s perimeter; 
the punishment is usually banishment, but some past 
goblin perpetrators have been executed.
The citizens of Umok use alchemy and magic to 
heat their food and light their town. They also employ 
domesticated woodland creatures to act as guards and 
lookouts in and around the town. If these animals see 
someone approaching with an open flame, they are 
trained to return to town to warn the gnomes in charge. 
Some of the larger creatures, such as wolves, try to scare 
off any such intruders, to varying degrees of success.
As the PCs approach Umok by road, they spot 
at about 500 yards from town a sign that reads in 
Common and Gnomish, “Now Entering the Umok 
Fire-Free Zone. Please Extinguish All Flames.” A 
cartoonish illustration of a fire with a big, black X 
across it has been painted underneath. Many such 
signs are around Umok, even in the surrounding 
woods. If the PCs haven’t already attempted a skill 
check to Recall Knowledge about the town, they 
might want to do so now to learn a little about the 
history behind this warning.

Umok
Umok was founded by gnomes several centuries
ago as a peaceful haven for those looking to live in
harmony with the nearby Chitterwood. Several times
over the years, the gnome residents clashed with
nearby goblin camps over local resources, namely

heat their food and light their town. They also employ

## Page 38
假定PC们会遵从告示牌的要求；不过，如果他们在白天旅行，就不需要火把来照明。若他们不遵从而携带火焰接近小镇，则一名随机PC会用眼角余光瞥见一对兔子朝乌莫克的方向疾奔而去。由于兔子发出警告，PC们在影响镇民并获得声望点数的技能检定上承受–2环境减值，无论他们当前的声望点数总计是多少。

当PC们进入能看见小镇的范围时，朗读或转述以下内容。

一座由尖顶小屋组成的古雅小镇映入眼帘，屋墙爬满常春藤，坐落在林地与丘陵之间。每个街角上方都悬浮着光球，闪烁着你能想象到的各种颜色。面带笑容的侏儒从门廊与台阶上挥手，他们的衣着与那些灯光一样绚丽。偶尔会有一群鹿或一只看起来脾气很坏的獾踱步经过，但侏儒们对此丝毫不以为意。自豪的伊斯嘉野猪猎犬在看着行人时开心地喘着气，有时还会四脚朝天打滚，希望有人替它挠挠肚皮。

只要外来者不携带明火，这座小镇便欢迎他们。若PC们悄悄打听，他们会得知乌莫克的大多数居民对切利亚斯的态度较为中立。村子远离伊斯嘉的大多数重要地点，因此基本自给自足。若非必要，他们宁愿不要用谈论叛乱来引起切利亚斯的注意。多数镇民更担心的是：过去几周里，小镇西南方的林地频繁出现小型火灾。他们以动物为基础的预警系统帮助他们确保火势没有蔓延，但他们一直没抓到纵火者。镇上普遍认为是地精或熊地精干的。若有PC属于地精或熊地精族裔，乌莫克的侏儒可能会不公正地以怀疑的态度对待他们。

当地侏儒能为PC们指明这些火灾发生的方向，但在他们离开小镇之前，街上忽然一阵骚动：一名严重烧伤的地精踉跄着走下主街，在PC们附近倒地不起。

【偶然的受害者】
这名不幸的地精名叫格里佐（倒霉的女性地精采集者1）。她与并不隶属于任何大型地精聚落的小家庭一起，住在窃语林之中。他们搜寻浆果与蘑菇，偶尔抓鱼，与森林之外的其他人很少往来。格里佐在不知情的情况下，正在先前火灾发生点附近的林地里翻找东西，遭到引发火灾的两只地狱犬袭击（见下文）。她被地狱火吐息灼伤，却勉强逃脱，朝小镇方向逃来。

当格里佐在PC们面前倒下时，她处于昏迷状态，生命值为0。一名PC可以为她治疗伤口，包扎烧伤，或许再涂抹一些外用药膏，以帮助她恢复意识。该PC还可以尝试一次DC 16医疗检定；成功则判定她的烧伤来自持续性的、直接的火焰冲击——也许是某个魔法法术，或某种能吐息火焰的生物——而非例如森林火灾那种“被火焰波及”的灼伤。

与此同时，其他PC会看到侏儒们开始聚拢——在安全距离外——对格里佐的出现感到好奇。有些侏儒开始低声指责她一定要为近期的火灾负责。没过多久，艾欧安·大理石杯（坚定的男性侏儒官员2），镇上的卫队长，也是乌莫克历史冠军的后裔，便上前评估情况。他听见同胞们的议论，但会等到确认格里佐不会死去之后，才对PC们说：“她得走。”显然，艾欧安相信其他侏儒对格里佐的判断。他解释说，违反乌莫克最重要法律的惩罚是放逐。

当格里佐恢复意识时，她会惊恐地啜泣不止。一名成功通过DC 17交涉检定的PC能让她稍微镇定些，使她一遍又一遍地嘟囔“火狗”这个词。可惜，这点信息不足以让PC们进行回忆知识，但PC可以尝试据理力争：格里佐的状况与恐惧表明她很可能不是纵火者。说服艾欧安同意需要DC 18交涉或威吓检定，或DC 16法律学识检定。成功则艾欧安不情不愿地允许格里佐留在镇医那里，PC们则去调查火灾。若PC在该检定中大失败，艾欧安会坚持立刻把格里佐带出乌莫克，并强烈建议由PC们亲自押送。

【获得声望点数】
当PC们在乌莫克时，他们可以尝试获得声望点数，以改善镇民对“破狱者同盟”的看法。通过贬斥切利亚斯政府（以及其地狱骑士走狗）所施加的严苛秩序、指出恶魔与火焰之间名正言顺的关联，或诚恳谈论自由与自然的重要性，一名PC可以尝试一次DC 18交涉、自然、表演或宗教检定。使用与“乡野旅行”（第30页）相同的成功度。

Adventure Toolbox
It is assumed that the PCs comply with the sign, 
though if they are traveling by day, they have no need 
of torches to light their way. If they don’t comply and 
approach the town carrying fire, a random PC spots a 
pair of rabbits bolting in Umok’s direction out of the 
corner of their eye. As a result of the rabbits’ warning, 
the PCs take a –2 circumstance penalty to their 
skill checks to influence the town’s people and gain 
Reputation Points, regardless of their current RP total.
When the PCs get within sight of the town, read or 
paraphrase the following.
A quaint town of cottages with peaked roofs and walls 
covered in ivy becomes visible, nestled between the 
woods and the hills. Orbs of light, twinkling in every 
color imaginable, hang in the air above each street corner. 
Smiling gnomes wave from porches and stoops, their 
clothing as brightly colored as the lights. Occasionally, a 
family of deer or a grumpy-looking badger wanders by, 
though the gnomes don’t find this at all unusual. Proud 
Isgeri boarhounds pant happily as they watch passersby, 
sometimes rolling onto their backs in hopes of a belly rub.
The town is welcome to outsiders, provided they aren’t 
carrying open flames. If the PCs discretely ask around, 
they learn that most Umok residents are neutral about 
Cheliax. The village is far enough away from most of 
Isger’s major sites that they are left to themselves. If they 
can help it, they’d rather not grab Cheliax’s attention 
with talk of rebellion. Most of the townspeople are 
more concerned about the rash of small fires that have 
been breaking out in the woods southwest of town over 
the past few weeks. Their animal-based early warning 
system has helped them ensure the fires haven’t spread, 
but they haven’t caught the perpetrator. The prevailing 
opinion around town is that goblins or hobgoblins are 
to blame. If any PC is of goblin or hobgoblin ancestry, 
the gnomes of Umok might unfairly treat them with 
suspicion.
The resident gnomes can point the PCs in the 
direction of these fires, but before they can leave town, 
there is a commotion: a badly burned goblin stumbles 
down the main street and collapses near the PCs.
A VICTIM OF HAPPENSTANCE
This unfortunate goblin is named Grizzo (hapless 
female goblin forager 1). She lives within the 
Chitterwood with her small family who aren’t a part of 
any major goblin settlement. They scrounge for berries 
and mushrooms and occasionally catch fish. Rarely do 
they interact with others outside of the forest. Grizzo 
was unknowingly rooting around the area of the 
woods near the previous fires and was attacked by the 
two hell hounds who were the fire’s cause (see below). 
She was burned by their hellfire breath but barely 
managed to escape, fleeing in the direction of town.
When Grizzo collapses in front of the PCs, she is 
unconscious with 0 Hit Points. A PC can Treat her 
Wounds, bandaging the burns and perhaps applying a 
topical salve, to help her regain consciousness. That PC 
can also attempt a DC 16 Medicine check, determining 
on a success that her burns were caused by a sustained 
direct blast of fire, perhaps from a magic spell or a 
creature that can breathe flames, rather than exposure 
to the flames of something like a forest fire.
Meanwhile, the other PCs see that gnomes are 
beginning to gather—at a safe distance—curious about 
Grizzo’s presence. Some of the gnomes begin to mutter 
accusations that she must be responsible for the recent 
fires. It isn’t too long before Ioan Marblemug (steadfast 
male gnome official 2), the town’s captain of the 
guard and descendant of Umok’s historical champion, 
approaches to assess the situation. He hears what his 
fellow citizens are saying but waits until it’s clear that 
Grizzo isn’t going to die before telling the PCs that 
“she’s got to go.” It’s clear that Ioan believes what the 
other gnomes believe about Grizzo. He explains that 
the punishment for violating Umok’s most important 
law is banishment.
When Grizzo regains consciousness, she begins 
blubbering in fear. A PC who succeeds at DC 17 
Diplomacy check calms her down enough for her to 
mutter the phrase “fire dog” over and over again. It is 
unfortunately not enough information for the PCs to 
be able to Recall Knowledge, but a PC can try to argue 
that Grizzo’s condition and her fear means that she 
likely didn’t set the fires. Getting Ioan to agree requires 
a DC 18 Diplomacy or Intimidation check or a DC 
16 Legal Lore check. On a success, Ioan begrudgingly 
allows Grizzo to remain with the town doctor while 
the PCs investigate the fires. If a PC critically fails this 
check, Ioan is adamant that Grizzo be taken out of 
Umok immediately and firmly suggests that the PCs be 
the ones to do so.
GAINING REPUTATION POINTS
While the PCs are in Umok, they can attempt to 
gain Reputation Points to bolster the townspeople’s 
opinions about the Hellbreakers League. With 
disparaging remarks about the strict order imposed 
by the Chelaxian government (and its Hellknight 
lackeys), rightful connections between devils and fire, 
or honest talk about the importance of freedom and 
nature, a PC can attempt a DC 18 Diplomacy, Nature, 
Performance, or Religion check. Use the same degrees 
of success for Countryside Travel (page 30).

With disparaging remarks about the strict order imposed by the Chelaxian government (and its Hellknight lackeys), rightful connections between devils and fire, or honest talk about the importance of freedom and nature, a PC can attempt a DC 18 Diplomacy, Nature, Performance, or Religion check. Use the same degrees of success for Countryside Travel (page 30).

【烧起来了！】（低威胁2）
当PC们进入奇特林林地（Chitterwood）的边缘调查火情时，他们看见远处升起一股烟柱。众人急忙朝那边赶去，却发现那里正是地表灌木火灾的初起之势——由地狱猎犬引发，若任其发展，后果可能极其严重。PC们必须在局势失控之前扑灭火焰。

如果格里佐（Grizzo）与PC们同行，她会因火焰而惊恐退缩，并立刻再次昏厥。

本遭遇使用胜利点子系统（GM Core 184）的改动版本：PC们以5点胜利点开始，并必须将累计胜利点提高到10点。每个阶段结束时（即每位PC都行动过之后），他们自动失去1点胜利点，以代表火势蔓延。若PC们的胜利点一度降至0点，则火势无法被控制（见下文“失败”）。

要扑灭一部分火焰，PC可以尝试DC 15的森林学识（Forest Lore）检定，或DC 17的自然（Nature）或生存（Survival）检定；成功则获得1点胜利点（大成功则获得2点；大失败则失去1点胜利点）。

任何能创造至少1加仑水的法术或能力，都会自动给予1点胜利点。由你酌情决定，其他能够控制火焰或让火焰缺氧的能力也可同样给予胜利点。

PC也可以尝试DC 18的运动（Athletics）检定，挖出一段沟渠作为防火隔离带；成功这么做不会获得胜利点，但可能阻止火势扩散。在某个阶段结束时，若有PC成功建立隔离带，则进行一次DC 15的纯骰检定；成功则该阶段PC们不会因为火势而失去那1点胜利点。若同一阶段有两名或更多PC建立隔离带，则将该纯骰检定的DC降为11。

成功：PC们在火势造成太大破坏之前扑灭了大火。侏儒们心怀感激，PC们获得1点声望点（Reputation Point）。

失败：火势失控肆虐。每名PC在逃离现场时受到4d6点火焰伤害（DC 16基础反射豁免）。最终，乌莫克（Umok）的居民与他们的动物朋友们集结起来，在火势蔓延到城镇之前将其扑灭。地狱猎犬被火焰鼓舞，在焦黑林地（Charred Wood，见第39页）中，它们的先攻掷骰获得+2环境加值；并且PC们在乌莫克进行以获取声望点为目的的技能检定时承受–1环境加值。

FIRE!
