【人数较多的队伍】
你可能想为超过四名PC的队伍减少社交轮数，因为他们会更容易达成目标。对于五名PC的队伍，你可能想设为5轮影响力；而六名PC的队伍则只用4轮即可。各类事件可以分散在整晚进行，每轮影响力安排1到2个。

……他们为了生存而不得不犯下的罪行，将招致严苛的后果。当一个饥饿的地精小乞儿试图从PC们身上行窃时，PC们便有机会亲身体验这种现实：一名卫兵发现了她，并扬言要让她在这座城市臭名昭著的监狱里承受严厉惩罚。

奥兹妮·咯咯嘴（走投无路的年轻女性地精小乞儿 –1）试图从随机一名PC那里偷走钱币。她进行一次盗窃检定，调整值+7，对抗所有PC的察觉DC。若她竟然成功，PC们可能会以为卫兵是冲他们来的，但很快就会发现卫兵看见的是奥兹妮，并打算把她拖去“镣狱”（Gyve）。

如果PC们之前没听说过镣狱，他们可以进行DC 17的艾利迪尔学识或DC 19的社会学识检定以回忆知识，从而知道那是城市的主要监狱：嫌犯会在其中遭受酷刑以逼取口供，就连轻罪也可能导致强迫劳动（他们也可以询问卫兵，卫兵会告知那是城市的监狱）。

奥兹妮哀求饶恕，说她只是想要几枚钱币来买吃的，但卫兵无动于衷。PC们可以尝试说服卫兵放走奥兹妮，不过卫兵对“放走一名罪犯”颇为犹豫。要说服他们，必须成功进行DC 17的法律学识或DC 19的交涉检定来【请求】卫兵放人，或进行DC 19的威吓检定来【胁迫】他们照做。

若PC们失败（或不出手干预），卫兵开始拖走啜泣的地精。PC们也可以与卫兵战斗来阻止他们，但要警告玩家：这么做会让他们获得镇压点数。

生物：若PC们主动发起战斗，这三名卫兵会还击。若战斗爆发，奥兹妮会躲在附近；如果你需要她的资料，可以使用小乞儿（NPC Core 40）。

巡逻军官
生物3
《Pathfinder NPC Core》113
先攻 察觉+8

卫兵（2名）
生物1
《Pathfinder NPC Core》110
先攻 察觉+7

奖励：如果PC们说服卫兵释放奥兹妮，给予他们如同在战斗中击败卫兵的XP。

后续：如果PC们与卫兵战斗，他们获得1点镇压点数；若他们杀死任意卫兵，则获得2点镇压点数。若他们阻止奥兹妮被捕，她会一手捂着因饥饿而绞痛的肚子向他们道谢——她确实真心感激获救，但也会借机想从这件事里捞到食物或钱。她还表示若他们需要任何帮助，她愿意帮忙；给予PC们1点起义点数。

【舞会】
舞会预定在PC们抵达城市一周后举行。当他们抵达里夫斯雷斯特时，朗读或转述以下内容。

红与白的浮空光球照亮宅邸的大厅。西翼舞台上一支弦乐四重奏演奏的音乐，盖过了交谈声在空气中流淌。许多到场宾客穿着仿地狱风格的服饰——精致华丽的服装上点缀着角等恶魔般的特征，搭配上等丝绸与天鹅绒的裙装与礼服——或扮作披甲的地狱骑士。一道弧形大楼梯沿着绘饰栏杆通往平台，再由平台延伸出一条横跨大厅的走道。上方有几个人影俯视下方，但楼梯底部有两名武装卫兵把守：他们身着恶魔装束，护甲上还系着一条假尾巴，阻止大多数人上楼。

这场舞会汇集了艾利迪尔的精英，以及为他们服务的卫兵与仆役；它将持续6个社交轮次，每轮约1小时。在此期间，PC们应当使用影响力（子系统）（GM Core 187）与奎斯特·西斯尔韦特达成交易。他们也可以结识其他重要来宾。由于PC们必须维持伪装，他们无法影响NPC去协助“破狱者联盟”，但可以赢得个人好感。

影响力轮次：让PC们知道他们至少有6个社交轮次，因为宴会很可能持续到深夜，直到实际的……

harsh repercussions for crimes they commit to 
survive. When a starving goblin urchin tries to 
steal from the PCs, they get the chance to 
experience this state of matters firsthand 
as a guard spots her and promises harsh 
consequences in the city’s notorious 
prison.
Ozney Cacklemouth (desperate young 
female goblin urchin –1) attempts to steal 
coins from a random PC. She attempts a 
single Thievery check with a +7 modifier 
against all the PCs’ Perception DCs. In the 
unlikely event she succeeds, the PCs 
might think the guards are coming 
for them, but it’s quickly clear that 
the guards have spotted Ozney and 
plan to drag her away to the Gyve. If the PCs 
didn’t learn about the Gyve earlier, they can attempt 
a DC 17 Elidir Lore or DC 19 Society Lore check to 
Recall Knowledge to know it’s the city’s main prison, 
where suspects are tortured to get confessions and 
even minor crimes can result in forced labor (they 
can also ask the guards, who inform them it’s the 
city’s prison).
Ozney begs for forgiveness, saying she simply 
wanted a few coins to buy food, but the guards are 
unmoved. The PCs can attempt to talk the guards 
into releasing Ozney, though they’re hesitant about 
“letting a criminal go free.” Convincing them 
requires succeeding at a DC 17 Legal Lore or DC 
19 Diplomacy check to Request that the guards let 
her go, or DC 19 Intimidation check to Coerce them 
into doing so. If the PCs fail (or don’t intervene), 
the guards begin dragging the sobbing goblin away. 
The PCs can fight the guards to stop them, but 
warn them that doing so will gain them Suppression 
Points.
Creatures: The three guards fight back if the PCs 
initiate combat. Ozney hides nearby if combat breaks 
out, but if you need statistics for her, you can use the 
urchin (NPC Core 40).

The Gala
The gala is scheduled to take place one week 
after the PCs arrive in the city. Once they 
arrive at Reevesrest, read or paraphrase 
the following.
Floating balls of red and white light 
illuminate the great room of the mansion. 
Music performed by a string quartet on a 
stage in the western wing of the room fills the air over 
the sound of conversation. Many of the assembled guests 
wear costumes to evoke Hell—elaborate pieces with horns 
and other devilish features embellish fine silk and velvet 
dresses and suits—or armored Hellknights.
A curved grand staircase with painted balusters leads 
up to a landing and a walkway that stretches across the 
room. A few figures look down from above, but a pair of 
armed guards, dressed as devils complete with a false tail 
attached to their armor, stand guard at the foot of the 
stairs, preventing most people from ascending.
The gala, filled with the elite of Elidir as well as the 
guards and servants who care for them, takes place 
over six social rounds, each taking about an hour. 
During this time, the PCs should reach a deal with 
Quoster Thistlewait using the influence subsystem 
(GM Core 187). They can also meet other important 
people in attendance. Because the PCs must maintain 
their disguises, they can’t influence the NPCs to help 
the Hellbreakers League, but can win personal favor.
Influence Rounds: Let the PCs know they have at 
least six social rounds, as the party will likely last into 
the small hours of the night, leading up to the actual

You might want to reduce the number of social 
rounds for groups with more than four PCs, who 
will find it much easier to accomplish their goals. 
For groups of five PCs, you may want to have five 
influence rounds, or just four for groups of six PCs. 
Events can be spread out over the evening, with 
one or two per influence round.

## Page 78
地狱骑士进军的纪念日。此外，若干事件（从第80页开始）会在晚会期间发生，其中一些会为PC提供额外的社交轮。

I. 里弗斯雷斯特庄园（REEVESREST MANOR）
里弗斯雷斯特庄园会在第5章（第85页）中得到完整描述，届时PC可以自由探索。眼下，队伍基本被限制在大会客厅（区域I2）以及外面的庭院与场地。想要探索的PC可以进入图书室、餐厅、画廊和花园等区域，但其他区域会被守卫与仆役限制；他们会将PC引导回对外开放的房间。楼上完全禁止进入；大会客厅楼梯底部有两名守卫把守，阻止任何人上楼。

登场人物（DRAMATIS PERSONAE）
舞会的一些宾客会在第5章与第6章中扮演更重要的角色。以下列出最显眼的几位，其中奎斯特、凯托与埃齐奥对本次冒险最为关键；你也可以按需加入其他宾客。

奎斯特·西斯尔韦特（QUOSTER THISTLEWAIT） 生物4
独特 小型 半身人 类人生物
男性半身人、杜鲁玛商人
察觉 +8
意志 +10
发现DC 17 商业学识，DC 21 察觉或表演，DC 19 社会
影响技能 DC 19 商业学识，DC 21 交涉与社会，DC 24 制作

影响0 奎斯特对自己提出的丰厚贸易协定要求毫不动摇。他同意帮助“破狱者同盟”，但这些让步会被证明极其苛刻，而且——如果PC为伊斯嘉赢得自由——也会不受欢迎。破狱者同盟的名望点数减少2点。
影响2 PC说服奎斯特接受对双方都有利的合理条款。破狱者同盟获得1点名望点数。
影响4 奎斯特同意一项交易：他可以从中获利，作为交换则提供与之相称的援助给叛军。破狱者同盟获得2点名望点数，且奎斯特承诺在舞会结束后给予PC一枚“魔翼徽章”（第211页）。
影响6 奎斯特的交易让他与伊斯嘉一同受益——国家越兴盛，奎斯特获利越多。破狱者同盟获得3点名望点数，且奎斯特立刻把“魔翼徽章”交给PC。

抗性（Resistances） 奎斯特会装傻以便占得先机，但他鄙视那些看不清真相的人。将他当傻子对待，或自己行事愚蠢的PC，在影响他的检定上承受–2环境减值。

弱点（Weaknesses） 由于切利亚斯的奴隶制历史以及其对科内里卡河贸易路线的铁腕掌控，奎斯特对切利亚斯深恶痛绝。若PC在谈判时强调这将如何伤害切利亚斯，则在影响检定上获得+2环境加值。

背景（背景） 奎斯特在杜鲁玛长大，意识到自己的生活比大多数半身人要好得多。尽管他把财富视作与生俱来的权利，但也明白财富能保护自己。他投入资源去支持他认为值得的事业，例如风铃花网络，但更优先考虑那些能让他个人获益的项目。

外表（Appearance） 奎斯特穿着浮夸的华服：红色天鹅绒长尾外套内搭带褶黑衬衫，并以金色扣饰固定。他的精致皮靴鞋尖上翘。他还拄着一根镶有硕大红宝石的银手杖。

性格（Personality） 奎斯特是个精明的商人，却用精心经营的花花公子形象来掩饰。他在生意上冷酷无情，力求获得每一分优势，并以“用资源帮助更不幸的人”为理由来为自己残忍的做派辩护。

凯托·武劳内克斯（CAETO VULAUNEX） 生物11
独特 中型 人类 类人生物
自以为是的男性人类地狱骑士
察觉 +18
意志 +20（对抗精神+22）
发现DC 24 威吓，DC 19 察觉，DC 17 宗教，DC 21 社会
影响技能 DC 19 威吓（展现钢铁般的意志），DC 21 宗教（讨论阿巴达与阿斯摩蒂斯都教导“法律与秩序”的重要性），或DC 24 欺瞒或交涉（谈论伊斯嘉）

影响2 凯托察觉到PC对伊斯嘉福祉的共同关切，以及对赫德文六世治理的不屑。他会给PC一枚“外交官徽章”，并敦促他们运用自己的声音来改善国家的处境。

抗性（Resistances） 凯托无法忍受谎言。任何在影响他时欺瞒检定失败的PC，都不能再尝试影响他（不过该PC仍可尝试发现关于他的信息）。

Weaknesses Quoster has a strong distaste for Cheliax due 
to its history of slavery and iron grip on the Conerica

of how it would hurt Cheliax gain a +2 circumstance 
bonus on Influence checks.
Background Growing up in Druma, Quoster realized how 
much better his life was than most halflings. While 
he sees his wealth as his birthright, he also knows it 
protects him. He’s devoted resources to helping causes 
he deems worthy, such as the Bellflower Network, but 
prioritizes those that benefit him personally.
Appearance Quoster is dressed in over-the-top finery, 
wearing a ruffled black blouse under a red velvet coat 
with long tails and golden fastenings. His fine leather 
boots curl up at the toes. He carries a silver cane with 
a large ruby. 
Personality Quoster is a shrewd merchant, which he hides 
behind a carefully cultivated image as a fop. He 
is remorseless in business, seeking to gain every 
advantage, and justifies his cutthroat attitude by 
using his resources to help those less fortunate.

Influence 6 Quoster’s bargain benefits him alongside Isger—the better the country does, the more Quoster profits. The Hellbreakers League gains 3 Reputation Points and Quoster immediately gives the PCs the devilwing badge.
Resistances Quoster plays the fool to get ahead, but disdains those who don’t see the truth. PCs who treat him as a fool or act foolish themselves take a –2 circumstance penalty on checks to Influence him.
Weaknesses Quoster has a strong distaste for Cheliax due to its history of slavery and iron grip on the Conerica River trade routes. PCs who frame negotiations in terms of how it would hurt Cheliax gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Influence checks.
Background Growing up in Druma, Quoster realized how much better his life was than most halflings. While he sees his wealth as his birthright, he also knows it protects him. He’s devoted resources to helping causes he deems worthy, such as the Bellflower Network, but prioritizes those that benefit him personally.
Appearance Quoster is dressed in over-the-top finery, wearing a ruffled black blouse under a red velvet coat with long tails and golden fastenings. His fine leather boots curl up at the toes. He carries a silver cane with a large ruby.
Personality Quoster is a shrewd merchant, which he hides behind a carefully cultivated image as a fop. He is remorseless in business, seeking to gain every advantage, and justifies his cutthroat attitude by using his resources to help those less fortunate.

再次影响他（不过PC仍可以尝试发掘关于他的信息）。

弱点 凯托在萨林加洛附近长大，那段童年令他怀念。只要PC提到该村庄，且不提及该地区的“破狱者”行动，他们对其进行影响的检定获得+2环境加值。

背景 凯托在地精血战中作战时一路晋升，之后与地狱骑士团一同离开伊斯嘉。他最近才返回，而赫德文德邀请他前往埃利迪尔，领导一支专门的特遣队追捕“破狱者”。关于凯托的更多信息见第238页。

外表 凯托身着完整的地狱骑士身份象征，包括护甲与武器。

性格 凯托可以很迷人、和气，但略带居高临下。由于长期不在伊斯嘉，他对时事缺乏深入了解，因此显得有些笨拙。

特别 凯托将在后续章节中扮演更重要的角色。他应表现得友好，甚至思想开放，以铺垫他在第5章与PC结盟并最终背叛PC。


埃齐奥·盖塔 生物7

意志 +18

影响2 埃齐奥乐于分享关于其他宾客的八卦。所有PC在余下的晚宴期间进行的发掘检定获得+1环境加值。

影响4 埃齐奥巧妙地替PC缓和误会，以展示与他交好的价值。晚宴期间有一次，若某名PC在一次影响检定中大失败，则改为失败。

影响6 埃齐奥提出帮忙牵线搭桥。晚宴期间有一次，某名PC可以在一次影响检定上掷骰两次并取较好结果。

抗力 埃齐奥讨厌无聊的人；若某名PC在影响他的一次检定中大失败，则该PC在此后所有为影响他而进行的检定都承受–2减值。

弱点 埃齐奥喜爱八卦。若PC谈论晚宴上其他人，则其为影响埃齐奥而进行的检定获得+2环境加值。

背景 埃齐奥是伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺的代理人，公开身份则是城中权贵（包括赫德文德六世）忠诚而可靠的顾问与“摆平者”，能替朋友把事情办成。关于埃齐奥的更多信息见第240页。

外表 埃齐奥身材高大、皮肤红润。他装扮成“ayngavhaul”（异端魔），披风会在他坐下时制造出一张铁王座的幻象。（若PC认出并询问这古怪的选择，他会开玩笑说这是在引用那些批评他建议的人。）

性格 埃齐奥性情古怪，有点过分令人反感、又过分谄媚，使人难以真正喜欢他；但他足够有用，因此众人会忽略这些特质。他总是对新机会敞开大门；若PC接近他，他也能看出PC的潜力。

特别 埃齐奥将在第5章扮演更重要的角色。他在此处应表现为PC能加以利用的人物，直到他真正的立场与行动被揭露。

someone else at the gala gains a +2 circumstance bonus 
on checks made to Influence him.
Background Ezio is an agent of Illcayna Alonnor playing 
a public role as a loyal, trusted advisor and fixer for the 
city’s elite, including Hedvend VI, who gets things done 
for his friends. See page 240 for more on Ezio.
Appearance Ezio is a large man with ruddy skin. He’s 
dressed as an ayngavhaul, a heresy devil, with a cape 
that forms the illusion of an iron throne whenever 
he sits. (If a PC recognizes it and asks about the odd 
choice, he jokes that it’s a reference to critics of his 
advice.)
Personality Ezio is eccentric, just a little too off-putting and 
ingratiating for people to really like him, but he’s useful 
enough that they overlook those traits. He’s always open 
for new opportunities and sees potential in the PCs if 
they approach him.
Special Ezio plays a much larger role in Chapter 5. He 
should appear as someone the PCs can make use of here, 
before his true allegiances and actions are revealed.

## Page 80
DC 24 制作或医疗（展示对萨斯托莉认为真正有用的技能的了解）

影响 2 萨斯托莉会对PCs变得友好（这会在第6章中使他们受益）。

抗性 萨斯托莉鄙视空谈。PC若在影响对方的检定中失败，则在宴会剩余时间里对影响对方的检定承受–2减值。

弱点 萨斯托莉欣赏从事体力劳动的人。最高属性为力量的PC在进行任何影响萨斯托莉的检定时获得+1。

背景 萨斯托莉从码头底层一路升上来，成为负责监管工人的码头主管之一；这些工人让城市的贸易经济得以运转。他们的称职巩固了自身地位，也为他们赢得了诸如此次宴会的邀请。

外貌 在衣着考究的精英人群里，萨斯托莉以最糟糕的方式显得格格不入——他们穿着朴素的码头工人衣服，只是在肩上披了一条毛绒绒的萨格拉贡，以此牵强呼应主题。

个性 萨斯托莉直言不讳且格格不入，屡屡破坏各种礼仪，例如从侍者手中抓起一把把开胃小点。他们也乐于欣赏那些精英想赶走他们却又做不到时的无声愤怒。

奖励：PCs每达成一个影响阈值，给予他们40 XP。

【次要来宾】
除了PCs能够通过“影响”结交的NPC之外，还有数名其他NPC可供互动；他们会在宴会后续事件中，或在事后余波里发挥作用。

弗里格大使（谨慎的男性熊地精外交官4级），曾是铁牙军团的军官，被派往伊斯嘉为奥普拉克寻找盟友。他基本已放弃这份希望，意识到未经切利亚斯许可，赫德文几乎没有缔结任何同盟的能力。他身穿铁牙军团制服，气质阴郁，把这场派对视作工作中必要的一环，而非乐事。

费西姆维斯“费西”·芬温克尔（焦虑的女性侏儒阿巴达牧师3级）在地精血战之后坚定了信仰——当时她试图帮助重建自己的故乡乌莫克。她来到艾利迪尔寻求援助，却对精英们对科涅里卡海峡以外地区的漠不关心感到沮丧。即便如此，她仍担忧地狱破坏者同盟的扰乱只会让情况更糟。由于当地大银行家对出席毫无兴趣，费西被派来作为她神殿的代表参加宴会。她没有穿戏服，而是照常穿着白金相间的宗教礼服。她在派对上很不自在，独自站在一旁，但很乐意任何人前来搭话。她渴望交谈，并会黏上对她友善的人。

莱齐妮娅（追逐地位的女性人类准歌姬1级）——只用一个名字，而且常常说得像后面跟着感叹号——穿得不比宴会上任何人逊色；那身行头的价钱大概足够支付一个小家庭一个月的食宿。她的裙装显然在致意“吉洛”（《怪物核心》91），组成裙摆的缎带触手恰到好处地衬出她的腿部线条。莱齐妮娅因赫德文的邀请来到伊斯嘉——赫德文在一次前往切利亚斯的旅途中看中了她。她无法拒绝这个机会：在切利亚斯，她的才华不足以获得同等机遇；但在伊斯嘉这样的边陲？她就是小池塘里的大鱼。交谈时，莱齐妮娅通常会把话题引向自己、自己的才艺与自己的名气。尽管她的自利意图非常明显，但她并不像许多伊斯嘉精英那样天生残酷或冷漠。

梅尔佩莉娅·卡拉福（不体谅人的女性人类贵族1级）是典型的艾利迪尔精英，对伊斯嘉的现状心满意足，也无法理解为什么会有人造反。她喋喋不休地谈着任何吸引她注意的事，就是想不通为何这么多伊斯嘉人会对自身处境感到不满。要是真像他们宣称的那样糟，他们肯定早就搬去艾利迪尔或别处了。既然他们懒得动，那要么是太懒，要么只是夸大其词来博取关注。梅尔佩莉娅在从梅纳多山脉一种稀有猫科动物制成的金色毛皮外套下，穿着一袭从伏陀罗进口的蓝色丝绸纱丽，配戴由黄金、暮木与稀有宝石制成的珠宝。她的穿着与主题不符。

伦塞洛斯·阿兹里（贪婪的男性人类战争投机商6级）是艾利迪尔最富有的人之一——他在地精血战服役后，成为伊斯嘉军队的主要武器供应商之一，从而发家。他对当前的动荡兴奋不已，因为这意味着对他服务的需求会更高。伦塞洛斯装扮成“内萨里”（《怪物核心》89）：身着带尖刺的护甲，配上从一只……身上取下的翅膀。

Background Sastoli came up through the ranks on the 
docks, becoming one of the dockmasters who oversees 
the workers that make the city’s trade economy function. 
Their competence secures their position, and earns them 
invitations to galas like this one.
Appearance Sastoli stands out among the finely dressed

dockworker’s clothes, except for a plush sarglagon 
draped around their shoulders as a conceit to the theme.

element, breaking all manner of etiquette such 
as grabbing fistfuls of appetizers from servants, 
and delights in the quiet outrage of the elites 
who can’t kick them out.

PCs meet, award them 40 XP.
MINOR ATTENDEES
In addition to the NPCs who the PCs can 
Influence to befriend, there are several 
other NPCs they can interact with who 
play some role in later events at the 
gala or in its aftermath.
Ambassador Vrig (cautious male 
hobgoblin diplomat 4), a former 
officer in the Ironfang Legion, was 
sent to Isger to find allies for Oprak. 
He has largely given up that hope for lost, 
realizing that Hedvend has little ability to 
make any alliances without permission from 
Cheliax. He wears an Ironfang Legion uniform 
and is a dour presence that sees the party as a 
necessary part of his job, not an enjoyable one.
Fesimwyth “Fessy” Finwinkle (anxious female 
gnome cleric of Abadar 3) found her faith following 
the Goblinblood Wars as she tried to help rebuild 
her native town of Umok. She came to Elidir 
seeking help, only to become frustrated by the 
elite’s lack of concern about the areas outside the 
Conerica Straits. Despite this, she fears the 
Hellbreakers League’s disruptions will only 
make matters worse. Fessy was sent to the 
gala as a representative of her temple, since the local 
archbanker had no interest in attending. She’s wearing 
her usual religious garb of white and gold rather than a 
costume. She isn’t comfortable at the party and stands 
off by herself, but is happy for anyone to approach her. 
She’s eager to talk, and latches on to anyone who is 
kind to her.
Lezinia (status-seeking female human wannabe diva 
1)—one name only, and often said as though followed 
by an exclamation point—is dressed as finely as anyone 
at the party, in an outfit that likely cost enough to pay 
for a small family’s food and housing for a month. Her 
dress clearly evokes a gylou (Monster Core 91), with 
the ribbon tentacles that make up her skirt showing 
off her legs to good effect. Lezinia came to Isger at 
Hedvend’s invitation after catching his eye on one of 
his trips to Cheliax. It was an opportunity she couldn’t 
turn down—she’s not talented enough to gain the same 
level of opportunity in Cheliax, but in a backwater like 
Isger? She’s a big fish in a little pond. In conversation, 
Lezinia typically steers discussion to herself, her 
talents, and her stardom. Despite her very clear self-
interest, she’s not inherently cruel or callous like 
many of the Isgeri elite.
Merpelia Carafo (inconsiderate female human 
noble 1) is a typical Elidiran elite, content 
with the way life is in Isger, and incapable of 
understanding why anyone would rebel. 
Prattling on about whatever catches 
her attention, she just can’t understand 
why so many Isgeri are upset about 
their conditions. Surely if it were 
as bad as they claim, they would 
move to Elidir or somewhere else. If 
they can’t be bothered, then they’re 
either too lazy, or just exaggerating 
for attention. Merpelia wears a fine 
golden fur made from a rare cat 
found in the Menador Mountains 
over her blue silk sari imported 
from Vudra, and jewelry made 
of gold, duskwood, and rare 
gemstones. Her outfit is not 
on theme.
Rencelos Azri (greedy male human 
war profiteer 6) is one of the richest men 
in Elidir, thanks to being one of the Isgeri 
army’s primary suppliers of arms following his 
service in the Goblinblood Wars. He’s thrilled 
by the unrest since it means more demand 
for his services. Rencelos is dressed like 
a nessari (Monster Core 89), complete 
with spiked armor, wings taken from a

……他为这场场合猎来的龙革，以及袒露的胸膛，展示出他虽已上年纪却依旧结实的体格。他的谈话内容多半是嘲笑比他更穷的人，并哀叹他儿子几天前差点被某个放出巨型野猪的蠢货害死。

【晚宴事件】
在晚宴的社交轮之间，会发生若干事件。它们按以下顺序出现，并以“假旗”事件作为高潮；该事件发生在最后一轮社交轮之后。

【事件：蝎狮游戏】
一小群宾客在庄园庭院里享受一场蝎狮游戏：在布置好的场地上向靶子投掷飞镖，并伴随相应的赌博。

庄园庭院草坪上已清出一条无雪地带。场地上摆着三个上了漆的稻草靶：20尺外的半身人、40尺外的地精、以及60尺外的人类农民。

任意玩家皆可加入游戏或下注。每位玩家最多可对某人下注20 gp，押其赢得比赛；也可在单次投掷前下注——最多下注1 gp押其命中半身人靶、3 gp押其命中地精靶、5 gp押其命中人类靶。

【运行蝎狮游戏】每名参与者获得6支飞镖，并将它们投向靶子，直到所有飞镖都用完。每个靶子的AC为18，但投掷者会因较远的射程而受到减值（分别为–2与–4）。命中最近的靶得1分，命中中间靶得2分，命中最远靶得3分；若为大成功，则命中靶子的头部，得分翻倍。玩家也可以同时向同一目标投掷两支飞镖；在此情况下，两次打击均承受多重攻击减值。双投掷中的每次命中都能获得双倍得分：命中分别得2、4或6分；若为大成功，则分别得4、8或12分。使用魔法在技术上是不被允许的，但大多数观众会觉得有人为了游戏而使出这种手段很有趣，因此会对隐蔽的小动作睁一只眼闭一只眼。

【参赛者】另外三名宾客也参加了游戏。你可以按其列出的攻击调整值为他们每一轮掷骰，或若想加快进程，也可以直接使用其“通常得分”。
• 维里格大使（攻击调整值+8；通常得分8）是一名有天赋的战士，但行事谨慎。他使用自己的飞镖，每次只投一支，并瞄准最近的靶。
• 里瑟特上校（攻击调整值+6；通常得分6）因缺少战斗机会而心痒难耐，便借此展示自己的本事。他先向地精靶投掷两次，随后再对同一靶进行两次双投掷。
• 伦塞洛斯·阿兹里（攻击调整值+15；通常得分12）是熟练的战斗者，但对取胜并不在意。他把所有飞镖都以两支一组投向最远的靶。每次命中（无论是他自己的还是其他玩家的）他都会放声大笑，并编造故事说靶子罪有应得。

【社交轮】参加该游戏的玩家获得1个额外社交轮，可用于影响里瑟特上校。

【宝藏】若某位玩家的得分超过维里格大使，他会向其道贺，并赠予一枚他个人的低阶银飞镖作为奖品。若有多位玩家得分超过他，他会将其赠予得分最高者。

【事件：社交“敌”通行证】低级 4
一声惊叫在咯咯声中戛然而止：一名缚影魔（velstrac）掐着一位身穿兽人戏服的人类仆从的喉咙，将其举到空中。洒出的酒液……

drake he hunted for the occasion, and a bare chest 
that shows off his aging, but still firm, physique. His

Gala Events
A number of events take place during the gala between 
social rounds. They occur in the following order, 
culminating in the False Flag event, which follows the 
final social round.
EVENT: A GAME OF MANTICORE
A small group of partygoers enjoys a game of 
manticore, which involves throwing darts at targets 
set up in a playing field, and the associated gambling 
on the manor grounds.
Snow has been cleared from a strip of the lawn on the 
manor grounds. Three painted straw targets are arranged 
on the field: a halfling twenty feet away, a goblin 
forty feet away, and a human peasant sixty 
feet away.
Any PCs are welcome to join in the game or place 
wagers. Each PC can wager up to 20 gp on someone 
to win the match or before an individual throw—up 
to 1 gp that someone will hit the halfling, 3 gp that 
someone will hit the goblin, and 5 gp that someone 
will hit the human target.
Running Manticore: Each participant gets six darts, 
which they throw at targets until each has used all their 
darts. Each target is AC 18, though throwers take penalties 
due to range for farther targets (–2 and –4, respectively). 
They get 1 point for hitting the closest target, 2 for the 
next target, or 3 for the farthest; on a critical hit, they 
hit the target’s head, and get double points. A player can 
also throw two darts at the same target at the same time. 
In this case, both Strikes take the multiple attack penalty. 
Each hit from a double-throw earns double points: 2, 4, 
or 6 for a hit, or 4, 8, or 12 for a critical hit. Using magic 
is technically not allowed, but most spectators find it 
amusing that someone would resort to such tactics for a 
game and will let subtle uses slide.
The contestants: Three other partygoers participate 
in the game. You can roll for each of their 
turns with the listed attack modifier, or 
simply use their usual score if you wish to 
speed the event along.
• Ambassador Vrig (attack modifier +8; usual 
score 8) is a talented warrior, but cautious. 
He uses his own darts, which he throws one 
at a time at the nearest target.
• Colonel Rithert (attack modifier +6; usual score 
6) chafes at xir lack of combat opportunities, and 
takes the opportunity to show xir skill. Xe throws 
twice at the goblin target before double-
throwing twice at the same target.
• Rencelos Azri (attack modifier +15, 
usual score 12) is a skilled combatant, but cares 
little about winning. He throws all his darts 
two at a time at the farthest target. He laughs 
uproariously at every hit (his or other players’) 
and makes up stories about the target deserving 
it.
Social Round: A PC who participates in the game 
gains an additional social round they can use to 
Influence Colonel Rithert.
Treasure: If a PC outscores Ambassador Vrig, he 
congratulates them and offers one of his personal low-
grade silver darts as a prize. If multiple PCs outscore 
him, he offers it to the highest scorer.

## Page 82
酒液从一名看上去颇具帝国气派、神情暴怒的女子身上滴落。“我穿这条裙子参加奥罗登的守灵！”她咆哮道，“它比你的命还值钱，你这可悲的小虫子！”

那个倒霉的仆人不幸把酒洒在了卡尔泰莎·伊伊斯夫人（神秘的人类女性玛门女祭司20）身上；她正前往切利亚斯，途中顺道来参加这场宴会。PC可以尝试DC 19的社交检定来回忆知识，认出她是一名看似不朽的贵族女子，也被称为“寡妇女王”，居住在米纳多山脉间的铁蔷薇庄园。一次成功的DC 21宗教检定来回忆知识能揭示她是大魔鬼玛门的高阶女祭司；若为大成功，他们还听过传闻，说她因与地狱签订契约而已年逾数百岁。

PC可以尝试通过向卡尔泰莎求情来救下仆人的性命：进行DC 21的交涉或宗教检定，或DC 23的威吓检定；成功则卡尔泰莎认定这仆人不值得她费事。若没有任何PC成功，她会因这番插手而被冒犯，命令三名小魔鬼侍从给这些多管闲事的PC一个教训。

生物：卡尔泰莎·伊伊斯夫人此刻对PC而言强大得超出应付范围，不过好在她并不想让自己的双手沾上他们的血。她会让三名邪魔侍从发起攻击，而她与缚魂者（velstrac）则在一旁旁观。

铁蔷薇小魔鬼（3） 生物2
精英小魔鬼（《Pathfinder 怪物 Core 6》281）
先攻 察觉+9

进展：若PC说服卡尔泰莎放过仆人、击败小魔鬼，或有PC被降至0生命值，伊伊斯夫人便认定自己已经看够了，一言不发地拂袖离去。这场冲突会在一段时间内成为宴会上的谈资，打断正常的交谈节奏；在PC需要花时间进行伤口处理的期间，不会经过任何社交轮。

奖励：若PC说服伊伊斯夫人允许仆人活命，给予他们等同于在战斗中击败这些小魔鬼的XP。

事件：不了，谢谢
一名或多名PC注意到一名面露嫌恶的仆人——奥顿·荨枝刷（心怀不满的半身人男性仆人0）——他穿着小魔鬼戏服，正气呼呼地用力刷洗一面墙；墙上沾着某种食物飞溅后的残渣，而那份食物的剩余部分则堆在地上。若PC询问，仆人会试图转移他们的注意力。若有PC成功通过DC 17的交涉或威吓检定从奥顿口中问出更多信息，便会得知那是一块焦糖蒜香挞——埃齐奥只咬了一口就嫌恶地把它砸在墙上。若PC去问埃齐奥，他会不好意思地承认此事并为自己的失礼道歉。他说是因为奶酪显然已经酸败，但真相是他对菜肴中的大蒜产生了反应——这是他真实本性的线索。随后埃齐奥会抓住机会去交际一番，让他交谈过的PC额外获得1次社交轮，可用于影响他们选择的任意一名NPC。

事件：假旗帜 中等4
宴会本该以赫德文六世的公告作为收尾，但埃齐奥安排了一个惊喜——让卫兵假扮“破狱者联盟”的革命者发动袭击！这场袭击不仅意在通过杀死重要的艾利迪尔人来制造混乱、煽动对破狱者的愤怒，也是为了掩护埃齐奥同时对赫德文本人下手。

在袭击发生前不久，埃齐奥的同伙莱弗拉内克·梅亚尔（狂热的人类女性乌加索娅特工4）把三名卫兵引到他身边，使其遭到支配，并取回她为这场闹剧准备好的假破狱者联盟旗帜。为每名PC进行一次暗骰DC 21的察觉检定——成功则该PC注意到卫兵离开了岗位，推测是终于要去护送赫德文来参加宴会；当战斗开始时，该PC的先攻掷骰获得+1环境加值。若为大成功，该PC还注意到卫兵返回时并未带回管家；由于这可疑举动，该PC在战斗第1轮获得加速，并且可以用额外动作进行互动以抽出武器或其他物品。

宣读或意译下文。

音乐戛然而止，一名女子尖刻的喊声令派对瞬间沉寂。“够了！长久以来，你和赫德文一直做切利亚斯的走狗，忽视我们美丽的伊斯嘉！我们要把你们身上的恶魔污秽从我们的国家清除！以破狱者联盟之名——这里的所有人都该死！”她挥舞着一面陌生的旗帜，其上绘着一把燃烧的长剑刺穿阿斯莫德斯的红色五芒星；与此同时，她那些戴着面具的同伙发动了攻击。

这番令人震惊的宣告终结了宴会的庆典，也为本章画下句点；故事将在第5章继续。

## Page 83
第5章：死人之宴

第5章紧接第4章结束之后立刻开始，一开场便与冒充的“狱破者”交战。你可以提醒PC们：他们知道在晚会上真正的狱破者只有他们自己。本次遭遇中，出席晚会的地狱骑士们并未现身，因为被支配的守卫将他们引走，并在庄园的另一区域与他们交战。

战斗结束后，地狱骑士们发现赫德文已经遭到谋杀。晚会上的每个人都是嫌疑人，不过卡埃托最终会征召PC们协助侦破此案。PC们还要面对另一桩只有他们才意识到的谜团——那些冒充的狱破者究竟是谁？他们为何偏偏在此时发动攻击？很快，新的难题又接踵而至：死亡持续累积，受害者既包括艾利迪尔的上流人物，也包括里夫斯雷斯特的仆役与守卫。

本章是一则“密室式”的谋杀悬案，推进方式很大程度上将是自由流动的：PC们可追查各种线索，破解他们所面对的谜团。在此过程中，若干事件会穿插其中、推动剧情前进，但这些事件并没有被严格设定发生时间。本次调查很可能在一夜之间完成——尸体不断出现，实在没有时间进行一段休息——但实际上并没有明确的时限。卡埃托会将庄园持续封锁，直到赫德文的谋杀案水落石出。

冲入战场！

冒充的狱破者　中等5级

……楼下大厅西侧部分的天花板与楼上的走廊下方为15尺高；而大厅东侧延伸至宅邸顶部的部分为25尺高。楼上的走廊边缘有小型栏杆，能提供一定的安全保障，但除此之外下方完全敞空，使其成为弓手的绝佳制高点。墙上的旗帜能帮助任何试图【攀爬】的人；进行一次运动检定的DC为20。

生物：莱芙拉涅克下楼梯，阻止任何人上楼。她每轮至少会使用一次【谴责】，试图进一步煽动对“破狱者联盟”的愤怒。她安排卫兵分别守在走廊两端。他们会先以宴会人群（见下方“危害”）为目标，直到PC们采取行动为止；随后通常用前2个动作以PC为目标，第3个动作继续以人群为目标——直到箭矢耗尽，或有PC靠近为止。届时他们会改用三叉戟与长鞭。第三名假破狱者则留在楼梯底部，试图阻止任何人接近弓手。

危害：大厅地面挤满了宾客（不包括埃齐奥——他正在游戏室里杀害赫德温德）。与大多数危害不同，这个危害并不会主动采取动作伤害PC，但确实会碍事。人群过于拥挤，宾客无法轻易逃离，且地面视为困难地形——但同时也为PC提供次等掩蔽。若PC解除该危害，他们会清空大厅地面。然而，假破狱者对该危害造成的伤害代表他们杀死的人数；每造成10点伤害，“破狱者联盟”就失去1点声望点（最多失去6点声望点），代表这场被归咎于叛乱的惨剧所引发的反应。

However, damage done by the false Hellbreakers on the hazard represents people they’ve killed, and for every 10 damage, the Hellbreakers League loses 1 Reputation Point (up to 6 Reputation Points), representing the reaction to the carnage that’s blamed on the rebellion.

## Page 85
【章节结构】
本章跟随PC调查赫德文之死，包含两种不同类型的遭遇：盘查（自第88页《游戏正酣》开始）与剧情事件（自第92页《剧情加深》开始）。盘查是PC进行调查并获取关于谋杀案信息的遭遇；剧情事件则展示调查期间，庄园中还发生了什么。

……管家的护卫触及范围内的方格视为困难地形，直到该冒牌破狱者的下一回合开始。

【宴会人群】危害4
独特 复杂 环境
隐匿 –10（+12先攻）
【描述】
陷入恐慌的宴会来宾人群对这次意外袭击做出反应。
【解除】DC 19 威吓、DC 21 交涉，或 DC 24 运动，以让宾客移出危险区域；需要跨所有技能累计获得4次成功才能解除该危害。
AC 18；强韧 +11，反射 +11
HP 60；弱点：区域 5

【宴会惊慌】[反应动作]
【触发】一名生物掷骰先攻；
【效果】人群发生踩踏，对所有在大宴会厅地面上的生物造成4d6钝击伤害（DC 20 基础反射豁免），然后该危害掷骰先攻。

【常规】（1动作）
人群会以下列方式之一反应，由 d12 掷骰决定：
• 1–2 蹲伏：人群因恐惧而僵住。它在1轮内为大宴会厅内所有生物提供次等掩蔽。
• 3–4 跑！：确定一个随机方向。区域内每名生物必须成功通过 DC 21 强韧豁免，否则被向该方向移动10尺。大失败时，他们还会倒地。这是强迫移动。
• 5–6 歇斯底里：人群的恐惧会传染。区域内每名生物必须尝试 DC 21 意志豁免，否则获得恐惧1（大失败时为恐惧2）。这是情绪、恐惧与精神效果。
• 7–8 哀嚎：哭喊声让人难以专注。持续1轮，区域内任何尝试带有专注（特征）的动作的生物，必须成功通过 DC 4 纯骰检定，否则该动作被扰乱。这是听觉效果。
• 9–10 拥挤挤压：人群成员推搡挤压，试图找到逃生之路。区域内每名生物受到2d8+5钝击伤害（DC 21 基础强韧豁免）。
• 11–12 失控沮丧：混乱令人难以承受。区域内每名生物必须尝试 DC 21 意志豁免，否则困惑1轮。这是情绪与精神效果。

【进展】
若有任何PC在与冒牌破狱者的战斗后处于濒死状态，立即结算复原检定或用于救助他们的动作，尽管他们不会立刻有时间进行疗伤或使用其他探索活动。

【死亡通告】
当所有人都处于稳定状态后，朗读或转述以下内容。

沉重军靴的踏步声截断了持续不断的尖叫与哭泣，除了伤者的呻吟外，万籁俱寂。身披护甲的卫兵在房间所有出口处就位时，一名全身板甲的地狱骑士——帕拉利克托·凯托·乌劳内克斯——走到楼梯顶端。这些骑士看起来略显狼狈，仿佛他们刚经历过一场战斗。

凯托俯视众人，高声说道：“女士们、先生们，很遗憾地通知各位：伊斯嘉全境管家赫德文六世已遭谋杀！”房间里响起一片倒抽冷气的声音。

“在我们查清真相前，你们所有人都将被拘押。为你们自身安全着想，请留在此处。袭击发生后，某些魔法防御已经启动，因此离开庄园可能会很危险。此外，外面的卫兵会认为任何试图离开的人都与这桩滔天罪行同流合污，并将据此处置。”

PC应当清楚，试图与凯托的部队硬闯出去几乎必然是致命的错误。在事态迫使他们采取行动之前，PC大约有一小时用于恢复。费西走上前来，若有需要便提出为他们治疗（她的神圣泉源中有四发2环的治疗法术，并愿意按PC需求施放，无论是现在还是本章稍后的时候）。PC也获得5级带来的所有收益许可，例如炼金术师的领域发现、额外法术位等。

其他宾客仍对过去一小时的变故震惊不已。他们大多三三两两挤作一团，低声议论这些事件以及它们对伊斯嘉可能意味着什么。由于赫德文六世并无明确继承人，“接下来谁将统治伊斯嘉”是更具政治倾向者热衷的话题。

【登场人物】
本章的角色阵容与第4章基本相同，不过其中几名在那一章登场的NPC将在此处扮演不同的角色：

HAZARD 4
UNIQUE

Panic at the Gala [reaction] Trigger A creature rolls initiative; Effect 
The crowd stampedes, dealing 4d6 bludgeoning damage 
to anyone on the great room floor (DC 20 basic Reflex 
save), then rolls initiative.
Routine (1 action) The crowd reacts in one of the following 
ways, determined by a d12 die roll:
•	 1–2 Hunker Down: The crowd freezes in fear. It 
provides lesser cover to all creatures in the great 
room for 1 round.
•	 3–4 Run!: Determine a random direction. Each creature 
in the area must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save or 
be moved 10 feet in that direction. On a critical failure, 
they’re also knocked prone. This is forced movement.
•	 5–6 Hysteria: The crowd’s dread is contagious. Each 
creature in the area must attempt a DC 21 Will save or 
become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure). 
This is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.
•	 7–8 Wailing: The cries make it hard to concentrate. 
For 1 round, any creature in the area that attempts 
an action with the concentrate trait must succeed at 
a DC 4 flat check or the action is disrupted. This is an 
auditory effect.
•	 9–10 Crushing Press: Members of the crowd shove and 
push, trying to find a way to safety. Each creature in 
the area takes 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage (DC 21 basic 
Fortitude save).
•	 11–12 Wild Dismay: The chaos is overwhelming. Each 
creature in the area must attempt a DC 21 Will save or 
become confused for 1 round. This is an emotion and 
mental effect.
Development: If any PCs are dying following the 
battle with the false Hellbreakers, immediately resolve 
recovery checks or actions to save them, though they 
won’t have time immediately to Treat Wounds or use 
other exploration activities.
DEATH NOTICE
Once everyone is in a stable condition, read or 
paraphrase the following.
The tromp of heavy boots cuts short the continuing sound 
of screams and crying, silencing everything but the moans 
of the wounded. As armor-clad guards take up positions at 
all of the exits to the room, a Hellknight in full plate mail—
Paralictor Caeto Vulaunex—moves to the top of the stairs. 
The knights look slightly battered, as if they’ve just had their 
own battle.
Caeto looks down and calls out: “Ladies and gentlemen, I 
regret to inform you that Hedvend VI, steward of all Isger, 
has been murdered!” Gasps fill the room. “You are all under 
arrest until we get to the bottom of this. Remain in this room 
for your own safety. Certain magical defenses have activated 
with the attack, so leaving the manor could be dangerous. In 
addition, the guards outside will assume anyone who tries to 
leave is complicit in this heinous crime, and they will be dealt 
with accordingly.”
It should be clear to the PCs that trying to fight their 
way out past Caeto’s forces would almost certainly be 
a fatal mistake. The PCs have about an hour to recover 
before events conspire to force them to take action. 
Fessy approaches and offers to heal them if needed 
(she has four 2nd-rank heal spells in her divine font 
and offers to cast them as the PCs need, either now or 
later during this chapter). PCs also gain access to any 
benefits they receive from becoming level 5, such as an 
alchemist’s field discovery, additional spell slots, etc.
The other guests are in shock at the events of the last 
hour. They largely huddle in small groups, whispering 
about the events and what they might mean for Isger. 
Who will rule Isger going forward is a big topic among 
the more politically inclined as Hedvend VI had no 
clear successor.

## Page 86
管家赫德文六世已死，管家赫德文六世万岁……不死的那种。赫德文死后不久，凯托便命人将其遗体移至卧室，让他以一种体面的方式躺在那里，直至凶案查明，他才能得到妥善安葬。凯托并不知道，埃齐奥·盖塔使用了伊尔凯娜借助她的战碎片打造的一件独特护符，将赫德文转化为吸血鬼（特征），以加速通常需要三天的转化过程。赫德文在一定程度上受埃齐奥控制，被当作武器，用来清除更多伊利迪尔的精英。然而，快速的转化过程让他饥渴难耐，他也在宅邸中随机捕食无辜者。不在积极狩猎时，赫德文会按埃齐奥的命令爬出庄园并藏匿起来。

当宅邸中发现第二具尸体后，凯托·乌拉乌内克斯便会请求PC们协助。早在大厅那场战斗中，PC们就给他留下了深刻印象；而且因为第二起死亡发生时PC们正被看守，他知道他们不可能对第二具尸体负责，并据此推断他们大概率也与赫德文之死无关。此时，凯托会作为一名盟友出现，PC们也应当被允许相信：在合适的情况下，他或许会成为他们争取伊斯嘉的长期友人。尽管他私下已经在盘算如何填补赫德文死后留下的权力真空，但他仍对宅邸内的调查保持兴趣，并会不时向PC们询问进展。若有需要，他也可用于推动调查继续前进，让你在玩家显得卡住或沮丧时，有机会引导他们发现线索。

埃齐奥·盖塔完全预料到赫德文遇害后宅邸将会被封锁——在他看来，这是制造更多死亡的绝佳机会。他认为破狱者联盟会为当晚的一切事件背锅，从而使他能继续以乌加索娅特工的身份，潜伏在伊斯嘉的新领导层中。埃齐奥准备了多套应急预案，其中包括将谋杀罪名栽赃给莱兹妮娅——他在当晚早些时候便支配了她。PC们介入后，他会尝试与他们交好，以便完全掌握他们的调查动向，并在需要时操控他们。除非被迫到绝对无法回避的地步，他不会暴露自己的真面目。


1. 瑞弗斯雷斯特
管家的宅邸由上等木材建造，配有加固门扉，在庆典期间这些门都不上锁。一楼层高15尺（大厅的部分区域直通建筑屋顶，最高处达25尺），二楼层高10尺。大多数房间都点着一处或多处壁炉或火盆，以抵御阿巴迪斯寒冷的天气。窗户以木制百叶封闭，内侧用一根简单的门闩上锁；从外侧强行打开的DC为22。整座宅邸内都由魔法灯光提供明亮光照。以下为各区域的基础描述；注意其中若干区域还包含与赫德文六世谋杀案之谜，以及本章后文所述的“伪破狱者”相关的更具体细节。

I1：前厅：庄重入口的深色木材上刻满了大量几乎难以察觉的符文，会触发魔法陷阱。庆典期间，这些陷阱全部停用。

I2：大厅：伊斯嘉的管家们修建大厅是为了给来访者留下深刻印象。这间奢华的厅室在东侧大部分区域都有高耸的天花板。一座舞台为乐师及其他艺人提供表演空间。一座绘有彩绘栏杆的宏伟楼梯通向二楼。墙面绘满壁画，据称描绘的是伊斯嘉的伟业。

I3：图书馆：图书馆与大厅一样，同样旨在震撼来访者。四面墙都立着直达天花板的书架，架上满是书籍。装在滚轮上的梯子让人能轻松触及上层书架的藏书。书籍经过精心筛选，确保符合切利亚斯人的品味。

I4：盥厕：瑞弗斯雷斯特设有数间盥厕。楼上的盥厕还配有浴缸。

I5：雕像厅：此处立着一尊神情严厉的女性雕像，佩戴着象征伊斯嘉管家身份的护符。铭牌注明她是阿德拉尔丁一世——伊斯嘉的第一任管家。

I6：艺术长廊：艺术长廊陈列着管家们数百年来收集的珍贵艺术品与遗物。墙上悬挂着多幅大型绘画，描绘所谓伊斯嘉历史中的场景，但其设计意在传达当代信息：最初的伊斯嘉部族向塔尔多军队投降；以及后来在“巧舌征服”期间，切利亚斯前来拯救伊斯嘉。

I7：温室：这座温室里有许多植物——其中不少可食用——种植在木桶中，并始终保持……


奎斯特在哪？
尽管奎斯特是第4章的重要角色，并会在第6章再次登场，但他在本章几乎无事可做，也不是埃齐奥或赫德文的目标。他会尽量与PC保持距离，以免任何人察觉他与破狱者联盟的交易；如果PC们接近他，他也会催促他们同样保持距离。

Adventure Toolbox
Steward Hedvend VI is dead, long unlive Steward 
Hedvend VI. In the immediate aftermath of Hedvend’s 
death, Caeto had his body moved to his bedroom 
and left to lie there in a respectful manner until his 
murder is solved and he can be properly buried. 
Unknown to Caeto, Ezio Gaeta transformed Hedvend 
into a vampire by using a unique talisman Illcayna 
created with her warshard to expedite the usual three-
day transformation process. Hedvend is partially 
under Ezio’s control and being used as a weapon to 
take out more of Elidir’s elite. However, the rapid 
transformation process has left him ravenously hungry 
and he is also feeding on random innocents in the 
mansion. When he’s not actively hunting, Hedvend 
climbs out of the manor and hides at Ezio’s command.
Caeto Vulaunex enlists the PCs’ help once a second 
body is discovered in the manor. Already impressed by 
the PCs for their fight in the great room, he knows they 
aren’t responsible for the second death because they are 
under guard at the time and concludes they are likely 
not responsible for Hedvend’s either. Caeto serves as an 
ally at this point, and PCs should be allowed to believe 
that he could, in the right circumstances, end up as a 
long-term friend in their struggle for Isger. While he is 
already privately planning how he will fill the vacuum 
left by Hedvend’s death, he remains interested in the 
investigation in the manor and checks in with the PCs 
on their progress. He can also be used to help push the 
investigation forward if needed, giving you a chance to 
lead players to hints if they appear stuck or frustrated.

Steward Hedvend VI is dead, long unlive Steward Hedvend VI. In the immediate aftermath of Hedvend’s death, Caeto had his body moved to his bedroom and left to lie there in a respectful manner until his murder is solved and he can be properly buried. Unknown to Caeto, Ezio Gaeta transformed Hedvend into a vampire by using a unique talisman Illcayna created with her warshard to expedite the usual three-day transformation process. Hedvend is partially under Ezio’s control and being used as a weapon to take out more of Elidir’s elite. However, the rapid transformation process has left him ravenously hungry and he is also feeding on random innocents in the mansion. When he’s not actively hunting, Hedvend climbs out of the manor and hides at Ezio’s command.

Caeto Vulaunex enlists the PCs’ help once a second body is discovered in the manor. Already impressed by the PCs for their fight in the great room, he knows they aren’t responsible for the second death because they are under guard at the time and concludes they are likely not responsible for Hedvend’s either. Caeto serves as an ally at this point, and PCs should be allowed to believe that he could, in the right circumstances, end up as a long-term friend in their struggle for Isger. While he is already privately planning how he will fill the vacuum left by Hedvend’s death, he remains interested in the investigation in the manor and checks in with the PCs on their progress. He can also be used to help push the investigation forward if needed, giving you a chance to lead players to hints if they appear stuck or frustrated.

Ezio Gaeta fully expected the mansion to be locked down after Hedvend’s murder, which he saw as a perfect opportunity to cause more death. He assumes the Hellbreakers League will take the blame for the night’s events, leaving him free to continue as Urgathoa’s agent among Isger’s new leadership. Ezio has multiple contingency plans ready including pinning the blame for the murder on Lezinia, whom he Dominated early in the evening. When the PCs get involved, he tries to befriend them so he can stay fully informed of their investigation and manipulate them as needed. He doesn’t reveal his true self until he is absolutely forced to.

The steward’s home is made of fine wood, with reinforced doors, which are unlocked during the gala. The first floor is 15 feet high (except for parts of the great room that are open to the building’s roof, 25 feet up), and the second floor is 10 feet high. Most rooms have one or more fireplaces or braziers going to keep them warm against the cold Abadius weather. The windows are closed with wooden shutters, which are locked with a simple bar from the inside; from outside, the DC to Force them Open is 22. Magical lights provide bright light in the entire household. 多亏早期某位总管安排的德鲁伊魔法，这里温暖而湿润。宽大的窗户在白天引入光线。

I8. 厨房：这间储备充足、设备齐全的厨房，旨在让总管或其宾客在一天中的任何时刻都能得到几乎任何想要的东西。这里总有炉火燃烧，通常有两到三位厨师和面点师在烹饪或随时准备开工。在诸如晚会等活动期间，这个数字会增加到六人左右。

I9. 储藏室：瑞芙斯憩所内有数间井然有序的储藏室。一层与温室相连的那间存放园艺用品；与厨房相连的那间存放烹饪常备品（尽管大多数物资每天都会以新鲜形式运入）。楼上有一间更大的储藏室，存放床品与织物。

I10. 餐厅：银制枝形吊灯垂挂着水晶。巨大的餐桌是一整块令人惊叹的黑色大理石板，置于一座精致的暮木桌架之上，桌脚雕成龙爪的模样。暮木椅则呼应伊斯嘉在内海中的角色：椅背顶端雕着一艘商船，而扶手的造型让人联想到科内里卡河的波涛。

I11. 仆役会客室：此房间作为庄园仆役的入口与聚集处。沿墙的架子上摆放着精致餐具、银器以及其他上菜用具。

I12. 仆役住处：有几名仆役——总管、主厨与内务主管——常住于庄园，居于这些小房间中。每间都配有床铺、衣柜与其他个人物品。

I13. 守卫岗哨：这里是总管私人卫队的总部，他们也负责瑞芙斯憩所的安保。一张桌子和几把椅子让守卫们在不值勤时可以放松，但仍需保持随时待命以应对紧急情况。

I14. 守卫住处：总管卫队的头领住在庄园内的这些房间。每间都有一张床，以及一个装有个人物品的箱子。

I15. 军械库：军械库内有多种类型的武器，供守卫使用。

I16. 楼上平台：大厅中的宏伟楼梯通往二层平台，平台几乎贯穿整座庄园的长度。东侧区域为开放式，使总管及其最亲近的宾客在活动期间无需与地位较低者周旋，也能参与其中并被人看见。约到人类腰部高度的彩绘栏杆可提供些许防坠落保护。

I17. 客房：这间令人印象深刻、富丽堂皇的卧室用于接待总管的私人宾客。室内有一张大型四柱帷幔床与多组衣柜。北侧的休息区沿墙摆着软垫长凳，宾客可通过落地窗将整座城市尽收眼底。相连的房间（I17a）设有床铺，可供两名获准随侍宾客的仆役或守卫居住。

I18. 游戏室：此房间为总管与宾客放松提供一个私密、较不正式的空间。室内有一张带抽屉的游戏桌。墙上挂柜里放着烟斗、烟草、烈酒瓶与水晶高脚杯。

I19. 赫德文的卧室：赫德文的卧室是他的主要起居空间。内有一张大而舒适的床、用于衣物的衣柜与箱子，以及其他个人物品。墙上挂着个人战利品、赠礼，以及其他颂扬他本人与其伊斯嘉总督任期的物件。

I20. 私人餐室：二层餐室提供了一个较小的用餐空间，供总管进食。软垫座椅环绕着一张暮木餐桌，其正式程度足以不冒犯在座任何宾客，同时又更适合总管与家人一同用餐时的舒适需求。

I21. 私人书房：私人书房存放着赫德文六世的个人文件，包括与其他统治者的往来书信及各种国政事务。

I22. 日光室：这间八角形房间为总管放松而设计。里面有几张舒适的……

顿悟时刻！

优秀的谋杀悬疑中最具标志性的桥段之一，便是无畏的侦探把零散线索——那些看似显而易见的事实与无关紧要的观察——全部拼合起来，突然意识到凶手是谁（调查员这一职业正是围绕这一思路而设计）。小说作者可以随心所欲地安排这一刻，但在桌面角色扮演游戏中，对玩家而言这可能并不那么明显。有些熟悉此类故事的玩家，或许能在后续页面中捕捉到部分线索并将其串联起来；但对没那么敏感的玩家，你可以提供技能检定来帮助PC建立这些联系——许多线索旁都列出了建议的技能与DC。（如果PC们正享受谜题，你甚至可以暗中进行这些检定，记录任何成功，并在他们卡住或在戏剧性时刻再把“领悟”分发给玩家。）

另一种选择是让凯托中途过来查看PC的进展，并指出他们可能忽略的点；不过要小心别让他抢走风头，因为他正忙着准备在伊斯嘉宣布戒严。

I8. Kitchen: The well-stocked, well-equipped kitchen 
is designed to provide almost anything the steward or 
their guests could want at any time of day or night. A 
fire always burns here, and usually two or three chefs 
and bakers are cooking or ready to cook. That number 
increases to a half dozen during events like the gala.
I9. Storeroom: Reevesrest contains several well-
organized store rooms. On the first floor, the one 
attached to the conservatory contains gardening 
supplies, and one attached to the kitchen contains 
cooking staples (though most goods are brought in fresh 
daily). Upstairs, a larger storeroom contains linens.
I10. Dining room: A silver chandelier drips with 
crystals. The massive table is an incredible slab of black 
marble resting on an elaborate duskwood stand with 
feet carved to resemble a dragon’s. Duskwood chairs 
evoke Isger’s role in the Inner Sea, with a trading ship 
carved into the headrest and the armrests evoking the 
waves of the Conerica River.
I11. Servants’ parlor: This room serves as an 
entrance and gathering place for the manor’s servants. 
Shelves along the walls contain fine dishes, silverware 
and other such serving items.
I12. Servant’s quarters: Several servants—the 
majordomo, head chef, and chamberlain—live full-
time in the manor, staying in these small rooms. Each 
contains a bed, dresser and other personal effects.
I13. Guard post: This is the headquarters for 
the steward’s personal guard, who also take care 
of Reevesrest’s security. A table and several chairs 
let guards relax when they are not on duty but still 
required to stay available in case of emergency.
I14. Guard quarters: The heads of the steward’s 
guard live on the premises, in these rooms. Each 
contains a bed, as well as a chest containing their 
personal items.
I15: Armory: The armory contains a number of 
weapons of all types for the guards’ use.
I16. Upstairs landing: The grand staircase in the 
great room leads to the upper landing, which runs 
almost the entire length of the manor. The eastern 
portion is open so the steward and his closest guests 
can participate and be seen during events without 
having to mingle with those of lesser importance. 
Painted balustrades at about waist height for a human 
provide some minimal protection from a fall.
I17. Guest room: This impressive, opulent bedroom 
serves personal guests of the steward. It contains a large 
canopied bed and numerous dressers. Padded benches 
line the northern seating area, where guests can take 
in a view of the entire city through the floor-to-ceiling 
windows. An attached room (I17a) contains beds for a 
pair of servants or guards permitted to guests.
I18. Game room: This room offers a private, less 
formal area for the steward to relax with guests. It 
contains a game table with built-in drawer. A mounted 
cabinet on the wall contains pipes, tobacco, bottles of 
liquor, and crystal goblets.
I19. Hedvend’s bedroom: Hedvend’s bedroom is his 
primary living space. It includes a large, comfortable 
bed, dressers and chests for his clothing, and other 
personal items. Personal trophies, gifts, and other 
items celebrating him and his governorship of Isger 
hang on the walls.
I20. Private dining room: The upstairs dining room 
offers a smaller area where the steward can eat. Padded 
chairs surround a duskwood table, formal enough to 
not offend any guests here, but also more comfortable 
for a steward and their family to dine together.

with other rulers and various other matters of state.

THE A-HA MOMENT!
One of the most iconic moments in a good murder 
mystery is when the intrepid detective puts 
together all the assorted clues—the seemingly 
obvious facts and innocuous observations—
to suddenly realize who the culprit is (the 
investigator class plays heavily on this very idea). 
While a novel author has free rein to create that 
moment, it might not be as obvious for players 
in a tabletop roleplaying game. Some players 
who are attuned to such stories might pick up 
on some of the clues in the ensuing pages and 
piece them together. But for those who aren’t, 
you can offer skill checks to help the PCs make 
those connections—suggested skills and DCs are 
listed with many clues. (If the PCs are having 
fun with the mystery, you could even make the 
checks secretly, noting any success, and doling 
out realizations to the players later if they get 
stuck, or at dramatic moments.)
Another option is to have Caeto stop in to check 
up on the PCs and point out something they might 
be missing, though take care not to let him steal 
the spotlight as he’s busy preparing to declare 
martial law over Isger.

……铺着软垫的椅子与长凳，以及摆满小说与其他消遣读物的书柜。窗户可将整座城市的壮阔景致尽收眼底。

I23. 闺房：管事套房内的这间私密卧室原本为其家庭而设，必要时可提供分开的起居空间。在像赫德文六世这类单身管事的情况下，它名义上也作为另一间客房使用；不过，一扇将此处与管事寝室相连的暗门，使得房内住客能轻易出入，以供私下幽会之用。自从数月前抵达埃利迪尔后住进此室以来，莱齐妮娅与赫德文便一直利用这条私密通道。

游戏开始
大约一小时后，一名神色紧张的仆役走近PC们，告知凯托·武劳内克斯希望与他们谈话。若PC们同意，她会护送他们上楼前往书房（区域I21）。凯托已将书房挪作己用，因为那里既能提供隐私，也便于他随时走出房间俯瞰大客厅里发生的一切。若PC们拒绝随她前往，凯托便会下楼请他们与自己会面。若他们仍拒绝，他会向PC们保证不会伤害他们，也不会追究他们的责任。朗读或转述以下内容：

“我听说，是你们阻止了那些地狱破坏者在宴会上屠杀所有人。这一点，再加上一个新情况，让我确信你们与这起谋杀无关。既然如此，也鉴于你们显而易见的技能，我希望你们调查这里正在发生的事。我原以为，宾客之中大概还有一两个同谋，我迟早能揪出来，可这个新情况……”

他的神情沉了下来。“有人——或者某种东西——杀了我的一名卫兵。我确信这里还另有隐情。然而，赫德文死后，我必须确保城市与国家的安全。我的卫兵虽有本事，但他们不是调查员。看来你们才是我最好的选择。若你们同意，你们将获准自由移动以进行调查；但在这些谋杀被侦破、且凶手被杀死或已被拘押之前，你们仍不得离开庄园范围。”

这给了PC们一个摆脱当前处境、并揭开“假地狱破坏者”之谜的机会。他们甚至可能赢得这位伊斯嘉显然的新领袖的青睐——对联盟而言，这将是一次重大机遇。PC们一旦同意，便有四个最可能的初始方向来着手破解谜团：假地狱破坏者、案发现场、赫德文的尸体，以及被杀的卫兵。让玩家自行决定先做什么；但若他们需要帮助开头，凯托可以建议其中任意一项或全部。他要求PC们将任何进展告知他，并表示会尽力提供他们破案所需的一切。下文的“调查”详述了PC们可能采取的调查途径，包括在四个初始方向之后才会展开的那些。

调查：假地狱破坏者
凯托已将这些假地狱破坏者押送至岗哨（区域I13）。幸存者被用质量上乘的镣铐铐住手脚。除不得释放这些卫兵外，凯托给予PC们充分许可，可自由展开调查。凯托手头有一张“死者交谈”卷轴；若卫兵全都已死，他允许PC们使用（若PC无人能施放该法术，费西可以施放）。

这些低阶冒牌货——包括那些袭击地狱骑士的人——其实是被埃齐奥以魔法支配的卫兵。PC可以用一次威吓检定强迫他们回答问题，其DC等同于其DC 15意志豁免。若PC们尝试对任何已死的卫兵使用“死者交谈”，他们会心甘情愿且如实作答。每个人讲述的内容都相同：莱弗拉内克把他们带到私用餐室，说是要就一件小事面见赫德文；然而他们在那里见到的却是一名披着红斗篷的人。他们每个人最后的记忆，都是与那人的双眼对视，然后感觉自己必须服从对方的命令。

这次“假地狱破坏者”袭击的首领莱弗拉内克·梅亚尔，是一名乌尔格索娅的邪教徒，按伊尔卡伊娜的指示渗透进赫德文的卫队之中。她对阴谋了解更多，但并不知道埃齐奥的身份及其在事件中的角色。宴会前，她收到一条加密讯息，指示她把其他卫兵带到赫德文的私用餐室。埃齐奥在那里对他们施放了支配，并命令他们在宴会上尽可能多地杀死宾客，由莱弗拉内克作为自愿的带头人。

若莱弗拉内克仍活着，她在任何获取情报的尝试中都基本不合作，不过PC们可以尝试若干不同方法。PC们可以用一次DC 19的威吓检定强迫她开口，但他们会令莱弗拉内克……

I23. Boudoir: This private bedroom in the 
steward’s apartments was designed for their 
family, offering separate quarters should they 
be needed. In the case of single stewards, like 
Hedvend VI, it officially serves as another

gives easy access to occupants for 
romantic assignations. Lezinia and

THE GAME’S AFOOT
After about an hour, a nervous-looking 
servant approaches the PCs, informing them that 
Caeto Vulaunex wishes to speak with them. If they 
agree, she escorts them upstairs to the study (area I21), 
which Caeto has appropriated for his own uses as it 
gives him privacy, but also lets him easily step out to 
look down on what’s happening in the great room. If 
the PCs refuse to accompany her, Caeto comes down 
to ask them to meet with him. If they still refuse, he 
promises the PCs that no harm will come to them 
and they are not in trouble. Read or paraphrase the 
following:
“I’m told you were responsible for stopping those 
Hellbreakers from killing everyone at the gala. That, 
along with a new development, has convinced me you 
were not involved with this slaying. Given that, and your 
obvious skill, I would like to ask you to investigate what is 
happening here. I thought there was likely one or two more 
conspirators among the partygoers who I would uncover, 
but this new development…”
His expression darkens. “Someone, or something, killed 
one of my guards. I’m convinced there’s more going on 
here. However, following Hedvend’s death, I need to 
make sure the city and country are secure. My guards are 
talented, but they are not investigators. It would appear 
you are my best option. If you agree, you will be allowed 
free movement to investigate, though you will still not be 
allowed to leave the manor grounds until these murders 
are solved and the captor killed or in custody.”
This is an opportunity for the PCs to get themselves 
out of this situation and uncover the mystery of the 
false Hellbreakers. They could even earn favor with 
the apparent new leader of Isger, which would be a 
major opportunity for the League. Once the PCs agree, 
they have four likely initial approaches to begin 
solving the mystery: the false Hellbreakers, 
the murder scene, Hedvend’s corpse, and the 
slain guard. Give players the opportunity 
to decide what to do first, but Caeto can 
suggest any or all of those if they need help 
getting started. He tells the PCs to keep him 
informed of any developments, and that he 
will try to provide anything they need 
to help them solve the crimes. The 
inquiries below detail avenues 
of investigation the PCs might 
undertake, including ones that 
develop after the four initial 
approaches.
Inquiry: False Hellbreakers
Caeto had the false Hellbreakers taken to 
the guard post (area I13). Survivors are bound hand 
and foot with good-quality manacles. Caeto gives PCs 
free rein in their investigation except that the guards 
can’t be freed. Caeto has a single scroll of talking 
corpse available, which he allows the PCs to use if all 
of the guards are dead (Fessy can cast the spell if no 
PC is able to).
The lower-level fakes, including those that attacked 
the Hellknights, were guards that Ezio magically 
dominated. A PC can Coerce them into answering 
questions with an Intimidation check against their DC 
15 Will save. If the PCs attempt to use talking corpse 
on any deceased guards, they answer willingly and 
truthfully. Each tells the same tale: Lefranek brought 
them to the private dining room, supposedly to meet 
with Hedvend on a minor matter. Instead, they found 
a red-cloaked individual there. The last thing each 
remembers was looking into the figure’s eyes and 
feeling that they needed to obey their commands.
The leader of the false Hellbreaker attack, Lefranek 
Meyal, is an Urgathoan cultist who infiltrated 
Hedvend’s guards at Illcayna’s instructions. She has 
more knowledge of the plot, though she’s unaware of 
Ezio’s identity and his role in events. Before the gala, 
she received a coded message that instructed her to 
bring her fellow guards to Hedvend’s private dining 
room. There, Ezio cast dominate on them and sent 
them to kill as many guests at the gala as they could 
with Lefranek as their willing leader.
If alive, Lefranek is largely uncooperative during any 
attempts to get information, though the PCs can try 
several different methods. PCs can attempt to Coerce 
her with a DC 19 Intimidation check, but they take

## Page 90
……则承受–2环境减值，因为莱弗拉内克并不害怕死亡。若成功通过DC 19的察言观色检定，PC会辨识出这一信息；若大成功，PC会意识到她害怕的是“在没有机会被转化为亡灵的情况下死去”，PC可以利用这一点来抵消该减值。PC也可以在交谈中成功套她的话：成功通过DC 21的交涉检定，或通过DC 23的欺瞒检定来假扮另一名伪装的“地狱破行者”。

如果莱弗拉内克已死亡，PC可以尝试在她身上使用那张死者交谈卷轴。若他们成功让她开口，莱弗拉内克会吹嘘自己在阴谋中的作用，称这是“将伊斯嘉从切利亚斯的暴政中解放出来，并把它献给‘丰饶的收获女士’”的第一步。成功通过DC 20的宗教检定可得知，这是乌尔格索娅（Urgathoa）的一项称号，源自古代伊斯嘉人将她视作收获女神的观念。莱弗拉内克承认她把其他守卫交给了一个披红斗篷的人，但也如实表示她不知道那人是谁。

宝藏：奥顿·荨麻刷会接近PC——比起地狱骑士，他觉得PC没那么吓人——并紧张地告知他们，他在晚宴期间看到莱弗拉内克从一间储物间离开。根据他的线索，PC会找到一根死者法杖，以及一枚用于仪式实践、雕工精致的缟玛瑙头骨，价值200 gp。

奖励：若PC从任意一名伪装的地狱破行者口中获得任何信息，给予他们30 XP。若他们得知莱弗拉内克效忠乌尔格索娅，再额外给予30 XP。

调查：犯罪现场

一扇结实的木门从铰链上脱落，露出一间庄严的游戏室。几只怪物被制成标本的头颅从墙上俯视着室内；华丽壁炉中仍有余烬闷燃。一张象牙与桃花心木制成的游戏桌占据了大半空间，桌旁摆着半打厚软靠椅。桌首的一把椅子翻倒在地，溅满血迹。翻倒的椅子前方，桌上摊着一手朝上的纸牌，旁边放着一把钥匙。相邻座位前，则有另一手纸牌扣放在桌上。

赫德文六世在盛大登场前，正在这间游戏室里消磨时间；他在此与埃齐奥会面，并迎来自己的死亡。杀死执政官后，埃齐奥锁上房门，并以雾化形态溜走。他回到楼下的宴会中，等待尸体被发现的必然时刻。不久之后，凯托在伪装地狱破行者发动袭击后寻找执政官，踹门而入，发现了赫德文的尸体。

此房间为细心的PC提供了若干线索。部分玩家可能会自行注意到这些，或明确询问相关主题；若没有，则把这些线索指出给那些成功通过所列技能检定的PC。
• DC 18 游戏学识、DC 20 社会：桌上两副牌暗示赫德文认识凶手，且对对方的出现并不惊讶。
• DC 20 运动或察觉：房间里没有搏斗痕迹，说明赫德文以某种方式被制住，或根本来不及对攻击做出反应（埃齐奥支配了赫德文）。
• DC 20 医疗或察觉：其中一把椅子上有几滴血，但量不足以表明存在严重创口（埃齐奥喝掉了大部分血）。
• DC 20 制造或巧手：钥匙就在赫德文座位旁的桌面上，表明房间是从内侧上锁，而凶手随后仍能离开这间上锁的房间。

除上述PC无需费力就能看出的线索外，他们也可以搜索房间。成功通过DC 18的察觉检定的PC会注意到桌下有一个小巧的黄铜沙漏护符，内部装着黑色砂粒。这是伊尔凯娜以她的战屑（warshard）制作的墓时护符，用以加速将赫德文转化为埃齐奥的吸血鬼仆从的过程。埃齐奥把护符固定在赫德文的尸体上，但凯托的手下在搬动执政官时不慎将其撞落，于是护符仍完好无损，而赫德文则被留在一种近乎野兽般、永无止境的饥渴状态中。

仔细检查沙漏的PC可以尝试进行DC 20的自然检定；若成功，他们会意识到这些砂粒其实是缟玛瑙。成功通过DC 22的宗教检定以回忆知识的PC，会知道缟玛瑙常用于制造亡灵的仪式。PC也可以用DC 22的宗教检定来对护符进行辨识魔法；若成功，PC理解该物品会影响尸体上的时间流动，可能用于保存尸体或加速其腐坏。请记录该检定的任何大成功——当PC开始意识到谋杀案牵涉吸血鬼时，该PC会意识到这护符也可能让“一瞬间仿佛过去了三个夜晚”，这正是生物被埋入土中、随后转化为吸血鬼仆从所需的典型时间。

person in a red cloak, but truthfully says she doesn’t

Treasure: Otton Nettlebrush approaches the PCs, 
finding them less intimidating than the Hellknights, 
and nervously informs them that he saw Lefranek 
leave a supply closet during the gala. Following his tip, 
the PCs uncover a staff of the dead and an intricately 
carved onyx skull for ritual practices worth 200 gp.
Reward: If the PCs get any information from any 
of the false Hellbreakers, award them 30 XP. Award 
them an additional 30 XP if they learn of Lefranek’s 
allegiance to Urgathoa.
Inquiry: Scene of the Crime
A solid wooden door hangs off its hinges, revealing a 
stately game room. The taxidermied heads of several 
monsters look down from the walls while the smoldering 
remains of a fire burn in the ornate fireplace.
An ivory and mahogany game table fills much of the 
space, with a half dozen well-cushioned chairs arranged 
around it. One chair at the head of the table is overturned 
and speckled with blood. In front of the overturned chair, 
a hand of cards is laid out face up on the table and a single 
key sits nearby. A second hand of cards rests face down in 
front of an adjacent seat.
Hedvend VI was in his game room passing the time 
before his grand entrance to the gala when he met with 
Ezio and his demise. After killing the steward, Ezio 
locked the door and slipped out using Mist Form. He 
returned to the party downstairs, where he waited for the 
inevitable discovery. A short time later, Caeto searched 
for the steward after the false Hellbreaker attacks and 
broke the door down, discovering Hedvend’s body.
The room offers a number of clues for observant 
PCs. Some players might notice these or ask 
specifically about these topics but if not, 
point out the clues to PCs who succeed at a 
listed skill check.
•  DC 18 Games Lore, DC 20 Society: Two 
sets of cards at the table suggest Hedvend 
knew his killer and was not surprised at their 
presence.
•  DC 20 Athletics or Perception: There are 
no signs of a struggle in the room, indicating 
that Hedvend was somehow subdued or that 
he had no chance to react to the attack 
(Ezio dominated Hedvend).
•  DC 20 Medicine or Perception: There 
are a few drops of blood in one of the 
chairs, but not enough to indicate a major wound 
(Ezio drank most of the blood).
•	 DC 20 Crafting or Thievery: The key is on 
the table next to where Hedvend was sitting, 
indicating that the room was locked from the 
inside and the killer was then able to leave the 
locked room.
In addition to the clues above that PCs can see with 
no real difficulty, they can Search the room. A PC who 
succeeds at a DC 18 Perception check notices a small 
brass hourglass talisman filled with a black sand under 
the table. This was a grave time talisman that Illcayna 
created with her warshard to expedite the process of 
transforming Hedvend into Ezio’s vampire servitor. 
Ezio affixed the talisman to Hedvend’s body but it was 
inadvertently knocked off by Caeto’s men when they 
moved the steward, leaving the talisman still intact 
and Hedvend in a state of near-feral perpetual hunger.
A PC who closely examines the hourglass can 
attempt a DC 20 Nature check; on a success they 
realize the sand is actually onyx. With a successful DC 
22 Religion check to Recall Knowledge, a PC is aware 
that onyx is used in rituals to create undead. A PC can 
also attempt to Identify Magic on the talisman with a 
DC 22 Religion check; on a success, the PC understands

a –2 circumstance penalty, as Lefranek isn’t afraid of dying. With a successful DC 19 check to Sense Motive, a PC discerns this information; on a critical success, a PC realizes she’s afraid of dying without the chance to be turned into an undead, which they can use to negate the penalty. PCs could also try to trick her up in conversation with a successful DC 21 Diplomacy check or a DC 23 Deception to Impersonate another false Hellbreaker.

If Lefranek is dead, the PCs can attempt to use the scroll of talking corpse on her. If they successfully get her to talk, Lefranek brags about her role in the plot, calling it the first step in freeing Isger from the tyranny of Cheliax and delivering it for “the Bountiful Lady of Harvests.” A successful DC 20 Religion check reveals this is a title for Urgathoa based off an ancient Isgeri conception of her as a harvest goddess. Lefranek admits she delivered the other guards to a person in a red cloak, but truthfully says she doesn’t know who it was.

Treasure: Otton Nettlebrush approaches the PCs, finding them less intimidating than the Hellknights, and nervously informs them that he saw Lefranek leave a supply closet during the gala. Following his tip, the PCs uncover a staff of the dead and an intricately carved onyx skull for ritual practices worth 200 gp.

Reward: If the PCs get any information from any of the false Hellbreakers, award them 30 XP. Award them an additional 30 XP if they learn of Lefranek’s allegiance to Urgathoa.

Inquiry: Scene of the Crime

A solid wooden door hangs off its hinges, revealing a stately game room. The taxidermied heads of several monsters look down from the walls while the smoldering remains of a fire burn in the ornate fireplace.

An ivory and mahogany game table fills much of the space, with a half dozen well-cushioned chairs arranged around it. One chair at the head of the table is overturned and speckled with blood. In front of the overturned chair, a hand of cards is laid out face up on the table and a single key sits nearby. A second hand of cards rests face down in front of an adjacent seat.

Hedvend VI was in his game room passing the time before his grand entrance to the gala when he met with Ezio and his demise. After killing the steward, Ezio locked the door and slipped out using Mist Form. He returned to the party downstairs, where he waited for the inevitable discovery. A short time later, Caeto searched for the steward after the false Hellbreaker attacks and broke the door down, discovering Hedvend’s body.

The room offers a number of clues for observant PCs. Some players might notice these or ask specifically about these topics but if not, point out the clues to PCs who succeed at a listed skill check.
• DC 18 Games Lore, DC 20 Society: Two sets of cards at the table suggest Hedvend knew his killer and was not surprised at their presence.
• DC 20 Athletics or Perception: There are no signs of a struggle in the room, indicating that Hedvend was somehow subdued or that he had no chance to react to the attack (Ezio dominated Hedvend).
• DC 20 Medicine or Perception: There are a few drops of blood in one of the chairs, but not enough to indicate a major wound (Ezio drank most of the blood).
• DC 20 Crafting or Thievery: The key is on the table next to where Hedvend was sitting, indicating that the room was locked from the inside and the killer was then able to leave the locked room.

In addition to the clues above that PCs can see with no real difficulty, they can Search the room. A PC who succeeds at a DC 18 Perception check notices a small brass hourglass talisman filled with a black sand under the table. This was a grave time talisman that Illcayna created with her warshard to expedite the process of transforming Hedvend into Ezio’s vampire servitor. Ezio affixed the talisman to Hedvend’s body but it was inadvertently knocked off by Caeto’s men when they moved the steward, leaving the talisman still intact and Hedvend in a state of near-feral perpetual hunger.

A PC who closely examines the hourglass can attempt a DC 20 Nature check; on a success they realize the sand is actually onyx. With a successful DC 22 Religion check to Recall Knowledge, a PC is aware that onyx is used in rituals to create undead. A PC can also attempt to Identify Magic on the talisman with a DC 22 Religion check; on a success, the PC understands the item would affect the flow of time on a body, likely to preserve it or accelerate its decomposition. Note any critical success on this check—when the PCs start realizing a vampire is involved in the murders, the PC realizes the talisman could also make it as if three nights had passed in an instant, the time typically required for a creature to be buried in the earth before turning into a vampire servitor.

宝藏：在一张桌子下面有一尊乌尔加索娅的缟玛瑙神像，价值10 gp。

奖励：如果PC们发现了坟冢时之护符，奖励他们30 XP。若他们发现了缟玛瑙的存在，或识别出该护符的用途，则再额外奖励30 XP。

调查：赫德文的尸体
赫德文的尸体被带到他的私人套房，并被安置在他的床上。一名地狱骑士守在通往房间的华丽双开门前，但她会允许PC们自由进入。不幸的是，PC们检查尸体的努力注定要失败：赫德文的尸体不见了！

厚重的深红色天鹅绒帷幕覆满墙面，一张熊皮地毯铺在这间奢华的大卧室地面上。壁炉上方挂着一柄仿佛由折叠银片制成的长柄刀作为战利品，火焰在寒冷的微风中舞动。敞开的窗下堆着一小片积雪，旁边还有一滩正在融化的水渍。南侧墙边，一张铺得整整齐齐的华盖床看不出曾有人躺过的痕迹，唯有厚重的被子上有一处浅浅的凹陷。

更仔细地检查现场后，会发现床上散落着似乎是几把泥土。调查这些泥土的PC可以尝试一次DC 20自然检定。
成功：他们辨认出这是刚挖出的新土，很可能来自宅邸的庭院；这是管家作为吸血鬼（特征）觉醒所需的条件之一。
觉醒为亡灵后，赫德文六世从窗户逃了出去，并将窗户敞开着。（PC也可以尝试DC 20自然检定或生存检定，以意识到积雪与水渍表明窗户是在不久前才被打开。）

除了以上PC们几乎不费力就能看见的线索外，他们也可以搜索房间。若其检定结果超过下列DC，则会发现额外线索：
• DC 20：地毯上也有泥土，仿佛曾有人把泥带进过房间。（若他们选择进一步调查，见第91页“调查：弄脏的床单”。）
• DC 22：西侧墙边的地板上有细小刮痕，显示这里有一扇通往套房梳妆室的密门（数十年前安装，用于秘密幽会）。
• DC 30：地毯上的足迹显然来自一名穿鞋的超小型生物。看起来留下足迹者从西侧密门进入，走到床边后转身，并沿原路折返。

若PC们告知地狱骑士卫兵赫德文的尸体不见了，她会大吃一惊并冲入室内核实。除PC们之外，自她被派来守卫尸体起，她未见任何人进出。她并不知道那扇密门的存在，也没有理由认为有人能在她不知情的情况下进出赫德文的卧室。

宝藏：搜索过房间（DC 20）的PC会发现一个暗格，里面有记录城内外贿赂与腐败的账册。这本账册对“合适的人”价值400 gp，但对其他人可能更值钱。机敏的PC也会注意到那柄长柄刀是一件魔法物品，但PC们直到第6章之前都没有机会把它据为己有。

奖励：如果PC们发现了赫德文房间里的足迹，奖励他们30 XP。

调查：第二名受害者
当吸血鬼（特征）管家从外面溜进来、撕开他的喉咙并尽可能多地饮血时，一名宅邸守卫正待在客房里搜寻赫德文被害的线索。当PC们进入房间时，读出或转述如下内容：

少量喷溅的血迹覆盖在一具穿着锁子甲、身着宅邸守卫制服的尸体周围地面上。那人脸上仍凝固着震惊的表情，而他的喉咙被残忍地撕裂。

PC可以尝试一次医疗检定来检查尸体。若其检定结果超过下列DC，则得知：
• DC 18：守卫的喉咙似乎是被利爪撕开。
• DC 20：基于缺乏任何防御性伤口，这名守卫很可能是遭到突袭。
• DC 22：以守卫的体型而言，血量比应有的少。喷溅看起来来自致命一击，但之后明显缺少血泊。
• DC 25：守卫颈部有獠牙痕迹，很可能是在他被杀后不久留下的。

PC也可以尝试一次DC 20察觉检定来检查房间。
成功：他们发现窗边的地板微微潮湿。
DC 20自然检定或生存检定表明潮湿是因为窗户曾短暂打开，让雪飘入后融化；赫德文使用念力之手打开窗户，在房间内外出入。

Treasure: Underneath a table is an onyx idol of 
Urgathoa worth 10 gp. 
Reward: If the PCs discover the grave time talisman, 
award them 30 XP. Award them an additional 30 XP 
if they discover either the presence of onyx or identify

Inquiry: Hedvend’s Body
Hedvend’s body was taken to his private quarters, 
where it was laid on his bed. A single Hellknight 
stands guard at the ornate double doors that lead 
into the room, but she allows the PCs to enter freely. 
Unfortunately, the PCs’ efforts to examine the body 
are doomed to failure: Hedvend’s body is missing!
Thick velvet maroon curtains cover the walls and 
a bearskin rug covers the floor of this luxurious 
grand bedroom. A glaive seemingly made of 
folded silver hangs as a trophy above the fireplace, 
where flames dance in a cold breeze. A drift of snow 
and a melting puddle both grow beneath an open 
window. Against the southern wall, a neatly made 
canopy bed shows no sign of an occupant except for a 
slight indent in the heavy quilt.
A closer examination of the scene reveals what 
appears to be a few handfuls of dirt scattered across 
the bed. PCs who investigate the dirt can attempt a 
DC 20 Nature check. On a success, they recognize it 
as freshly dug soil, likely from the manor grounds; a 
requirement for the steward’s vampiric awakening. 
Upon awakening as undead, Hedvend VI escaped 
out the window, which he left open. (A PC can 
attempt a DC 20 Nature or Survival check to realize 
the snow and puddle indicate the window was 
opened only recently).
In addition to the clues above that PCs can see 
with no real difficulty, they can Search the room. If 
their check exceeds the DC listed below, they discover 
additional clues:
•	 DC 20: The rug also has dirt on it, as if it were 
tracked into the room at some point. (If they 
choose to investigate it, see the Soiled Sheets 
Inquiry on page 91.)
•	 DC 22: Small scratches on the floor against the 
western wall indicate a secret door leading into 
the suite’s boudoir (installed decades ago to allow 
discrete assignations).
•	 DC 30: The tracks on the rug clearly were made 
by a Small creature wearing shoes. It appears 
whoever made them came in from the secret door 
in the west, moved to the bed, then turned around 
and retraced their steps.
The Hellknight guard is shocked if the PCs inform 
her that Hedvend’s body is missing and rushes in 
to verify the claim. Other than the PCs, she 
hasn’t seen anyone enter or exit since she was 
placed here to guard the body. She was unaware of 
the secret door and had no reason to think anyone 
could enter or exit Hedvend’s bedroom without 
her knowledge.
Treasure: A PC who Searched the room (DC 
20) discovers a hidden compartment with ledgers 
tracking bribes and corruption in and outside of the 
city. This ledger is worth 400 gp to the right people, 
though it might be worth even more to others. An 
astute PC also notices the glaive is a magical item, but 
the PCs won’t have the opportunity to claim 
it for themselves until Chapter 6.
Reward: If the PCs discover the tracks in 
Hedvend’s room, award them 30 XP.
Inquiry: Second Victim
One of the manor guards was searching for clues 
to Hedvend’s murder in the guest room when the 
vampire steward slipped in from outside and ripped 
out his throat before drinking as much of the guard’s 
blood as he could. When the PCs enter the room, read 
or paraphrase the following:
A small spray of blood covers the floor around a corpse in 
chain mail and the uniform of the manor guard. A frozen 
expression of shock remains on the man’s face above 
where his throat was brutally torn out.
A PC can attempt a Medicine check to examine the 
body. If their check exceeds the DC listed below, they 
learn the following:
•	 DC 18: It appears the guard’s throat was torn out 
by claws.
•	 DC 20: Based on the lack of any defensive wounds, 
the guard likely was taken by surprise.
•	 DC 22: There’s less blood than there should 
be based on the guard’s size. The spray looks 
like it came from the killing blow, but there’s a 
conspicuous lack of a pool of blood afterward.
•	 DC 25: The guard has fang marks on his neck, which 
likely were made moments after he was killed.
A PC can also attempt a DC 20 Perception check to 
examine the room. On a success, they discover the floor 
is slightly damp around the window A DC 20 Nature 
or Survival check indicates the dampness is because 
the window was opened briefly, allowing in snow that 
then melted; Hedvend moved in and out of the room by 
opening the window with telekinetic hand.

奖励：在此处，PC每发现一项线索，奖励30 XP；若他们得知关于尸体与敞开窗户的一切信息，最多可获得150 XP。

调查：私用餐厅
对PC而言是个好消息：埃齐奥是个精明的阴谋家，但莱夫拉内克的本事就差得多。她在私用餐厅里为那场伪造的“地狱破坏者”袭击做准备时，把她的魔鬼戏服和其他可指证她的物件都丢在了这里。只要搜查这间屋子（莱夫拉内克就是在这里把卫兵们带来以便支配），PC就能发现这些物品。

除了莱夫拉内克丢弃的魔鬼戏服外，PC还会找到12节彼此融合成一柱的椎骨。每一节椎骨都能独立旋转，其上以死灵语刻着若干字母。该装置是一种魔法转轮密码器，乌加索亚的代理人会用它来发送加密信息。最近的一条信息是：“把卫兵带去见一名披着我们最神圣颜色斗篷的仆役。等伊斯嘉落入她手，伊尔凯娜将奖赏你。”
• PC在DC 15医疗检定成功，则认出这些椎骨属于人类脊柱的一部分。
• PC在DC 20制作或社交检定以回忆知识成功，则认出该装置是一种用于编码与解码信息的转轮密码器。
• PC在DC 20宗教检定以回忆知识成功，则认出该转轮密码器是乌加索亚代理人使用的工具。
• PC可以尝试DC 20奥术、自然、宗教或神秘检定以辨识魔法。如此做会使其在进行社交检定以破译文字时获得+2环境加值；若大成功则为+4。

最后，PC可以尝试DC 25社交检定以破译文字；成功时，他们能破译出足够内容，从而理解其中包含一名乌加索亚信徒给收信人的指示：把同僚卫兵带到餐厅里一名披红斗篷的男子面前；并且该阴谋由名为“伊尔凯娜”的人策划，她意图掌控这个国家。

宝藏：莱夫拉内克留在桌上的有一盘腐梦拼盘（见199页）以及一把骷髅钥匙。
奖励：若PC至少在一次检定中成功，从而了解到乌加索亚转轮密码器的相关信息，奖励30 XP。若他们破译文字并得知信息内容，额外奖励80 XP。

调查：弄脏的床单（中等5）
若PC察觉到赫德文卧室或更衣室里的脏脚印，他们可能想要跟踪这些痕迹；他们可以尝试一次DC 20生存检定以追踪（若大成功，他们能看出足够细节，以确定泥土来自一名穿鞋且尾巴拖过泥地的小型生物）。痕迹从赫德文的卧室出发，穿过暗门进入更衣室，随后沿走廊通往宅邸西侧的仆役楼梯间，最终从仆役入口通向室外的家族陵墓。

一座大型石质陵墓由柔和发光的恒光水晶照明；在飘落的雪中，这些光点几乎像在闪烁。修剪整齐的树篱、小树以及几尊树篱雕塑环绕着这处历代总管的历史安息之所，即便身处暴风雪中，也营造出一种宁静感。

使用92页的地图。冬季风暴使察觉检定与物理远程攻击承受–2环境减值，会熄灭手持火焰，并使距离超过30尺的生物处于隐蔽状态。积雪覆盖令整个区域成为困难地形。尽管PC调查时很可能是夜晚，但由于水晶的光芒在落雪上反射，以陵墓为中心60尺半径内为明亮光照（再往外延伸60尺为昏暗光照）。

生物：对PC不幸的是，埃齐奥对赫德文的袭击触发了宅邸的部分魔法防御。这些防御不会对宅邸仆役起反应，但PC并无此保护；三尊树篱雕塑会离开原位并发动攻击。它们会战斗到被摧毁为止。

PC可以尝试用DC 20交涉检定来搜集情报以找到那名仆从，用察觉检定来发现他们，或用生存检定来追踪。若成功，那名受惊的仆从坦白：有个披红斗篷、双眼燃烧的人命令他们去挖取陵墓外的泥土，并把泥土抹在赫德文的尸体上——当时尸体在卧室里。仆从记不起关于斗篷人的任何其他细节。

宝藏：PC在活体树篱雕像的残骸中发现一枝原初槲寄生。

奖励：若PC成功将土壤线索追查到仆从，给予他们30 XP。

调查：红斗篷
PC可能想找到埃齐奥在宴会中支配数人时所穿的红斗篷。不幸的是，他把它藏在闺房里莱齐妮娅的衣橱中。除非他们开始逐屋搜索，否则这条线索走入死胡同，反而会引发更多“夜半谋杀”事件，并让埃齐奥意识到PC知道斗篷一事且正在搜寻它。若PC不知怎地在埃齐奥的时间表之前找到了斗篷，他会在后续“莱齐妮娅离开了大楼”中提及此事。

阴谋加深
当PC展开调查时，宅邸内的事件并不会静止不动。大多数NPC焦虑地等待，但仍有一些人在宅邸里游荡，成为赫德文的猎物——要么为了满足其饥渴，要么遵照埃齐奥的指示。与此同时，埃齐奥努力掩盖自己的角色并制造混乱。这些事件大体上会按下列顺序发生，不过根据PC的行动以及你为了让故事对玩家更有吸引力的需要，有些事件可能需要提前或延后。

事件：埃齐奥介入
在本章开头看到凯托召来PC时，埃齐奥开始担忧，并决定必须亲自介入，以应对这项出乎意料的计划变数。他会在PC与凯托会面后、第一次从二楼下楼时接近他们，很可能发生在“伪地狱破坏者”或“取得泥土”调查期间。他扮演一名忧心的宾客，向PC询问正在发生什么。若PC在上一章对他产生过任何成功影响，他会表示愿意再次协助，提议自己凭借人脉为PC促成与其他宾客的对话，或提供PC所需的其他帮助。他试图在本章过程中随时掌握PC的动向，一边将他们引向自己想要的方向，一边尽可能破坏他们的调查。不过，他不会冒险尝试支配他们。

事件：夜半谋杀
赫德文再度出手，在宅邸里又杀死一人。此事件会在夜里多次发生，大约每隔一小时重复一次，直到PC发现凶手为止，从而增加PC调查的紧迫性，并可能缩小嫌疑人范围。从玩法角度看，此事件通常会在每完成1–2次调查后触发。若干目标是为削弱伊斯嘉而被挑选，另一些则只是赫德文饥渴下的随机受害者。埃齐奥安排的目标将按下列顺序死亡，其间夹杂不幸的卫兵与仆从。死亡地点与情境如下；而卫兵与仆从的尸体可出现在任何有通往室外许可的房间。
• 墨佩莉娅·卡拉福——埃齐奥的目标是终止她对伊斯嘉军队的支援——在画廊遇害。
• 弗里格大使——为防止与奥普拉克结盟的任何可能性而成为目标——在图书馆被杀。
• 萨斯托利·布伦克——其对码头的指挥促进伊斯嘉贸易——在厨房遇害（赫德文沿烟囱爬下）。
• 里瑟特上校——军中重要的后勤军官——在温室被杀。

PCs can attempt to find the servant with a DC 20 
Diplomacy check to Gather Information, Perception 
check to spot them, or Survival check to Track. If they 
succeed, the scared servant confesses that a person in 
a red cloak with burning eyes told them to go dig up 
the dirt from outside the mausoleum and put it on 
Hedvend’s body, which was in the bedroom at the 
time. The servant doesn’t remember any other details 
about the person in the cloak.
Treasure: The PCs discover a primeval mistletoe 
among the remains of the living topiaries.
Reward: Award the PCs 30 XP if they successfully

Inquiry: The Red Cloak
The PCs might want to find the red cloak that Ezio 
wore while dominating a number of people in the 
gala. Unfortunately, he hid it in Lezinia’s closet in the 
boudoir. Unless they begin a room-by-room search, 
this is a dead end, leading to more Murders in the 
Night events and making Ezio aware the PCs know 
about the cloak and are searching for it. Should the 
PCs somehow find it ahead of Ezio’s schedule, he 
brings it up later in Lezinia Has Left the Building.
The Plot Thickens
Events don’t remain static in the mansion as the PCs 
investigate. While most of the NPCs wait anxiously, 
some wander around the mansion, falling prey to 
Hedvend—either to sate his hunger or at Ezio’s 
instructions. Ezio, meanwhile, works to obfuscate his 
role and create confusion. The events likely occur in 
generally the following order, though some might need 
to happen sooner or later depending on what the PCs do 
and your needs to keep the story engaging for players.
EVENT: EZIO GETS INVOLVED
Ezio becomes concerned when he sees Caeto summon 
the PCs at the start of the chapter, and decides he needs 
to involve himself with this unexpected complication 
to his plans. He approaches them the first time they 
descend from the second floor after their meeting with 
Caeto, likely during the False Hellbreakers or Get the 
Dirt inquiry. He plays the role of concerned guest, 
asking PCs for information about what’s happening. 
If the PCs successfully influenced him at all during 
the previous chapter, he offers to help them again, 
suggesting he could facilitate any discussions with 
other guests thanks to his connections or anything 
else the PCs need. He attempts to keep tabs on the 
PCs throughout the course of this chapter, steering 
them in directions he wants while disrupting their 
investigation as much as possible. He doesn’t take the 
risk of attempting to Dominate them, however.
EVENT: MURDERS IN THE NIGHT
Hedvend strikes again, killing another person in the 
mansion. This event occurs multiple times over the 
course of the night, repeating every hour or so until 
the PCs discover the murderer(s), adding urgency to 
the PCs’ investigation and possibly narrowing their 
pool of suspects. In terms of gameplay, the event likely 
follows every 1–2 completed inquiries. While several 
of the targets are selected to weaken Isger, others are 
random victims of Hedvend’s hunger. Ezio’s targets 
are killed in the following order, interspersed with 
unfortunate guards and servants. The location and 
circumstances of the deaths are included below, while 
the guards and servants can be found in any room 
with access to outside.
•	 Merpelia Carafo, whom Ezio targets to end her 
support of Isger’s army, is murdered in the gallery.
•	 Ambassador Vrig, targeted to prevent any chance 
of an alliance with Oprak, is killed in the library.
•	 Sastoli Brunc, whose command of the docks 
facilitates Isger’s trade, is killed in the kitchen 
(Hedvend climbs down through the chimney).
•	 Colonel Rithert, an important logistics officer in 
the Army, in the conservatory.

## Page 94
用医疗检定检查尸体，会得到相同的结果，并发现其可能的死因似乎是失血过多。

第一次有具名目标被杀时，PC可以尝试DC 21的伊斯嘉学识检定或DC 23的社会检定以回忆知识，从而意识到这次死亡会对伊斯嘉政府造成额外打击。此后每有一个具名目标，DC降低1。每次有守卫或仆从死亡后，他们也可以以当前DC尝试同样的检定，从而意识到这些死者似乎不符合该模式，可能只是刚好出现在错误的地点与错误的时间。

想了解受害者在临终时行动或行为的PC，可以尝试一次交涉检定以打听消息。对无名的仆从或守卫，DC为20；成功会揭示他们当时行为正常、在做本职工作。对具名受害者，DC起始为25，之后每出现一个受害者就降低1。成功时，PC可以得知受害者最后一次被看见是在与埃齐奥说话。大成功时，PC得知他们似乎进行了一场非常激烈的交谈，期间有大量直视对方的目光交流，随后受害者仿佛只是转身走开、四处游荡。若PC与他对质，参见下文“事件：不在场攻击”以及“真相大白”（第94页）中埃齐奥的反应。

在弗里格大使死亡之后，以及之后每一次死亡后，PC可以尝试DC 20的建筑学识或DC 22的制造检定以回忆知识，从而意识到每一次死亡都发生在有通向室外的窗户的房间里，或发生在有烟囱的房间里。

发展：如果PC意识到所有死亡都发生在具有通向室外的许可的房间中，他们就可以警告宾客避开这些房间。这会阻止该事件的任何进一步重演。

奖励：如果PC得知这些死亡中有任何一例是意在伤害伊斯嘉政府，则奖励他们30XP。如果他们得知埃齐奥与任一受害者的交谈，则额外奖励30XP。如果PC警告舞会宾客远离那些有通向室外许可的房间，则奖励他们80XP。

事件：不在场攻击
PC可能会在本章早期就对埃齐奥起疑，尤其是当他们在“夜半凶案”事件中发现有人看见他与某位被赫德文杀死的具名受害者交谈。如果他们试图询问或对质他，他就会触发该事件。

允许PC与埃齐奥进行一次简短互动；他会否认自己对当夜事件负有责任。即便他正与PC交谈，他也会通过心灵感应命令赫德文前往仆役会客室（区域I11），并杀死他在那里见到的第一个生物（若PC恰好在仆役会客室内，则杀戮发生在楼上储藏室外）。随后，PC的质询会被打断：如果他们靠近凶案现场，就会听见尖叫；否则就是一名仆从惊慌失措地赶来通报。

不同于埃齐奥策划的大多数谋杀，这一次由于仓促，留下了目击者：不幸的奥顿·荨木刷。他语无伦次地说，有什么东西正试图吃掉那名如今倒在地上、血流不止的人类女子。PC可以尝试用DC 20的交涉或医疗，或DC 22的威吓检定使他镇定下来。若成功，奥顿含泪承认，那东西看起来像赫德文；在他尖叫后，那东西就慌忙爬到室外（要么是从门出去；若袭击发生在楼上，则从窗户出去）。

发展：若PC回去继续与埃齐奥的对话，他会试图引导他们得出结论：既然他一直在PC面前而期间又发生了另一桩谋杀，那么他不可能是凶手——但他不会把这话直接说出口。若PC继续紧咬不放，他会触发“事件：莱齐尼娅离开建筑”（第94页），谜团随即进入终局。

事件：消灭害虫 低危5
随着PC调查推进，他们对埃齐奥的计划构成越来越大的威胁，于是他决定除掉他们。该事件应发生在他第一次接近PC之后的某个时间点——很可能是在他们又完成了一两项调查，并可能已发现线索指向里维斯雷斯特存在吸血鬼（特征），但尚未确定其存在时。它可以发生在庄园内任何地点，但你可能想选一个PC不常去（且之前未发生过战斗）的区域，如温室、一楼餐厅、画廊或图书馆。

危害：埃齐奥从城镇周边召来夜行生物，指使它们杀死PC。这些生物以一个危害来表现，它们通过地基与烟囱进入建筑，并一路逼近PC。该危害占据此次遭遇发生的整间房间。

Medicine check to examine the body reveals the 
same, and that the likely cause of death appears to be 
exsanguination.
The first time a named target is killed, the PCs can 
attempt a DC 21 Isger Lore check or DC 23 Society 
check to Recall Knowledge to realize the death would 
be an additional blow to Isger’s government. For each 
subsequent named target, reduce the DC by 1. They 
can attempt the same check, at the current DC, after 
each guard or servant’s death to realize that they don’t 
seem to fit the pattern, and could have simply been in 
the wrong place at the wrong time.
A PC who wants to learn more about a victim’s 
actions or behavior in their final moments can attempt 
a Diplomacy check to Gather Information. The DC 
for an unnamed servant or guard is 20, with a success 
revealing they were acting normally and doing their 
job. The DC for a named victim begins at 25, and goes 
down by 1 for each subsequent victim. On a success, 
PCs can learn that the victim was last seen speaking 
with Ezio. On a critical success, PCs learn that they 
seemed to be having an intense conversation with a 
lot of direct eye contact, before the victim seemed 
to just turn and wander away. See Event: The Alibi 
Attack (below) and The Jig Is Up (page 94) for Ezio’s 
reactions if they confront him.
After Ambassador Vrig’s death, and each subsequent 
death, a PC can attempt a DC 20 Architecture Lore or 
DC 22 Crafting check to Recall Knowledge to realize 
the each death is occurring in a room with a window 
to the outside, or in a room that has a chimney.
Development: If the PCs realize all the deaths are in 
rooms with access to outside, they can warn guests to 
avoid them. This prevents any further reoccurrences 
of this event.
Reward: If the PCs learn any of the deaths are 
intended to harm the Isgeri government, award them 
30 XP. If they learn of Ezio’s conversations with any 
of the victims, award them an additional 30 XP. If the 
PCs warn gala guests to stay out of rooms with access 
to the outdoors, award them 80 XP.
EVENT: THE ALIBI ATTACK
It’s possible the PCs become suspicious of Ezio early in 
this chapter, likely if they discover he was seen talking 
with a named victim of Hedvend in a Murders in the 
Night event. If they attempt to question or confront 
him, he triggers this event. Allow the PCs to have a 
brief interaction with Ezio, who rejects any allegations 
of culpability in the night’s events. Even as he talks to 
the PCs, he telepathically commands Hedvend to go to 
the servants’ parlor (area I11) and kill the first creature 
he sees there (if the PCs happen to be in the servants’ 
parlor, the killing takes place outside the upstairs 
storeroom). The PCs’ questioning is then interrupted 
either by a scream if they’re near the murder scene or 
the panicked arrival of a servant.
Unlike most of the murders Ezio orchestrates, 
the hurried nature of this one leaves a witness: the 
unfortunate Otton Nettlebrush. He babbles that 
something was trying to eat the human woman who 
now lies dead and bleeding on the floor. A PC can 
attempt to calm him down with a DC 20 Diplomacy 
or Medicine or a DC 22 Intimidation check. If they 
succeed, Otton tearfully admits it looked like Hedvend 
before it scrambled outside when he screamed (either 
through the door or, if the attack occurred upstairs, 
through the window).
Development: If the PCs return to the conversation 
with Ezio, he attempts to lead them to the conclusion 
that he can’t be responsible since there was another 
killing while he was in their presence without outright 
saying so. If the PCs press the issue, he triggers Event: 
Lezinia Has Left the Building (page 94), and the 
mystery moves into its end game.
EVENT: EXTERMINATE THE PESTS	
LOW 5
As the PCs’ investigation progresses, they increasingly 
threaten Ezio’s plan and he decides to eliminate them. 
This event should occur sometime after he approaches 
the PCs for the first time, likely after they have 
completed one or two more inquiries and might have 
discovered signs that point to a vampire in Reevesrest 
but not yet be certain of its presence. It can take place 
anywhere in the manor, but you might want to choose 
an area where the PCs haven’t spent much time (and 
haven’t had a fight before), such as the conservatory, 
downstairs dining room, gallery, or library.
Hazard: Ezio summons creatures of the night from 
the city environs, directing them to kill the PCs. The 
creatures, which are represented as a hazard, enter the 
building through the foundations and chimneys and 
make their way to the PCs. The hazard occupies the 
entire room where this encounter occurs.

## Page 95
房间内的每个生物必须在DC 24强韧豁免中成功，否则陷入恶心1（大失败则为恶心2）。随后该危害掷先攻。

常规（1行动）蝙蝠与老鼠啃咬房间内所有生物，造成2d8+3穿刺伤害（DC 24基础反射豁免）。失败时，该生物还会受到3点持续流血伤害。

发展：在PC们击败虫群后，他们可以尝试一次DC 22宗教检定以回忆知识。成功时，他们知道某些吸血鬼可以召唤这类生物，并在其位于100尺内时与其进行心灵感应交流，这意味着其几乎肯定就在庄园的某处。大成功时，他们还知道只有更强大的吸血鬼才具备此类能力，而且这类生物也很可能能化为雾气，并支配心智较弱的生物。

事件：费茜的恐惧（低危 5）

埃齐奥的应急计划涉及嫁祸莱茵齐娅，但他也足够狡猾，会试图同时清除一个对他潜在的威胁、以及PC们可能的支援来源：费茜。他派遣被支配的切利亚斯歌姬去建议费茜找个安全的地方休息、恢复精神。莱茵齐娅还给了她一张召唤天界生物的卷轴，声称这是她在切利亚斯弄到的，以防恶魔攻击。实际上这张卷轴来自埃齐奥，并被伊尔凯娜的战晶污染了。

惊恐的侏儒牧师躲进了私宴厅，在那里她把门反锁，精疲力竭地沉沉睡去。

理想情况下，此事件发生在PC们在一场战斗后寻找费茜为他们治疗的时候。一名仆从会告知他们，费茜不久前去了二楼的私宴厅（区域I20）。如果PC们不需要费茜的帮助，则此事件发生在“消灭害虫”之后、但在赫德文杀害里瑟特上校之前。一名仆从怯生生地接近PC们，表达对费茜的担忧——他看到费茜进了私宴厅，却一直没有出来。

门被锁住了，但PC可以通过三次成功的DC 20盗贼检定打开它，或以一次成功的DC 20运动检定强行破门。无论哪种方式，声响都会把费茜惊醒，她会在PC们打开门的同时迅速施放卷轴，召唤出一只格诺凯什。

生物：受战晶污染的卷轴灌注的战斗嗜血驱使，格诺凯什将PC们视为威胁并发起攻击，斥骂他们是恶魔崇拜者。即便没有被维持，它也会持续战斗直至被杀死，并无视任何试图唤醒其真实本性、或尝试让它停手或解除它的努力。

精英格诺凯什 生物6
《Pathfinder 怪物 Core 2》6、36页
先攻 察觉+17

发展：战斗结束后，费茜含泪道歉。如果她的神圣泉源中还有任何治愈法术剩余，她坚持要用它们为任何受伤的PC治疗。她告知众人，是莱茵齐娅建议她找个安全处休息，并给了她那张卷轴用来自保。

PC还可以尝试一次DC 20宗教检定以辨识魔法。成功时，他们会认出该卷轴似乎被以某种方式污染了，以至于它所召唤出的天界生物会暴怒。如果PC们质问莱茵齐娅，她记得自己是在切利亚斯得到这张卷轴，但想不起细节。一次DC 20察觉检定以察觉动机会揭示她记忆的缺失并不寻常；她并没有成功到“得到这种卷轴”会是无足轻重的小事。大成功时，PC会意识到她的记忆被魔法篡改了（但不会意识到她目前仍处于被支配状态）。

宝藏：作为把格诺凯什引到他们身上的道歉，费茜坚持让PC们收下她的次级生命灵药与奇妙小模型（马），以作补偿。

骗局败露
当他们完成所有询问时，PC们应当对吸血鬼活动有强烈怀疑。他们很可能已经知道赫德文是被吸血鬼杀死的，被转化成了吸血鬼，并在过去数小时里杀死了许多人。有些PC可能会优先寻找赫德文，但埃齐奥试图把他们的注意力转向莱茵齐娅。

事件：莱茵齐娅离开大楼（中危 5）

此事件标志着终局的开始。如果PC们质问埃齐奥，而他的“不在场攻击”未能把注意力从他身上转移开，他就会触发该事件。否则，它应发生在PC们完成所有可用询问之后，或在赫德文杀害里瑟特上校之后。在埃齐奥的心灵感应催促下，莱茵齐娅高声表示，她并不需要为了这场调查继续待着——
