EVENT: FESSY’S FEAR
LOW 5
Ezio’s contingency plan involves implicating Lezinia, 
but he’s cunning enough to also try to remove a 
potential threat to himself and source of support for 
the PCs: Fessy. He sends the dominated Chelaxian 
diva to suggest that Fessy find somewhere safe to rest 
and refresh. Lezinia also provides her with a scroll to 
summon a celestial that she claims she acquired in 
Cheliax in case of devil attack. In truth the scroll is from 
Ezio, and it’s tainted by Illcayna’s warshard. The scared 
gnome cleric hides in the private dining room, where 
she locks the door and falls into an exhausted sleep.
This event ideally occurs if the PCs look for Fessy to 
help heal them following a battle. A servant informs 
them that she went to the private dining room on 
the second floor (area I20) a short while ago. If the 
PCs don’t need Fessy’s help, this event occurs after 
Exterminate the Pests but before Colonel Rithert’s 
murder by Hedvend. A servant timidly approaches the 
PCs to express concern about Fessy after seeing her go 
into the private dining room and never emerge.
The door is locked, but a PC can open it with three 
successful DC 20 Thievery checks or Force it Open 
with a successful DC 20 Athletics check. In either 
case, the noise startles Fessy awake and she quickly 
casts from the scroll, summoning a gnokesh just as 
the PCs open the door.
Creatures: Filled with battle lust by the warshard-
tainted scroll, the gnokesh takes the PCs for threats 
and attacks, castigating them as devil worshippers. 
It continues fighting until slain, despite not being 
sustained, and ignores any attempts to appeal to 
its true nature or attempts to stop or 
Dismiss it.
ELITE GNOKESH	
CREATURE 6
Pathfinder Monster Core 2 6, 36
Initiative Perception +17
Development: Following the fight, Fessy 
tearfully apologizes. If she has any heal 
spells remaining in her divine font, she insists 
on using them to heal any injured PCs. 
She informs them that Lezinia suggested 
she find a safe spot to rest and gave her 
the scroll to protect herself. A PC can 
also attempt a DC 20 Religion check 
to Identify Magic. On a success, 
they recognize that the scroll appears 
to have been tainted somehow so that the 
celestial it summoned was enraged.
If the PCs question Lezinia, she remembers getting 
the scroll in Cheliax, but doesn’t recall details. A DC 
20 Perception check to Sense Motive reveals her lack 
of memory seems unusual; she’s not so successful that 
getting such a scroll would be a small matter. On a 
critical success, a PC realizes her memory has been 
magically tampered with (though not that she’s still 
currently dominated).
Treasure: As an apology for setting the gnokesh 
on them, Fessy insists the PCs take her lesser elixir 
of life and marvelous miniature (horse) to make up 
for it.
The Jig Is Up
By the time they have completed all the inquiries,

activity. They likely know that Hedvend was killed 
by a vampire, turned into one himself, and killed a 
number of people in the last few hours. Some PCs 
might prioritize finding Hedvend, but Ezio tries to 
turn their attention to Lezinia.

……继续追问她在这次调查中也会不耐烦，还会质问谁敢这么对她！她怒气冲冲地从正门冲出去，却正好撞上在庄园围墙巡逻的奥罗坎。惊恐足以短暂打破埃齐奥对她的控制，她转身逃回庄园，守卫们紧追不舍。

生物：当奥罗坎发起攻击时，莱齐妮娅飞奔躲到PC们身后。它会战斗到被摧毁，或PC们说服它相信他们并非试图逃跑为止。

弱化奥罗坎（WEAK AUROCAN） 生物7
《Pathfinder 怪物 Core 7》，第223页
先攻 察觉+14；黑暗视觉

多疑的歌姬：战斗结束后，凯托命令惊恐的歌姬回到闺房，并宣布未经他明确许可，任何人不得进入或离开那间房间。一位神情忧虑的埃齐奥走近与他自称“关系最好”的那名PC，表达他对莱齐妮娅的怀疑。

如果埃齐奥得知PC们已经注意到他今晚早些时候穿过的红斗篷（他把它藏在莱齐妮娅的衣橱里），他会建议他们搜查她的房间。若PC们听从建议，一名守卫坚持表示没有凯托陪同他们不能进入。PC们提出请求后，凯托会加入他们。

这一幕以莱齐妮娅——在埃齐奥的控制下——最终“坦白”自己杀死了赫德文而告终，但具体如何展开取决于PC们的动作。若他们进门就指控她，她会立刻坦白；若他们想先搜查房间，她会闹别扭似地允许。进行一次DC 10 察觉检定以搜查房间，可发现一件红斗篷在莱齐妮娅衣橱深处团成一团，裹着数件魔法物品；若大成功，PC会意识到这斗篷本可以藏在许多地方，那些地方会让它更难被找到。

一旦PC们指控她——或他们打算不指控就离开——莱齐妮娅就会以戏剧化的方式坦白。宣读或转述以下内容：

“好吧。”莱齐妮娅忽然宣布，“你们抓到我了！是我干的！我杀了那个可憎的老东西！他答应会娶我，让我成为伊斯嘉的王后。今晚本该是为了这个——我们的订婚！可后来他说他不打算这么做；当他仍不肯同意娶我时，我就杀了他！之后发生了什么我不知道！”她随即崩溃痛哭。

由于这份坦白纯属幻想，莱齐妮娅几乎给不出更多细节，也无法说明她“本该如何”杀死赫德文。她声称自己拿走那些物品是因为他欠她的，就随手用找到的第一件斗篷把它们包起来。

若某名PC心存怀疑，可以进行DC 20 察觉检定以洞悉动机。成功则得知莱齐妮娅的表现并不正常；大成功则揭示她肯定正受到魔法控制。

无论PC们如何反应，凯托都对这突如其来的坦白以及莱齐妮娅能实施如此缜密的谋杀的能力感到怀疑。他坚持要PC们想办法测试她是否为吸血鬼，但如果他们别无他法，他会说应该去厨房拿一份剩下的焦糖蒜味挞，用它来测试她。

提到大蒜，是在呼应第4章（第81页）的“不要，谢谢咬一口”事件，指向埃齐奥真实身份为吸血鬼；GM若觉得玩家忘了那一幕，可能想提醒他们，但先给他们自行联想到这一点的机会。或者，凯托也可能质问他们为何会怀疑莱齐妮娅，从而把线索再次引向埃齐奥。

无论PC们用何种方式检验她是否为吸血鬼，莱齐妮娅都会“未通过”测试，但她仍持续宣称自己有罪。PC可以通过一次DC 20 交涉或威吓检定，说服她自己并非吸血鬼或凶手。若成功，莱齐妮娅会困惑自己为何会坦白。她承认自己说的都不是真的；她与赫德文确实有过关系，但他从未向她承诺过任何事，不过她也无法解释其他情况。

宝藏：若PC们说服莱齐妮娅她并非凶手，她会以赫德文赠予她的珠宝（价值200 gp）作为奖励，并交出那件斗篷所裹的更强低语金属丝（greater whispering wire，第212页）与启示之油（oil of revelation）。

奖励：若PC们说服莱齐妮娅她不是杀人凶手，奖励PC们30 XP。若他们在这次调查后把线索拼凑起来并意识到埃齐奥有罪，再额外奖励80 XP。

调查：追猎赫德文VI（Hunting for Hedvend VI） 严峻5
当PC们意识到吸血鬼化的赫德文正在宅邸里徘徊时，他们的第一反应可能是设下陷阱引他现身，或主动追猎。凯托会放手让他们任选其一，但他拒绝参与。他表示对PC们能力的信心，同时也忙于确保这次对庄园的袭击并非对艾利迪尔发动全面突袭的地狱破城者攻击的前兆。

WEAK AUROCAN
CREATURE 7
Pathfinder Monster Core 7, page 223
Initiative Perception +14; darkvision
Suspicious Diva: Following the 
fight, Caeto orders the terrified 
singer back to the boudoir and 
declares that no one may enter or 
leave that room without his express 
permission. 
A 
concerned-looking 
Ezio approaches the PC, with whom he 
says he has the best relationship, and voices his 
suspicions of Lezinia.
If Ezio is aware the PCs learned about the red 
cloak he wore earlier in the evening (which he hid in 
Lezinia’s closet), he suggests they search her room If 
the PCs follow his advice, a guard insists they can’t 
enter without Caeto accompanying him. Caeto joins 
them at their request.
This scene concludes with Lezinia—under Ezio’s 
control—ultimately confessing to killing Hedvend, 
but how exactly that plays out depends on the PCs’ 
actions. If they come in and accuse her, she confesses 
immediately. If they instead want to search the 
room, she petulantly allows it. A DC 10 Perception 
check to search the room reveals a red cloak balled 
up around several magical items in the back of 
Lezinia’s closet; on a critical success, the PC realizes 
there were a number of places it could have been 
hidden that would have made it far more difficult 
to find.
Once the PCs accuse her—or if they go to leave 
without doing so—Lezinia confesses in dramatic 
fashion. Read or paraphrase the following:
“Fine,” Lezinia suddenly declares. “You caught me! I did it! 
I killed that miserable old man! He promised me he would 
marry me and make me queen of Isger. That’s what tonight 
was supposed to be about, our engagement! But then he 
said he wasn’t going to do it; when he still wouldn’t agree 
to marry me, I killed him! I don’t know what happened 
afterward!” She breaks down in sobs.
Because the confession is pure fantasy, Lezinia has 
few other details she’s able to give the PCs and can’t 
say how she supposedly killed Hedvend. She 
claims she took the items because he owed 
them to her and wrapped it in the first 
cloak she found.
If a PC is suspicious, they can attempt a 
DC 20 Perception check to Sense Motive. 
On a success, they know Lezinia isn’t acting 
normally, while a critical success reveals she’s 
certainly being magically controlled.
Regardless of the PCs’ reactions, 
Caeto is suspicious of the unexpected 
confession and Lezinia’s ability to pull 
off such a calculated murder. He 
insists the PCs find some way to 
test if she is a vampire, but if they 
don’t have any other options, he 
says they should go get a leftover 
caramelized garlic tart from 
the kitchen and test her with that. 
The reference to garlic calls back to the No Thank You 
Bite event in Chapter 4 (page 81), pointing to Ezio’s 
true status as a vampire; GMs might want to remind 
players of that moment if they’ve forgotten, but give 
them a chance to make the connection themselves first. 
Alternatively, Caeto could question why they suspected 
Lezinia, also directing them back toward Ezio.
Lezinia fails whatever test the PCs attempt to 
determine whether she’s a vampire, but she continues 
to proclaim her guilt. A PC can convince her that she’s 
not a vampire or a murderer with a DC 20 Diplomacy 
or Intimidation check. If they are successful, Lezinia 
is confused about why she confessed. She admits that 
nothing she said is true; she and Hedvend were in a 
relationship but he hadn’t promised her anything, but 
can’t explain anything else.
Treasure: If the PCs persuade Lezinia that she was 
not the killer, she rewards them with 200 gp in jewelry 
gifted to her by Hedvend and the greater whispering 
wire (page 212) and oil of revelation that were 
wrapped with the cloak.
Reward: Award the PCs 30 XP if they persuade 
Lezinia that she is not a murderer. Award an additional 
80 XP if they put the pieces together and realize Ezio’s 
guilt after this inquiry.

## Page 97
【神智清醒的歌姬】
如果PC察觉到莱齐妮娅正受某种控制并成功驱散了魔法，那么她有很小的几率不再被埃齐奥支配。在这种情况下，她不会招供，而是把黑曜石护目镜交给PC作为拯救她性命的报酬，并自动让他们看到衣橱里的红斗篷（如果他们搜查房间，也可能会发现它）。

……在对PC能力更有信心的同时，他也仍忙于确保庄园里的袭击并非一次针对埃利迪尔的全面突袭“破狱者”行动的前奏。

【设置陷阱】在“夜间谋杀”事件之后，如果PC得知赫德文正在杀害对伊斯嘉政府重要的人物，并且他的杀戮都发生在可通往户外的房间里，那么他们已经掌握了设置陷阱所需的一切信息；他们只缺诱饵。他们可以通过一次成功的DC 20外交检定以搜集信息，或社交检定以回忆知识，来判断谁适合充当“引诱的诱马”——成功会揭示，“夜间谋杀”事件中仍健在的任何一名已点名的受害者都很适合担任该角色，伦塞洛斯·阿兹里也同样适合。大成功则揭示费茜也可以作为选项。

接下来的挑战是说服诱饵扮演这个角色。PC可以通过一次成功的DC 20欺瞒检定来尝试骗对方独自进入PC的伏击地点；或通过DC 22外交检定来尝试说服；或通过DC 24威吓检定来尝试强迫。如果PC试图让费茜当诱饵，她会自动同意帮忙。

一旦拥有潜在的受害者，PC可以在里夫斯雷斯特选择他们想要的任何伏击地点，但不能选大厅，因为那里仍然人满为患。允许他们进行任何他们想做的准备。准备就绪后，他们可以每15分钟尝试一次DC 6纯骰检定；若成功，赫德文进入房间并发动攻击。

【追捕凶手】PC一旦意识到赫德文很可能在庄园外、两次谋杀之间潜伏，可能会想去寻找他的踪迹，但外头的暴风雪让这件事变得困难。如果他们坚持不懈，PC可以通过一次成功的DC 25生存检定以追踪，将他一路追到陵寝的屋顶。若他们成功，这场战斗很可能会因环境而更加困难。尽管很可能仍是夜晚，陵寝周围60尺半径范围内由于长明晶体的光照反射在坠落的雪花上，而处于明亮光照（再向外60尺为昏暗光照）。冬季风暴会对察觉检定与物理远程攻击施加–2环境减值，会熄灭手持火焰（如火把或蜡烛），并使距离超过30尺的生物处于隐蔽。积雪覆盖使整个区域成为困难地形。

【埃齐奥的介入】当PC面对赫德文时，埃齐奥已经完全意识到他们对他——更重要的是对伊尔凯娜的计划——构成的威胁。考虑到这场遭遇的隐秘性质，他将其视为消灭PC并把责任推给赫德文的机会。如果你认为在PC面对赫德文之前，埃齐奥还没有理由相信PC在怀疑他，那么他会改为在当晚稍后与他们一对一交锋。

当PC意识到埃齐奥才是最初的凶手并一直在晚宴周边操纵事件后，他们可能比起赫德文更担心埃齐奥。他们可以自行选择在何处、以何种方式安排任何对峙，并进行必要的准备。若PC与他对峙，埃齐奥起初否认一切责任，但当PC摆出全部证据后，他最终会承认自己已输。

如果PC在追捕赫德文之前就与埃齐奥对峙，埃齐奥会微笑着称赞PC的调查工作，并承认若不是他们插手，他很可能已经逍遥法外。“让那些崇拜恶魔的人和叛军去打吧，”他说，“最后，当他们倒下时，我们的不死军队将因他们的鲜血与尸体而饱餐，我们将为苍白公主收复这片土地！我们的资源不必再用来供养他人。伊斯嘉将属于伊斯嘉与乌加索娅！”

【生物】赫德文VI被饥饿吞噬，会战斗至被摧毁为止。如果PC用某个NPC做诱饵来设置陷阱，该角色会在战斗第一轮开始时逃离。埃齐奥在战斗第二轮开始时掷先攻，并在该轮以他的先攻顺序加入战斗。他从庄园内部的一扇门进入，必要时使用他的“变化形态”能力。埃齐奥清楚：若他没能杀光所有PC就会暴露；同时他也期待自己的“疫病之云”能力能维系他的不死存在，因此会战斗直到生命值降至0。若埃齐奥未参与这场战斗，它将变成一场琐碎遭遇。

埃齐奥会战斗直到生命值降至0，并完全指望能借由疫病之云复苏。若赫德文VI尚未被摧毁，埃齐奥会召唤这位吸血鬼管家来援助他。为赫德文VI掷先攻；他将在1d3轮后抵达；如果战斗发生在……

confidence in the PCs’ abilities while at the same time 
remaining busy making sure the attack in the manor 
isn’t a prelude to a full-scale surprise Hellbreaker 
attack on Elidir.
Setting a Trap: Following the Murders in the 
Night event, if the PCs learn that Hedvend is killing 
people important to the Isgeri government and 
that his killings all occur in rooms with access to 
the outdoors, they have all the information they 
need to set a trap; all they require is bait. They 
can determine who would make sense to use as a 
stalking horse with a successful DC 20 Diplomacy 
check to Gather Information or Society check to 
Recall Knowledge—a success reveals that any of the 
still-living named victims from the Murders in the 
Night event would serve well in that role, as would 
Rencelos Azri. A critical success reveals that Fessy 
would also be an option.
The next challenge is persuading the bait to play 
the role. A PC can do so with a successful DC 20 
Deception check to try to trick them into going alone 
into the PC’s ambush site, a DC 22 Diplomacy check 
to try to persuade them, or a DC 24 Intimidation 
check to try to make them. If the PCs attempt to get 
Fessy to be the bait, she automatically agrees to help.
Once they have a potential victim, the PCs can 
choose any Reevesrest location they want for the 
ambush other than the great room, which remains 
crowded. Allow them to make any preparations they 
want. Once they’re ready, they can attempt a DC 6 
flat check every 15 minutes; on a success, Hedvend 
enters the room and attacks.
Pursuing the Killer: The PCs might want to look 
for Hedvend’s tracks once they realize he’s likely 
hiding outside between murders in the manor but 
the snowstorm outside makes this difficult. If they 
persevere, the PCs can track him to the roof of the 
mausoleum with a successful DC 25 Survival check to 
Track. If they’re successful, the conditions are likely 
to make this a more difficult fight. Although it’s likely 
still nighttime, the area in a 60-foot radius around 
the mausoleum is in bright light (and then dim light 
for another 60 feet) due to the everlight crystals’ light 
reflecting on falling snow. The winter storm imposes 
a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and 
physical ranged attacks, snuffs handheld flames (such 
as from a torch or candle), and makes creatures 
concealed if they’re more than 30 feet away. The 
snow cover makes the entire area difficult terrain.
Ezio’s Involvement: By the time the PCs face 
Hedvend, Ezio is fully aware of the threat they 
pose to him and, more importantly, Illcayna’s plans. 
Considering the secluded nature of this encounter, he 
sees it as an opportunity to eliminate the PCs and 
blame it on Hedvend. If you feel that Ezio wouldn’t 
have reason to think the PCs are suspicious of him by 
the time they face Hedvend, he’ll instead face them 
one-on-one later in the evening.
The PCs might be more concerned with Ezio than 
Hedvend once they realize that he’s the original killer 
and manipulating events around he gala. They can 
choose where and how to stage any confrontation, 
making any necessary preparations. If the PCs 
confront him, Ezio initially denies any responsibility 
but finally acknowledges he’s lost once the PCs lay 
out all their evidence.
If the PCs confront Ezio before hunting down 
Hedvend, Ezio smiles and compliments the PCs on 
their investigative work, acknowledging that he 
would likely have gotten away with it if it weren’t 
for them. “Let the devil worshippers and the rebels 
fight,” he says. “In the end when they fall, our undead 
army will grow fat with their blood and bodies, and 
we will reclaim this land for the Pallid Princess! No 
more will our resources go to feed others. Isger will 
be for Isger and Urgathoa!”
Creatures: Hedvend VI, consumed with hunger, 
fights until destroyed. If the PCs used an NPC as bait 
to set a trap, that character flees at the start of the 
first round of combat. Ezio rolls initiative at the start 
of the second round of combat and joins the fight at 
his initiative spot in that round. He enters through 
a door from the manor interior, using his Change 
Shape ability if necessary. Fully cognizant that he will 
be exposed if he doesn’t kill all the PCs and expecting 
that his Cloud of Plague ability will preserve his 
unlife, Ezio fights until reduced to 0 HP. If Ezio isn’t 
involved in this fight, it becomes a trivial encounter.

confidence in the PCs’ abilities while at the same time remaining busy making sure the attack in the manor isn’t a prelude to a full-scale surprise Hellbreaker attack on Elidir.

Setting a Trap: Following the Murders in the Night event, if the PCs learn that Hedvend is killing people important to the Isgeri government and that his killings all occur in rooms with access to the outdoors, they have all the information they need to set a trap; all they require is bait. They can determine who would make sense to use as a stalking horse with a successful DC 20 Diplomacy check to Gather Information or Society check to Recall Knowledge—a success reveals that any of the still-living named victims from the Murders in the Night event would serve well in that role, as would Rencelos Azri. A critical success reveals that Fessy would also be an option.

The next challenge is persuading the bait to play the role. A PC can do so with a successful DC 20 Deception check to try to trick them into going alone into the PC’s ambush site, a DC 22 Diplomacy check to try to persuade them, or a DC 24 Intimidation check to try to make them. If the PCs attempt to get Fessy to be the bait, she automatically agrees to help.

Once they have a potential victim, the PCs can choose any Reevesrest location they want for the ambush other than the great room, which remains crowded. Allow them to make any preparations they want. Once they’re ready, they can attempt a DC 6 flat check every 15 minutes; on a success, Hedvend enters the room and attacks.

Pursuing the Killer: The PCs might want to look for Hedvend’s tracks once they realize he’s likely hiding outside between murders in the manor but the snowstorm outside makes this difficult. If they persevere, the PCs can track him to the roof of the mausoleum with a successful DC 25 Survival check to Track. If they’re successful, the conditions are likely to make this a more difficult fight. Although it’s likely still nighttime, the area in a 60-foot radius around the mausoleum is in bright light (and then dim light for another 60 feet) due to the everlight crystals’ light reflecting on falling snow. The winter storm imposes a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and physical ranged attacks, snuffs handheld flames (such as from a torch or candle), and makes creatures concealed if they’re more than 30 feet away. The snow cover makes the entire area difficult terrain.

Ezio’s Involvement: By the time the PCs face Hedvend, Ezio is fully aware of the threat they pose to him and, more importantly, Illcayna’s plans. Considering the secluded nature of this encounter, he sees it as an opportunity to eliminate the PCs and blame it on Hedvend. If you feel that Ezio wouldn’t have reason to think the PCs are suspicious of him by the time they face Hedvend, he’ll instead face them one-on-one later in the evening.

The PCs might be more concerned with Ezio than Hedvend once they realize that he’s the original killer and manipulating events around he gala. They can choose where and how to stage any confrontation, making any necessary preparations. If the PCs confront him, Ezio initially denies any responsibility but finally acknowledges he’s lost once the PCs lay out all their evidence.

If the PCs confront Ezio before hunting down Hedvend, Ezio smiles and compliments the PCs on their investigative work, acknowledging that he would likely have gotten away with it if it weren’t for them. “Let the devil worshippers and the rebels fight,” he says. “In the end when they fall, our undead army will grow fat with their blood and bodies, and we will reclaim this land for the Pallid Princess! No more will our resources go to feed others. Isger will be for Isger and Urgathoa!”

Creatures: Hedvend VI, consumed with hunger, fights until destroyed. If the PCs used an NPC as bait to set a trap, that character flees at the start of the first round of combat. Ezio rolls initiative at the start of the second round of combat and joins the fight at his initiative spot in that round. He enters through a door from the manor interior, using his Change Shape ability if necessary. Fully cognizant that he will be exposed if he doesn’t kill all the PCs and expecting that his Cloud of Plague ability will preserve his unlife, Ezio fights until reduced to 0 HP. If Ezio isn’t involved in this fight, it becomes a trivial encounter.

第6章：唯一的出路

在玩家角色（PC）战胜埃齐奥以及变异后的赫德文德六世后，他们得以与其他破狱者重新会合，并庆祝成功招募夸斯特完成任务。不幸的是，第二天早晨他们醒来便得知一场灾害：凯托·武劳内克斯宣布戒严，并封锁全城，以便“抓住破狱者刺客并将其绳之以法”。破狱者如今被困在敌境，还被栽赃为凶手！他们必须在被追捕之前找到逃离城市的办法。所幸，他们在艾利迪尔结交了盟友，而赫德文德之死与凯托的强硬镇压叠加，使全城群情激愤，正适合招募新的破狱者！

本章大约持续三周，直到阿巴迪乌斯月末。PC基本上不会受到明确的时间压力；若他们在某次任务中失败，通常可以撤退后再尝试，但这么做很可能会增加他们的镇压点数。

第1部分：束缚之链

舞会后的第二天，PC听到安全屋的门被敲响。他们开门后发现是夸斯特，他溜进屋内，身后跟着两名携带货物的人类雇员。他带来了城市封锁的严峻消息，并向PC提出一项提议（以及他在初次会面时承诺给他们的任何物品），同时也请求他们的帮助。

“我知道我们彼此还不熟，”这位半身人商人说道，“但我们既然已经同意合作，如今城被封锁了，我们就更需要紧密配合。我可不想让地狱骑士找到你们——不利于生意，也不利于活命。我可以帮你——”

Following the PCs’ victory over Ezio and the transformed Hedvend VI, they’re able to regroup with their fellow Hellbreakers and celebrate their successful mission in recruiting Quoster. Unfortunately, they wake the next morning to learn of disaster: Caeto Vulaunex has declared martial law and is locking down the city so he can “catch the Hellbreaker assassins and bring them to justice.” The Hellbreakers are now trapped in enemy territory and framed for murder! They must find a way to escape the city before they’re hunted down. Fortunately, they’ve made allies in Elidir, and the combination of Hedvend’s assassination and Caeto’s crackdown has the city up in arms and ripe for recruiting new Hellbreakers!

This chapter lasts roughly three weeks, to the end of Abadius. There’s largely little time-specific pressure on the PCs; if they fail a mission, they can generally retreat and then try again, but doing so will likely increase their Suppression Points.

Part 1: The Chains That Bind

The day after the gala, the PCs hear a knock on the door of their safe house. They open it to find Quoster, who slips in followed by two human employees laden with goods. He comes bearing the grim news of the city’s lockdown along with an offer for the PCs (and any items he promised them during their first meeting), but also a request for their help.

“I know we don’t know each other well,” the halfling merchant says, “but we’ve already agreed to work together and we need to work even more closely now that the city’s locked down. I don’t want the Hellknight to find you—bad for business, bad for surviving. I can help you”

## Page 100
……离开艾利迪尔，但这需要一点时间。作为一名德鲁玛人，我应该能要求他们允许我离开这座城市，而我会把你们藏在我的货物里偷偷带出去。

“与此同时，我会给你们提供一个更安全的落脚点；要是我能找到你们，那么武拉乌内克斯找到你们也只是时间问题。还有一些伪装能帮助你们在城里安全活动。但我需要你们的帮助；我的一个朋友被逮捕了。我的一个竞争对手诬陷他在帮助破狱者——说他促成了那笔其实是我和你们做成的交易！我没能及时警告他，而军队正在清扫式地抓走各种人。他们把人都带去枷狱。他在那里活不了多久，所以拜托了，我需要你们在为时已晚之前把他救出来！”

奎斯特对PC们大体上是诚实的。他担心一旦PC们被抓，他自己对破狱者联盟刚刚萌芽的支持就会暴露。他没有完全坦白的是：这位“朋友”其实是他在城中的秘密情人——西亚德里乌斯·波特（热心的男性半身人怪奇掮客0），也是少数知晓奎斯特政治活动的其他人之一。PC可以以DC 20的察觉检定来【察觉动机】，从而看出奎斯特所赌上的其实非常私人。

如果PC同意帮忙，奎斯特的雇员会卸下补给，供PC用作伪装。这些物资足够全面，PC可以有效地为自己打造新身份，从而在城中行动时基本不受阻碍。若PC拒绝帮忙，奎斯特会试图施压，利用他“同意帮助破狱者联盟”的协议作为筹码。若这也失败，他最终会提出金币（金额会慢慢提高，直到PC同意），但他因把这视为贿赂而产生的怒气会影响他日后的交易。将破狱者联盟的声望点数降低1点。

宝藏：每名PC获得一条化装舞会围巾，奎斯特另赠予小队一根幻象法杖。若PC立刻同意帮忙，奎斯特会深受触动，并额外赠予他们一枚公正评估戒指（第212页）。

任务：劫狱
当PC抵达枷狱时，他们发现一群愤怒的市民正在抗议镇压，并阻止押送西亚德里乌斯的人把他带进“泥沼”——那座环绕监狱的劳改营。由于军队正忙于封锁全城，反应迟缓，这给了PC一个机会：无需进入监狱本体也能救出西亚德里乌斯。朗读或转述以下内容。

高耸的铁门通向一处庭院，囚犯们会在这里抵达，随后被押过阴暗的石墙，进入被称为“泥沼”的劳改营。在营地中央，枷狱高耸于墙垣之上。这座由黑色石材筑成的监狱在天际线上如同污点，在艾利迪尔那些色彩明快的木屋与商铺之间显得可怖而不祥。你能在二楼与四层塔楼上看到几扇小小的铁栅窗，塔楼约在40英尺高处。

当外门打开以放押送西亚德里乌斯的人进入时，一群愤怒的人潮涌入这片被称为“炼狱”的庭院。如今这群暴躁的人正在阻止守卫关闭外门或开启内门。守卫被堵在此处，又被人群严重压制，PC抵达时他们仍在试图决定应对之策。西亚德里乌斯手脚都戴着镣铐，还被绑在一根杆上；杆子由两名守卫扶持，站在内门前。

监狱门前的暴动（严峻6）
本遭遇使用第108页的地图。本遭遇发生于炼狱（区域K1）。由于暴民的存在，整个区域都是困难地形，且在混乱中生物可以【躲藏】或【潜行】。PC或守卫可以尝试用以下特殊动作控制人群：

控制人群 [单动作]（听觉，专注）
你试图引导人群。尝试DC 22的交涉或威吓检定。
大成功 人群按你的命令移动。直到你下回合开始前，你不将该区域视作困难地形，并且你可以选择让人群对区域内每个敌人造成2d8伤害。

子系统
本章使用若干子系统，列于此处以便查阅。
《监狱门前的暴动》（第99页）与《庄园差事》（第101页）都使用胜利点数系统（GM Core 184）。
《护符差事》（第103页）使用渗透（子系统）（GM Core 196）。
《不成功便成仁》（第114页）使用追逐（子系统）（GM Core 192）。

get out of Elidir, but it will take a little time. As a Druman, 
I should be able to demand that they let me leave the city, 
and I’ll smuggle you out with my wares.
“In the meantime, I’ll provide you a safer place to 
stay; if I found you here, it’s just a matter of time until 
Vulaunex does too. There’s also some disguises to help 
you move around the city safely. But I need your help; a 
friend of mine has been arrested. One of my rivals falsely 
accused him of helping the Hellbreakers—of making the 
deal that I actually made with you! I couldn’t warn him in 
time and the army is snatching up all sorts of people in 
a sweep. They’re bringing them all to the Gyve. He won’t 
survive long there, so please, I need you to go get him out 
before it’s too late!”
Quoster is largely being honest with the PCs. He 
fears his own nascent support for the 
Hellbreakers League will be discovered if 
the PCs are captured. What he’s not fully 
open about is that the friend is actually his 
secret paramour in the city, Siadrius Pott 
(warmhearted male halfling oddities broker 
0), one of the few other people who knows 
about Quoster’s political activities. A PC 
can discern that the stakes are very personal 
for Quoster with a DC 20 Perception check 
to Sense Motive.
If the PCs agree to help, Quoster’s 
employees unload their supplies for 
the PCs to use as disguises. They’re 
comprehensive enough that the PCs can 
effectively create new identities for themselves that 
allow them to move largely unhindered around the 
city. If the PCs refuse to help, Quoster tries to pressure 
them, using his agreement to help the Hellbreakers 
League. If that fails, he eventually offers gold (slowly 
increasing the amount until the PCs agree), but his 
anger over what he sees as a bribe affects his trading 
in the future. Reduce the Hellbreakers League’s 
Reputation Points by 1.
Treasure: Each PC is given a masquerade scarf and 
Quoster gives the group a staff of phantasms. If the 
PCs immediately agree to help, Quoster is touched and 
also gives them a ring of fair assessment (page 212).
MISSION: JAILBREAK
When the PCs arrive at the Gyve, they find a group 
of outraged citizens protesting the crackdown and 
preventing Siadrius’s captors from bringing him into 
the Moil, the labor camp that surrounds the prison. The 
army is slow to respond as it locks down the city, giving 
the PCs a chance to free Siadrius without having to enter 
the prison itself. Read or paraphrase the following.
Towering iron gates open into a courtyard, where prisoners 
arrive to be led through the dark stone walls that lead 
into the labor camp known as the Moil. In the 
center of the camp, the Gyve rises above the 
walls. Made of black stone, the prison is a blot 
on the skyline, a dreadful, ominous presence 
among the cheerfully painted wooden homes 
and businesses of Elidir. Small barred windows 
can be seen on the second floor and in the 
fourth-floor tower, about 40 feet up.
An angry crowd spilled into the 
courtyard, known as Purgatory, when 
the outer gates were opened to allow in 
Siadrius’s captors. The volatile crowd 
is currently preventing the guards from 
closing the outer gates or opening the interior 
ones. Blocked and badly outnumbered by the 
crowd, the guards are still trying to decide on a course 
of action when the PCs arrive. Siadrius is shackled 
hand and foot, and bound to a pole held by two 
guards in front of the interior gate.
Riot at the Prison Gates	
Severe 6
Use the map on page 108 for this encounter. This 
encounter takes place in Purgatory (area K1). Because 
of the mob, the entire area is difficult terrain and a 
creature can Hide or Sneak in the chaos. A PC or guard 
can attempt to control the crowd with the following 
special action:
CONTROL THE CROWD [one-action]
AUDITORY
CONCENTRATE
You try to direct the crowd. Attempt a DC 22 Diplomacy or 
Intimidation check.
Critical Success The crowd moves at your command. You 
do not treat the area as difficult terrain until the start of 
your next turn and you can choose to have the crowd do 
2d8 damage to each enemy in the area.

system (GM Core 184).

subsystem (GM Core 196).

## Page 101
### 谁是新手破狱者？
加入PC队伍的破狱者人数并未具体说明，他们大多只作为背景角色存在。你可以让PC在城里遇到过的NPC重新登场，以充实队伍规模，包括任何与他们一同进城的人，例如：他们刚进入艾利迪尔后不久遇到的精灵学徒萨雷维亚尔（第68页）；受伤的老兵帕迪斯科（第75页）；奥兹妮——如果PC没有让当局把她押进监狱（第76页）；以及“仁慈神父”和“儿童慈善会”（第72页）。萨里尼庄园的仆人奥顿·荨刷肯定会加入（第81页）。他会出现在珍维里克提出的早期暴动之一中，但之后被捕，并在镣铐所受刑后泄露PC的位置。

你也可以自由补充更多破狱者新兵，并为他们设定背景，以突出伊斯嘉境内的不义。让PC在本章前半段与NPC建立联系，会增强他们日后被捕、以及PC尝试营救他们时的冲击力。

**成功** 人群暂时为你分开一条路。在你下个回合开始前，你不将该区域视为**困难地形**。

**失败** 人群无视你。

**大失败** 人群只会把你推搡得更厉害。在你下一次**动作**或**反应动作（）**（以先发生者为准），直到你下个回合开始前，你必须进行一次DC 5的**纯骰检定**。若失败，该动作被打断。

**生物：**该区域内有4名卫兵；由于暴民的存在，没有其他卫兵会赶来支援。这些卫兵眼见无路可退，会战斗到被击昏或被杀为止。

**卫兵队长**　**生物6**
*Pathfinder NPC Core* 115
**先攻** 察觉 +15

**门卫（3名）**　**生物4**
宫廷卫兵（*Pathfinder NPC Core* 14）
**先攻** 察觉 +14

**发展：**暴民因PC对卫兵的反抗而兴奋不已；当战斗结束时，他们开始高喊口号，例如“伊斯嘉属于伊斯嘉”、“把恶魔送回切利亚斯”，以及“破狱者！”如果玩家或PC彼此间讨论过或使用过某些口号，让人群自发高喊这些口号，会更能传达PC对破狱者联盟日益增长的影响力与重要性。

此时，接下来该做什么就由PC决定——他们可以放任暴民自行发展；也可以为了示威者自身的安全试着让人群散去；或如阿尔西奥与菲比在他们初到时交代的那样，为自己在破狱者联盟中的分会招募成员。

在暴民失控之前试图驱散他们，需要以基础的胜利点机制（*GM Core* 184）进行一次DC 22的**技能检定**来衡量PC的成果。决定PC要如何与暴民互动，以及使用哪项技能最合理；每名PC只有一次影响人群的机会。可能的选择包括：用运动将人从人群中强行分隔开；用交涉与他们讲道理；用威吓把他们吓走；或用社会说明他们继续抗议将面临的危险。若PC放任暴民自行发展，并带着西亚德里乌斯逃离，他们获得0点胜利点。

**0点胜利点：**PC离开后，暴民继续抗议，直到被凯托的部队残酷镇压。屠杀的消息迅速传播，PC失去2点暴动点数。

**1–2点胜利点：**PC说服了少数示威者采取他们要求的行动，但无法控制大多数暴民。他们获得0点暴动点数。

**3–4点胜利点：**大多数暴民听从PC并按其指示行动，尽管仍有少数示威者继续谴责凯托的镇压。他们获得1点暴动点数。

**5点以上胜利点：**PC迅速说服示威者按指示行事，提升了自身声望。他们获得2点暴动点数，并使破狱者联盟的声望点数提高1点。

## 第2部分：掀起地狱
当PC返回安全屋后，奎斯特因他们救出西亚德里乌斯而欣喜若狂。

“我……我真不知道该怎么感谢你们。……西亚德里乌斯对我而言，比你们想象得还要重要。如果你们在晚宴上做的事还不够，这一次更证明我支持破狱者联盟的选择是正确的。你们留在这里，休息、恢复，我会尽快把我们所有人都带出艾利迪尔。”

作为答谢，西亚德里乌斯表示：即便他目前官司缠身，他在城里仍有足够多的朋友，可以替PC买到（或卖出）他们可能需要的任何东西，让他们在本段冒险期间也能安全购物。他说自己会联系一位朋友——珍维里克（性情亢奋的女性死裔半身人古董收藏家3级），他信任她可以充当中间人，并会把她派到PC的安全屋。

Development: The mob is thrilled by the PCs’ 
resistance to the guards and, as the battle concludes, 
begins chanting slogans, such as “Isger for Isger,” “Send 
the devils back to Cheliax,” and “Hellbreakers!” If the 
players or PCs have discussed or used any slogans among 
themselves, having the crowd spontaneously chant that 
would help convey the PCs’ growing influence and 
importance to the Hellbreakers League. At this point, it’s 
up to the PCs to decide what to do—they can abandon 
the mob to its own devices, try to get it to disperse for 
the protesters’ own safety, or recruit members for their 
own chapter of the Hellbreakers League as Alceo and 
Phoebe tasked them to do when they first arrived.
Attempting to break up the mob before it gets out 
of hand requires a DC 22 skill check using the basic 
Victory Point mechanic (GM Core 184) to measure the 
PCs’ success. Determine how a PC wants to engage the 
mob and what skill makes the most sense; each PC has 
one chance to influence the crowd. Some likely choices 
include Athletics to bodily separate people from the 
whole; Diplomacy to reason with them; Intimidation 
to scare them away; or Society to explain the danger 
they face with the protest. If the PCs leave the mob to 
its own devices and flee with Siadrius, they receive 0 
Victory Points.
0 	
Victory Points: The mob continues to protest after 
the PCs leave until they are brutally put down 
by Caeto’s forces. Word of the slaughter quickly 
spreads, and the PCs lose 2 Uprising Points.
1–2 	 Victory Points: The PCs persuade a few protesters 
to take their requested action, but can’t control 
most of the mob. They gain 0 Uprising Points.
3–4 	Victory Points: Most of the mob heeds the PCs and 
follows their directions, though a few protesters 
continue to decry Caeto’s crackdown. They gain 1 
Uprising Points.
5+	 Victory Points: The PCs quickly persuade the 
protesters to do as instructed, bolstering their 
reputation. They gain 2 Uprising Points and increase 
the Hellbreakers League’s Reputation Points by 1.
Part 2: Raising Hell
Once the PCs return to the safe house, Quoster is 
elated that they saved Siadrius.
“I can’t think you all enough, I... Siadrius means more to me 
than you’ll ever know. If what you did at the gala wasn’t 
enough, this only proves I’m making the right choice by 
supporting the Hellbreakers League. Stay here, rest and 
recover, and I’ll get us all out of Elidir as quickly as possible.”
Siadrius, as a way of thanks, says even with his 
current legal troubles, he has enough friends in the 
city that he can buy (or sell) anything the PCs might 
need, letting them shop safely during this part of the 
adventure. He says he’ll contact a friend, Jenvirick 
(excitable female nephilim halfling antiques collector 
3), whom he trusts to serve as an intermediary, and 
will send her to the PCs’ safe house.
WHO ARE THE ROOKIE HELLBREAKERS?
The number of Hellbreakers who join the PCs 
isn’t specified and mostly serve as background 
characters. You can reintroduce NPCs the PCs 
met in the city to fill out the ranks, including 
any of those they entered the city with, such as: 
Sarevial, the elf apprentice they met shortly after 
entering Elidir (page 68); Padisco, the wounded 
veteran (page 75); Ozney, if they didn’t let the 
authorities take her to prison (page 76); and 
Father Kindness and the Children’s Charity (page 
72). Otton Nettlebrush, the servant from the 
manor (page 81), definitely joins. He appears in 
one of the early uprisings that Jenvirick suggests, 
but is later captured and reveals the PCs’ locations 
after being tortured in the Gyve. Feel free to flesh 
out additional Hellbreaker recruits and give them 
backgrounds that emphasize the iniquity in Isger. 
Creating connections with NPCs during the earlier 
part of the chapter will increase the impact of 
their eventual arrest and attempts to free them.

WHO ARE THE ROOKIE HELLBREAKERS?
The number of Hellbreakers who join the PCs isn’t specified and mostly serve as background characters. You can reintroduce NPCs the PCs met in the city to fill out the ranks, including any of those they entered the city with, such as: Sarevial, the elf apprentice they met shortly after entering Elidir (page 68); Padisco, the wounded veteran (page 75); Ozney, if they didn’t let the authorities take her to prison (page 76); and Father Kindness and the Children’s Charity (page 72). Otton Nettlebrush, the servant from the manor (page 81), definitely joins. He appears in one of the early uprisings that Jenvirick suggests, but is later captured and reveals the PCs’ locations after being tortured in the Gyve. Feel free to flesh out additional Hellbreaker recruits and give them backgrounds that emphasize the iniquity in Isger. Creating connections with NPCs during the earlier part of the chapter will increase the impact of their eventual arrest and attempts to free them.

0 Victory Points: The mob continues to protest after the PCs leave until they are brutally put down by Caeto’s forces. Word of the slaughter quickly spreads, and the PCs lose 2 Uprising Points.

3–4 Victory Points: Most of the mob heeds the PCs and follows their directions, though a few protesters continue to decry Caeto’s crackdown. They gain 1 Uprising Points.
5+ Victory Points: The PCs quickly persuade the protesters to do as instructed, bolstering their reputation. They gain 2 Uprising Points and increase the Hellbreakers League’s Reputation Points by 1.

Part 2: Raising Hell
Once the PCs return to the safe house, Quoster is elated that they saved Siadrius.
“I can’t think you all enough, I... Siadrius means more to me than you’ll ever know. If what you did at the gala wasn’t enough, this only proves I’m making the right choice by supporting the Hellbreakers League. Stay here, rest and recover, and I’ll get us all out of Elidir as quickly as possible.”

Siadrius, as a way of thanks, says even with his current legal troubles, he has enough friends in the city that he can buy (or sell) anything the PCs might need, letting them shop safely during this part of the adventure. He says he’ll contact a friend, Jenvirick (excitable female nephilim halfling antiques collector 3), whom he trusts to serve as an intermediary, and will send her to the PCs’ safe house.

## Page 102
珍薇瑞克在PC们有机会在莫伊尔之战后休息并恢复不久便抵达了。她是地精血战老兵的女儿，早已厌倦看着自己的父母与国家被人占便宜。她一向精力旺盛（还略带一点阴谋论倾向），而西亚德里乌斯提出要她与“破狱者联盟”合作的请求，更是点燃了她，使她彻底变成一名激进分子。她很快就会找到PC们，提出要成立破狱者联盟的本地分会。

提出这一请求的具体时机由你决定——让她在第一次为PC们外出采购归来后立刻提出会很合适；但如果PC们一开始并没有什么想买卖的东西，这个时机也可以更早。

在本节中，珍薇瑞克是一名重要NPC。她会推动PC们在城里建立破狱者联盟的分会，并向他们提供任务以推进他们的事业。

珍薇瑞克几乎因兴奋而嗡嗡作响，不停从一只脚换重心到另一只脚，仿佛她只是勉强忍住不立刻冲出去行动。“我能做的不只是买东西。我在赫德文——”她提到那位现已死亡的总管时停下来，朝地上啐了一口，“——镇压煽乱者之前就参加过抗议了。我听说了破狱者联盟在南方做的事，西亚德里乌斯也告诉我你们是怎么救了他。现在就是时候！艾利迪尔已经准备好建立自己的分会。莫伊尔那场抗议证明了这一点。我们只需要领袖！而你们证明了你们能领导！让我加入，让我帮忙！我有太多点子了！”

如果PC们同意，珍薇瑞克会拍手叫好。等他们准备就绪时，她会滔滔不绝地抛出PC们可以去做的任务点子。她的点子构成了以下遭遇：庄园差事（第101页）、军队差事（第102页）以及护符差事（第103页），PC们可以按任意顺序进行。完成珍薇瑞克的第二个任务后，奎斯特会来找他们，谈到码头差事起义（第104页）。如果PC们觉得自己的起义点数偏低，他们也可以尝试宣传任务（第105页）。

本节冒险大约持续2–3周，让PC们能在任务间休息、制造或购物。你甚至可以让多个任务彼此重叠，以传达时间流逝的感觉——尤其是让护符差事中的一两个障碍发生在其他起义行动的前后；不过你应当确保这样安排不会让玩家困惑。

如果PC们拒绝她，珍薇瑞克会很失望，但接下来的几天仍会继续劝说他们，主张联盟对伊斯嘉其他地区一直是股积极力量，艾利迪尔也应当如此。若他们仍然拒绝，她就决定亲自动手，慢慢把越来越多的革命者带进安全屋，并在PC们眼皮底下召开会议——这些会议会催生越来越狂野的想法，而PC们应当能立刻看出这些想法会导致大规模伤亡。

如果PC们不尽快承担起领导角色，他们就会意识到：这个未经授权的破狱者联盟正在试图煽动不端行为，并激怒凯托加大对他们的打击力度。从此开始，PC们的镇压点数每天增加1点。三天后，奎斯特会来找PC们，分享他对那些被归咎于联盟的高调行动及其后果的担忧，并敦促PC们接管该组织的领导权。

【任务：庄园差事】

珍薇瑞克带着一名眼熟的半身人走来。“这位是奥顿·内特尔布拉什。我听见他在和另一位联盟成员说话，呃，你们应该听听他要说什么！”

奥顿紧张地嘟囔着，脚下不安地挪了挪，过了一会儿才开口。“对……珍薇瑞克说我应该告诉你们：我一直在里夫斯雷斯特服侍，直到赫德文得到他罪有应得的下场。之后，武拉乌内克解雇了大部分仆役，只留了少数守卫和仆人。但关键在于：那座庄园里有很多值钱东西。当然有钱币，但还有艺术品、珍本书，甚至还有那柄挂在总管房间里的长柄刀——年长的仆人们过去说那似乎是某种古老的魔法武器，是历任总管自从击败最初的伊斯嘉人之后一直保留至今的。”

珍薇瑞克兴奋得浑身发颤，打断道：“所以我有个主意！我们可以去把它洗劫一空。然后用这些钱帮助城里的穷苦人，这应该能让他们站到我们这边来！”

凯托仍然安坐在切里亚斯区——也被称为“恶魔之亩”的城区壁垒之内；那是城中切里亚斯精英居住的有墙区域——使得里夫斯雷斯特除了少数用于维持庄园运作的守卫与仆人外基本空无一人。PC们既已熟悉庄园的布局，如今便有了一个绝佳机会潜回去洗劫一番。珍薇瑞克建议将其中一部分……

Hellbreakers (Adventure Path)

Jenvirick arrives shortly after the PCs have had a chance to rest and recover from the fight at the Moil. The daughter of Goblinblood War veterans, she’s tired of watching her parents and her country be taken advantage of. While she’s always been excitable (as well as a bit of a conspiracy theorist), Siadrius’s request to work with the Hellbreakers has ignited her into a full-blown radical. She soon approaches the PCs about starting a local chapter of the Hellbreakers League. The exact timing for this request is up to you—it might work well immediately after she returns from a first shopping expedition for the PCs, but could be sooner if they don’t immediately have any goods they want to buy or sell.

Jenvirick serves as an important NPC in this section. She pushes the PCs to start a chapter of the Hellbreakers League in the city and offers them missions to advance their cause.

Jenvirick nearly thrums with excitement, shifting her weight from foot to foot as if she’s only barely holding herself back from rushing into action. “I can do more than just shop. I joined the protests before Hedvend—” She stops to spit on the ground as she mentions the now-dead steward. “—cracked down on the Riotmongers. I’ve heard about what the Hellbreakers League is doing in the south, and Siadrius told me how you rescued him. The time is now! Elidir is ready for its own chapter. That protest at the Moil proves it. We just need leaders! And you showed you can lead! Let me join, let me help! I have so many ideas!”

If the PCs agree, Jenvirick claps her hands. When they’re ready, she spills out ideas for missions the PCs can undertake. Her ideas make up the following encounters: The Manor Job (page 101), The Army Job (page 102), and The Talisman Job (page 103), which the PCs can do in whatever order they chose. After they complete the second of Jenvirick’s missions, Quoster approaches them about The Dock Job uprising (page 104). If the PCs feel they’re low on Uprising Points, they can also attempt the Propaganda mission (page 105). This section of the adventure lasts about 2–3 weeks, giving PCs time to rest, craft, or shop between missions. You could even have missions overlap to convey a sense of time passing—especially with perhaps one or two obstacles from the Talisman Job happening around other uprisings, though you should make sure doing it this way won’t confuse your players.

If the PCs rebuff her, Jenvirick is disappointed, but continues to press them over the following days, arguing that the League has been a positive force for other areas of Isger and that Elidir deserves the same. If they still refuse, she decides to take matters into her own hands, slowly bringing more and more revolutionaries into the safe house and holding meetings right under the PCs’ noses—such meetings lead to wilder and wilder ideas that the PCs should be able to immediately tell would result in mass casualties. If the PCs don’t quickly take a leadership role, they become aware that the unauthorized Hellbreakers League is trying to incite misbehavior and provoking Caeto to increase his efforts against them. From here, the PCs’ Suppression Points increase by 1 per day. After three days, Quoster approaches the PCs to share his concerns about the high-profile actions being attributed to the League and their repercussions, and urges the PCs to take leadership of the group.

MISSION: THE MANOR JOB

Jenvirick approaches with a familiar halfling. “This is Otton Nettlebrush. I heard him talking with another League member and, well, you should hear what he has to say!”

Otton mumbles to himself nervously and shifts his feet for a moment before he begins. “Right... Jenvirick says I should tell you that I served in Reevesrest until Hedvend got exactly what he deserved. After that, Vulaunex sacked most of the staff, just left a few guards and servants. But here’s the thing: that manor has a lot of valuables in it. Coins, of course, but also artwork, rare books, even that glaive that hangs in the steward’s room—the older servants used to say it was some sort of ancient magical weapon that stewards have kept since they defeated the original Isgeri.”

Vibrating with excitement, Jenvirick interrupts. “So that gave me an idea! We could go loot it. Then we use the money to help the city’s needy, which should bring them to our side!”

## Page 103
这些宝藏可以帮助资助新生的破狱者同盟分会，而其余部分则可以分发给贫民，以赢得对叛乱的支持。

要在这项任务中成功，PC必须潜行避开守卫，悄悄进入住宅。这场起义是一次使用胜利点机制（《GM核心规则》184）的技能挑战。这是一个两步挑战，总计约8小时，可在白天或夜晚进行。每位PC每一步可进行一次检定；若PC施放一个合适的非法术戏法法术，则可获得一次自动成功；若该法术是其能施放的最高环级，则改为自动大成功。

在挑战的第一部分，PC必须避开人类与动物守卫。他们可以用DC 22检定来尝试：使用体操从门与守卫上方或周围翻越绕行；使用欺瞒冒充新仆从或守卫；使用自然命令动物；使用隐匿避免被看见；或使用察觉发现接近的巡逻队。

0–1胜利点：PC被发现，未能通过守卫。

2–3胜利点：PC通过了守卫，但引起怀疑。在本挑战第二部分的任何技能检定上承受–1环境减值。

4胜利点：PC完全不被察觉地溜入宅邸庭院。

若PC拥有足够的VP以进入挑战的第二部分，他们必须闯入宅邸，并绕过用来保护该地点的锁具与魔法陷阱。他们可以用DC 22检定来做到这一点：使用运动强行开启一扇门或一扇窗；或进行DC 22奥秘、制作、秘学、宗教或盗窃检定以绕过魔法安保。

0–1胜利点：PC未能进入宅邸，必须撤退。

2–3胜利点：PC进入了宅邸，但无法取得其全部贵重物品。

4胜利点：PC把宅邸里一切没钉死的东西都搜刮一空。

若PC在任一挑战中失败，他们能毫发无伤地逃脱，并可改日再试。每次失败的尝试会使PC获得1点镇压点数，但也会使挑战两部分的DC各降低1，因为他们对安保措施愈发熟悉（若PC多次尝试，此降低可累加）。

宝藏：若PC把宅邸所有贵重物品都搜刮一空，他们获得一枚盐与土的信物（第212页），以及赫德文德房间里的长柄刀——一把古老的伊斯嘉武器“生命绽放”（第214页）。此外，由于破狱者将赫德文德的财富分发给有需要的人，他们获得2点起义点数。若他们无法取得全部贵重物品，他们仍得到这两件宝藏，但只获得1点起义点数。

奖励：若PC成功进入宅邸并取得任何贵重物品，奖励他们10 XP。

任务：军队差事

詹薇瑞克脸上掠过一抹邪恶的笑容。“我有个主意！”她兴奋地说。“我之前在找吃的，然后因为想要点面包，不小心冲着萨瑞维亚尔发了火。人饿了就会暴躁，而且不一定能做出最好的选择。要是我们也对军队这么干呢？谁知道乌劳内克斯是不是已经用他那贪婪的拳头把住了军队的剑柄，但我敢打赌，我们能让那里变得不太舒服！”

詹薇瑞克建议PC趁凯托接管所造成的混乱，扰乱伊斯嘉军队的运作。若他们冒充切里克斯信使，就能把补给甚至部队送到错误的地点，制造短缺并为其他行动创造机会。为此，PC需要伪造命令并潜入“伊斯嘉之拳”——军队总部；这会耗费整整一天。

PC必须先伪造文件。他们可以尝试以DC 22社会检定进行伪造文书，或以DC 22制作检定制作与军队书面命令相关的纸张、墨水与印章。该检定应秘密进行。

随后PC必须递送命令，这需要进行DC 22欺瞒或表演检定。若PC在第4章（第78页）成功影响了里瑟特上校且xe在宴会后存活，则将每个DC降低1。

若PC两次检定都成功，他们会扰乱军队补给线，使其镇压点数减少2；若其中一次检定大成功，则改为减少3；若两次检定都大成功，则改为减少4。

若PC任一次检定失败，他们无法递送伪造命令，但可以再次尝试。若其中一次检定大失败，他们会引起怀疑并获得1点镇压点数。若两次检定都大失败，他们获得2点镇压点数，并且不能再次尝试这次起义。

奖励：若PC成功完成军队差事，奖励他们10 XP。

To succeed at this mission, the PCs need to sneak 
past the guards and quietly enter the home. This 
uprising is a skill challenge using the Victory Points 
mechanic (GM Core 184). This is a two-step challenge 
over about 8 hours that can be done day or night. 
Each PC can attempt one check per step and a PC 
who uses an appropriate non-cantrip spell can earn 
an automatic success, or a critical success if it’s the 
highest rank spell they can cast.
In the first part of the challenge, the PCs must avoid 
both human and animal guards. They can attempt 
to do so with a DC 22 check using Acrobatics to 
go over and around gates and guards, Deception 
to Impersonate a new servant or guard, Nature to 
Command an Animal, Stealth to avoid being seen, or 
Perception to Spot approaching patrols.
0–1	  Victory Points: The PCs are spotted, and fail to get 
past the guards.
2–3 	Victory Points: The PCs make it past the guards, 
but raise suspicions. They suffer a –1 circumstance 
penalty to any skill checks in the second part of this 
challenge.
4 	
Victory Points: The PCs slip into the manor grounds 
completely undetected.
If the PCs have enough VP to proceed to the second 
part of the challenge, they must break into the manor 
and bypass locks and magical traps set to secure the 
location. They can do so with a DC 22 check using 
Athletics to Force Open a door or window, or a DC 
22 Arcana, Crafting, Occultism, Religion, or Thievery 
check to bypass the magical security.
0–1 	Victory Points: The PCs fail to get into the manor 
and need to retreat.
2–3 	Victory Points: The PCs get into the manor, but 
can’t access all of its valuables.
4 	
Victory Points: The PCs strip the manor of 
everything that’s not nailed down.
If the PCs fail at either challenge, they escape 
unscathed and can try again on another day. Each 
failed attempt gains the PCs 1 Suppression Point, but 
also reduces the DCs in both parts of the challenge by 1 
as they gain familiarity with the security (this reduction 
is cumulative if the PCs make multiple attempts).

the treasure could help fund the nascent chapter of the Hellbreakers League, but the rest could be distributed to the needy to earn favor for the rebellion.

To succeed at this mission, the PCs need to sneak past the guards and quietly enter the home. This uprising is a skill challenge using the Victory Points mechanic (GM Core 184). This is a two-step challenge over about 8 hours that can be done day or night. Each PC can attempt one check per step and a PC who uses an appropriate non-cantrip spell can earn an automatic success, or a critical success if it’s the highest rank spell they can cast.

In the first part of the challenge, the PCs must avoid both human and animal guards. They can attempt to do so with a DC 22 check using Acrobatics to go over and around gates and guards, Deception to Impersonate a new servant or guard, Nature to Command an Animal, Stealth to avoid being seen, or Perception to Spot approaching patrols.

0–1 Victory Points: The PCs are spotted, and fail to get past the guards.

2–3 Victory Points: The PCs make it past the guards, but raise suspicions. They suffer a –1 circumstance penalty to any skill checks in the second part of this challenge.

4 Victory Points: The PCs slip into the manor grounds completely undetected.

If the PCs have enough VP to proceed to the second part of the challenge, they must break into the manor and bypass locks and magical traps set to secure the location. They can do so with a DC 22 check using Athletics to Force Open a door or window, or a DC 22 Arcana, Crafting, Occultism, Religion, or Thievery check to bypass the magical security.

0–1 Victory Points: The PCs fail to get into the manor and need to retreat.

2–3 Victory Points: The PCs get into the manor, but can’t access all of its valuables.

4 Victory Points: The PCs strip the manor of everything that’s not nailed down.

If the PCs fail at either challenge, they escape unscathed and can try again on another day. Each failed attempt gains the PCs 1 Suppression Point, but also reduces the DCs in both parts of the challenge by 1 as they gain familiarity with the security (this reduction is cumulative if the PCs make multiple attempts).

Treasure: If the PCs strip the manor of all its valuables, they claim a token of salt and earth (page 212) as well as the glaive in Hedvend’s room, an ancient Isgeri weapon called Lifebloom (page 214). In addition, they earn 2 Uprising Points as the Hellbreakers distribute Hedvend’s wealth to those who need it. If they couldn’t access all of the valuables, they get the two treasures and only gain 1 Uprising Point.

Reward: If the PCs successfully get into the manor and get any valuables, award them 10 XP.

An evil grin crosses Jenvirick’s face. “I have an idea!” she says excitedly. “I was looking for something to eat earlier and I accidentally snapped at Sarevial because I wanted some bread. People get cranky when they’re hungry, and they don’t always make the best choices. What if we did that to the army? Who knows if Vulaunex has fully wrapped his greedy fists around the army’s hilt, but I bet we can make things uncomfortable there!”

Jenvirick suggests the PCs take advantage of the confusion around Caeto’s takeover to disrupt the Isgeri army’s operations. If they impersonate Chelaxian couriers, they could send supplies or even forces to the wrong places, creating shortages and opportunities for other activities. Doing so requires the PCs to create false orders and infiltrate Isger’s Fist, the army headquarters, which takes an entire day.

The PCs must first falsify documents, which they can attempt to do with a DC 22 Society check to Create a Forgery or a DC 22 Crafting check to create the paper, inks, and seals associated with the army’s written orders. This check should be made secretly.

The PCs then must deliver the orders, which requires a DC 22 Deception or Performance check. If the PCs successfully influenced Colonel Rithert in Chapter 4 (page 78) and xe survived the gala, reduce each DC by 1.

If they fail at either check, they aren’t able to deliver the false orders, but can attempt to do so again. If they critically fail at one of the checks, they raise suspicions and gain 1 Suppression Point. If they critically fail at both checks, they gain 2 Suppression Points and can’t attempt this uprising again.

Reward: If the PCs successfully complete the Army Job, award them 10 XP.

## Page 104
（……）已经知道答案了。“这全是栽赃嫁祸，好来抓我们。但我想我有个迄今为止最好的主意！如果我们也对他们来这一套呢？”

PC们已经与阿兹里家族打过几次交道；这家人代表了伊斯嘉最糟糕的一面：无与伦比的财富、对平民的关切还不如他们精致定制鞋底的尘土，以及比地狱里的恶魔还少的良知。可惜的是，他们的地位与人脉——作为伊斯嘉军队武器与补给的主要供应者之一——再加上数量惊人的私人安保，使他们基本上无人敢动。把阿兹里家族栽成“破狱者联盟”成员，会迫使凯托逮捕他们，哪怕最后只是为了宣告无罪。他们或许能花钱买来自由，但指控严重到足以让他们被关押，而这会干扰军队的武器供应。

詹维里克为PC们拟定了一场精心策划的劫案：先散播谣言，说有一批来自杜鲁玛、原本要送往埃利迪尔军队的护符货物失踪了。接着，PC们必须想办法把这些护符与阿兹里家族联系起来：他们可以假扮成盗贼，向这群腐败贵族兜售护符。随后，PC们再向军方放出消息，宣称阿兹里家族才是最初盗走“那批货物”的人，并计划把它卖给破狱者联盟。等所有鱼钩都挂上饵之后，就只剩下把双方引到同一地点，然后在不被看见、也不被触及的情况下全身而退。这场起义使用《GM核心》196页的渗透系统。

**制造奖品（障碍 6）**
渗透点数 2（团体）；**克服** DC 24 欺瞒，以散播失物的消息；DC 27 表演，扮演货物被盗的商人；或 DC 22 战争学识或黑道学识，以回忆知识了解军需补给与本地盗贼行会。
PC们需要通过散布谣言来“创造”一批失踪的护符货物，从而引起阿兹里家族的兴趣，并激怒军官。

**挂饵上钩（障碍 6）**
渗透点数 2（团体）；**克服** DC 22 奥秘、制作、自然、秘学或宗教，以制作一个伪造的护符样品；DC 24 欺瞒、交涉或商业学识，以谈判交易条件；或 DC 27 社会，以安排一场交易。
PC们必须与阿兹里家族会面，并安排让他们购买这批“被盗”的货物。

**开始追猎（障碍 6）**
渗透点数 2（团体）；**克服** DC 24 欺瞒、交涉或表演，把消息送到相关当局；DC 22 法律学识或战争学识，以回忆知识了解军队流程；或 DC 27 社会，以制造线索供军方调查员发现。
一旦PC们把阿兹里家族拉进局里，他们就需要向军方通报这起所谓的腐败。
**特殊** 若PC们在第4章成功影响了里瑟特上校且对方在晚宴中幸存，则本障碍的DC降低2；若里瑟特上校未能在晚宴中幸存，则所有DC提高1，因为其继任者仍在熟悉工作，对PC们的暗示反应迟缓。

**聚拢目标（障碍 6）**
渗透点数 2（团体）；**克服** DC 27 欺瞒或交涉，使所有人聚到一起；DC 24 求生，为军方调查员布下伪造踪迹；或 DC 22 巧手，以栽放一个假护符。
PC们必须安排让军方调查员当场抓到阿兹里家族持有这些“被盗”的护符。

**让他们背锅（障碍 6）**
渗透点数 2（团体）；**克服** DC 24 特技动作或运动，以翻越围墙；DC 25 埃利迪尔学识或 DC 27 社会，以找到城内最佳逃生路线；或 DC 22 隐匿，以潜行离开。
PC们最后要做的就是悄然脱身，仿佛他们从未存在过一般，留下阿兹里家族持有“赃物”，以及一套荒诞的交易说辞。

PC的“警觉点数”总计具有以下效果（除起义点数或镇压点数的其他效果外）。

**5 点警觉点数：** 阿兹里家族变得谨慎。本次起义中各障碍的DC提高1。

**10 点警觉点数：** 军方将这次所谓的护符失窃归咎于破狱者。PC的镇压点数+1。

**15 点警觉点数：** 对失踪护符的追查加剧。PC的镇压点数总计增加2。

**20 点警觉点数：** 阿兹里家族起疑并放弃计划。“护符劫案”失败。

**后续：** 若PC成功完成“护符劫案”，阿兹里家族会被逮捕并送往铁械牢（PC们之后会在那里遇到他们）。此举对军方行动造成的扰乱使镇压点数减少2。

**奖励：** 若PC成功完成“护符劫案”，给予他们10 XP。

knows the answer already. “It’s all a frame job to come 
after us. But I think I have my best idea yet! What if we did

The PCs have had a couple of interactions with the 
Azri family, who represent the very worst Isger has 
to offer: unparalleled wealth, less concern for the 
common person than the dirt on their exquisite 
custom shoes, and fewer scruples than a devil from 
the Hells. Unfortunately, their status and connections 
as one of the primary providers of weapons and 
supplies to the Isgeri army have largely made them 
untouchable as does their immense amount of private 
security. Framing the Azris as Hellbreakers would 
force Caeto to arrest them, even if only to acquit 
them. While they might be able to buy their freedom, 
the charges would be serious enough that they would 
be imprisoned, which would in turn interfere with 
the army’s weapon supply.
Jenvirick lays out an elaborate heist for the PCs, 
which involves spreading rumors about a shipment 
of talismans from Druma intended for Elidir’s army 
that have disappeared. Next, the PCs must find a way 
to connect the talismans to the Azris by posing as 
thieves who offer to sell them to the corrupt nobles. 
The PCs can then slip word to the army, claiming 
the Azris were the ones who stole the supposed 
shipment in the first place with plans to sell them 
to the Hellbreakers League. Once all those hooks 
are baited, it’s simply a matter of luring both sides 
to the same location and getting away unseen and 
untouched. This uprising uses the Infiltration system 
from GM Core 196.
CREATE A PRIZE	
OBSTACLE 6
Infiltration Points 2 (group); Overcome DC 24 Deception 
to spread word of the missing items, DC 27 Performance 
to act as merchants who have had their goods stolen, 
or DC 22 Warfare Lore or Underworld Lore to Recall 
Knowledge about army supplies and local thieves’ 
guilds
The PCs need to “create” a missing shipment of talismans 
to intrigue the Azris and anger army officers by spreading 
rumors.
BAIT THE HOOK	
OBSTACLE 6
Infiltration Points 2 (group); Overcome DC 22 Arcana, 
Crafting, Nature, Occultism, or Religion to create a 
fake sample talisman, DC 24 Deception, Diplomacy or 
Mercantile Lore to negotiate terms, or DC 27 Society to 
arrange a deal
The PCs must meet with the Azris and arrange for them to 
buy the supposedly stolen shipment.
START THE HUNT	
OBSTACLE 6
Infiltration Points 2 (group); Overcome DC 24 Deception, 
Diplomacy, or Performance to get a message to the 
proper authorities, DC 22 Legal Lore or Warfare Lore 
to Recall Knowledge about army procedures, or DC 27 
Society to create clues for army investigators to find
Once the PCs rope the Azris into the scheme, they need to 
alert the army to the supposed corruption.
Special If the PCs successfully Influenced Colonel Rithert 
during Chapter 4 and xe survived the gala, reduce the DCs 
for this obstacle by 2; if Colonel Rithert didn’t survive the 
gala, increase all DCs by 1 as xir replacement is still learning 
the job and is slow to respond to the PCs’ prompts.
GATHER THE MARKS	
OBSTACLE 6
Infiltration Points 2 (group); Overcome DC 27 Deception or 
Diplomacy to bring everyone together, DC 24 Survival 
to lay false tracks for army investigators, or DC 22 
Thievery to plant a fake talisman
The PCs must arrange for army investigators to catch the 
Azris red-handed with the supposedly stolen talismans.
LEAVE THEM HOLDING THE BAG	
OBSTACLE 6
Infiltration Points 2 (group); Overcome DC 24 Acrobatics 
or Athletics to get over walls, DC 25 Elidir Lore or DC 27 
Society to find the best escape routes in the city, or DC 
22 Stealth to Sneak away
The last thing for the PCs to do is slip away, as if they 
never existed at all, leaving the Azris with supposedly 
stolen goods and a nonsense explanation about the 
alleged deal.
The PCs’ Awareness Points total has the following 
effects (in addition to any effects from Uprising Points 
or Suppression Points).
5 Awareness Points: The Azris grow wary. Increase the 
DCs for obstacles in this uprising by 1.
10 Awareness Points: The Army blames the Hellbreakers 
for the supposed theft of the talismans. Add 1 to the 
PCs’ Suppression Points.
15 Awareness Points: The hunt for the missing talismans 
intensifies. Increase the PCs’ Suppression Points by a 
total of 2.
20 Awareness Points: The Azris become suspicious and 
abandon the plan. The Talisman Job fails.
Development: If the PCs successfully complete 
the Talisman Job, the Azris are arrested and sent 
to the Gyve (where the PCs encounter them later). 
The disruption to the army’s activities reduces the 
number of Suppression Points by 2.
Reward: If the PCs successfully complete the 
Talisman Job, award them 10 XP.

## Page 105
【任务：码头差事】
【低或中等 6级】

这场起义发生在PC完成前述两场起义之后。奎斯特会来找PC，说他在说服当局允许他离开城市方面遇到了麻烦。所幸，珍维里克有个主意：她建议PC策划一场抢劫，以进一步施压。

奎斯特用手抓了抓头发，神情憔悴。“我还是觉得我能带着货把你们弄出去，但当局像顽固的魔鬼一样。他们拒绝让我离开，而我需要点筹码。”

珍维里克尖声一叫：“哦，我有主意！你们要不要去码头那边策划一场抢劫，故意让人看见，确保不可能被忽略？这样奎斯特就能借机强调，他的货在这里不安全！”

PC是否真的偷到东西并不重要，但奎斯特需要他们被人发现，这样他就能以“有贼”为由，要求允许他把货物运出艾利迪尔——否则，卡埃托就得冒着他闹得足够大、引发国际纠纷的风险。奎斯特建议夜间行动，那时码头除了巡逻的安保队外基本空无一人，而巡逻队通常只由少数卫兵组成。他敦促PC避免杀人，因为那可能适得其反，让卡埃托收得更紧。

如果PC在第4章（第78页）成功影响了萨斯托利·布伦克且他在晚宴中幸存，奎斯特会建议他们争取他的协助。前往码头与他交谈的PC可以尝试一次DC 20的交涉检定来【请求】他的帮助。成功时，他会告知PC一次典型的卫兵巡逻包含哪些成员，包括守望法师准备了哪些法术，以及地狱犬的存在。大成功时，萨斯托利同意把部分资源从PC计划上演抢劫的地点调开；将遭遇中的一名码头卫兵移除，使该遭遇从中等降为低。

本遭遇使用左侧地图。如果PC想提前勘察现场，他们可以轻松做到。等他们准备开始时，允许他们在想要的位置布置。至少要有一名PC明显扮演“盗贼”的角色，好让卫兵发现。让任何希望在“抢劫码头”时被抓个正着的PC尝试一次DC 22的表演检定，或DC 24的体操、欺骗、巧手、或隐匿检定，来“做出正在撬入、却故意失败”的样子；或者进行一次DC 27的运动检定来推倒物品、制造噪音。成功的PC在卫兵上前对质时，其先攻掷骰获得+2环境加值；大成功时，其在战斗的第一轮获得加速状态，并可用额外动作进行【调整步伐】、【移动】、【打击】或【寻找掩护】。

This uprising occurs after the PCs complete two of the 
previous uprisings. Quoster approaches the PCs and

发展：PC与守卫的战斗动静足够大，会引来更多守卫。PC能听见有人接近，但仍有充足时间在不被发现的情况下撤离——只是来不及完成一场“抢劫”。尽管PC最终不会有机会和奎斯特一起偷偷离开城市（见第3部分：大逃亡），这位商人施压的努力仍会让他们受益：当局会调拨兵力去码头制止“一连串胆大妄为的盗窃”。将PC的镇压点数降低2点。

如果PC杀死了任何人类守卫，缚令官会借此为进一步镇压提供正当理由；PC每杀死1名守卫便获得1点镇压点数（凯托并不在乎地狱犬的死活）。

奖励：如果PC说服萨斯托利降低巡逻强度，奖励他们20 XP。

任务：宣传
如果PC的起义点数不足，这场起义可作为可选事件。凯托对叛乱分子的残酷镇压正在重创城市，但“破狱者”可以通过这场起义进一步将民意导向反对他。

首先，PC必须尝试制作反切利亚斯宣传品，进行一次DC 22的制作或适当的学识检定。若PC从伊维斯那里得到了《阿布罗盖尔一世》剧本（第71页），则自动成功。

接着，PC必须将宣传品带到公众面前。他们可以悄悄进行或大张旗鼓进行；两者各有风险与收益。

若PC选择悄悄方式，他们可以等到夜晚，进行一次DC 24的潜行或盗窃检定，将材料偷偷散发出去。

若他们选择高调方式，他们便组织一场公开集会，抗议凯托的统治并煽动人群，进行一次DC 24的交涉、威吓或表演检定。

成功：PC获得1点起义点数（若采取高调方式则为2点）。

失败：PC不获得起义点数。

大失败：他们引起守卫注意并遭到对峙（悄悄方式为2名守卫，高调方式为4名守卫）。

第3部分：大逃亡
在PC尝试完珍维里克的全部任务后，他们便进入本章第3部分。宴会结束约三周后，随着阿巴迪乌斯临近尾声，PC收到消息：奎斯特终于获准离开，他们应当在码头与他会合，并带上所有想带出城的物品。

时机恰到好处：PC的出发仅比总部遭伊斯嘉军队突袭早了几分钟。无人知晓的是，奥顿·内特尔布拉什早在一段时间前就已被捕。他最终在“镣狱”的酷刑下崩溃，供出了“破狱者”的据点。珍维里克勉强逃脱，连忙赶来向PC报信。

奎斯特催促手下尽快完成准备，谨慎地让他们把箱子在船上摆放好，做出一个藏身处，以便将多人偷运出艾利迪尔。他们的工作被一名守卫的呼喊打断：“头儿，有人来了！”

众人紧绷之际，一个孤零零的身影一瘸一拐走进仓库。那是珍维里克，但她显然刚经历过一场恶战。她用另一只手小心把一只手臂压在胸前，将其护住以免受伤的肢体被震动。她的头发被血糊成一团，一只眼肿得睁不开。

“是军队，他们找到我们了！你们一走他们就动手了，”她强忍疼痛说道，“我勉强逃出来。其他人全都被抓了——他们都被带到镣狱去了！”说到最后一个词时，她的声音破裂，带着啜泣。

PC很可能会有问题要问她，珍维里克则尽力回答。她不知道当局是如何找到总部的，但他们来势汹汹，还直接称呼他们为“破狱者”，显然非常清楚自己闯进了什么地方。

她告诉PC，其他革命者此刻几乎肯定已被送进监狱——她也不知道还能做什么，于是躲了起来，直到确认安全才来找PC。她恳求PC……

After the PCs have attempted all of Jenvirick’s missions, 
they move on to Part 3 of this chapter. About three 
weeks after the gala, as Abadius draws to a close, the 
PCs receive word that Quoster is finally being allowed 
to leave and they should meet him at the docks along 
with everything they wish to take with them out of 
the city.
The timing is serendipitous, as the PCs’ departure 
comes minutes before the headquarters is raided by the 
Isgeri army. Unrealized by anyone, Otton Nettlebrush 
was captured some time ago. He finally broke under 
torture at the Gyve and revealed the Hellbreakers’ 
location. Jenvirick is barely able to escape, and rushes 
to bring word to the PCs.
Quoster urges his men to quickly finish the preparations, 
carefully having them arrange crates on the ship to create 
a hiding place where they can smuggle multiple people 
out of Elidir. Their work is interrupted as a guard calls out,

As everyone tenses, a solitary figure limps into the 
warehouse. It’s Jenvirick, but she’s clearly been in a fight. 
She holds one arm carefully against her chest with the 
other, cradling it to prevent the injured limb from being 
jarred. Her hair is matted with blood, and one eye is swollen 
closed. “It’s the army, they found us! They attacked us 
moments after you left,” she says, clearly in pain. “I barely 
escaped. Everyone else has been captured—they’ve all been 
taken to the Gyve!” Her voice cracks with a sob as the final 
word escapes her lips.

She tells the PCs that the other revolutionaries are 
almost certainly in the prison by now—she didn’t 
know what else to do, so she hid until she knew it 
was safe to come find the PCs. She urges the PCs to

## Page 107
……把他们从监狱里救出来；否则，他们很可能会被公开处决，这几乎会彻底断绝在首都发动任何叛乱的希望。若PC们同意，请朗读或转述以下内容。

“我不觉得你们能直接强攻镣狱——那是自杀。就算你们进得去，也再也出不来。不过我有个主意！我父母的一位朋友参加过地精血战，他总在说那些地精炸弹造成的混乱有多可怕。如果我们能弄到些爆炸物，那就能让你们更容易进出监狱！而且也许我们还能在城里布置一些，引发混乱——当然要远离人群。这样军队就得去处理那些事，没法来追你们。”

詹维里克听说，伦塞洛斯·阿兹里经营着一所退伍军人之家，名为“士兵之庇”，那里还兼作秘密工坊，为军队制造并出售军火。若有哪个地方能在不立刻招来军方震怒的情况下，提供足以让她的计划奏效的爆炸物，那就只有那里了。PC们一旦拿到物资，便可以在恰当的时机将其布置在城内，用以制造分心诱饵。接着，在他们成功进出监狱之后，还需要偷走军队的坐骑——这既能让他们迅速逃离，也能阻止军队追击。PC们也许能在“铺路”（第108页）之后获得一次休息机会，但要警告他们：一旦进入监狱，他们很可能要到逃出城市之后才能再次休息。

拒绝：如果PC们拒绝帮忙，奎斯特会皱起眉头，但仍同意协助他们离开城市。然而，当他们抵达城门时，这次尝试会以失败告终——城门已经关闭；在凯托处决被俘的地狱破坏者之前，他不会允许任何人离开城里。

J. 任务：全副武装
在地精血战之后，伦塞洛斯·阿兹里为其连队成员开设了一所退伍军人之家，名为“士兵之庇”。起初，这是真诚的慈善之举，用以帮助那些在战争中一路协助他的人。然而，随着时间推移，他开始让他们为自己制作魔法军火，以便卖给出价最高的人。“士兵之庇”逐渐从疗养之家转变为一间魔法武器工坊，雇佣的都是被称作“散法战士”（skirmancers）的退伍军人。

“士兵之庇”的墙壁由木板条构成，门也都是木制的。每个房间都有魔法灯光：通常提供昏暗光照；但若房间内有一名散法战士，则改为提供明亮光照。窗户以木制百叶封闭，但可以通过一次成功的DC 22 运动检定将其强行打开。窗户足以让小型生物进入，但中型或更大的生物需要挤入才能通过。以下遭遇使用上方地图。

J1. 门厅（微不足道6）
这间镶板精致的木质前厅中，大门对面的墙上挂着一幅身着军装的伦塞洛斯·阿兹里画像。门边的衣帽架上挂着几件厚外套，旁边的小桶里装着水和一块抹布，用来擦掉泥靴上的污渍。

从外庭院通往门厅的门上了锁。PC可以通过进行三次成功的DC 22 盗贼检定来撬锁。

危害：通往庭院的门被一道魔法陷阱守卫。

immediate ire, that would be it. Once the PCs get the 
supplies, they can set them up in the city to create 
distractions at the proper time. Then, after they get in 
and out of the prison, they’ll need to steal the army’s 
mounts—that will both let them escape quickly and 
prevent the army from following. The PCs might have 
a chance to rest after Prepare the Path (page 108), but 
warn them that once they enter the prison, they likely 
won’t get to rest until they escape the city.
Refusal: If the PCs refuse to help, Quoster frowns 
but agrees that he’ll still help them leave the city. 
However, that attempt is foiled when they arrive at the 
gates and find that they’ve been closed—Caeto isn’t 
allowing anyone to leave the city until he’s executed 
the captured Hellbreakers.
J. MISSION: UP IN ARMS
After the Goblinblood Wars, Rencelos Azri opened 
a veteran’s home called Soldier’s Aegis for members 
of his company. In the beginning, this was a genuine 
act of charity for those who’d aided him throughout 
the war. In time, however, he began having them 
craft magical munitions for him to sell to the highest 
bidder. Soldier’s Aegis slowly transformed from respite 
home to a magical arms workshop staffed by veterans 
known as skirmancers.
Soldier’s Aegis’s walls are wooden slats, and the 
doors are wood. It has magical lights in each room 
that provide dim light unless one of the skirmancers is 
in the room, in which case it provides bright light. The 
windows are closed with wooden shutters, but can be 
Forced Open with a successful DC 22 Athletics check. 
The windows are big enough for a Small creature 
to enter, but Medium or larger creatures need to 
Squeeze through. Use the map above for the following 
encounters.

J2. 休息室
数张厚垫扶手椅与小边桌散落在这间舒适的房间里。魔法光照亮了角落；沿墙的书架上摆着许多书卷。一只酒架里放着十余瓶葡萄酒，旁边还配有水晶高脚杯。

J3. 奥术铁匠房
琐碎6
魔法与炼金的刺鼻气味弥漫在空气中。一册法术书漂浮在这间木制房间地板上的一处银色仪式法阵内，法阵上刻着力量的奥术符文。架子上摆放着各类魔法枢机与其他制造要素，均被细心收纳并贴上标签。

散兵匠在这间房里进行魔法制造；房间内的防护结界法阵为他们提供保护。法阵启动时，会阻止任何事物穿越其边界。位于法阵中的生物，对来自该区域外的任何攻击，其AC获得+2状态加值。此外，试图进入法阵的生物必须进行DC 22 意志豁免。失败时，法阵会停止其移动（不过，只要满足需求，他们仍可尝试任何作为某个行动一部分的其他动作，例如“突袭冲锋”中的一次打击）。大失败时，整个行动结束，且该生物陷入震慑1。无法在法阵内召唤生物；而具有魔法特征或被召唤（特征）的生物若试图进入法阵，则其豁免结果视为降低一级。

生物：一名散兵匠正在结界法阵中工作。他们会留在法阵内，寄望其魔法保护自己，并以致命意图回应任何入侵者。若阿兹里一家在休息室内，散兵匠一旦听见战斗便会冲过去支援。他的生命值降至10或更低时会投降。

散兵匠法师（SKIRMANCER MAGE）
生物5

J4. 金库
散兵匠将尚未售出的物品存放在这处隐藏金库里。
宝藏：金库目前存放一面殉道者之盾（第214页）、一枚刻有创伤符文的符石，以及一枚高等烟雾球。

J5. 试验场
低等6
覆盖这间房墙面的草垫上满是撕裂与划痕，露出其下的金属加固结构；然而即便是那些金属也带着缺口与凹痕，显示它们遭受了大量摧残。房间东北角张着一口深坑，坑口的石缘布满崩裂与焦黑。

这里是散兵匠测试军火的地方。深坑深15尺；攀爬出坑所需的运动检定DC为15。

生物：一名散兵匠正在此处工作，旁边还有一具用于测试魔法武装的构装体。散兵匠沉浸于自己的工作，不会注意到外面的战斗声响，但若PC们进入房间，她会发动攻击。她的生命值降至10或更低时会投降。发条士兵会攻击任何进入房间的PC，但不会离开此处，将战斗到被摧毁为止。

J2. Lounge
Several thickly padded chairs and side tables are scattered 
around this comfortable room. Magical light illuminates the 
corners where bookcases along the walls hold a number of 
titles. A dozen bottles of wine fill a rack, which also holds 
crystal goblets.
The Azris take care of the skirmancers whose 
creations make them so much money, and have 
maintained this lounge for them to relax when they’re 
not working. A small bathroom connects to the lounge 
through a door to the west. It includes a secret door to 
the vault, which can be discovered with a successful 
DC 22 Perception check.
Creatures: If the Azris weren’t taken to the Gyve at 
the end of the Talisman Job, they retreated here. They 
respond to intruders with lethal intent even if they 
recognize the PCs.

CREATURE 6

Initiative Perception +15

CREATURE 4

J3. Arcane Smithy	
Trivial 6
The acrid smell of magic and alchemy permeates the air. A 
spellbook floats in a silver ritual circle with arcane runes 
of power set in the floor of this wooden room. Shelves 
hold various magical loci and other crafting elements, all 
carefully stored and labeled.
The skirmancers use this room, with its protective 
warding circle, for their magical crafting. While 
activated, the circle prevents anything from crossing. 
Creatures in the circle gain a +2 status bonus to AC 
against any attacks made from outside the area. In 
addition, a creature that attempts to enter the circle 
must make a DC 22 Will save. On a failure, the circle 
stops their movement (though they can still attempt 
any other actions that were part of an activity as long 
as they meet the requirements, such as a Strike that 
is part of a Sudden Charge). On a critical failure, 
the entire activity ends and the creature becomes 
stunned 1. A creature cannot be summoned inside the 
circle, and a creature with the magical or summoned 
trait that tries to enter the circle treats the results of its 
save as one degree worse.
Creatures: A skirmancer is working here in the 
warding circle. They remain in the circle, hoping its 
magic will protect them, and they respond to any 
intruders with deadly intent. If the Azris are in the 
lounge, the skirmancer rushes in to help them if they 
hear combat. The skirmancer surrenders if reduced to 
10 Hit Points or fewer.
SKIRMANCER MAGE	
CREATURE 5
Variant watchmage (Pathfinder NPC Core 115)
Initiative Perception +15
Arcane Prepared Spells DC 20, attack +12; 3rd haste, 
paralyze; 2nd blood vendetta, telekinetic maneuver; 1st 
force barrage, runic weapon, sure strike; Cantrips (3rd) 
ignition, live wire, prestidigitation, shield, telekinetic 
projectile
Treasure: The skirmancer’s spellbook, worth 128 
gp, includes the spells the skirmancer knows: fireball, 
gravity well, dispelling globe, and two additional 
arcane spells of the GM’s choice.
J4. Vault
The skirmancers keep items that haven’t been sold yet 
in this hidden vault.
Treasure: The vault currently holds a martyr’s shield 
(page 214), a runestone with a wounding rune, and a 
greater smoke ball.
J5. Proving Ground	
Low 6
Tears and slashes in the hay padding which covers the 
walls of this room reveal metal reinforcements, though 
even those bear nicks and dents that indicate they 
take a large amount of abuse. A pit yawns open in the 
northeast corner of the room, the stone rim chipped and 
blackened.
This is where the skirmancers test their munitions. 
The pit is 15 feet deep and the DC for Athletics checks 
to Climb out of it is 15.
Creatures: A skirmancer is working here, along 
with a construct used to test magical armaments. The 
skirmancer is absorbed in her work and doesn’t notice 
any sounds of combat from outside, but attacks if the 
PCs enter the room. She surrenders if reduced to 10 
Hit Points or fewer. The clockwork soldier attacks 
any PCs that enter the room, but doesn’t leave the 
room, fighting until destroyed.

宝藏：PC可以在坑里找到大量尚未爆炸的冰封熔岩。其确切数量不作规定，因为预计PC会在本章剩余部分将其中的大部分用于炸开通往监狱的道路，然后再从艾利迪尔炸出一条逃生通道。他们可以保留2份冰封熔岩与1份永恒喷发供个人使用。

J6. 锻炉
南墙边的炉火将这间屋子烘得滚热。工匠工具占据了区域的大部分空间，包括用于锻打金属的铁砧、锤子和钳子，以及用于加工木材的凿子与刨子。门旁的墙上架子上摆着几只贴了标签的药水瓶。

斯奇曼斯们在这间由厨房改造而成的铁匠铺里，制作他们所用的各类实体器具。

宝藏：架子上放着两瓶中级治疗药水，原本用于在制作过程中或在区域K5的测试中，帮助任何受伤者。

任务：准备道路
在成功从老兵家中取得补给后，PC如今必须将冰封熔岩安置在最理想的位置，以便在他们最后逃离城市时造成大规模混乱。这样做会使用下述特殊行动。每名PC最多可以尝试该行动3次，但第二次尝试时会获得2点镇压点数，第三次尝试时会获得3点镇压点数，因为他们的活动会吸引注意。

安置炸弹（专注　探索　秘密）
你花费1小时寻找安置爆炸物的最佳位置，以便在从“枷锁”（Gyve）逃脱时获得最理想的收益。使用合适的学识（例如艾利迪尔学识、工程学识或战争学识）进行一次DC20检定，或进行一次DC22的制作、社交或隐匿检定。

They can keep 2 frozen lavas and an eternal eruption for their personal use.

J6. Forge
A fire in the forge against the southern wall fills this room with heat. Crafter’s tools fill much of the area, including an anvil, hammer, and tongs for working with metals, as well as chisels and planes for shaping wood. A shelf built on the wall near the door holds several labeled potion bottles.

The skirmancers craft the physical implements they use in this kitchen-turned-smithy.

Treasure: The shelf holds two moderate healing potions intended to help anyone injured during the crafting process or during tests in area K5.

MISSION: PREPARE THE PATH
Having successfully obtained supplies from the veteran’s home, the PCs now must place the frozen lava in the most optimal locations to cause mass chaos during their final escape from the city. Doing so uses the following special activity. A PC can attempt the activity up to three times, but they gain 2 Suppression Points the second time they try and 3 Suppression Points the third time as their activities attract attention.

PLACE BOMB
CONCENTRATE EXPLORATION SECRET
You spend an hour finding the best location to place an explosive to provide the optimum benefit during the escape from the Gyve. Attempt a DC 20 check with an appropriate Lore (such as Elidir Lore, Engineering Lore, or Warfare Lore) or a DC 22 Crafting, Society, or Stealth check.

Map labels: K1, K2, K3a, K3b, K4, K5, K6, K7, K8, K9, K10, K11, K12, K13, K13a, K13b

## Page 110
大成功 你获得2点火山扰乱点，如同“成功”所述。

成功 你获得1点火山扰乱点。在“同生共死”起义期间（见第114页）进行任何检定之前，你可以花费1点火山扰乱点，描述冻结熔岩如何提供帮助——要么清理道路，要么分散追兵注意力，或对追兵造成伤害。如此做会使成功等级提升1级。

失败 你未能正确安放冻结熔岩。

大失败 如同失败，且你获得1点灾害点，使你的该次检定的成功等级降低1级。你必须在“同生共死”期间的一次检定中使用你的灾害点；否则你将因冻结熔岩在你身上爆炸而受到5d6伤害。

【内容警告】
“桎梏”刻意被设计成一处可怖之地——一座以制造痛苦为目的的监狱，并包含对酷刑的提及。在你开始之前，请理解玩家同意（包括游戏主持人的同意）对每个人都能拥有安全且愉快的游戏体验至关重要。你应在开始本次冒险前与玩家沟通，并视情况调整叙事描述。

K. 任务：打破镣铐
当PC完成准备后，他们可以在任何时候开始对“桎梏”的突袭。监狱使用第108页的地图，由维护良好的砖石结构建成（硬度14，HP 56【破损阈值28】、攀爬DC 22），天花板高10英尺。其门与闸门为木制（硬度10，HP 40【破损阈值20】），除非另有注明，否则均上锁。要撬锁需要在DC 22盗贼检定上获得两次成功；或可用DC 27运动检定强行开启。窗户装有铁栅栏，但因政府将有限资源投入其他优先事项而维护不善——其硬度10，HP 40（破损阈值20），并可在一次成功的DC 24运动检定下强行打开。一层的火把在整个区域内提供明亮光照。除非另有说明，监狱其余部分处于黑暗之中。

如果PC想了解更多关于监狱的信息，他们可以尝试一次DC 20社交检定以回忆知识，或一次DC 22交涉检定以搜集信息。成功时，他们得知囚犯被关押在上层，而地窖里有一间刑讯室。大成功时，他们得知监狱的具体情况：给他们一张一层、二层与三层的地图，但不要让他们知道通往区域K5的秘密入口在哪里。

Jenvirick强烈建议PC炸开监狱外围墙壁的一处洞口进入——他们可以使用从“士兵的庇护”取得的补给来完成。允许他们在外墙上选择一个想安放炸弹的位置。炸弹爆炸后，会炸出一个5英尺宽的缺口，PC可以利用它直接进入“混乱场”（区域K2），并从那里进入“桎梏”。如果他们拥有火山扰乱点，则可以花费1点在“桎梏”的外墙上、或在监狱本体上再制造一个额外的5英尺洞口。

有些PC可能想尝试更隐蔽的方式。其中一个选择——Jenvirick强烈不建议——是让自己被捕。他们可以通过街道巡逻非常容易地做到这一点（使用第65页的“出示证件”遭遇）。这会让他们经由“炼狱”进入监狱，再通过“下行”主入口进入，但守卫会没收任何护甲、武器与魔法物品，除非这些物品以潜行或魔法成功藏匿。他们也可以尝试用一笔可观的贿赂（300+ gp）或一次极其困难的交涉检定（DC 30）在内部安插一个人手，但这可能会耗费他们无法承受的时间。

如果有PC想冒充守卫，通过一名NPC警告他们：守卫每天都有一句用于互相识别的口令。PC闯入的当天口令是：“比霜龙的吐息还冷。”PC必须找到一名守卫，并通过DC 27交涉检定或DC 29威吓检定从其口中套出口令。

K1. 炼狱 低微6
监狱那阴森的门扉，等待着那些注定沉沦之人。

通往监狱场地的入口通道如同一道气闸——内外两道门从不会在同一时间开启。依Caeto之令，在地狱破局者被处决之前，监狱处于封锁状态。这里驻守着三名守卫，持有两道门的钥匙，但他们只会为说出口令的守卫开门。本区域北侧与南侧的门为铁制，硬度18，HP 72（破损阈值36），强行开启DC为27。

生物：守卫只有在听到正确口令时才会开门。否则，若PC进入本区域，守卫会发动攻击。守卫会战斗到HP降至10为止，此时他们会尝试投降或逃跑。若守卫听到“混乱场”中的骚动（例如PC以爆炸方式闯入），他们会赶去调查，很可能在区域K2与PC遭遇。

K. MISSION: BREAK THE FETTERS
Once the PCs finish their preparations, they can begin 
their assault on the Gyve at any time. The prison uses 
the map on page 108 and is made of well-maintained 
masonry (Hardness 14, HP 56 [BT 28], Climb DC 22), 
with 10-foot-high ceilings. Its doors and portcullises 
are wood (Hardness 10, HP 40 [BT 20]) and are locked 
unless otherwise noted. They require two successes 
on a DC 22 Thievery check to Pick the Lock or can 
be Forced Open with a DC 27 Athletics check. The 
windows are barred with iron, but have been poorly 
maintained while the government has used its limited 
resources on other priorities—they have Hardness 
10, HP 40 (BT 20), and can be Forced Open with a 
successful DC 24 Athletics check. Torches on the first 
floor provide bright light throughout the area. The rest 
of the prison is in darkness unless indicated otherwise.
If the PCs wish to know more about the prison, 
they can attempt a DC 20 Society check to Recall 
Knowledge or a DC 22 Diplomacy check to Gather 
Information. On a success, they learn that prisoners 
are kept on the upper floors, while a torture chamber 
is in the basement. On a critical success, they learn 
specifics about the prison: Give them a map of the first, 
second, and third floor, though don’t let them know 
where the secret entrance to area K5 is.
Jenvirick strongly recommends the PCs blow a 
hole in the surrounding walls of the prison to enter, 
which they can do with supplies they’ve acquired 
from Soldier’s Aegis. Allow them to pick a spot on the 
outer walls where they want to set a bomb. When it 
explodes, it blows a 5-foot-wide gap the PCs can use 
to enter directly into the Moil (area K2), and from 
there the Gyve. If they have Volcanic Diversion Points, 
they can spend 1 to create an additional 5-foot hole in 
the Gyve’s outer wall, or in the prison itself.
Some PCs might want to try a stealthier approach. 
One option—which Jenvirick strongly recommends 
against—is to get themselves arrested. They can do 
this very easily via street patrol (use the Papers, Please 
encounter on page 65). This would bring them into 
the prison via Purgatory and then the main entrance 
to the Descent, but the guards would take any 
armor, weapons, and magic items unless they were 
successfully concealed with Stealth or magic. They 
could also attempt to get a man on the inside through 
a hefty bribe of 300+ gp or an extremely difficult 
Diplomacy check (DC 30), but this might take time 
they can’t afford.
If a PC wants to impersonate a guard, warn them 
through a NPC that the guards have a daily code 
phrase that they use to identify themselves. The phrase 
on the day the PCs break in is “It’s colder than a rime 
dragon’s breath,” and the PCs must find a guard and 
get the code out of them with a DC 27 Diplomacy 
check or a DC 29 Intimidation check.
K1. Purgatory	
Trivial 6
The grim gates of the prison await those doomed.
The entranceway to the prison grounds acts as an 
airlock—the interior and exterior gates are never 
opened at the same time. By Caeto’s orders, the 
prison is under lockdown until the Hellbreakers 
have been executed. Three guards are stationed here, 
with keys for both gates, but they’ll only open them 
for guards with the pass phrase. The gates to the 
north and south of this area are iron, with Hardness 
18, and 72 HP (Broken Threshold 36), and the DC 
to Force them Open is 27.
Creatures: The guards only open the gates if they 
hear the proper pass phrase. Otherwise, if the PCs 
enter this area, they attack. They fight until reduced 
to 10 HP, at which point they attempt to surrender 
or flee. If the guards hear a disturbance in the Moil 
(such as an explosive entrance by the PCs), they rush 
to investigate, likely encountering the PCs in area K2.
CONTENT WARNING
The Gyve is intentionally a horrible place, a 
prison designed to cause suffering and includes 
mention of torture. Before you begin, understand 
that player consent (including that of the Game 
Master) is vital to a safe and fun play experience 
for everyone. You should talk with your players 
before beginning the adventure and modify 
descriptions of the narrative as appropriate.

宝藏：除其所列道具外，守门卫兵还携带通往“炼狱”之门以及监狱外部各门的钥匙。

K2. 苦役场
简陋的棚屋与帆布顶篷倚靠在这片院落的墙边。大堆木材与其他原材料堆放在旁，散落在院中，供“镣铐”里的囚犯使用。破旧生锈的镣铐碎裂地躺在地上，是这座院落往昔的残迹。

监狱附设的旧奴隶拍卖场在4722 AR《解放典范》后被改造成劳改营。欠债者与轻罪犯被判在此劳动，通过制作军队所需的物资来赚取铜币，以偿还其债务。此处露天，可能会根据PC们发动袭击的时间而有不同的照明。囚犯都被锁在室内，因此这里空无一人（要么因为是夜晚，要么因为凯托的封锁命令），没有任何值得注意或有价值的东西。

K3. 瞭望塔 低威胁6
这座石塔高出监狱围墙10尺。两盏牛眼提灯固定在墙上，一架弩炮朝向监狱场地内部。

苦役场的东西两侧各有一座孪生塔楼，驻守的卫兵负责警戒逃犯。一层（K3a）有一架梯子通往一处活板门。若卫兵看见有人进入塔楼一层，他们会把活板门锁上。自塔顶（K3b）的射界实际上覆盖了院落中该塔所对应的一半区域，但也使卫兵无法瞄准位于监狱场地远侧的敌人。

生物：此处昼夜都有三名卫兵驻守，无论如何都不会离开塔楼。如果他们在苦役场看见PC，就会从这里向其射击；炮手用他们的动作操控弩炮（《枪炮与道具》74），狙击手则使用自己的武器。若在夜间，狙击手会调整提灯，使PC保持在光照之下。若PC进入塔楼，卫兵会转为近战。他们会战斗至生命值降至10点，此时会尝试投降或逃跑。

K2. Moil
Makeshift buildings and canvas canopies lean against 
the walls of this courtyard. Large piles of wood and 
other raw materials sit next to them, scattered about the 
yard for use by the prisoners of the Gyve. Old, rusted 
manacles lie broken on the ground, remnants of the 
courtyard’s past.
The former slave auction attached to the prison was 
transformed into a labor camp after the Emancipation 
Edict in 4722 ar. Debtors and minor criminals are 
sentenced to work here, earning coppers to pay off 
their obligations by crafting supplies used by the army. 
This area is open to the sky and might have lighting 
based on the time of day the PCs attack. The prisoners 
are locked inside, so the area is empty (either because 
it’s night or because of Caeto’s lockdown orders) with 
nothing of note or value.
K3. Guard Tower	
Low 6
This stone tower rises 10 feet above the prison walls. Two 
bull’s-eye lanterns are mounted on the walls, and a ballista 
points in toward the prison grounds.
Twin towers to the east and west of the Moil house 
guards who watch for escapees. A ladder on the first 
floor (K3a) goes up to a trapdoor. If the guards see 
someone enter the first floor of the tower, they lock 
the trapdoor. The range of fire from the top of the 
tower (K3b) effectively includes the tower’s entire 
half of the court yard, but prevents the guards 
from targeting enemies on the far side of the prison 
grounds.
Creatures: Three guards are stationed in this area, 
day or night, and don’t leave the tower under any 
circumstances. If they see PCs in the Moil, they shoot 
at them from this location, with the artillerists using 
their actions to operate the ballista (Guns & Gears 
74) and the sniper using his own weapons. If it’s night, 
the sniper turns the lanterns to keep the PCs in light. 
If the PCs enter the tower, the guards switch to melee 
combat. They fight until reduced to 10 HP, at which 
point they attempt to surrender or flee.

## Page 112
此处之所以得名，是因为这条蜿蜒的通道通往“桎梏”这座地狱。通道绕过卫兵室，为狱卒提供了多次机会，向任何试图从主入口逃脱（或未经许可进入——不过在桎梏里，几乎所有人都会对有人胆敢这么做感到困惑）的人射箭。

囚犯会被强制换上以薄而粗糙的麻布制成的囚衣，囚衣挂在主入口以西的挂钩上。抵达囚犯被没收的任何随身物品，要么被守卫据为己有，要么被销毁。

K5. 卫兵室（威胁 6）
这间明亮的房间里有一张小桌子和几把椅子，让人能从冰冷、严酷的监狱环境中稍得喘息。墙上的箭窗便于观察外面的蜿蜒走廊。

守卫不巡逻时会在此休息，并留意“下行道”里是否有人。作为防范囚犯的额外措施，这扇门被隐藏起来；但每天多次开合使其位置更加明显。进行一次成功的DC 22 察觉检定即可找到。

生物：此房间始终驻扎4名守卫。若他们处于戒备状态，会从本室的箭窗向K4区域内的任何人开火。除非有人说出正确的口令短语，否则他们不会打开暗门。若他们听见有人试图未经许可打开暗门，就会移动到房间远端，以便在任何人进入时射箭，直到他们进入近战。一名守卫被打到10生命值时会投降；若有3名守卫被杀或投降，剩下的第4名守卫在被打到20生命值时也会投降——前提是PC没有攻击过任何试图投降的守卫。

精英弓箭哨兵（3） 生物 3
《Pathfinder NPC Core》5、111
先攻 察觉 +13

雇佣法师 生物 3
《Pathfinder NPC Core》82
先攻 察觉 +7

宝藏：此房间存有供守卫值勤时使用的武器——PC可以找到任意他们想要的常见武器。PC还可以找到若干违禁品与没收物品，总价值50 gp。此处的守卫持有能开启监狱内任何门的钥匙。

K6. 厨房
厨房的大壁炉里放着一口沉重的铁锅，浓郁鲜香的气味充满房间。一张木桌占据了房间的大部分空间，桌面的工作区布满深深的刀痕；各种烹饪器具挂在墙上。

PC发动袭击时，厨房里无人工作，使他们有机会在此短暂休息，以进行治疗伤势或再专注。

宝藏：锅里正为次日将被安排去做最危险工作的囚犯准备4剂修补者浓汤（《宝藏金库》49）。PC可以立刻食用；若他们有容器，也可以将其带走。桌上还有一瓶高等口粮补剂。

K7. 储藏室
此室墙边摆着一排上锁的箱子，箱子上方的架子上放满贴有整齐标签的瓶子。

此处用于临时存放在“泥沼”中制作、但价值高得不适合留在工区的物品。只有典狱长有此房间的钥匙，而她除非有人送入物品，否则不会打开。此房间的锁为普通锁，需要4次成功的DC 25 盗窃检定。

本室火把只在使用时点燃；除非PC提供光源，否则这里处于黑暗。

宝藏：PC可在此找到一些尚未交付军队的贵重补给品，这些补给品在“泥沼”中制作完成。瓶中装有3瓶次等生命灵药、3瓶次等瓶装宣泄，以及2剂涌动力血清。箱子里有一对利爪护臂与一枚刻有就绪符文的符文石。

K8. 拘押室A
肮脏的稻草覆盖着房间地面，部分地方堆成粗糙的睡铺；污渍斑斑、令人不快的床单是唯一的毯子。

被判在“泥沼”劳动的囚犯，在不工作时会睡在这间共用牢房里。此房间没有火把；若PC在白天抵达，从带栅栏的窗户透入的光线会使整个区域处于昏暗光照，否则这里是黑暗。

在PC被捕时，这里关押着12名不同年龄与族裔的人。若PC释放他们，将其镇压点数减少1，因为军队资源会被分流去重新抓捕他们。PC也可以尝试招募他们，进行一次DC 22 交涉检定。若成功，
