Named because it’s the path into the hell that is 
the Gyve, this winding passage leads around the 
guardhouse, giving jailers multiple opportunities to 
fire arrows at anyone trying to escape through the 
main entrance (or enter without permission, though 
the idea someone would attempt that would baffle 
almost everyone in the Gyve). Prisoners are forced 
to change into prison robes made of a thin, scratchy 
burlap, which hang from hooks to the west of the 
main entrance. Any possessions taken from arriving 
prisoners are claimed by the guards or destroyed.
K5. Guardhouse	
Low 6
This well-lit room holds a small table and chairs, offering 
relief from the cold, stark prison environment. Arrow 
slits on the walls allow easy view of the winding corridor 
outside.
The guards relax here and watch for anyone in the 
Descent when they’re not patrolling. The door to 
the room is hidden as an added precaution against 
prisoners, though being opened multiple times a day 
has made its location more obvious; it can be found 
with a successful DC 22 Perception check.
Creatures: Four guards are stationed in this room 
at all times. If they are on alert, they open fire through 
the arrow slits in this room at anyone in area K4. They 
don’t open the secret door unless someone gives the 
correct code phrase. If they hear anyone try to open 
the secret door without permission, they move to the 
far side of the room so they can fire arrows at anyone 
who enters until they enter melee. Once a guard is 
reduced to 10 Hit Points, they surrender; if three 
guards are killed or surrender, the fourth surrenders 
when they’re reduced to 20 Hit Points as long as the 
PCs haven’t attacked another guard who attempted 
to surrender.

K6. Kitchen
A heavy iron cauldron sits in the large fireplace of this 
kitchen, filling the room with a rich, savory scent. A wooden 
table with a heavily scarred work surface fills much of the 
room, and various cooking implements hang on the wall.
No one is working in the kitchen at the time of the 
PCs’ attack, giving them an opportunity to rest here 
briefly to Treat Wounds or Refocus.
Treasure: The cauldron contains four doses of 
mender’s soup (Treasure Vault 49) being prepared for 
inmates scheduled to work on the most dangerous 
tasks the next day. The PCs can eat it immediately, or 
if they have containers, take it with them. There is also 
a greater ration tonic on the table.
K7. Storeroom
Closed chests line the walls of this room beneath shelves 
laden with neatly labeled bottles.
This room is used to temporarily store goods created 
in the Moil that are too valuable to leave in the work 
areas. Only the warden has the keys to this room, and 
she doesn’t unlock it except when someone is bringing 
in items. The room has an average lock, requiring 
four successful DC 25 Thievery checks. The torches in 
this room are only lit when it’s in use; it’s in darkness 
except for any light provided by the PCs.
Treasure: PCs can find a number of valuable supplies 
here, crafted in the Moil but not yet delivered to the 
army. The bottles hold 3 lesser elixirs of life, 3 lesser 
bottled catharsis, and 2 surging serums. In the chests 
are clawed bracers and a runestone with a ready rune.
K8. Holding Cell A

## Page 113
【是谁？】
被关押在区域K13的两名“破狱者”并未给出姓名。如果PC与任何一位招募对象建立了联系，这里或许很适合让他们登场，但要谨慎衡量这是否会让人过于难受。

许多囚犯同意加入，PC获得1点起义点数；若为大成功，他们全都热情加入，PC获得2点起义点数。
若PC在第4章（第76页）允许奥兹妮被逮捕，她可以在这里找到。然而她认出PC，并大声宣称他们毫无悔意地任由她被扔进镣狱，令PC在此处进行的任何【交涉】检定承受–1环境减值。

K9. 拘押牢房B（低6级）
陈旧汗臭弥漫在这间大通铺牢房里，那股恶臭更添被关在此处的痛苦。几堆稻草与亚麻布拼成的“床铺”，只会更凸显这里有多么糟糕。

破坏规矩或惹恼看守的囚犯会被转移到拘押牢房B。此处的光照条件与另一间牢房相同。

危害：当PC打开门时，本牢房的囚犯抓住机会试图逃跑，碾压路径上的任何人。

越狱危害 7
复杂 环境
隐匿 +21

描述 一群囚犯为争取自由发起冲逃，践踏前路上的一切。

解除 DC 27【运动】以阻止囚犯前进；DC 30【交涉】以与人群讲道理；或DC 27【威吓】以震慑他们冷静下来。

AC 22；强韧+18，反射+12，意志+20
HP 62（破损阈值31）；弱点：区域伤害6，溅射伤害6

冲向自由 反应动作（） 触发 拘押牢房B的门被打开；效果 危害抓向门口20尺内任意生物的武器，以+19调整值尝试对其进行缴械，然后掷先攻。

例行程序（1动作）囚犯朝出口践踏冲去，对区域K9以及其北侧走廊内的每个活体生物造成2d10+9钝击伤害（DC 25基础反射豁免）。若为大失败，该生物对其所携带物品的握持会被削弱，仿佛危害在一次缴械尝试中成功一般。若其握持已被削弱，则会掉落该物品。

特殊 若PC在4轮后仍未击败该危害，则危害自动结束，因为所有囚犯都已逃脱。

发展 若PC在危害自动结束前解除危害，但未将其HP降至0，他们可以尝试一次DC 22【交涉】检定以说服剩余囚犯加入他们。成功则PC获得1点起义点数；若为大成功则获得2点。

K10. 工具间
这间房的北门与南门之间，有一道因频繁旅行而略微凹陷的小径。工具挂在墙上的钩子上。

用于在泥沼作业的工具存放于此，每天早晨在看守监督下领取，每晚归还。

宝藏：除了几乎任何类型的长短手工具外，PC还能找到一把杠杆撬棍，以及足够制作两枚次级银屑炸弹（第209页）的装备。

K11. 牢房区（低6级）
这条由黑色石材构成的走廊两侧排列着结实的木门，每扇门上在头部高度处都有一块小木板。偶尔的呻吟、啜泣与其他声响——甚至是失心疯般的笑声——从牢房内飘出。此区域充斥着痛苦的恶臭，以及未洗净的身体与排泄物所散发的瘴气。

牢房区的外侧走廊没有照明，处于黑暗中。内侧“庭院”点着几根低燃的蜡烛，使该区域处于昏暗光照——这是给那些被关在该处、表现较好的囚犯的一点小小特权。西侧墙上有两间略大的牢房，每间各有一扇小窗——通常分配给向看守告密的囚犯。每扇牢门上的小木板都可以打开，以便看守（或PC）向内查看。

生物：若PC成功完成“护符差事”，阿兹里家族成员会被关押在这里。由于他们被捕多半只是为了作秀，他们的牢门保持不上锁，并被允许作为特权在这一层自由走动。PC进入后，阿兹里会认出他们在先前遭遇中的身份，愤怒地发起攻击！这两名敌人会一次集中火力对付一个目标，并互相照应背后。若阿兹里未被逮捕，PC可以毫无阻碍地解救他们的伙伴。

K11. Cell Block	
Low 6
A small wooden panel at head height sits in each of the 
solid wooden doors that line this hallway of dark stone. 
Occasional moans, sobs and other noises—even unhinged 
laughter—drift out from inside the cells. The stench of 
misery fills this area along with the miasma of unwashed 
bodies and excreta.
This outer hallway of the cell block is unlit and 
in darkness. A few candles burn low in the inner 
“courtyard,” leaving that area in dim light, a very 
small privilege for the better-behaved inmates that 
are kept in those cells. Two slightly larger cells in the 
western wall have one small window each—they’re 
typically given to prisoners who inform on their fellow 
inmates to the guards. The panel in each cell door can 
be opened to allow guards (or PCs) to look in.
Creatures: If the PCs successfully completed the 
Talisman Job, the Azris have been imprisoned here. 
As they’ve mostly been arrest for the optics, their cell 
doors are kept unlocked and they’re free to roam the 
floor as a special privilege. When the PCs enter, the 
Azris recognize them from previous encounters and 
attack in a rage! The pair focus on a single target at 
a time and protect each other’s backs. If the Azris 
weren’t arrested, the PCs can free their companions 
without issue.

Development: If the PCs Disable the hazard without reducing it to 0 HP before it automatically ends, they can attempt a DC 22 Diplomacy check to get the remaining prisoners to join them. On a success, the PCs gain 1 Uprising Point, or 2 points on a critical success.

K10. Tool Bin
A slightly indented path from constant travel stretches between the north and south doors of this room. Tools hang from hooks on the walls.

Tools for working in the Moil are kept here, collected under guard each morning and returned each night.

Treasure: In addition to almost any type of long or short tool here, PCs can find a levered crowbar and enough equipment to Craft two lesser silverscrap bombs (page 209).

K11. Cell Block Low 6
A small wooden panel at head height sits in each of the solid wooden doors that line this hallway of dark stone. Occasional moans, sobs and other noises—even unhinged laughter—drift out from inside the cells. The stench of misery fills this area along with the miasma of unwashed bodies and excreta.

This outer hallway of the cell block is unlit and in darkness. A few candles burn low in the inner “courtyard,” leaving that area in dim light, a very small privilege for the better-behaved inmates that are kept in those cells. Two slightly larger cells in the western wall have one small window each—they’re typically given to prisoners who inform on their fellow inmates to the guards. The panel in each cell door can be opened to allow guards (or PCs) to look in.

Creatures: If the PCs successfully completed the Talisman Job, the Azris have been imprisoned here. As they’ve mostly been arrest for the optics, their cell doors are kept unlocked and they’re free to roam the floor as a special privilege. When the PCs enter, the Azris recognize them from previous encounters and attack in a rage! The pair focus on a single target at a time and protect each other’s backs. If the Azris weren’t arrested, the PCs can free their companions without issue.

发展：几乎所有被俘的“破狱者”——除了两名正在K13区域接受审讯的成员之外——都被关在此处这些狭小、无光照的牢房里。他们知道失踪的破狱者们被带进了监狱，但并不知道此后发生了什么。

这些囚犯中有奥顿（Otton），他在遭受逼供折磨后被扔回这里，状况极其糟糕。他含泪道歉并解释：自己被抓后一直试图保持沉默，但最终还是告诉了施虐者破狱者们的会面地点。若PC对奥顿表现出善意，“破狱者同盟”的声望点数增加1点。

K12. 典狱长塔楼（Warden’s Tower）
中等 6
这间六边形房间陈设考究：深色石质地面上铺着地毯，有栅栏的窗户之间的墙上挂着朴素的墨线画。一张大木桌立于房间中央，上面堆满纸张。桌后是一把巨大的、如王座般的椅子；桌前有三把较小的椅子，其中两把在扶手与椅腿处装有皮带。

典狱长以此办公室将监狱当作个人王国来统治。较小的椅子供她的下属使用，或偶尔用于约束并带来受访的囚犯。此区域以永光水晶照明，因此这里始终处于明亮光照。

生物：典狱长伊尔卡泽（Irkazer；冷酷的女性人类典狱长8级）在此塔楼统管监狱。她日夜工作，任何时候都可能在这里出现。她会攻击任何闯入的PC，并战至死方休。

典狱长 伊尔卡泽（WARDEN IRKAZER）
生物 8
宪兵（《Pathfinder NPC Core》117）
先攻 察觉 +19

发展：若PC在击败典狱长后搜查房间，他们能在她桌上找到关于破狱者被囚的记录。其内容包括一些笔记，表明当局是在抓获奥顿并对其折磨数日后，才得知破狱者的藏身处。他们也能得知：几乎所有破狱者都被关在囚室区，唯有两人仍在地下室；在那里，监狱拷问者罗维米·斯卡菲（Rovimi Scaphe；虐待狂的女性人类拷问者6级）仍在试图从他们口中榨取关于PC可能下落的情报。

典狱长持有监狱内所有区域的钥匙；她桌上一张纸还记录着每日通行口令。

宝藏：典狱长房间里有一只箱子，内含五根银锭。

K13. 地牢（Oubliette）
低 6
潮湿的寒意弥漫于这间圆形地下室。黑石上不断滴落的水珠形成持续的淅沥声，仿佛被放大成诡异回响，并很快变得单调。生锈的镣铐从天花板与墙上垂下。在主室里，坟穴般的泥土气味之下隐约透出血的铁腥味。房间中央在天花板悬挂的滑轮系统下方放着一架刑具台，在火盆的光照下清晰可见。残酷的烙铁、刀刃与其他刑具挂在后墙。

“镣铐”监狱的狱卒在这间为折磨受害者一切感官而设计的刑讯室中，从囚犯口中榨取供词——不论真假。受害者会被吊在前室（K13a）的手铐上，被迫聆听他人的惨叫；另一些人则在主区（K13）等待，被迫目睹即将降临于己的命运。

此处关着两名破狱者俘虏，他们都被锁链吊在主室里，而拷问者正为下一场审讯团期做准备。

此区域保持良好照明，既为了让囚犯看清等待他们的是什么，也为了与上方昏暗牢房形成对比。此处奇异的回声特性会增强噪声——任何造成音波伤害的效果都会额外造成1点音波溅射伤害。

生物：除被上铐的破狱者外，监狱的首席审讯官也在此，身边带着一名助手，为对受害者的下一场审讯做计划。若她在前室听见PC接近，她会移动到西北侧，迫使他们进入主室，并在其中投入近战。她将战至典狱长伊尔卡泽

K12. Warden’s Tower	
Moderate 6
This hexagonal chamber is finely appointed, with a rug 
covering the dark stone floor and simple ink drawings 
hanging on the wall between the barred windows. A large 
wooden desk stands in the middle of the room, covered 
in papers. One large, throne-like chair stands behind the 
desk and three smaller ones in front of it, two of them with

The warden rules the prison as a personal kingdom 
from this office. The smaller chairs are for her

is lit with everlight crystals, so it’s always bright light 
here.

K13. Oubliette
Low 6
A damp chill pervades this round, subterranean chamber. 
Water drips from the black stone, a constant trickle that 
seems somehow amplified into strange echoes, and almost 
instantly begins to feel monotonous. Rusty shackles hang 
from the ceiling and walls. In the main chamber, an iron 
smell of blood underlies the grave-like scent of the earth. 
A torture rack stands in the center of the room beneath a 
pulley system hanging from the ceiling, clearly visible in 
the light from flaming braziers. Cruel pokers, blades, and 
other implements of torture hang on the back wall.
Gyve jailers extract confessions, true or not, from 
prisoners in this torture chamber that was designed 
to prey on all the senses of its victims. Victims hang 
from manacles in the antechamber (K13a), where 
they’re forced to listen to others’ screams, while others 
wait in the main area (K13) and are forced to see what 
awaits them. Two Hellbreaker captives are here, both 
hanging from chains in the main chamber while their 
torturer prepares for another interrogation session.
The area is kept well-lit both so prisoners can 
see what awaits them and also as a contrast to the 
darkened cells above. The strange echoing properties 
enhance noises here—any effect that does sonic 
damage does an additional 1 point of sonic splash.

the prison’s head interrogator is here with an assistant, 
planning for another session with her victims. If she

发展：罗维米·斯卡菲带着钥匙，PC可以用它打开本区域的镣铐，以及牢房区内的所有门。被解救的地狱破坏者可以告诉PC，他们先前被关在牢房区，之后被带到遗忘牢，但不知道其他俘虏是否也都在那里。

任务：同生共死（MISSION: RIDE OR DIE）
当PC从镣铐监狱中救出所有同伴地狱破坏者后，他们必须穿过混乱的监狱，在聚集到城市上空的冬季风暴中躲开守卫与囚犯，赶往军营马厩。抵达马厩后，他们可以偷走坐骑——既能加快他们逃离城市的速度，也能阻止追兵。

追逐：本遭遇使用追逐（子系统）（GM Core 192），PC在奔向自由的路上试图避免落入凯托的魔掌。本次追逐的每一轮持续15分钟。由于PC正在逃亡并试图避免被追上，他们先行动。在追击者的回合，追击者获得1d4点追逐点数。此外，追击者进行掷骰时获得等同于PC“镇压点数”阈值（最高4）的加值，并承受等同于PC“起义点数”阈值（最高4）的减值——但二者可能相互抵消。若PC先前在“安放炸弹”中取得成功，提醒他们在逃亡过程中可以使用那些炸弹提供帮助。

若追击者追上PC，一支巡逻队会切断他们的去路，他们必须杀出一条路才能继续逃亡。发生这种情况时，除非PC另有说明（通常是因为他们的速度高于30，或体型过大无法骑马），否则默认PC已骑乘。若他们下马，假定其他一些地狱破坏者会抓住他们的马匹，他们可在战斗结束后自由重新上马。

生物：多支军队单位冲来阻止PC逃脱。由于他们组织不佳，这些都是低威胁遭遇。因为这种拦截可能发生多次，你可以混搭下面列出的生物来决定是谁追上了逃亡者，让每次遭遇都感觉不同。你可以使用XP预算（GM Core 75）构建遭遇，或使用以下组合之一：1名副官与2名精英步兵士兵；1名未经授权的治安官与2名精英步兵士兵；2名骑警警吏与1支征召兵小队；2名精英步兵士兵与2名守望官。

PCs can use to unlock the shackles in this area as well

can tell the PCs that they were held in the cell block 
before being brought to the oubliette, but don’t know

MISSION: RIDE OR DIE
Once the PCs have rescued all of their fellow 
Hellbreakers from the Gyve, they must make their 
way out of the chaotic prison, avoiding guards and 
prisoners to reach the army stables through a winter 
storm that has gathered over the city. Once they make 
it to the stables, they can steal mounts both to speed 
their passage out of the city and prevent pursuit.
Chase: This encounter uses the chase subsystem 
(GM Core 192) as the PCs try to avoid falling into 
Caeto’s clutches in their rush toward freedom. Each 
round of this chase takes 15 minutes. Because the PCs 
are fleeing and trying to avoid pursuit, they act first. 
On their turn, the pursuers gain 1d4 Chase Points. In 
addition, the pursuers get a bonus to the roll equal 
to the PCs’ Suppression Point threshold (up to 4) and 
a penalty equal to the PCs’ Uprising Point threshold 
(up to 4), though these might cancel each other out. If 
the PCs were successful Placing Bombs earlier, remind 
them they can use those to help during their escape.
If the pursuers catch the PCs, a patrol cuts off their 
path and they must fight their way past it before they 
can resume their pursuit. When this happens, the PCs 
are presumed to be mounted unless they indicate 
otherwise (likely because they have a Speed greater 
than 30, or they’re too large to ride a horse). If they 
dismount, assume some of the other Hellbreakers catch 
their horses and they can remount freely after the fight.
Creatures: A number of army units rush to stop the 
PCs’ escape. Because they are not well organized, these 
are low-threat encounters. Because they can happen 
multiple times, you can mix and match who catches 
the escapees, drawing from the creatures below so 
the encounters feel different each time. You can build 
an encounter using the XP budget (GM Core 75) or 
use one of the following combinations: One adiutor 
and two elite infantry soldiers, one unsanctioned 
sheriff and two elite infantry soldiers, two equestrian 
constables and a conscript squad, two elite infantry 
soldiers and two watch officers.

……而不是进行检定来克服障碍。即便这类行动通常只需10分钟，但由于PC们在进行这些工作时仍在移动，因此它会占用完整的15分钟一轮。即使PC们通常需要保持静止或在该行动中执行某个其他特定动作才可再专注，也允许他们再专注。

【追逐障碍】角色必须按以下顺序克服这六个障碍，才能成功完成追逐。

【监狱暴动】障碍6
追逐点数4；克服：DC 27 运动以强行挤过去，DC 24 威吓以说服一群守卫或囚犯去寻找更容易的目标，或DC 22 潜行以避免被发现
在枷锁堡各处爆发血腥而暴力的冲突，囚犯试图逃脱，守卫则试图阻止他们。

【天气：风暴】障碍6
追逐点数2；克服：DC 27 交涉以说服某人给你指路，DC 27 察觉以注意到关键地标，DC 24 社会以回忆城市布局，或DC 22 求生以找到方向
冬季风暴的强度不断攀升，呼啸的飞雪让人难以分辨左右。

【召集骑兵】障碍6
追逐点数4；克服：DC 27 制作以为战马配上鞍具，DC 22 自然以驾驭动物，或DC 24 巧手以撬开马厩与物资的锁
在军队马厩里，战马需要上鞍并做好抵御恶劣环境的准备。

【冰与火】障碍6
追逐点数4；克服：DC 24 特技以保持平衡，DC 27 威吓以惊吓人群让他们让路，或DC 22 自然以骑乘
城中的混乱惊扰了马匹，也让街道上挤满了目瞪口呆、围观事态发展的居民。

【空中密探】障碍6
追逐点数3；克服：DC 22 宗教以驱退邪魔，DC 27 潜行以避开视线，或DC 24 求生以掩盖行踪
小魔鬼从空中搜寻地狱破坏者。

【通往毁灭之路】障碍7
追逐点数4；克服：DC 23 奥秘学、秘学或宗教以对抗该魔法；DC 25 求生以寻找新的路径
剩余的监视法师施放强大的魔法，扭曲地狱破坏者脚下的道路，把他们引回监狱与被捕的命运。

【任务：杜鲁玛路城门】极难6
构成杜鲁玛路城门的巨大木门高耸于城墙之上，是为抵御外敌而建的防御工事，旨在守护城市免受任何外来威胁。

不幸的是，对PC们而言，在自由之前仍有一道障碍：凯托和大部分军队正忙于应对PC们行动造成的混乱（或许还在字面意义上灭火），但地狱骑士也在得知越狱消息后派出部队，封锁城市的各处出口。使用第114页的地图进行本遭遇。PC们在接近城门时便会注意到敌人，并可选择以骑乘或徒步方式开始本遭遇。

生物：凯托派出一支地狱骑士旅来协助城门处的守卫。他们认为地狱破坏者是叛徒与杀人犯，将战斗至死或被击倒失去意识，以阻止其逃脱。在PC们应对主要威胁的同时，你也可以描述其他守卫与逃亡的地狱破坏者之间发生的小规模战斗。

发展：一旦PC们成功击败城门守卫，他们便能遁入风暴，将艾利迪尔抛在身后。他们返回萨林盖洛，阿尔塞奥与菲比正与他们带来的新地狱破坏者一同迎接他们。这些新地狱破坏者会被欢迎加入萨林盖洛，并很快被授予统治高堡的权利——那是一座靠近城市、被废弃的熊地精要塞。PC们也有充足的时间休息，并与同伴叙旧；同伴们见到他们归来欣喜不已。罗克拉格、梅芙与泽拉尤其高兴，用极大的热情欢迎PC们。

然而，并非一切都好。凯托仍牢牢掌控着艾利迪尔，因此也握住了伊斯嘉当权者的命脉；而在西方，一股新的威胁正在滋长，凯托却乐于将其忽视。埃齐奥·盖塔或许已被击败，但他主人的计划仍在推进，并将很快实现。

第7章：
尸妖女王的解冻

在一段早已被遗忘的时代里，一位如今已无名的国王从他已故的弟弟——大亲王塞里卡斯（Cyricas）——手中继承了王冠；塞里卡斯因远离故土而在异乡死去，而那结局源于他自身的傲慢。

这位“如今已无名之王”索要与其狂妄相称的贡品：征服群山之间的土地。数百年来，国王的祖先觊觎这片土地，撕咬抓挠却始终无功而返。自太阳被吞没之前便已作为一体守护此地的“四季十二部族”，宛如由桦、枫与橡木构成的密林，难以逾越。

然而，再伟大的林海，也无法与“如今已无名之王”为遂其意而派出的剑与护甲之林相比。他的许多战士倒下：有的死于长矛与刀剑，有的败在阴谋与欺骗之下。整整一代人忘却了何谓和平，只知恐惧、战斗与逃亡。夺取土地仍不足以满足“如今已无名之王”；他还要求屠戮诸部族，因为他渴求的不仅是“征服者”的头衔。

在被追猎、饥饿与躲藏之中，有一个走投无路的部族以死者的骨灰涂抹皮肤。依循“苍白言者”（Speakers of the Pale）之道，他们呼唤先祖、土地之灵，以及四季十二部族的守护神祇。寒冬的荒寂静默里，有一道声音回应。

“享用你们的敌人所收获的成果吧，”那声音安抚道。“成为我之冬季的先驱，在死亡之上存续——永恒。”

最终，该部族仍被捕获。幸存者如秋叶般随风飘散；而未能幸存者则作为尸妖复起。不久，一支不朽军势已整装待发，准备解放这片土地，并摧毁那些……

Once upon a forgotten time, a king now nameless 
inherited the crown from his deceased younger 
brother, Grand Prince Cyricas, who had perished as a 
result of his own hubris in lands far away from home. 
The King-Now-Nameless demanded a tribute worthy 
his arrogance: the subjugation of the lands between 
the mountains. For centuries, the king’s ancestors had 
coveted these lands and bit and clawed at them to no 
avail. The Twelve Tribes of the Seasons, which had 
protected the region as one since before the sun was 
swallowed, were an impassable wood of birch, maple, 
and oak.
But even a great wood is nothing compared to the 
forest of swords and armor the King-Now-Nameless 
sent to do his bidding. Many of his warriors fell, some to 
spears and swords and others to schemes and deceit. An 
entire generation forgot what it meant to live in peace, 
knowing only fear, fighting, and fleeing. Capturing the 
land was not enough to satiate the King-Now-Nameless; 
he demanded the tribes be slaughtered, for he hungered 
for more than the title of conqueror.
Hunted, starving, and hiding, one desperate tribe 
painted their skin with the ashes of their dead. 
Through the ways of the Speakers of the Pale, they 
called upon their predecessors, the spirits of the land, 
and the patron deities of the Twelve Tribes. In the bleak 
silence of winter, one voice answered. Feast upon the 
harvest your enemies have wrought, the voice soothed. 
Become the herald of my winter and survive in spite of 
death—forever.

scattered to the winds like leaves in fall, but those who 
didn’t rose as wights. Before long, an immortal army

## Page 118
他们曾屠戮了他们。出于恐惧，塔尔多废黜了那位无名、嗜血的大公，但已经太迟了——仅仅十余年内，亡灵便将入侵者逐出，并开始谋划向南进军。

不愿让自己的遗产成为把不死带给他人的罪证，四季十二部族的残存者与塔尔多军队结盟，发动最后一场战争。由于他们人数寥寥，当最后一只尸妖被摧毁时，四季十二部族的文化也随之消亡。为纪念这份失落，塔尔多将这些部族铭记为“伊斯嘉人（Isgeri）”。有人说这个名字意为“被献祭者”，也可能是“自我献祭之人”。不幸的是，其确切含义已湮没于时代之中。

对某些伊斯嘉后裔——例如阿隆诺家族及其同道的邪教徒——这个故事的结局并不重要，甚至他们是否认为这故事已然结束都未可知。他们将向其救主立下的古老誓约视为神圣；然而伊斯嘉并未从征服者手中获得自由。毕竟，它先落入塔尔多的统治，继而又归于切利亚斯。因此，伊斯嘉仍注定要成为苍白公主的国度。

伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺自幼便深信自己在这宏大命运中扮演关键角色。她那炽热的幻象，以及转化为乌尔格索娅之子的经历，只是让她的自我重要感愈发强烈。过去一个世纪里，她一直暗中在全国各地播撒纷争：借由埃齐奥·盖塔煽动地精血战，又诅咒某位商人，使其为吉拉穆尔招致致命的诅咒。她的阴谋本应还需一个世纪才能真正圆满，但塔尔-巴风的回归与神雨期间落下的战晶碎片加速了她的计划。

尽管伊斯嘉的大多数人都将伊尔凯娜视作被夸大的都市传说，但伊斯嘉的尸妖之母及其教团知道，他们已接近达成目标，终于要为他们的女神夺取这片土地。赫德文德六世之死分散了埃利迪尔政治掮客们的注意力，她已站在胜利门槛上。若她成功诅咒整个国家，并将这片土地献给乌尔格索娅，她的女神将在格拉利昂获得一处被唯一崇敬而非唾弃之地。

【地平线上的警讯】
自从他们爆炸般地逃离埃利迪尔之后，破狱者一直忙个不停。在队伍的休整模式期间，他们已在高堡建立新的总部——这是一座废弃的地精堡垒，曾在地精血战期间被使用。高堡距离萨林加洛仅数日脚程，其位置使破狱者的两支分部即便彼此仍相对隔绝，也能协同行动。这份远见在第8章将变得至关重要。

当阿巴迪乌斯步入尾声，伊斯嘉南部出现亡灵活动的报告。起初，这些麻烦听来还很寻常，但随即袭击呈指数级增长。聚居地被淹没，居民为求安全而逃离。若条件允许，PC可以通过以下方式一窥逐步成形的威胁：

• 地精采集者格里佐（Grizzo）送来一封来自侏儒官员伊欧安·大理石杯（Ioan Marblemug）的信。尽管乌莫克尚不需要援助，伊欧安队长仍认为谨慎起见，应提醒PC：亡灵正在成为问题。若盛会上的阿巴达尔牧师费西姆威斯“费西”·芬温克（Fesimwyth “Fessy” Finwinkle）仍活着且与众人友好，她会在信上共同署名。

• 树桩地（Stumpfield）的创始者之一——地精画师厄克·油指（Erk Oilfingers）——在率领难民北上途中经过萨林加洛。厄克因他们向伊斯嘉正规军请求援助却遭无视而愤怒。

• 若盛会上的人类歌手莱兹妮娅（Lezinia）仍活着，她会在“邪魔的终幕（Fiend’s Finale）”作为特邀表演者与队伍擦肩而过。莱兹妮娅劝PC离开伊斯嘉，因为她听说凯托·武劳内克斯（Caeto Vulaunex）已命令其部队无视亡灵问题，转而优先追捕破狱者。

【被冲淡的庆祝】
随着埃利迪尔的破狱者在高堡安顿下来，萨林加洛的破狱者于卡丽丝翠尔月（Calistril）1日，在罗克拉格家中举办庆功晚宴。聚会之中，PC能见到一张张熟悉的面孔：从罗克拉格到梅尔（Maire）再到泽拉（Xerra）；甚至连格兰姆（Gram，见第200页“萨林加洛志”）也罕见露面。菲比（Phoebe）与阿尔塞奥（Alceo）亲切地主持庆祝活动；而珍薇瑞克（Jenvirick）则与萨瑞维亚尔（Sarevial）和奥顿（Otton）一道，代表埃利迪尔的破狱者出席。

【奇特木攻势】
在他宣布埃利迪尔实行戒严后的数日，凯托·武劳内克斯指挥他的地狱骑士夺取洛加斯（Logas）。不幸的是，当伊斯嘉南部的亡灵复起之时，这项行动把他的战友们置于火线之上。洛加斯的地狱骑士最终被击溃，而那些跌跌撞撞闯入奇特木（Chitterwood）的幸存者则被地精俘虏；地精夺走了他们的道具，并将其改装以满足自身用途。在卡丽丝翠尔月，这些穿戴地狱骑士道具的地精成功击退奇特木上的一次亡灵入侵，随后解放洛加斯——这场行动将被称为“奇特木攻势”。

【战役概览】
第1章：对抗地狱
第2章：为了事业
第3章：奇特木的恶魔
第4章：深入巨颚
第5章：亡者的派对

第7章：尸妖女王的解冻

had slaughtered them. In fear, Taldor deposed their 
nameless, bloodthirsty grand prince, but it was too 
late—in a little over a decade, the undead drove the 
invaders out and made plans to march south.
Unwilling to let their legacy become that of 
bringing undeath to others, what remained of the 
Twelve Tribes allied with the Taldane army for one 
last war. They were so few in number that by the time 
the last wight was destroyed, so too was the culture 
of the Twelve Tribes of the Seasons. In tribute to the 
lost, Taldor commemorated the tribes as the Isgeri, a 
name some say means “those who were sacrificed,” 
or perhaps “those who sacrificed themselves.” The 
definitive meaning is unfortunately lost to time.
For some Isgeri descendants, such as the Alonnors 
and their fellow cultists, the ending of this story did 
not matter—if they considered the tale to have ended 
at all. They held the ancient pledge to their savior as 
sacred, but Isger was not freed from its conqueror. It 
fell to Taldor’s rule, after all, and then to Cheliax’s. 
Isger is, therefore, yet destined to become the realm of 
the Pallid Princess.
Illcayna Alonnor has believed since youth that she has 
a pivotal role to play in this grand destiny. Her feverish 
visions and transformation into a Child of Urgathoa 
only strengthened that sense of self-importance. For the 
past century, she has secretly sowed discord throughout 
the nation, instigating the Goblinblood Wars through 
Ezio Gaeta and cursing a merchant to afflict Gillamoor 
with a deadly curse. Her plots would have required 
another century to reach proper culmination, but the 
return of Tar-Baphon and the descent of warshards 
during the Godsrain accelerated her plans.
While most in Isger regard Illcayna as an exaggerated 
urban legend, the Wight Mother of Isger and her cult 
know they are close to reaching their goals and finally 
claiming the land for their goddess. With the murder 
of Hedvend VI distracting the political movers in 
Elidir, she is on the cusp of victory. Should she manage 
to curse the entire nation and deliver the land to 
Urgathoa, her goddess shall gain a place on Golarion 
where she is singularly revered, not reviled.
Warnings on the Horizon
The Hellbreakers have been busy since their explosive 
exit out of Elidir. During the party’s downtime, they 
have settled into a new headquarters at Highfort, 
an abandoned hobgoblin fortress once used during 
the Goblinblood Wars. As it is only a few days’ trek 
from Saringallow, Highfort’s location enables the 
two Hellbreakers branches to cooperate even as they 
remain isolated from one another. This foresight 
becomes very important in Chapter 8.
As Abadius comes to an end, reports of undead 
activity surface in southern Isger. At first, the 
troubles sound typical, but then the attacks increase 
exponentially. Settlements are overrun, and their 
residents flee for safety. The PCs can get a glimpse of 
the developing threat through the following methods, 
if they are available:
•	 Grizzo the goblin forager delivers a letter from 
the gnome official Ioan Marblemug. While Umok 
doesn’t require assistance yet, Captain Ioan 
finds it prudent to alert the PCs that undead 
are becoming an issue. If Fesimwyth “Fessy” 
Finwinkle, the Abadaran cleric from the gala, is 
alive and friendly, she co-signs the letter.
•	 One of the founders of Stumpfield, Erk Oilfingers 
the goblin painter, passes by Saringallow while 
leading refugees north. Erk is angry that their 
requests for aid to the official Isgeri army were 
ignored.
•	 If Lezinia, the human singer from the gala, is 
alive, she crosses paths with the party as a guest 
performer at the Fiend’s Finale. Lezinia urges the 
PCs to leave Isger, for she has heard that Caeto 
Vulaunex has ordered his forces to ignore the 
undead problem in favor of catching Hellbreakers.
Dampened Celebrations
With the Elidir Hellbreakers settled in at Highfort, 
Saringallow’s Hellbreakers host a celebratory dinner 
on the 1st of Calistril at Rhokrag’s house. At the 
gathering, the PCs see familiar faces ranging from 
Rhokrag to Maire to Xerra; even Gram (see the 
Saringallow gazetteer on page 200) makes a rare 
appearance. Phoebe and Alceo graciously host the 
celebrations, while Jenvirick represents the Elidir 
Hellbreakers with Sarevial and Otton.
THE CHITTERWOOD OFFENSIVE
A few days after he declared martial law in Elidir, 
Caeto Vulaunex directed his Hellknights to seize 
Logas. This unfortunately placed his comrades 
in the line of fire when undead rose in southern 
Isger. The Hellknights in Logas were ultimately 
routed, and the survivors who stumbled into 
the Chitterwood were captured by goblins who 
acquired their gear and modified it for their own 
purposes. In Calistril, these goblins with Hellknight 
gear successfully repel an undead invasion on the 
Chitterwood, then liberate Logas in what will come 
to be known as the Chitterwood Offensive.

A few days after he declared martial law in Elidir, Caeto Vulaunex directed his Hellknights to seize Logas. The Hellknights in Logas were ultimately routed, and the survivors who stumbled into the Chitterwood were captured by goblins who acquired their gear and modified it for their own purposes. In Calistril, these goblins with Hellknight gear successfully repel an undead invasion on the Chitterwood, then liberate Logas in what will come to be known as the Chitterwood Offensive.

Dampened Celebrations

At the gathering, the PCs see familiar faces ranging from Rhokrag to Maire to Xerra; even Gram (see the Saringallow gazetteer on page 200) makes a rare appearance. Phoebe and Alceo graciously host the celebrations, while Jenvirick represents the Elidir Hellbreakers with Sarevial and Otton.

## Page 119
【章节时间线】
下方是本章若干特定事件或截止日期的建议时间线，不过GM也可以根据需要自行调整。阿尔切欧会通过梦境讯息，在所示日期当晚分享破狱者们获知的任何信息或他们采取的任何动作。按时完成建议的期限通常会得到额外奖励。即使错过期限也不会影响整体任务线，但这可能会限制PC的选择，直到他们在之后设法弥补为止。

【卡利斯特里尔 4726 AR】
1日：庆祝晚宴举行。
4日：寻求荆棘握援助的截止期限。
6日：“咔嚓林地攻势”成功夺回洛加斯。阿尔切欧与拯救洛加斯免于亡灵之灾的“地狱铠地精”谈妥同盟。自此之后，“破狱者联盟”的新兵应在洛加斯集结。
7日：若PC尚未发现，梅尔会查明吉拉穆尔是亡灵诅咒的源头。
9日：若PC仍未调查吉拉穆尔，“暴乱煽动者”将代为前往，并发现伊尔凯娜是亡灵增多的幕后黑手。他们未能破除诅咒。这也是在洛加斯重新集结的截止期限。
10日：破狱者大军离开洛加斯，向寻者峡谷进军。
13日：破狱者大军抵达寻者峡谷郊外。
19日：若无人打断，伊尔凯娜会在黄昏完成她的诅咒，将伊斯嘉献祭给乌加索娅。

尽管这场晚宴的用意是庆祝，宾客间却仍萦绕着一股不安。最终，梅尔主动提起话题，询问大家是否听说了亡灵的事。PC可以分享他们所知道的一切，而珍维里克则悲伤地提到，她听说洛加斯在几天前遭到亡灵入侵而陷落。然而，菲比拿出了一封信。

“这是武劳内克斯在洛加斯请求援助之后发回的回信副本。开头和你们想的一样：‘我们已注意到局势发展……’、‘我理解你们的担忧……’一堆官话。我直接读重点。‘伊斯嘉的问题比区区几只亡灵更严重。破狱者是必须趁其异议尚未像瘟疫般蔓延前掐灭的害虫，不过他们那套自命不凡的把戏也许仍有些用处。你们的顾虑已记录在案。’”

阿尔切欧叹了口气。“过去几个月，破狱者一直努力赢得民众信任，证明我们是个会采取行动的组织。在官员们对这场危机无动于衷的情况下，人民既恐惧又迫切需要帮助。我们必须尽一切努力帮助平民找到避难之所，以对抗这股亡灵势力，并让他们有能力为自己而战……而若伊斯嘉所谓的领导者不愿保护人民免受亡灵侵害，那就由我们亲自处理。”

PC可以尝试一次察觉检定以“洞悉动机”，或进行一次社交或战争学识检定以“回忆知识”，DC 23，以探明凯托的意图。成功则他们会看出，这名地狱骑士希望破狱者去扮演英雄。若他们死了，凯托就省得费力追猎；若他们活下来，也可能已被削弱，从而更容易被抓住并解散。

破狱者已经赢得了“为人民而战的组织”的名声，而在政府官员不提供援助的情况下，平民正急切地想要采取行动并寻找指引。破狱者只需要集结那些准备战斗的人。帮助人们巩固他们的聚居地或转移到安全地带，会让招募变得更加容易。事实上，若破狱者能一劳永逸地解决亡灵危机，这本身就会巩固他们在民众心中的地位。凭借诸如“地狱骑士丘”与“埃利迪尔”等过往成功经验，阿尔切欧确信正面迎击亡灵在组织能力范围之内。是时候向凯托证明，他究竟有多么低估他们了。

【新任务，旧地方】
“暴乱煽动者”、洛克拉格与珍维里克很快为破狱者分配好了任务。他们派PC前往萨林加洛以南、咔嚓林地以北的熟悉区域，进行援助与招募。这也让队伍负责与“荆棘握”谈判——这项任务极其重要，因为荆棘握的长老们代表着咔嚓林地，就像破狱者希望在林地之外代表伊斯嘉人一样。一旦破狱者解放伊斯嘉，PC做出的任何承诺都可能成为政治义务。

至于解决亡灵危机，阿尔切欧提到他刚来到这个国家时就听过传闻：有一道诅咒是亡灵的源头。菲比接话解释，这个故事源自与伊斯嘉南部进行贸易的商人。不过多年过去，如今的商队只知道哪些路线安全，却不知道他们究竟在躲避什么、或在躲避哪里。但若破狱者能问对问题并观察亡灵，他们应能通过排除法推算出诅咒的位置。

Despite the dinner’s celebratory intent, a sense of dread 
lingers over the guests. Maire ultimately broaches the 
subject and asks if people have heard about the undead. 
The PCs can share what they know, and Jenvirick sadly 
mentions how she heard that Logas fell to an undead 
incursion some days ago. Phoebe, however, shares a letter.
“This is a copy of the reply Vulaunex sent to Logas after 
the city requested aid. Begins much as expected. ‘We are 
aware of the situation developing…’ and ‘I understand your 
concern…’ Bureaucratic speak. I’ll skip to the good part.
“‘Isger has greater problems than a few undead. The 
Hellbreakers are a pest that must be nipped in the bud 
before their dissidence spreads like a plague, though their 
self-righteous act may still be of some use. Your concerns 
are noted.’”
Alceo sighs. “The Hellbreakers have worked hard in 
the past months to earn the people’s trust and show that 
we’re an organization that takes action. With officials 
doing nothing about the crisis, people are frightened 
and desperate for help. We need to do all we can to 
help civilians find refuge against this undead entity and 
empower them to fight for themselves… and if the so-called 
leaders of Isger won’t protect its people from the undead, 
we’ll deal with it ourselves.”
PCs can attempt a Perception check to Sense Motive 
or a Society or Warfare Lore check to Recall Knowledge 
at DC 23 to suss out Caeto’s intent. On a success, they 
discern that the Hellknight hopes the Hellbreakers will 
play heroes. If they perish, it saves Caeto the trouble 
of hunting them, but if they live, they might still be 
weakened, making them easier to catch and dissolve.
The Hellbreakers have earned a reputation as an 
organization that fights for the people, and with no aid 
coming from government officials, civilians are itching 
to act and looking for guidance. The Hellbreakers 
just need to rally those ready to fight. Helping 
people secure their settlements or relocate to safety 
would make recruitment even easier. In fact, if the 
Hellbreakers solve the undead crisis once and for all, 
that in itself would cement their standing in the heart 
of the populace. With past successes like Hellknight 
Hill and Elidir under the Hellbreakers’ belt, Alceo is 
confident that tackling the undead head-on is within 
the organization’s capabilities. It’s time to prove to 
Caeto how much he has underestimated them.
NEW ASSIGNMENTS, OLD PLACES
The Riotmongers, Rhokrag, and Jenvirick quickly 
divide tasks up for the Hellbreakers. They charge the 
PCs with aiding and recruiting from the familiar area 
south of Saringallow and north of the Chitterwood. 
This also puts the party in charge of negotiating with 
Thorngrip—an 
exceptionally 
important 
task, 
as 
Thorngrip’s elders represent the Chitterwood much like 
how the Hellbreakers wish to represent the Isgeri outside 
the woods. Any promises the PCs make may become 
political obligations once the Hellbreakers free Isger.
As for solving the undead crisis, Alceo mentions he 
heard a rumor when he first came to the nation that a 
curse was the source of the undead. Phoebe chimes in 
and explains that the tale originated from merchants 
who traded in southern Isger. After all these years, 
however, present day trade caravans only know which 
routes are safe, not what or where they are avoiding. 
If the Hellbreakers ask the right questions and observe 
the undead, though, they should be able to triangulate 
the curse’s location by process of elimination.
CHAPTER TIMELINE
Below is a proposed timeline for specific events 
or deadlines featured in this chapter, though GMs 
are welcome to make adjustments to it as they 
see fit. Alceo shares any information that the 
Hellbreakers learn or any actions they take during 
the night of the day indicated via dream message. 
Meeting the suggested deadlines often gives extra 
rewards. Though missing them doesn’t impact the 
overall questline, this can limit the PCs’ options 
until they make up for them later.
CALISTRIL 4726 ar
1st: The celebration dinner takes place.
4th: Deadline for seeking Thorngrip aid.
6th: The Chitterwood Offensive successfully 
retakes Logas. Alceo negotiates an alliance 
with the Hellclad Goblins who saved Logas 
from the undead. Hellbreakers League recruits 
should convene in Logas from here on.
7th: Maire discovers Gillamoor is the source of 
the undead curse if the PCs haven’t.
9th: If the PCs have yet to investigate Gillamoor, 
the Riotmongers visit instead and discover 
that Illcayna is behind the rising undead. They 
fail to break the curse. This is the deadline to 
reconvene in Logas.
10th: The Hellbreakers army leaves Logas and 
marches toward Finder’s Gulch.
13th: The Hellbreakers army arrives on the 
outskirts of Finder’s Gulch.

Hellbreakers Adventure Path

CHAPTER TIMELINE
Below is a proposed timeline for specific events or deadlines featured in this chapter, though GMs are welcome to make adjustments to it as they see fit. Alceo shares any information that the Hellbreakers learn or any actions they take during the night of the day indicated via dream message. Meeting the suggested deadlines often gives extra rewards. Though missing them doesn’t impact the overall questline, this can limit the PCs’ options until they make up for them later.

CALISTRIL 4726 AR
1st: The celebration dinner takes place.
4th: Deadline for seeking Thorngrip aid.
6th: The Chitterwood Offensive successfully retakes Logas. Alceo negotiates an alliance with the Hellclad Goblins who saved Logas from the undead. Hellbreakers League recruits should convene in Logas from here on.
7th: Maire discovers Gillamoor is the source of the undead curse if the PCs haven’t.
9th: If the PCs have yet to investigate Gillamoor, the Riotmongers visit instead and discover that Illcayna is behind the rising undead. They fail to break the curse. This is the deadline to reconvene in Logas.
10th: The Hellbreakers army leaves Logas and marches toward Finder’s Gulch.
13th: The Hellbreakers army arrives on the outskirts of Finder’s Gulch.
19th: If she isn’t interrupted, Illcayna completes her curse and sacrifices Isger to Urgathoa at dusk.

Alceo sighs. “The Hellbreakers have worked hard in the past months to earn the people’s trust and show that we’re an organization that takes action. With officials doing nothing about the crisis, people are frightened and desperate for help. We need to do all we can to help civilians find refuge against this undead entity and empower them to fight for themselves… and if the so-called leaders of Isger won’t protect its people from the undead, we’ll deal with it ourselves.”

PCs can attempt a Perception check to Sense Motive or a Society or Warfare Lore check to Recall Knowledge at DC 23 to suss out Caeto’s intent. On a success, they discern that the Hellknight hopes the Hellbreakers will play heroes. If they perish, it saves Caeto the trouble of hunting them, but if they live, they might still be weakened, making them easier to catch and dissolve.

The Hellbreakers have earned a reputation as an organization that fights for the people, and with no aid coming from government officials, civilians are itching to act and looking for guidance. The Hellbreakers just need to rally those ready to fight. Helping people secure their settlements or relocate to safety would make recruitment even easier. In fact, if the Hellbreakers solve the undead crisis once and for all, that in itself would cement their standing in the heart of the populace. With past successes like Hellknight Hill and Elidir under the Hellbreakers’ belt, Alceo is confident that tackling the undead head-on is within the organization’s capabilities. It’s time to prove to Caeto how much he has underestimated them.

NEW ASSIGNMENTS, OLD PLACES
The Riotmongers, Rhokrag, and Jenvirick quickly divide tasks up for the Hellbreakers. They charge the PCs with aiding and recruiting from the familiar area south of Saringallow and north of the Chitterwood. This also puts the party in charge of negotiating with Thorngrip—an exceptionally important task, as Thorngrip’s elders represent the Chitterwood much like how the Hellbreakers wish to represent the Isgeri outside the woods. Any promises the PCs make may become political obligations once the Hellbreakers free Isger.

As for solving the undead crisis, Alceo mentions he heard a rumor when he first came to the nation that a curse was the source of the undead. Phoebe chimes in and explains that the tale originated from merchants who traded in southern Isger. After all these years, however, present day trade caravans only know which routes are safe, not what or where they are avoiding. If the Hellbreakers ask the right questions and observe the undead, though, they should be able to triangulate the curse’s location by process of elimination.

Despite the dinner’s celebratory intent, a sense of dread lingers over the guests. Maire ultimately broaches the subject and asks if people have heard about the undead. The PCs can share what they know, and Jenvirick sadly mentions how she heard that Logas fell to an undead incursion some days ago. Phoebe, however, shares a letter.

“This is a copy of the reply Vulaunex sent to Logas after the city requested aid. Begins much as expected. ‘We are aware of the situation developing…’ and ‘I understand your concern…’ Bureaucratic speak. I’ll skip to the good part.

“‘Isger has greater problems than a few undead. The Hellbreakers are a pest that must be nipped in the bud before their dissidence spreads like a plague, though their self-righteous act may still be of some use. Your concerns are noted.’”

## Page 120
以下是PC们在接受任务后可能会问的问题，以及阿尔西奥给出的回答。

你们要负责哪些聚居地？“按离萨林盖洛由近到远，你们负责斯威夫特伦、树桩原、乌莫克，以及沃迪亚。哦，对了，再加上狼点。那里可能有些可被感化的强盗正躲着亡灵。”

我们需要为这些聚居地做什么？“大多可能需要加固防御工事；也有些会因自身处境提出独特要求。除此之外，你们随时可以护送民众撤离到安全处。哦，你们也可以把招募到的新成员送去萨林盖洛——如果这安排有变，我会通知你们。”

我们必须去找诅咒源头吗？罗克拉格精神一振。“我跟你们赌100金币：我和梅尔在北边时，肯定能比你们更快找到这些玩意儿是从哪个洞里爬出来的。”

每人100金币，赌了。“所以，如果我们赢，你们每人都要给100金币？成交！”

我们还有多少时间？“我希望能在从今天起三天内得知荆棘握会不会加入我们，”阿尔西奥说。“时间很紧，但越早知道，我们就越有时间让其他人慢慢接受他们作为盟友。至于招募，我们9号再碰头——不过大概不会在萨林盖洛。我之后会就此更新你们。至于诅咒……”阿尔西奥的声音压低成耳语。“罗克拉格通常只有在他觉得一周内能办成时才会下注。别有压力。”

你觉得荆棘握会要求什么？“我确实说不准。要猜什么能促成和解，总是很难。我想布拉克纳普会帮忙把条件维持在合理范围内。”

你们其他人要做什么？“詹维里克会带领伊利迪尔人从首都周边招募。罗克拉格和梅尔先去裂隙堡，但他们会在返程时一路招募。菲比和我会去洛加斯；关于那里发生了什么，有相互矛盾的消息，所以我们得亲眼确认。格拉姆会在我们离开期间守住萨林盖洛。”

如果大家都在路上，我们怎么互相联络？“……我就知道我忘了什么，”阿尔西奥叹气。格拉姆眨了眨眼，把一根【梦讯魔杖】（4环）塞进牧师手里。

如果PC们还有其他办法能帮助破狱者彼此联络，他们可以提出方案。否则，破狱者决定改为联络萨林盖洛的格拉姆（神秘的女性半身人制烛匠4），由她每日向阿尔西奥更新情况。之后，阿尔西奥每晚会向他选定的11名对象发送一次【梦讯】；PC队伍应指定两名成员作为联络人。若有需要，他们也可以告知阿尔西奥改为联络谁。


伊斯嘉南部的亡灵
任务简报结束后，游戏将进入一个轻度沙盒结构，主要以休整模式推进，其间穿插探索与遭遇。尽管PC们有带潜在期限的目标，但要去哪里、何时出发都由他们自行决定。在与游荡于大地上的亡灵遭遇后，他们可能需要撤退并恢复，再次整装出发。

随机遭遇：当他们旅行时，PC们很可能会被伊尔凯娜的爪牙伏击；随着她的计划接近圆满，这些爪牙会愈发大胆。每天一次，只要PC们从出发点起旅行超过1英里，就进行一次秘密纯骰检定，对抗DC=5+卡利斯特里尔的已过天数（或本章开始后已过的天数）。若检定失败，PC们会在接下来的24小时内遭遇下方“亡灵随机遭遇”表中的一组敌人。使用与PC所在地点相匹配的适用翻页战斗地图（Flip-Mats），或重复使用前几章的地图。

如果PC或他们所在的区域正处于某种效果之下——该效果能压制亡灵的复起、隐藏其踪迹以避开亡灵，或提供任何类似益处——则纯骰检定的DC降低4。

每当PC们击败一次随机遭遇后，你可以在接下来的2天内不再进行该纯骰检定。一旦吉拉穆尔的诅咒被打破（见第122页“吉拉穆尔的诅咒”），纯骰检定的DC降低并固定为5（若有进一步防护，可能降至1）。一旦伊尔凯娜被摧毁，这些遭遇将完全停止；若吉拉穆尔的诅咒仍未被解除，则只有在距吉拉穆尔10英里以内才会继续发生。

Below are questions the PCs might ask after they are 
given their tasks and the answers Alceo provides.
Which settlements are we covering? “From closest 
to furthest from Saringallow, you’re in charge of 
Swiftrun, Stumpfield, Umok, and Vordia. Oh, and add 
Wolfpoint. There might be redeemable bandits hiding 
there from the undead.”
What should we do for the settlements? “Most will 
likely need fortifications, and some might have unique 
requests based on their situations. You can always 
escort folks to safety otherwise. Oh, and you can 
also send any recruits to Saringallow, though if that 
changes, I’ll let you know.”
Do we have to search for the curse? Rhokrag perks 
up. “I’ll bet you 100 gold that Maire and I can beat 
you lot to finding the hole these things are crawling 
out of while we’re in the north.”
Make it 100 gold each and it’s on. “So, 100 gold 
from each of you if we win? Deal!”
How much time do we have? “I’d like to know if 
Thorngrip will join us within three days from today,” 
Alceo says. “It’s tight deadline, but the sooner we know, 
the more time we have to ease others into accepting 
them as allies. As for recruitment, let’s reconvene on 
the 9th, though probably not in Saringallow. I’ll update 
you about that later. As for the curse…” Alceo’s voice 
drops to a whisper. “Rhokrag usually only bets if he 
believes he can get it done in a week. No pressure.”
What can we expect Thorngrip to demand? “I truly 
can’t say. It’s always difficult to guess what would help 
achieve reconciliation. I imagine Brakknap will help 
keep the terms reasonable.”
What are the rest of you doing? “Jenvirick will 
lead the Elidirans to recruit from around the capital. 
Rhokrag and Maire are headed to Breachill first, 
but they’ll recruit as they return. Phoebe and I are 
bound for Logas; there’s contradicting information 
about what happened there, so we need to see for 
ourselves how things are. Gram will be holding down 
Saringallow while we’re away.”
How do we contact each other if we’re all on the 
move? “…I knew I was forgetting something,” 
Alceo sighs. Gram presses a wand of dream message 
(4th-rank) into the cleric’s hand with a wink.
If the PCs have other means of helping the 
Hellbreakers communicate, they can offer solutions. 
Otherwise, the Hellbreakers settle on contacting Gram 
(mysterious female halfling candler 4) in Saringallow, 
who will update Alceo daily. Alceo will then send a 
dream message each night to 11 individuals of his 
choice; the PCs should pick two in their party to be 
designated contacts. They can update Alceo on who to 
contact if need be.
Undeath in Southern Isger
After the mission briefing, the game opens into a 
slight sandbox that proceeds mostly in downtime 
mode, with exploration and encounters in between. 
While the PCs have objectives with prospective 
deadlines, where they go and when is up to them. 
They might need to retreat and recuperate before 
heading out again after encounters with the undead 
roaming the lands.
Random Encounters: As they travel, the PCs are 
likely going to be ambushed by Illcayna’s minions, who 
grow bold as her plan approaches fruition. Once per 
day, whenever the PCs travel more than 1 mile from 
their point of origin, make a secret flat check against 
a DC of 5 + the number of days into Calistril (or the 
number of days passed since this chapter started). On 
a failure, the PCs encounter a group from the Undead 
Random Encounters table below within the next 24 
hours. Use appropriate Flip-Mats that match the 
PCs’ location, or reuse maps from previous chapters. 
If the PCs or the area they are in are under an effect 
that would suppress the rise of undead, conceal their 
presence from undead, or provide any similar benefit, 
the DC of the flat check decreases by 4.
Each time the PCs defeat a random encounter, 
you can forgo the flat check for 2 days. Once the 
curse in Gillamoor has been broken (see The Curse 
of Gillamoor on page 122), the DC of the flat check 
is reduced and fixed at 5 (and possibly reduced to 
1 with further protection). Once Illcayna has been 
destroyed, these encounters stop entirely except 
within 10 miles of Gillamoor if the curse there has 
not been dispelled.

**聚居地单位：**每个聚居地可招募的部队如上方“聚居地单位”表所示。PC应记录自己已招募了哪些单位以及数量。

• 斯威夫特伦的艾拉斯提尔神职人员很难被说服，而学徒法师们则渴望证明自己。
• 斯坦普菲尔德的艺术风格，使得部分居民天生就是破坏者。
• 斯坦普菲尔德的本地口述诗协会很容易学会战歌吟诵。
• 乌莫克可以请求其动物守卫者中的狼群协助破狱者。
• 与动物交流的侏儒兽语者会在乌莫克得到保障后加入。
• 沃迪亚人口不足以提供部队，但他们知道几名雇佣兵可以改为雇来。
• 狼岬附近藏着一些强盗，他们可以被说服——或被威吓——加入。

**宝藏：**在第7章期间，于“协助聚居地”行动中成功也会按上方“聚居地技能与奖励”表中所示，奖励PC物品。在第7章之外成功进行“协助聚居地”不会获得这些宝藏，不过GM可自行决定在之后以其他成就为由发放这些物品。

**奖励：**若PC成功从三个不同的聚居地招募到部队，他们获得2点声望点数和30 XP。若他们设法从全部五个聚居地都招募到部队，则改为获得5点声望点数和50 XP。此奖励可在任何时间点获得，即使不在本章期间亦然。

## 协助聚居地（ASSIST A SETTLEMENT）
【专注】【休整模式】

你花费一天帮助一个聚居地为入侵做准备，或防御危险。你可以进行一次制造、社会或生存检定来加固该地点，或进行一次宗教、斥候学识或隐匿检定来守卫那些离开的人。这些检定的DC为基于你当前等级的困难DC（7级DC 25）。GM可酌情接受其他技能。

作为该行动的一部分，队伍每天可以旅行至多等同于自身速度、其坐骑的速度或其载具的速度。每个聚居地还有额外可用技能，列于上方“聚居地技能与奖励”表中。这些技能的DC为基于你当前等级的简单DC（7级DC 21）。你每月只能“协助聚居地”一次。

**大成功：**同成功，且你在“为事业招募”的掷骰结果视为比你实际掷出好1个步骤。

**成功：**在接下来一周内，你在所协助的聚居地进行“为事业招募”的检定，或协助另一名PC进行该聚居地的“为事业招募”时，获得+2环境加值。

**大失败：**同成功，但你改为获得–2环境减值。

## 为事业招募（RECRUIT FOR THE CAUSE）
【探索】

你花费一小时说话或与潜在新兵通信，劝说他们加入破狱者的事业。你每个聚居地每周只能进行一次（或按冒险对目标的定义执行）。一旦你已招募到某支部队，在下一章开始之前，你无法再从同一聚居地重复招募他们。

招募的DC为基于你等级的极难检定（7级DC 28），使用交涉或社会。若有多名PC同时进行此行动，他们可以选择分别掷骰，或由一名PC尝试掷骰而其他人进行协助。

•	 Swiftrun’s Erastilian clergy are difficult to

Reward: If the PCs successfully recruit troops from 
three different settlements, they gain 2 Reputation 
Points and 30 XP. If they manage to recruit troops from 
all five settlements, they instead gain 5 Reputation 
Points and 50 XP. This reward can be earned at any 
point, even outside of this chapter.
ASSIST A SETTLEMENT
CONCENTRATE
DOWNTIME
You spend a day helping a settlement prepare for 
incursions or defend against dangers. This is a Crafting, 
Society, or Survival check to fortify the location, or a 
Religion, Scouting Lore, or Stealth check to guard those 
leaving. The DC for these checks is a hard DC based on 
your current level (DC 25 for level 7). The GM can accept 
other skills as they see fit.
As part of this activity, the party can travel up to their 
Speed or the Speed of their mount or vehicle per day. 
Each settlement has additional skills you can use that are 
listed on the Settlement Skills and Rewards table above. 
The DC for these skills is an easy DC for your current level 
(DC 21 for level 7). You can only Assist a Settlement once 
per month.
Critical Success As success, and count your roll to Recruit 
for the Cause as one step better than what you rolled.
Success For a week, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to 
Recruit for the Cause or to Aid another PC to Recruit for 
the Cause at the settlement you assisted.
Critical Failure As success, but you gain a –2 circumstance 
penalty instead.
RECRUIT FOR THE CAUSE
EXPLORATION
You spend an hour speaking or corresponding with 
potential recruits, urging them to join the Hellbreakers’ 
cause. You can do this once per week per settlement 
or target as defined by the adventure. Once you have 
recruited a troop, you cannot recruit them again from the 
same settlement until the next chapter begins.
The DC to recruit is a very hard check for your level 
(DC 28 for level 7) using Diplomacy or Society. If more 
than one PC takes this activity at the same time, they can 
choose to roll separately or have one PC attempt the roll 
while the others Aid.

地狱破坏者联盟的声望每高于“无视”一档，PC的掷骰获得+1环境加值，最多+3。每低于“无视”一档，PC承受–1环境减值。

大成功 居民热情地让最优秀者加入战斗，或派出一支坚实的营。除成功效果外，额外有该聚居地的1支进阶单位部队加入你们的事业。

成功 如失败效果外，额外有该聚居地的1支基础单位加入你们的事业。

失败 一支象征性的征召小队（NPC Core 89）加入你们高尚的事业。在第8章，为该小队加入精英模板。在第9章，将该单位替换为线列步兵（NPC Core 90）。

如何发现源头
有些PC可能更习惯学术追索（例如确定诅咒的位置），而不太擅长尝试招募。这项任务通过“定位诅咒”休整模式行动进行。要发现吉拉穆尔是诅咒的源头，队伍需要使用胜利点数系统（GM Core 184）获得10点追踪点数。

定位诅咒
【专注】【休整模式】
你花一天时间在旅行中追寻流言或追踪亡灵动向，以三角定位亡灵灾祸的源头。你每天只能进行此行动一次。尝试一次DC 25的奥秘、交涉、秘学、宗教、生存或合适的学识检定，以进行“收集信息”。GM可酌情允许其他技能，并为合适的支援动作或行动给予环境加值。若布拉克纳普与队伍同行，本行动中的所有DC降低5。

若PC在卡利斯特里月7日之前未达到10点追踪点数，梅尔会抢先一步。阿尔西奥当晚通过“梦境讯息”将消息告知所有人。由于他和菲比还无法从洛加斯抽身一两天，离吉拉穆尔最近的人——很可能就是队伍——应当去调查那里。

宝藏：罗克拉格押上了大量金币来激励队伍。若PC先一步发现地点，他们下次返回萨林加洛时可各自领取100 gp的报酬。若他们输了并支付款项，罗克拉格会给每人两罐守护药膏（第210页）和一份安息药膏（第210页）作为安慰。

奖励：若PC在梅尔之前定位到诅咒，他们获得30 XP。

与地精谈判
考虑到地精血战遗留的情绪，招募荆握部族会更为棘手。新的地狱破坏者军队让许多类地精担心它将来可能成为威胁。PC抵达荆握时不会遇到任何抗力，但气氛紧绷，接待也很冷淡。只有布拉克纳普热情地迎接PC。

“你们在艰难的时刻提出艰难的请求。祖先的声音告诉我，在五十—十代之前的许多世代里，这样的事发生过很多次。我想知道为何它停止了。死亡降临我们所有人；在许多情况下，来得过早。至少对我来说，我不想看到奇特林树林变得死寂无生，因此让我们坦诚地谈谈——在这一切死亡之后，我们双方都渴望的和平。”

在PC与布拉克纳普叙旧后，他们便可开始与荆握部族谈判。这是一项对抗长老议会的影响力挑战（GM Core 187）。PC有6轮、每轮10分钟的时间来进行发现与影响检定。

HOW TO DISCOVER A SOURCE
Some PCs might be more comfortable with academic 
pursuits, such as determining the location of the 
curse, than they are with attempting recruitment. This 
mission is conducted through the Locate the Curse 
downtime activity. To discover that Gillamoor is the 
curse’s source, the party needs to obtain 10 Tracking 
Points with the Victory Point system (GM Core 184).
LOCATE THE CURSE
CONCENTRATE
DOWNTIME
You spend the day pursuing rumors or tracing undead 
movements as you travel to triangulate the source of the 
undead scourge. You can take this activity once per day. 
Attempt a DC 25 Arcana, Diplomacy, Occultism, Religion, 
Survival, or suitable Lore check to Gather Information. 
GMs can allow other skills as they see fit and award 
circumstance bonuses for appropriate supporting actions 
or activities. If Brakknap is with the party, all DCs in this 
activity decrease by 5.
If the PCs don’t reach 10 Tracking Points by the 
7th of Calistril, Maire beats them to the punch. Alceo 
shares the news with everyone that night through 
dream message. As he and Phoebe can’t step away 
from Logas for a day or two yet, those closest to 
Gillamoor—likely the party—should investigate the 
place.
Treasure: Rhokrag put a lot of gold on the line to 
motivate the party. Should the PCs discover the location 
first, they can pick up their reward of 100 gp each when 
they next return to Saringallow. If they lose and pay up, 
Rhokrag gives them two jars of warding paste (page 
210) and a restful salve (page 210) each as consolation.
Reward: The PCs receive 30 XP if they locate the 
curse before Maire.
NEGOTIATING WITH GOBLINS
Recruiting Thorngrip is a more delicate 
matter given the lingering sentiments 
from the Goblinblood Wars. The 
new Hellbreakers army makes many 
goblinoids wary that it might become 
a threat to them in the future. While the 
PCs don’t meet any resistance when they 
arrive in Thorngrip, the atmosphere is tense 
and their reception cold. Brakknap is the 
only one who greets the PCs warmly.
“You come in difficult times to make a difficult request. 
The voices of my ancestors say this took place quite often 
over fifty-ten generations ago. I wonder why it stopped. 
Death has come for us all; prematurely, in many cases. I, 
for one, do not want to see the Chitterwood lifeless, so 
let us speak openly of the peace we both desire beyond 
all this death.”
After the PCs and Brakknap have caught up, they 
can begin negotiations with Thorngrip. This is an 
Influence challenge (GM Core 187) against the council 
of elders. The PCs have six 10-minute rounds to make 
their discovery and influence checks.

## Page 123
招募一支大地精营（《NPC核心规则》194）。PC获得2点声望点数。

【影响力 8】议会只坚持奇特林伍德的自治。PC按【影响力 6】招募部队，但改为获得5点声望点数，而非2点。

【抗性】尽管长老们明白人类的记忆更长、也更不容易原谅，但他们相信地精与人类应当继续保持日常往来。任何暗示类地精与人类应当各自封闭、互不往来的影响尝试，都会使本次掷骰的DC提高2。

【弱点】长老们喜爱押韵。每轮开始时，一名PC可以尝试DC 26的表演或戏剧学识检定，用打油诗来措辞提议。成功则该轮所有影响力DC降低2。

【背景】议会成员的头衔有的花哨、有的朴素，例如“公共泥沼大师”或“二”。

【外观】该领导议会由6名类地精组成。他们都被视为长老，尽管其中一些可能是因阅历而非因年代。

【性格】议会混乱却又团结，每位成员都在尽其所能为奇特林伍德的这一片区域谋利。

【减值】长老们不信任文字。若PC提及或从事书写行为，则所有影响力DC提高2，直到PC与布拉克纳普放弃一轮、向议会保证队伍不会用文字束缚他们的灵魂为止。第二次犯下此文化错误会使DC永久提高。

【发展】谈判结束后，布拉克纳普请求加入队伍。他说自己想帮助PC，尤其是在定位诅咒源头方面。长老们坚持让他们的顾问带上两名保镖同行（一名地精突击兵与一名地精纵火兵，见《怪物核心规则》174）。这些地精无法在战斗中做出有意义的贡献，但若战斗爆发，他们会协助把布拉克纳普拖离战场。

事实上，布拉克纳普从祖先那里得知了一种破除亡灵诅咒的方法，但祖先警告这可能要以他的生命为代价。这位地精神谕者为了更大的善坦然面对自己的终局。他将此事秘而不宣，因为他认为若PC与长老们知道他将迎来死亡，就会拒绝他的帮助或阻止他离开。

【宝藏】为庆祝达成协议，长老议会将“赏金之光”（第214页）赠予PC。

【奖励】无论谈判表现如何，PC获得80 XP。

L. 吉拉穆尔的诅咒
地精血战结束后，伊尔凯娜把一项正在测试的诅咒施加在一名勘探新商路的商人身上。那名不幸的商人后来因病去世，被葬在吉拉穆尔。他尸身上的诅咒亵渎了这处聚居地，使墓园里先前下葬的尸体与仍活着的村民都变成了亡灵。

有一段时间，这道诅咒被误认为瘟疫。小镇因此被隔离，管事还悬赏寻求解药。然而，当无人能找到那并不存在的疾病时，悬赏被撤销，吉拉穆尔也被遗忘……直到现在。

这道诅咒只是伊尔凯娜打算施加于伊斯嘉的仪式的一次试运行。真正的仪式已经启动后，吉拉穆尔成了一条导管——许多导管之一，协助仪式在这片国土的土壤深处扎根。虽然在此驱散诅咒无法阻止伊尔凯娜的仪式，但它能降低亡灵滋生的速度。

【村庄状态】在地精血战之后、诅咒生效之前，吉拉穆尔迅速恢复，借战后经济繁荣成为一座生机勃勃的村庄。杜鲁玛佣兵联盟旗下的商队常在此停歇；他们更偏爱温馨的家庭旅馆，而非大型聚居地里拥挤的客栈。

诅咒扎根后，村民要么离开村庄，要么任由亡灵与天气肆虐。如今，吉拉穆尔已成一片破败废墟，满是坍塌的棚屋与房舍。这里几乎没有自然重新夺回遗址的迹象；残存的树木也呈现病态的枯萎，叶片上布满黄黑斑点。在令人不安的寂静中，通往墓园的道路清晰可见。

Appearance Six goblinoids make up this leadership council. 
All are considered elders, though this might be due to 
experience rather than age in some cases.
Personality The council is chaotic yet cohesive, each doing 
their best for this part of the Chitterwood.

particularly in locating the curse. The elders insist 
their advisor take two bodyguards with him (a goblin 
commando and a goblin pyro, Monster Core 174). 
While these goblins can’t participate meaningfully in 
combat, they do help drag Brakknap out of combat if 
a fight starts.
In truth, Brakknap has learned of a way to break the 
undead curse from his ancestors, but they cautioned 
that it might come at the cost of his life. The goblin 
oracle faces his end bravely for the greater good. He 
keeps this to himself, thinking the PCs and elders 
would reject his aid or prevent him from leaving if 
they knew of his impending death.

L. The Curse of Gillamoor
After the Goblinblood Wars ended, Illcayna placed a 
curse she was testing on a merchant who was scouting 
out new trade routes. The unfortunate merchant later 
passed from sickness and was buried in Gillamoor. The 
curse on his body desecrated the settlement, and both the 
bodies previously buried in its graveyard and its living 
villagers transformed into undead. For a while, this curse 
was misidentified as a plague. The town was quarantined, 
and the steward put up a bounty for a cure. When none 
could find the nonexistent disease, however, the bounty 
was rescinded and Gillamoor forgotten… until now.
The curse is but a trial run of the ritual Illcayna 
wishes to inflict on Isger. With the true ritual underway, 
Gillamoor has become a conduit—one of many helping 
the ritual take root in the nation’s very soil. While 
dispelling the curse here does not stop Illcayna’s ritual, 
it can reduce the rate at which the undead spawn.
Village Condition: In the wake of the Goblinblood 
Wars but before the curse took hold, Gillamoor quickly 
recovered, becoming a vibrant village in the post-war 
economic boom. It was popular with caravans under 
Druma’s Mercenary League, who preferred homely 
bed-and-breakfasts to the crowded inns of larger 
settlements. Once the curse took root, the inhabitants 
left the village for the undead and weather to ravage. 
Today, Gillamoor is a decrepit ruin full of collapsed 
huts and houses. It’s devoid of the nature that usually 
reclaims such sites, and any trees still standing have an 
unhealthy wilt to them, their leaves spotted yellow and 
black. In the unsettling silence, the way to the graveyard 
is clear.

## Page 124
L1. 长枪骑士团
琉狱破军并不是唯一在寻找诅咒源头的人。一支隶属于长枪骑士团的地狱骑士分遣队——该骑士团致力于屠灭威胁社会的怪物——在凯托命令他们无视不死生物之后，脱离了凯托的部队。随后，他们找到了吉拉穆尔，前来查看自己是否能解决这里的问题。

生物：不幸的是，不死生物在他们行军途中削减了地狱骑士的兵力。最终只有赫卡蒂妮娅与赫斯特莱贝丝·雷姆塞恩（意志坚定的人类女性地狱骑士双胞胎3），也就是长枪骑士团执政官的外甥女，成功抵达吉拉穆尔。PC们抵达时，这对双胞胎正将被骷髅巨人淹没。

赫卡蒂妮娅　生物3
执勤军官（《Pathfinder NPC Core》113）
先攻 察觉 +9
猎人的疲乏 由于整天与不死生物连续作战，两名地狱骑士都具有疲乏（状态）。如常，经过一整夜的休息后该状态会消失。

赫斯特莱贝丝　生物3
狱卒（《Pathfinder NPC Core》112）
先攻 察觉 +9
猎人的疲乏 同赫卡蒂妮娅。

骷髅巨人（2）　生物3
《Pathfinder 怪物 Core》313
先攻 察觉 +7

招募地狱骑士：如果PC们救下赫卡蒂妮娅与赫斯特莱贝丝，队伍可以使用“为事业招募”（第120页）来尝试招募长枪骑士团。诸如治疗双胞胎并为她们提供庇护等友善举动，会使该检定的DC降低2。成功时，双胞胎说服她们的姨妈向琉狱破军派遣一支令人印象深刻的地狱骑士骑兵旅（《NPC Core》93；若为大成功，则派遣两支骑兵）。

奖励：如果PC们成功将长枪骑士团招募到己方阵营，他们获得2点声望点数。若他们蓄意杀死筋疲力尽的见习地狱骑士（armiger），则争议将导致琉狱破军失去5点声望点数。姐妹二人还带着一张记载仪式“神圣基石”（divine keystone，第215页）的卷轴，以及施放该仪式所需的材料——她们原计划用它在这座被诅咒的村庄里为自己建立一处安全据点。

L2. 守墓人小屋
守墓人的家是最后几座被遗弃的建筑之一。门窗都经过坚固加固。室内覆着一层尘土，但除此之外仍适合过夜休息……前提是诅咒已不再生效。

濒死的艾琳涅丝：如果PC们放过了第2章中“黄金艾琳涅丝”的首领恩德瑞娅修女，那么他们会在这里发现她仅剩1点生命值，正被诅咒夺走生命。若恩德瑞娅已死，PC们则会发现希尔芙修女。

艾琳涅丝姐妹并非为诅咒而来；她们被引到此处，是为了追猎那些扰动她们亡者坟墓的人。事实上，失踪的死者已作为忠于伊尔凯娜的尸妖（特征）复苏。新生的不死生物将她们过往的同伴诱至吉拉穆尔，希望杀死她们，以为这里的诅咒提供燃料。

宝藏：若PC们在卡丽丝翠尔月10日之前设法解除诅咒，此处的那位修女会幸存并在萨林盖洛避难。她会将拯救了自己的“盐与土护符”（token of salt and earth，第212页）赠与PC们，并指引他们前往一座被扰动的坟墓——她曾在那里看到一件“灾祸”（calamity，第212页）从土中露出。

L3. 受诅咒的坟墓　中等7
被伊尔凯娜下咒的商人，是一名来自杜鲁玛乡间、名叫多托尔·哈皮尔的艾尤瓦林男性。尽管他在商队中的前景一片光明，但多托尔却因染上痢疾而英年早逝。由于没有遗嘱可执行，并且不愿将可能带有传染性的尸体运回杜鲁玛，商队选择将他安葬在吉拉穆尔一座体面的墓穴中，却在不知不觉间为这座城镇招来了灭顶之灾。

吉拉穆尔的墓园位于一座10尺高的小丘上，四周围着一圈5尺高的砖铁围栏。所有坟墓看起来都曾被掘开并遭到亵渎。多托尔的坟也被挖开了，但他的墓碑仍然完好。除名字外，墓碑还记载了他的死亡年份（4702 AR），以及一句话：“永存于佣兵联盟第27支队的记忆之中。”

PC们可以通过一次成功的DC 28 医疗检定，推断出多托尔的族裔与死因。若他们成功通过DC 23 宗教或秘学检定，还会得知他的骨骸已被虚无能量浸透，并正渗入周围土壤。若PC们在该检定中超出DC 5点，他们会注意到：在尸体之中还有一处更深的“不死之井”，正为诅咒提供养分并放大其效应。事实上，伊斯嘉地下翻涌着足以称作“一整片海洋”的虚无能量；之所以只能在这里观察到，是因为这具尸体正在汲取它。

L2. KEEPER’S HUT
The grave keeper’s home was one of the last buildings 
to be left behind. The windows and doors are 
well-fortified. The interior is covered in a layer of 
dust but is otherwise suitable for an overnight 
rest… if the curse is no longer in effect.
Dying Erinyes: If the PCs spared Sister 
Endreah, the leader of the Golden Erinys from 
Chapter 2, they find her here with 1 Hit Point 
left, succumbing to the curse. If Endreah 
died, the PCs find Sister Sylve instead.
The Erinys sisters are not here for 
the curse; they were led here to hunt 
whoever disturbed the graves of their 
deceased. In truth, the missing dead 
have risen as wights loyal to Illcayna. 
The newly undead lured their past 
compatriots to Gillamoor in hopes of killing 
them to fuel the curse here.
Treasure: If the PCs manage to lift the curse before 
the 10th of Calistril, the sister here survives and takes 
shelter in Saringallow. She gifts the PCs the token of 
salt and earth (page 212) that saved her and points 
them to a disturbed grave where she saw a calamity 
(page 212) sticking out.
L3. THE CURSED GRAVE	
MODERATE 7
The merchant Illcayna cursed was an aiuvarin man 
from rural Druma named Dottol Harpier. Though 
his future with the caravan looked bright, Dottol’s 
life was cut short when he caught dysentery and died. 
Without a will to execute and not wanting to transport 
a possibly infectious body back to Druma, the caravan 
opted to bury him in a respectable grave in Gillamoor, 
unknowingly dooming the town.
Gillamoor’s graveyard is up on a 10-foot-high hill, 
surrounded by a brick-and-iron fence that’s 5 feet tall. 
All of the graves look like they’ve been dug up and 
desecrated. Dottol’s grave has been dug up as well, but 
his gravestone is still intact. Other than his name, the 
gravestone notes the year of his death (4702 ar) and a 
single sentence that reads, “Forever in the memory of 
the 27th contingent of the Mercenary League.”
The PCs can deduce Dottol’s ancestry and cause 
of death with a successful DC 28 Medicine check. If 
they succeed at a DC 23 Religion or Occultism check, 
they also learn that his bones are saturated with void 
energy that’s bleeding into the surrounding soil. If the 
PCs surpass this check by 5, they notice that there’s an 
even deeper well of undeath feeding and amplifying 
the curse on the body. In fact, an entire ocean’s worth 
of void energy rumbles beneath Isger, which can only 
be observed here because the body is tapping into it.
L1. THE ORDER OF THE PIKE	
TRIVIAL 7
The Hellbreakers aren’t the only ones seeking the 
curse’s source. A Hellknight contingent from the 
Order of the Pike, which is dedicated to slaying 
monsters that threaten society, broke off from 
Caeto’s forces after he ordered them to ignore 
the undead. They then located Gillamoor and 
came to see if they could solve the problem.
Creatures: Unfortunately, the undead 
thinned the Hellknights’ ranks as they 
traveled. Only Hecatinia and Hestlebeth 
Remsaine (determined female human 
Hellknight twins 3), nieces to the lictor 
of the Order of the Pike, managed 
to reach Gillamoor. When the PCs 
arrive, the twins are about to be 
overwhelmed by skeletal giants.

Dying Erinyes: If the PCs spared Sister Endreah, the leader of the Golden Erinys from Chapter 2, they find her here with 1 Hit Point left, succumbing to the curse. If Endreah died, the PCs find Sister Sylve instead.
The Erinys sisters are not here for the curse; they were led here to hunt whoever disturbed the graves of their deceased. In truth, the missing dead have risen as wights loyal to Illcayna. The newly undead lured their past compatriots to Gillamoor in hopes of killing them to fuel the curse here.
Treasure: If the PCs manage to lift the curse before the 10th of Calistril, the sister here survives and takes shelter in Saringallow. She gifts the PCs the token of salt and earth (page 212) that saved her and points them to a disturbed grave where she saw a calamity (page 212) sticking out.

Dottol’s Grave

L3. THE CURSED GRAVE MODERATE 7
The merchant Illcayna cursed was an aiuvarin man from rural Druma named Dottol Harpier. Though his future with the caravan looked bright, Dottol’s life was cut short when he caught dysentery and died. Without a will to execute and not wanting to transport a possibly infectious body back to Druma, the caravan opted to bury him in a respectable grave in Gillamoor, unknowingly dooming the town.
Gillamoor’s graveyard is up on a 10-foot-high hill, surrounded by a brick-and-iron fence that’s 5 feet tall. All of the graves look like they’ve been dug up and desecrated. Dottol’s grave has been dug up as well, but his gravestone is still intact. Other than his name, the gravestone notes the year of his death (4702 ar) and a single sentence that reads, “Forever in the memory of the 27th contingent of the Mercenary League.”
The PCs can deduce Dottol’s ancestry and cause of death with a successful DC 28 Medicine check. If they succeed at a DC 23 Religion or Occultism check, they also learn that his bones are saturated with void energy that’s bleeding into the surrounding soil. If the PCs surpass this check by 5, they notice that there’s an even deeper well of undeath feeding and amplifying the curse on the body. In fact, an entire ocean’s worth of void energy rumbles beneath Isger, which can only be observed here because the body is tapping into it.

## Page 125
【安全港湾】
当本章开始时，由于埃利迪尔处于戒严状态，而洛加斯则分别被亡灵占领，PC唯一能返回的地方只有萨灵加洛。随着“奇特伍德攻势”的成功，自卡利斯崔尔月7日起，洛加斯也可作为PC休整恢复的地点。该城市被视为一个8级定居点。洛加斯还会向PC的部队提供两个大地精营。

【解除诅咒】
若布拉克纳普不与队伍同行，PC可以使用诸如4环或更高阶的consecrate或divine keystone等仪式来破解诅咒。除了时间成本外，若他们手头没有材料，PC可能还需要前往洛加斯或萨灵加洛取得所需的成分。

若布拉克纳普与队伍同行，他会透露自己知道一种更快的破除诅咒方法，这得益于其祖先的协助。与需要更多准备的仪式不同，布拉克纳普只需连续吟唱5轮。在此期间，他每轮都会获得迟缓2，且必须始终保持在坟墓5尺范围内。

【生物】
让布拉克纳普破除诅咒虽然高效，但也会使他成为亡灵欲除之后快的目标，因为它们能感知到他的力量将宣告它们的毁灭。当PC或布拉克纳普开始仪式时，四名“不死侍僧”与一名“神爪地狱王冠”会悄然起身包围他们。侍僧们会从坟中爬出，并贴近目标保持距离，以便它们的灵光能够阻止治疗并牵制PC。神爪地狱王冠则从外侧现身，试图从栅栏后方偷袭仪式的主要施法者。

破除诅咒并不会打断这些亡灵；即使诅咒已被解除，它们也必须被摧毁。

若布拉克纳普陷入昏迷，他的灵魂会立刻升起，并在自己昏迷的身体上方继续吟唱。若该地精连续3个回合保持在0生命值，他便会死亡。此牺牲会自动解除诅咒：他的身体会在坟墓上长成一棵树，数据等同于一棵4环的protector tree。在灵魂离去前，布拉克纳普会安慰PC，说他的死亡出于自愿，与他们无关，并表示自己很高兴能回馈那些曾为他的族人付出良多的人。随后布拉克纳普与祖先相聚，进入永恒的休息，终于获得安宁。此后数年，吉拉莫尔朝奇特伍德方向会生长出更多树木，直到两片林地连成一体。

若PC搜索坟墓，他们会发现多托尔的日记，其中详细记录了他在“寻者峡谷”附近进行的勘测。日记中提到，据传该峡谷是“伊斯嘉尸妖之母”的藏身处。多托尔记录自己在勘测后感到病恹恹的，但他的最后一篇记录发生在数月之后；其中他抱怨自己患上痢疾，却又为即将前往吉拉莫尔而欣喜。PC只需花1小时研究日记，就能推断他们下一步应前往寻者峡谷，并确定伊尔凯娜是操纵亡灵的幕后敌人。

Lifting the Curse: If Brakknap isn’t with the party, 
the PCs can break the curse with rituals such as 
consecrate or divine keystone of 4th rank or higher. 
Other than the cost of time, the PCs might need to 
head to Logas or Saringallow to obtain ingredients if 
they don’t have any on hand.
If Brakknap is with the party, however, he reveals 
he knows of a faster method to break the curse that is 
made possible with the help of his ancestors. Unlike the 
rituals, which require greater preparation, Brakknap 
only needs to chant for 5 consecutive rounds. During 
these, he is slowed 2 each round and must remain 
within 5 feet of the grave.
Creature: While having Brakknap break the curse is 
efficient, it also marks him as a target for the undead 
to eliminate, as they can sense that his power would 
spell their doom. When the PCs or Brakknap start the 
ritual, four deathless acolytes and a Godclaw hellcrown 
stealthily rise to surround them. The acolytes come 
out from the graves, remaining close by so their aura 
can prevent healing and keep the PCs occupied. The 
Godclaw hellcrown rises outside and tries to pick 
off the ritual’s primary caster from behind the fence. 
Breaking the curse doesn’t disrupt these undead; they 
must be destroyed even if the curse is broken.
If Brakknap falls unconscious, his soul immediately 
rises and continues chanting over his own unconscious 
body. The goblin dies if he remains at 0 Hit Points 
for 3 consecutive turns. This sacrifice automatically 
breaks the curse, as his body sprouts into a tree over 
the grave with the statistics of a 4th-rank protector 
tree. Before his soul departs, Brakknap makes sure to 
comfort the PCs, saying that his death was his choice 
and wasn’t their fault, and that he’s glad to give back 
to those who gave so much for his people. Brakknap 
then joins his ancestors for his eternal rest, finally 
at peace. In the years afterward, more trees grow in 
Gillamoor in the direction of Chitterwood until the 
two woods become one.

SAFE HAVENS
The PCs only have Saringallow to return to when they start this chapter, since both Elidir and Logas are under martial law or overrun by undead, respectively. With the success of the Chitterwood Offensive, Logas becomes available as a place where the PCs can recuperate from the 7th of Calistril onward. The city is considered a level 8 settlement. Logas also provides two hobgoblin battalions to the PCs’ forces.

Lifting the Curse: If Brakknap isn’t with the party, the PCs can break the curse with rituals such as consecrate or divine keystone of 4th rank or higher. Other than the cost of time, the PCs might need to head to Logas or Saringallow to obtain ingredients if they don’t have any on hand.
If Brakknap is with the party, however, he reveals he knows of a faster method to break the curse that is made possible with the help of his ancestors. Unlike the rituals, which require greater preparation, Brakknap only needs to chant for 5 consecutive rounds. During these, he is slowed 2 each round and must remain within 5 feet of the grave.

Creature: While having Brakknap break the curse is efficient, it also marks him as a target for the undead to eliminate, as they can sense that his power would spell their doom. When the PCs or Brakknap start the ritual, four deathless acolytes and a Godclaw hellcrown stealthily rise to surround them. The acolytes come out from the graves, remaining close by so their aura can prevent healing and keep the PCs occupied. The Godclaw hellcrown rises outside and tries to pick off the ritual’s primary caster from behind the fence.
Breaking the curse doesn’t disrupt these undead; they must be destroyed even if the curse is broken.
If Brakknap falls unconscious, his soul immediately rises and continues chanting over his own unconscious body. The goblin dies if he remains at 0 Hit Points for 3 consecutive turns. This sacrifice automatically breaks the curse, as his body sprouts into a tree over the grave with the statistics of a 4th-rank protector tree. Before his soul departs, Brakknap makes sure to comfort the PCs, saying that his death was his choice and wasn’t their fault, and that he’s glad to give back to those who gave so much for his people. Brakknap then joins his ancestors for his eternal rest, finally at peace. In the years afterward, more trees grow in Gillamoor in the direction of Chitterwood until the two woods become one.

## Page 126
宝藏：PC们找到一件阴森的战利品、20 gp、价值100 gp的散装宝石，以及一份安眠药膏。

奖励：若PC们在吉拉穆尔解除诅咒，则除战斗通常获得的XP外，再获得30 XP与5点声望点数。若由布拉克纳普解除诅咒且在过程中存活，PC们额外获得10 XP。先知变得更为强大，GM可以将精英模板应用于布拉克纳普的数据。

M. 寻觅者峡谷之谜
寻觅者峡谷镇在一个多世纪前遭遇了与吉拉穆尔相似的命运，不过其毁灭并非源于诅咒，而是伊尔凯娜本人带来的。直到她探索了乌加梭娅神殿洞窟之外蜿蜒扭曲的隧道后，才发现自己巢穴的意义。尽管大多数隧道通往幽暗地域，但其中有一条向上延伸，终点是一处洞窟，其内有一汪清澈如水晶的池水。伊尔凯娜观摩墙上的古老壁画，并饮下池水后得知：这间密室正是她的先祖最初接受乌加梭娅恩典之地。
同样也是在这里，“四季十二部族”最后的战团集结，随后他们举兵对抗自己的亡灵同族，并最终成为伊斯嘉人。真相早就写在这处聚落的名字里：此山谷正是伊斯嘉的奠基之地——无论在不死抑或死亡之中，在精神与哲学层面皆是如此。多数人面对这般启示都会心怀谦卑，但伊尔凯娜在得知这一切后，反而更加坚信自己就是伊斯嘉受选的统治者。

侦察寻觅者峡谷：伊尔凯娜的名字一直以都市传说的形式被低声耳语；当“断狱者”的新兵得知她竟是眼下亡灵大军的幕后主使时，皆为之震惊。许多人开始绝望，因为他们原以为将要对抗的是邪教徒或摧毁一件被诅咒的物品，而不是举兵对抗一个传说与噩梦之中的存在。“暴动煽动者”竭尽所能修补这支初生军队的士气，于是请求PC们前去侦察寻觅者峡谷，以证明伊尔凯娜的势力并非不可战胜。
在获得一枚战争碎片后，伊尔凯娜自认已不可触及，便决定：与其让最强大的仆从守护自己，不如让他们去为她那席卷全国的诅咒提供所需的亡灵储备。部分仆从心甘情愿献出自身存在，另一些则徒劳地试图反抗。因而，寻觅者峡谷在数十年来首次出现防卫空虚——PC们必须抓住这次机会。

M1. 进镇道路　琐碎 7
通往镇子的道路两侧，是已被遗弃的农庄。这里曾住着一名侍僧与一名死灵法师，担任瞭望者；如今两人都已在违背意愿的情况下，被诅咒献祭。

生物：由于仍需要有人望风，伊尔凯娜用一种名为“红滴”的真菌苦难感染了镇郊的红帽妖。她将病症压制在缓解期，并威胁这些妖精：若拒绝为她效力，她便撤去保护。红帽妖虽心怀不满却仍接受了，因为他们宁愿在这里继续其嗜杀行径，也不愿回到第一世界。
红帽妖很乐意将PC们当作最新的受害者，但任何提出要治疗这些明显感染的妖精的提议，都会令其迟疑。若PC们成功治愈红帽妖，它们会决定装作没看见几分钟，让PC们通过；但它们也会警告：若PC们从这条路返回，它们会视之为PC们主动求死的信号，并将战至最后一刻。

Treasure: The PCs find a grim trophy, 20 gp, 100 gp 
worth of loose gemstones, and a restful salve.
Reward: The PCs gain 30 XP and 5 Reputation Points 
if they lift the curse in Gillamoor in addition to the usual 
XP from combat. If Brakknap is the one who breaks the 
curse and survives the process, the PCs gain an additional 
10 XP. The oracle grows more powerful, and the GM can 
apply the elite template to Brakknap’s statistics.
M. The Mystery of Finder’s 
Gulch
The town of Finder’s Gulch suffered a fate similar to 
Gillamoor’s over a century ago, though rather than a 
curse, it was Illcayna herself who brought ruination. 
She didn’t discover the significance of her lair until 
she explored the twisting tunnels beyond the cave of 
Urgathoa’s temple. Though most led to the Darklands, 
there was one that led upward, ending at a grotto that 
featured a pool clearer than crystal. While observing 
the ancient murals on the walls and drinking from its 
waters, Illcayna learned this chamber was the site where 
her ancestors first accepted Urgathoa’s grace.
It was also here that the last warband of the Twelve 
Tribes of the Seasons gathered before they took up arms 
against their undead brethren and became the Isgeri. 
The truth was in the settlement’s name all along: this 
valley was the place where Isger was founded, spiritually 
and philosophically, in both undeath and death. Most 
would have been humbled by such revelations, but 
when Illcayna gained this knowledge, it only solidified 
her belief that she was the chosen ruler of Isger.
Scouting Finder’s Gulch: Illcayna’s name is 
whispered as an urban legend; learning that she’s the 
mastermind behind the current undead horde shocks 
the Hellbreakers’ recruits. Many begin to despair, 
as they were expecting to fight cultists or destroy a 
cursed item, not take up arms against a being of legend 
and nightmares. As the Riotmongers do all they can 
to repair the nascent army’s morale, they ask the PCs 
to scout out Finder’s Gulch and prove that Illcayna’s 
forces are not invincible.
After she obtained a warshard, Illcayna believed she’d 
become untouchable and decided that her strongest 
servants would be of more use fueling the undead 
reservoir needed for her nationwide curse than they 
would protecting her. Some of these servants readily give 
their existence, while others futilely attempt to resist her. 
Finder’s Gulch is therefore low in security for the first 
time in decades—an opportunity the PCs must seize.
M1. TOWN ENTRY ROAD	
TRIVIAL 7
The abandoned farms that flank the path into town 
used to house an acolyte and a necromancer who 
served as lookouts. Both have been sacrificed to the 
curse unwillingly.
Creatures: As she still needed someone to keep 
watch, Illcayna infected the redcaps on the outskirts 
of town with a fungal affliction known as the red drip. 
She held the disease in remission and threatened to 
withdraw her protection should the fey refuse to serve 
her. The redcaps grudgingly accepted, as they preferred 
to continue their murderous ways here instead of back 
in the First World.
While the redcaps are more than happy to make 
the PCs their latest victims, any offer to cure the 
visibly infected fey makes them hesitate. If the PCs 
successfully cure the redcaps, they decide to look away 
for a few minutes and let the PCs pass. They warn that 
if the PCs return this way, though, they’ll view it as a 
sign that the PCs wish to be murdered and will fight 
to the death.

M. The Mystery of Finder’s Gulch
The town of Finder’s Gulch suffered a fate similar to Gillamoor’s over a century ago, though rather than a curse, it was Illcayna herself who brought ruination. She didn’t discover the significance of her lair until she explored the twisting tunnels beyond the cave of Urgathoa’s temple. It was also here that the last warband of the Twelve Tribes of the Seasons gathered before they took up arms against their undead brethren and became the Isgeri. Most would have been humbled by such revelations, but when Illcayna gained this knowledge, it only solidified her belief that she was the chosen ruler of Isger.

Scouting Finder’s Gulch: Illcayna’s name is whispered as an urban legend; learning that she’s the mastermind behind the current undead horde shocks the Hellbreakers’ recruits. 杀死了她，并让它们追查制造它们的人。她还确保抓住灰烬教会的女大祭司西莱迪娅·艾欧曼迪（Cileidia Iomandi）。伊尔凯娜一直认为西莱迪娅不配侍奉乌加梭娅，因为这位来自乌斯塔拉夫的老女人更热衷于策划如何攻击她的故土，而不是贯彻苍白公主的意志。就像她把自己喂给不死生物一样，伊尔凯娜割开西莱迪娅的身体，让尸妖将这位女祭司吞噬殆尽。尽管从技术上讲，这确实是对一名完成任务的乌加梭娅仆从而言恰当的终末献祭，但伊尔凯娜个人也很高兴能让教团摆脱她所认为的、丢人现眼的信徒。

祟灵：西莱迪娅惨死的回响在她死后数年间凝结为一处祟灵。侍奉伊尔凯娜的教徒对其默许，尤其因为伊尔凯娜喜欢一遍遍重看西莱迪娅的死亡。然而，自诅咒仪式开始后，伊尔凯娜自身死亡的回声也再次浮现。两位女祭司之死的相似性让两道灵性回响彼此共振，直到最终融合。

当祟灵处于活跃状态时，受过【察觉】训练且未被祟灵影响的生物会注意到祟灵中心有一名女性身影在闪烁，成群不死生物会扑上去将其吞噬。该身影的面容迅速变化，在两名不同女祭司的形象间交替：年轻的女祭司张开双臂接受命运，喜极而泣；年迈的女祭司则痛苦惊恐地尖叫，双臂被绳索绑在柱子上。两者看起来都在流血，身上有被拉出的长长伤口。

女祭司被啃食祟灵（CANNIBALIZATION OF THE PRIESTESS） 祟灵 9

killed her and had them track down their makers. She 
made sure to capture the head priestess of the Ashen 
Church, Cileidia Iomandi. Illcayna always thought 
Cileidia was unworthy to serve Urgathoa, as the old 
Ustalav woman was more focused on planning how to 
attack her homeland than enacting the Pallid Princess’s 
will. Much like how she fed herself to the undead, 
Illcayna cut Cileidia and let the wights devour the 
priestess. While it was technically a proper final sacrifice 
in honor of a servant of Urgathoa who completed their 
task, Illcayna was personally glad to rid the cult of what 
she considered to be an embarrassment of a worshipper.
Haunt: The echoes of Cileidia’s gruesome end 
manifested as a haunt in the years after her death. The 
cultists serving Illcayna tolerated it, especially since 
she was fond of rewatching Cileidia’s demise. Since the 
curse ritual began, however, echoes of Illcayna’s own 
death have resurfaced as well. The similarities between 
the two priestesses’ deaths caused the two spiritual 
echoes to resonate until they merged.
When the haunt is active, creatures trained in 
Perception and not caught by the haunt notice a feminine 
figure flickering in the center of the haunt, which throngs 
of undead descend upon and devour. The visage of the 
figure changes rapidly, alternating between images of 
two different priestesses. The young priestess cries tears 
of joy as she holds out her arms to accept her fate, while 
the elderly priestess cries out in pain and panic, her arms 
bound to pillars with ropes. Both appear to be bleeding 
from long cuts made to the body.

重置（Reset） 该祸患在M2中不再有任何生物处于流血状态后的1分钟内失效。若被解除，则在1天后重置。彻底摧毁此祸患的唯一方法是消灭伊尔凯娜（Illcayna）。

宝藏（宝藏）PC们第一次解除该祸患时，它会伴随一声尖啸消失，并留下了一块破烂的红布，其效果等同于一张“千痛之刃符箓”（blade thousand-pains fulu，《宝藏库》79页）。

M3. 祭献地点（SACRIFICIAL SITE） 低威胁 7（LOW 7）
过去，其他信仰的信徒曾在这片焦黑的土地上被献祭。这里原本有一个祸患，但随着伊尔凯娜的仪式展开，它已消散，以便让其他事物取而代之。

生物（生物）伊尔凯娜最近一次献祭自己的仆从，创造出一种名为“硫磺丧尸”的焚燃不死生物。伊尔凯娜认为处理这些残留物不值一提，于是任命了三名新近复苏的“艾琳妮丝姐妹尸妖”来约束这具燃烧的不死生物。由于过去曾被PC们击败，这些不死姐妹将战斗至被摧毁为止。注意：艾琳妮丝姐妹尸妖只有爪击与飞镖打击（Strike），而非尸妖通常的攻击方式。

M4. 亵渎教堂（DESECRATED CHURCH） 极端 7（SEVERE 7）
乌加托亚信徒已将这座原本供奉法拉丝玛的神殿彻底亵渎：所有窗户尽数破碎，墙面满是歌颂苍白公主的涂鸦。人们曾多次试图将整栋建筑彻底拆毁，但都以失败告终，因此最终任其荒废。当默语魔道的代表团请求一处永久居所时，乌加托亚信徒便安排他们搬入此处，作为一种隐蔽的羞辱。这座教堂内部的地图见第128页。

默语魔道提供协助自然并非出于利他，因为塔—巴丰（塔巴丰）并不介意再拥有一位乌加托亚之子作为仆从——若这名仆从还带来一片领地，那就更好了。另一方面，他们也担忧：受战晶（warshard）强化的伊尔凯娜可能成为敌人，因为她绝不会接受侍奉任何人（除了乌加托亚）。因此，默语魔道派遣吸血裔（特征）女巫瓦拉里奥·德米奇（Varlario Demicci，随性、无性别的吸血裔女巫8级）前往伊斯嘉，既作为友好使者，也作为间谍。瓦拉里奥推进了伊尔凯娜的计划，并在此过程中得知了她的诸多弱点。这名女巫甚至研发出一道法术，以便在必要时剥夺“伊斯嘉尸妖之母”（尸妖（特征） Mother of 伊斯嘉）的战晶。

生物（Creatures）伊尔凯娜忙于仪式之际，瓦拉里奥腾出时间，邀请了1只石棺异怪（sarcovalt）与2只碎骨小鬼（skaveling）作为默语魔道的客人前来。瓦拉里奥并不介意PC们偷听他们的交谈；他们反倒觉得好笑，居然有人会考虑击倒伊尔凯娜而不是逃命。在他们看来，这些自封英雄已晚了几个月；若伊尔凯娜没拿到战晶，PC们或许还有机会。若与瓦拉里奥交谈，PC们很容易察觉这名间谍并不排斥建立秘密同盟。瓦拉里奥能协助PC们了解伊尔凯娜的弱点，但与默语魔道达成交易会严重损害地狱破除者（Hellbreakers）的声誉，使PC们失去5点声望点数（Reputation Points）。

在战斗中，石棺异怪与碎骨小鬼会战至死亡，而瓦拉里奥会战斗到其生命值低于50点为止。一旦到达该阈值，瓦拉里奥便会哀求饶命，承诺以任何PC们想要的条件交换性命。若PC们不肯放过，瓦拉里奥会先把PC们的物品朝他们扔过去以分散注意，随后施放其传送法术（translocate）逃离。

M3. SACRIFICIAL SITE	
LOW 7
Worshippers of other faiths were sacrificed at this 
patch of scorched earth in the past. There used to be a 
haunt here, but with Illcayna’s ritual underway, it has 
dissipated to allow something else to take its place.
Creature: The most recent sacrifice of Illcayna’s 
own servants created an incendiary undead known as 
a sulfur zombie. Illcayna considers dealing with these 
residues to be beneath her. She appointed three newly 
risen erinys sister wights to keep the fiery undead in 
check. Having been defeated by the PCs in the past, 
the undead sisters fight until destroyed. Note that the 
erinys sister wights only have a claw and a dart Strike 
instead of the usual attacks of a wight.

Treasure: The sulfur zombie crumbles to dust once

M4. DESECRATED CHURCH	
SEVERE 7
The Urgathoans have thoroughly desecrated this 
former temple to Pharasma. All windows are broken, 
and the walls have been graffitied with praises to the 
Pallid Princess. Attempts to fully tear down the building 
have always failed, so the structure was eventually 
left alone. When the delegation from the Whispering 
Way requested a permanent residence, the Urgathoans 
arranged for them to move into this building as a 
stealthy insult. The map of the interior of this church 
is on page 128.
The Whispering Way’s assistance is naturally not 
altruistic, as Tar-Baphon would not mind having 
another Child of Urgathoa as a servant. If that servant 
came with a piece of territory, all the better. There’s 
also the concern that a warshard-empowered Illcayna 
could become an enemy, as she would soundly reject the 
idea of serving anyone but Urgathoa. The Whispering 
Way thus sent the dhampir witch Varlario Demicci 
(carefree agender dhampir witch 8) to Isger as both a 
goodwill ambassador and a spy. Varlario has furthered 
Illcayna’s plans and in the process learned many of her 
weaknesses. The witch has even developed a spell to 
deprive the Wight Mother of Isger of her warshard 
should the need arise.
Creatures: With Illcayna busy with her ritual, 
Varlario found time to invite a sarcovalt and two 
skavelings from the Whispering Way over as guests. 
Varlario doesn’t mind the PCs overhearing their 
conversation, finding it amusing that anyone might 
consider taking Illcayna down instead of fleeing. In 
their opinion, the wannabe-heroes are a few months 
too late; if Illcayna hadn’t gotten the warshard, they 
might have stood a chance. If they converse with 
Varlario, the PCs easily get the sense that the spy 
wouldn’t mind establishing a secret alliance. While 
Varlario can assist the PCs in learning Illcayna’s 
weaknesses, making a deal with the Whispering Way 
greatly harms the reputation of the Hellbreakers, 
causing the PCs to lose 5 Reputation Points.
In combat, the sarcovalt and the skavelings fight to 
the death, while Varlario fights until they are below 50 
Hit Points. Once they hit this threshold, Varlario begs 
for mercy, offering anything the PCs wish in exchange 
for their life. If the PCs don’t give up, Varlario distracts 
them by throwing their items at them before using 
their translocate spell to flee.

The Urgathoans have thoroughly desecrated this former temple to Pharasma. All windows are broken, and the walls have been graffitied with praises to the Pallid Princess. HP 110（虚空治疗）

影融 反应动作（）(幻术、灵异、暗影) 频率：每分钟一次；触发：当瓦拉里奥因昏暗光照或黑暗而处于隐蔽或隐藏状态时，有生物尝试进行纯骰检定以将其作为目标；效果：阴影缠绕瓦拉里奥的形体。该纯骰检定的DC提高2。
速度 25英尺
近战 [单动作] 匕首 +19（灵巧、娴熟、投掷10英尺、多用S），伤害 2d6+10 穿刺
远程 [单动作] 拳击 +18（灵巧、非致命），伤害 2d6+8 钝击
远程 [单动作] 手弩 +18（射程60英尺），伤害 2d8+10 穿刺

神圣先天法术 DC 26；2环 伤害术；1环 不死祝福；戏法（4环）虚空扭曲
灵异准备法术 DC 26，攻击+18；4环 困惑、飞行、秘法护甲、移位；3环 麻痹、召唤不死生物、吸血盛宴（×2）；2环 黑暗、朦胧、隐形、看见不可见；1环 命令、恐惧、阴森触须、宠物贮藏；戏法（6环）恍惚、侦测魔法、读取灵光、护盾
女巫祈咒法术（4环）3专注点，攻击+18；4环 恶意暗影、复仇之针、相位魔宠；戏法（4环）虚空扭曲
仪式 DC 26：创造不死生物

隐藏的魔宠 瓦拉里奥通过宠物贮藏法术藏起了自己的蝙蝠魔宠。除非使用撕裂灵魂，否则他们会一直把蝙蝠收容起来。

撕裂灵魂 [双动作]（专注、灵魂）频率：每分钟一次；效果：瓦拉里奥放出其蝙蝠魔宠，作为幻影般的导体，去撕扯30英尺内某个生物的灵魂。目标生物必须成功通过DC 26的基础意志豁免，否则受到9d6点灵魂伤害。随后瓦拉里奥恢复等于所造成伤害一半的生命值。

宝藏：除敌人的战利品之外，PC还能找到一块强力的灵异磁石，这是瓦拉里奥为窃取伊尔凯娜的战碎片而设计的。PC也可以从瓦拉里奥的笔记中得知：伊尔凯娜的最终仪式将在卡利斯特里尔月19日傍晚、当暮色让位于夜色之时生效。为了完成诅咒，伊尔凯娜必须返回寻者峡谷中某处瓦拉里奥并不知情的地点。该地点为“祭献者石窟”（第130页）。

M5. 西镇
在伊尔凯娜蜕变之前，灰烬教会就居住并活动在镇子的西部。邪教被歼灭后，这里的秘密地下室与房间仍被继续使用，用来创造不死生物。对这些建筑进行一次简短的探索，就能发现伊尔凯娜仆从留下的文书与往来信函，其中一些在作者被献祭给不断增长的诅咒前尚未写完。任一PC在DC 24的宗教、不死生物学识或战争学识检定中成功后，便可利用这里的信息来调查他们在“寻者峡谷围城战”（第133页）中可能遭遇的兵种类型。大成功时，他们还可以估算自己将要面对的部队数量。

宝藏：搜查这些建筑时，PC可以发现用于创造不死生物仪式而留下的、价值220 gp的玛瑙。这里也有足够的信息，使他们若愿意的话可以学会该仪式。

M6. 肉棺蜂巢 中等 7
镇中心以北有几栋建筑，曾是寻者峡谷的政治中心。最大的建筑是一座开放式市政厅，镇长就住在其旁边。这里还有两处社区花园：一处种草药，另一处（令人意外地）种有毒植物。

生物：凡是狂热崇拜乌加索娅之处，便会出现肉棺。偶尔，当伊尔凯娜认为某人卑劣到甚至不配成为不死生物时，她就会召唤肉棺来清除这处“碍眼之物”。伊尔凯娜已许久未献祭仆从——无论其是否“配得上”——而此地饥饿的肉棺蜂巢一逮到机会便会扑向PC。

低威胁7
