Hellbreakers Adventure Path
Continuing the Campaign

The PCs should be level 10 at the end of the Hellbreakers Adventure Path, having faced the many political and supernatural crises of Isger. The players are primed to continue their PCs’ adventures in the next Adventure Path, Hell’s Destiny, but there’s plenty to be done if the players wish to continue in Isger.

Campaign Consequences
The following scenarios happen if the PCs fail to defeat certain enemies or achieve their objectives.

REIGN OF THE WIGHT MOTHER
Should Illcayna succeed in her ritual, she becomes the mortal herald of Urgathoa and restores the might of the warshard embedded in her chest. This turns her into a powerful mythic being who quickly takes over Isger as she weaves a curse of undeath into the very bones of the nation, transforming it into a tribute state for Urgathoa. The goblins of the Chitterwood burrow deep underground, while those above ground are forced to flee or perish as fodder for Illcayna’s endless army of wights. Isger is at last free from Cheliax’s devilish grasp only to find itself bound by a different type of tyrant.

Ironically, Illcayna’s greatest enemy might be another terrible force of undeath: the Whispering Tyrant, Tar-Baphon. Tar-Baphon is displeased to find a rival for world domination, especially since they use similar methods of manipulating undeath, and plots to raise Whispering Way supporters against Illcayna. He also sends spies and infiltrators into the camps of his own enemies to manipulate them into taking down the Wight Mother for him, hoping his foes will weaken each other enough to allow him to destroy them all in one fell swoop.

Kinza (passionate female human cleric 6), a descendant of the original Isgeri tribes, suggests seeking warshards to aid in striking down Illcayna. The Hellbreakers League knows the approximate location of one: the very warshard they gave the Eagle Knights in exchange for their alliance, which went missing along with its carriers in the town of Falcon’s Hollow in Darkmoon Vale.

An unexpected ally is Caeto Vulaunex himself. Horrified and chastened by the chaos unleashed by his refusal to prioritize the people over his ambitions, he dedicates himself to Illcayna’s defeat in repentance. The Hellknight has little support from Cheliax, which is cutting its losses to focus on other parts of the growing war, but he’s stalwart in his devotion to seeing Illcayna’s downfall and more open to compromise than previously. Caeto is able to utilize his Chelaxian connections to learn of other warshards rumored to lie in the Iron Rose palace in the Menador Mountains and one embedded in a mysterious aquatic creature in the Conerica River.

THE KNIGHT STEWARD
In the event that the PCs fail to defeat Caeto in Saringallow, he quickly amasses the forces and authority to crush the Hellbreakers League leadership in one swift blow. Saringallow is swept up in a wave of brutal interrogations, weeding out anyone with even the slightest sympathy for rebels. The most prominent leaders are transported back to Elidir, where a public execution is held for each individual rebel leader every week so as to draw out anyone foolish and loyal enough to attempt a rescue. The Riotmongers are saved for last and executed together in a small show of kindness from Caeto.

Ardano Grizzi III (exacting male human governor 12) is chosen as the new steward of Isger. Unlike Hedvend, Ardano is ruthlessly efficient and has little love for finery or the spoiled elites. He quickly purges the government of anyone he deems too soft and promotes officials of his own choice such as Reverine Hallowell (cunning female human politician 9) and Justiro Adama (precise male gnome machinist 10). His rule is severe to make up for the recent chaos and even the elites of Elidir find themselves stifled under his iron hand.

The Hellbreakers are broken, but their story doesn’t end. The numerous allies they made and the people they helped remember who it was that truly cared for and defended Isger in its time of need. The image of a rose growing through Abrogail Thrune’s broken crown becomes a widespread symbol of resistance, along with an anti-Caeto version popular in the countryside that depicts his cracked face with thorny roses bursting through it. In this bleak present, hope is still alive, as are the PCs, and it will persevere as they continue to fight oppression.

## Page 171
更多冒险
以下情境为潜在故事线，前提是PC成功完成本冒险的目标。

地狱的宿命
尽管伊斯嘉仍有大量冒险等待发掘，想要继续与切利亚斯作战的PC可以转入下一条冒险之路《地狱的宿命》。在这场战役中，PC将加入安多安与瑞瓦诺等多个派系，直接对抗切利亚斯，并在敌人筹备迄今最恶毒的计划之际，对其地狱般的势力发动攻击。

修复首都
埃利迪尔因PC的逃脱而遭受巨大伤害，且仍由地狱骑士掌控。破狱者同盟必须与玛拉里克托露西亚·德沃娜（严肃的女性人类地狱骑士10级）谈判其投降事宜；在凯托缺席期间，是他留下露西亚主持大局。即便凯托幸存并已投降，露西亚也拒不让步，必须通过一场彻底的法律争辩，或以决斗审判来说服她。杀死露西亚也是一种选择，但这会在亲切利亚斯的精英阶层中煽动深刻的恐惧与怨恨，使他们更可能在未来策划自己的叛乱。

即使没有切利亚斯的直接干预，也有许多忠诚的切利亚斯人决心推翻破狱者同盟、恢复邪魔秩序，以便继续从一个更在意取悦其靠山而非帮助人民的政府中获利。西格内图斯·弗劳恩（浮夸的非二元人类花花公子9级）在城中踱步，哀叹其昔日荣光的陨落，痛惜埃利迪尔不再富足，并尽其所能抹黑破狱者的名声。涅里娜·半歌（被宠坏的女性德罗玛尔社交名媛10级）要求为破狱者对城市造成的一切破坏进行赔偿——首先是为她举办一场生日舞会，因为在破狱者引发的骚乱之下，她的舞会被迫取消。牧师温狄克图斯·里奇（狂热的男性人类牧师8级）每天都在阿斯摩蒂斯大教堂外抗议，高喊破狱者冒犯了其守护神祇，将为伊斯嘉招致毁灭。这些精英虽琐碎而轻浮，却掌握了埃利迪尔（进而也包括全国）的大部分财富，并对城市走向具有相当影响力。

寻觅「悲怆」
当伊尔凯娜被击败后，PC会在她的随身物品中发现一瓶共享记忆药剂。饮下药剂将揭示一段记忆：伊尔凯娜在「献祭者洞窟」的「冬之壁画」中发现了一条以魔法隐藏的信息，从而引向对四季第四奇观「悲怆」（Woe）的异象。该异象描述了群山之中一位披着雪花披风的冰冷身影。PC可以前往梅纳多山脉寻觅「悲怆」；它目前在一位名为扎莫兰娜的强大冬季鬼婆（富有艺术气质的女性鬼婆10级）手中。扎莫兰娜渴望保存世界之美，并无视类人生物社会的丑陋。她认为人们在快乐之时最为美丽，于是她走访村庄、收留旅人，以赋礼般的赠予厚待他们，并努力帮助人们实现内心所愿——却在他们幸福达到顶点时，将其冻结成坚实的冰雕。她那冰冷的山中巢穴里，满是数十件这样的冻结艺术品。

铁之女王
卡尔泰莎·伊伊斯女士已将伊斯嘉视为自己的领地数百年，蛰伏以完善其计划。得知这个国家被一群叛逆的暴发户夺走，她并不高兴。尽管她不会直接出手干预，却派遣特工着手瓦解破狱者同盟的权威，迫使他们处于更能满足玛门欲望的位置。

这些特工中的第一位是尼塞福罗·齐卡（严厉的男性人类玛门的冠军12级），一名金融家，要求在政府中担任司库并占据席位。尼塞福罗直言不讳地宣称，他要让伊斯嘉从新得的独立中获利，且不会接受拒绝；他煽动市民支持自己，声称若在与切利亚斯脱离后不如此，伊斯嘉将陷入财政灾害。他真正的动机，是通过银行将来自厄瑞玻斯的钱币散布到伊斯嘉的人群之中，借由贸易与市场在整个地区自然扩散其主人的影响。

佩特里卡·塞格拉奇（铺张的女性涅斐林犯罪头目10级）是卡尔泰莎的另一名走狗；她受雇袭击运输队、断绝国家的外来资源供给，以牵制破狱者，让女祭司得以推进其计划。卡尔泰莎还与德鲁玛商人西尔格雷·曙袖（野心勃勃的女性矮人资本家9级）有所往来；她拥有伊斯嘉人的大面积——

Further Adventures
The following scenarios are potential storylines 
contingent upon the PCs successfully completing the 
objectives of the adventure.
HELL’S DESTINY
While Isger still has plenty of adventure left, PCs 
who wish to continue the fight against Cheliax can 
transition into the next Adventure Path, Hell’s Destiny. 
In this campaign, the PCs join various factions such as 
Andoran and Ravounel to directly confront Cheliax 
and mount an attack against its hellish forces as their 
enemy prepares their most diabolical plan yet.
REPAIRING THE CAPITAL
Elidir suffered great damage from the PCs’ escape and 
is still in the hands of Hellknights. The Hellbreakers 
League must negotiate a surrender from maralictor 
Lucia Devona (serious female human Hellknight 
10), whom Caeto left in charge in his absence. Even 
if Caeto survived and surrendered, Lucia refuses to 
give in and must be persuaded via a thorough legal 
battle or trial by combat. Killing Lucia is an option, 
but this foments deep fear and resentment among the 
pro-Cheliax elites and makes them more likely to stage 
their own eventual rebellion.
Even without Cheliax’s direct intervention, there are 
plenty of loyal Chelaxians determined to bring down 
the Hellbreakers League and restore fiendish order 
so they can continue to benefit off a government that 
cares more about appeasing its patrons than helping 
its people. Cygnetus Frawn (flamboyant nonbinary 
human dandy 9) prances about the city bemoaning its 
fall from glory, lamenting the lack of riches Elidir once 
had and besmirching the name of the Hellbreakers as 
much as they can. Nerina Halfsong (spoiled female 
dromaar socialite 10) demands reparations for all 
the destruction the Hellbreakers wrought on the city, 
starting with throwing her a birthday ball since hers 
was canceled thanks to Hellbreaker-inspired riots. 
Priest Vindictus Ricci (fanatical male human priest 
8) protests daily outside the cathedral of Asmodeus, 
crying out that the Hellbreakers have sinned against 
their patron deity and will bring destruction to Isger. 
These elites, while petty and frivolous, hold most of 
Elidir’s (and therefore the nation’s) wealth and have 
substantial influence over the direction of the city.
SEEKING WOE
When Illcayna is defeated, the PCs find a potion of 
shared memories in her possession. Drinking the 
potion reveals a memory of Illcayna finding a magically 
hidden message in the mural of winter in the Grotto of 
the Sacrificed, leading to a vision of the fourth Wonder 
of the Seasons, Woe.
The vision details an icy figure in the mountains 
wearing a mantle of snowflakes. The PCs can seek 
Woe in the Menador Mountains, where it’s currently 
in the possession of a powerful winter hag named 
Zamoranna (artistic female hag 10). Zamoranna 
desires to preserve the beauty of the world and ignore 
the ugliness of humanoid societies. Believing people are 
most beautiful when they’re happy, she visits villages 
and takes in travelers, lavishing them with gifts and 
working to help people gain their heart’s desires only 
to freeze them into solid ice sculptures at the height 
of their happiness. Her icy mountain lair is filled with 
dozens of such frozen art pieces.

……土地，并计划代表卡利斯拉德预言购买更多。西尔格雷与佩特里卡合作压低聚居地的成本，好让她能轻松购入土地，同时承诺将其中一部分分给卡尔泰莎。

## 破碎的军队（FRACTURED ARMY）
并非所有人都乐于接受伊斯嘉的新方向。其官方军队分裂为数个派系，只有其中一个选择接受伊斯嘉的新领导层。

指挥官尼尔·哈罗文（军国主义男性人类士兵 12 级）领导着其中一支派系“炽焰之剑”，在地狱破除者联盟尚未能在埃利迪尔巩固地位之前便对其发动打击。尼尔认为地狱破除者过于软弱，无法恰当地领导国家，因此认定唯有军政府才是正确的答案。他得到贵族维托里娅·勒戈托（粗鲁女性人类贵族 10 级）的支持；后者希望成为伊斯嘉的新总督。维托里娅的资金与社会地位在“炽焰之剑”试图掌控首都并宣布自己为伊斯嘉新领导者时，能让埃利迪尔的社交名流们不敢轻举妄动。

其他派系则沦为四处流窜的盗匪团，趁变革带来的混乱掠夺；还有一些转而成为义警，对新秩序并不信任。卡丽丝塔·弗蕾上尉（富有魅力的女性人类士兵 9 级）领导最大的义警团体“真正的军队”，并拒绝加入任何由革命者领导的势力。

## 地狱的残余（HELLISH REMNANTS）
尽管切利亚斯在形式上已与伊斯嘉脱钩，但它地狱般的利爪早已深深扎入这个国家结构与社会的骨髓，其影响力依旧强大。最显著的是，“金伊莉妮丝修女会”声誉完美无瑕，并掌握相当可观的社会权力。即便伊斯嘉获得自由，这些修女仍怀抱使命：传播阿斯摩蒂斯的信仰，并照料那些需要其神祇严苛且复仇性指引的孤儿。事实上，在凯托忽视处理的不死生物起义之后，又出现了大量新孤儿可供她们照护。

PC们也许希望把修女会连同阿斯摩蒂斯的一切痕迹一并逐出伊斯嘉；也可能选择与她们合作。玛塞拉修女（虔诚的人类武僧 6 级）作为修女会的代表出面，恳请PC们允许修女会继续其慈善工作，并宣誓修女们效忠的是阿斯摩蒂斯而非切利亚斯。她愿意签署一份（非魔法）契约以正式化该协议，并会在不直接干涉其信仰实践的前提下对大多数条款作出让步。作为修女会得以继续存在的回报，她提供一项奖赏：在阿斯波戴尔山脉某座修道院中，一块小型战碎片（warshard）的位置；那块石头的存在已将修女们照料的一群石羊突变为“活体晨银（dawnsilver）”。

若PC们更愿意驱逐修女们，大多数人都会不作抗议地离开，唯独卡文娜修女（狂热的女性人类修女 10 级）例外。她召集虔诚的阿斯摩蒂斯信徒反对伊斯嘉的新统治者，并要求正式将阿斯摩蒂斯命名为伊斯嘉的守护神祇。若她的要求得不到满足，她便开始绑架儿童，向他们灌输阿斯摩蒂斯之道，决心不惜任何代价履行对其神祇的职责。

## 焦土之家关系（SCORCHHOME RELATIONS）
当尘埃落定，奇特林森林的地精正式将其地区命名为“焦土之家”，并宣布为自由独立的国家。地精类内部对是否信任类人生物、建立正式同盟还是保持自立，存在紧张分歧。布拉克纳普更希望见到所有族裔团结一致，并建议PC们摧毁“伊斯嘉屠戮者”这一偏执而暴力的组织，以示善意。PC们可以轻易追踪并清剿分散各地的伊斯嘉屠戮者小队，从而铲除该组织；但真正的问题在于修复过去的创伤——正是这些创伤显现为如此仇恨的反应。

一些地精请求PC们设立一个正式节日，以庆祝伊斯嘉境内地精类与类人生物的联盟；因为地精在对抗切利亚斯的势力与不死大军入侵时都做出了巨大贡献。两方之间“赏金之光（Bounty’s Light）”的传递可重新确立为一种根源，或也可推行新的方式以彰显和平。以下是一些建议。

• 举办一场节庆（地精建议办“腌黄瓜节”）
• 在奇特林森林重新植树
• 设立“和解日”
• 推动教育改革

总而言之，伊斯嘉在从不死灾祸与切利亚斯漠视统治的余波中恢复之时，和平仍在逐步推进。

FRACTURED ARMY
Not all are eager to accept 
Isger’s new direction. Its 
official military splinters 
into several factions, with 
only one electing to accept 
Isger’s 
new 
leadership. 
Commander Nil Harovin 
(militaristic male human 
soldier 12) leads one such 
faction, the Blazing Sword, striking 
at Elidir before the Hellbreakers can cement their 
position there. Nil believes that the Hellbreakers are 
too soft to properly lead the country and determines 
that military governance is the only appropriate 
answer. He is backed by the noble Vittoria Legoto 
(churlish female human aristocrat 10), who hopes to 
become Isger’s new governor. Vittoria’s funding and 
social status keeps Elidiran socialites in check as the 
Blazing Sword attempts to take hold of the capital and 
declare itself the new leaders of Isger.
Other factions become bands of roving bandits, 
preying on the chaos of change, while others yet turn 
to vigilantism, untrusting of the new order. Captain 
Carista Frey (charismatic female human soldier 9) 
leads the largest vigilante group, the True Army, and 
refuses to join any forces led by revolutionaries.
HELLISH REMNANTS
Though Cheliax is formally detached from Isger, its 
hellish claws dug deep into the very bones of the nation’s 
structure and society, and its influence remains strong. 
Most notably, the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys has 
an impeccable reputation and holds substantial social 
power. Even if Isger is free, these nuns have a mission: 
to spread the faith of Asmodeus and care for orphans 
in need of their deity’s strict and vengeful guidance. In 
fact, there are plenty of new orphans for them to care 
for in the aftermath of the undead uprising that Caeto 
neglected to address.
PCs may wish to oust the Sisterhood from Isger, 
along with all traces of Asmodeus, or they might 
partner with them. Sister Marcella (pious human monk 
6) comes forward as the Sisterhood’s representative 
and beseeches the PCs to allow the Sisterhood to 
continue their charitable work, swearing the Sisters’ 
allegiance is to Asmodeus and not to Cheliax. She is 
willing to sign a (non-magical) contract to formalize 
the agreement and concedes to most stipulations 
unless they directly interfere with her faith’s 
practices. In return for the 
Sisterhood’s 
continued 
existence, she offers a prize: 
the location of a small 
warshard at a nunnery in 
the Aspodell Mountains, 
where the stone’s presence 
has mutated a herd of stony 
goats in the Sisters’ care 
into living dawnsilver.
Should the PCs prefer to 
oust the Sisters, most go 
without protest except for 
Sister Kavinna (fanatical female human 
nun 10), who rallies pious Asmodeans against the 
new governors of Isger and demands that Asmodeus 
be formally named the patron deity of Isger. If her 
demands aren’t met, she begins kidnapping children 
to indoctrinate them to the ways of Asmodeus, 
determined to fulfill her duties to her deity no matter 
the cost.
SCORCHHOME RELATIONS
As the dust settles, the goblins of the Chitterwood 
formally 
name 
their 
region 
Scorchhome 
and 
declare it a free and independent nation. There are 
tensions amongst the goblinoids on whether to trust 
humanoids and establish a formal alliance or keep to 
themselves. Brakknap prefers to see all ancestries unite 
and suggests the PCs destroy the bigoted and violent 
organization of the Isgeri Slayers as a show of good 
faith. The PCs can easily track down disparate groups 
of Isgeri Slayers to stamp out the organization, but the 
real issue lies in resolving the wounds of the past that 
have manifested into such a hateful response.
Some goblins request that the PCs establish a 
formal holiday to celebrate the alliance of goblinoids 
and humanoids in Isger, as goblins did much to fight 
against both Cheliax’s forces and the undead invasion. 
The passing of Bounty’s Light between the two groups 
could be reestablished as a tradition, or a new way to 
highlight peace might be implemented. Here are some 
suggestions.
•	 A festival (the goblins suggest a pickle festival)
•	 Replanting trees in the Chitterwood
•	 A day of reconciliation
•	 Educational reforms
All in all, peace is still a work in progress for 
Isger as it recovers from the undead scourge and the 
aftereffects of Cheliax’s neglectful rule.

land and plans to own more on behalf of the Prophecies

FRACTURED ARMY
Not all are eager to accept
Isger’s new direction. Its
official military splinters
into several factions, with
only one electing to accept
Isger’s new
leadership.
Commander Nil Harovin
(militaristic male human
soldier 12) leads one such

striking at Elidir before the
Hellbreakers can cement their
position there.
Nil believes that the Hellbreakers are
too soft to properly lead the country and determines
that military governance is the only appropriate
answer. He is backed by the noble Vittoria Legoto
(churlish female human aristocrat 10), who hopes to
become Isger’s new governor. Vittoria’s funding and
social status keeps Elidiran socialites in check as the
Blazing Sword attempts to take hold of the capital and
declare itself the new leaders of Isger.
Other factions become bands of roving bandits,
preying on the chaos of change, while others yet turn
to vigilantism, untrusting of the new order. Captain
Carista Frey (charismatic female human soldier 9)
leads the largest vigilante group, the True Army, and
refuses to join any forces led by revolutionaries.

HELLISH REMNANTS
Though Cheliax is formally detached from Isger, its
hellish claws dug deep into the very bones of the nation’s
structure and society, and its influence remains strong.
Most notably, the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys has
an impeccable reputation and holds substantial social
power. Even if Isger is free, these nuns have a mission:
to spread the faith of Asmodeus and care for orphans
in need of their deity’s strict and vengeful guidance. In
fact, there are plenty of new orphans for them to care
for in the aftermath of the undead uprising that Caeto
neglected to address.
PCs may wish to oust the Sisterhood from Isger,
along with all traces of Asmodeus, or they might
partner with them. Sister Marcella (pious human monk
6) comes forward as the Sisterhood’s representative
and beseeches the PCs to allow the Sisterhood to
continue their charitable work, swearing the Sisters’
allegiance is to Asmodeus and not to Cheliax. She is
willing to sign a (non-magical) contract to formalize
the agreement and concedes to most stipulations
unless they directly interfere with her faith’s
practices. In return for the
Sisterhood’s
continued
existence,
she offers a prize:
the location of a small
warshard at a nunnery in
the Aspodell Mountains,
where the stone’s presence
has mutated a herd of stony
goats in the Sisters’ care
into living dawnsilver.
Should the PCs prefer to
oust the Sisters,
most go
without protest except for
Sister Kavinna (fanatical female human
nun 10), who rallies pious
Asmodeans against the
new governors of Isger and demands that
Asmodeus be formally named
the patron deity of Isger. If her
demands aren’t met, she begins kidnapping children
to indoctrinate them to the ways of Asmodeus,
determined to fulfill her duties to her deity no matter
the cost.

SCORCHHOME RELATIONS
As the dust settles, the goblins of the Chitterwood
formally name their region Scorchhome and
declare it a free and independent nation. There are
tensions amongst the goblinoids on whether to trust
humanoids and establish a formal alliance or keep to
themselves. Brakknap prefers to see all ancestries unite
and suggests the PCs destroy the bigoted and violent
organization of the Isgeri Slayers as a show of good
faith. The PCs can easily track down disparate groups
of Isgeri Slayers to stamp out the organization, but the
real issue lies in resolving the wounds of the past that
have manifested into such a hateful response.
Some goblins request that the PCs establish a
formal holiday to celebrate the alliance of goblinoids
and humanoids in Isger, as goblins did much to fight
against both Cheliax’s forces and the undead invasion.
The passing of Bounty’s Light between the two groups
could be reestablished as a tradition, or a new way to
highlight peace might be implemented. Here are some
suggestions.
• A festival (the goblins suggest a pickle festival)
• Replanting trees in the Chitterwood
• A day of reconciliation
• Educational reforms
All in all, peace is still a work in progress for
Isger as it recovers from the undead scourge and the
aftereffects of Cheliax’s neglectful rule.

## Page 174
地狱破除者（Hellbreakers）

伊斯嘉

在内海地区，伊斯嘉以受切利亚斯钳制的附庸国而闻名，如今正处在一个重大里程碑的边缘。随着近期事态发展，这个国家要么将获得完全独立，要么将被自以为高人一等者彻底碾碎其精神。在被一个国家又一个国家控制了数个世纪后，许多伊斯嘉人只差一个小小的推动，便会成群起义反抗斯戎家族。然而，这样的事件绝不会不流血；而伊斯嘉仍在从其与奇特伍德地精类居民之间近期的内部冲突中进行治疗。另一场战争可能会让伊斯嘉沦为破败空壳，成为又一个国家吞食的肥肉。

历史

如同阿维斯坦的许多地区，后来成为伊斯嘉的土地在数千年间一直由凯立德部族占据。这些坚韧的人民在平原游牧、在丘陵狩猎、在河流捕鱼，以此为生。共有11个部族，合称“伊斯嘉人（Isgeri）”，他们依靠生活在梅纳多山脉与五王山脉之间的土地。当这些部族定期聚会交易、通婚与交往时，会在河流交汇处集会——地点就在后来将建起埃利迪尔城之处附近。若部族间的纷争无法在这场议会中解决，偶尔便会演变为战斗，但从未有任何一支部族彻底征服另一支。

这一切在2133 AR终结：塔尔多的第七探索军团开入该地区，并宣称此地归其所有。伊斯嘉人奋起抵抗，但他们的坚韧仍敌不过塔尔多军队的庞大规模。土地被征服，人民被奴役；尽管新设之国以“伊斯嘉”之名来“纪念”他们——这对战死的凯立德人毫无慰藉。塔尔多对伊斯嘉的统治持续了将近2,000年，直到切利亚斯在4081年的“巧舌征服”中赢得独立。不久之后，切利亚斯以武力夺取伊斯嘉，使其成为这个新兴帝国的第一个附庸国。

接下来的数个世纪，伊斯嘉大体上享有相对和平，但切利亚斯人终究愈发贪婪，开始蚕食奇特伍德，企图将其据为己有。最初作为自卫的冲突，很快在嗜血的熊地精军阀推动下升级为全面战争——他们只需要一个开战借口，便利用奇特伍德的地精部族组建出一支庞大军队。厌倦了人类的虐待，许多地精类乐于参军，但也有同样数量被强征入伍。

地精血战始于4697年，持续四年之久。数千名伊斯嘉公民的死亡之外，地精大军北渡科内里卡河、向五王山脉山麓推进时，更造成了难以计数的财产损失。最终，只有切利亚斯的地狱骑士、杜鲁玛的佣兵联盟与安多安的雄鹰骑士之间一场几乎不可能的同盟，才遏止了攻势。这些势力点燃了奇特伍德的边缘；尽管森林并未被彻底焚毁，其体量仍大幅缩减。自那以来，许多地精从曾经藏身的洞窟中再度现身，试图夺回他们的森林。

战后，在斯戎家族——切利亚斯现任统治者——的支援下，阿斯摩蒂斯教会推行了各类计划，帮助那些受战事波及者。然而这些举措并非纯粹慈善；伤者由阿斯摩蒂斯的祭司照料，代价是日后的人情与回报。失去父母的孩子被安置进新建的孤儿院，由名为“金色厄里倪厄斯姊妹会”的组织经营；该组织在过去二十年里一直将这些孩子教化并灌输其信仰。许多伊斯嘉公民对这份支援心怀感激，因此对切利亚斯更加忠诚；与此同时，他们对地精类的偏见也时强时弱。

神雨在部分伊斯嘉公民心中点燃了革命的火花。他们目睹即便最强大的神祇也能陨落，于是开始……

Known throughout the Inner Sea Region as a vassal 
state under the thumb of Cheliax, Isger is poised on 
the brink of a major milestone. With recent events, 
the nation could either gain its full independence or 
have its spirit thoroughly crushed by those who claim 
to be its betters. After centuries of being controlled 
by one nation or another, many of the Isgeri people 
are just one small push away from rising up en masse 
against House Thrune. But such an event wouldn’t be 
without bloodshed, and Isger is still healing from its 
recent internal conflict with the goblinoid residents 
of the Chitterwood. Another war could leave Isger a 
broken husk, ripe pickings for yet another nation to 
consume.
History
Like many areas of Avistan, the land that would 
become Isger was occupied by Kellid tribes for 
thousands of years. These hardy people roamed the 
plains, hunted in the hills, and fished in the rivers as 
a way of life. There were 11 tribes in all, collectively 
known as the Isgeri, who lived off the land between the 
Menador Mountains and the Five Kings Mountains. 
When these tribes met regularly with one another to 
trade and intermingle, they did so at the confluence of 
rivers close to where the city of Elidir would be built. 
When conflicts between the tribes couldn’t be settled 
at this moot, they would occasionally result in battles, 
though one tribe never fully conquered another.
This all ended in 2133 ar when Taldor’s Seventh 
Army of Exploration marched into the region and 
claimed it as their own. The Isgeri fought back, but 
their tenacity was no match for the sheer size of 
Taldor’s army. The land was conquered and its people 
subjugated, though the newfound country was named 
Isger in their honor—no consolation to the Kellids 
killed in battle. Taldor ruled over Isger for almost 
2,000 years until Cheliax won its own independence 
in the Even-Tongued Conquest of 4081. Shortly after, 
Cheliax acquired Isger by force as the first vassal state 
of a burgeoning empire.
Isger experienced relative peace for the next few 
centuries, but the Chelaxians eventually got greedy 
and encroached upon the Chitterwood in an attempt 
to take it for themselves. What initially began as 
self‑defense soon grew into all-out war as bloodthirsty 
hobgoblin warlords, who only needed an excuse for 
conflict, used the goblin tribes of the Chitterwood to 
form a massive army. Fed up with their mistreatment 
at the hands of humans, many of these goblinoids 
were happy to enlist, but an equal number were 
conscripted by force.
The Goblinblood Wars began in 4697 and lasted 
for four years. The deaths of thousands of Isgeri 
citizens were accompanied by untold property 
damage as the goblin hordes moved north across the 
Conerica River and toward the foothills of the Five 
Kings Mountains. Only an unlikely alliance between 
Cheliax’s Hellknights, Druma’s Mercenary League, 
and Andoran’s Eagle Knights halted the offensive. 
These groups set the edges of the Chitterwood aflame, 
and though the forest wasn’t completely burned down, 
its size was greatly reduced. Since that time, many 
goblins have reemerged from the caves they hid within 
to reclaim their forest.
In the aftermath of the war, the Church of Asmodeus, 
with the support of House Thrune—the current rulers 
of Cheliax—enacted programs to help those affected 
by the fighting. These acts weren’t of pure charity; 
the wounded were cared for by Asmodean priests in 
exchange for future favors. Orphaned children were 
placed in newly built orphanages run by a group called 
the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys that has spent the 
last two decades indoctrinating those children into 
their faith. Many Isgeri citizens felt grateful for this 
support and became more loyal to Cheliax while their 
prejudice against goblinoids waned and waxed.

hearts of some of Isger’s citizenry. They saw how even

## Page 175
……开始怀疑是否有可能摆脱切利亚斯的枷锁。一个名为“破狱者联盟”（Hellbreakers League）的团体站上了这股异见浪潮的前台：他们发现了一枚战魂碎片（warshard）——死去的神祇戈鲁姆的一部分——并将其作为号召众人的象征。此举惹恼了切利亚斯的“地狱女皇陛下”阿布罗盖尔·斯戎二世，她一直在为自己搜寻这些力量器具。她最近派遣一支“刑架骑士团”（Order of the Rack）的地狱骑士分遣队，前往裂丘镇（Breachill）肃清破狱者联盟。占领持续数周后，安多安政府派出退役的鹰骑士雷金纳德·科莫斯（Reginald Cormoth）代表裂丘镇议会出面干预。他被地狱骑士当众处决；地狱骑士在毫无证据的情况下宣称他是敌方间谍。此事最终导致阿尔塔雷林堡（Citadel Altaerein）附近原野上爆发大规模冲突，后来被称为“地狱骑士丘之战”（Battle of Hellknight Hill）。有人说，这是切利亚斯与安多安全面战争的第一轮炮火。

【概览】
伊斯嘉是一片温带国度，南以凯尔德河（River Keld）与阿斯波戴尔山脉（Aspodell Mountains）为界，北有梅纳多山脉（Menador Mountains），东接五王山脉。它与切利亚斯、安多安、杜鲁玛与摩尔苏恩接壤，但通往摩尔苏恩的最直接路线必须穿越北部群山。其地理以平原与丘陵为主，其中奇特林林地（Chitterwood）是全国最大的森林。科涅里卡河（Conerica River）是重要的贸易走廊，贯穿伊斯嘉中部，并构成其西部边境的重要一段。科涅里卡河由北科涅里卡河（North Conerica River）补给；后者在首都艾利迪尔（Elidir）与萨默伦河（Summerun River）汇合。

伊斯嘉是切利亚斯的附庸国，必须遵守其法律与敕令。赫德文六世（Hedvend VI，猥琐的男性人类贵族9级）是切利亚斯政府任命、负责监管伊斯嘉的总管（steward）之最新一任。切利亚斯要求该国维持常备军以保护要道，但几乎不提供钱、物资支援或训练。伊斯嘉军队由志愿兵组成，负责守卫科涅里卡河上的旅行往来，以及杜鲁玛与安多安边境。自“地狱骑士丘之战”后，大多数士兵已被调回以保卫艾利迪尔。

伊斯嘉的大多数居民是人类，主要为塔尔丹或凯立德血裔。人口中的第二大族群是地精，多数居住在奇特林林地。令人意外的是，伊斯嘉的侏儒数量也很可观，这在一定程度上要归功于侏儒聚居地乌莫克（Umok）。此外，全国各地也有其他血统与族裔，主要集中在河畔城市。

【政府】
伊斯嘉由切利亚斯任命的总管统治，监管国家及其贸易。然而，伊斯嘉的精英往往沉迷于科涅里卡河沿岸的贸易，忽视首都之外的任何聚居地。因此，多数城镇与村落几乎不受更大政府的干预，采取自治。治安官、市长与卫兵承担起公民职责，照料那些被自家统治者遗忘的人。

【宗教】
作为切利亚斯的附庸，伊斯嘉的守护神祇是阿斯摩蒂斯，但其他神祇也同样有人在暗中崇拜。阿巴达尔拥有第二多的信众，而密拉妮在反抗者与自由斗士中日益流行——这些人对切利亚斯的铁靴深感不满。乌加索亚的势力虽小却根深蒂固，这要归功于她的仆从伊尔凯娜·阿洛诺尔（Illcayna Alonnor，邪恶的女性乌加索亚之女9级）在乡间建立了亡灵势力的据点。她的爪牙在全国阴影之中活动，以推进其邪恶计划。

忠于切利亚斯者通常公开崇拜阿斯摩蒂斯；而在其他人之中，伊拉斯提尔在伊斯嘉乡间更受欢迎。他关于照料社群的神谕，与那些失去太多、渴望重建的人们产生共鸣。许多城镇都设有伊拉斯提尔的圣龛，但总会再设一座更大的阿斯摩蒂斯圣龛——以防当局来访。

在首都，一座古老的诺克提库拉神殿已成为巨大冲突的焦点：一边是诺克提库拉仍为恶魔化身时的旧信徒，另一边则是敬奉她现今“救赎女王”（Redeemer Queen）化身的新皈依者。

【文化与社会】
伊斯嘉是一片充满矛盾的土地。极尽富贵者居于首都城市，在奢靡过度的顶点尽情挥霍。关于更多艾利迪尔的文化，可见第192页。大多数生活在首都之外的人则是朴实的乡野居民，仍在艰难地从地精血战中恢复，并承受那场可怕冲突的余波。

地狱骑士头盔

At a Glance
Isger is a temperate country bounded by the River 
Keld and the Aspodell Mountains to the south, the 
Menador Mountains to the north, and the Five Kings 
Mountains to the east. It shares borders with Cheliax, 
Andoran, Druma, and Molthune, though the most 
direct routes to Molthune must pass through the 
northern mountains. Its geography is mostly plains 
and hills, with the Chitterwood being the nation’s 
largest forest. The Conerica River, a major corridor 
of trade, runs through the center of Isger and forms 
a major part of its western border. The Conerica is 
fed by the North Conerica River, which joins with the 
Summerun River at the capital of Elidir.
Isger is a vassal state of Cheliax and must abide 
by its laws and decrees. Hedvend VI (sniveling male 
human aristocrat 9) is the latest in a long line of 
stewards appointed by the Chelaxian government to 
oversee Isger. The nation is required by Cheliax to 
maintain a standing army to protect the important 
routes but receives little money, material support, 
or training from Cheliax to do so. The Isgeri army 
consists of volunteer recruits and watches over travel 
on the Conerica River as well as the borders of Druma 
and Andoran. Since the Battle of Hellknight Hill, most 
soldiers have been pulled back to protect Elidir.
Most of the people of Isger are human, the majority 
being either of Taldan or Kellid descent. The next 
biggest bloc of population are goblins, with most of 
them residing in the Chitterwood. Surprisingly, gnomes 
are plentiful in Isger, thanks in part to the gnome 
settlement of Umok. Other ancestries and ethnicities 
are present throughout the nation, concentrated 
mostly in the riverside cities.
Government
Isger is ruled by a steward appointed by Cheliax 
who oversees the nation and its trade. However, 
the elites of Isger are often preoccupied 
with the trade along the Conerica 
River and neglect any settlements 
outside the capital. Therefore, 
most 
towns 
and 
villages 
are self-governed with little

government. Sheriffs, mayors, 
and guards take up civic duties for 
those forgotten by their own rulers.
Religion
As a vassal of Cheliax, Isger’s patron deity is 
Asmodeus, but other deities are quietly worshipped as 
well. Abadar has the second greatest following, and 
Milani has grown popular with rebels and freedom 
fighters who chafe against Cheliax’s boot. Urgathoa 
has a small but strong presence thanks to her servant 
Illcayna Alonnor (malevolent female daughter of 
Urgathoa 9) making a stronghold for undead forces in 
the countryside. Her servants work in the shadows of 
the nation to bring about her nefarious plans.
Asmodeus is popularly worshipped by those loyal 
to Cheliax, but otherwise, Erastil is popular among 
the Isgeri countryside. His edicts of taking care of 
community resonate with those who lost so much and 
wish to rebuild. Many towns have shrines to Erastil, 
though they always have a larger one for Asmodeus just 
in case the authorities ever come around.
In the capital, an old temple of Nocticula has become 
a focal point in the great clash between Nocticula’s old 
followers from her incarnation as a demon and her 
newer converts who revere her current incarnation as 
the Redeemer Queen.
Culture and Society
Isger is a land full of contradictions. The ultrarich 
dwell in the capital city, where they live lavishly at the 
height of excess. More about Elidiran culture can be 
found on page 192. Most of those who dwell outside 
the capital are humble, rustic people still struggling to 
recover from the Goblinblood Wars and deal with the 
consequences of that terrible conflict.

This displeased Her Infernal Majestrix Abrogail Thrune II of Cheliax, who’s been seeking these implements of power for her own. At a Glance
Isger is a temperate country bounded by the River Keld and the Aspodell Mountains to the south, the Menador Mountains to the north, and the Five Kings Mountains to the east. It shares borders with Cheliax, Andoran, Druma, and Molthune, though the most direct routes to Molthune must pass through the northern mountains. Its geography is mostly plains and hills, with the Chitterwood being the nation’s largest forest. The Conerica River, a major corridor of trade, runs through the center of Isger and forms a major part of its western border. The Conerica is fed by the North Conerica River, which joins with the Summerun River at the capital of Elidir.

Isger is a vassal state of Cheliax and must abide by its laws and decrees. Hedvend VI (sniveling male human aristocrat 9) is the latest in a long line of stewards appointed by the Chelaxian government to oversee Isger. The nation is required by Cheliax to maintain a standing army to protect the important routes but receives little money, material support, or training from Cheliax to do so. The Isgeri army consists of volunteer recruits and watches over travel on the Conerica River as well as the borders of Druma and Andoran. Since the Battle of Hellknight Hill, most soldiers have been pulled back to protect Elidir.

Most of the people of Isger are human, the majority being either of Taldan or Kellid descent. The next biggest bloc of population are goblins, with most of them residing in the Chitterwood. Surprisingly, gnomes are plentiful in Isger, thanks in part to the gnome settlement of Umok. Other ancestries and ethnicities are present throughout the nation, concentrated mostly in the riverside cities.

Government
Isger is ruled by a steward appointed by Cheliax who oversees the nation and its trade. However, the elites of Isger are often preoccupied with the trade along the Conerica River and neglect any settlements outside the capital. Therefore, most towns and villages are self-governed with little interference from the wider government. Sheriffs, mayors, and guards take up civic duties for those forgotten by their own rulers.

Religion
As a vassal of Cheliax, Isger’s patron deity is Asmodeus, but other deities are quietly worshipped as well. Abadar has the second greatest following, and Milani has grown popular with rebels and freedom fighters who chafe against Cheliax’s boot. Urgathoa has a small but strong presence thanks to her servant Illcayna Alonnor (malevolent female daughter of Urgathoa 9) making a stronghold for undead forces in the countryside. Her servants work in the shadows of the nation to bring about her nefarious plans.

Asmodeus is popularly worshipped by those loyal to Cheliax, but otherwise, Erastil is popular among the Isgeri countryside. His edicts of taking care of community resonate with those who lost so much and wish to rebuild. Many towns have shrines to Erastil, though they always have a larger one for Asmodeus just in case the authorities ever come around.

In the capital, an old temple of Nocticula has become a focal point in the great clash between Nocticula’s old followers from her incarnation as a demon and her newer converts who revere her current incarnation as the Redeemer Queen.

Culture and Society
Isger is a land full of contradictions. The ultrarich dwell in the capital city, where they live lavishly at the height of excess. More about Elidiran culture can be found on page 192. Most of those who dwell outside the capital are humble, rustic people still struggling to recover from the Goblinblood Wars and deal with the consequences of that terrible conflict.

## Page 176
像萨林盖洛这样的小城市与较大的城镇，因为有行商往来而买得起一些奢侈品。乡间的人则没这么幸运，为了生存变得固执而坚韧。作为那些从战争中幸存、并发誓不再承受那般损失的人，这些乡村地区培育出强烈的共同体意识。邻里往往不待请求就会伸出援手，也不求一句谢意，只是做需要做的事。

香料对乡间来说价格高昂，饭菜因而寡淡。典型的伊斯嘉人（埃利迪尔之外）偏好不加盐的餐食，对于香料下得重的菜肴会皱起鼻子。粥食、烤鸡与沙拉都很常见。

时尚通常是伊斯嘉农夫最不放在心上的事，但它仍是生活中重要的功能性需求。帽子对于遮挡阳光与风沙、避免迷眼至关重要；围巾则能防尘御寒。更讲究些的人会把帽子染成鲜艳颜色，并用枝条与花朵装饰；而纺织者则以家族制作的精致围巾为荣。符号常被巧妙地织入衣物之中，例如用某些花朵求好运，或用骷髅表示困顿时日。用本地花朵的染料为指甲上色也成了风尚，不过这种指甲漆必须足够耐用，才能撑过一整天的劳作。

对切利亚斯的忠诚态度不一。有些人畏惧并憎恨这个宗主国，认为它是大多数苦难的根源。另一些人却无法否认切利亚斯在地精血战之后所做的善后，并对阿斯摩蒂斯教会抱持正面观感，认为他们与切利亚斯都是仁善的施助者。许多年轻女性由“金色艾莉妮丝修女会”抚养并灌输教义，该修女会在乡间势力强大。尽管有人将这种“慈善”视作骗局，但无人能否认切利亚斯确曾帮助过有需要的人。

【知名人物】
阿尔修·德梅特里亚斯（睿智的男性艾乌瓦林人类，密拉妮牧师7）与菲比·德梅特里亚斯（正义的女性人类指挥官7）是“破狱者同盟”的叛逆领袖。该组织旨在解放伊斯嘉。关于他们的更多信息见第244页。

布拉克纳普（受困扰的男性地精先知4）是一位地精长者，致力于修复类人种与地精裔之间的关系。关于布拉克纳普的更多信息见第236页。

伊斯嘉军由哈尔温·贝尔费洛将军（恪守原则的男性士兵10）统领。他是个严厉的人，困在道德与职责之间进退维谷。哈尔温对伊斯嘉的现状感到挫败，却又极度服从命令；他暗自希望发生改变，却不愿成为带来改变的那个人。

赫德文六世已统治伊斯嘉数十年，而他的遗产绝不会令人自豪。他在地精血战期间无视乡间困境的决定，其后果至今仍在伊斯嘉回响——永久伤残的老兵、数不清的孤儿，以及从地图上彻底消失的城镇。众所周知，赫德文只在乎取悦切利亚斯；只要精英们对掠夺所得感到满足，他就乐得让国家其余部分腐烂。

乌伽索娅强大的女儿伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺，多年来一直在乡间施展阴谋诡计，以不死生物侵染大地。由于政府对乡村地区缺乏兴趣，她的计划大体上一直畅行无阻。关于伊尔凯娜的更多信息见第242页。

卡尔泰莎·艾伊斯夫人（神秘的女性人类，玛门女祭司20）是一位看似不朽的玛门女祭司，在梅纳多山脉中生活了无法计数的岁月。她被恶魔般的仆从环绕，从要塞中俯瞰这个国家，并代表其主策划阴谋。这些恶魔以及她异常漫长的寿命，皆源于她与大魔鬼玛门签订的炼狱契约——这是卡尔泰莎谋求统治伊斯嘉、乃至有朝一日统治切利亚斯的计划之一。她奉献于玛门而非阿斯摩蒂斯，使她在切利亚斯疆域内多少成了异类；因此她在数百里之外运筹帷幄。随着她在神雨之后获得一枚战晶，以及切利亚斯与安多安之间的紧张局势升温，“寡妇女王”艾伊斯夫人随时可能出手。

数十年来，乡间饱受纷争折磨之际，“灰爪妈妈”（狡诈的女性铁鬼婆9）在地精血战造成的大量孤儿中轻易就能挑选猎物。她把受害者藏在一座被防止探知魔法影响的小镇中。幻术环绕小镇，确保旅行者不假思索地擦肩而过。近些年，村庄治安官与防卫的改善让鬼婆更难下手，但灰爪妈妈只是命令她现有的孩子制造干扰，好让她掳走他们最新的“手足”。村庄逐渐意识到她这般恐怖行径，并告诫孩子要乖，否则噩梦女巫就会抓走他们——然而灰爪妈妈并不在乎孩子有多乖，她只在乎他们是否容易绑走。如今，潜在战争的混乱在全国播下不和与恐惧，灰爪妈妈也找到了更多机会，得以掠食那些脆弱之人。

Adventure Toolbox
Those in small cities and large towns like Saringallow 
can afford some luxuries thanks to traveling merchants. 
Those in the countryside have no such luck and have 
become stubborn and resilient to survive. As those who 
have survived war and vowed to never face such loss 
again, these rural areas have fostered a strong sense of 
community. Neighbors tend to lend a hand without 
being asked and without expecting thanks, simply 
doing what needs to be done.
Spices are expensive for the countryside, making 
for bland meals. The typical Isgeri (outside Elidir) 
prefers an unsalted meal and will wrinkle their nose 
at heavily spiced cuisine. Porridges, roast chicken, 
and salads are common.
Fashion is usually the last thing on the mind of an 
Isgeri farmer, yet it’s still an important function of life. 
Hats are vital to keep the sun and wind from one’s 
eyes, and scarves protect from dust and cold. Those 
who are more fashion-forward dye their hats bright 
colors and decorate them with twigs and flowers, while 
knitters take pride in their families’ elaborate scarves. 
Symbols are often subtly woven into clothing, such as 
certain flowers for good luck or skulls to indicate hard 
times. Coloring one’s nails with a local flower’s dye 
has become popular, though such lacquers must be 
tough to withstand a full day’s labor.
Loyalty to Cheliax is mixed. Some fear and hate 
the patron nation, seeing it as the source of most of 
their troubles. Others can’t deny the good Cheliax did 
in the aftermath of the Goblinblood Wars and view 
the Church of Asmodeus positively, seeing both them 
and Cheliax as benevolent benefactors. Many young 
women were raised and indoctrinated by the Sisters of 
the Golden Erinys, who have a strong presence in the 
countryside. While some see such “charity” as a scam, 
no one can deny that Cheliax did help those in need.
Notable Figures
Alceo Demetrias (wise male aiuvarin human cleric of 
Milani 7) and Phoebe Demetrias (righteous female 
human commander 7) are the rebellious leaders of the 
Hellbreakers League, an organization formed to free 
Isger. More about them can be found on page 244.
Brakknap (haunted male goblin oracle 4) is a 
goblin elder working toward restoring humanoid 
and goblinoid relations. More information about 
Brakknap can be found on page 236.
The Isgeri Army is led by General Harwin Balefellow 
(principled male soldier 10), a stern man caught 
between his morals and his duty. Harwin is frustrated 
by the state of Isger but follows orders to a fault, 
secretly hoping for change yet unwilling to be the one 
to bring it about.
Hedvend VI has ruled Isger for decades, and his 
legacy won’t be a proud one. The ramifications of his 
decision to ignore the plight of the countryside during 
the Goblinblood Wars still echo throughout Isger to 
this day in the form of permanently wounded veterans, 
innumerable orphans, and towns completely wiped 
from the map. It’s well known that Hedvend cares 
only about pleasing Cheliax and is happy to let the rest 
of the nation fester so long as the elites are satisfied 
with their spoils.
The powerful daughter of Urgathoa, Illcayna 
Alonnor, has been working her machinations in 
the countryside for decades, infesting the land with 
undead. Her plans have largely run unhindered, 
thanks to the government’s lack of interest in the rural 
areas. More information about Illcayna can be found 
on page 242.
Lady Kaltessa Iyis (mysterious female human 
priestess of Mammon 20) is a seemingly immortal 
priestess of Mammon who has lived in the Menador 
Mountains for an uncounted period of time. 
Surrounded by devilish servants, she watches over the 
nation from her fortress while she plots on behalf of 
her master. These devils and her unnaturally long life 
are the result of an infernal pact with the archdevil 
Mammon as part of Kaltessa’s designs on ruling Isger, 
and perhaps one day, Cheliax as well. Her devotion to 
Mammon instead of Asmodeus makes her somewhat 
of a rogue element within the borders of Cheliax, so 
she plots and schemes from hundreds of miles away. 
With her acquisition of a warshard after the Godsrain 
and rising tensions between Cheliax and Andoran, 
Lady Iyis the Widow Queen is poised to make her 
move any day now.
For decades while the countryside was riddled with 
strife, Mama Grimclaw (devious female iron hag 9) 
had easy pickings among the numerous children left 
orphaned by the Goblinblood Wars. She keeps her 
victims hidden in a small town shielded from scrying 
magic. Illusions surround the town, ensuring that 
travelers pass by without a thought. In recent years, 
improvements in village sheriffs and security have 
made it more challenging for the hag to find victims, 
but Mama Grimclaw simply orders her current 
children to cause distractions so she can snatch up 
their newest sibling. Villages are coming to be aware 
of her brand of terror and warn their children to be 
good or the nightmare witch will get them—though 
Mama Grimclaw cares not for how good a child is, 
only that they’re easy to kidnap. Now, with the chaos 
of potential war sowing discord and fear throughout 
the nation, Mama Grimclaw has found plenty of new 
opportunities to prey on the vulnerable.

the Golden Erinys, who have a strong presence in the
countryside. While some see such “charity” as a scam,
no one can deny that Cheliax did help those in need.

Notable Figures
Alceo Demetrias (wise male aiuvarin human cleric of
Milani 7) and Phoebe Demetrias (righteous female
human commander 7) are the rebellious leaders of the
Hellbreakers League, an organization formed to free
Isger. More about them can be found on page 244.

Brakknap (haunted male goblin oracle 4) is a
goblin elder working toward restoring humanoid
and goblinoid relations. More information about
Brakknap can be found on page 236.

The Isgeri Army is led by General Harwin Balefellow
(principled male soldier 10), a stern man caught
between his morals and his duty. Harwin is frustrated
by the state of Isger but follows orders to a fault,
secretly hoping for change yet unwilling to be the one
to bring it about.

Hedvend VI has ruled Isger for decades, and his
legacy won’t be a proud one. The ramifications of his
decision to ignore the plight of the countryside during
the Goblinblood Wars still echo throughout Isger to
this day in the form of permanently wounded veterans,
innumerable orphans, and towns completely wiped
from the map. It’s well known that Hedvend cares
only about pleasing Cheliax and is happy to let the rest
of the nation fester so long as the elites are satisfied
with their spoils.

The powerful daughter of Urgathoa, Illcayna
Alonnor, has been working her machinations in the
countryside for decades, infesting the land with undead.
Her plans have largely run unhindered, thanks to the
government’s lack of interest in the rural areas. More
information about Illcayna can be found on page 242.

Lady Kaltessa Iyis (mysterious female human
priestess of Mammon 20) is a seemingly immortal
priestess of Mammon who has lived in the Menador
Mountains for an uncounted period of time.
Surrounded by devilish servants, she watches over the
nation from her fortress while she plots on behalf of
her master. These devils and her unnaturally long life
are the result of an infernal pact with the archdevil
Mammon as part of Kaltessa’s designs on ruling Isger,
and perhaps one day, Cheliax as well.

Her devotion to Mammon instead of Asmodeus
makes her somewhat of a rogue element within the
borders of Cheliax, so she plots and schemes from
hundreds of miles away. With her acquisition of a
warshard after the Godsrain and rising tensions between
Cheliax and Andoran, Lady Iyis the Widow Queen is
poised to make her move any day now.

For decades while the countryside was riddled with
strife, Mama Grimclaw (devious female iron hag 9)
had easy pickings among the numerous children left
orphaned by the Goblinblood Wars. She keeps her
victims hidden in a small town shielded from scrying
magic. Illusions surround the town, ensuring that
travelers pass by without a thought. In recent years,
improvements in village sheriffs and security have
made it more challenging for the hag to find victims,
but Mama Grimclaw simply orders her current
children to cause distractions so she can snatch up
their newest sibling. Villages are coming to be aware
of her brand of terror and warn their children to be
good or the nightmare witch will get them—though
Mama Grimclaw cares not for how good a child is,
only that they’re easy to kidnap. Now, with the chaos
of potential war sowing discord and fear throughout the
nation, Mama Grimclaw has found plenty of new
opportunities to prey on the vulnerable.

金色艾琳尼斯姐妹会中最有影响力的成员，是玛塞拉修女（虔诚的人类武僧6级）。她是一位不起眼的年迈女性，自幼便在阿斯摩蒂斯教会中侍奉。作为修会慈善事业的总监理，她凭借姐妹会的卓著声望，在乡间拥有巨大的影响力。玛塞拉喜爱孩子，经常能见到她给年纪尚小、尚不懂其含义的孩子们，朗读宗教典籍中的炼狱段落。

瓦斯坎德·吉尔沃拉德（复仇的男性人类偏执者8级）是地精血战的老兵，也是臭名昭著的伊斯嘉屠杀者的创始人之一。他在熊地精劫掠者手中失去了家园与左眼，从未原谅地精族群对他犯下的罪行。瓦斯坎德将自己与他的帮派视为十字军，认为他们拔剑行事，是在替无人愿做之事——施行政府未能伸张的“正义”。他努力把伊斯嘉屠杀者包装成一个合法的佣兵与冒险者组织，而非其真实面目：一群愤怒的偏执者。

伊斯嘉的地貌上散布着小村与农庄，这里不乏值得造访或探索之处。以下列出本国最有趣或最重要的几个地点。

布里奇希尔：与其他伊斯嘉聚居地相比，这座小镇相对年轻。它坐落于五王山脉的阴影之下，其起源同样笼罩在谜团中：在4520 AR，人们在此发现的第一批居民是50名人类，他们既不记得自己是谁，也不记得如何来到此地。一位路过的法师拉蒙德·布里奇顿发现了这处前哨，并帮助这些迷失的居民把营地建设成一座完整的城镇。尽管他无法查明他们的过往，心怀感激的村民仍以他的名字为小镇命名。随着布里奇希尔的人口逐年增长，拉蒙德·布里奇顿一直留在此地，以父亲般的方式引导他们，直到某天他突然失踪。镇民为他立起纪念雕像，并延续他仁善的遗泽。布里奇希尔和平的民风引起了新成立的钉骑士团的注意；他们于4638年在小镇东北10英里处修建了自己的要塞。尽管仅44年后，他们便受多米娜女王引诱前往科沃萨，这座要塞至今仍矗立不倒。

近几个月来，谣言四起，称布里奇希尔窝藏了“破狱者联盟”的成员，而铁砧骑士团的地狱骑士们迅速……

The most influential member among the Sisters of 
the Golden Erinys is Sister Marcella (pious human 
monk 6), an unassuming elderly woman who’s served 
the church of Asmodeus since she was a child. As the 
grand overseer of the sisterhood’s charities, she has 
great influence over the countryside thanks to the 
sisters’ stellar reputation. Marcella loves children and 
can often be found reading infernal passages from 
religious tomes to children too young to understand 
what they mean.
Varskand Gilwrad (vengeful male human bigot 8)
is a veteran of the Goblinblood Wars and one of the 
founders of the notorious Isgeri Slayers. He lost his 
home and his left eye to hobgoblin raiders and has 
never forgiven goblinkind for its sins against him. 
Varskand sees himself and his gang as crusaders, doing 
the work no one else will by taking up the sword to 
enact justice that the government has failed to serve. He 
works hard to pass off the Isgeri Slayers as a legitimate 
organization of mercenaries and adventurers rather 
than what they truly are: angry bigots.
Notable Locations
With small villages and farmsteads dotting the 
landscape, Isger is full of locations to visit or explore. 
Below are a few of the country’s most interesting or 
important locations.
Breachill: This small town is relatively young 
compared to other Isgeri settlements. Situated in 
the shadow of the Five Kings Mountains, its origins 
are similarly shrouded in mystery, as the first people 
found there in 4520 ar were 50 humans with no 
memory of who they were or how they got there. A 
passing wizard named Lamond Breachton discovered 
this outpost and helped its lost inhabitants build 
up their camp into a full-fledged town. Though he 
couldn’t uncover their past, the grateful villagers 
named the town after him. As Breachill’s population 
grew over the years, Lamond Breachton remained 
to guide them in a paternal fashion until he one 
day disappeared. The townsfolk erected a statue in 
his honor and continued his legacy of benevolence. 
Breachill’s peaceful populace attracted the attention 
of the newly formed Hellknight Order of the Nail, 
who built their citadel 10 miles northeast of the town 
in 4638. Though they were lured to Korvosa by Queen 
Domina only 44 years later, the citadel still stands. 
In recent months, rumors spread that Breachill 
was harboring members of the Hellbreakers League, 
and Hellknights from the Order of the Rack quickly

Breachill: This small town is relatively young compared to other Isgeri settlements. ……占领了该镇。这些地狱骑士制定了严格的宵禁与其他法令，让布瑞契尔议会大为不满。议员格蕾塔·加达尼娅（热忱的女性人类议员1级）尤其对切利亚斯的这种越权行径怒不可遏，秘密向所有邻国发出求援密函。最终，安多安作出回应，派遣退役的雄鹰骑士将军雷金纳德·科莫思前来促成外交解决。地狱骑士以干预其事务为由将他处决，从而引发了一连串事件，最终在布瑞契尔与阿尔泰雷因要塞之间的田野上爆发了血腥的“地狱骑士山之战”。安多安的军队赢得胜利，而如今布瑞契尔必须面对这场战斗的余波。

奇特伍德：这片原始森林是许多地精部族的家园，不过自地精血战结束后，数量明显减少。更危险的生物潜伏在林木之间。关于奇特伍德的详细信息见第180页起的文章。

阿尔泰雷因要塞：距离布瑞契尔不远，这座地狱骑士要塞在钉之骑士团于4682年迁往科沃萨之前，曾作为其行动基地。此后几十年间，大楼里驻扎的地狱骑士不足三打，直到4711年被彻底废弃。4717年，地精迁入要塞下层与地下室，但两年后，他们遭到诺格博的一个教团袭击；该教团随后被一群英雄击败。英雄们在击退达哈克的显现后，将要塞赠予布瑞契尔镇。然而，神雨为此地带来更多纷争；当刑架之骑士团的地狱骑士开进布瑞契尔时，他们也占据了阿尔泰雷因要塞。最近，安多安的雄鹰骑士与这些地狱骑士在周边区域爆发大战，其中包括对要塞的围攻。随着地狱骑士在地狱骑士山之战中溃败，这座要塞的所有权再度易手，而其未来归属如今仍不确定。

迪尼亚尔要塞：这座坚固要塞位于阿斯波戴尔山脉群峰之间，是神爪地狱骑士团的总部。随着这个宗教骑士团近期所宣扬的神祇发生变化，以及切利亚斯与安多安之间迫近的战争威胁，迪尼亚尔要塞的许多地狱骑士开始更频繁地深入乡野。与许多其他地狱骑士团动辄要求服从不同，那些崇拜被称为“神爪之爪”的万神殿者，更专注于教育平民：有序而自律的生活在日常中有哪些好处。与神爪中更为传统的地狱骑士之间的摩擦，迫使这些崇拜者中的许多人返回要塞，以确保新征募的披甲侍从不会因他们的新理念而受到过度影响。

尘爪镇：这座靠近杜鲁玛边境、曾经繁荣的铁矿小镇，其居民在矿脉枯竭后，围绕镇上众多山羊建立起兴盛产业。来自伊斯嘉、杜鲁玛与安多安各地的商人定期来此购买羊奶、黄油、奶酪、肉类与皮革。持续不断的贸易往来也使往返尘爪镇道路上的商队成为强盗的绝佳目标；这些强盗中许多人把旧矿井坑道当作藏身处。最近，埃拉达斯·德莫斯——一名从尘爪镇政府勒索钱财、以将匪患维持在最低水平的走私者——被发现遭到斩首，尸首陈列在镇广场上。有人说她因散布关于阿布罗盖尔二世血统的阴谋论而遭斯戎家族盯上；也有人相信她伪造了自己的死亡，在囤积数年的金钱收益后前往杜鲁玛过上奢华生活。然而自她死后，商人因惧怕强盗而对前往尘爪镇的旅程愈发谨慎。现任镇长鲁普雷希特·黑史密斯（焦虑的男性人类政治家1级）已多次向埃利迪尔发出援助请求，却都石沉大海。

埃利迪尔：位于萨默伦河与北科涅里卡河交汇处，伊斯嘉的豪金之耳——

occupied the town. These Hellknights established 
strict curfews and other laws, much to the dismay of 
the Breachill town council. Councilor Greta Gardania 
(passionate female human councilor 1) in particular 
was incensed by this overreach from Cheliax and sent 
secret missives to all neighboring countries, asking for 
help. Eventually Andoran responded, sending retired 
Eagle Knight general Reginald Cormoth to effect a 
diplomatic solution. The Hellknights executed him for 
meddling in their affairs, setting off a chain of events 
that culminated in the bloody Battle of Hellknight Hill 
in the fields between Breachill and Citadel Altaerein. 
Andoran’s forces won the day, and now Breachill must 
deal with the aftermath of the fight.
Chitterwood: This old-growth forest is home to 
many tribes of goblins, though markedly fewer since 
the end of the Goblinblood Wars. Far more dangerous 
creatures lurk among the trees. Detailed information 
about the Chitterwood can be found in the article 
starting on page 180.
Citadel Altaerein: Only a short distance from 
Breachill, this Hellknight citadel was built as the 
base of operations for the Order of the Nail before 
they moved to Korvosa in 4682. The building housed 
fewer than three dozen Hellknights for the following 
decades until it was completely abandoned in 4711. 
Goblins moved into the lower and basement levels of 
the citadel in 4717, but they were targeted by a cult 
of Norgorber who was defeated by a group of heroes 
only two years later. After defeating a manifestation 
of Dahak, the heroes gifted the citadel to the town of 
Breachill. However, the Godsrain brought more strife 
to the area, and when Hellknights from the Order of 
the Rack marched into Breachill, they also occupied 
Citadel Altaerein. Recently, a major battle between 
those Hellknights and Andoran’s Eagle Knights 
occurred in the surrounding area, part of which 
included a siege of the citadel. Once again, ownership 
of the fortress changed hands after the Hellknights 
were routed in the Battle of Hellknight Hill, and its 
future providence is now uncertain.
Citadel Dinyar: Located among the peaks of the 
Aspodell Mountains, this sturdy fortress serves as the 
headquarters for the Hellknight Order of the Godclaw. 
After the recent change in the deities promoted 
by this religious order and the looming threat 
of war between Cheliax and Andoran, many 
Hellknights at Citadel Dinyar have begun venturing 
forth into the countryside with more regularity. 
Rather than demand obedience like so many other 
Hellknight orders, those who worship the pantheon 
known as the Talons of the Godclaw have been focused 
more on educating the common folk on the everyday 
benefits of an ordered and disciplined life. Friction 
with the more traditional Hellknights of the Godclaw 
has forced many of these worshippers to return to the 
citadel to ensure newly enlisted armigers aren’t overly 
influenced against their newer philosophy.
Dustpawn: The citizens of this once prosperous 
iron mining town near the Drumish border built a 
thriving industry around the town’s many goats after 
the mines were exhausted. Merchants from all over 
Isger, Druma, and Andoran regularly visit to purchase 
the town’s goat milk, butter, cheese, meat, and hides. 
This constant trade traffic also makes the caravans 
traveling the roads into and out of Dustpawn prime 
targets for bandits, many of whom make their 
hideouts in the former mining tunnels. Recently, 
Elladas Demos, a smuggler who extorted money from 
the Dustpawn government to keep bandit attacks to a 
minimum, was found decapitated in the town square. 
Some say she was targeted by House Thrune after 
spreading conspiracy theories about Abrogail II’s 
lineage. Others believe she faked her death to live a 
life of luxury in Druma after hoarding several years’ 
worth of monetary gains. Since her death, though, 
merchants have become wary of making the journey 
to Dustpawn for fear of the bandits. The town’s 
current mayor, Ruprecht Haesmith (anxious male 
human politician 1), has repeatedly sent requests for 
aid from Elidir to no avail.
Elidir: Situated at the junction where the Summerun 
River merges with the North Conerica River, Isger’s

Citadel Dinyar: Located among the peaks of the Aspodell Mountains, this sturdy fortress serves as the headquarters for the Hellknight Order of the Godclaw. After the recent change in the deities promoted by this religious order and the looming threat of war between Cheliax and Andoran, many Hellknights at Citadel Dinyar have begun venturing forth into the countryside with more regularity. Rather than demand obedience like so many other Hellknight orders, those who worship the pantheon known as the Talons of the Godclaw have been focused more on educating the common folk on the everyday benefits of an ordered and disciplined life. Friction with the more traditional Hellknights of the Godclaw has forced many of these worshippers to return to the citadel to ensure newly enlisted armigers aren’t overly influenced against their newer philosophy.

Dustpawn: The citizens of this once prosperous iron mining town near the Drumish border built a thriving industry around the town’s many goats after the mines were exhausted. Merchants from all over Isger, Druma, and Andoran regularly visit to purchase the town’s goat milk, butter, cheese, meat, and hides. This constant trade traffic also makes the caravans traveling the roads into and out of Dustpawn prime targets for bandits, many of whom make their hideouts in the former mining tunnels. Recently, Elladas Demos, a smuggler who extorted money from the Dustpawn government to keep bandit attacks to a minimum, was found decapitated in the town square. Some say she was targeted by House Thrune after spreading conspiracy theories about Abrogail II’s lineage. Others believe she faked her death to live a life of luxury in Druma after hoarding several years’ worth of monetary gains. Since her death, though, merchants have become wary of making the journey to Dustpawn for fear of the bandits. The town’s current mayor, Ruprecht Haesmith (anxious male human politician 1), has repeatedly sent requests for aid from Elidir to no avail.

……其首都是来自摩尔苏恩、杜鲁玛，甚至更遥远的切利亚斯的贸易枢纽。由于距离奇特伍德超过100英里，这座城市在地精血战中躲过了大部分破坏。这种偏远使伊斯嘉政府在冲突期间得以照常运转，但如今许多士兵与村民觉得这种安全感来得“不配”，尤其是埃利迪尔的官员与将领若没有邻国援助，便无法终结战争。有些人甚至指责政府在遏止地精类生物一事上拖拖拉拉，或以某种方式从本国平民的苦难中牟利。因此，普通的伊斯嘉农夫谈起埃利迪尔时往往嗤之以鼻，认为那里的居民不过是一群蠢货。

颇具讽刺意味的是，切利亚斯政府对伊斯嘉现任监国海德文六世也抱持相近看法。尽管他数十年来一直忠诚地为切利亚斯效劳，许多切利亚斯贵族仍认为这个国家应交由更有能力的人掌管。关于撤换他的传言在埃利迪尔流传已逾五年，但不知为何，切利亚斯至今仍未下达命令。海德文对这一迫在眉睫的威胁心知肚明，而他最亲近的盟友一直鼓励他采取更大胆的行动，尤其是在地狱骑士于阿尔泰雷因城堡最近遭到击败之后。关于埃利迪尔的更多内容，见第188页起的文章。

芬兹比（Fernsby）：奇特伍德北部的一座小型农耕村落。芬兹比与附近的艺术家聚落树桩原（Stumpfield）关系略显紧张。更多信息见第40页。

寻觅者峡谷（Finder’s Gulch）：伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺（Illcayna Alonnor）是这处闹鬼之地无可争议的主宰。寻觅者峡谷曾只是偏远的采石小镇，但数十年前被恶毒的不死生物淹没。乌加托娅的女祭司伊尔凯娜追随尸妖群（wights）而来，在此建立行动基地，并持续袭掠伊斯嘉的其他村镇、切利亚斯与摩尔苏恩，以扩充其不死军团的规模。随着时间推移，伊尔凯娜希望让伊斯嘉的全体民众都改奉她的神祇，但这一目标很可能必须借助武力才能实现。关于寻觅者峡谷与伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺的更多内容，分别见第125页与第242页。

吉拉穆尔（Gillamoor）：位于奇特伍德边缘。吉拉穆尔先后挺过地精的袭击与数场焚毁周边大片森林的火灾，却最终败给了不死诅咒。作为其在伊斯嘉各地散布不死生物的战役之一部分，伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺因吉拉穆尔悲惨的历史、以及因此而来的巨大墓园而选中此地。为让城镇尽快被不死生物淹没，她对聚落施下诅咒，使任何在吉拉穆尔境内死去的人都会迅速以噬脑丧尸的形态复起。为了点燃这枚神秘炸弹的引信，伊尔凯娜随后在深夜以死灵力量从吉拉穆尔墓地唤起了数具丧尸。数小时后，第一起死亡发生；尽管最初的那些丧尸被摧毁，连锁反应却已开始。数周之内，吉拉穆尔全体居民不是死亡就是逃离。伊斯嘉军方将该地区隔离，认为惨剧源于瘟疫，但当他们发现无法检测到任何瘟疫后，便很快弃守撤离。

好家园（Good Home）：这座小镇在地精血战期间被遗弃，随后被鬼爪妈妈（Mama Grimclaw）占据，并被她改名为“好家园”。她在此抚养自己众多被绑架来的孩子，并以魔法遮蔽城镇，使无人注意到它。小镇仍保持可运作状态；被绑架的孩子们学习自给自足，从而永远不必离开。偶尔有旅人走得太近，会被杀害，好让鬼爪妈妈能将他们的财物作为“赋礼”赠予她的孩子们。

豪金之耳（Haugin’s Ear）：这座静谧的渔村居民会把每日渔获与腌制鱼货，卖给在凯尔德河（River Keld）上往来的船只——多为切利亚斯军用与商贸船——以及在阿斯波德尔丘陵淘金的矿工。也有少数家庭靠出售驯化的火足耳廓狐（firefoot fennecs）为生；在当地许多人眼中，这种动物是好运的象征。

豪金之耳之名源自码头附近河岸上一处不同寻常、高达30英尺的岩石露头，它形似一名侧卧巨人的半埋头颅与耳朵。传说这块岩石突起乃是豪金的石化遗骸的一部分；豪金是一名食人巨人，数百年前曾与一位塔尔多巫师结怨。偶尔会有来自伊斯嘉之外的寻宝者前来寻找豪金破碎的残片；据传这些碎片蕴含强大力量。过去许多人相信石头脑袋在某种程度上诱拐孩子进入其中，但真相是：这些失踪儿童被一名名为玛朱拉（Marjulla）的甜美鬼婆（特征）吞食；她最近已被某位来访的寻宝者发现并杀死。临终之际，玛朱拉警告说，她的两名姐妹将会前来复仇。

铁蔷薇（Iron Rose）：这座宫殿以精致的石拱张扬其切利亚斯风格，向所有胆敢靠近之人昭示其影响力。数百年前，卡尔泰莎·伊伊斯女士（Lady Kaltessa Iyis）在杜鲁玛边境附近的一处葱郁山谷宣示领地，并征召数十名魔鬼建造她称作家园的宏伟建筑。这座奢华的堡垒据传堆满了足以买下整个国家的黄金，但从未有人有幸踏入其中一探究竟。

capital is a hub of trade from Molthune, Druma, and

## Page 180
梅里威姆（Merrywim）：这座小小的河畔城镇原本主要以贝壳饰品闻名；除此之外，镇民只是在乡间勉强过着平静的日子。这一切在神雨之后都改变了。如今，梅里威姆的人变得喧闹不羁，每晚举办盛大的派对，常常饮酒到日落。意识到连神明都可能陨落，让镇上的居民恐惧到极点，于是他们变成了纵欲的虚无主义者，一心要尽可能尽情享受人生。然而近来，狂欢不得不暂停，因为有人在科涅里卡河（Conerica River）目击到某种神秘生物——体型巨大到足以威胁岸上居民。几名勇敢的渔夫联合起来想要捕捉这头野兽，却只带回了破碎的渔网与断裂的钓线。看来，能解决此事的或许得是职业冒险者；而城镇也迫切希望处理掉这个问题，好让他们回到那种疯狂的纵情作乐中。

洛加斯（Logas）：洛加斯曾是伊斯嘉的首都；地精血战留下的伤痕，无论是肉体上的还是精神上的，至今仍能在这座河畔城市的建筑与市民身上找到。冲突期间洛加斯一直遭围攻，导致人们对类地精族群长期不信任。该城现任市长瓦莱尼娅·雷明沃德（Valenia Remingward，进步派女性人类政治家2级）曾参与这场战争，但她在4723年上任后，立即停止了定期向附近的颤齿林（Chitterwood）发射投石机的做法，并拆除了城墙上陈列的地精头骨。此类命令让城中部分贵族颇为不满，他们声称雷明沃德市长的政策会被地精部族视为软弱的信号，从而点燃第二轮敌对行动。然而，随着近期事件的发展——地狱骑士在城内集结（要么是在地狱骑士山之战中战败后逃来，要么是作为援军从切利亚斯边境越境而来）——他们的大多数抱怨都被压了下去。洛加斯的紧张气氛居高不下，不过其大多数市民仍支持切利亚斯对伊斯嘉的统治。

萨林盖洛（Saringallow）：数百年前，这座城市起初只是一个名为“萨里尼的洼地”（Sarini’s Hollow）的小型园林庄园，由切利亚斯的一个小贵族家族——萨里尼家族（House Sarini）——建立。随着时间推移，它缓慢发展成拥有自家农田、商铺，并通过附近河流进行贸易的村庄。尽管从外表看起来田园牧歌般宁静，它却藏着一个阴暗的秘密。萨里尼家族的贵族早在斯戎家族（斯戎家族）崛起之前就涉足魔鬼崇拜，而他们骇人的仪式导致村里数名年轻人丧命。市民起义，将能找到的每一位萨里尼家族成员都吊死。于是，这座城镇被戏称为“萨里尼绞架”（Sarini Gallows），久而久之演变成如今的城市名。萨里尼庄园至今仍矗立，作为对其他可能想要欺压民众的切利亚斯贵族的一则森冷警示；而市民也确保外来的贵族不受欢迎——尤其是姓萨里尼的那些人。该城的历史很可能正是“地狱破除者同盟”（Hellbreakers League）行动最为活跃的原因，这也让许多人相信萨林盖洛就是这一反叛组织的总部。关于萨林盖洛的更多内容，见第200页起的条目。

树桩原野（Stumpfield）：树桩原野由地精与人类艺术家共同建立，是各类创作者的避风港。它在许多日用品上仰赖与附近的芬斯比（Fernsby）交易。更多信息见第30页与第39页。

急湍村（Swiftrun）：这座小村最为人所知的是其厄拉斯提尔（Erastil）祭司，他们教人如何建立自给自足的家园并守护自己的社区。村子几乎全是厄拉斯提尔的信徒，强调互助互惠。村里并不鼓励各自为政的种植，而是拥有一座巨大的公共菜园，人人轮流照料。村中万物共享，从工具到手推车皆然；好客被视为最伟大的美德。

双角修道院（Twin Horns）：金色艾瑞妮丝姐妹会（Sisters of the Golden Erinys）的这所女修道院坐落于阿斯波德尔山脉（Aspodell Mountains），安静地作为年轻女性立志成为修女时的训练之所。修道院规模不大、训练严苛；修女们从黎明到黄昏同时操练宗教职责与武艺。许多在姐妹会孤儿院长大的女孩最终会来到此处成为修女。最近，修道院发现了一块战晶碎片（warshard），它影响了她们的牲畜，把山羊变成了晨银（dawnsilver）。

乌莫克（Umok）：这座有数百年历史的侏儒村庄，由于过去曾与来自颤齿林、嗜火的地精发生冲突，因而禁止在距建筑500码范围内用火。居民如今以炼金术与魔法提供热量与光照。关于乌莫克的更多信息见第30页与第36页。

沃迪亚（Vordia）：地精血战之后，金色艾瑞妮丝姐妹会，以及其背后的阿斯莫德斯教会，曾竭力重建沃迪亚并照料其居民。因此，这里的市民通常对切利亚斯心怀感激并保持忠诚。沃迪亚也以其为战后由姐妹会建立的首批孤儿院之一而自豪。更多信息见第30页与第32页。

狼岬（Wolfpoint）：作为伊斯嘉军队的预备驻防地，狼岬自地狱骑士山之战后便一直空置，其士兵被调往国内其他地区执行现役任务。结果，当地河盗愈发大胆，并常把狼岬当作集会地点。关于狼岬的更多信息见第30页。

Merrywim: This small riverside town was mainly 
known for its shell jewelry; beyond that, its people eked 
out a quiet living in the countryside. That all changed 
after the Godsrain. Now, the people of Merrywim 
have become rambunctious, throwing enormous 
parties nightly and often drinking until sundown. The 
realization that even a god can fall terrified the town’s 
inhabitants so much that they’ve become hedonistic 
nihilists, intent on enjoying their lives as much as they 
possibly can. However, of late the partying has had 
to stop because of a mysterious creature that’s been 
spotted in the Conerica River, something massive 
enough to be a threat to those who live ashore. A few 
brave fishers banded together to capture the beast but 
returned with only broken nets and lines. It seems that 
professional adventurers might be the solution for this 
issue, which the town is eager to address so that they 
can return to their frantic revelry.
Logas: Once the capital of Isger, the scars of the 
Goblinblood Wars, both physical and mental, can 
still be found in this riverside city’s architecture and 
citizens. Logas was continually under siege during the 
conflict, leading to a lasting distrust of goblinoids. The 
city’s current mayor, Valenia Remingward (progressive 
female human politician 2), fought in the war but 
ceased the practice of regularly firing trebuchets into 
the nearby Chitterwood and dismantled the display of 
goblin skulls along the city walls immediately after her 
appointment in 4723. These mandates caused some 
consternation among the city’s nobles, who claimed 
that Mayor Remingward’s policies would be seen as 
a sign of weakness by the goblin tribes and ignite a 
second round of hostilities. Most of their complaints 
have been silenced in the wake of recent events as 
Hellknights amass within the city, either fleeing from 
their defeat at the Battle of Hellknight Hill or arriving 
from across the Chelaxian border as reinforcements. 
Tensions run high in Logas, though the majority of its 
citizens support Chelaxian rule over Isger.
Saringallow: Centuries ago, this city began as a 
small garden estate named Sarini’s Hollow, founded 
by House Sarini of Cheliax, a minor noble house. Over 
time, it slowly grew into a village with its own farms, 
shops, and trade via the nearby river. Though it seemed 
idyllic from the outside, it harbored a sinister secret. 
The nobles of House Sarini dabbled in diabolism long 
before House Thrune rose to power, and their hideous 
rituals resulted in the deaths of several of the village’s 
young people. The citizens rebelled and hung every 
member of House Sarini they could find. The town 
was then nicknamed Sarini Gallows, which over time 
evolved into the city’s current name. The Sarini estate 
still stands as a grim warning to other Chelaxian 
nobles who might think to take advantage of the 
populace, and they ensure that noble outsiders don’t 
feel welcome, especially if their last name is Sarini. 
The city’s history is likely the reason that Hellbreakers 
League activity is most prevalent there, leading 
many to believe that Saringallow is the rebellious 
organization’s headquarters. More about Saringallow 
can be found in the article starting on page 200.
Stumpfield: Founded by goblin and human artists, 
Stumpfield is a haven for creators of all stripes. It 
relies on trading with nearby Fernsby for much of its 
practical goods. More information can be found on 
pages 30 and 39.
Swiftrun: This small village is most known for its 
priests of Erastil who teach how to homestead and 
defend one’s community. The community is nearly all 
Erastilian, with an emphasis on helping one another. 
Rather than individual gardening, the village has an 
enormous community garden that everyone takes 
turns caring for. Everything is shared in the village, 
from tools to carts, and hospitality is seen as the 
greatest virtue.
Twin Horns: This nunnery of the Sisters of the 
Golden Erinys lies in the Aspodell Mountains, quietly 
serving as a place for aspiring young women to train as 
sisters. The convent is small and its training rigorous, 
the nuns practicing both religious duties and martial 
arts from dawn to dusk. Many of the girls raised in the 
sisters’ orphanages end up traveling here to become 
nuns. Recently, the nunnery discovered a piece of a 
warshard that affected their livestock, turning their 
goats into dawnsilver.
Umok: This centuries-old gnome village has 
outlawed fire within 500 yards of its buildings due 
to past run-ins with fire-loving goblins from the 
Chitterwood. The residents now use alchemy and 
magic for heat and light. More information about 
Umok can be found on pages 30 and 36.
Vordia: After the Goblinblood Wars, the Sisters of 
the Golden Erinys and, by extension, the Church of 
Asmodeus worked hard to rebuild Vordia and take 
care of its citizens. As such, its citizens are generally 
grateful and loyal to Cheliax. Vordia is the proud 
location of one of the first orphanages built by the 
sisters after the wars. More information can be found 
on pages 30 and 32.
Wolfpoint: A reserve garrison for the Isgeri army, 
Wolfpoint has been left empty since the Battle of 
Hellknight Hill, its soldiers called to active duty in 
other parts of the country. As a result, the local river 
bandits have grown bolder and often use Wolfpoint as 
a meeting place. More information about Wolfpoint 
can be found on page 30.

</details>

奇特伍德

欢迎来到奇特伍德
伊斯嘉是一片伤痕累累的土地——既有字面意义上的，也有象征意义上的。而最能体现这一点的，莫过于那片曾经郁郁葱葱的阔叶林：奇特伍德。奇特伍德位于伊斯嘉南部，靠近科内里卡河、阿斯波德尔山脉以及洛加斯城，长期以来一直是数百个地精类部族的家园。这里同样有一条走私者偏爱的商路。由于有强盗出没，穿越这片林地从来都是件危险的事，但一些走投无路、名声不佳的旅人仍愿意横穿奇特伍德，以避开伊斯嘉的主干道路。

由于该区域声名狼藉，多数人都尽可能避开奇特伍德，与当地的地精类居民几乎没有往来。这一局面在4697 ar骤然改变：大地精指挥官率领其地精军队，对伊斯嘉的乡村聚居地发动了一系列致命袭击。这场冲突后来被称为“地精血战”，在四年间以极其血腥的方式持续进行。成群的地精与大地精部队席卷整个地区，所过之处尽是死亡与毁灭。从瓦瑞西亚到塔尔多，整座城镇在屠戮中被夷为平地。安多安、切利亚斯与杜鲁玛的军队结成同盟共同对抗这一威胁。当地精血战终于结束时，由杜鲁玛佣兵、雄鹰骑士与地狱骑士组成的胜利联军将奇特伍德的大部分焚烧殆尽。

尽管它承受了巨大的生态破坏，奇特伍德并非完全没有动物。鸟儿依旧歌唱，熊与野猪仍在游荡，丝蛾有时也会被发现啃食桑叶。关于一头凶猛而古老的野兽的传闻依旧流传——据说它如今成了一道活着的阴影，而这头野兽仍在狩猎。

奇特伍德的洞窟
地精血战在各方都夺走了惊人的生命，但对地精部族而言——他们被大地精指挥官奴役，又遭到奉行灭绝的伊斯嘉屠戮者追杀——这场冲突几乎带来了彻底的毁灭。奇特伍德的大部分都成了仍在冒烟的废墟，幸存地精只剩下一个去处可逃：地下。

在奇特伍德残骸的深处之下，横亘着庞大的洞窟与地道网络——对一个满目疮痍的民族而言，这是一个理想却并不舒适的藏身、整编与重建之所。然而让各部族恼火的是，这些洞窟早已住着许多生物，它们并不怎么愿意分享自己的空间。蝙蝠和老鼠至少还算够吃，但洞穴熊则完全是另一回事；“蜂群之民”部族原本就有190多首歌曲以露骨的方式描述熊袭的危险，很快又添了专门警告洞穴熊的新歌。

在奇特伍德的洞窟中长期生存之所以困难，原因不止是可能遭遇熊类。洞中唯有在洞口附近才能找到光，湿度很高，食物也很有限。所幸对地精来说，他们的黑暗视觉、足智多谋，以及几乎能消化任何有机物的能力，使他们比格拉利昂的大多数居民更适合洞穴生活。地精能弄到肉时更爱吃肉——老鼠能炖出一锅好汤，蝙蝠也很适合腌制——但他们在洞窟中的大部分饮食由真菌和昆虫构成，偶尔再用青蛙和鱼来补齐菜单。

隔上一阵子，有时出于无聊，有时则是打赌，某个住在洞里的地精会冒险前往地表世界，寻找更美味的食物或闪闪发光的新宝物。部族中最年长的成员通常不赞成这种行为；他们的父母和祖父母是战争幸存者——满身疤痕、恐惧深入骨髓——而那第一代人也将这份可以理解的恐惧传给了子女。从未体验过洞外生活的年轻地精则更愿意探索地表世界，即使不在巡逻或狩猎时也是如此。一些格外明智的地精领袖已开始小心翼翼地重新与非地精建立外交关系，以便更好地应对在乡间游荡、日益增长的不死生物威胁。

居民
无论地上还是地下，奇特伍德的人口都比许多人意识到的更多。尽管地精占据居民的最大比例，这里也能找到少量大地精，甚至还有非地精类的居民。

Welcome to the Chitterwood
Isger is a land of many scars, both literal and 
metaphorical, and no place better illustrates this 
quality than the once-dense hardwood forest known 
as the Chitterwood. Located in southern Isger near 
the Conerica River, the Aspodell Mountains, and the 
city of Logas, the Chitterwood has long been home 
to hundreds of goblinoid tribes. It’s also home to a 
trade route favored by smugglers. Travel through these 
woods has always been a risky affair due to the threat 
of bandits, but desperate and unsavory travelers are 
willing to traverse the Chitterwood to stay off Isger’s 
main roads.
Due to the area’s unsavory reputation, most 
preferred to avoid the Chitterwood as much as 
possible and maintained little contact with its 
goblinoid residents. This situation suddenly changed 
in 4697 ar, when hobgoblin commanders and their 
goblin armies launched a series of deadly attacks 
against Isger’s rural settlements. The Goblinblood 
Wars, as the conflicts became known, lasted for 
four intensely bloody years. Scores of goblin and 
hobgoblin forces spread across the region, leaving 
death and devastation in their wake. From Varisia to 
Taldor, entire towns were destroyed in the carnage. 
Forces from Andoran, Cheliax, and Druma allied to 
fight the threat. When the Goblinblood Wars at last 
came to an end, the victorious alliance of Drumish 
mercenaries, Eagle Knights, and Hellknights burned 
most of the Chitterwood to the ground.
Despite the massive ecological damage it sustained, 
the Chitterwood isn’t entirely devoid of fauna. Birds 
still sing, bears and boars still roam, and silk moths 
can sometimes be found munching on mulberry 
leaves. Stories of a fierce and ancient beast persist, 
said to now be a living shadow, and the beast is 
rumored to still be on the hunt.
The Caverns of the Chitterwood
The Goblinblood Wars claimed a staggering number of 
lives on all sides, but for the goblin tribes, subjugated 
by hobgoblin commanders and hunted by the 
genocidal Isgeri Slayers, the conflict brought almost 
total annihilation. With most of the Chitterwood a 
smoldering ruin, there remained only one place for 
the surviving goblins to flee: underground.
Deep beneath the remains of the Chitterwood lies a 
vast network of caverns and warrens—an ideal, if less 
than pleasant, place for a devastated people to hide, 
regroup, and rebuild. Much to the tribes’ annoyance, 
however, the caverns were already home to a number 
of creatures who weren’t exactly keen to share their 
space. The bats and rats at least proved tolerably tasty, 
but the cave bears were another story altogether; the 
People of the Swarm tribe, which already had over 
190 songs graphically describing the danger of bear 
attacks, soon added new songs specifically warning 
about cave bears.
Surviving the caverns of Chitterwood for an 
extended period is difficult for several reasons 
outside of ursine encounters. The only light to be 
found is near the cave entrances, humidity is high, 
and food is limited. Fortunately for goblins, their 
darkvision, resourcefulness, and ability to digest 
pretty much anything organic means they’re better 
suited for living in caves than most other Golarion 
residents. Goblins prefer meat when they can get 
it—rats make a good stew, and bats pickle well—but 
most of their diet in the caverns consists of fungi and 
insects, with frogs and fish occasionally rounding 
out the menu.
Every once in a while, sometimes out of boredom 
and sometimes on a dare, a cavern-dwelling goblin 
risks a trip to the world above in search of tastier 
eats or shiny new treasures. This is generally frowned 
upon by the eldest tribe members, whose parents 
and grandparents were survivors of the war; visibly 
scarred and deeply afraid, that first generation passed 
their understandable fear on to their children. Younger 
goblins who have never known life outside the caverns 
are more willing to explore the world above, even 
when not patrolling or hunting. Some particularly 
wise goblin leaders have begun the delicate process of 
reestablishing diplomatic relations with non-goblins 
to better deal with the increasing threat of undead 
roaming the countryside.
Inhabitants
Aboveground and below, the Chitterwood’s population 
is higher than many realize. While goblins represent the 
largest percentage of residents, one can also find a small 
number of hobgoblins and even non-goblinoids here.

Isger is a land of many scars, both literal and metaphorical, and no place better illustrates this quality than the once-dense hardwood forest known as the Chitterwood. Located in southern Isger near the Conerica River, the Aspodell Mountains, and the city of Logas, the Chitterwood has long been home to hundreds of goblinoid tribes. It’s also home to a trade route favored by smugglers. Travel through these woods has always been a risky affair due to the threat of bandits, but desperate and unsavory travelers are willing to traverse the Chitterwood to stay off Isger’s main roads.

Due to the area’s unsavory reputation, most preferred to avoid the Chitterwood as much as possible and maintained little contact with its goblinoid residents. This situation suddenly changed in 4697 ar, when hobgoblin commanders and their goblin armies launched a series of deadly attacks against Isger’s rural settlements. The Goblinblood Wars, as the conflicts became known, lasted for four intensely bloody years. Scores of goblin and hobgoblin forces spread across the region, leaving death and devastation in their wake. From Varisia to Taldor, entire towns were destroyed in the carnage. Forces from Andoran, Cheliax, and Druma allied to fight the threat. When the Goblinblood Wars at last came to an end, the victorious alliance of Drumish mercenaries, Eagle Knights, and Hellknights burned most of the Chitterwood to the ground.

Despite the massive ecological damage it sustained, the Chitterwood isn’t entirely devoid of fauna. Birds still sing, bears and boars still roam, and silk moths can sometimes be found munching on mulberry leaves. Stories of a fierce and ancient beast persist, said to now be a living shadow, and the beast is rumored to still be on the hunt.

The Caverns of the Chitterwood
The Goblinblood Wars claimed a staggering number of lives on all sides, but for the goblin tribes, subjugated by hobgoblin commanders and hunted by the genocidal Isgeri Slayers, the conflict brought almost total annihilation. With most of the Chitterwood a smoldering ruin, there remained only one place for the surviving goblins to flee: underground.

Deep beneath the remains of the Chitterwood lies a vast network of caverns and warrens—an ideal, if less than pleasant, place for a devastated people to hide, regroup, and rebuild. Much to the tribes’ annoyance, however, the caverns were already home to a number of creatures who weren’t exactly keen to share their space. The bats and rats at least proved tolerably tasty, but the cave bears were another story altogether; the People of the Swarm tribe, which already had over 190 songs graphically describing the danger of bear attacks, soon added new songs specifically warning about cave bears.

Surviving the caverns of Chitterwood for an extended period is difficult for several reasons outside of ursine encounters. The only light to be found is near the cave entrances, humidity is high, and food is limited. Fortunately for goblins, their darkvision, resourcefulness, and ability to digest pretty much anything organic means they’re better suited for living in caves than most other Golarion residents. Goblins prefer meat when they can get it—rats make a good stew, and bats pickle well—but most of their diet in the caverns consists of fungi and insects, with frogs and fish occasionally rounding out the menu.

Every once in a while, sometimes out of boredom and sometimes on a dare, a cavern-dwelling goblin risks a trip to the world above in search of tastier eats or shiny new treasures. This is generally frowned upon by the eldest tribe members, whose parents and grandparents were survivors of the war; visibly scarred and deeply afraid, that first generation passed their understandable fear on to their children. Younger goblins who have never known life outside the caverns are more willing to explore the world above, even when not patrolling or hunting. Some particularly wise goblin leaders have begun the delicate process of reestablishing diplomatic relations with non-goblins to better deal with the increasing threat of undead roaming the countryside.

Inhabitants
Aboveground and below, the Chitterwood’s population is higher than many realize. While goblins represent the largest percentage of residents, one can also find a small number of hobgoblins and even non-goblinoids here.

【喳喳林地的地精】
地精血战结束后，对类地精而言已经过去了六代。在这段时期里，伊斯嘉的许多——若非大多数——地精都把喳喳林地的洞窟当作家园。像“虫群之民”“棘背打击者”和“真藏”这样的部族广为人知，但居住在喳喳林地内或其下的类地精文化多达数百种，此处仅介绍其中少数。

一些地精社会普遍共有的特征——惧怕狗与马、热爱歌唱与火焰、以及对文字的警惕——尽管经历了可怖的损失与随后的流离失所，仍在喳喳林地的地精之间延续。然而，各群体之间也存在显著差异；战后，各文化群体的区分反而加深了，因为它们各自以不同方式应对那段经历。举例而言，“虫群之民”会唱起激励人心的战歌，歌颂向昔日的大地精指挥官复仇；而“棘背打击者”则在战斗方面出类拔萃。“钩背”部族如今居住在喳喳林地南部的洞穴中，其名字源自他们在战争期间遭受的一种格外残忍的酷刑。幸存的钩背地精把当年强加于己、深入骨髓的永久穿刺施加在自己的孩子身上，把痛苦转化为生存的象征，以及成年礼的仪式。

在地精血战之前，喳喳林地的地精和许多森林地精一样，往往相当隐居。然而，这种倾向并不意味着他们在想要危险时就不危险。与非类地精的接触通常很有限，唯一显著的例外是：他们会从穿越其领地、缺乏戒备的旅行者身上拾荒与偷窃。地精伏击若真发生，既凶猛又混乱——这一点也被大地精指挥官加以利用，服务于他们自身目的。战争的恐怖更强化了喳喳林地地精尽可能与世隔绝的欲望。几乎所有战士都已阵亡后，战后幸存的地精基本毫无自保之力。如今，地精通常只在必要时才到地表活动，并且尽量在夜色掩蔽之下，以免被更高大、更危险的存在发现。

有些较小的部族出于不同原因，根本没有逃往洞窟，结果也好坏参半。沿着喳喳林地被焚毁的边缘地带，居住着“葫芦头”部族，其名称来自他们独特的习俗：佩戴用葫芦制成的面具。战争期间，残忍的大地精指挥官强迫其地精部队戴上装满黄蜂或蜘蛛的葫芦；地精则通过自发佩戴面具夺回主动权，让大地精失去取乐的对象。这些粗陋的面具在战斗中的帮助存疑，但葫芦头战士仍是强劲的对手。

“余烬寻觅者”事实上并非部族，而是一场激进运动。其成员在喳喳林地各处旅行，肩负使命：确保地精永不再为大地精效力。他们首选的武器是纵火，对大地精及其地精合作者施以炽烈的复仇。

喳喳林地东缘洪水频发，但正是在这片区域，微小的“泥擦”部族宣称拥有领地。顾名思义，这些地精偏好在自己身上糊上一层厚厚的沼泽污泥，并厌恶任何试图把它洗掉的行为。战争期间，大地精用文字烙印来惩罚泥擦地精。幸存者既羞愧又急于去除烙印，便转而在被烙印处自焚自残以留下疤痕；最终，他们开始以一种新传统来给自己的孩子做标记。泥擦地精拒绝文字，他们用随机图样或图像的烧灼与疤痕来标记自己的孩子。

在某些情况下，不去洞窟避难的决定反而带来了回报。“歪趾”部族成为旅行者与冒险者，行至远达艾巴萨罗姆，并成为终焉之墙骑士团所珍视的盟友。“龙居者”部族同样也曾向多个国家的人类提供援助，赢得了盟友的尊敬与庇护。

【葫芦头】
葫芦头地精以其标志性的葫芦头盔而闻名；这是一种可追溯至地精血战的文化风尚。尽管这种头盔曾被用作折磨他们的工具，如今他们却自豪地佩戴它，象征他们已克服大地精首领施加的羞辱与痛苦。甚至连婴儿也会戴上小小的葫芦，据说这有助于把他们的头型塑造成漂亮的圆形。对葫芦的偏爱也让这些地精以南瓜食谱闻名，例如葫芦泥鼠肉炖汤，以及焦糖南瓜方块。
