Places of Interest
As the capital city, Elidir is the location of several 
unique and storied places. Here are some of the most 
important or interesting of those locations.
A. Caravanserai: Caravanserais nestle against the 
city’s walls, offering a place to stay for those willing to 
trade safety for ease. Guards and adventurers come to 
seek employment or companions for journeys through 
more dangerous parts of Avistan, while thieves and 
opportunists look for easy prey.
B. Chelaxian Quarter: This walled neighborhood, 
known to locals as the Devils’ Court, surrounds the 
official Thrune embassy and the wealthy homes of 
expatriates and other Chelaxians who find themselves 
in Elidir. The houses here are the most luxurious in 
all the city, and the occupants are known for their 
lifestyles of excess. Dottari and devils ensure the 
residents’ safety, brutally enforcing the law against any 
trespassers and lawbreakers.
C. Coffer Hall: The primary temple of Abadar is a 
surprisingly low-key structure considering the amount 
of wealth that flows through Elidir. That’s by design, 
as Urgathoa’s agents have long worked to ensure the 
Master of the First Vault’s most capable clerics find 
opportunities in other parts of the Inner Sea, leaving 
only those who lack grand ambition or imagination to 
cater to the city’s faithful.
D. Conerica Landing: The collection of wooden 
docks and warehouses that facilitate the city’s prime 
industry—trade—are collectively known as Conerica 
Landing. They run up and down both banks of the 
river and are some of the most heavily guarded areas 
of the city.
E. Druma Road Gate: The main overland highway 
from Druma enters Elidir at the Druma Road Gate, 
which is always crowded with caravans and others 
seeking to enter or exit. Waits to enter can reach up 
to a day here (though a little gold helps speed up the 
process) with anyone who leaves their place in line 
having to reenter at the end of the queue.
F. Elidir Academy for Proper Goblins: After the 
children raised in this former orphanage grew up and 
moved out, Ottschan Rasefel (severe nonbinary human 
caretaker 2) set their sights on a new project: educating 
goblins. Their short temper and harsh methods quickly 
drive away most young goblins who end up here, but 
the school continues to garner popular support from 
the city’s elite.
G. Grand Cheliax Gate: Two carved wooden 
statues of nessari devils tower over the wall on either 
side of this western entrance to the city, which locals 
know as the Devilsgate. Though it’s nearly as busy 
as the Druma Road Gate, it’s known for the guards’ 
efficient manner, which keeps a steady flow of traffic 
moving.
H. Gyve: The city’s prison holds debtors, political 
prisoners, and true criminals in horrid conditions. 
Subterranean torture chambers routinely extract 
confessions from the innocent and guilty alike.
I. Hedvend Park: This park is named after one of 
the earlier stewards of Isger, a stark reminder of the 
nepotism that runs rampant in Chelaxian circles. 
Hedvend VI has tried to make this park a luxurious 
experience, pouring funds to build a towering 
fountain with a likeness of Abrogail Thrune II on 
it,and importing a number of exotic birds and fish to 
decorate the landscape with.
J. The Iron Strop: This home for wounded veterans 
was run by Gorumite clerics who sought to restore 
their patients to full health—and the ability to battle 
again. Following Gorum’s death, the remaining 
caretakers and patients have become jaded nihilists, 
picking fights with anyone who passes by.
K. Home to Kazhlik: This popular, smoke-filled 
tavern has passed from one dwarven owner to another 
ever since it was founded more than 2,000 years ago. 
Though the origin of its name was forgotten until a 
recent discovery by the Pathfinder Society, it is known 
for its home-cooked meals with Five Kings Mountains 
delicacies and is a favorite of dwarves (and many 
others) who make their way through the city.
L. Isgeri Circle: Most residents give a wide berth 
to this 2,500-year-old circle of standing stones 
surrounding a badly worn altar to Urgathoa (in an 
ancient Kellid incarnation as a harvest goddess) in 
Xerlidia Park. Originally put up to help appease the 
early Isgeri, attempts to remove the circle over the 
millennia have all failed, and superstition says anyone 
who tries will grow ill and die.
M. Isger’s Fist: The Isgeri military operates out of 
this fortress complex, so-called because it wields the 
sword that is the army. Surrounding the central castle 
that hosts the command operations are barracks, 
stables, and other key elements of the country’s armed 
forces.
N. Kingsthrone Cathedral: Built with taxpayers’ 
money at the direct command of the Thrunes, this 
grand cathedral is the center of Asmodeus’ faith in 
Elidir. Its five ruby-studded towers rise high into the 
skyline, ensuring they can be seen from anywhere 
in the city. Traffic is constant at the cathedral, with 
merchants and dottari milling about outside of 
the grand doors and congregants attending strictly 
scheduled times of worship. The cathedral is the most 
popular place of worship not out of piety but fear, as 
no one wants to be seen as disloyal to Cheliax.

The houses here are the most luxurious in all the city, and the occupants are known for their lifestyles of excess. Dottari and devils ensure the residents’ safety, brutally enforcing the law against any trespassers and lawbreakers.
C. Coffer Hall: The primary temple of Abadar is a surprisingly low-key structure considering the amount of wealth that flows through Elidir. That’s by design, as Urgathoa’s agents have long worked to ensure the Master of the First Vault’s most capable clerics find opportunities in other parts of the Inner Sea, leaving only those who lack grand ambition or imagination to cater to the city’s faithful.
D. Conerica Landing: The collection of wooden docks and warehouses that facilitate the city’s prime industry—trade—are collectively known as Conerica Landing. They run up and down both banks of the river and are some of the most heavily guarded areas of the city.
E. Druma Road Gate: The main overland highway from Druma enters Elidir at the Druma Road Gate, which is always crowded with caravans and others seeking to enter or exit. Waits to enter can reach up to a day here (though a little gold helps speed up the process) with anyone who leaves their place in line having to reenter at the end of the queue.
F. Elidir Academy for Proper Goblins: After the children raised in this former orphanage grew up and moved out, Ottschan Rasefel (severe nonbinary human caretaker 2) set their sights on a new project: educating goblins. Their short temper and harsh methods quickly drive away most young goblins who end up here, but the school continues to garner popular support from the city’s elite.
G. Grand Cheliax Gate: Two carved wooden statues of nessari devils tower over the wall on either side of this western entrance to the city, which locals know as the Devilsgate. Though it’s nearly as busy as the Druma Road Gate, it’s known for the guards’ efficient manner, which keeps a steady flow of traffic moving.
H. Gyve: The city’s prison holds debtors, political prisoners, and true criminals in horrid conditions. Subterranean torture chambers routinely extract confessions from the innocent and guilty alike.
I. Hedvend Park: This park is named after one of the earlier stewards of Isger, a stark reminder of the nepotism that runs rampant in Chelaxian circles. Hedvend VI has tried to make this park a luxurious experience, pouring funds to build a towering fountain with a likeness of Abrogail Thrune II on it, and importing a number of exotic birds and fish to decorate the landscape with.
J. The Iron Strop: This home for wounded veterans was run by Gorumite clerics who sought to restore their patients to full health—and the ability to battle again. Following Gorum’s death, the remaining caretakers and patients have become jaded nihilists, picking fights with anyone who passes by.
K. Home to Kazhlik: This popular, smoke-filled tavern has passed from one dwarven owner to another ever since it was founded more than 2,000 years ago. Though the origin of its name was forgotten until a recent discovery by the Pathfinder Society, it is known for its home-cooked meals with Five Kings Mountains delicacies and is a favorite of dwarves (and many others) who make their way through the city.
L. Isgeri Circle: Most residents give a wide berth to this 2,500-year-old circle of standing stones surrounding a badly worn altar to Urgathoa (in an ancient Kellid incarnation as a harvest goddess) in Xerlidia Park. Originally put up to help appease the early Isgeri, attempts to remove the circle over the millennia have all failed, and superstition says anyone who tries will grow ill and die.
M. Isger’s Fist: The Isgeri military operates out of this fortress complex, so-called because it wields the sword that is the army. Surrounding the central castle that hosts the command operations are barracks, stables, and other key elements of the country’s armed forces.
N. Kingsthrone Cathedral: Built with taxpayers’ money at the direct command of the Thrunes, this grand cathedral is the center of Asmodeus’ faith in Elidir. Its five ruby-studded towers rise high into the skyline, ensuring they can be seen from anywhere in the city. Traffic is constant at the cathedral, with merchants and dottari milling about outside of the grand doors and congregants attending strictly scheduled times of worship. The cathedral is the most popular place of worship not out of piety but fear, as no one wants to be seen as disloyal to Cheliax.

## Page 196
O. 沼泽洼地：
与枷械所相连的旧奴隶市场在《解放典范》颁布后被关闭，但不久便以劳役营的形式重新开放。那些无力偿还债务、或犯下其他轻罪者会在此以艰苦的条件劳动，制造供军队使用的军需品，或生产售卖以补偿其债主的货物。

P. 米洛吉的动物园：
这处展示异域动物与怪奇生物的场馆曾是城中最耀眼的景点之一，如今却已年久失修。普通市民仍会偶尔前来参观，但富裕精英已对常见动物感到厌倦；若动物园想继续得到他们的资助，就必须提供更多新鲜花样。布尔里克·索登塔夫（焦头烂额的男性人类饲养员 3）转而付钱请冒险者替他带来新生物，不论其有多危险。他希望让动物园保持新鲜有趣，以吸引高端客户。

Q. 新梦设计：
这家纹身店是诺克提库拉在城市中的残余追随者的秘密聚会地点；在女神背弃其恶魔过往之后，城中信众爆发了激烈的分裂，而这些人则是幸存者。塞维佐伊是此处小型会众的领袖，他正在研发可售卖的魔法纹身，以便雇佣佣兵，在一场针对旧日伙伴的血腥斗争中获得援助。

R. 夜市：
这座街市从杜鲁玛大道门外延展开来，白天或夜晚都向城中居民与途经商队提供农产、货物与手工艺品。日落后，摊位上的商品不可避免地会出现由工人和盗贼从过境货物中顺手牵羊之物——这些货原本从未打算留在伊利迪尔。

S. 高架道：
环绕伊利迪尔的道路网络让商人能够绕城而行，也使军队得以轻易穿行科内里卡海峡。由于高架道比河道本身更难防卫，本地区的大多数强盗活动都发生在其上：掠袭者出手后迅速撤回丘陵之中。

T. 缚咒者舞台：
这座小剧院因其极简演出而在城中精英圈子里声名鹊起，演出内容往往不过是独白作品或台上朗读。赞助者完全没有意识到剧院缺乏上演更宏大剧目的资源，反而称其为前卫——一种独具伊斯嘉风格的戏剧表达。剧院主人特莱奇（颠覆性的男性凯亚尔剧作家 4）开始推出愈发尖锐的演出，坚信观众会继续对眼前显而易见的问题视而不见。据传该剧院计划在时机成熟时上演臭名昭著的剧作《阿布罗盖尔一世》。

U. 魅魔腰带：
这家高端精品店无视“魅魔并非魔鬼”这一事实，专营魔鬼主题时装与“最新”（其实已落后数月）的埃戈里安时尚潮流。店主费莉丝·格雷戈里亚（精明的性别流动半身人裁缝 6）并非真正的切利亚斯拥护者，但她知道迎合那些拥护者能让他们赚到最多金币。本店也为最昂贵的商品提供特殊附魔，例如幻象香气或闪耀的舞动贵族幻影。额外付费者还能获得店内最稀有的商品：以魔法打造、可投入战斗的服装，兼顾美观与实用。

V. 甜蜜拥抱：
这座不起眼的木塔多年来一直经营低端妓院，同时暗中也是城中诺克提库拉的神殿——一处以她之名运作的刺客公会。前恶魔领主飞升为救赎女王后，埃里蒂夫人（迷人的女性人类刺客 9）夺得了“甜蜜拥抱”的控制权，并在继续其两门生意的同时，努力铲除那些拒不接受诺克提库拉变化的教团残党。她与同伴刺客已找到一位新的神祇庇护以回应祈祷，但他们获得力量的源头究竟是谁，连他们自己是否清楚也未可知。

W. 贸易署：
这座城市的税务与关务机构负责监管科内里卡码头、城内的商队客栈及一切其他贸易事务，盘踞于码头附近一片庞大而曲折如迷宫的建筑群。其广泛职权使其腐败机会丛生，而这种腐败通常会被忽视，直到其恶劣程度过于离谱。即便如此，惩罚也往往很轻，因而让许多用城市金币填满自家钱箱的人变得无所畏惧。

X. 白牡鹿旅店：
这家规模庞大、熙攘繁忙的旅店距离码头仅需步行片刻，服务于一切以河道为生之人——从最富有的商人到最底层的装卸工。这里常能找到工作或工人，取决于一个人站在这条分界线的哪一边。

Y. 泽尔莉迪娅公园：
这座公园以伊利迪尔的建立者命名，因她与早期伊斯嘉部族缔结的一项铁一般的盟约而历经数个世纪仍得以存续。公园由少数泛灵者照料，他们引导着古老凯立德“苍白之语者”信仰的灵魂；这些泛灵者也欢迎访客漫步园径、亲近自然，并在城市的“失落士兵纪念碑”处与亡者相通——那是一座用断裂的剑与护甲铸成、闪耀如新的钢铁雕塑。此地是伊斯嘉少数未受切利亚斯染指的灵性场所之一；许多人来到这里并非出于信仰，而是出于希望——希望能看到某种未被地狱的邪魔存在所玷污的事物。

Adventure Toolbox
O. Moil: The former slave market attached to the 
Gyve was shut down following the Emancipation 
Edict, only to reopen a short time later as a labor 
camp. Those who can’t pay their debts or who commit 
other minor crimes work here in difficult conditions, 
creating munitions for use by the army or goods sold 
to benefit their creditors.
P. Myrogy’s Menagerie: This showcase of exotic 
animals and bizarre creatures was once a star 
attraction of the city but has fallen into disrepair. 
While ordinary citizens still enjoy the occasional tour, 
the wealthy elites have grown bored of the mainstay 
animals and demand variety if the menagerie wants 
their patronage. Bulric Soddentough (frazzled male 
human zookeeper 3) has turned to paying adventurers 
to bring him new creatures, no matter how dangerous. 
He hopes to keep the menagerie fresh and interesting 
to attract the high-end clientele.
Q. New Dream Designs: This tattoo shop is the secret 
meeting place of Nocticula’s remaining followers who 
survived the violent schism among the city’s faithful 
after the goddess turned her back on her demonic past. 
Sevizoy, who leads the shrine’s small congregation, 
is developing magical tattoos to sell so he can hire 
mercenaries to help in a bloody struggle against his 
former companions.
R. Night Market: This street market spills out of the 
Druma Road Gate, offering produce, goods, and crafts 
by day or night to city residents and passing caravans. 
After the sun sets, the merchandise inevitably includes 
items lifted by workers and thieves from cargo on 
its way through the city that were never intended to 
remain in Elidir.
S. Rampways: The network of roads that runs 
around Elidir allows traders to bypass the city and the 
army to easily navigate the Conerica Straits. Because 
the Rampways are more difficult to protect than the 
river itself, the bulk of bandit activity in the region 
occurs on them, with raiders striking and quickly 
retreating back into the hills.
T. Spellbinder’s Stage: This small theater has 
become celebrated by the city’s elite for its minimalist 
performances, often little more than spoken pieces 
or stage readings. Completely oblivious to the truth 
that the theater lacks the resources to put on grander 
shows, its patrons praise it as avant-garde—a uniquely 
Isgeri take on drama. The theater’s owner, Theletch 
(subversive male kayal playwright 4), has taken to 
presenting ever more searing shows, convinced that 
his audience will continue to overlook what’s right 
in their face. It’s rumored that the theater plans to 
perform the infamous play Abrogail I when the 
timing is right.
U. The Succubus’s Sash: Ignoring the fact that 
succubi aren’t devils, this high-end boutique specializes 
in devil-themed fashion and the “latest” (really 
months behind) Egorian fashion trends. Owner Felice 
Gregoria (savvy genderfluid halfling tailor 6) isn’t 
actually a Chelaxian loyalist but knows catering to 
those who are will bring the most gold to their hands. 
The boutique also provides special enchantments for 
their most expensive items, such as illusory scents or 
glimmering images of dancing nobles. Those who pay 
extra can gain access to the store’s rarest merchandise, 
magically battle-ready clothing designed for both 
aesthetic and practicality.
V. Sweet Embrace: This unassuming wooden tower 
for years held a low-end brothel and, secretly, the 
city’s temple of Nocticula, home to an assassin’s guild 
operating in her name. Following the former demon 
lord’s ascension as the Redeemer Queen, Mistress 
Erity (charming female human assassin 9) won control 
of Sweet Embrace and continues both of its trades 
while battling to eliminate the remnant of the cult 
that accepted Nocticula’s changes. She and her fellow 
assassins have found a new divine patron to answer 
their prayers, but it isn’t clear if even they know who 
grants them power.
W. Trade House: The city’s tax and customs 
office, which oversees Conerica Landing, the city’s 
caravanserai, and all other trade matters, fills a 
sprawling labyrinth of buildings near the docks. 
Its wide purview leaves it rife with opportunities 
for corruption, which generally gets ignored until it 
becomes too egregious. Even so, punishment is often 
light, leading to a certain fearlessness among those 
who fill their coffers with the city’s gold.
X. White Stag Inn: This large, bustling inn a short 
walk away from the docks serves all those who make 
their living from the river, from the richest merchants 
to the meanest stevedore. It’s a common place to find 
work or workers, depending on which side of the 
divide a person falls on.
Y. Xerlidia Park: Named for Elidir’s founder, this 
park has survived through the centuries thanks to an 
ironclad pact she made with the early Isgeri tribes. 
It’s tended by a handful of animists who channel the 
spirits of the ancient Kellid Speakers of the Pale faith; 
these animists also welcome visitors to walk its paths, 
interact with nature, and commune with the dead at 
the city’s Memorial to Lost Soldiers, a gleaming steel 
sculpture made from broken swords and armor. This 
site is one of the few spiritual places in Isger that 
remains untouched by Cheliax, and many flock to it 
not out of faith but out of hope, seeing something that 
isn’t tainted by Hell’s fiendish presence.

## Page 198
苍白公主的阴谋

乌尔格索娅曾是一名凡人女子，她对肉体与心灵的享乐沉溺至深，以至于从骨冢中撕裂而出，并登临神位。作为疾病、暴食与不死的女神，乌尔格索娅邀请她的追随者无尽饕餮格拉利昂所能提供的一切感官与体验，几乎不顾道德或生死。享乐主义者、饕餮之徒、死灵法师与不死生物都循着她血腥的足迹前行，追逐一种欲望永不落空的生命。

内容警告
本文探讨乌尔格索娅崇拜的诸多表现形式。内容包含：身体恐怖、食人、饮食失调、呕吐、酒精、优生学、疾病、蓄意传播疾病、医疗疏失、难产致死、大规模谋杀、自杀、人体实验、亵渎死者、不死生物，以及非自愿复生。

重要人物
乌尔格索娅最有影响力的崇拜者，有人奉为圭臬，有人深恶痛绝，而所有人都畏惧三分。他们被饥渴驱使，沉醉于不死所带来的自由，是一小撮最狰狞、最怪诞、也最辉煌的典范，忠诚侍奉苍白公主。

巴拉斯桑加斯
巴拉斯桑加斯（好学的女性血肉畸变体法师11级）痴迷于毁灭与反生命的机巧，于是前往虚空，并从精灵法师蜕变为不死法师。她的力量如今与虚空纠缠在一起；她的皮肉被绷得极紧，以至于骨骼与组织透过半透明的皮肤清晰可见。回到宇宙后，巴拉斯桑加斯试验创造注入熵能的新型不死生物，把乌尔格索娅视为她亵渎子嗣的庇主与共同亲代。她经常以敌人的生命力为自己的魔法添柴，让对手陷入迟钝，并将其转化为新的试验对象。

菲亚恩
菲亚恩（老练的男性食尸鬼指挥官12级）身形魁梧，尸灰色皮肤配上一抹令人不安的僵硬笑容，足以让任何不幸在战场上与他狭路相逢的人胆寒。他曾是一位乌芬的林诺姆王；在被迫谋杀并吞食自己的仪仗卫队后，他以自尽结束生命，却带着禁忌血肉的余味从坟中爬起。如今，他对乌尔格索娅的敌人发动无尽战争，吞食倒下的敌尸以壮大自身。献身于其他神祇的圣武士与战士私语着那骇人一幕：昔日高贵的身影卑伏下来，像寻常野兽般啃噬腐肉。

母之咽
作为乌尔格索娅的神圣代表，“母之咽”（神秘的无性别传令使15级）以皮革般的蝙蝠翼翱翔空中，执行其女神的意志。它周身环绕嗡鸣的蝇群与狂热的不死奴仆；这具巨大的有翼骷髅将盟友载入战场，创造新的不死生物，并把敌人推入其无尽的咽喉之中。无论任务多么具毁灭性或怪诞离奇，它都会执行女神命令的一切。当它不忙于满足乌尔格索娅的愿望时，母之咽便会寻找新奇的感官体验，并热烈谈论食物、酒、香水，以及生命的其他乐趣。

百肢基马托
基马托（悲恸的无性别半身人赫雷克森5级）曾是一位侍奉莎伦瑞的医师；当其配偶死于难产时，他们的信仰随之破碎。为了与配偶团聚，基马托唾弃了自己曾信奉的一切，以可怖的外科精准将挚爱尚有余温的遗骸移植到自身躯体上。这种亵渎的反抗令乌尔格索娅欣喜，她赐予其不死与新的头衔。如今的“百肢基马托”为乌尔格索娅之名，怀着复仇之心在莎伦瑞的神殿与信众之间开出一条血路；他们那亵渎拼合的身躯随每一个新受害者而膨胀，数百只手臂与腿脚以诡异的整齐步调齐动。

Urgathoa was a mortal woman who so loved indulging 
in the pleasures of the body and mind that she tore 
herself from the Boneyard and ascended to godhood. 
As the goddess of disease, gluttony, and undeath, 
Urgathoa invites her followers to endlessly feast on all 
the sensations and experiences Golarion has to offer 
with little regard to morality or mortality. Hedonists, 
gluttons, necromancers, and undead all follow in 
her bloody footsteps, chasing after a life where their 
desires never go unfulfilled.
Prominent Figures
Urgathoa’s most influential worshippers are revered 
by some, reviled by many, and feared by all. Driven 
by hunger and delighting in the freedom of undeath, 
they’re handful of the most gruesome, grotesque, 
and glorious paragons who faithfully serve the Pallid 
Princess.
BARASTHANGAS
Barasthangas (studious female fleshwarp mage 11) 
was obsessed with the machinations of destruction 
and anti-life, and so she traveled to the Void and was 
transformed from an elven mage into an undead one. 
Her powers are now entwined with the Void, and her 
flesh is stretched so tautly that bones and tissue are 
visible through her translucent skin. Now back in the 
Universe, Barasthangas experiments with the creation 
of new forms of undead infused with entropic energy, 
viewing Urgathoa as both patron and co-parent to her 
profane children. She regularly fuels her magic with 
the life force of foes, allowing her to stupefy them and 
turn them into new test subjects.
FJARN
Fjarn (veteran male ghoul commander 12) has a 
hulking form, corpse-gray skin, and an unnerving 
rictus smile that strike fear in the hearts of anyone 
unlucky enough to cross his path in battle. Once an 
Ulfen Linnorm King who died by suicide after he was 
forced to murder and eat his own honor guard, Fjarn 
rose from the grave with the taste of forbidden flesh 
on his tongue. He now wages endless war against 
Urgathoa’s enemies, devouring the corpses of his 
fallen foes to grow his power. Paladins and warriors 
devoted to other gods whisper about the horrifying 
sight of a once regal figure stooping low to gnaw on 
carrion like a common beast.
MOTHER’S MAW
As the divine representative of Urgathoa, Mother’s 
Maw (enigmatic agender herald 15) soars through the 
air on leathery bat wings to enact its goddess’s will. 
Surrounded by swarms of buzzing flies and adoring 
undead thralls, the giant winged skull ferries allies into 
battle, creates new undead, and shoves enemies into 
its endless gullet. It does everything and anything that 
the goddess commands, no matter how destructive 
or bizarre the task is. When it isn’t busy fulfilling 
Urgathoa’s wishes, Mother’s Maw searches for 
novel sensual experiences and partakes in passionate 
conversation about food, wine, perfume, and the other 
pleasures of life.
MANY-LIMBS KIMMATO
Formerly a physician devoted to Sarenrae, Kimmato 
(sorrowful nonbinary halfling herexen 5) had their 
faith shattered when their spouse died in childbirth. 
Desperate to be united with their spouse, Kimmato 
spat in the face of everything they once believed and 
grafted the still-warm remains of their loved one onto 
their own body with gruesome surgical precision. This 
act of blasphemous defiance delighted Urgathoa, who 
blessed them with undeath and a new title. Many-
Limbs Kimmato now vengefully carves a bloody path 
through Sarenrae’s temples and worshippers in the 
name of Urgathoa, their profanely amalgamated body 
growing with each new victim, hundreds of arms and 
legs moving in uncanny unison.

This article explores the many manifestations of 
Urgathoan worship. It includes themes of body 
horror, cannibalism, disordered eating, vomiting, 
alcohol, eugenics, disease, intentional transmission 
of disease, medical negligence, death in childbirth, 
mass murder, suicide, human experimentation, 
desecration of the dead, undead, and involuntary 
reanimation.

## Page 199
乌拉·莱尼登（URRA LYNEDON）

乌加索娅赋予乌拉·莱尼登（试验性女性吸血鬼伯爵 9级）在本来乏味的永生里一个新目标：像培育稀有异域花卉那样培育疾病。乌拉利用她忠诚的凡俗情人们的身体，滋养并繁育来自格拉利昂各地的细菌、真菌与病毒的不同菌株。她将这些实验成果献给同信乌加索娅者——那些追求新奇感官体验，或渴望从其女神那里获得由高热驱动的异象之人。

习俗（Practices）

乌加索娅要求她的崇拜者将个人满足置于一切之上，并抛却道德、社会与凡躯所施加的束缚。她的许多追随者沉溺于极端享乐，藐视禁忌，只为满足肉体与心智的欲望。崇拜者摒弃自我克制，饕餮格拉利昂所能提供的一切——无论那是稀罕的美馔、带毒的腐烂之物，还是有智生物的血肉与生命精华。他们试探自身躯体的感官极限，将快乐与痛苦交织，追逐愈发怪诞而可怖的饥渴。

另一些追随者则会自愿感染并忍受疾病。任由病痛与感染蹂躏身体，乌加索娅的信徒既能证明自己对无尽放纵之生的奉献，又能体验前所未有的感受。乌加索娅常在苦难所致的高热梦境中赐予追随者异象与神启，而她所偏爱的使者则恒常处于一种病恹恹的状态。

乌加索娅的崇拜者将不死视为超越凡躯局限的终极升华。许多人梦想成为亡灵，如此便能永无止境地满足欲望，不再受恼人的寿命限制。更具魔法天赋者会修习死灵术，学习如何唤起死者，向自然秩序竖起中指，以成就自身野心。那些无法实现死后幻想的人则崇敬亡灵，有时甚至愿意将自己喂给更为贪婪的同伴——只为在侍奉乌加索娅的死亡狂喜中体验那一刻。

乌加索娅追随者中更嗜血的一群，则以折磨与杀戮来满足对暴力的渴求。他们会寻找崇拜乌加索娅之敌的会众，并以屠戮他们为乐，品味尖叫的交响与温热鲜血溅上皮肤的触感。那些最坚决反对不死之人随后会被复苏为亡灵，作为扭曲而讽刺的终章，被派去追杀其幸存的挚爱亲朋。

邪教（Cults）

如饥饿的腐烂般在格拉利昂的黑暗中溃烂滋生，乌加索娅的邪教秘密集结，崇拜苍白公主。无论他们是出于自身私利，还是出于迷误的无私；无论他们追随她在疾病、暴食或死亡上的神性性相——所有这些邪教都在试图侍奉乌加索娅那永不餍足的意志。

品尝社团（THE SAVORING SOCIETY）

表面上，“品尝社团”是由艾巴萨罗姆最富有的政客、商人和贵族组成的古怪且排他的俱乐部。然而在鎏金大门之后，它却是一支让上层阶级得以尽情享受特权所带来快乐的邪教。对这些享乐的贵族而言，暴食与奢华是其应得之物，而乌加索娅则是他们的守护者，确保宴会永不落幕。成员们夸口称，他们一边啜饮陈酿千年的美酒，一边品尝过格拉利昂历史上存在过的每一种活物。奢靡的聚会可以持续数周之久，因为邪教的规条宣称，成员不仅必须沉溺于物质之乐，也必须“品味”它——为享受这等挥霍，投入一切所需的时间，甚至更多。“品尝社团”从富有而强权的精英中引诱新成员，以其恶习相馈，并说服他们乌加索娅才是唯一值得崇敬的女神——因为还有谁能理解：要享受不可能的财富带来的好处，就必须吞食穷人？

灰烬教会（THE ASHEN CHURCH）

在乌加索娅的崇拜者之中，致力于传播并敬奉亡灵的邪教不在少数，但没有哪一个如“灰烬教会”这般成功。灰烬教会出现在格拉利昂各地——凡战乱、自然灾害或极端贫困降临之处，都能见其踪影；他们目睹了人们在直面自身必死命运时如何变得恐惧、残忍而绝望。教会成员试图通过分享女神所赐的慰藉来缓解这一苦难循环：无需畏惧死亡，因为乌加索娅确保死亡并非终结。他们以温柔的善举与共情之心教导世人：不死乃乌加索娅赐予一切凡类的慈悲，是将他们从凡俗恐惧中拯救出来的方法——并以“永生等待所有接受之人”的寄望为凭。

灰烬教会的怜悯并不局限于活人。大多数人面对亡灵生物只会感到厌恶或恐惧，而灰烬教会却将其视为值得尊重与关爱的存在。他们的存在本身便能平息那些原本怀有恶意、饥渴噬人的亡灵的攻击性。正是通过这种和平的行止……

URRA LYNEDON
Urgathoa gave Urra Lynedon (experimental female 
vampire count 9) a new purpose in an otherwise boring 
immortal life: cultivating diseases like one would rare, 
exotic flowers. Using the bodies of her devoted mortal 
consorts, Urra nurtures and breeds strains of bacteria, 
fungi, and viruses from all across Golarion. She offers 
the results of her experiments to fellow Urgathoan 
faithful who seek new sensations or the fever-driven 
visions from their goddess.
Practices
Urgathoa demands that her worshippers put personal 
gratification before all else and cast off the constraints 
imposed by morality, society, and the mortal body. 
Many of her followers indulge in extreme hedonism, 
defying taboo to satiate their appetites of the body 
and the mind. Casting away self-restraint, worshippers 
feast upon everything Golarion has to offer, whether 
that’s rare delicacies, poisonous rot, or the flesh and 
lifeblood of sapient creatures. They experiment with 
the sensual limitations of their bodies, mixing pleasure 
and pain as they chase increasingly bizarre and 
grotesque hungers.
Other followers willingly contract and endure 
illnesses. By allowing disease and infection to ravage 
their bodies, Urgathoa’s faithful can prove their 
dedication to a life of limitless indulgence while 
experiencing novel sensations. Urgathoa often gives 
visions and divine insights to her followers during 
the fevered dreams of affliction, and her favored 
messengers exist in a perpetual sickly state. 
Urgathoa’s worshippers view undeath as the 
ultimate transcendence of the mortal body’s limitation. 
Many dream of becoming undead, when they can 
forever fulfill their desires without the pesky limit of 
mortality. The more magically gifted practice the art 
of necromancy, learning how to raise the dead and 
spit in the eye of the natural order to fulfill their own 
ambitions. Those unable to realize their post-death 
fantasies venerate the undead, sometimes to the extent 
of willingly feeding themselves to their more ravenous 
peers if only to experience the rapture of death in 
service to Urgathoa.
The more bloodthirsty of Urgathoa’s followers 
satisfy their cravings for violence by torturing and 
killing in her name. They seek out congregations 
who worship Urgathoa’s enemies and take delight in 
massacring them, savoring the symphony of screams 
and the splatter of warm blood upon skin. The victims 
who were most adamantly against undeath are then 
reanimated and sent after their surviving loved ones in 
a final act of perverse and ironic pleasure.
Cults
Festering in the darkness of Golarion like a hungry rot, 
Urgathoan cults gather in secrecy to worship the Pallid 
Princess. Whether they act in their own self-interest or 
in misguided selflessness, no matter if they follow her 
divine aspect of disease, gluttony, or death, all these 
cults seek to serve Urgathoa’s insatiable will.
THE SAVORING SOCIETY
On the surface, the Savoring Society is an eccentric and 
exclusive club made up of the wealthiest politicians, 
merchants, and nobility of Absalom. However, behind 
gilded doors is a cult that allows the upper class to 
freely indulge in the pleasures that privilege provides. 
For these hedonistic aristocrats, gluttony and luxury 
are their given due, and Urgathoa is their patron who 
ensures the party never stops.
Members boast of tasting every living thing that 
has existed across Golarion while sipping wine aged 
for a thousand years. Opulent gatherings can last 
for weeks, as the cult’s rules proclaim that members 
must not only indulge in material joy but also savor 
it, taking all the time one could ever need and more 
to enjoy such extravagance. The Savoring Society 
lures in new members from the rich and powerful 
elite, plying them with their vices and convincing 
them that Urgathoa is the only goddess they should 
revere—for who else understands that to enjoy the 
benefits of impossible wealth, one must consume the 
poor?
THE ASHEN CHURCH
Cults dedicated to proliferating and venerating the 
undead are plentiful among Urgathoa’s worshippers, 
but none are as successful as the Ashen Church. 
Appearing across Golarion where war, natural 
disaster, or extreme poverty have struck, the Ashen 
Church bears witness to the ways people become 
fearful, cruel, and desperate when faced with their 
own mortality. Members seek to alleviate this cycle of 
suffering by sharing the comfort their goddess offers: 
that one doesn’t have to fear death, as Urgathoa 
ensures that death isn’t the end. Through gentle acts of 
kindness and empathy, they teach people that undeath 
is Urgathoa’s mercy to all mortal kind, a way to save 
them from their mortal dread with the promise that 
immortality awaits all who accept it.
The Ashen Church’s compassion isn’t limited to the 
living. While most people look upon an undead creature 
with revulsion or terror, the Ashen Church sees a being 
that deserves respect and affection. Their very presence 
can quell the aggression of otherwise malevolently 
ravenous undead. It’s through this peaceful conduct

## Page 200
……灰烬教会如此凯旋般地敞开了格拉利昂人民的心灵与思想，使他们接纳乌尔格瑟亚与不死，使她的名与慈悲得以永远传播。

《苦难牧者》
惊骇之眼的居民亲眼见识了：在神祇般的威胁面前，凡人是何等无力。有人畏缩在英雄的盾牌之后，有人把自己隔绝在遗迹之中；而苦难牧者则相信，文明生存之道在于培育强者、剔除弱者。他们将乌尔格瑟亚奉为生存的巅峰，并把疾病当作终极试炼，以检验谁有资格以她之名继承这个世界。

他们从一个城镇走到另一个城镇，以毁灭性的疾病感染整座村庄，并剥夺其药物。幸存者会被带入教团，获得充足食物、军事训练，以及可用来对抗一切威胁他们之物的死灵奥秘。那些不配、因而死去的人则会被再度唤起为不死仆从，被当作工具使用，而非享有安宁休息的尊严。少数得到乌尔格瑟亚异象恩赐者会被尊为先知，享有重大特权，却也被迫永远处在持续发热的状态。苦难牧者的数量与力量日增，带着不可动摇的信念继续前进：他们所追求的、被疾病蹂躏的世界，终将值得这份牺牲。

《永恒食者》
有人说“人如其食”，而永恒食者把这句话以最字面、最极端的方式贯彻到底。其成员来自黄金之路各地，因共同的信念而团结：他们所摄入的一切都会成为灵魂不可分割的一部分，并会随他们一同抵达死后世界的最终归宿。进食不仅为了维系凡躯，也为了填满彼界的宴席长桌。牙齿嚼碎觊觎的传家宝与珍贵宝石以填满金库，喉咙粗粝地吞下石块与金属以建造个人宫殿。在最极端的情形下，成员甚至会吞食心爱的宠物与家人，以确保彼此能在永恒中团聚。每一口都献给乌尔格瑟亚，祈望她接受他们的虔敬，并在她的领域中赐予他们一处家园。

永恒食者因身体艰难消化这等异常饮食而深受折磨。然而，他们将痛苦视为死后永恒幸福所需付出的微小价格，并拒绝任何缓解症状的医疗治疗。永恒食者死后，其最后的奉献便是将遗体献给乌尔格瑟亚，使其仍能在凡人位面继续为她效劳，而灵魂则前往他们精心打造的来世。

物品
这些物品常为乌尔格瑟亚的崇拜者所用。

苍白水晶（PALLID CRYSTAL） 物品 7
罕见 神圣 灌注
价格 360 gp
穿戴方式 佩戴；负载 —
需求 你是乌尔格瑟亚的追随者。
这枚手指状水晶系在一条细皮带上，连接着生与不死的世界：由活体生物佩戴时呈苍白不透明的粉色；由不死生物佩戴时则转为深邃半透明的紫色。佩戴项链期间，腐败的食物与饮品尝起来如同新鲜一般，且食用不会产生不良效果。若你被活力治疗效果治疗，你获得虚空抗力 5；但若你被虚空效果治疗，你改为获得活力抗力 5。

腐梦银盘（PLATTER OF PUTRID DREAMS） 物品 4
罕见 神圣
价格 100 gp
使用方式 1手持用；负载 L
这只银质托盘与圆顶罩盖上，精细雕刻着宴席长桌满溢的场景。当你说出命令词时，会只为你的唇舌创造一道菜。任何其他尝试食用被召唤食物的人，都会被迫立刻将其呕出——未咀嚼也未消化。

启动—美味盛宴（Savory Feast） 10分钟（专注、探索、操作）
频率 每周一次；
效果 当你掀开罩盖并说出“savor”时，会创造一道你从未品尝过的菜肴：可能是遥远地域的独特珍馐，也可能是知性生物的禁忌血肉。若你花费10分钟吃完整顿餐点，你恢复 2d6+8 生命值，并在24小时内对抗恶心（sickened）的豁免检定获得+2状态加值；但若你在这段时间内尝试吞咽任何其他东西——包括万灵药与药水——你必须先通过一次 DC 5 纯骰检定，否则该动作被浪费。

that the Ashen Church has so triumphantly opened 
the minds and hearts of Golarion’s people to Urgathoa 
and undeath, allowing her name and mercy to spread 
forever more.
THE SHEPHERDS OF AFFLICTION
The Eye of Dread’s residents have 
experienced firsthand how powerless 
mere mortals are in the face of 
godlike threats. While some people 
cower behind the shields of 
heroes or sequester themselves 
away in ruins, the Shepherds 
of Affliction believe that the 
path to civilization’s survival 
is to nurture the strong and weed 
out the weak. They worship Urgathoa 
as the pinnacle of survival and utilize 
disease as the ultimate test to see who’s worthy to 
inherit the world in her name.
Going from town to town, the Shepherds of 
Affliction infect entire villages with devastating 
illnesses and deprive them of medicine. Those who 
survive are brought into the fold, given plenty of 
food, military training, and necromantic secrets to use 
against anything that threatens them. Those unworthy 
enough to die are reanimated as undead servants, used 
as tools rather than given the dignity of peaceful rest. 
The rare few who are gifted with visions of Urgathoa 
are revered as prophets, granted great privilege though 
forced to stay in a perpetual fever state. Each day, the 
Shepherds of Affliction grow in number and strength, 
marching forward with the unshakable belief that the 
disease-ravaged world they seek to build will be worth 
the sacrifice.
THE ETERNAL EATERS
Some say you are what you eat, and the Eternal Eaters 
take that saying to its most literal extreme. Members 
come from all across the Golden Road, united in 
the belief that everything they consume becomes an 
inextricable part of their soul and will be brought with 
them to their final destination in the afterlife. Food 
is eaten not just to sustain mortal bodies but also to 
fill otherworldly feast tables. Teeth crunch against 
coveted heirlooms and precious gems to fill coffers, 
and throats raggedly swallow down stone and metals 
to build personal palaces. In the most extreme cases, 
members will even consume beloved pets and family 
members to guarantee they’ll be united in eternity. 
Every bite is dedicated to Urgathoa in the hopes that 
she’ll accept their piety and provide them a home 
within her domain.
The Eternal Eaters suffer greatly as their bodies 
struggle to digest this unusual diet. However, they 
accept the pain as a minor price to pay for everlasting 
happiness after death and refuse any medical treatment 
to alleviate their symptoms. After an Eternal Eater 
dies, their last act of devotion is to give their body 
to Urgathoa so that it can continue to serve 
her on the mortal plane while their soul 
moves on to their carefully crafted 
afterlife.

of

the worlds of life and undeath, shifting from a pale opaque 
pink when worn by a living creature to a deep translucent 
purple when worn by an undead creature. While wearing 
the necklace, rotten food and drink taste as if they were 
fresh and can be eaten with no ill effects. If you’re healed 
by healing vitality effects, you gain void resistance 5, but 
if you’re healed by void effects, you instead gain vitality 
resistance 5.

## Page 202
萨林加洛

伊斯嘉作为切利亚斯受虐的附庸国，这一地位遮蔽了这个国家过往的大半篇章。七个世纪以来，切利亚斯与伊斯嘉的贵族家系掠夺着这片土地所能提供的一切资源。从木材、矿产与宝石中收割来的那点财富，也被一代代的执政总管挥霍殆尽。纵使威胁四起、险境迫近，富人和权势者在意的也只有科涅里卡河水面上钱币流动的声响。因此，每当伊斯嘉的平民遭受磨难——无论是饥荒、疾病，还是战争——他们往往只能独自面对。

近三十年前的地精血战便是这种忽视的典型写照。奇特伍德的部落大军焚毁整片乡野社群，而伊斯嘉军队却未能及时作出反应。当时的赫德文六世执政不过两年，只象征性地下达了一些军事命令，用以保护上层阶级与首都的资产。随着更多聚居地沦陷，一波波士兵擅离岗位，士气进一步下滑，资源也愈发紧张。地精血战的暴力因此不可避免地蔓延至国境之外。

待到伊斯嘉的邻国介入时，科涅里卡河两岸早已被攻陷。奇迹般地，河畔城镇萨林加洛在满目疮痍之中相对未受重创。它由古老城垣守护，这份防御不仅吸引了难民，也吸引了想要休整的士兵。更何况，这座城镇临河的位置使前往伊斯嘉各处的旅行更为迅捷；对撤退的部队或增援兵力而言，这同样是一项战略优势。

然而，便利并不必然等同于支援。那时的萨林加洛不过是个小聚居地，最多只计划收容2,000名居民。由于没有来自政府的正式补给渠道，随着涌入人口骤增，镇上的粮食储备迅速见底。时任市长忧心忡忡，遂对外国部队颁布了一项极具争议的条例：每名士兵每周只允许获得一顿饭与一夜休息；伤员可停留两周，但随后将被禁止入城一个月。

不出所料，许多本地人反对这些荒唐规定，开始设法规避。他们把陌生人带回家中，声称对方是远房表亲或类似亲属。甚至有人冒险到城墙外采集、捕鱼或狩猎，好私下为军队补给。无论他们对外来者有多么疑心，萨林加洛的居民都知道伊斯嘉需要援助。若真有一个时刻值得为了国家的利益而违抗法律与文化，那就是当时——不然就再也不会有了。

据说，秘密收容外国士兵，正是“鹰骑士”“地狱骑士”与“佣兵同盟”这一不太可能的联盟得以建立的开端。传闻有三位指挥官在同一处屋檐下、以同一个假身份藏匿时，尴尬地发现了彼此的真实隶属。坦白之后，三人意识到他们目标一致。即便各自的将军因理念分歧而拒绝结盟，这些指挥官仍暗中协调了部队调动。数次胜利之后，那些勉为其难的高层终于承认合作的成效，并建立了正式同盟……至少萨林加洛的民间故事是这么低语的。

这支著名同盟以惨重代价拯救了伊斯嘉。许多亲眼见证同盟如何成立的人也随之死去。赫德文六世趁乱掩饰自己的无能，暗示是他秘密将英雄们聚到了一起。当萨林加洛试图提出不同说法时，这位总管便警告说，他可能会把复兴工程与未来防务转向更“重要”的地点。难民挤满城镇的萨林加洛为了生存与重建，只得保持沉默。多年间，它又退回到那个仅以阴郁之名、悲惨过去与迷信闻名的小镇。

萨林加洛所试图掩藏的过往——无论是这座城市自身的创立，还是它在地精血战中扮演的角色——都揭示了一个简单的真相：这个聚居地从一开始就注定成为舞台，让反抗建制、教条或暴政的故事在此上演。那看似偏执的东西，其核心其实是对权力的戒惧。

自从摆脱一次恶魔腐化危机后，焕新的成长重新点燃了萨林加洛那份命运的火花。尽管这座年轻城市仍保留着排他的社交圈根源，但圈与圈之间的缝隙已让那些过去本会为敌的人得以和解。如今，人们维持传统的社交距离并非出于恐惧，而是为了避免肤浅的评判。对现代的萨林加洛而言，在……之时的行动——（未完）

Isger’s status as a mistreated vassal state of Cheliax 
overshadows much of the nation’s past. For seven 
centuries, Chelaxian and Isgeri noble houses plundered 
what resources the land had to offer. What wealth 
was gained from the lumber, minerals, and gems 
harvested, generations of ruling stewards squandered. 
Though threats rose and dangers imperiled, the rich 
and powerful cared only for the flow of coin on the 
waters of the Conerica River. And so, whenever the 
common folk of Isger suffered strife—be it famine, 
disease, or war—they often faced it alone.
The Goblinblood Wars from nearly three decades 
ago exemplified this neglect. The Chitterwood hordes 
razed entire rural communities while the Isgeri 
army failed to make a timely response. Hedvend 
VI, then only a couple of years into his stewardship, 
issued token military orders to protect assets of the 
upper class and the capital. As more settlements 
succumbed, waves of soldiers deserted their posts, 
further lowering morale and straining resources. The 
violence of the Goblinblood Wars thus inevitably 
spread beyond the nation.
By the time Isger’s neighbors intervened, both 
banks of the Conerica were overrun. Miraculously, 
the riverside town of Saringallow stood relatively 
unscathed amid the wreckage. Protected by its historic 
ramparts, this defense attracted not only refugees but 
also soldiers looking to recuperate. That the town’s 
location by the river expedited travel to all corners of 
Isger was another strategic boon for retreating action 
or reinforcements.
Convenience, 
however, 
didn’t 
automatically 
translate to support. Saringallow was but a small 
settlement back then, with plans to shelter 2,000 
denizens at most. Without official resupply channels 
from the government, the town’s food stores shrank 
quickly from the influx of people. Alarmed, the then-
mayor passed a highly controversial ordinance upon 
the foreign forces. Each soldier was allowed a meal 
and a night of rest per week. Those wounded could 
stay a fortnight but would consequently be barred 
from town for a month.
Predictably, many locals disagreed with the 
absurd rules and began circumnavigating it. They 
took strangers into their homes, claiming them to 
be distant cousins or similar relations. Some even 
risked foraging, fishing, or hunting outside the walls 
to privately resupply the troops. However suspicious 
they were of outsiders, the inhabitants of Saringallow 
knew Isger needed help. If there was a time to defy law 
and culture for the good of the nation, it was then or 
never again.
Allegedly, sheltering foreign troops in secrecy was 
how the unlikely alliance between the Eagle Knights, 
Hellknights, and Mercenary League started. Claims 
purport three commanders awkwardly discovered 
each other’s true affiliations while hiding under the 
same false identity and roof. After coming clean, 
the three recognized their shared goal. Even when 
their generals refused to ally over philosophical 
differences, the commanders tacitly coordinated their 
troop movements anyway. Several victories later, the 
reluctant higher-ups acknowledged the effectiveness of 
cooperation and established a formal alliance… or so 
the Saringallow folklore whisper.
The famed alliance saved Isger at an immense cost. 
Death took with it many who witnessed how the 
coalition formed. Capitalizing on the uncertainty to 
hide his incompetence, Hedvend VI insinuated he was 
the one who secretly brought the heroes together. When 
Saringallow attempted to suggest otherwise, the steward 
warned he might direct recovery efforts and future 
protection toward more “important” locations. Yet full 
of refugees, Saringallow held its tongue to survive and 
rebuild. For years, it reverted back to the town known 
only for its grim name, tragic past, and superstitions. 
The past Saringallow hides from—be it the city’s 
own founding or the role it played in the Goblinblood 
Wars—speaks a simple truth: the settlement was 
always meant to be a stage on which rebellions against

Hellbreakers Adventure Path

Saringallow

Isger’s status as a mistreated vassal state of Cheliax overshadows much of the nation’s past. For seven centuries, Chelaxian and Isgeri noble houses plundered what resources the land had to offer. What wealth was gained from the lumber, minerals, and gems harvested, generations of ruling stewards squandered. Though threats rose and dangers imperiled, the rich and powerful cared only for the flow of coin on the waters of the Conerica River. And so, whenever the common folk of Isger suffered strife—be it famine, disease, or war—they often faced it alone.

The Goblinblood Wars from nearly three decades ago exemplified this neglect. The Chitterwood hordes razed entire rural communities while the Isgeri army failed to make a timely response. Hedvend VI, then only a couple of years into his stewardship, issued token military orders to protect assets of the upper class and the capital. As more settlements succumbed, waves of soldiers deserted their posts, further lowering morale and straining resources. The violence of the Goblinblood Wars thus inevitably spread beyond the nation.

By the time Isger’s neighbors intervened, both banks of the Conerica were overrun. Miraculously, the riverside town of Saringallow stood relatively unscathed amid the wreckage. Protected by its historic ramparts, this defense attracted not only refugees but also soldiers looking to recuperate. That the town’s location by the river expedited travel to all corners of Isger was another strategic boon for retreating action or reinforcements.

Convenience, however, didn’t automatically translate to support. Saringallow was but a small settlement back then, with plans to shelter 2,000 denizens at most. Without official resupply channels from the government, the town’s food stores shrank quickly from the influx of people. Alarmed, the then-mayor passed a highly controversial ordinance upon the foreign forces. Each soldier was allowed a meal and a night of rest per week. Those wounded could stay a fortnight but would consequently be barred from town for a month.

Predictably, many locals disagreed with the absurd rules and began circumnavigating it. They took strangers into their homes, claiming them to be distant cousins or similar relations. Some even risked foraging, fishing, or hunting outside the walls to privately resupply the troops. However suspicious they were of outsiders, the inhabitants of Saringallow knew Isger needed help. If there was a time to defy law and culture for the good of the nation, it was then or never again.

Allegedly, sheltering foreign troops in secrecy was how the unlikely alliance between the Eagle Knights, Hellknights, and Mercenary League started. Claims purport three commanders awkwardly discovered each other’s true affiliations while hiding under the same false identity and roof. After coming clean, the three recognized their shared goal. Even when their generals refused to ally over philosophical differences, the commanders tacitly coordinated their troop movements anyway. Several victories later, the reluctant higher-ups acknowledged the effectiveness of cooperation and established a formal alliance… or so the Saringallow folklore whisper.

The famed alliance saved Isger at an immense cost. Death took with it many who witnessed how the coalition formed. Capitalizing on the uncertainty to hide his incompetence, Hedvend VI insinuated he was the one who secretly brought the heroes together. When Saringallow attempted to suggest otherwise, the steward warned he might direct recovery efforts and future protection toward more “important” locations. Yet full of refugees, Saringallow held its tongue to survive and rebuild. For years, it reverted back to the town known only for its grim name, tragic past, and superstitions.

The past Saringallow hides from—be it the city’s own founding or the role it played in the Goblinblood Wars—speaks a simple truth: the settlement was always meant to be a stage on which rebellions against establishments, dogma, or tyranny played out. What manifests as paranoia was at its heart a wariness toward power.

Since recovering from a demonic corruption crisis, a renewed growth has revived a spark of that destiny in Saringallow. While the young city yet maintains the tradition of exclusive social circles, the spaces in between have allowed those who would’ve been enemies in the past to reconcile. People now maintained the traditional social distance not out of fear, but rather to abstain from superficial judgment. For the modern Saringallow, actions in times of

【恶魔胆汁事件】
本地志中提到的恶魔腐化与恶魔胆汁事件，出自《Pathfinder》模组《疯狂的绞架》（Gallows of Madness）。你可以阅读（甚至游玩）该模组以了解此事件的完整背景；在该模组中，萨里尼庄园旧址那座废弃老宅会发生一连串神秘事件。

危机最能真实地衡量一个人的可信度。当一场新生战争的赤红阴霾自地平线逼近，萨林盖洛再一次整装以待，准备见证伊斯嘉未来将要发生的一切——无论那会是变好的一转，还是变坏的一转。

萨林盖洛（SARINGALLOW） 定居点5
【城市】
一座庇护叛乱的小城

政府：市长（民选领袖）
人口：2,550（80%人类、8%艾尤瓦林、4%半身人、3%地精、3%侏儒、2%其他）
语言：通用语（塔尔丹语）
宗教：艾拉斯提尔、密拉妮
威胁：不满的妖精、不断升级的战事、躁动不安的亡灵

谨慎而警惕：萨林盖洛的居民对他们所见、所闻以及其他一切察觉到的事物都会三思而后行。每天一次，若生物已在城中居住累计满一周，则当其位于萨林盖洛境内时，可以在一次失败的察觉检定或意志豁免上进行重骰，并获得+2物品加值。每当萨林盖洛本地人与对手的先攻掷骰结果打平时，本地人先行动。

精通迷信：萨林盖洛在诸多情境下都有丰厚的手势、短语或信物等传统；总有一种能对症下药。每月一次，若生物已在萨林盖洛居住累计至少一周，则当其尝试一次技能检定时，可以以带有专注、语言学与操作特征的自由动作（free action）进行：掷两次骰并取较好结果；这是一个幸运效果。此外，萨林盖洛会出售最高至其定居点等级两倍的常见护符。

伊德里斯·鲁瓦拉（善良的男性人类艾拉斯提尔牧师6级）：艾拉斯提尔的司祭，本地信仰支柱
乔迪斯·塞雷利（意志坚定的非二元艾尤瓦林人类卫队队长5级）：萨林盖洛城卫队队长

桑德拉·特里内利（谨慎的女性人类市长6级）：萨林盖洛现任市长

历史
人人都知道，萨林盖洛建立在绞死切利亚克斯贵族萨里尼家族之上。该家族的仆从会神秘失踪，直到居民忍无可忍，亲自对萨里尼家族下手。清剿女巫的狂潮让该定居点自治后的第一个十年陷入泥沼。乡野地区的人回忆那是一个教条横行的时代：他们的祖先冒险在城墙之外的荒野耕作；因为那时住在萨林盖洛，就等同于活在高度的偏执之中。

该定居点在财政上举步维艰：失去需要侍奉的庄园后，码头不再有货物流入。

科内里卡河最终将该定居点从解体的边缘拯救出来：萨林盖洛通过充当南北旅人的休息站，成功稳定了经济。随着时间推移，走陆路的人也开始将这里作为停靠点；有时只是过客，有时则与河上的商旅进行交易。

接下来两个世纪里，萨林盖洛的增长十分缓慢，主要动力来自那些离乡追逐财富、成功后再度归来的人。多数尝试者若能回来，也往往两手空空；而更多人干脆一去不返。随着该镇迈入第三个世纪，局势出现变化：地精血战已近在眼前。战争期间，萨林盖洛挺了过来。尽管本地人把城墙称作“穷人的屋顶”，但那些壁垒的质量一点也不寒酸。战争中毫发无损，使萨林盖洛在战后复苏上抢得先机。

多数人并不知晓：在更古老的远古时代，萨林盖洛如今所在之处被称为“十字路口”（Crosspaths）。它几乎位于伊斯嘉的腹地，是生活在阿斯波戴尔山脉与梅纳多尔山脉之间土地上的人们定期聚会之处，通常用于重申盟约。萨里尼家族特意选择在此修建庄园，因为这能让来访宾客进行一些业余考古作为消遣。曾有一次，人们从村落中挖出一柄华美的长柄刀（glaive）。这件完好无损的历史遗物被送往艾利迪尔，自此一直留在那里。

History
Everyone knows Saringallow as the place founded on the lynching of the Chelaxian noble house of Sarini. The noble house’s servants would go mysteriously missing until residents had enough and dealt with the Sarinis themselves. Witch hunts mired the settlement’s first decade of self-rule. Those in the rural regions recall it as a time of dogma. Their ancestors risked cultivating the wilderness outside the walls, for to live in Saringallow then was to live in intense paranoia.
The settlement struggled financially, as without a manor to serve, there were no goods coming in through the docks.
The Conerica River ultimately saved the settlement from dissolution, for Saringallow managed to stabilize its economy by serving as a rest stop for those traveling north and south. In time, those traveling by road began using it as a stop as well, sometimes as passersby, sometimes to trade with those on the river.
Saringallow’s growth was slow for the next two centuries, fueled mostly by those who left to find fortune and returned upon success. Most who tried returned empty-handed if they returned at all. Things changed as the town’s third century rolled in, for the Goblinblood Wars were on the horizon. During the wars, Saringallow persevered. Though the locals called their walls the Pauper’s Roof, the ramparts were anything but poor in quality. Surviving the war intact gave Saringallow a head start on recovery.
Unbeknownst to most, the site where Saringallow is today was known as the Crosspaths in older, ancient days. Lying almost at the heart of Isger, it was a regular place where those who lived on the lands between the Aspodell and Menador mountains met, usually to reaffirm their alliance. The Sarinis specifically chose to construct their manor here, for it allowed their guests to entertain themselves with some amateur archaeology. At one point, a beautiful glaive was unearthed from the village. The pristine historical artifact was sent to Elidir, where it stayed ever since.

## Page 204
任期为终身。在最初一个世纪之后，萨林盖洛改为每届任期5至10年，具体年数会作为市长候选人在竞选期间提出的政见之一。这让萨林盖洛更容易在同一位领袖的任内推进大型基础设施工程。按传统，新候选人通常会在任期结束前约两年开始拉票，尽管也曾出现更早启动的情况。

尽管聚落选举市长，萨林盖洛仍需向埃利迪尔以及伊斯嘉的总督负责。虽然城市大多按伊斯嘉的标准执法，但有时萨林盖洛会决定援引其“旧书”的权利。这套法律据称源自一份极为古老的《阿巴达尔城市建造手册》抄本，其年代之久，以至于其书名实际上可译作《文明建造法》。一些萨林盖洛本地人认为，“旧书”对被剥夺权利的人更为友善，尤其是那些依靠土地为生的人。“旧书”的批评者则指出，这恰恰说明它不应在现代使用，因为其中的考量往往并不适用于城市环境。

不可否认，萨林盖洛几乎已经算是一座真正的城市；它只需要将自身正确划分为各个区、为街道命名并给建筑编号即可。特里内利市长任期还不到一年就将结束，但她已显著增强了市政厅的行政能力，以为该项目做准备。这份准备在总督为持续中的战争实施新税时意外成了助力。许多人需要延期缴纳；若非增员带来的文书处理能力提升，萨林盖洛很可能会被榨得一干二净。

居民
在城墙之内，萨林盖洛居住着2,500余人。另有约800人生活在城墙之外的乡村地区，其中一些聚居点规模几乎与小镇相当。人口主要由三大群体构成：萨里尼家仆的后裔、在地精血战之前移居此地的人，以及在战后移居的人。第一群体可通过其姓氏或家族名辨识，他们也严格遵循许多传统的祈祷方式与迷信习俗。萨林盖洛的一些法律曾在土地或房屋所有权等方面赋予这些家族特定特权。近些年来，这些带有歧视性的法律大多已被逐步废止。

地精血战之前，萨林盖洛被视为人类聚落；如今几乎所有非人类族裔的居民都是在那之后迁入的。有些人是因为家园被毁、已无可挽回；另一些人则因萨林盖洛被证明足够安全而感到安心。半身人与侏儒是最早迁入城内的族群之一，而地精与大地精则直到最近几年才开始定居。最早的一批地精类甚至是被付钱请来迁入的，因为萨林盖洛意识到，避免与奇特林森林发生冲突的最好方式，就是先接纳那里的人。

如今，“年龄”通常更能决定萨林盖洛居民的行事风格。年长者更为疏离、迷信、坚忍且勤劳；年轻居民与新移民更投机、直接且思想开放。十几岁及以下的孩子几乎普遍顽皮又好奇。不论年龄，几乎所有萨林盖洛人都厌恶贵族与上层阶级。即便是最良善的贵族逃亡者，也必须先证明自己才能在此获得接纳；因此，这些贵胄后裔也像萨林盖洛其他人一样，形成了属于自己的私人社群。

文化与社会

evoke their right to the Old Book. This set of laws is 
reportedly based on an ancient copy of the Abadaran 
Manual of City-Building, so ancient that its title 
actually translates to Laws of Civilization-Building. 
Some Saringallow locals believe the Old Book to be 
more friendly for the disenfranchised, especially if 
they live off the land. Critics of the Old Book point to 
this reason as to why it shouldn’t be used in modern 
times since its considerations are often unsuitable for 
an urban environment.
It’s undeniable that Saringallow is almost a proper 
city; it just needs to properly divide itself into 
districts, name its streets, and number its buildings. 
While Mayor Trinelli has less than a full year left 
in her term, she has significantly increased the city 
hall’s administrative capabilities to prepare for this 
project. This preparation accidentally ended up being 
a boon when the Steward implemented a new tax 
for the ongoing war. Many needed it to be deferred, 
and without the increase in staff to complete all the 
paperwork, Saringallow might have been squeezed 
dry.
Residents
Within the walls, Saringallow is home to over 
2,500 people. Another 800 or so live beyond the 
walls in the rural regions, some of which are almost 
the size of small towns. The population has three 
major demographics: those who descended from the 
Sarini servants, those who immigrated here before 
the Goblinblood Wars, and those who immigrated 
after. The first group is distinguished by their last or 
family name as well as their strict adherence to many 
traditional practices in prayers and superstitions. 
Some Saringallow laws once gave these families 
specific privileges in areas such as land or home 
ownership. Most of these discriminatory laws have 
been phased out in the recent years.
Saringallow was considered a human settlement 
before the Goblinblood Wars; nearly all residents 
without human ancestry today came to reside 
hereafter. For some, it was because their home 
was destroyed and beyond salvage. For others, 
Saringallow’s proven safety gave them peace of mind. 
Halflings and gnomes were among the first to move 
into the city, while goblins and hobgoblins only 
started settling in within the last few years. The first of 
the goblinoids were even paid to move to the city, as 
Saringallow realized the best way to prevent conflict 
with the Chitterwood was to accept its people first.
Age is usually a better determiner of how 
a Saringallow resident acts nowadays. Older 
residents are more distant, superstitious, stoic, 
and hardworking. Younger residents and newer 
immigrants are opportunistic, direct, and open-
minded. Those in their teens and under are almost 
universally mischievous and curious. Regardless of 
age, nearly all Saringallow folk despise nobility and 
aristocracy. Even the kindest of noble runaways need 
to prove themselves before they find acceptance here, 
which resulted in these scions forming their own 
private community like everyone else in Saringallow.

## Page 205
人们可能一辈子都住在聚落里，却从未见过那个将来会在墓地里与自己相邻的人。从某种意义上说，这也许确实如此。由于教育主要由各自家庭负责，而学徒制仍是通往事业的最佳道路，萨林加洛的社会流动性并不高。一个人的阶级与地位往往在出生时就已决定；只有冒险生涯与功勋卓著的军旅生涯，才可能较为可靠地打破这些期待。

尽管魔法曾一度令人极度畏惧，但在神雨之后，这种态度发生了显著变化。萨林加洛曾将神圣力量视为最可靠的——至少也是可预测地善或恶。目睹一位神祇的死亡让许多人重新思考。大多数人最终接受了这样的看法：最重要的是施法者的意图，而非魔法本身。人们应当以其为人来评判，而不是以其掌握的力量来评判。反魔法的标语已被撤下，魔法使用者也更有底气公开自己的能力——在过去，他们可能会将其隐藏起来。

真正能让萨林加洛团结起来的一件事，是这里的节庆。许多节日整个阿维斯坦都在庆祝，但也有一些是本地的特色活动。比如“夜驰”（Nightgallop），这是在乡间萨林加洛举行的赛马活动，于春季第一个满月之夜进行。另一方面，“传承日”（Succession）则是学徒从师傅处获得认可徽章的日子，仪式会以字面意义上的“传火”来完成。

而许多地方性节庆则与农业相关：如“剪行”（Shearwalk），追赶羊群并剪毛的一周；“劈橡”（Oaksplit），处理木材的时节；“雪播”（Snowsow），为将用于冬小麦的谷物祝福；“丰收宴”（Harvest Feast），共享聚餐的时段；以及“织集”（Loomgather），雪琳信徒“晶彩节”（Crystalhue）的本地化版本。“绞刑日”（Gallows Day）用以纪念城市的建立，过去是肃穆的宗教纪念日，但最近为了吸引游客而被商业化了。

【知名人物】
没人知道艾勒莉“奶奶”（Elleri “Gram” Smalltoes，神秘的女性半身人制烛匠 4级）从何而来；有人说她和萨林加洛一样古老。这位制烛匠大多独来独往，除了会絮叨着训斥顾客。实际上，奶奶在《解放典范》颁布前是一名逃奴，并因切利亚斯加诸于她的一切罪孽而对其怀恨在心。

Saringallow
204
could live their entire life in the settlement and never 
meet the soul that will become their neighbor in 
the graveyard. In some ways, this might be true. As 
schooling is primarily conducted by one’s own family 
and apprenticeship remains the best path to a career, 
there isn’t a lot of social mobility in Saringallow. 
One’s class and status are often decided upon birth; 
only adventuring and a decorated military career can 
predictably break those expectations.
While magic was once greatly feared, that attitude has 
changed significantly after the Godsrain. Saringallow 
once saw divine powers as the most reliable—or at 
least predictably good or evil. Witnessing the death of 
a god has made many reconsider. Most settled on the 
sentiment that the intent of the magic user mattered 
most, not the magic itself. People should be judged by 
who they are, not what powers they wielded. Anti-
magic signage has been taken down, and magic users 
have been emboldened to be more open about their 
abilities when they once might have hid them.
One thing that does unite Saringallow is its holidays. 
While many are observed in Avistan at large, a few 
are local attractions. There’s the Nightgallop, a horse 
race in rural Saringallow that takes place at night on 
the first full moon of spring. Succession, on the other 
hand, is a day when apprentices receive their badge 
of approval from their teachers in a literal torch-
passing ceremony.
Many of the local holidays are then related to 
agriculture, such as Shearwalk, a week chasing 
down sheep to shear; Oaksplit, a time when lumber 
is processed; Snowsow, blessing of the grains that 
will be used for winter wheat; Harvest Feast, a time 
of communal meals; and Loomgather, a localized 
version of the Shelynite Crystalhue. Gallows Day, 
which commemorates the city’s founding, was a 
somber day of religious observance in the past but 
has been commercialized recently in an attempt to 
attract tourism.
Notable People
No one knows where Elleri “Gram” Smalltoes 
(mysterious female halfling candler 4) came from; 
some say she’s as old as Saringallow itself. The candler 
mostly keeps to herself except to nag her customers. 
In truth, Gram was a runaway slave before the 
Emancipation Edict and harbors a grudge against 
Cheliax for all its sins against her.

## Page 206
老霍克（顽固的男性人类危言耸听者4级）是萨林盖洛最年长的居民之一，笃信各种迷信做法，包括用盐把房子围上一圈、吃下成堆的大蒜。他坚信不久后的某一天，萨里尼家族会降临萨林盖洛，夺回曾经属于他们的一切，而他决心为此做好准备。许多年轻人都顺着他的胡言乱语：收下大蒜花环，承诺会训练战斗；但年长者越来越厌烦他没完没了地散播恐慌。

市长桑德拉·特里内利（谨慎的女性人类市长6级）相信现代化与改革。这种观点与部分年长居民相冲突——他们抱守迷信，对变化心存戒备。市长希望循序渐进地为萨林盖洛的成长铺路，因为这座城市正摇摇欲坠地处在可能迈向大城的门槛上。

梅尔·费兰（快乐的女性人类说书人3级）在萨林盖洛定居的时间不长；她在作为说书吟游诗人四处旅行后，才来到这里。她亲眼目睹伊斯嘉政府（以及隐含其后的切利亚克斯政府）的疏忽与暴行，明白人们需要希望。她用自己的故事来鼓舞民心。

关系与冲突

如今萨林盖洛的名声相当清白，这座城市与伊斯嘉境内许多聚居地保持着良好关系，尤其是附近的斯威夫特伦镇。然而在城中，人际冲突却愈发频繁。有些矛盾本属私事，却无意间波及社区；另一些则事关公众利益。但最可能的冲突来源，是萨林盖洛在近期记忆中几乎不曾正面遭遇过的：妖精。

许多人哀叹这座朴素的聚居地失去了乡野魅力，妖精也不例外——它们对人口与建筑的涌入感到不适与恼怒。尽管数百年来无人再与妖精交流并非城市之过，但如果萨林盖洛的人们没能意识到这些原始邻居日渐增长的怨恨，萨林盖洛可能会再次遭到攻击。

名胜地

作为一座正在兴起的城市，萨林盖洛既有古旧之处，也有新建设施，甚至还有历史悠久、值得一访的地点。

A. 绞架农场：六座绞架农场自聚居地建立以来，一直负责维持萨林盖洛的紧急口粮储备。有些由家族经营并世代相传，另一些则几经买卖易主。随着近期北墙沿线出现贫民窟、农作物失窃增多，农场主们正发起运动，要求更换市长。拥有者中资历最深的格鲁迪娜·梅泽雷特（细致的女性半身人农夫4级）是他们属意的候选人。尽管格鲁迪娜计划兴建社会住房，并对未经监管的建筑采取惩罚性措施，但她在其他议题上缺乏立场而饱受批评。

B. 城市守卫兵营：恶魔胆汁事件之后，萨林盖洛扩充了安保力量。城市守卫兵营设在“贵族愚行”之门内。尽管此举显然是为了阻止年轻人偷溜出城，守卫们仍不断抓到各个年龄段的孩子试图挑战传统胆量试炼——沿着贵族愚行的小径一路走上去。

兵营设施齐全，配有自己的瞭望塔、训练场、马厩、可容纳两打守卫的宿舍，以及食堂。队长乔迪斯·塞雷利（坚定的无性别艾乌瓦林人类守卫队长5级）把各个小队管得严如他们成长的孤儿院。乔迪斯指挥下的城市守卫从处理扒手、夜间巡查墓园，到频繁的噪音投诉（针对新来的驻城乐队）无所不包。尽管乔迪斯并非切利亚克斯同情者，他们却厌恶叛乱分子，认为无论组织意图多么高尚，都只会弊大于利。

C. 绞架墓园：这座墓园的坟墓与城市一样古老，是大多数人非必要不愿踏足之地。诺拉莉娅·温特伦（爱冒险的女性人类厄拉斯提尔牧师5级）自愿担任新任守墓人时，让许多人都大吃一惊。传言说，她接下此职或许是对养父伊尔德里斯的一次“成年叛逆”；也有人认为她对这地方的眷恋出于情感。

接手墓园后，诺拉莉娅培育出一大片槲寄生树冠，作为守护该区域、抵御邪恶的结界。她经常修剪这些植株，防止其过度蔓生。剪下的枝叶随后被她与萨林盖洛的许多工匠用于制作可佩戴护符，形制多为手环或花冠。

D. 旅人广场：顾名思义，旅人广场四周环绕着旅店、食肆与商铺，专门招待途经萨林盖洛的旅人——他们通常沿科内里卡公路而来。这里的绞架尽管阴森、仍在实际使用，而且由面相凶悍（但很有礼貌）的城市守卫看守，却依旧是热门景点。当天气宜人时，梅尔·费兰这样的表演者常在清晨沿广场边缘排开，既为谋生，也顺便充当那些睡过头旅人的“闹钟”。

Old Hawk (stubborn male human fearmonger 4) is 
one of the oldest residents of Saringallow and holds to 
various superstitions, including lining his house with 
salt and eating tons of garlic. He’s convinced that, one 
day soon, the Sarinis will descend upon Saringallow to 
reclaim what was once theirs, and he’s determined to 
be ready for it. Many of the younger folk humor his 
ravings by accepting garlic garlands and promising to 
train in fighting, but the older folk are getting tired of 
his constant fearmongering.
Mayor Sandra Trinelli (prudent female human 
mayor 6) believes in modernization and reform. This 
outlook clashes with some of the older residents, who 
cling to superstition and are wary of change. Slowly 
but surely, the mayor hopes to pave the way for growth 
in Saringallow as it teeters on the edge of becoming a 
potentially major city.
Maire Phelan (jovial female human storyteller 3) 
has lived in Saringallow for only a short time, settling 
there after traveling as a storytelling bard. She has 
witnessed firsthand the neglect and atrocities of the 
Isgeri government (and implicitly, the Chelaxian 
government) and knows the people need hope. Using 
her stories, she works to uplift the people.
Relationships and Conflicts
Saringallow’s reputation is quite pristine these days, 
and the city maintains good relations with many 
settlements within Isger, particularly the nearby town 
of Swiftrun. Within the city, however, there have been 
more and more interpersonal conflicts. Some are more 
private in nature that inadvertently spill over into the 
community, while others are of the public interest. 
The most likely conflict though is from a source 
Saringallow has likely not faced before, in recent 
memory at least: the fey.
Many mourn that the simple settlement has lost its 
rustic charm, and the fey are no different, chafing at 
the influx of people and structures. While it isn’t the 
city’s fault that no one has communed with the fey 
in centuries, Saringallow might find itself under attack 
again if its people don’t come to realize the growing 
grudge of their primal neighbors.
Places of Interest
As a burgeoning city, Saringallow has a mix of old, 
new, and even historical locations of interest to visit.
A. Gallow Farms: The six Gallow Farms have been 
responsible for maintaining Saringallow’s emergency 
ration supply since the settlement’s establishment. 
Some are family-run and passed down through the 
generations, while others have been bought and 
sold. With the recent formation of slums along the 
north wall and a rise in theft of crops, the farms are 
campaigning for a change in mayorship. Gerudina 
Mezeret (meticulous female halfling farmer 4), the 
most senior of the owners, is their candidate of choice. 
Though Gerudina has plans for social housing and 
punitive measures against unregulated construction, 
her lack of opinion on other issues is criticized.
B. City Watch Barracks: After the demon bile 
incident, Saringallow expanded its security. The city 
watch barrack was established within the Noble 
Folly’s gate. Despite the obvious move to deter youths 
from sneaking out, guards continue to catch children 
of all ages attempting the traditional dare of going up 
the Noble Folly’s path.
The barracks is fully equipped with its own watch 
towers, a training yard, stables, a dormitory for two 
dozen guards, and a mess hall. Captain Jordis Serelli 
(determined nonbinary aiuvarin human guard captain 
5) runs the squads as tightly as the orphanage they 
grew up in. Under Jordis’s command, the city watch 
handles matters from pickpockets and nightly rounds 
in the graveyard, to frequent noise complaints against 
the new resident band. While Jordis is no Chelaxian 
sympathizer, they dislike insurgents, believing no 
matter how noble the organization’s intent might be, 
they would do more harm than good.
C. Gallow’s Graveyard: With graves as old as the 
city, Saringallow’s graveyard is a place most avoid 
except when necessary. Nolaria Wintren (adventurous 
female human cleric of Erastil 5) surprised many when 
she volunteered to become the new groundskeeper. 
Rumors say that she might have taken up the post 
in an act of adulthood rebellion against her adoptive 
father, Ildris. Others suggest her attachment to the 
place is sentimental.
Since taking over the graveyard, Nolaria has 
cultivated a large canopy of mistletoe as a ward on 
the area against evil. She prunes the patches frequently 
to prevent overgrowth. The cuttings are then used by 
both her and many other artisans in Saringallow to 
create wearable charms in the form of bracelets or 
wreathes.
D. Traveler’s Square: As its name suggests, Traveler’s 
Square is surrounded by inns, eateries, and stores that 
cater to those who are passing through Saringallow, 
usually by the Conerica Highway. The gallows here 
are a popular attraction despite it being forebodingly 
functional and guarded by menacing-looking (but 
polite) city guards. When the weather is pleasant, 
performers like Maire Phelan often line the perimeter 
of the square in the morning, both to earn their keep 
and to serve as a convenient alarm clock for travelers 
who have overslept.

Hellbreakers Adventure Path

Old Hawk (stubborn male human fearmonger 4) is one of the oldest residents of Saringallow and holds to various superstitions, including lining his house with salt and eating tons of garlic. He’s convinced that, one day soon, the Sarinis will descend upon Saringallow to reclaim what was once theirs, and he’s determined to be ready for it. Many of the younger folk humor his ravings by accepting garlic garlands and promising to train in fighting, but the older folk are getting tired of his constant fearmongering.

Mayor Sandra Trinelli (prudent female human mayor 6) believes in modernization and reform. This outlook clashes with some of the older residents, who cling to superstition and are wary of change. Slowly but surely, the mayor hopes to pave the way for growth in Saringallow as it teeters on the edge of becoming a potentially major city.

Maire Phelan (jovial female human storyteller 3) has lived in Saringallow for only a short time, settling there after traveling as a storytelling bard. She has witnessed firsthand the neglect and atrocities of the Isgeri government (and implicitly, the Chelaxian government) and knows the people need hope. Using her stories, she works to uplift the people.

Relationships and Conflicts
Saringallow’s reputation is quite pristine these days, and the city maintains good relations with many settlements within Isger, particularly the nearby town of Swiftrun. Within the city, however, there have been more and more interpersonal conflicts. Some are more private in nature that inadvertently spill over into the community, while others are of the public interest.
The most likely conflict though is from a source Saringallow has likely not faced before, in recent memory at least: the fey.
Many mourn that the simple settlement has lost its rustic charm, and the fey are no different, chafing at the influx of people and structures. While it isn’t the city’s fault that no one has communed with the fey in centuries, Saringallow might find itself under attack again if its people don’t come to realize the growing grudge of their primal neighbors.

Places of Interest
As a burgeoning city, Saringallow has a mix of old, new, and even historical locations of interest to visit.
A. Gallow Farms: The six Gallow Farms have been responsible for maintaining Saringallow’s emergency ration supply since the settlement’s establishment. Some are family-run and passed down through the generations, while others have been bought and sold. With the recent formation of slums along the north wall and a rise in theft of crops, the farms are campaigning for a change in mayorship. Gerudina Mezeret (meticulous female halfling farmer 4), the most senior of the owners, is their candidate of choice. Though Gerudina has plans for social housing and punitive measures against unregulated construction, her lack of opinion on other issues is criticized.

B. City Watch Barracks: After the demon bile incident, Saringallow expanded its security. The city watch barrack was established within the Noble Folly’s gate. Despite the obvious move to deter youths from sneaking out, guards continue to catch children of all ages attempting the traditional dare of going up the Noble Folly’s path.
The barracks is fully equipped with its own watch towers, a training yard, stables, a dormitory for two dozen guards, and a mess hall. Captain Jordis Serelli (determined nonbinary aiuvarin human guard captain 5) runs the squads as tightly as the orphanage they grew up in. Under Jordis’s command, the city watch handles matters from pickpockets and nightly rounds in the graveyard, to frequent noise complaints against the new resident band. While Jordis is no Chelaxian sympathizer, they dislike insurgents, believing no matter how noble the organization’s intent might be, they would do more harm than good.

C. Gallow’s Graveyard: With graves as old as the city, Saringallow’s graveyard is a place most avoid except when necessary. Nolaria Wintren (adventurous female human cleric of Erastil 5) surprised many when she volunteered to become the new groundskeeper. Rumors say that she might have taken up the post in an act of adulthood rebellion against her adoptive father, Ildris. Others suggest her attachment to the place is sentimental.
Since taking over the graveyard, Nolaria has cultivated a large canopy of mistletoe as a ward on the area against evil. She prunes the patches frequently to prevent overgrowth. The cuttings are then used by both her and many other artisans in Saringallow to create wearable charms in the form of bracelets or wreathes.

D. Traveler’s Square: As its name suggests, Traveler’s Square is surrounded by inns, eateries, and stores that cater to those who are passing through Saringallow, usually by the Conerica Highway. The gallows here are a popular attraction despite it being forebodingly functional and guarded by menacing-looking (but polite) city guards. E. 市政厅：特里内利市长意识到，随着人口增长，萨林加洛很快就会需要更庞大的行政体系，因此在数年前买下了这座位于三角形十字路口广场旁的宅邸。旧市政厅则交给城卫队作为第二处办公地点使用。与以往一样，这栋建筑包含市长的住所与办公室，也存放着萨林加洛的城镇档案。新增设施包括一间大型登记处，用于追踪从人口普查到地契等各类文书；另设有一处制图部门，专门负责测绘萨林加洛乡间地区。目前一间法院正在布置中，但法官尚未正式雇用或任命。

特里内利的前秘书卢皮娅·马里埃蒂（好奇的女性人类历史学家3级）已被擢升为城市史官。她的研究发掘出不少关于伊斯嘉建国前萨林加洛地区的奇特记录，但在如此政治动荡的时期，卢皮娅对于这些信息是否该公开仍心存顾虑。

F. 厄拉斯提神殿：这座供奉“老死眼”之神的神殿，很可能是萨林加洛最古老的建筑，仅次于半废弃的萨里尼庄园。尽管数百年来历经多次扩建与翻修，这栋建筑依旧以服务公众为宗旨。神殿在健康、营养与庇护方面的贡献，是萨林加洛大多数人将厄拉斯提视为守护神的主要原因。受此影响，其他信仰——尤其是在切利亚斯颇受欢迎的那些——要在这座城市立足就变得相当困难。

伊尔德里斯·鲁瓦拉（善良的男性人类厄拉斯提牧师6级）担任神殿主祭近20年。近期政治局势的发展使他刻意与任何一方保持距离，表示自己希望专注于确保城市的粮食安全与农业需求。尽管如此，神殿的人员或伊尔德里斯从未拒绝为任何人提供治疗或援助——即便是公开表明自身隶属的“破狱者”也不例外。

G. 破狱者总部：这栋两层住宅若无向导便很难找到。破狱者在帮助原房主瓦扎罗一家于别处重启生活后，以略低的价格取得了这处房产。名义上，房产登记在罗克拉格（老练的男性大地精战士3级）名下，但菲比与阿尔切奥则以“房客”身份为人所知。三人定期为房屋祝圣，这让他们深受邻里喜爱；每当约迪斯队长在附近出现时，邻居们也会心照不宣地保持沉默。

H. 萨林加洛杂货铺：这家城市合作社为旅人提供通用的冒险道具以及基础武器与护甲。店里也偶尔出售银制与冷铁武器，但长期以来供不应求。去年，这里增设了一座鸟舍，开始提供信鸽快递服务，往返于伊斯嘉境内外的主要聚居地。阿卜迪尔·内斯休（谨慎的男性人类文书3级）直接从洛加斯的合作鸟舍聘来，既负责照看鸟群，也担任代笔写信人。破狱者很希望能让阿卜迪尔成为盟友，但从梅尔的试探来看，这名年轻人对阴谋与诡计抱有强烈厌恶。

I. 萨林加洛果园：这片苹果园在“恶魔胆汁事件”之后不幸遭受了反复的虫害侵扰。土地最终捐赠给厄拉斯提神殿，并被祝圣了数年，以终结害虫问题。首次成功收成后，一项新的合作社事业随之兴起。如今，“绞刑架苹果”的果酱与苹果干片已成为萨林加洛广受欢迎的伴手礼，可在杂货铺与数个码头摊位购买。神殿计划将这笔资金最终用于兴建学校——但这是否能阻止年轻人逃避家务、翘课或抛下学徒工作跑去果园闲逛，就有待观察了。

J. 女巫终点酒馆：这间由阿莉西·克鲁普廷（强硬的女性人类酒馆老板4级）经营的酒馆，在较为保守的萨林加洛居民中尤其受欢迎；因为在“恶魔胆汁事件”之后，它实施了严格的“除神术外禁止魔法”政策。整间酒馆都笼罩在强力的魔法压制力场之下，以至于连只是路过的人也引发了不少麻烦。阿莉西究竟雇了谁或用了什么手段，她拒绝说明，只表示这总比让某些东西在她的地盘上发生要安全。

K. 可靠的德鲁马迪：过去这里只是一家补鞋铺，如今的“可靠的德鲁马迪”已发展成一家正规的男装店与精品店。德鲁马迪·拉泰尔纳（有野心的女性人类鞋匠4级）在过去十年里凭借良好口碑与敏锐的时尚眼光扩张了生意，她捕捉潮流的速度甚至比埃利迪尔还快。尽管不是正式成员，德鲁马迪过去多次协助破狱者进行乔装。就连她的员工也对她的活动所知甚少，因为她常在店铺营业时间之外处理这些事。作为萨林加洛杂货铺与萨林加洛果园背后的股东之一，德鲁马迪在城市经济圈中颇具影响力。

E. City Hall: Realizing that Saringallow would 
require a larger administration soon with its growing 
population, Mayor Trinelli bought this mansion by 
the triangular Crossroad Plaza several years ago. The 
old town hall was given to the city guard to use as a 
second office. Much like before, the building contains 
the mayor’s residence, office, and also Saringallow’s 
town records. New additions include a large registry 
office that keeps track of paperwork, from census to 
deeds, as well as a cartography department dedicated 
to surveying rural Saringallow. A courthouse is 
currently being furnished, though a judge has yet to be 
officially hired or appointed.
Trinelli’s former secretary, Lupia Marietti (curious 
female human historian 3), has been promoted to City 
Historian. While her research has uncovered curious 
records about the Saringallow region before Isger 
was founded, Lupia has reservations on whether the 
information should go public during such politically 
turbulent times.
F. Temple of Erastil: This temple to Old Deadeye is 
likely the oldest structure in Saringallow, second only to 
the half-derelict Sarini Manor. While it has undergone 
many expansions and renovations over the centuries, 
the building remains dedicated to serving the public. The 
temple’s contribution in health, nutrition, and shelter 
is the predominant reason why most in Saringallow 
consider Erastil to be their patron god. Other faiths, 
especially those popular in Cheliax, have found it rather 
difficult to establish a foothold in the city as a result.
Ildris Ruvarra (kind male human cleric of Erastil 
6) has served as the head priest to the temple for 
nearly 20 years. With recent political developments, 
he’s distanced himself from associating with any side, 
stating he wishes to focus on ensuring the city’s food 
security and agricultural needs. That said, no one—
even Hellbreakers who disclose their affiliation—
has ever been refused treatment or assistance by the 
temple’s staff or Ildris.
G. Hellbreakers’ Headquarters: This two-story 
residence is difficult to locate unless one has a 
guide. The Hellbreakers obtained the property at 
a slight discount after helping the original owners, 
the Vazarros, restart their life elsewhere. On paper, 
the property is under Rhokrag’s (hardened male 
hobgoblin warrior 3) name, though Phoebe and Alceo 
are known “tenants.” The three regularly consecrating 
the house has endeared them to their neighbors, who 
respectfully keep quiet whenever Captain Jordis is in 
the neighborhood.
H. Saringallow’s Sundries: The city’s co-op venture 
supplies travelers with general adventuring gear and 
basic weapons and armor. The store also occasionally 
sells silver and cold iron weapons, though the demand 
has long exceeded the supply. Last year, an aviary 
was added to start a courier pigeon service to major 
settlements in and out of Isger. Abdil Nestthew (discreet 
male human scribe 3), hired directly from the partner 
aviary in Logas, acts as both caretaker to the birds and 
letter-writer-in-proxy. While the Hellbreakers would 
love to have Abdil as an ally, Maire’s probing so far 
suggests the young man has an intense dislike for 
conspiracy and intrigue.
I. Saringallow Orchard: This apple orchard 
unfortunately suffered from repeated infestations 
after the demon bile incident. The land was ultimately 
donated to the Temple of Erastil and consecrated 
for years to end the vermin problem. After its first 
successful harvest, a new co-op venture took off.
Today, gallow apple preserves and dried slices have 
become popular gifts to buy in Saringallow, available at 
the sundries store and several dockside stalls. The temple 
intends for the funds to ultimately go toward building 
a school, though whether that will prevent the youths 
from skipping their chores, classes, or apprenticeship to 
hang out in the orchard remains to be seen.
J. Witch’s End Tavern: This tavern managed by 
Alicie Kruptin (tough female human tavern keeper 4) is 
especially popular with more conservative Saringallow 
residents, as it implemented a heavy “no magic unless 
of divinity” policy after the demon bile incident. The 
entire tavern is under a strong magic suppression field, 
which has caused a number of issues to even those who 
might have simply passed by. Exactly who or what 
Alicie has employed, she refuses to say, other than it’s 
safer than whatever is being prevented on her premise.
K. Dependable Drummady’s: Once a simple 
cobbler shop, Dependable Drummady’s is a full-on 
haberdashery and boutique these days. Drummady 
Laterna (ambitious female human cobbler 4) 
expanded her business over the past decade with 
good word-of-mouth and a sharp eye for fashion that 
picks up trends faster than Elidir. Though not a full-
on member, Drummady has helped the Hellbreakers 
with disguises many times in the past. Even her 
staff knows little of her activities since she often 
conducts them outside of shop hours. As one of the 
stockholders behind Saringallow’s Sundries and the 
Saringallow Orchard, Drummady holds quite a bit of 
influence in the city’s economic circles.
L. The Lucky Anvil: Ludoff Smeltbristle (boisterous 
male dwarf blacksmith 5) first visited Saringallow as 
a tinkerer for his family’s caravan from the Five Kings 
Mountains about a decade ago. He immediately fell 
in love with Saringallow’s surroundings, both nature 
and urban. After moving to the city proper, he slowly

……已确立自己作为一名可靠的铁匠的名声。卢多夫内心是个叛逆者，他暗中支持“破狱者”，并在闲暇时间为他们打造物品。

M. 马什诺姆的佣兵与砂浆：当“石嚼者”地精类部族最初迁入萨林加洛时，他们很难找到愿意为氏族提供住处的人。最终，地精与大地精们决定：既然没人愿意出租，那他们就自己建房子。在马什诺姆（沉默的女性地精工会领袖 5）领导下，萨林加洛诞生了一个充满活力的地精类社群。虽然那条非正式的“咔嗒石路”上有许多满足日常需求的常规商铺（其商品尤其深受地精类喜爱），但它最出名的还是建筑公司、技艺精湛的石匠，以及佣兵行会。

N. 格蒂的厚实面包：这家面包坊宣称自己卖的是“这条河这边最他妈厚实的面包”，招牌下方还额外挂着一块牌子写着：“现有点心与派！”面包坊老板格蒂·凯罗娜（严厉的男性人类面包师 4）如今花在与顾客闲聊上的时间，比守在烤炉旁还多。他在地精血战中留下的旧腿伤所带来的慢性疼痛，使他无法久站。所幸，他过去的学徒诺艾米·陶拉里奥（容易作呕的女性人类面包师 3）已经成长为独当一面的面包师。泽拉·蓝瓶（和善的无性别半身人面包师 2）也非常好共事。这个半身人喜欢在一天结束时把剩余的面包带回去给“破狱者”。

O. 商人广场：商人广场会在一天中不同的时段定期举行各类货物与商品的拍卖。白天的拍卖喧闹嘈杂；夜间的拍卖则令人愉悦地安静，好让附近居民得以休息。安排拍卖日程的佩特雷洛·平德利昂（贪婪的男性人类毛皮商 6）因愿意调换时间段而颇有名气——只要他的抽成比例提高一两个百分点，他就会把某位卖家的日程变更“忘了”通知。佩特雷洛也一直在进行政治运作，承诺将通过自己的子女，为萨林加洛提供减税并与伊斯嘉之外的城市建立贸易协议。尽管众所周知，他的儿子在杜鲁玛、女儿在切利亚斯，但对大多数人来说，佩特雷洛的参选仍只是猜测。

P. 刺荨麻的药水与药膏：玛加拉·刺荨麻（简短生硬的女性侏儒炼金术师 4）近来常因定制疗剂的订单而忙得不可开交。她不愿收学徒，而坚持改雇佣契约工，尤其是那些正努力在这座城市立足的人。作为来自乌莫克的移民，她再清楚不过融入萨林加洛的艰难——即便近些年这道门槛已大幅降低。

Q. 女王的奇珍异宝：作为最早专门从事魔法物品收购与售卖的商店之一，许多访客在踏过前门那道串珠门帘时都显得格外紧张。为了让体验更有趣而不那么焦虑，店主卢库斯·梅尔基安（坚毅的男性侏儒哈罗占卜师 4）会扮演一位名叫“亚伽妈妈”的慈母型算命师。除了为当季推荐最合适的幸运符，亚伽妈妈还总会提起：她那套关于一切魔法之事的庞大私人藏书，对所有“心地端正”的人开放阅览。

R. 魔鬼的终曲：这家店曾名为“双周旅店”，如今是深夜用餐的热门去处。莫文纳尔·阿尔布辛（迷信的男性人类旅店老板 3）在几年前买下此处，并用自己的积蓄翻新了这间历史悠久的旅店。作为阿莉西的学徒，莫文纳尔的菜肴以美味闻名。然而，在这位店主看来，他的食物只是额外加值，真正的看点是：萨林加洛新入驻的乐队“绿洲雨阵”（直言不讳的男性阿纳迪、男性人类、女性豺狼人、女性精灵与无性别艾尤瓦林人类吟游诗人 3）。绿洲雨阵由五名玛嘎安比亚毕业生组成——每个学系各一名——他们不仅影响着萨林加洛的文化风貌；他们对魔法的理解，以及愿意向人讲解魔法的态度，也是萨林加洛近些年对魔法明显缓和的重要原因之一。当然，还有那起著名的“把切利亚斯忠党唱出城”事件。

S. 灯塔蜡烛工坊：在“破狱者”买下这座废弃仓库后，他们发现这里作为总部并不像他们希望的那样不起眼。格拉姆（神秘的女性人类蜡烛匠 4）——最早加入的“破狱者”新兵之一——建议他们无论如何都留着它，作为诱饵。最终就有了灯塔蜡烛工坊，其雕刻蜡烛帮助为“破狱者”筹集资金。格拉姆甚至设计出一种方式：通过蜡烛的颜色，以及雕刻出的纹样与形状来传递秘密信息。

T. 科内里卡码头：尽管如今停靠在萨林加洛的船只比以往任何时候都多，巴特尔·舵港（多疑的男性人类码头管理员 4）仍会对所有经手货物的清单进行细致记录。他始终担心走私者会毁掉这座城市的名声。即便如此，巴特尔还是给过“破狱者”好几次改过自新的机会，有时甚至会指出该组织应当如何改进其掩人耳目的手段。
