established himself as a reliable smith. A rebel at heart, 
Ludoff secretly supports the Hellbreakers and crafts 
items for them in his spare time.
M. 
Mashnom’s 
Mercs 
and 
Mortar: 
When 
the Stonechewer goblinoid tribe first moved to 
Saringallow, they had a difficult time finding those 
willing to provide housing to the clan. Ultimately, the 
goblins and hobgoblins decided that, if people won’t 
lease, then they’ll just build their own homes. Under 
the leadership of Mashnom (mute female goblin union 
leader 5), a vibrant goblinoid community was born in 
Saringallow. While the unofficial “Chitterstone Road” 
has many regular businesses that cater to daily needs 
(with products especially beloved by goblinoids), it’s 
most famous for its construction companies, excellent 
masons, and mercenary associations.
N. Gerty’s Hearty Breads: Claiming “the heartiest 
damn breads this side o’ the river,” this bakery’s 
signage has an additional piece hanging underneath 
that reads, “Now with Pastries and Pies!” The bakery’s 
owner, Gerty Keronna (stern male human baker 4), 
spends more time chatting with customers nowadays 
than at the oven. The chronic pain from his old leg 
injury from the Goblinblood Wars prevents him from 
standing for long. Fortunately, his past apprentice 
Noemi Tauralio (squeamish female human baker 3) 
has become a baker in her own right. Xerra Bluebottle 
(kind genderfluid halfling baker 2) is a joy to work 
with too. The halfling likes to take home leftover 
bread for the Hellbreakers at the end of the day.
O. Merchant’s Square: The Merchant’s Square 
regularly holds auctions for various goods and wares 
at different hours of the day. Those in the day are a 
cacophony, while those at night are pleasantly quiet so 
the nearby residents can rest. Petrello Pindlion (greedy 
male human fur trader 6), who schedules the auctions, 
is pretty well known for being willing to move time 
slots around and “forget” to inform a seller of a 
schedule change if his commission rates are upped by a 
percent or two. Petrello has also been making political 
endeavors, promising to provide tax cuts and establish 
trade deals with cities outside of Isger through his 
children. While it’s known his son and daughter are in 
Druma and Cheliax respectively, Petrello’s campaign 
remains speculative for most.
P. Pricknettle’s Potions and Poultices: Majara 
Pricknettle (curt female gnome alchemist 4) is 
often overworked these days with custom orders 
for remedies. Rather than take on an apprentice, 
Majara insists on hiring contract workers instead, 
especially those who are working hard to establish 
themselves in the city. As an immigrant from Umok, 
she knows all too well the struggles of integrating 
into Saringallow, even if that barrier has lowered 
considerably in recent times.
Q. Queenly Quriosities: As one of the first shops 
dedicated to the purchase and sale of magic items, 
many visitors are decidedly nervous to step beyond 
the beaded curtains of the front door. To make the 
experience more entertaining than anxious, the store’s 
proprietor, Lukus Melchian (resolute male gnome 
harrower 4), adopts the persona of a motherly fortune-
teller by the name of “Mama Yaga.” In addition to 
suggesting the best lucky charms for the season, Mama 
Yaga always mentions that her extensive private 
collection of books on all things magical is available 
to peruse for any whose heart is in the right place.
R. The Fiend’s Finale: Once known as the Fortnight 
Inn, this establishment is a popular spot to dine late 
into the night. Morvinarr Albusin (superstitious male 
human innkeeper 3) bought the place a couple of 
years ago and refurbished the historic inn with his 
savings. As Alicie’s apprentice, Morvinarr’s dishes are 
famously delicious. The innkeeper, however, considers 
his food a bonus to the real attraction: Saringallow’s 
new resident band, Oasis Rain Showers (outspoken 
male anadi, male human, female knoll, female elf, and 
agender aiuvarin human bards 3).
Made up of five Magaambya graduates—one 
of each branch—Oasis Rain Showers haven’t only 
been influencing Saringallow’s cultural scene, their 
understanding and willingness to explain magic is 
one of the reasons why Saringallow has softened its 
attitude toward magic considerably in recent years. 
That and the famous “sing a Chelaxian loyalist out of 
town” incident, of course.
S. Beacon Candles Workshop: After the Hellbreakers 
bought this abandoned warehouse, they discovered 
it wasn’t as inconspicuous as they’d hoped for a 
headquarters. Gram (mysterious female human 
chandler 4), one of the oldest Hellbreaker recruits, 
suggested that they keep it anyway as a decoy. The 
result is the Beacon Candles Workshop, whose carved 
candles help fund the Hellbreakers. Gram even worked 
out a way to pass secret messages by the colors of the 
candles she makes as well as their carved patterns and 
shapes.
T. Conerica Docks: Though more boats are 
docking in Saringallow these days than ever before, 
Bartle Rudderport (skeptical male human wharfinger 
4) keeps meticulous track of all inventory passing 
through. He’s ever concerned of smugglers ruining 
the reputation of the city. Despite this, Bartle has 
given the Hellbreakers several second chances and 
sometimes even points out how the organization 
could improve their subterfuge.

Rather than take on an apprentice, Majara insists on hiring contract workers instead, especially those who are working hard to establish themselves in the city. As an immigrant from Umok, she knows all too well the struggles of integrating into Saringallow, even if that barrier has lowered considerably in recent times.

Q. Queenly Quriosities: As one of the first shops dedicated to the purchase and sale of magic items, many visitors are decidedly nervous to step beyond the beaded curtains of the front door. To make the experience more entertaining than anxious, the store’s proprietor, Lukus Melchian (resolute male gnome harrower 4), adopts the persona of a motherly fortune-teller by the name of “Mama Yaga.” In addition to suggesting the best lucky charms for the season, Mama Yaga always mentions that her extensive private collection of books on all things magical is available to peruse for any whose heart is in the right place.

Conerica Docks: Though more boats are docking in Saringallow these days than ever before, Bartle Rudderport (skeptical male human wharfinger 4) keeps meticulous track of all inventory passing through. He’s ever concerned of smugglers ruining the reputation of the city. Despite this, Bartle has given the Hellbreakers several second chances and sometimes even points out how the organization could improve their subterfuge.

萎缩炸弹（Atrophy Bomb） 物品 1+
罕见 炼金 炸弹 消耗品 溅射 虚体

启动：◆ 打击
萎缩炸弹内含由乌加索亚信徒的炼金术师研发的强效化学物质，能削弱活体生物的力量并汲取其能量。一名主要的活体目标若因萎缩炸弹而受到伤害，便会陷入虚弱状态，直到你下一回合开始。许多类型的炸弹会对攻击检定获得物品加值。

类型：次等；等级 1；价格 4 gp
炸弹造成1d4持续虚体伤害与1点虚体溅射伤害，且目标在你下一回合开始前陷入虚弱1。

类型：中等；等级 3；价格 11 gp
你对攻击检定获得+1物品加值。炸弹造成2d4持续虚体伤害与2点虚体溅射伤害，且目标在你下一回合开始前陷入虚弱1。

类型：强效；等级 11；价格 255 gp

类型：极效；等级 17；价格 2,550 gp
你对攻击检定获得+3物品加值。炸弹造成4d4持续虚体伤害与4点虚体溅射伤害，且目标在你下一回合开始前陷入虚弱2。

博特尔德的心头好（Bortled Favorite） 物品 2+

使用：持握于2只手；负载 L
启动：◆（操作）
这道根茎蔬菜粥是来自伊斯嘉埃特兰之愚的特色美食，以矮人商人博特·巴吉斯之名命名。当你吃下这碗粥时，你在探索期间可以额外疾行10分钟。该效果持续24小时，或直到你进行下一次每日准备（以先发生者为准）。

类型：次等；等级 2；价格 5 gp

类型：中等；等级 5；价格 25 gp

价格 3 gp

启动：◆（操作）
这包嗅盐的气味极其刺鼻，足以让任何生物从恐慌状态中惊醒。当你对自己或触及范围内的一名生物使用时，该目标的惊惧状态值降低1，并在1小时内对任何宁神嗅盐暂时免疫。

启动：◆ 打击
银屑炸弹是一团紧密的银质碎片簇，撞击后会爆炸，将附近的一切撕碎。该炸弹会对攻击检定给予物品加值，并依其类型造成穿刺伤害与穿刺溅射伤害。炸弹造成的所有伤害在计算弱点、抗性等时都视为银。

这份由伊斯嘉各地常见的药草与干浆果制成的敷剂，是由对抗切利亚斯恶魔入侵者、以及在世界之伤与恶魔作战的人们所发明。你可以将翠绿敷剂用于一名正因邪魔而承受持续伤害的生物；以导致该持续伤害的效果之DC为目标、带有+1物品加值进行一次自然检定。成功时，该持续伤害结束。

ITEM 6
RARE
ALCHEMICAL
CONSUMABLE
Price 50 gp
Usage held in 1 hand; Bulk —
Activate [three-actions] (manipulate) 
Silver filings to ward off fiends, cold iron filings to repulse 
demons and fey, and powders made from garlic, peppers, 
and wort to repel undead creatures are combined into this 
gritty paste. A container of warding paste contains enough 
to cover one suit of armor or set of clothes. For the next 
hour, creatures with the unholy trait take a –1 circumstance 
penalty to melee attacks against the affected outfit’s wearer.

MAGICAL
TALISMAN

situations, a greased axle is a quick way out. You attempt a 
check to Escape, with a +1 item bonus to your check. If you 
critically fail, you get a failure instead.

CONSUMABLE
MAGICAL

UNCOMMON
CONSUMABLE
EXPANDABLE
MAGICAL
Price 6 gp
Usage held in 1 hand; Bulk —
Activate [one-action] (manipulate)
When activated, this miniature transforms into a seemingly 
mundane sparrow. The sparrow flies to a destination of 
your choice within 200 feet that you can see, then Seeks 
in a 30-foot burst using your Perception modifier before

RESTFUL SALVE	
ITEM 5
UNCOMMON
CONSUMABLE
MAGICAL
OIL
Price 30 gp
Usage held in 2 hands; Bulk L
Activate [one-action] (manipulate)
A restful salve is a compound that can be applied to the skin 
to prevent undeath. If applied to a fresh corpse, the corpse 
doesn’t decay, nor can it be transformed into an undead or 
otherwise controlled until the sun rises the next morning. If 
applied to a living creature, this salve lasts for only 1 hour due 
to the body’s natural excretions. For that duration, the salve 
wards off effects that would cause undeath upon dying.
SMUGGLER’S PADLOCK	
ITEM 3
UNCOMMON
CONSUMABLE
EXTRADIMENSIONAL
MAGICAL
Price 50 gp
Usage held in 2 hands (see text); Bulk L
Activate 1 minute (manipulate)
This padlock exists in a dormant state while it’s closed and 
its associated key is in the keyhole. To activate this item, 
you remove the key, which causes the keyhole to become 
a portal to an extradimensional space. This space can hold 
a single object of up to 1 Bulk by pressing it against the 
keyhole. At any point within the next 24 hours, the key 
can be used to open the lock with an Interact action, which 
safely releases the item onto the ground in your space. 
If the lock isn’t opened within the next 24 hours, the key 
disintegrates, and from then on, a creature who succeeds at 
a DC 16 Thievery check can Pick the Lock open to release 
the item. On a critical failure, the padlock is destroyed and 
its contents are lost forever.

地狱残壳斗篷（HELLHUSK SHROUD） 物品6
【非普通】【已投资】【魔法】
价格 230 gp
使用方式 穿戴斗篷；负载 —
这件带兜帽的斗篷在那些必须躲避或监视魔族当局的人之中很受欢迎。此衣物背后的可怖秘密与其无害外表并不相称；其织物中包含以诸多魔鬼的毛发、鲜血与鳞片织成的线。当你对其进行投资后，除非用于侦测魔法或类似法术的法术为 4 环或更高，否则地狱残壳斗篷看起来不会散发魔法灵光。只要你穿着这件斗篷，你便能阅读并说出炼狱语。
启动—有角残壳 ◆（幻觉、操作、嗅觉、视觉）频率 每日一次；效果 斗篷裹住你，化作第二层皮肤，让地狱的腐蚀性硫磺气息渗入你的躯体。你的外表变为一名不起眼的低阶魔鬼；当你为了维持伪装而说谎时，你的欺瞒检定获得 +1 状态加值。对于具有嗅觉的生物而言，你闻起来也像个魔鬼。
启动—地狱感官 ◆（专注、操作）频率 每日一次；效果 你拉起兜帽，让堕落魔鬼的残余紧贴并低语地狱的秘密。你获得魔族感知作为 60 尺内的模糊感官，使你能以朦胧感官感知具有魔族特征的生物。该效果持续 10 分钟，或直到你再次进行该动作。

懒骨坠饰（LAZYBONES PENDANT） 物品5
【非普通】【已投资】【魔法】
价格 130 gp
使用方式 穿戴；负载 —
懒骨坠饰是一枚六面骰吊坠，由“干活太拼的瓦帕”（Work-Too-Hard Whappa）的悔恨之骨雕刻而成——这名地精生前异常勤勉，据说在来世正为了早该补上的休息而弥补过度劳作。六面骰的五个面刻着瓦帕从事各种懒散恶作剧的图样，而剩下的一面则一片空白；显然，他沉迷于怠惰之中，以至于连他的形象都忘了出现在骰子的那一面。
当你佩戴并投资这枚坠饰时，你在“跟随专家”时进行的检定获得 +1 物品加值。
启动—难道不能让别人来做吗？◆◆◆（专注、操作、异能）频率 每日一次；效果 你施放 phantasmal minion，召唤一个短暂存在的你的版本。当你启动坠饰以及你每次维持该法术时，你的幻象仆从获得一个反应动作（），且仅能用于援助一名盟友。它在进行任何技能检定时使用你的技能，且不能援助攻击。

HELLHUSK SHROUD	
ITEM 6
UNCOMMON
INVESTED
MAGICAL
Price 230 gp
Usage worn cloak; Bulk — 
This hooded cloak is popular among those who must evade 
or surveil fiendish authorities. The grisly secrets behind 
this garment belies its innocuous appearance; its 
fabrics include threads woven from the hair, 
blood, and scales of various devils. When 
invested, a hellhusk shroud doesn’t appear to 
radiate a magic aura to detect magic or similar 
spells unless the spells are 4th rank or higher. 
As long as you’re wearing the cloak, you can 
read and speak Diabolic.
Activate—Horned 
Husk 
[one-action] 
(illusion, 
manipulate, olfactory, visual) Frequency once 
per day; Effect The cloak wraps around you, 
becoming a second skin that suffuses you with 
Hell’s corrosive brimstone. Your appearance 
becomes that of a nondescript low-level 
devil, and you gain a +1 status bonus to your 
Deception checks when you Lie to maintain 
your disguise. To creatures with scent, you 
also smell like a devil.
Activate—Hellish Senses [one-action] (concentrate, manipulate) 
Frequency once per day; Effect You pull your hood up, 
allowing the remnants of fallen devils to nestle closely 
and whisper Hell’s secrets. You gain fiendsense as an 
imprecise sense within 60 feet, allowing you to sense 
creatures with the fiend trait as a vague sense. This 
effect lasts for 10 minutes or until you take this action 
again.
LAZYBONES PENDANT	
ITEM 5
UNCOMMON
INVESTED
MAGICAL
Price 130 gp
Usage worn; Bulk —
A lazybones pendant is a six-sided die pendant carved from 
the regretful bones of Work-Too-Hard Whappa, a goblin 
unusually industrious in life and said to be making up for a 
long-overdue rest in his afterlife. Depicted on the five sides 
of this six-sided die are representations of Whappa engaged 
in various acts of slothful mischief, while the remaining 
side is utterly blank; apparently, he’s so engrossed in his 
indolence that even his image has forgotten to show up on 
that side of the die.
When you wear and invest in this pendant, you gain a +1 
item bonus to checks when you Follow the Expert.
Activate—Can’t Someone Else Do It? [three-actions] (concentrate, 
manipulate, occult) Frequency once per day; Effect 
You cast phantasmal minion, summoning an ephemeral 
version of yourself. When you Activate the pendant and 
each time you Sustain the spell, your phantasmal minion 
gains a reaction that can be used only to Aid an ally. 
It uses your skills for any skill checks and can’t Aid an 
attack.

公平评估戒指（Ring of Fair Assessment） 物品7
【非普通】【已投资】【魔法】
价格 350 gp
用法 穿戴；负载 —
当杜鲁玛的卡利斯特拉德贵族一边向破狱者与地狱骑士双方兜售武器以牟利时，他们也提供适用于情报与反情报工作的选择。这枚白金戒指使你在进行主要为数字或数学性质的【破译文字】技能检定时获得+1物品加值；此外，你在进行【交涉】与【威吓】的技能检定以【留下印象】与【胁迫】他人、令对方相信你的判断公平或准确时，也获得+1物品加值。
启动—公平评估 [two-动作]（专注，操作，精神）
频率 每小时1次；效果 卡利斯拉德预言向你揭示财富的秘密；其呈现为一份仅你可见的数字资产负债表。选择30尺内、至多1立方尺的区域；你可以估算该区域内任何物品以金币计的价值。若你试图估算某个生物穿戴或持握的物品价值，你必须以其意志DC为DC，进行一次【社交】检定以【破译文字】。

厄瑞倪厄斯长袍（Robe of the Erinys） 物品3+
【非普通】【已投资】【魔法】
用法 穿戴衣物；负载 L
这件精美的猩红长袍以金线绣出魔裔与其武器的图样，其样式仿照隐修的“金色厄瑞倪厄斯姐妹会”所着装束。长袍的腰带绣成蛇形，并配有金属獠牙。
启动—噬咬腰带 [two-动作]（专注，操作）
频率 每日1次；效果 你取下长袍的腰带，并在你触及内朝一名敌人猛甩。腰带随即短暂活化并咬向该敌人，造成2d8毒素伤害，目标必须进行一次DC 18的基础强韧豁免。大失败时，目标还会陷入恶心1。
类别 厄瑞倪厄斯长袍；等级 3；价格 55 gp
类别 强效厄瑞倪厄斯长袍；等级 8；价格 475 gp
蛇造成4d8毒素伤害，DC为24。
类别 极效厄瑞倪厄斯长袍；等级 13；价格 2,750 gp
蛇造成6d8毒素伤害，DC为31。

断镣者（Shacklebreaker） 物品4
【非普通】【已投资】【魔法】
用法 穿戴；负载 L
这只手环带有三个护符，分别描绘匕首、盾牌与玫瑰。佩戴此手环期间，你的【盗窃】检定获得+1物品加值。每当你掷出成功以将某人从镣铐中解救出来时，该成功视为两次成功（大成功则视为三次成功）。
启动—无镣铐 [reaction]（操作）
频率 每日1次；触发 某个生物尝试擒抱你；需求 你察觉该生物，且未处于措手不及；效果 手环将你的身体猛地扯向一侧，试图摆脱攻击者的抓握。你对抗该次触发的擒抱时，你的强韧DC获得+1环境加值。
类别 断镣者；等级 4；价格 100 gp
类别 强效断镣者；等级 10；价格 950 gp
物品加值为+2，且你的强韧DC所获得的环境加值为+2。

盐与土护符（Token of Salt and Earth） 物品6
【稀有】【已投资】【魔法】
价格 225 gp
用法 穿戴；负载 —
此护符通常佩戴在颈间或悬挂于腰带上。它由三段式沙漏组成，三个独立的玻璃泡内分别装有海盐、木炭灰与细微的银屑。它使佩戴者在对具有邪秽（特征）的生物进行【躲藏】与【潜行】时的【隐匿】检定获得+1物品加值。
启动—躲避可憎者 [two-动作]（幻术，操作，契灵，隐秘）
频率 每日1次；效果 你沿着护符同心环之一旋转它，使你在1分钟内对具有魔裔、精类或不死（特征）的生物（由你选择其一）隐形。若你使用敌对动作，则在该动作完成后你将不再隐形。

耳语导线（Whispering Wire） 物品3+
【非普通】【魔法】
用法 单手持用；负载 —
这段卷曲的亮色金属导线可以被整齐地扭折成任何形状。
启动—随风之语 [one-action]（专注）
频率 每10分钟1次；效果 你对着导线轻声吐出言语，它会以【传讯】戏法的效果将这些话传至一个目标。
类别 耳语导线；等级 2；价格 30 gp
类别 强效耳语导线；等级 5；价格 125 gp
该导线复制3环【传讯】的效果。

RING OF FAIR ASSESSMENT	
ITEM 7
UNCOMMON
INVESTED
MAGICAL
Price 350 gp
Usage worn; Bulk —
While the Kalistocrats of Druma profiteer off 
selling weapons to both Hellbreakers and 
Hellknights, they also offer options suitable for 
intelligence and counterintelligence efforts. 
This white gold ring grants you a +1 item 
bonus to skill checks to Decipher Writing 
that’s primarily numerical or mathematical in 
nature as well as to skill checks to Make an 
Impression and Coerce to convince others of the 
fairness or accuracy of your judgments.
Activate—Fair Assessment [two-actions] (concentrate, 
manipulate, mental) Frequency once 
per hour; Effect The Prophecies of 
Kalistrade reveal the secrets of wealth 
to you; this appears as a balance sheet 
of numbers only you can see. Choose an area of up to 
1 cubic foot within 30 feet; you can estimate the value 
in gold pieces of any items within this area. If you 
attempt to estimate the value of items worn or held 
by a creature, you must succeed at a Society check to 
Decipher Writing against their Will DC.
ROBE OF THE ERINYS	
ITEM 3+
UNCOMMON
INVESTED
MAGICAL
Usage worn garment; Bulk L
This exquisite scarlet robe embroidered with golden depictions 
of fiends and their weapons is fashioned after the garb of 
the cloistered Sisters of the Golden Erinys. The robe’s belt is 
embroidered to look like a snake, complete with metal fangs.
Activate—Biting Belt [two-actions] (concentrate, manipulate) 
Frequency once per day; Effect You remove the robe’s 
belt and snap it at an enemy within your reach. As 
you do, it briefly animates to bite that foe, dealing 2d8 
poison damage with a basic DC 18 Fortitude save. On a 
critical failure, the target is also sickened 1.
Type robe of the erinys; Level 3; Price 55 gp
Type greater robe of the erinys; Level 8; Price 475 gp
The snake deals 4d8 poison damage, and the DC is 24.
Type major robe of the erinys; Level 13; Price 2,750 gp
The snake deals 6d8 poison damage, and the DC is 31.

ITEM 4
UNCOMMON
INVESTED
MAGICAL
Usage worn; Bulk L
This bracelet has three charms depicting a dagger, a shield, 
and a rose. While wearing this bracelet, you gain a +1 item 
bonus to Thievery checks. Whenever you roll a success to 
free someone from manacles, it counts as two successes 
(three on a critical success).
Activate—No Chains [reaction] (manipulate) Frequency once per day; 
Trigger A creature attempts to Grapple you; Requirements 
You are aware of the creature and aren’t off-guard; Effect 
The bracelet yanks your body in one direction, 
attempting to throw off your attacker’s grip. You 
gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude 
DC against the triggering Grapple.
Type shacklebreaker; Level 4; Price 100 gp
Type greater shacklebreaker; Level 10; 
Price 950 gp
The item bonus is +2, and the circumstance 
bonus to your Fortitude DC is +2.

ash, and minute slivers of silver. It grants the wearer a

频率 每日一次；

猩红荆棘（CRIMSON THORN） 物品3
【非普通】【魔法】
价格 60 gp
使用方式 单手持用；负载 1
这把+1阿斯普缠鞭（asp coil；《Pathfinder Lost Omens Hellfire Dispatches》109）为许多受训的「金色厄里倪厄斯修女会」成员所用。其刀身的每个节段都呈深红色，并配以乌黑如墨的剑柄末端。对承受其鞭挞的人而言，死亡并非最糟的结局。

启动—品尝痛苦（Taste the Pain）[自由动作]（操作，视觉）
频率 每小时一次；
触发 你的上一个动作是以猩红荆棘进行一次打击，且对某个生物造成了伤害；
效果 尝试一次威吓检定以挫志你所伤害的该生物；此次掷骰获得+2物品加值。你在此检定中不会因不共享语言而承受任何减值。

碎梦者（DREAMCRUSHER） 物品4
【稀有】【魔法】
价格 80 gp
使用方式 单手持用；负载 1
刑架骑士团（Order of the Rack）使用诸如碎梦者之类的武器，来碾碎那些胆敢阻挡其道路之人。这把+1长剑的剑尖额外加重，使其持用者能将打击更深地“钉”进目标。

启动—毁灭叛徒（Doom the Rebel）[单动作]（专注，精神）
频率 每10分钟一次；
需求 你的上一个动作是以碎梦者进行一次打击，且对某个生物造成了重击；
效果 你重击的该生物必须尝试一次DC 19意志豁免。失败时，其攻击掷骰与技能检定在1轮内承受–1状态减值（大失败则为1分钟）。

破邪盾（FIENDSBANE SHIELD） 物品4
【非普通】【神圣】【魔法】
价格 70 gp
使用方式 单手持用；负载 1
这面低纯度银盾（硬度3、HP 12、BT 6）装有+1盾刺，其上印有一名被斩首的邪魔的形象。任何具有邪秽（特征）且持用此盾的生物将变为力竭2，并且在持用该盾期间无法从此状态中恢复。

启动—银辉反噬（Silvery Backlash）[自由动作]（专注，神圣）
频率 每日一次；
触发 你用「盾牌格挡」格挡了一次来自具有邪秽（特征）的生物的攻击；
效果 破邪盾的硬度提高至10，被斩首恶魔的象征化作银色缎带猛然反击，对你所格挡其攻击的生物造成3d6挥砍伤害（DC 19基础反射豁免）。就弱点、抗性等效果而言，此伤害视为银。

威势盾（IMPOSING SHIELD） 物品6
【非普通】【魔法】
价格 245 gp
使用方式 单手持用；负载 1
地狱骑士的爱物，这面钢盾（硬度6、HP 36、BT 18）常印有某个地狱骑士骑士团的标记，并且往往会刻下其吸收伤害的次数。

启动—恐惧格挡（Terrifying Block）[自由动作]（专注，情绪，恐惧，精神）
频率 每10分钟一次；
触发 你使用「盾牌格挡」；

磁力流星索（MAGNETIC BOLA） 物品3
【非普通】【魔法】
价格 60 gp
使用方式 单手持用；负载 L
这件沉重的金属+1流星索是叛军与煽动者对付装甲对手时最爱用的工具。由于其重量，它的射程增量为15尺。你用此武器成功打击由金属制成或穿着金属护甲的生物时，流星索会吸附在金属上，且目标生物的速度承受–10尺环境减值，直到其花费一个「交互」动作将流星索移除。

启动—过载（Overcharge）[单动作]（电击，操作，金属）
频率 每日一次；
效果 你为流星索的磁性过载充能。你用此武器进行的下一次打击将额外造成1d6电击伤害。命中时，除正常效果外，目标还必须成功通过一次DC 18反射豁免，否则将变为笨拙1，持续1轮（大失败则笨拙2）。若目标穿着金属护甲，其豁免还会承受–2环境减值。

制作需求 初始原材料必须包含一种导电金属。

## Page 215
【坚定的基石】
“神圣基石”仪式最初见于《开拓者协会冒险 #4-02：重返墓地》。该仪式由一位天赋异禀的学院派（Acadamae）法师、后转为法拉丝玛祭司的人——艾利奥斯——所发明。他试图保护位于死坟末土的一处小型难民聚居地“坚定镇”，使其免遭一名堕落的象牙收割者所统御的亡灵大军侵袭。不幸的是，艾利奥斯发现，默语暴君的影响力过于强大，寻常的祝圣仪式无法与之抗衡。

根据艾利奥斯在自己死前留下的指引，开拓者协会成功将坚定镇旧法拉丝玛神殿的一块楔石灌注入法拉丝玛本人所赐的神圣接触，并派出一支开拓者小队将其送往被围困的城镇、救出难民。自那之后，该仪式也被用于保护死坟末土中其他数处难民聚居地，使其不至于被饥渴的亡者所淹没。

【殉道者之盾】物品7
不常见 魔法
价格 360 gp
使用方式 握持于1手；负载 1
这面银色的次级加固钢盾（硬度8、HP 64、BT 32）上刻着两名士兵并肩而立的图像。

启动—自我牺牲 反应动作（）(操控)
频率 每分钟一次；
触发 你20尺内的一名盟友将要受到物理伤害；
需求 殉道者之盾已举起；
效果 你启动该盾时，它会以魔法强行挡在触发的盟友身前，并以“盾牌格挡”的效果替其承受伤害。任何未被盾牌预防的伤害都会转移到你身上。

【四季奇珍】
早在塔尔多征服伊斯嘉之前，凯立德人与早期伊斯嘉人就制造——或许是改造——了强大的魔法器物，用以标记其创制时的季节。其中之一是“初绽”（Firstbloom），一把据称由阿斯菲尔森林的天然本土木材雕成的关刀，却比同类钢制武器更为坚韧。另一件是“丰收盛宴”（Harvest Feast），一把旨在迎来收获与丰饶的长柄镰刀，但据传背负着黑暗的过去与更黑暗的现在。

一件夏之奇珍“富饶之光”（Bounty’s Light），据说是一支魔法火炬，能将一整片田地照得仿佛被阳光亲吻一般；在任何战争点燃怨恨之前，它曾作为赋礼在伊斯嘉人与其地精邻居之间往复交换，以此象征彼此的友谊。最后一件奇珍仅以“灾厄”（Woe）为名；关于其建造与使用的记录连同其可能所在的信息，都早已佚失。关于“灾厄”的更多内容，见“继续战役”（第168页）。

这些奇珍皆为遗珍种子；遗珍的完整规则与所列赋礼的描述（包括何时推进遗珍），见《GM Core》自第308页起。

【富饶之光】物品8
唯一 火焰 魔法 遗珍
面向 火焰
使用方式 1手；负载 L
这支由一束盛夏鲜活花朵组成的魔法火炬，其功能等同于一根高等火焰法杖。其光芒可用一个“交互”动作开关。
次级赋礼：热雾、炽目视界
主要赋礼：喷气推进、灼烈浪潮
宏伟赋礼：炽焰之魂

【生绽】物品6
唯一 魔法 遗珍 木质
面向 生命与植物
使用方式 2手；负载 2
这把+1活化强袭关刀据说是由阿斯菲尔森林深处一棵古老白蜡树的一根枝条雕成。武器刃部的木纹异常紧密，使其既无比耐用，又呈现出仿佛由大师铁匠折叠锻造出的银钢质感。
次级赋礼：药师花园、治疗波

【收割者之叹】物品7
唯一 魔法 遗珍 虚无
面向 死亡
使用方式 2手；负载 2
这把+1致伤强袭长柄镰刀由精工点缀的熏黑金属与抛光表面构成。它原本用于在前塔尔多时代的伊斯嘉，尊崇乌加托娅作为“秋之先驱”的一面；但近来却被赋予了更为恶毒的含义。据说乌加托娅手持此镰，会为盛宴收割庄稼，以此迎来寒冷凄厉的冬季。随着乌加托娅的传说愈发阴暗，这把镰刀的传说也被重新夺回，用于在如今以其命名的节日里尊崇伊拉斯提与法拉丝玛。
次级赋礼：死亡凝视、活尸
主要赋礼：洞穿帷幕、死亡潮汐
宏伟赋礼：阴森鬼影

ITEM 7
UNCOMMON
MAGICAL

This silvery minor reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 
64, and BT 32) bears the image of two soldiers standing 
side-by-side.
Activate—Self Sacrifice [reaction] (manipulate) Frequency once 
per minute; Trigger An ally within 20 feet of you would 
take physical damage; Requirements The martyr’s 
shield is raised; Effect When you activate this shield, it 
magically imposes itself in front of the triggering ally 
and takes the damage for them with the effects of Shield

THE WONDERS OF THE SEASONS
Long before Taldor’s conquest of Isger, the Kellid 
and early Isgeri created or perhaps retooled powerful 
magical artifacts to mark the seasons of their creation. 
One was Firstbloom, a glaive said to be carved of 
natural and native woods from the Arthfell Forest yet 
stronger than any steel weapon of its like. Another was 
Harvest Feast, a scythe meant to usher in harvest and 
bounty yet rumored to be burdened with a dark past 
and darker present. A summer wonder, Bounty’s Light, 
was said to be a magical torch that could light a field as if 
kissed by sunlight and was a gift traded back and forth 
between the Isgeri and their goblin neighbors as a sign 
of mutual friendship long before any wars fomented 
resentment. The final wonder was known only as Woe, 
but records of its construction and use have long since

THE STEADFAST KEYSTONE
The divine keystone ritual first appears in the Pathfinder Society Adventure #4-02: Return to the Grave. This ritual was the invention of a gifted Acadamae wizard turned Pharasmin priest named Elios. He sought to protect Steadfast, a small settlement of refugees in the Gravelands, from oncoming hordes of undead under the control of a fallen Ivory Reaper. Unfortunately, Elios found that the Whispering Tyrant’s influence was too great for a common consecration ritual. With the instructions Elios left before his own demise, the Pathfinder Society successfully imbued a keystone from Steadfast’s old Pharasmin temple with the divine touch of Pharasma herself, sending a team of Pathfinders to bring it to the besieged town and rescue the refugees. Since then, the ritual has been used to protect several other refugee settlements in the Gravelands from becoming overrun by the hungry dead.

MARTYR’S SHIELD ITEM 7
UNCOMMON MAGICAL
Price 360 gp
Usage held in 1 hand; Bulk 1
This silvery minor reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 64, and BT 32) bears the image of two soldiers standing side-by-side.
Activate—Self Sacrifice [reaction] (manipulate)
Frequency once per minute; Trigger An ally within 20 feet of you would take physical damage; Requirements The martyr’s shield is raised; Effect When you activate this shield, it magically imposes itself in front of the triggering ally and takes the damage for them with the effects of Shield Block. Any damage that isn’t prevented by the shield is transferred onto you.

THE WONDERS OF THE SEASONS
Long before Taldor’s conquest of Isger, the Kellid and early Isgeri created or perhaps retooled powerful magical artifacts to mark the seasons of their creation. One was Firstbloom, a glaive said to be carved of natural and native woods from the Arthfell Forest yet stronger than any steel weapon of its like. Another was Harvest Feast, a scythe meant to usher in harvest and bounty yet rumored to be burdened with a dark past and darker present. A summer wonder, Bounty’s Light, was said to be a magical torch that could light a field as if kissed by sunlight and was a gift traded back and forth between the Isgeri and their goblin neighbors as a sign of mutual friendship long before any wars fomented resentment. The final wonder was known only as Woe, but records of its construction and use have long since disappeared along with any information about where it might reside. See Continuing the Campaign (page 168) for more on Woe.

施放 4天；需求 施放区域所处建筑结构中的一块基石作为法器；花费 价值200gp的圣水、银粉与净化粉笔；次要施法者 1

New Animal Companion
This boarhound is a new animal companion local to 
Isger.
Isgeri Boarhound
UNCOMMON
Through training and selective breeding, the gnomes 
of Umok found ways to capitalize on the native Isgeri 
boarhounds’ exceptional scent abilities and sturdy frame 
to patrol against extraplanar predators and other enemies 
regularly found in the region.
Size Small
Melee [one-action] jaws (finesse), Damage 1d8 piercing
Str +2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int –4, Wis +1, Cha +0
Hit Points 6
Skill Survival
Senses foe scent (precise, 40 feet), low-light vision, scent 
(imprecise, 40 feet)
Speed 40 feet
Special As part of daily preparations, the Isgeri boarhound 
can be offered a sample of an enemy with the fiend or 
undead trait, such as a bone, piece of flesh, or similarly 
scented sample that has been acquired within the last 
24 hours. For the next 24 hours, either fiend or undead 
becomes the boarhound’s designated foe. The Isgeri 
boarhound’s foe scent enables it to smell the presence 
of a creature designated as its foe as a precise scent at 
a range of 40 feet.
Support Benefit Your boarhound is a faithful hunting 
companion. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your 
next attack roll to Strike a foe within your boarhound’s 
reach. This bonus lasts until the first time you use 
it or until the beginning of your next turn, whichever 
comes first. If you damage a creature with the trait 
corresponding to your boarhound’s designated foe with 
that Strike, the creature takes an additional 1d6 piercing 
damage from the boarhound. If your boarhound is 
nimble or savage, the damage increases to 2d6.
Advanced Maneuver Lock Jaw
LOCK JAW [one-action]
Requirements The boarhound’s last action was a successful 
jaws Strike. 
The target becomes grabbed, as if the boarhound 
successfully Grappled the target.
New Ritual
The following ritual appears in this adventure.
DIVINE KEYSTONE	
RITUAL 4
RARE
CONSECRATION
HOLY
Cast 4 days; Requirements cornerstone from the structure 
of the casting area used as a locus; Cost holy water, 
powdered silver, and purified chalk worth 200 gp; 
Secondary Casters 1
Primary Check Arcana (master) or Religion (expert); 
Secondary Checks Architecture Lore, Crafting, or 
Engineering Lore
Area 100-foot emanation from the building’s keystone
Duration 1 week
You magically remove and consecrate the cornerstone 
of a building or ruin in the center of a settlement before 
returning the stone to its structure to spread its divine 
protection into the settlement around it. Once the final 
hammer strike returns the stone to its structure, the area 
protected by the sanctified stone becomes a sacred space, 
protecting the living from undead. Within the protected 
area, the consecrated site is holy, undead creatures can’t 
be created or raised, and living creatures are invisible to 
the undead. 
A successful dispel magic used on a specific effect 
removes only that effect (such as the invisibility effect). 
However, destroying or removing the keystone ends the 
entire ritual and all its effects.
Critical Success You create the effects described above, 
and the keystone’s consecration effect doubles its 
radius.
Success You create the effects described above.
Failure The ritual has no effect.
Critical Failure The area becomes a font of power for 
undead for the next month. All undead creatures in the 
ritual’s area gain fast healing 3 and resistance 3 to holy.
Heightened (+1) The emanation protected by the keystone 
increases by 20 feet.

## Page 217
破狱者（变体）

破狱者联盟成立于伊斯嘉，旨在抗议远在切利亚斯的统治者所施加的不公与冷漠。它是个年轻却不断壮大的叛乱组织，决心留下自己的印记。联盟成员宣誓成为反叛的代理人，推翻切利亚斯政权，并将其附庸诸国从压迫统治下解放出来——从伊斯嘉开始。

破狱者联盟也清楚，作为一个仍在发展的团体，却要挑战世界上最强大的国家之一，他们在与切利亚斯的战争中处于极大劣势。破狱者的战术依靠机智与胆识，也仰赖对敌人可能动用的邪魔势力的了解。他们以刀剑、法术与诡计并用，不知疲倦地解放受压迫者，并将暴君赶下权位。

额外专长：4级 战斗评估（《玩家核心》140）、闪电互换（《玩家核心》141）；10级 盲斗（《玩家核心》145）、伐倒重击（《玩家核心》146）

破狱者奉献专长 2
罕见 变体 奉献
许可 你是破狱者联盟的成员。
加入联盟后，你承担起破狱者的责任。你获得“额外学识”通用专长，其适用于“魔鬼学识”和“地狱骑士学识”两项学识（技能）。如果你在其中一项或两项学识（技能）上已受训，你还会在你选择的一项学识（技能）上受训。

当你掷先攻时，你可以以自由动作（）尝试一次“魔鬼学识”、“地狱骑士学识”或“社会”检定，以回忆知识，目标为你能看见的一名敌人，前提是该技能在此适用。GM对这些技能是否适合用于回忆该敌人的知识拥有最终裁决权。

你所知的魔鬼 专长 4
变体 技能
先决条件 破狱者奉献；魔鬼学识或地狱骑士学识为专家
你对敌人的知识使你在对抗他们时占得先机，使你能迅速对其邪术作出反应。若你在一次遭遇开始时就知道自己将与任意魔鬼或地狱骑士作战，你可以用相应的学识（技能）作为你的先攻掷骰。

此外，每当你使用魔鬼学识或地狱骑士学识对某个生物成功回忆知识时，在你下个回合结束前，你对该生物进行的下一次技能检定获得+1环境加值。若你的魔鬼学识或地狱骑士学识为大师，该加值提升为+2。

变体

你为危险同时武装心智与躯体，坚定你的决心。你获得等同于你等级数量的临时生命值，持续1分钟。当你拥有这些临时生命值时，你的意志豁免获得+1状态加值。

Hellbreaker (Archetype)
Founded in Isger to protest against the injustice 
and apathy of their faraway rulers in Cheliax, the 
Hellbreakers League is a young but growing rebel 
organization determined to make its mark. Members 
of the League swear themselves as agents of rebellion 
to topple the Chelaxian regime and free its vassal 
states from its oppressive rule, starting with Isger. 
The Hellbreakers League knows it’s at a heavy 
disadvantage in its war against Cheliax as a still-
developing group challenging one of the world’s most 
powerful nations. Hellbreaker tactics rely on wit and 
daring as well as knowledge of the fiendish forces their 
enemies might use against them. Through sword, spell, 
and subterfuge, they work tirelessly to liberate the 
oppressed and remove tyrants from power.
Additional Feats: 4th Combat Assessment (Player 
Core 140), Lightning Swap (Player Core 141); 10th 
Blind-Fight (Player Core 145), Felling Strike (Player 
Core 146)
HELLBREAKER DEDICATION	
FEAT 2
UNCOMMON
ARCHETYPE
DEDICATION
Access You’re a member of the Hellbreakers league.
By joining the League, you’ve taken on the responsibilities 
of a Hellbreaker. You gain the Additional Lore general feat 
for both Devil Lore and Hellknight Lore. If you were already 
trained in one or both of those Lore skills, you also become 
trained in a Lore skill of your choice.
When you roll initiative, you can attempt a Devil Lore, 
Hellknight Lore, or Society check to Recall Knowledge 
about one enemy you can see as a free action, if that skill 
would be applicable. The GM is the final arbiter of whether 
or not one of those skills would be appropriate to Recall 
Knowledge about the enemy.

Hellbreaker (Archetype)
Founded in Isger to protest against the injustice and apathy of their faraway rulers in Cheliax, the Hellbreakers League is a young but growing rebel organization determined to make its mark. Members of the League swear themselves as agents of rebellion to topple the Chelaxian regime and free its vassal states from its oppressive rule, starting with Isger.
The Hellbreakers League knows it’s at a heavy disadvantage in its war against Cheliax as a still-developing group challenging one of the world’s most powerful nations. Hellbreaker tactics rely on wit and daring as well as knowledge of the fiendish forces their enemies might use against them. Through sword, spell, and subterfuge, they work tirelessly to liberate the oppressed and remove tyrants from power.
Additional Feats: 4th Combat Assessment (Player Core 140), Lightning Swap (Player Core 141); 10th Blind-Fight (Player Core 145), Felling Strike (Player Core 146)

HELLBREAKER DEDICATION FEAT 2
UNCOMMON ARCHETYPE DEDICATION
Access You’re a member of the Hellbreakers league.
By joining the League, you’ve taken on the responsibilities of a Hellbreaker. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for both Devil Lore and Hellknight Lore. If you were already trained in one or both of those Lore skills, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.
When you roll initiative, you can attempt a Devil Lore, Hellknight Lore, or Society check to Recall Knowledge about one enemy you can see as a free action, if that skill would be applicable. The GM is the final arbiter of whether or not one of those skills would be appropriate to Recall Knowledge about the enemy.

触发：一名相邻的盟友对一个生物进行一次近战打击。

你不介意使用卑劣手段来取得优势，在敌人发动攻击时轻易将其击溃。对作为触发攻击目标的生物，进行一次欺瞒检定，对抗该生物的察觉DC。无论结果如何，目标在接下来的10分钟内暂时免疫你使用“见机诡诈者”的尝试。
大成功：目标陷入措手不及（包括对触发攻击）直到你的盟友回合结束。
成功：目标对触发攻击陷入措手不及。

敌人的防御在你面前不堪一击，你猛拧武器以破坏其护甲。该生物的AC承受–2环境减值，持续直到其能花费10分钟修理护甲为止。该生物也可以进行一次交互来调整护甲，使该减值移除1分钟。

地狱破坏者打击 双动作 （神圣）

【地狱破坏者的作息】
地狱破坏者们日夜不停地工作，因为他们知道对手也不会有片刻松懈。训练严苛且频繁，不断考验地狱破坏者的能力，几乎总是将他们逼近精疲力竭的边缘。尽管如此，地狱破坏者据点中的纪律，肯定比他们的切利亚斯对等组织要少些痛苦。

OPPORTUNE TRICKSTER [reaction]	
FEAT 6
ARCHETYPE
MENTAL
Prerequisites Hellbreaker Dedication, trained in Deception
Trigger An adjacent ally makes a melee Strike against a 
creature.
Requirements You’re adjacent to both your ally and the 
creature.
You aren’t above using underhanded tactics to gain an 
advantage, easily routing your opponents when they 
attack. Attempt a Deception check against the Perception 
DC of the creature that’s the target of the triggering attack. 
Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune 
to your attempts to use Opportune Trickster for the next 
10 minutes.
Critical Success The target is off-guard (including against 
the triggering attack) until the end of your ally’s turn.
Success The target is off-guard against the triggering 
attack.
Critical Failure You lose your balance in your attempt to 
assist your ally and fall prone. 
Special If you have the Dirty Trick skill feat (Player Core 
2 229), you can attempt a Thievery check instead of a 
Deception check; if you do, this action loses the mental 
trait.
HELL’S BANE	
FEAT 8
ARCHETYPE
Prerequisites Devil You Know
Your in-depth knowledge of your foes grants you insight 
into their weaknesses, granting you an advantage when 
fighting against them. When you critically succeed at a 
skill check to Recall Knowledge about a devil or Hellknight, 
you gain a +4 status bonus to damage against that creature 
for 1 minute.
REND ARMOR [one-action]	
FEAT 8
ARCHETYPE
MANIPULATE
Prerequisites Hellbreaker Dedication
Requirements Your last action was a critical Strike that 
dealt bludgeoning or piercing damage.
Your enemies’ defenses are no match for you as you 
wrench your weapon to compromise their armor. The 
creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their AC that 
lasts until they can take 10 minutes to repair their armor. 
The creature can also Interact to adjust their armor, which 
removes this penalty for 1 minute.
BATTLE SCARS	
FEAT 10
ARCHETYPE
Prerequisites Hellbreaker Dedication
You’ve faced enough opponents that your experience is 
written across your skin, toughening you against your 
fiendish foes. You gain resistance to bludgeoning and 
slashing damage from devils and creatures allied with the 
Chelaxian government (as determined by the GM) equal to 
half your level.
DEFY HELL [one-action]	
FEAT 10
ARCHETYPE
DIVINE
STANCE
Prerequisites Hellbreaker Dedication
Requirements You aren’t unholy.
Your devotion to your cause gives you endless strength 
and courage to withstand the enemy’s attacks. As long as 
you’re in this stance, you gain a +2 status bonus to saves 
against mental effects and can make Hellbreaker Strikes.
Hellbreaker Strike [two-actions] (holy) Make a weapon or unarmed 
Strike. This counts as two attacks when determining 
your multiple attack penalty. If your Strike hits, you 
deal an additional 2d8 spirit damage. At 18th level, this 
increases to 3d8 spirit damage. 
RETURN TO THE PIT!	
FEAT 12
ARCHETYPE
Prerequisites Hellbreaker Dedication
You can send the fiends who have vexed you back to their 
home plane where they belong. You can cast banishment 
once per day as a divine innate spell. When you take 
this feat, you craft a personal symbol of the Hellbreakers 
League that’s anathema to devils. If you wield this symbol 
in one hand when you spend an extra action while casting 
banishment on a devil, you don’t need to pay the extra cost 
to give that creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save.
THORN IN HELL’S SIDE	
FEAT 12
ARCHETYPE
Prerequisites Defy Hell
Your devotion to the ideals of justice, freedom, and 
revolution allow you to truly punish those who stand in 
your way. When you critically succeed at a Hellbreaker 
Strike, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against 
your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become 
stunned 1 (stunned 2 on a critical failure). This effect has 
the incapacitation trait.
HELLBREAKERS’ REGIMEN
Hellbreakers work around the clock, as they 
know their opposition won’t be taking a moment 
off either. Training is vigorous and frequent, 
constantly testing Hellbreakers’ abilities and 
almost always bringing them to the brink of 
exhaustion. That being said, discipline in a 
Hellbreaker station is certainly less painful than in 
their Chelaxian counterpart’s.

## Page 219
作为敌人的破狱者部队
尽管此处呈现的四支部队旨在于本《冒险路径》中与PC并肩作战，但GM也能在本战役之外将他们用作敌方战斗人员。某个地精村落可能会派出一支战争歌者合唱团来保卫自身，或为一支劫掠队提供助力——这可由战争破坏者来体现。

破狱者部队
破狱者联盟最初只有散落在伊斯嘉各地的少数新兵，他们进行着针对切利亚斯的小规模叛乱行动，并向普通伊斯嘉人表达支援。在本《冒险路径》期间，该组织逐步成长为革命的核心，从国家的各个角落招募盟友。当终于到了全面开战之时，破狱者们希望能指望许多伊斯嘉公民挺身而出，为此事业奉献一切。以下部队只是PC能够招募的众多盟友中的四支，可在他们对抗地狱骑士及更可怕敌人的小规模遭遇战中提供支援。

树桩地战争歌者合唱团
树桩地的地精艺术家，如同大多数地精一样，热爱好歌。尽管他们并非以战士为业，这些地精仍拿起狗切刀，为伊斯嘉的解放而战。不过，作为小规模遭遇战中的部队资产，他们最大的优势在于能用战歌鼓舞盟友、扰乱敌人。

HELLBREAKER TROOPS 
AS ENEMIES
While the four troops presented 
here are meant to ally with the PCs 
during this Adventure Path, a GM 
can find use for them outside of this 
campaign as enemy combatants. A 
goblin village could field a choir of 
war chanters to protect itself or to 
bolster a raiding party, represented 
by the war saboteurs. 
Hellbreaker Troops
The Hellbreakers League stared with just a few recruits scattered across Isger, 
performing small acts of rebellion against Cheliax and demonstrations of 
support for everyday Isgeri. During this Adventure Path, the organization 
grows to become the center of the revolution, gathering allies from every 
corner of the country. When the time comes to fully go to war, the Hellbreakers 
can hopefully count on many Isgeri citizens to rise up and give their all for 
the cause. The following troops are just four of the many allies that the PCs 
can recruit for their skirmish encounters against Hellknights and worse.
STUMPFIELD WAR CHANTER CHOIR
The goblin artists of Stumpfield love a good song, as most goblins do. 
While they aren’t primarily warriors, these goblins have taken up their 
dogslicers to fight for the liberation of Isger. Their main advantage as a 
troop asset in skirmish encounters, though, is their ability to bolster their 
allies and flummox their enemies with their chants.

HELLBREAKER TROOPS AS ENEMIES
While the four troops presented here are meant to ally with the PCs during this Adventure Path, a GM can find use for them outside of this campaign as enemy combatants. A goblin village could field a choir of war chanters to protect itself or to bolster a raiding party, represented by the war saboteurs.

Hellbreaker Troops
The Hellbreakers League stared with just a few recruits scattered across Isger, performing small acts of rebellion against Cheliax and demonstrations of support for everyday Isgeri. During this Adventure Path, the organization grows to become the center of the revolution, gathering allies from every corner of the country. When the time comes to fully go to war, the Hellbreakers can hopefully count on many Isgeri citizens to rise up and give their all for the cause.
The following troops are just four of the many allies that the PCs can recruit for their skirmish encounters against Hellknights and worse.

STUMPFIELD WAR CHANTER CHOIR
The goblin artists of Stumpfield love a good song, as most goblins do. While they aren’t primarily warriors, these goblins have taken up their dogslicers to fight for the liberation of Isger. Their main advantage as a troop asset in skirmish encounters, though, is their ability to bolster their allies and flummox their enemies with their chants.

## Page 221
地狱破坏者部队作为敌人
斯威夫特伦的神职人员很容易被塑造成一支敌对团体，他们只关心自己的社群。乌莫克的侏儒兽语者也可以代表一群德鲁伊，他们更热衷于惩罚文明而非保护自然。

斯威夫特伦神职人员
斯威夫特伦是一个奉祀艾拉斯提尔的小型聚落，规模勉强够得上村落。这里的祭司致力于社群与和平、自然与培育。然而，有时也会来到必须拿起武器保卫社群的时刻，当言语与温和已不足以应对之时。

艾拉斯提尔的神职人员与其说以魔法闻名，不如说以耕作技艺见长；但他们的乡野作风不应让任何人误以为他们无法自卫。每位祭司都受“老死眼”的神圣力量加护，同时也具备与艾拉斯提尔偏好武器——长弓——相得益彰的精湛射术。这些祭司在必要时会运用自身技能守卫家园，但他们从不渴望流血；若可选择，他们更愿意把日子花在照料庄稼与社群上。

部队施法
当斯威夫特伦神职人员施放一个法术时，其组成成员会合力施放出比任何单一成员独自施放都更强的版本。当施放一个区域为爆发、锥形或线形、且不具有持续时间的法术时，增大该法术的区域：对通常半径至少为10尺的爆发，其半径+5尺（半径更小的爆发不受影响）。对通常长度为15尺或更短的锥形或线形，其长度+5尺；对更长的锥形或线形，其长度+10尺。

SWIFTRUN CLERGY
Swiftrun is a small settlement dedicated to Erastil, barely large enough to 
be considered a village. Its priests are devoted to community and peace, 
nature and nurture. And yet, sometimes the time comes when one must 
take up arms to protect their community, when words and gentleness 
aren’t enough.
The Erastilian clergy is known more for their farming techniques than 
their magic, but their rural ways shouldn’t fool anyone into thinking they 
can’t defend themselves. Each priest is equipped with the divine power 
of Old Deadeye as well as sharpshooting skills conducive to Erastil’s 
favored weapon, the longbow. These priests are prepared to defend their 
homes with their skills when they must, though they are never eager to 
shed blood and would rather spend their days tending their crops and 
community.

## Page 222
乌莫克兽语者之环
乌莫克的侏儒在地精血战期间那场得不偿失的野火焚毁了喋喋林后，便对火焰心存戒惧。为保护家园免遭恶意纵火，乌莫克的许多侏儒学会了与动物沟通；动物的本能能迅速嗅出未经允许的烟雾或火焰。两者协同守护城镇安全：当威胁逼近时，动物充当早期预警系统。

数名乌莫克兽语者已加入战争，运用他们的原初魔法及与动物的联结对抗切利亚斯的军队。他们强大的魔法用来召唤荒野猛兽，守卫伊斯嘉免受威胁家园和平的势力侵扰，以原初之力对抗邪魔。

## Page 223
想当恶魔

据说，阿迪尤托的制造过程是由反传统的大魔鬼巴巴托斯一手设计的；传言他并不具备真正的恶魔传承。虽然没人敢在“长须之主”面前这么做，但真正的魔鬼很乐于对阿迪尤托颐指气使——这些家伙既非地狱的当选者，也非其精英——并把他们派去执行危险任务，好让他们去挣那点永远也赢不到的尊重。

阿迪尤托
阿迪尤托虽被戏称为“辅助恶魔”，却并非真正的恶魔，而是被灌注了炼狱之力的凡人。这些凡人因其对暴政与压迫事业的忠诚而获得奖励，得以浅尝地狱的威能。阿迪尤托渴求力量，为了实现自己的邪魔野心，不惜一切代价冷酷地执行地狱的意志。

由于切利亚斯与地狱势力的关系，阿迪尤托最常见于切利亚斯及其领地，为特伦家族与那些热衷干预凡人的强大魔鬼担任间谍与线人。尽管有些阿迪尤托会在凡人社会中攀升阶层，成为地狱骑士与其他暴政支持者，但多数人的野心更大，渴望自己变成恶魔。为此，他们会寻求侍奉更强大的魔鬼，并缔结能使自身受益的契约，以确保自己的转化。

没有什么比自身的凡人性更令阿迪尤托憎恶——在他们看来，那是弱点的象征；而像魔鬼这样的存在，正以其完美的地狱愿景行走于宇宙之间。尽管阿迪尤托最可能出没在那些与地狱已有联系的地点或人物附近，但他们也可能出现在任何地方，暗中谋划获取权力与地位，好成为他们所渴望的地狱副官。

WANNABE DEVILS
The process by which the adiutors 
are created is supposedly one 
engineered by the iconoclastic 
archfiend Barbatos, who’s rumored 
to not be of true devilish heritage. 
While none would dare do so in front 
of the Bearded Lord, true devils take 
a joy in lording over the adiutors, 
who are neither of Hell’s elect nor 
its elite, and in sending them on 
dangerous tasks to earn some 
unwinnable respect.
Adiutor
Adiutors, while nicknamed auxiliary devils, are not truly devils, but 
mortals invested with infernal power. These mortals gain a taste of Hell’s 
might as rewards for their loyalty to the cause of tyranny and oppression. 
Hungry for power, an adiutor ruthlessly enforces Hell’s will at any cost in 
hopes of fulfilling their fiendish ambitions. They’re most commonly found 
in Cheliax and its territories due to the nation’s relationship with the forces 
of Hell, serving as spies and informants for both the Thrunes and powerful 
devils invested in meddling with mortals.
While some adiutors climb the ranks of mortal society to become 
Hellknights and other supporters of tyranny, most have higher ambitions 
and desire to become devils themselves. To this end, they seek to serve more 
powerful devils and make deals that will benefit them so that they can 
ensure their transformation. There’s nothing an adiutor despises more than 
their own mortality—a sign of weakness, when beings like devils walk the 
Universe in their perfect Hellish vision.
Although they’re most likely to be found in places or near people with 
existing links to Hell, adiutors can be found anywhere, quietly plotting 
to gain power and status so they can become the lieutenants of Hell they 
desire to be.

奥罗康
人们可以通过敌人在战场上的声音来预判他们的种类。步兵行军时，武器敲击盾牌铿锵作响。骑兵则以马蹄急促的鼓点为标志。麾下有强大怪物的军队不会试图压制那令人毛骨悚然的尖啸。

没有任何声音能比齿轮稳定的咔哒声与翻涌蒸汽的嘶鸣更能令人警惕，因为伴随那种合奏出现的唯一之物，就是奥罗康：一种被塑造成巨大六足公牛形态的机械生物，且在被摧毁时极易爆炸。奥罗康最强之处在于，它的头部能从躯体上分离，在高处倾泻滚烫蒸汽。

One can predict what foes are on the battlefield by how they sound. Foot 
soldiers clang weapons on shields as they march. Cavalry is marked by 
a rapid drumbeat of hooves. Armies with great monsters under their 
command don’t try to silence their hair-raising screeches.
No sound prompts as much caution as the steady clicking of gears and 
hiss of billowing steam, for the only thing that accompanies that chorus 
is an aurocan: a mechanical creature created in the shape of a massive 
six-legged bull prone to exploding when destroyed. The aurocan’s greatest 
strength is how its head can detach from its body to rain down scalding 
steam from above.

Aurocan
One can predict what foes are on the battlefield by how they sound. Foot soldiers clang weapons on shields as they march. Cavalry is marked by a rapid drumbeat of hooves. Armies with great monsters under their command don’t try to silence their hair-raising screeches.
No sound prompts as much caution as the steady clicking of gears and hiss of billowing steam, for the only thing that accompanies that chorus is an aurocan: a mechanical creature created in the shape of a massive six-legged bull prone to exploding when destroyed. The aurocan’s greatest strength is how its head can detach from its body to rain down scalding steam from above.

MODE OF TRANSPORT
The aurocan’s chest hull is large enough to carry up to five Medium or smaller creatures. The creatures benefit from total cover and can leave the aurocan with an Interact action to open a hatch and slide out. Some aurocans are designed specifically as protective tanks for ranged soldiers like snipers and spellcasters, with slots built into their sides for weapons and spells to shoot out of.

## Page 225
【蜘蛛般的倾向】
诡计者常常会模仿特定种类的蜘蛛，甚至在脸上带有网状纹路，这也体现在他们的战术上。受跳蛛启发的诡计者会迅速追猎猎物，动用他们拥有的一切手段进行穷追猛打；而更接近耐心的陷阱门蛛者，则会深度融入他们所渗透的社会之中。

【魔鬼，诡计者（设局魔鬼）】
这些来自地狱第一层的魔鬼，通过诱捕那些容易被诱惑之人、编织导致凡人灵魂堕落的阴谋，来为更高阶者效力。诡计者常被招募来设置“钓鱼执法”式的圈套，引诱凡人犯下可怕的罪孽，或揭露恶魔竞争对手的阴谋诡计。他们乐于见到受害者落入其精心打造的计谋之中，并可能为一个完美计划耗费数年；不过，最有效率者更可能在地狱的阶级中步步高升。

诡计者的隐秘天赋也延伸至其肉体形态。他们蝙蝠般的翅膀看似轻薄如纱，但如同其所模仿的蛛网一般，极擅长捕捉猎物、黏附敌人并在近战中将其困住。若心血来潮或形势所迫，设局魔鬼还能改变皮肤与翅膀的颜色以避免被发现。

诡计者通常会设法避免肉搏战，更偏好以诡计与精神操控的游戏来戏弄其目标。他们的专长是引导目标沿着一条曲折复杂的道路前行，最终令目标自证其罪或自取其辱，从而被迫同意诡计者的要求。若潜在受害者看穿了诡计者的布局，这名魔鬼便会承认暂时失利并离去，重新开始策划。当一切手段都失效且不得不诉诸武力时，设局魔鬼也是能手；他们会利用蜘蛛般的蛛网与伪装能力占据优势，采用偷袭战术令对手措手不及。

【变色皮肤】［一动作］（专注、神术、幻术）
诡计者改变皮肤的颜色以匹配其周围的环境。如此一来，即使他们没有掩蔽，也可以进行躲藏。当诡计者移动到不同的环境中时，必须再次使用此动作，否则失去其效果。

【改变形态】［一动作］（专注、神术、变形）
诡计者可以变成任何中型类人生物的外貌（《Pathfinder 怪物 Core》358）。这不会改变其速度，亦不会改变其打击的攻击加值与伤害加值，但可能会改变其打击造成的伤害类型（通常改为钝击）。

【隐秘移动】
如果诡计者在其回合开始时对某生物处于未被察觉或隐匿状态，则该生物在该回合结束前，对抗诡计者的攻击时处于措手不及。

【蛛网陷阱】
被诡计者的蛛网打击命中的生物将陷入定身，并黏附在最近的表面上，直到其逃脱（DC 17）。

SPIDERY INCLINATIONS
The insidiator often takes after 
specific spiders, even bearing 
webbed markings on their face, 
which shows in their tactics. Those 
inspired by jumping spiders are 
quick to hunt down their prey, 
attacking relentlessly with every 
tool they have, while those closer 
to the patient trapdoor spiders 
integrate deeply into the society 
they infiltrate.
Devil, Insidiator (Entrapment Devil)
These devils from the first layer of Hell serve their betters by ensnaring those 
who are easily tempted and weaving plots that lead to the fall of mortal 
souls. Insidiators are commonly recruited to set up sting operations that 
entice mortals into committing terrible sins or lay bare the machinations 
of fiendish rivals. They delight in seeing their victims fall prey to their well-
crafted schemes and might spend years on the perfect plan, though the 
most efficient are more likely to rise through Hell’s ranks.
An insidiator’s talent for subtlety extends to their physical form. Their 
bat-like wings appear gossamer but, like the spider webs they resemble, 
are excellent for catching prey, sticking to enemies and trapping them 
in melee. When the mood strikes or circumstances warrant, entrapment 
devils can alter the color of their skin and wings to avoid detection.
Insidiators generally seek to avoid physical combat, preferring to toy 
with their targets in games of subterfuge and mental manipulation. Their 
specialty is leading a target down a convoluted path that ends with the target 
incriminating or damning themselves, forcing them to agree to the insidiator’s 
demands. Should a would-be victim see through the insidiator’s 
schemes, the devil concedes temporary defeat and 
leaves to begin plotting anew. When all else fails 
and physical tactics become necessary, entrapment 
devils are capable fighters who use their spiderlike webs and 
camouflage abilities to their advantage, employing sneak 
tactics to throw their opponents off-guard.

## Page 226
恶魔，因斯提洛（教官恶魔）

在地狱炽燃阴影之中，只要有学习与教导的需求——无论是在狄斯的官署与厄瑞玻斯的金库，还是马勒博吉的战争学院与凯纳的法庭——教官恶魔都以其不张扬却目光如炬的行当维系运转。因斯提洛之名，源于其创意与天赋：它们擅长向被俘听众灌注对地狱方式与其合法性的尊崇。它们因能将新近征服的土地改造为顺从、甚至忠诚的附庸国而备受重视。被征服者会被教导为自身出身而羞愧；绝望者会被灌输某些哲学，将责任与不确定性转嫁给历史与地理的“错误”；失怙者则会被教导去敬重那些使其失怙之人。

反智主义者
因斯提洛深知多元思考与媒体素养的重要性，因此它们会把矛头指向教育机构与自由思想者。它们在组织中播撒虚假信息，并安插自私的“知识分子”——这些人将所学用于自身而非他人。因斯提洛先以权力与情报拉拢他们，继而揭露其腐败，使整个社会转而与之为敌。

ANTI-INTELLECTUALISTS
Instillos know the importance 
of diverse thinking and media 
literacy, which leads them to target 
educational institutions and free 
thinkers. They seed organizations 
with false information and selfish 
intellectuals who use their 
knowledge for themselves instead of 
others, plying them with power and 
information before exposing their 
corruption so society turns against 
them.
Devil, Instillo (Docent Devil)
Wherever learning and instruction is called for within the burning shadows 
of Hell, from the bureaus of Dis and coffers of Erebus to the war colleges 
of Malebolge and Caina’s courtrooms, docent devils ply their unassuming 
and perspicacious trade. The instillo, so named for their creativity and 
talent in instilling a respect for Hell’s ways and legitimacy to captive 
audiences, are valued for their ability to transform recently conquered 
lands into compliant, even loyal, client-states. The conquered are taught 
to be ashamed of their origins; the despairing are issued philosophies

Devil, Instillo (Docent Devil)
Wherever learning and instruction is called for within the burning shadows of Hell, from the bureaus of Dis and coffers of Erebus to the war colleges of Malebolge and Caina’s courtrooms, docent devils ply their unassuming and perspicacious trade. The instillo, so named for their creativity and talent in instilling a respect for Hell’s ways and legitimacy to captive audiences, are valued for their ability to transform recently conquered lands into compliant, even loyal, client-states. The conquered are taught to be ashamed of their origins; the despairing are issued philosophies that displace blame and uncertainty upon the mistakes of history and geography; the orphaned are taught to respect those who orphaned them.

ANTI-INTELLECTUALISTS
Instillos know the importance of diverse thinking and media literacy, which leads them to target educational institutions and free thinkers. They seed organizations with false information and selfish intellectuals who use their knowledge for themselves instead of others, plying them with power and information before exposing their corruption so society turns against them.

爪牙与附庸
强大的基利克斯会把他们的酒杯不仅当作配饰，更当作武器；他们能将酒杯活化，让其向对手倾泻酸液，并在远处猛击敌人。尽管所有侍杯魔鬼都极具魅力，但只有最强者才能将那诱人的个人魅力发挥到极致：攫住受害者的心智，令其离去并替魔鬼办事；而那些被蛊惑的“朋友”却仍坚信自己是在凭本心行事。

魔鬼，基利克斯（侍杯魔鬼）
优雅、外表近乎凡人的基利克斯（亦称侍杯魔鬼）很少掩藏其炼狱本性；他们更喜欢以得体而一丝不苟的装束，衬托自身形体之美与对称。它们擅长闲谈与机敏的巧语；在微笑暗示的轻佻之间，抛出半真半假的友谊允诺。无论身在何处，它们都能迅速结交朋友；仅凭其存在，似乎就能压制叛乱与冲突。
侍杯者是占领的门面：凭借恶魔般的魅惑，它们能从叛乱中夺走革命者，让配偶离间，偷走襁褓中的孩子，却还能得到感谢。侍杯者塑造艺术与文化，运用其待客与欢宴的天赋，将宾客与随从诱向邪恶的浮华。毕竟，地狱是文明的堡垒；侍杯者用闪耀的器皿与漫不经心却真诚的奉承，提醒众人：地狱才是最好的归宿，你无需畏惧它的律法。

MINIONS AND VASSALS
Powerful kylixes use their goblets 
not just as accessories but weapons, 
animating them to pour acid onto 
rivals and batter opponents from 
afar. Though all cupbearer devils are

Devil, Kylix (Cupbearer Devil)
The elegant and mortal-appearing kylixes, or cupbearer devils, rarely 
hide their infernal nature, preferring to dress tastefully and immaculately 
to accentuate the beauty and symmetry of their forms. Theirs is the 
dance of idle speech and clever chatter, half-promises of friendship amid 
smiling hints of dalliance. They make friends swiftly wherever they go, 
and their presence alone seems to prevent insurrection and conflict. The 
cupbearers are the face of occupation; with their devilish charms, they 
can rob a rebellion of its revolutionaries, waylay spouses from their 
partners, steal children from cradles, and get thanked for it all. 
The cupbearers shape art and culture, wielding their talents in hospitality 
and merrymaking to seduce their guests and entourages toward the 
glamour of evil. Hell is, after all, a bastion of civilization; the cupbearers, 
with their twinkling vessels and carelessly sincere flattery, remind that Hell 
is the best place to be, and you have nothing to fear from its laws.

FANATICS OF HELL
Odvolos love to engage foes in 
debate, even if they’re ill-suited to 
the arts of logic and rhetoric; their 
passion is to engulf their opponents 
in fallacy and flame. In their eyes, 
anyone who dares to disagree with 
them or their archdevil idols is but 
a straw man, and they’ll do their 
damnedest to ensure the straw man 
burns.
Devil, Odvolos (Censorship Devil)
As empires posture amid decline and demagogues preside over republics, 
censorship devils scatter the burning ash of ignorance as a comforting 
veil over the complications of history and causality. These devils are 
feverishly devoted to Hell and find anything that could be interpreted 
against Hell’s doctrines to be anathema and deserving of immediate 
destruction. Inconvenient accounts of the past, truths that draw the 
faithful away from the ways of Asmodeus, words that bring hope to 
those who might otherwise fall into a devil’s temptations—these are fuel 
for the odvolos’s hateful torches, burning bright on the cinders of ink 
and vellum.

Hellbreakers

Devil, Odvolos (Censorship Devil)
As empires posture amid decline and demagogues preside over republics, censorship devils scatter the burning ash of ignorance as a comforting veil over the complications of history and causality. These devils are feverishly devoted to Hell and find anything that could be interpreted against Hell’s doctrines to be anathema and deserving of immediate destruction. Inconvenient accounts of the past, truths that draw the faithful away from the ways of Asmodeus, words that bring hope to those who might otherwise fall into a devil’s temptations—these are fuel for the odvolos’s hateful torches, burning bright on the cinders of ink and vellum.

FANATICS OF HELL
Odvolos love to engage foes in debate, even if they’re ill-suited to the arts of logic and rhetoric; their passion is to engulf their opponents in fallacy and flame. In their eyes, anyone who dares to disagree with them or their archdevil idols is but a straw man, and they’ll do their damnedest to ensure the straw man burns.

【精神胜过物质】
维拉维斯有着细长的鸟类般双腿、苍白的皮肤，以及锐利的黑色眼睛，令许多与其对视者心生不安。它们一旦被激怒，只需一记怒视便足以恐吓惹事者，让其乖乖服从。尽管气势逼人，维拉维斯的体魄并不算强壮。需要搬动沉重典籍时，它们往往借助魔法与召唤出的仆从来完成。这些恶魔是技艺娴熟的施法者，其智识、言辞与羽毛笔才是最强大的武器。

恶魔，维拉维（图书管理员恶魔）
知识即力量，而对这一真理体会最深的，莫过于维拉维。这些书记与初级学者负责维护冥河地狱斯提吉亚“谎言学院”里浩瀚到难以想象的馆藏。维拉维是图书馆的门面，迎接访客并决定是否准许其请求。它们的组织能力堪称地狱一流，记忆也极为绵长，因此能以惊人的速度在自家馆内穿梭查找。

维拉维还为地狱提供另一项关键服务：当有其他恶魔做出宝贵发现时，它们会被要求前往某所学院，让维拉维将其记录在卷轴或书籍上——而这些书籍由维拉维用活体血肉制成。

每名维拉维都对自己图书馆中的馆藏了如指掌，并且对其他学院的档案拥有不受限制的许可。想在地狱中寻求情报之人或许会被诱使去求助于维拉维，但维拉维在让步提供任何信息之前，必会索取高昂代价——即便如此，知识的流动几乎总是单向的，因为维拉维对自己分享的内容非常狡猾。图书管理员恶魔既是管理者，也是守门人与守卫；维拉维极少与非更高阶的恶魔分享知识，而即便面对高阶恶魔，也必须通过交易或威胁才能从它们口中撬出情报。

MIND OVER MATTER
Velavis have long, birdlike legs, pallid 
skin, and piercing black eyes that 
unnerve many who look upon them. 
When angered, one glare is enough 
to intimidate troublemakers into 
compliance. Despite their imposing 
demeanor, velavis aren’t especially 
strong physically. When they need 
to move heavy tomes, they tend 
to do so with the aid of magic and 
conjured servants. These devils are 
accomplished spellcasters whose 
intellect, speech, and quills are their 
most powerful weapons.
Devil, Velavi (Librarian Devil)
Knowledge is power, and no one is more keenly aware of this truth than 
velavis. These scribes and junior scholars are tasked with maintaining the 
unfathomably vast collections in Stygia’s Academies of Lies. Velavis are 
the front faces of the library, greeting visitors and determining whether 
to grant their requests. Their organizational skills are among the best in 
Hell, and their memories are long, allowing them to easily navigate their 
home library with astonishing speed. Velavis provide another vital service 
for Hell: should another devil make a valuable discovery, they’re expected 
to report to an Academy to have a velavi record it on a scroll or book the 
velavi crafts out of living flesh.
Each velavi is intimately familiar with the collections in their library, 
and they have unfettered access to other Academies’ archives. Those 
seeking information in Hell might be tempted to seek a velavi’s aid, but the 
velavi will demand a high price before conceding any information—even 
then, the flow of knowledge almost always goes one way, as velavis are 
tricky with what they share. Librarian devils are custodians, gatekeepers, 
and guardians; it’s exceedingly rare for velavis to share their knowledge 
with anyone but a devil of higher rank, and even then, it must be bought 
or threatened out of them.

烟残兽（Fumecrux）
通过研究地狱冠（hellcrowns，第232页）与断首者（beheaded，《怪物核心2》56页）的现象，切里克斯法师将二者融合。多年的实验最终催生了烟残兽：以硫磺幽灵为躯壳，头顶则是巨大野兽被斩下后腐烂的头颅。作为对抗安多安战争的又一种武器，这一制造流程正被愈发频繁地尝试。

龙裔烟残兽（DRACONIC FUMECRUX）
该生物是将烟残兽仪式施加在一头年轻的精金龙头颅上所得到的产物。与大多数烟残兽不同，龙裔烟残兽保留了其活体对应物的一部分独特魔法。

干枯巨石吐息[二动作]（虚空）龙裔烟残兽喷出一团半为实体、半为虚空能量的碎石。这些碎石在30尺锥形范围内造成4d8 钝击伤害与4d8 虚空伤害（DC 25 基础反射豁免）。它在1d4回合内无法再次使用干枯巨石吐息。

地狱烟体 一只烟残兽的身躯由注入虚空能量的地狱烟雾构成。当一个生物在被烟残兽以“吞食殆尽”吞下并且正屏住呼吸时，于其回合中发动攻击或施放法术，则该生物失去3轮空气而非2轮。

吐出[二动作] 需求 龙裔烟残兽已有一个生物被其吞食殆尽；效果 龙裔烟残兽将被吞下的生物吐出，把它抛掷到空中，最远可达40尺。该生物承受等同于其飞行距离的钝击伤害并倒地。若它落在另一生物的同一空间内，则该另一生物被推开5尺并承受3d8+4 钝击伤害（DC 25 基础反射豁免）。无论体型如何，烟残兽一次最多只能吐出1个生物，且总是先吐出最近被吞下的生物。

吞食殆尽[一动作] 中型，1d10+4 虚空与1d10 火焰，破裂值12

烟残兽变体（FUMECRUX VARIANTS）
尽管龙裔烟残兽的破坏力惊人，但它们并不常见。常见的烟残兽多由马匹、大型鸟类与其他寻常野兽制成。所有烟残兽对活物——包括其制作者——都表现出冷漠，这使得它们难以控制。若一名死灵法师放出一只由像龙这种难以驯服之物制成的烟残兽，那要么说明他强大得可怕，要么愚蠢得惊人。

FUMECRUX VARIANTS
As devastating as draconic 
fumecruxes are, they’re uncommon 
sights to behold. Common 
fumecruxes are made from horses, 
large birds, and other mundane 
beasts. All fumecruxes display an 
apathy toward living creatures, 
including their makers, making them 
difficult to control. A necromancer 
who unleashes a fumecrux made 
from something as untamable as a 
dragon is either incredibly powerful 
or incredibly foolish.
Fumecrux
By studying the phenomena of hellcrowns (page 232) and beheaded 
(Monster Core 2 56), Chelaxian mages have created a fusion of the two. 
Years of experimentation culminated in the creation of fumecruxes, 
brimstone specters capped with the decapitated and rotting heads of great 
beasts. The process is being attempted more frequently as yet another 
weapon for the war against Andoran.
DRACONIC FUMECRUX
This creature is the result of the fumecrux ritual performed on the head of a 
young adamantine dragon. Unlike most fumecruxes, draconic fumecruxes 
retain some of the unique magic of their living counterparts.

Fumecrux
By studying the phenomena of hellcrowns (page 232) and beheaded (Monster Core 2 56), Chelaxian mages have created a fusion of the two. Years of experimentation culminated in the creation of fumecruxes, brimstone specters capped with the decapitated and rotting heads of great beasts. The process is being attempted more frequently as yet another weapon for the war against Andoran.

DRACONIC FUMECRUX
This creature is the result of the fumecrux ritual performed on the head of a young adamantine dragon. Unlike most fumecruxes, draconic fumecruxes retain some of the unique magic of their living counterparts.

DRACONIC FUMECRUX CREATURE 9
UNCOMMON LARGE UNDEAD UNHOLY
Perception +18; darkvision
Languages Common, Diabolic (can’t speak any language)
Skills Athletics +20, Intimidation +18
Str –5, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +6
AC 27; Fort +21, Ref +15, Will +17
HP 140, void healing (Pathfinder Monster Core 360); Immunities bleed, death effects, disease, paralyzed, poison, unconscious
Frightful Presence (aura, emotion, fear, mental) 90 feet, DC 26
Speed 25 feet, fly 90 feet
Melee [one-action] jaws +21 (magical, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d12+9 piercing plus Grab (Pathfinder Monster Core 359)
Melee [one-action] claw +18 (agile, finesse, magical, void), Damage 4d8+4 void
Melee [one-action] tail +18 (agile, finesse, magical, reach 15 feet, void), Damage 4d6+4 void
Desiccated Boulder Breath [two-actions] (void) The draconic fumecrux belches forth a mass of stones that are partially solid and partially void energy. These stones deal 4d8 bludgeoning damage and 4d8 void damage in a 30-foot cone (DC 25 basic Reflex save). It can’t use Desiccated Boulder Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
Hellfume Body A fumecrux’s body consists of hellish fumes infused with void energy. When a creature that’s holding its breath while it has been Swallowed Whole by a fumecrux attacks or casts a spell on a turn, the creature loses 3 rounds of air instead of 2.
Spit Up [two-actions] Requirements The draconic fumecrux has a creature Swallowed Whole; Effect The draconic fumecrux spits out the swallowed creature, flinging it through the air up to 40 feet away. The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to the distance it traveled and lands prone. If it lands in the same space as another creature, the other creature is pushed 5 feet and takes 3d8+4 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save). The fumecrux can’t Spit Up more than one creature at a time no matter their size, and the most recently swallowed creature is Spit Up first.
Swallow Whole [one-action] Medium, 1d10+4 void and 1d10 fire, Rupture 12

FUMECRUX VARIANTS
As devastating as draconic fumecruxes are, they’re uncommon sights to behold. Common fumecruxes are made from horses, large birds, and other mundane beasts. All fumecruxes display an apathy toward living creatures, including their makers, making them difficult to control. A necromancer who unleashes a fumecrux made from something as untamable as a dragon is either incredibly powerful or incredibly foolish.

【秘密信号】
滑翔河蛇有时会根据天气状况与猎物的移动在巢穴之间迁徙，这使得一些村庄用它们来传递信息。一旦蛇被驯化，就会被训练依靠气味定位特定巢穴，并将信件绑在它的身上。当蛇抵达时，会以活体猎物作为奖励。

【滑翔河蛇】
精明的旅人会在行进路线上留意蛇类，但很少有人会料到它们会从头顶发起攻击。受威胁时，滑翔河蛇会爬上高处，朝目标发射般冲出：它将肋骨压扁以在空中滑翔，并通过蛇形摆动来控制飞行。若无法进行空中攻击，滑翔河蛇就会试图咬住目标，扯下目标的一两根手指。此蛇的颌部力量极其惊人，能够将骨与肉一口咬断。

滑翔河蛇带有轻微毒性，平时更喜欢独处，但会以凶狠的咬击来应对潜在威胁。它的口中布满锯齿状牙齿，会撕扯猎物，而非像典型蛇类那样单纯穿刺。凭借这些牙齿，滑翔河蛇会先把食物撕成块再吞下，使其得以瞄准更大的猎物。有时，某些倒霉的动物会遭到多条滑翔河蛇围攻，被扭动的蛇群覆盖。这类群体进食曾被误认为单一怪物，因为人们只能看见蛇那如触手般的身体在进食时翻动。

滑翔河蛇常成对生活，在交配季与伴侣相伴，待到淡季便分开。它们会在树上或水下产卵，有时甚至会在吞食鸟蛋后，夺取鸟巢供自己使用。不少观鸟者都曾因在树梢上看到孵化中的蛇而大吃一惊；这些蛇蛋有时还会与鸟蛋并排放置，便于它们顺手获得一顿餐食。

滑翔河蛇（GLIDING RIVER SNAKE）

力量 +0，敏捷 +3，体质 +1，智力 –4，感知 +1，魅力 –2

深呼吸 滑翔河蛇可以屏住呼吸约1小时。

滑翔河蛇毒液（毒素）
豁免 DC 18 强韧；最大持续时间 4轮；阶段1 1d8毒素伤害（1轮）

盘旋滑翔【单动作】（移动）
蛇朝地面滑翔：向下5尺，并在空中向前至多20尺。只要它每轮至少花费1个动作进行滑翔且尚未触地，它在其回合结束时仍保持在空中。

SECRET SIGNALS
Gliding river snakes sometimes 
migrate between nests depending 
on weather conditions and the 
movement of prey, which has 
led some villages to use them 
as messengers. Once a snake is 
domesticated, it’s trained to locate 
specific nests based on scent, and 
messages are tied to its body. When 
the snake arrives, it’s rewarded with 
live prey.
Gliding River Snake
Wise travelers keep watch for snakes along their path, but few expect 
them to attack from above. When threatened, the gliding river snake takes 
to high ground and launches toward its target, gliding through the air by 
flattening its ribs and controlling its flight by moving sinuously. If unable 
to make an aerial attack, the gliding river snake simply attempts to bite 
its target and snap off a finger or two. The snake’s jaws are extremely 
powerful, able to bite clean through bone and flesh.
The mildly venomous gliding river snake prefers to keep to itself but 
reacts harshly to potential threats with a vicious bite. Its mouth is filled 
with serrated teeth that tear into its prey rather than piercing like a 
typical snake. Using these teeth, the gliding river snake rends its food into 
chunks before swallowing, allowing it to target larger prey. Sometimes 
an unfortunate animal is beset by multiple gliding river snakes, covering 
it with writhing serpents. These group meals have been mistaken for a 
singular monster before, as only the snakes’ tentacle-like bodies can be 
seen as they feast.
The gliding river snake often lives in pairs, staying together with its 
mate through the mating season before separating in the off season. They 
lay their eggs either in trees or underwater, sometimes even stealing bird 
nests for their own uses once they’ve devoured the birds’ eggs. Many a 
birdwatcher has been taken aback by the sight of hatching snakes up in 
the treetops, occasionally even laid side by side with bird eggs for easy 
access to a meal.

against this Strike.

## Page 232
戈尔加，德鲁德
德鲁德是一种戈尔加，体现了人们对夜间闹鬼之地的恐惧。这种影影绰绰、能够变形的妖精会被巨大的悲剧、失落或冲突之地吸引，并在那里利用受害者对周遭环境的恐惧下手。德鲁德以戏弄猎物为扭曲的乐趣来源：它们会在整夜里恐吓并折磨目标，直至对方精疲力竭。德鲁德恶毒但并非真正邪恶，通常会克制自己不去夺取性命，因为死亡会终结它们的游戏。若面对无法取胜的局面，这种妖精更倾向于逃走而非战斗。

德鲁德的真形像是一只瘦骨嶙峋、无尾的狐狸，由黑暗与幽魂般的阴影构成，但德鲁德很少向他人显露真身。一旦盯上目标，它们更喜欢变成便于潜入受害者睡眠空间的形态，例如流浪狗、附近的灌木，或蜷在目标道具之间的某件物品。

如果德鲁德找不到合适的地点来取乐，它们会自己“造”一个。它们会寻找自己能找到的最偏僻区域，然后上演一场大戏，以激起任何住民的恐惧。被德鲁德选定领地的不幸之人会遭到奇异身影的尾随、被哭嚎般的声音袭扰、并被可怕的噩梦纠缠——这些全都是变形德鲁德的把戏，为它自己营造最完美的环境。极少数情况下，德鲁德可能会对某个特定受害者产生执念并跟随其前往其他地点，选择纠缠此人而非拘泥于单一地点。

残酷恶作剧者
德鲁德与其他施虐者非常合群，常与格雷姆林、萨基尔以及其他渴望制造痛苦的戈尔加结伙。已有不止几只德鲁德被发现充当连环杀手与拷问者的宠物与伙伴；这些暴行会取悦妖精，让它们乐在其中。

技能 欺骗+8，社会+7，潜行+8
力+0，敏+3，体+0，智+2，感+2，魅+4

CRUEL PRANKSTERS
Drudes are very sociable with 
other sadists and often team up 
with gremlins, sahkils, and other 
gorgas who wish to cause suffering. 
More than a few drudes have been 
discovered serving as pets and 
companions for serial killers and 
torturers who amuse the fey with 
their brutal activities.
Gorga, Drude
A drude is a gorga who embodies the fear of haunted places at night. 
This shadowy, shapeshifting fey is drawn to places of great tragedy, loss, 
or conflict, where they prey on their victim’s fear of their surroundings. 
A drude takes perverse pleasure in toying with their quarry, whom they 
terrorize and exhaust over the course of the night. Malicious but not truly 
malevolent, a drude typically stops short of causing death since that would 
put an end to their fun. When faced with a situation they can’t win, this fey 
is more likely to flee than fight. 
A drude’s true form resembles an emaciated, tailless fox made of 
darkness and ghostly shadows, though a drude rarely reveals this true self 
to others. When a drude has set their sights on a target, they prefer to shift 
into a form better suited to infiltrating the victim’s sleeping space, such as 
a stray dog, a nearby shrub, or an item nestled among the target’s gear.
If the drude can’t find a suitable location for their fun, they’ll make 
one. They find the most isolated area they can and put on a great show to 
bring out the fear of any residents. The unfortunate people in the drude’s 
chosen territory are stalked by strange figures, assailed by wailing sounds, 
and haunted by terrible nightmares—all tricks by the shapeshifting drude 
to create the perfect environment for themself. Very rarely, a drude might 
become attached to a particular victim and follow them to other locations, 
choosing to haunt them instead of a singular location.
DRUDE
CREATURE 2
UNCOMMON
SMALL
FEY
Perception +10; greater darkvision
Languages Common, Fey; telepathy 100 feet (Pathfinder Monster Core 360)
Skills Deception +8, Society +7, Stealth +8
Str +0, Dex +3, Con +0, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4
AC 18; Fort +5, Ref +11, Will +8
HP 25; Weaknesses cold iron 3
Lay Bare When a drude using Change Shape is reduced to fewer than half their 
Hit Points, they revert to their true form.
Nightmare Herald (aura) 90 feet. A creature that sleeps within the drude’s 
aura is tormented with horrific nightmares and must attempt a DC 18 
Will save. On a failure, it’s enfeebled 1 for 24 hours when it awakens. On 
a critical failure, it’s also fatigued.
Speed 25 feet
Melee [one-action] jaws +8 (agile, finesse, magical), Damage 1d6+3 piercing
Innate Primal Spells DC 16; Constant (1st) vanishing tracks
Change Shape [one-action] (concentrate, polymorph, primal) The drude takes 
on the appearance of a Small animal or inanimate object (Pathfinder 
Monster Core 358). This doesn’t affect their statistics, but it could 
change the damage type of their Strikes while in animal form.
Haunting Echoes [two-actions] (concentrate, illusion, emotion, fear, mental, 
primal) The drude targets a creature they can see within 30 feet and 
assaults it with illusions of ghosts and nightly terrors. The creature 
must attempt a DC 18 Will save.
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 
24 hours.
Success The creature takes 1d6 mental damage.
Failure The creature takes 1d6 mental damage and is frightened 1.
Critical Failure The creature takes 2d6 mental damage and is frightened 2.

## Page 233
【不同教团】
地狱冠会因其生前所属的教团而以不同能力现世。来自“刑架教团”的地狱冠以一枚大钉为武器，而来自“锁链教团”的地狱冠则会使用长长的灵体锁链来束缚并扼喉其猎物。无论出身何教团，所有地狱冠都渴望摧毁一切非其同类之物。

【地狱冠】
精通对抗地狱骑士之道者常告诫同袍：切勿对敌人斩首。这是因为地狱骑士那超凡的忠诚有时会将虚空能量灌注进其头盔，最终催生一种名为“地狱冠”的不息亡魂。地狱冠漂浮于空中，其幽魂般的躯体宛如它们生前所穿护甲的烟雾幻影；尽管仍保有对事业的扭曲效忠，但其余昔日的人性与自我认知已几乎荡然无存。地狱冠不会与仍然活着的同袍一同编入军队或团队，而更倾向于在它们最初陨落的血腥战场徘徊作祟。地狱冠的强弱取决于死去士兵生前的实力，以及其对自身死因的仇恨之力。在某些情况下，尤其强大的地狱冠拥有施法的许可，甚至会聚成幽灵般的群体，向它们认定应为其死亡负责之人复仇。

【神爪地狱冠】
与任一地狱骑士教团交战时，地狱冠都是已知的危害；若对手来自“神爪教团”，更是尤甚。这些地狱冠似乎对贯穿其存在的死灵术拥有更深的掌控，据报告它们能从幽魂之躯中塑造灵体武器，并可在转瞬间将其抽击向敌人。它们是人们可能遭遇的最危险地狱冠之一。

神爪地狱冠（Godclaw Hellcrown） 生物 7

速度 飞行25尺

近战 [单动作] 灵体鞭挞 +17（魔法，触及5尺，虚空），伤害 2d12+3虚空伤害 外加 苦痛鞭挞

神圣天生法术 DC 23，攻击+15；4环 神圣谴责；3环 信仰危机；1环 命令（随意）；戏法（4环） 念动投射物

苦痛鞭挞（神圣）
一名被神爪地狱冠的灵体鞭挞打击（Strike）造成伤害的生物必须尝试一次DC 23强韧豁免。失败时，鞭梢的尖端会嵌入该生物，造成1d6持续流血伤害，并使目标的各项速度获得–5尺状态减值，持续1分钟。每有一个额外的嵌入尖端，流血伤害增加1点，且速度减值增加5尺。生物可以用一个交互动作移除一个尖端，以减少流血伤害数值与速度减值。拔出最后一个尖端会移除这两种状况。

所有能看见地狱冠且正受苦痛鞭挞影响的生物都必须尝试一次DC 25意志豁免。豁免失败的生物陷入恐惧1；大失败时，只要它仍处于恐惧状态，就会变为逃窜。无论结果如何，该生物随后在10分钟内暂时免疫禁戒凝视。

DIFFERENT ORDERS
Hellcrowns arise with different 
abilities depending on the order 
they were part of. Hellcrowns from 
the Order of the Rack use a large 
nail as their weapon, while those 
from the Order of the Chain use long 
spectral chains to bind and choke 
their quarry. No matter the Order, all 
Hellcrowns seek to destroy anything 
that isn’t one of them.
Hellcrown
Those well-versed in the art of fighting against Hellknights warn their 
comrades to avoid decapitating their foes. This is because a Hellknight’s 
unearthly loyalty can sometimes imbue their helmet with void energy, 
resulting in a restless spirit called a hellcrown. Hellcrowns float through 
the air, their ghostly bodies resembling smoky apparitions of the armor 
they once wore in life, and though they retain their twisted allegiance to 
their cause, little else remains of their former humanity and sense of self.
Hellcrowns don’t join their living counterparts in armies or regiments, 
preferring to haunt the bloody battle sites where they originally fell. The 
strength of a hellcrown varies depending on the might of the living soldier 
who fell and the power of their enmity toward the cause of their death. 
In some cases, particularly powerful hellcrowns have access to spells 
and even form ghostly swarms to seek vengeance against any they deem 
responsible for their deaths.
GODCLAW HELLCROWN
Hellcrowns are a known hazard when fighting any order of Hellknights, 
especially so when those knights hail from the Order of the Godclaw. 
These hellcrowns seem to have a much better grasp on the necromancy 
that weaves through their existence and have been reported to form 
spectral weapons from their ghostly bodies that they can whip at their foes 
at a moment’s notice. These are some of the most dangerous hellcrowns 
one can meet.
GODCLAW HELLCROWN

UNCOMMON
TINY
UNDEAD
UNHOLY

Agony Lash (divine) A creature damaged by the godclaw hellcrown’s 
spectral lash Strike must attempt a DC 23 Fortitude save. On a failure, the tip 
of the lash is embedded in the creature, dealing 1d6 persistent bleed damage 
and imparting a –5-foot status penalty to the target’s Speeds for 1 minute. Each 
additional embedded tip increases the bleed damage by 1 and the penalty to 
Speed by 5 feet. A creature can remove a tip with an Interact action to reduce 
the amount of bleed damage and the penalty to Speed. Pulling out the last tip 
removes both conditions.
Forbidding Stare [one-action] (concentrate, emotion, fear, mental, visual) All creatures 
that can see the hellcrown and are affected by agony lash must attempt 
a DC 25 Will saving throw. A creature that fails is frightened 1, and on a 
critical failure, it becomes fleeing for as long as it’s frightened. Regardless 
of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune to Forbidding Stare 
for 10 minutes.

## Page 234
骷髅地狱骑士
地狱骑士的尸体偶尔会复起以继续他们的战斗。这只是地狱不死士兵的一个例子。

骷髅地狱骑士·骨咏者
一些不死地狱骑士能同时操控自身与他人的骨骼，他们主要用这种能力暂时强化自己，并召来一波波援军。尽管同样是不死之身，这些所谓的“骨咏者”仍具备足够的智能，能与活着的同袍并肩作战，但他们通常会遭到排斥与否认。

枢十字会
被称为“枢十字会”的佣兵团由三名墓骑士组成；他们在被天谴会杀死后，正缓慢地积聚一支军队。他们最重要的资产是骷髅地狱骑士——这些存在能在他们的不死队伍中获得接纳——不过他们真正的目标仍不得而知。

The bodies of Hellknights occasionally rise to continue their fight. This is 
just one example of an undead soldier of Hell.

Some undead Hellknights can command the bones of both their own 
bodies and others, and they primarily use this ability to temporarily 
strengthen themselves and summon waves of reinforcements. While just 
as undead as their compatriots, these so-called bonesingers have enough 
intelligence to join their living counterparts, though they’re generally 
shunned and disavowed.

## Page 235
【乌加索娅的仆从】
萨柯沃特仅为侍奉乌加索娅及其追随者而存在，除了一心要让其女主人之意志得以实现外，几乎不具备思考或推理能力。强大的乌加索娅信徒常召唤它们来协助阴谋，因为在他们看来，萨柯沃特正是女神意志的具现。

萨柯沃特
在多元宇宙中，很少有生物比萨柯沃特更怪诞而令人作呕——这是一种恶魔，长着苍蝇般的身体与无肉秃鹫颅骨般的头。区区不足2尺长的生物似乎不具威胁，但萨柯沃特虫群却能吞没整座村庄。萨柯沃特的头几乎像是与身体完全分离的个体，会在数小时后把它们用喙捕获的东西呕吐出来，化作腐臭、凝结的污泥。

萨柯沃特
单个萨柯沃特几乎没有个人身份，其短期记忆也短得惊人。

枯萎灵气（灵气，疾病）15尺。萨柯沃特被一团感染瘴气所环绕。敌人进入该灵气或在灵气内结束其回合时，必须尝试一次DC 19强韧豁免。
成功 该生物不受影响，并在1分钟内对该灵气暂时免疫。

反应性分离【反应动作】
触发 当萨柯沃特抓住或束缚了另一名生物时，某生物对其造成挥砍伤害；
效果 萨柯沃特使用“分离头颅”。它的头仍保持对该生物的抓住或束缚，而其身体则踏步。萨柯沃特获得对触发的挥砍伤害5点抗力。

退回寄件人【反应动作】
触发 某生物从萨柯沃特已分离的头颅处逃脱抓住或束缚；
效果 萨柯沃特的头颅沿最短可能路径返回其身体。任何位于头颅与身体之间直线上的生物必须成功通过一次DC 21反射豁免，否则陷入笨拙1，持续1轮（若大失败则笨拙2）。萨柯沃特解消“分离头颅”。

异界天生法术 DC 21；3环 呕吐虫群（Pathfinder 玩家 Core 2 254）；2环 酸性攫握；1环 衰弱，地精痘；戏法（3环）恍惚

分离头颅【自由动作】（异界）
触发 萨柯沃特因挥砍武器的大成功造成的伤害而受伤，或其头颅被移除（例如被斩首武器）；
效果 萨柯沃特能在被斩首后存活，且若某效果移除其头颅本应杀死它，则不会因此死亡。取而代之的是，萨柯沃特的头颅会从其身体上分离……

它们的身体。分离的头颅具有与身体相同的属性（但不包含凋萎灵气），并获得仆从（特征）。萨柯伏特的身体可以用单动作向分离的头颅发出口头命令，使头颅获得2个动作。分离的头颅与身体共享同一组生命值池。

当头颅分离时，萨柯伏特的身体无法进行喙击打击或使用恶臭尖啸。分离的头颅只能攀爬、飞行、迈步、进行喙击打击或使用恶臭尖啸。

恶臭尖啸 [双动作]（神秘，嗅觉，毒素，音波）萨柯伏特（无论头颅是否分离）透过其头骨发出尖啸，将头颅中残存的腐烂内脏喷洒成一片20尺锥形。区域内每个生物受到3d6音波伤害与3d6毒素伤害（DC 21基础反射豁免）。萨柯伏特在1d4回合内无法再次使用此能力。

萨柯伏特虫群
在大多数情况下，你几乎不可能遇到单独一只萨柯伏特。更常见的是，一群来自乌加索娅的恶心造物会袭击某个倒霉的村庄；这些生物狡猾到足以避开最有效的击杀尝试。

Sarcovalt swarms bring disease with 
them, wiping out entire villages in a 
matter of days. The creatures feast 
on the infected bodies, unbothered 
by any illness thanks to their

can’t use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

beset upon an unfortunate village, the creatures just clever enough to duck 
away from the best attempts to kill them

## Page 237
布拉克纳普
铭记往事的地精神谕者

布拉克纳普是棘握（Thorngrip）村的一位年长地精，也是少数亲眼目睹地精血战之后地精族所遭暴行的幸存者之一。他的许多家人——包括父亲与祖母——在奇特木（Chitterwood）燃起的大火中丧生，而布拉克纳普至今仍被诅咒般地受他们的灵魂纠缠。尽管承受着这样的个人损失，他却并不希望伊斯嘉（伊斯嘉）的人类居民走向毁灭。他相信，人类与地精之间这些可怕的创伤能够愈合——但双方都必须忘却偏见，携手合作。

当大地精（hobgoblin）指挥官首次进入奇特木，为其试图征服伊斯嘉而召集地精新兵时，布拉克纳普的大多数家人与邻里都拒绝了征召。他们对与类人生物邻居开战心存戒备，即便这些邻居多半并不友善。然而，其他一些地精村落却急于反击那些将地精一步步逼入森林更深处的伊斯嘉人类。他们知道许多人类称他们为“怪物”和“害虫”，并相信如今轮到他们为霸权而战。布拉克纳普曾目睹远亲与同族参与焚烧与掠夺伊斯嘉的乡间，随后又在报复中被杀。

战争极大地改变了奇特木，并非所有地精都是出于自愿而参战。布拉克纳普见过地精被强迫编入军列，所幸他的家人躲过了这样的征召。尽管如此，随着战争持续，世界愈发阴沉。奇特木不再只是家园，而成了战场。

多年后，战局逆转，人类开始焚烧奇特木，企图将国内的地精彻底灭绝。人类深入森林的程度前所未有，他们狂热地想要烧毁敌人的家园。许多地精——包括布拉克纳普的父亲——试图保卫家园，却被“伊斯嘉屠戮者”（Isgeri Slayers）成员砍倒；那是一个在战争期间成立的反地精偏执团体，自那以后便执意要将地精族从世上抹去。在那命运之夜，布拉克纳普看见父亲挺身对抗一名人类，随后倒在对方的刀刃之下。他眼睁睁看着父亲的鲜血在泥土中汇成一滩，直到祖母把他拉走，带他逃离燃烧中的村落。

少数地精逃到附近的一处洞穴，他们希望人类并不知道那里。等待期间，他们望见树梢上方升起浓烟，火光甚至比日出更明亮。最终，天色开始转亮；但他们还未来得及松一口气，数名伊斯嘉屠戮者便逼近了。尽管他们似乎仍在黑暗中摸索游荡，但很明显，屠戮者发现洞口只是时间问题。布拉克纳普的祖母——村里的医者，也是原初魔法（primal 魔法）的学徒——吻了吻孙子的额头，走入黎明。布拉克纳普用手捂住自己的哭声，与同伴一起退到洞穴更深处。

布拉克纳普看见祖母变形为一头雄鹿，将屠戮者从洞穴边引开，最终也因此走向死亡。但她的牺牲让幸存的村民得以安全。布拉克纳普知道祖母在那天逝去，因为当夜她的灵魂前来探望，告诉他那片区域已再次安全。

在许多地精社群中，与亡故的祖先交谈是一项受人尊崇的传统（根源）。因此，当布拉克纳普向其他人提起祖母的灵魂时，他们相信了他，并听从他的指引。在接下来的几天里，越来越多地精灵魂出现在布拉克纳普面前；其中有些是他自幼便认识的家人，还有些则向他讲述久远时代（时代）的往事。通过他们，布拉克纳普得以窥见不久将来的些许片段，
