Brakknap, an elder goblin of the village of Thorngrip, 
is one of the few living goblins who witnessed 
firsthand the atrocities visited on goblinkind after the 
Goblinblood Wars. Many of his family, including his 
father and grandmother, lost their lives in the fires that 
burned the Chitterwood, and Brakknap is cursed to 
be haunted by their spirits to this day. Despite this 
personal loss, he doesn’t wish destruction on the 
human residents of Isger. He believes that these terrible 
wounds between humans and goblins can be healed, 
though both sides have to forget their prejudices and 
work together.
When hobgoblin commanders first entered the 
Chitterwood to gather goblin recruits for their 
attempted conquest of Isger, most of Brakknap’s 
family and neighbors refused the call. They were wary 
of waging war against their humanoid neighbors, even 
if said neighbors were more hostile than not. Other 
goblin villages, however, were eager to strike back 
against Isgeri humans who’d pushed their kind deeper 
and deeper into the woods. They knew that many 
humans called them “monsters” and “pests,” and 
believed it was their time to fight 
for supremacy. Brakknap saw 
distant kin and fellow goblins 
take part in burning and pillaging 
the Isgeri countryside, only to be 
killed in retaliation.
War changed Chitterwood 
greatly, and not all goblins 
joined up of their own free will. 
Brakknap witnessed goblins being 
forced into the ranks, though his family 
thankfully avoided such conscription. 
Nevertheless, the world became grim 
as the war raged on. The Chitterwood 
was no longer just a home, but now a 
battlefield.
Years later, the tides of the war turned and 
humans began burning the Chitterwood in 
efforts to completely exterminate the country’s 
goblins. Humans went deeper into the woods 
than they’d ever dared before, zealous in 
their desire to burn down the homes of 
their enemies. Many goblins, Brakknap’s 
father among them, attempted to defend their homes 
but were cut down by members of the Isgeri Slayers, 
an organization of anti-goblin bigots formed during 
the wars that has been determined to wipe out 
goblinkind ever since. On that fateful night, Brakknap 
saw his father stand up to a human and then fall to 
their blade. He watched as his father’s blood pooled 
in the dirt before his grandmother pulled him away to 
flee their burning village.
A handful of goblins made it to a nearby cave 
they hoped the humans didn’t know about. As they 
waited, they watched smoke rise over the tops of the 
trees, the fires burning brighter than even the sunrise. 
Eventually, the sky began to lighten, but before they 
could breathe sighs of relief, several Isgeri Slayers 
approached. Though they seemed to be wandering 
around in the dark, it was clear that it was only a 
matter of time before they spotted the cave entrance. 
Brakknap’s grandmother, the village’s healer and a 
student of primal magic, kissed her grandson on the 
forehead and stepped out into the dawn. Brakknap 
muffled his cries with his hand and retreated deeper 
into the cave with his fellows.
Brakknap saw his grandmother 
transform into a stag and lead the 
slayers away from the cave, leading to 
her own demise. But her sacrifice 
meant that what remained of the 
villagers were safe. Brakknap knew 
that his grandmother perished that 
day, for her spirit visited him that 
night to tell him the area was safe 
again.
Being able to speak to one’s 
deceased ancestors is an honored 
tradition in many goblin communities, 
so when Brakknap told the others 
of his grandmother, they believed him 
and heeded his guidance. Over the next 
several days, more and more goblin spirits 
appeared to Brakknap, some of whom he 
recognized as family from his youth, and 
others spoke to him of times long past. 
Through them, Brakknap was granted 
small glimpses into the immediate future,

Hellbreakers Adventure Path

Brakknap
Goblin Oracle Who Remembers

Brakknap, an elder goblin of the village of Thorngrip, is one of the few living goblins who witnessed firsthand the atrocities visited on goblinkind after the Goblinblood Wars. Many of his family, including his father and grandmother, lost their lives in the fires that burned the Chitterwood, and Brakknap is cursed to be haunted by their spirits to this day. Despite this personal loss, he doesn’t wish destruction on the human residents of Isger. He believes that these terrible wounds between humans and goblins can be healed, though both sides have to forget their prejudices and work together.

When hobgoblin commanders first entered the Chitterwood to gather goblin recruits for their attempted conquest of Isger, most of Brakknap’s family and neighbors refused the call. They were wary of waging war against their humanoid neighbors, even if said neighbors were more hostile than not. Other goblin villages, however, were eager to strike back against Isgeri humans who’d pushed their kind deeper and deeper into the woods. They knew that many humans called them “monsters” and “pests,” and believed it was their time to fight for supremacy. Brakknap saw distant kin and fellow goblins take part in burning and pillaging the Isgeri countryside, only to be killed in retaliation.

War changed Chitterwood greatly, and not all goblins joined up of their own free will. Brakknap witnessed goblins being forced into the ranks, though his family thankfully avoided such conscription. Nevertheless, the world became grim as the war raged on. The Chitterwood was no longer just a home, but now a battlefield.

Years later, the tides of the war turned and humans began burning the Chitterwood in efforts to completely exterminate the country’s goblins. Humans went deeper into the woods than they’d ever dared before, zealous in their desire to burn down the homes of their enemies. Many goblins, Brakknap’s father among them, attempted to defend their homes but were cut down by members of the Isgeri Slayers, an organization of anti-goblin bigots formed during the wars that has been determined to wipe out goblinkind ever since. On that fateful night, Brakknap saw his father stand up to a human and then fall to their blade. He watched as his father’s blood pooled in the dirt before his grandmother pulled him away to flee their burning village.

A handful of goblins made it to a nearby cave they hoped the humans didn’t know about. As they waited, they watched smoke rise over the tops of the trees, the fires burning brighter than even the sunrise. Eventually, the sky began to lighten, but before they could breathe sighs of relief, several Isgeri Slayers approached. Though they seemed to be wandering around in the dark, it was clear that it was only a matter of time before they spotted the cave entrance. Brakknap’s grandmother, the village’s healer and a student of primal magic, kissed her grandson on the forehead and stepped out into the dawn. Brakknap muffled his cries with his hand and retreated deeper into the cave with his fellows.

Brakknap saw his grandmother transform into a stag and lead the slayers away from the cave, leading to her own demise. But her sacrifice meant that what remained of the villagers were safe. Brakknap knew that his grandmother perished that day, for her spirit visited him that night to tell him the area was safe again.

Being able to speak to one’s deceased ancestors is an honored tradition in many goblin communities, so when Brakknap told the others of his grandmother, they believed him and heeded his guidance. Over the next several days, more and more goblin spirits appeared to Brakknap, some of whom he recognized as family from his youth, and others spoke to him of times long past. Through them, Brakknap was granted small glimpses into the immediate future,

## Page 238
……这让他与同伴地精在继续深入森林时，得以避开更多伊斯嘉屠杀者的巡逻队。

终于，这支队伍抵达了那棵巨大的红杉——索恩格里普即将围绕它建立。布拉克纳普一见父亲的灵魂站在高树旁，向他招手，便跪倒在地。父亲告诉他，要在此处建立一座村庄：它将免受外界干扰，成为伊斯嘉各地受欺凌地精的避风港。为证明自己所言非虚，布拉克纳普父亲的灵魂在树周围升起一道巨大的环形荆棘之墙，将树根处遮蔽起来，不让路过的人类察觉。地精们开始在这处新圣所的庇护下建造家园，并以守护他们的荆棘之墙为名，将这里命名为“索恩格里普”。

自那日起约20年过去了。地精血战末期家园被焚、此后一直逃亡躲避迫害的许多地精，陆续被索恩格里普的地精接纳，使村庄迅速扩张。当地面被建筑挤满后，地精们开始在巨红杉上加建住宅，但高度从不超过城镇那道荆棘之墙。尽管按描述这类聚落似乎会十分显眼，荆棘的密度却驱离了所有自然掠食者；而人类与其他猎地精者则会无意识地避开此地，仿佛这里根本不存在。

在城镇的全部历史中，布拉克纳普一直担任顾问，却从未成为真正的领袖。当村民试图逃离那些想要伤害他们的人时，他的魔法在挽救不少地精性命方面起到了关键作用。与此同时，布拉克纳普盼望有一天索恩格里普不再需要躲藏。

布拉克纳普最大的梦想，是人类与地精能够和平共处。然而，“伊斯嘉屠杀者”之类团体的持续存在扼杀了这一梦想；他们的偏执与暴力，直接对抗着和平的希望。尽管像树桩地这样的小例子表明，他的目标不仅可能，甚至很有希望实现，但在伊斯嘉的地精能与类人生物邻居真正全面和解之前，仍有大量工作要做。哪怕这需要时间，也许甚至还要地精再经历六代人，布拉克纳普仍希望能看到那一天的到来。

战役职责
布拉克纳普在第3章中担当队伍与喋语林地精的主要联络人。一旦PC们向村庄证明自己值得信任，布拉克纳普便会成为可靠的盟友，因为他看到了“破狱者同盟”为解放伊斯嘉所做之事的潜力。尽管祖灵警告他，信任非地精或许不会有好结果，布拉克纳普仍相信PC们的使命。

这位年迈的地精在第7章同样至关重要，他会协助PC们解除吉拉穆尔的诅咒。此事可能以布拉克纳普之死告终；否则，他会继续支援PC们及其目标。由这位乐观的先知带领，索恩格里普的地精甚至可能在后续章节中前来支援同盟。

在战役结束后，布拉克纳普是建立灼家（Scorchhome）的关键人物，并努力改善地精类与类人生物之间的关系。他鼓励双方和平共处，并希望两国能和睦相处。

Finally, the group reached the large sequoia around 
which Thorngrip would be built. Brakknap fell to 
his knees as he saw the spirit of his father standing 
next to that tall tree, beckoning him forward. He told 
Brakknap to form a village at this spot, one that would 
be protected from outside interference and be a haven 
to downtrodden goblins throughout Isger. To prove 
his words, the spirit of Brakknap’s father raised a wall 
of thorns in a large circle around the tree, hiding its 
base from the scrutiny of passing humans. The goblins 
began to build in the safety of this new sanctuary, 
naming it Thorngrip for the wall that protected them.
Approximately 20 years have passed since that day. 
The goblins of Thorngrip welcomed many goblins 
whose previous homes were burned at the end of 
the Goblinblood Wars and who have been fleeing 
persecution since then, growing the village by leaps and 
bounds. Once the ground was packed with buildings, 
the goblins began constructing homes attached to the 
giant sequoia, but never higher than the town’s thorny 
wall. Though such a settlement might appear to be 
quite noticeable by its description, the density of the 
thorns have warded off any natural predators while 
humans and other goblin-hunters unconsciously avoid 
the area, as if it didn’t exist.
For the entirety of the town’s history, Brakknap has 
served as an advisor but never an outright leader. His 
magic has been instrumental in saving more than a 
few goblin lives as they try to escape from those that 
would do them harm. All the while, Brakknap hopes 
for a day in which Thorngrip no longer needs to hide.
Brakknap’s great dream is that humans and goblins 
will live together in peace. However, the continued 
existence of groups like the Isgeri Slayers stymies that 
dream, their bigotry and violence a direct counter to 
hopes of peace. While small examples like the town of 
Stumpfield show that his goals are certainly possible 
and even probable, there’s still much work to be done 
before the goblins of Isger can fully make peace with 
their humanoid neighbors. Though it might take time, 
maybe even another six generations of goblins to do 
so, Brakknap hopes to see that day come.
Campaign Role
Brakknap serves as the party’s main contact with the 
goblins of Chitterwood in Chapter 3. Once the PCs 
prove to the village that they can be trusted, Brakknap 
becomes a trusted ally, as he sees the potential of what 
the Hellbreakers League is doing to free Isger. Though 
his ancestors warn him that trusting non-goblins 
might come to no good, Brakknap believes in the PCs’ 
mission.
The elderly goblin also plays a crucial role in 
Chapter 7, aiding the PCs in lifting the curse on 
Gillamoor. This event can possibly end in Brakknap’s 
demise, but otherwise he continues to support the PCs 
and their goals. The goblins of Thorngrip might even 
come to the League’s aid in later chapters, led by this 
optimistic oracle.
Post-campaign, Brakknap is a key figure in the 
founding of Scorchhome and works hard to improve 
goblinoid relations with humanoids. He encourages 
peaceful coexistence between the two and hopes for 
the two nations to live in harmony.

All the while, Brakknap hopes for a day in which Thorngrip no longer needs to hide.

Brakknap’s great dream is that humans and goblins will live together in peace. However, the continued existence of groups like the Isgeri Slayers stymies that dream, their bigotry and violence a direct counter to hopes of peace. While small examples like the town of Stumpfield show that his goals are certainly possible and even probable, there’s still much work to be done before the goblins of Isger can fully make peace with their humanoid neighbors. Though it might take time, maybe even another six generations of goblins to do so, Brakknap hopes to see that day come.

Campaign Role
Brakknap serves as the party’s main contact with the goblins of Chitterwood in Chapter 3. Once the PCs prove to the village that they can be trusted, Brakknap becomes a trusted ally, as he sees the potential of what the Hellbreakers League is doing to free Isger. Though his ancestors warn him that trusting non-goblins might come to no good, Brakknap believes in the PCs’ mission.

The elderly goblin also plays a crucial role in Chapter 7, aiding the PCs in lifting the curse on Gillamoor. This event can possibly end in Brakknap’s demise, but otherwise he continues to support the PCs and their goals. The goblins of Thorngrip might even come to the League’s aid in later chapters, led by this optimistic oracle.

Post-campaign, Brakknap is a key figure in the founding of Scorchhome and works hard to improve goblinoid relations with humanoids. He encourages peaceful coexistence between the two and hopes for the two nations to live in harmony.

凯托·乌拉乌内克斯
自以为是的地狱骑士

凯托出身于伊斯嘉乡间、靠近萨林加洛的一户大家族牧场主。成长过程中，他既厌恶田园生活的日常循环，也痛恨平民在牛盗与匪徒面前的无助。人们对法律与秩序自有一套认知，可它从未让人觉得真正被执行；生活反倒充满妥协与隐忍。周围那几名守卫与治安官对百姓毫无助益，政府亦是如此。伊利迪尔从未回应任何求救的呼声，当地民兵也一无是处。凯托渴望真正的改变，而那永远不会到来——至少在赫德文德掌权之时绝无可能。

在与家人就根本信念与价值观爆发多次争执后，凯托一有机会便离家而去，前往神爪教团的驻地迪尼亚尔堡，寻求他所渴望的那种不容动摇的正义。

凯托进步神速：在担任扈从（armiger）的第三年，他斩杀了一名魔鬼，赢得了自己成为地狱骑士的一席之地。年仅18岁的他在同侪中显得格外年轻；但他以强大的个人气场弥补了战斗经验的不足。他的社交才能甚至在冲突时期也格外出众；在地精血战正式结盟之前，他就已协助自己的军团长（maralictor）与钢隼与黑夹克暗中协调联动。

地精血战对凯托而言宛如噩梦：真正的无法无天摧毁了他的家园。他与大地精将军们苦战不休，并急切地想点燃火把，焚毁喋喋林（Chitterwood），把地精们的巢穴夷为平地。

作为少数地精血战老兵之一，凯托被擢升为军团长，并加入神爪教团的外派宣讲与扩展行动，这让他远离故土。十余年来，凯托鲜少想起伊斯嘉；即便他与来自锁链教团与刑架教团的朋友辩论法律与秩序究竟意味着什么，也很少提及。

一切在凯托为抵御光辉复国、守卫迪尼亚尔堡而战死时改变了。尽管许多神爪守军后来都被复活，凯托却没想到自己也会名列其中。至少在当时的他看来，自己对尘世几乎没有任何情感牵挂。为了弄清自己为何归来，凯托数年来第一次将目光重新投向故乡。

他所窥见的那一点伊斯嘉令他厌恶；但他也明白，自己并无权力挑战执政官。故国需要法律与秩序，然而统治者却只迎合富人以维系其地位。伊斯嘉的命运愈发啃噬着他的心。

这名地狱骑士通过一项颇具争议的举动——为艾奥梅黛信仰的地狱骑士开脱——来推进自己成为大团长（paralictor）的道路。于4724 AR，凯托在晋升仪式上获授新衔，并亲历神雨。叛乱的低语，以及“破狱者联盟”对战碎片（warshards）的追猎，使他确信：是时候把伊斯嘉真正拉回切利亚斯的守法掌控之下了。

Caeto hails from a large family of ranchers in rural 
Isger near Saringallow. Growing up, he loathed both 
the routine of pastoral life and the helplessness of 
commoners against cattle thieves and bandits. People 
had a sense of law and order, yet it never felt enforced; 
life was instead full of compromises and forbearance. 
The few guards and sheriffs around did nothing for the 
people, and neither did the government. Elidir never 
answered any calls for deliverance, and the local militia 
was useless. Caeto wanted real change, and it was never 
coming—not while Hedvend was in charge, anyway.
After many arguments with his family over 
fundamental beliefs and values, Caeto left as soon as 
he was able to seek the unwavering justice he desired 
at Citadel Dinyar, home of the Order of the Godclaw.
Caeto progressed quickly, and in his third year as 
an armiger, he slew a devil and earned his place as a 
Hellknight. At only 18, he was unusually young among 
his peers, but what he lacked in combat experience, he 
made up for with his force of personality. His social 
skills shined even in times of conflict, and he helped 
his maralictor coordinate with the Steel Falcons and 
Blackjackets in secrecy even before a formal alliance 
during the Goblinblood Wars was formed.
The Goblinblood Wars were a nightmare for Caeto, 
with true lawlessness destroying his home. He fought 
bitterly against hobgoblin generals and was eager to 
light the torches that burned down the Chitterwood to 
raze the goblins’ own homes.
As one of the few veterans of the Goblinblood Wars, 
Caeto was promoted to maralictor and joined the 
Godclaw’s outreach efforts, which took him far from 
his home country. For over a decade, Caeto seldom 
thought of Isger, even when he debated what law and 
order entailed with friends he made from the Orders 
of the Chain and the Rack.
Things changed when Caeto died defending Citadel 
Dinyar against the Glorious Reclamation. Though 
many of the Godclaw defenders were resurrected, 
Caeto didn’t expect himself to be among them. He 
had, as far as he thought then, very little emotional 
investment among the living. In questioning why he 
returned, Caeto turned his sights back on his homeland 
for the first time in years.
What little he glimpsed of Isger disgusted him, 
though he knew then he didn’t have the authority to 
challenge the steward. His home country needed law 
and order, yet those who ruled it only catered to the 
wealthy to cling to their status. More and more, Isger’s 
fate gnawed at him.
The Hellknight worked toward becoming a 
paralictor by controversially exonerating Iomedaean 
Hellknights. In 4724 ar, Caeto received his promotion 
and witnessed the Godsrain during the ceremony. The 
whispers of rebellion and the Hellbreakers League’s 
hunt for warshards have convinced him that it’s time 
to properly bring Isger back into Cheliax’s lawful 
grasp.

Hellbreakers Adventure Path

Caeto Vulaunex
Self-Righteous Hellknight

Caeto hails from a large family of ranchers in rural Isger near Saringallow. Growing up, he loathed both the routine of pastoral life and the helplessness of commoners against cattle thieves and bandits. People had a sense of law and order, yet it never felt enforced; life was instead full of compromises and forbearance. The few guards and sheriffs around did nothing for the people, and neither did the government. Elidir never answered any calls for deliverance, and the local militia was useless. Caeto wanted real change, and it was never coming—not while Hedvend was in charge, anyway.

After many arguments with his family over fundamental beliefs and values, Caeto left as soon as he was able to seek the unwavering justice he desired at Citadel Dinyar, home of the Order of the Godclaw.

Caeto progressed quickly, and in his third year as an armiger, he slew a devil and earned his place as a Hellknight. At only 18, he was unusually young among his peers, but what he lacked in combat experience, he made up for with his force of personality. His social skills shined even in times of conflict, and he helped his maralictor coordinate with the Steel Falcons and Blackjackets in secrecy even before a formal alliance during the Goblinblood Wars was formed.

The Goblinblood Wars were a nightmare for Caeto, with true lawlessness destroying his home. He fought bitterly against hobgoblin generals and was eager to light the torches that burned down the Chitterwood to raze the goblins’ own homes.

As one of the few veterans of the Goblinblood Wars, Caeto was promoted to maralictor and joined the Godclaw’s outreach efforts, which took him far from his home country. For over a decade, Caeto seldom thought of Isger, even when he debated what law and order entailed with friends he made from the Orders of the Chain and the Rack.

Things changed when Caeto died defending Citadel Dinyar against the Glorious Reclamation. Though many of the Godclaw defenders were resurrected, Caeto didn’t expect himself to be among them. He had, as far as he thought then, very little emotional investment among the living. In questioning why he returned, Caeto turned his sights back on his homeland for the first time in years.

What little he glimpsed of Isger disgusted him, though he knew then he didn’t have the authority to challenge the steward. His home country needed law and order, yet those who ruled it only catered to the wealthy to cling to their status. More and more, Isger’s fate gnawed at him.

The Hellknight worked toward becoming a paralictor by controversially exonerating Iomedaean Hellknights. In 4724 ar, Caeto received his promotion and witnessed the Godsrain during the ceremony. The whispers of rebellion and the Hellbreakers League’s hunt for warshards have convinced him that it’s time to properly bring Isger back into Cheliax’s lawful grasp.

## 战役角色（战役 Role）
玩家角色们会在第4章首次遇见凯托；他可能成为盟友，并真心希望改革伊斯嘉。尽管他憎恨赫德文，但这起谋杀案的严重性使他在调查期间支持玩家角色。虽然凯托是伊斯嘉人，他却与当下的时事与潮流脱节。这名地狱骑士依旧和蔼可亲，只是社交观念有些过时，看起来并不像他的护甲所暗示的那般令人生畏。

一旦凶案告破、赫德文也确实死透，凯托便会显露真面目：他对伊斯嘉实施戒严，并栽赃“地狱破坏者联盟”杀害赫德文。他一心追捕叛军、却不去保护平民抵御亡灵入侵，这清楚表明凯托的优先顺序早已错置；讽刺的是，这恰恰反映了那位他如此憎恶的执政官所奉行的政策。凯托为不惜一切代价抓住地狱破坏者而扭曲的决心，使他对自己最初的原则视而不见，即便他仍声称自己是在为伊斯嘉带来秩序。这个自以为是的地狱骑士最终会成为玩家角色必须击败的终局反派；唯有如此，伊斯嘉才能终于挣脱切利亚斯强加其上的奴役枷锁。

## 敕令与禁忌（Edicts and 禁忌）
作为一名地狱骑士与阿斯摩蒂斯的守护者，凯托的行动受特定规则指引。

**敕令（Edicts）**：从根源上消灭混沌；成为秩序的典范（不仅配得上一位神祇，而是五位）；寻求超越个体信仰的普世律法；维持恰当的等级体系；推翻不合法的等级体系；当你最适合该任务时挺身领导；追猎那些伤害无辜或犯下滔天暴行之人。

**禁忌（禁忌）**：当仍有无法无天可战时休息；自认比“神爪”万神殿更懂或理解得更多；让地位低于你的人对你行使权力或领导你。

Campaign Role
The PCs first meet Caeto during Chapter 4, where he’s 
a potential ally with a genuine desire to reform Isger. 
Though he despises Hedvend, the serious nature of 
his murder makes him supportive of the PCs during 
their investigation. While he’s Isgeri, Caeto is out of 
touch with current events and trends. The Hellknight 
remains an affable if socially outdated man who seems 
not as intimidating as his armor suggests.
Once the homicide is solved and Hedvend properly 
dead, Caeto shows his true colors by placing Isger 
under martial law and framing the Hellbreakers for 
Hedvend’s murder. His relentless pursuit to capture 
the rebels over defending the commoner against 
the undead invasion speaks volumes about Caeto’s 
misplaced priorities, ironically reflecting the policies 
of the steward he so despised. Caeto’s warped 
determination to capture the Hellbreakers at all costs 
blinds him to his original principles, even as he claims 
to bring order to Isger. The self-righteous Hellknight 
ultimately becomes the final villain the PCs must 
defeat to finally free Isger from the chains of servitude 
that Cheliax has placed upon it.
Edicts and Anathema
As a Hellknight and champion of Asmodeus, Caeto’s 
actions are guided by specific rules.
Edicts eliminate chaos at its root, be an exemplar of 
order (worthy of not one, but five), seek the universal 
laws that transcend individual faiths, enforce proper 
hierarchies, topple illegitimate hierarchies, lead when 
you’re the most suited to the task, hunt down those 
who have harmed innocents or committed heinous 
atrocities.
Anathema rest when there’s lawlessness to fight, believe 
you know or understand more than the Godclaw 
pantheon, let one who’s lesser than you wield power 
over you or lead you

Campaign Role
The PCs first meet Caeto during Chapter 4, where he’s a potential ally with a genuine desire to reform Isger. Though he despises Hedvend, the serious nature of his murder makes him supportive of the PCs during their investigation. While he’s Isgeri, Caeto is out of touch with current events and trends. The Hellknight remains an affable if socially outdated man who seems not as intimidating as his armor suggests.

Once the homicide is solved and Hedvend properly dead, Caeto shows his true colors by placing Isger under martial law and framing the Hellbreakers for Hedvend’s murder. His relentless pursuit to capture the rebels over defending the commoner against the undead invasion speaks volumes about Caeto’s misplaced priorities, ironically reflecting the policies of the steward he so despised. Caeto’s warped determination to capture the Hellbreakers at all costs blinds him to his original principles, even as he claims to bring order to Isger. The self-righteous Hellknight ultimately becomes the final villain the PCs must defeat to finally free Isger from the chains of servitude that Cheliax has placed upon it.

Edicts and Anathema
As a Hellknight and champion of Asmodeus, Caeto’s actions are guided by specific rules.
Edicts eliminate chaos at its root, be an exemplar of order (worthy of not one, but five), seek the universal laws that transcend individual faiths, enforce proper hierarchies, topple illegitimate hierarchies, lead when you’re the most suited to the task, hunt down those who have harmed innocents or committed heinous atrocities.
Anathema rest when there’s lawlessness to fight, believe you know or understand more than the Godclaw pantheon, let one who’s lesser than you wield power over you or lead you

## Page 241
埃齐奥·盖塔（Ezio Gaeta）过去是、现在是、并将永远是一个伊斯嘉的爱国者。和许多生于这片土地的忠诚派一样，他逐渐痛恨自己可怜的祖国作为切利亚斯附庸国的地位。不幸的是，对伊斯嘉而言，埃齐奥在乌加索娅的教义中找到了他的“解决之道”。像许多处在总督统治下的人一样，他饱受匮乏与剥夺，便抓住了自己凯立德祖先对苍白公主的理解——将其视为丰收女神，一位能为她的子民带来无限赐福的神祇。她对暴食与纵欲的呼唤，正是一个长期被迫过着最低限度生计的民族所“应得”的东西。

当他在 4675 AR 迎来自己的 50 岁生日时，埃齐奥决定他需要更多的时间、更多的力量、更多的掌控。得知伊尔凯娜·阿隆诺（Illcayna Alonnor）的故事以及她对这位共同女神的虔诚后，他前往芬德的峡谷（Finder’s Gulch）寻求她的帮助。伊尔凯娜在他身上看到了某种东西——一种狡黠，以及对乌加索娅的虔敬；这使埃齐奥不同于那些不配成为“更高存在”、只配化作无知僵尸或她卑贱尸妖仆从的家伙。在他的恳求下，她以仪式将他转化为一个独特的吸血鬼，以换取他的效忠，而他也欣然奉上。

在之后的数十年里，埃齐奥作为伊尔凯娜在世间的代理人行动，悄然传播乌加索娅的信仰，并破坏切利亚斯榨取伊斯嘉最后一滴资源的企图。到了 4680 年代，他偶尔会对切特伍德（Chitterwood）的地精村落发动残酷突袭，让本就恶劣的处境更加难以忍受；他还刻意安排切特伍德居民、附近村庄，以及路过的冒险者与佣兵团之间爆发剧烈冲突。他的阴谋诡计助长了该地区日益溃烂的愤怒，最终在地精血战中爆发。伊尔凯娜为她的不死军团收集尸体之时，埃齐奥则前往埃利迪尔（Elidir），并开始累积影响力。

在战后数十年里，他对伊斯嘉统治层的操纵只增不减；他利用自己的地位向伊尔凯娜提供有关政治气候的情报，并悄无声息地清除威胁她计划的障碍。针对英雄们清剿阿尔泰雷因城堡（Citadel Altaerein）的报告，埃齐奥精心策划了塔奥塔克（Taotake）商人带着一船姆万吉缟玛瑙（Mwangi onyx）抵达的事件：他用这种方式让市场供货泛滥、压低价格，从而降低制造不死生物所需仪式的关键材料成本。同样地，为了迎接伊尔凯娜征服全国的那一天，他花了 30 年在幕后拉线，确保强大的牧师无法进入埃利迪尔。他细致入微的手段包括：制造危机，引诱最优秀的牧师离境；以及营造一种环境，让这座城市更适合那些即便虔诚，也更不可能或无力走上战场、对抗乡间日益增长的不死威胁的人。

遵照伊尔凯娜的命令行事时，埃齐奥相信自己是在为她将伊斯嘉转化为乌加索娅的贡赋国铺平道路。他并不将这一可怖的未来视为终结，而视为伊斯嘉的“更新”——在那里，人们终于将拥有力量与资源，去夺回他们应得之物。

Ezio Gaeta is, was, and always has been an Isgeri 
patriot. And like many such loyalists born in the 
country, he came to rue his poor nation’s role as 
Cheliax’s vassal state. Unfortunately for Isger, Ezio 
found his solution in Urgathoa’s teachings. Suffering 
from the deprivations common to many under the 
stewards’ governorship, he latched onto his Kellid 
ancestors’ view of the Pallid Princess as a harvest 
goddess, one who provides unlimited bounty for her 
people. Her calls for gluttony and excess were just 
what a people long forced into the barest subsistence 
deserved.
When he reached his 50th birthday in 4675 ar, 
Ezio decided he needed more time, more power, more 
control. Knowing of Illcayna Alonnor’s story and 
her devotion to their shared goddess, he journeyed 
to Finder’s Gulch and sought her help. Illcayna saw 
something in him, a slyness and devotion to Urgathoa 
that set Ezio apart from those unworthy of becoming 
more than senseless zombies or her servile wights. 
At his pleading, she ritually transformed him into a 
unique vampire in return for his loyalty, which he gave 
gladly.
For several decades, Ezio moved as Illcayna’s agent 
in the world, quietly spreading Urgathoa’s faith and 
sabotaging Chelaxian efforts to take the final dregs 
of Isger’s resources. In the 4680s, he led occasional 
brutal raids against goblin villages in the Chitterwood, 
making already bad conditions even less tolerable, 
and arranged for explosive confrontations between 
the Chitterwood residents, nearby villages, and 
passing bands of adventurers and mercenaries. His 
machinations contributed to the festering anger of the 
region that eventually exploded in the Goblinblood 
Wars. While Illcayna collected corpses for her undead 
army, Ezio traveled to Elidir, where he began amassing 
influence.
In the decades after the war, he has only increased 
his manipulations of Isger’s leadership, using his 
position to feed Illcayna information on the political 
climate and quietly eliminate threats to her plans. 
In response to reports of heroes clearing Citadel 
Altaerein, Ezio choreographed the arrival of Taotake 
traders with a shipload of Mwangi onyx, flooding the 
market and lowering prices for the key ingredient in 
the ritual to create undead. Similarly, he has spent 
30 years pulling strings to keep powerful clerics 
out of Elidir in preparation for the day Illcayna 
conquers the nation. His subtle methods include 
creating crises that lure the best clerics out of the 
country and fostering conditions that make the city 
conducive to those who, even if devout in faith, are less 
likely or able to take the field against the countryside’s 
growing undead threat.
In following Illcayna’s orders, Ezio believes he’s 
clearing the way for her plans to transform the 
country into a tribute state for Urgathoa. He 
sees this gruesome future not as an end, but a 
renewal of Isger where the people will finally 
have the power and resources to take what 
they’re due.

Hellbreakers ADVENTURE PATH

Ezio Gaeta
Secret Vampire Agent of Urgathoa

Ezio Gaeta is, was, and always has been an Isgeri patriot. And like many such loyalists born in the country, he came to rue his poor nation’s role as Cheliax’s vassal state. Unfortunately for Isger, Ezio found his solution in Urgathoa’s teachings. Suffering from the deprivations common to many under the stewards’ governorship, he latched onto his Kellid ancestors’ view of the Pallid Princess as a harvest goddess, one who provides unlimited bounty for her people. Her calls for gluttony and excess were just what a people long forced into the barest subsistence deserved.

When he reached his 50th birthday in 4675 ar, Ezio decided he needed more time, more power, more control. Knowing of Illcayna Alonnor’s story and her devotion to their shared goddess, he journeyed to Finder’s Gulch and sought her help. Illcayna saw something in him, a slyness and devotion to Urgathoa that set Ezio apart from those unworthy of becoming more than senseless zombies or her servile wights. At his pleading, she ritually transformed him into a unique vampire in return for his loyalty, which he gave gladly.

For several decades, Ezio moved as Illcayna’s agent in the world, quietly spreading Urgathoa’s faith and sabotaging Chelaxian efforts to take the final dregs of Isger’s resources. In the 4680s, he led occasional brutal raids against goblin villages in the Chitterwood, making already bad conditions even less tolerable, and arranged for explosive confrontations between the Chitterwood residents, nearby villages, and passing bands of adventurers and mercenaries. His machinations contributed to the festering anger of the region that eventually exploded in the Goblinblood Wars. While Illcayna collected corpses for her undead army, Ezio traveled to Elidir, where he began amassing influence.

In the decades after the war, he has only increased his manipulations of Isger’s leadership, using his position to feed Illcayna information on the political climate and quietly eliminate threats to her plans. In response to reports of heroes clearing Citadel Altaerein, Ezio choreographed the arrival of Taotake traders with a shipload of Mwangi onyx, flooding the market and lowering prices for the key ingredient in the ritual to create undead. Similarly, he has spent 30 years pulling strings to keep powerful clerics out of Elidir in preparation for the day Illcayna conquers the nation. His subtle methods include creating crises that lure the best clerics out of the country and fostering conditions that make the city conducive to those who, even if devout in faith, are less likely or able to take the field against the countryside’s growing undead threat.

In following Illcayna’s orders, Ezio believes he’s clearing the way for her plans to transform the country into a tribute state for Urgathoa. He sees this gruesome future not as an end, but a renewal of Isger where the people will finally have the power and resources to take what they’re due.

战役作用
当埃齐奥谋杀总督赫德文德六世时，他在战役后半段充当关键的催化剂：国家在失去领袖后陷入动荡，并使伊尔凯娜成为一项主要威胁。在谋杀发生前，PC们可以在晚会上遭遇他；在那里他显得神秘莫测。他显然是埃利迪尔的上层人物之一，也为伊斯嘉的问题推波助澜，但他似乎对现政权并不忠诚，甚至可能被视为PC们潜在的盟友与招募目标。一旦谋杀被发现，他便与PC们玩起猫捉老鼠的游戏；当他们追查赫德文德的凶手并试图解开里夫斯雷斯特持续死亡的谜团时，他会用误导线索与伪造证据分散他们的注意力。

Campaign Role
Ezio serves as a critical catalyst for the second half of 
the campaign when he murders Steward Hedvend VI, 
throwing the nation into turmoil at the loss of its leader 
and ushering Illcayna in as a major threat. Prior to the 
murder, the PCs can encounter him at the gala, where he 
comes across as an enigma. He’s clearly one of the elites 
of Elidir and contributes to Isger’s problems, but he also 
seems to have little loyalty to the regime and might even 
be seen as a potential ally and target for recruitment by 
the PCs. Once the murder is discovered, he plays a cat-
and-mouse game with the PCs, attempting to distract 
them with red herrings and false evidence as they seek 
the identity of Hedvend’s killer and to solve the mystery 
of the ongoing deaths in Reevesrest.

Campaign Role
Ezio serves as a critical catalyst for the second half of the campaign when he murders Steward Hedvend VI, throwing the nation into turmoil at the loss of its leader and ushering Illcayna in as a major threat. Prior to the murder, the PCs can encounter him at the gala, where he comes across as an enigma. He’s clearly one of the elites of Elidir and contributes to Isger’s problems, but he also seems to have little loyalty to the regime and might even be seen as a potential ally and target for recruitment by the PCs. Once the murder is discovered, he plays a cat-and-mouse game with the PCs, attempting to distract them with red herrings and false evidence as they seek the identity of Hedvend’s killer and to solve the mystery of the ongoing deaths in Reevesrest.

## Page 243
伊尔卡娅娜·阿隆诺
伊斯嘉尸妖之母

伊尔卡娅娜自幼便是“苦难牧者”（Shepherds of the 苦难）的乌尔格娑亚教团一员；她与父母一同在商队里假扮成药剂师，周游于伊斯嘉与切利亚斯之间。伊尔卡娅娜自出生起便体弱多病，她相信这是乌尔格娑亚赐福于她。当她的父母因自作自受的疾病而死去时，她在他们的坟上起舞，庆祝自己在发热的谵妄中获得的狂喜。这些炽烈的异象帮助她与同道在往后的岁月里躲避追捕。

最终，伊尔卡娅娜与她的羊群来到寻人峡谷（Finder’s Gulch），那里住着一群灰烬教会（Ashen Church）的邪教徒。在当地女祭司所挥舞的长镰倒影之中，伊尔卡娅娜目睹了自己迫近的死亡与重生。作为卑微的见习女祭司等待那被寄望的一日，本身就是一种折磨。然而她的耐心终有回报——当灰烬教会终于失去对他们耗费多年制造的尸妖的控制时，那一天到来了。其他邪教徒仓皇逃散之际，伊尔卡娅娜拾起灰烬女祭司遗落的长镰，剖开自己的身体，让不死大军吞噬她。在最后一息将尽之时，伊尔卡娅娜以“乌尔格娑亚之子”的身份再度站起，那柄古老的凯立德武器“死神之叹”（Reaper’s Sigh）与她融为一体。她已成为乌尔格娑亚寒冬被寄望的先驱，如今必须着手那漫长的工作：让伊斯嘉做好被收割、并献给苍白公主（Pallid Princess）的准备。唯有如此，那份很久以前——当塔尔多前来征服这片土地时——所立下、真正解放伊斯嘉的寄望，方能实现。

随后数十年里，伊尔卡娅娜筹谋以不死生物淹没伊斯嘉。她诅咒吉拉穆尔镇（Gillamoor），令死者以她的尸妖之躯复起；起初人们还误以为那是一场瘟疫。她也收集了地精血战中的尸体，并悄然杀死、再生那些过于靠近寻人峡谷的强盗帮派。她的爪牙——其中最显著者便是埃齐奥·盖塔（Ezio Gaeta，见第240页）——协助她推动阴谋，也帮助她与恶魔术士卡尔泰莎·伊伊斯（Kaltessa Iyis）抗衡；后者直到不久前仍在聚拢自己的不死军团。

在战役开始前不久，伊尔卡娅娜在寻人峡谷外的丘陵间发现了一块堕落古鲁姆（Gorum）的碎片。这团血红的金属在她的接触下搏动不止，她将其命名为“乌尔格娑亚的流血之心”（Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa），并举行了一场仪式，将其嵌入自己的胸膛。该仪式存在缺陷：它不但未能赋予她神话之力，反而大幅削弱了她的不死形态；但它也赐予她一个邪恶的启示——一种全新的仪式，能够彻底激活这枚战裂片（warshard），使她得以以乌尔格娑亚之名蹂躏伊斯嘉的乡野。

战役定位
在她完成蜕变后的一个世纪里，伊尔卡娅娜一直命令手下散布流言：伊斯嘉的“尸妖之母”注定将成为一个献给乌尔格娑亚的不死国度的统治者。她的称号逐渐化作都市传说，被用来恐吓孩童乖乖听话，然而也成了一个……

Illcayna grew up as a member of the Urgathoan cult 
of the Shepherds of the Affliction, traveling about Isger 
and Cheliax with her parents under the guise of an 
apothecary in their caravan. Sickly since birth, Illcayna 
believed she was blessed by Urgathoa. When her 
parents succumbed to a disease of their own making, 
she danced on their graves in celebration of the feverish 
delirium she gained. These fervent visions helped her 
and her fellow cultists evade capture in following years. 
Eventually, Illcayna and her flock arrived at Finder’s 
Gulch, where a group of Ashen Church cultists resided.
In the reflection of the scythe the local priestess 
wielded, Illcayna witnessed her own impending death 
and rebirth. Waiting for that promised day as a lowly 
junior priestess was a trial in itself. Her patience paid 
off though, and at last the day came when the Ashen 
Church lost control of the wights they spent so long 
creating. As the other cultists fled, Illcayna picked up 
the scythe the Ashen priestess dropped, cut herself 
open, and let the undead horde devour her. Upon her 
last breath, Illcayna rose as a Child of Urgathoa, the 
ancient Kellid weapon Reaper’s Sigh fused to her. She’d 
become the promised herald of Urgathoa’s winter, 
who must now begin the long work of preparing Isger 
to be reaped and offered to the Pallid Princess. Only 
then will the promise to truly free Isger, made long ago 
when Taldor came to conquer these lands, be fulfilled.
Illcayna spent the next decades plotting to overrun 
Isger with undead. She cursed the town of Gillamoor so 
the dead would rise as her wights, which was initially 
mistaken for a plague. She also collected bodies from 
the Goblinblood Wars and has quietly killed and 
reanimated bandit gangs that veer too close to Finder’s 
Gulch. Her agents, most prominently Ezio Gaeta (page 
240), have assisted her machinations and helped her 
compete with the diabolist Kaltessa Iyis, who was 
amassing her own undead army until recently.
Not long before the campaign begins, Illcayna 
discovered a piece of the fallen Gorum in the hills 
outside of Finder’s Gulch. This blood-red lump 
of metal pulsed at her touch, and she named it the 
Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa before engaging in a 
ritual that embedded it into her chest. The ritual 
was flawed, drastically diminishing her undead form 
without granting her mythic powers, but granted 
her an unholy vision of a new ritual that could fully 
empower the warshard and allow her to devastate the 
Isgeri countryside in Urgathoa’s name.

Illcayna Alonnor
Wight Mother of Isger

Illcayna grew up as a member of the Urgathoan cult of the Shepherds of the Affliction, traveling about Isger and Cheliax with her parents under the guise of an apothecary in their caravan. Sickly since birth, Illcayna believed she was blessed by Urgathoa. When her parents succumbed to a disease of their own making, she danced on their graves in celebration of the feverish delirium she gained. These fervent visions helped her and her fellow cultists evade capture in following years. Eventually, Illcayna and her flock arrived at Finder’s Gulch, where a group of Ashen Church cultists resided.

In the reflection of the scythe the local priestess wielded, Illcayna witnessed her own impending death and rebirth. Waiting for that promised day as a lowly junior priestess was a trial in itself. Her patience paid off though, and at last the day came when the Ashen Church lost control of the wights they spent so long creating. As the other cultists fled, Illcayna picked up the scythe the Ashen priestess dropped, cut herself open, and let the undead horde devour her. Upon her last breath, Illcayna rose as a Child of Urgathoa, the ancient Kellid weapon Reaper’s Sigh fused to her. She’d become the promised herald of Urgathoa’s winter, who must now begin the long work of preparing Isger to be reaped and offered to the Pallid Princess. Only then will the promise to truly free Isger, made long ago when Taldor came to conquer these lands, be fulfilled.

Illcayna spent the next decades plotting to overrun Isger with undead. She cursed the town of Gillamoor so the dead would rise as her wights, which was initially mistaken for a plague. She also collected bodies from the Goblinblood Wars and has quietly killed and reanimated bandit gangs that veer too close to Finder’s Gulch. Her agents, most prominently Ezio Gaeta (page 240), have assisted her machinations and helped her compete with the diabolist Kaltessa Iyis, who was amassing her own undead army until recently.

Not long before the campaign begins, Illcayna discovered a piece of the fallen Gorum in the hills outside of Finder’s Gulch. This blood-red lump of metal pulsed at her touch, and she named it the Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa before engaging in a ritual that embedded it into her chest. The ritual was flawed, drastically diminishing her undead form without granting her mythic powers, but granted her an unholy vision of a new ritual that could fully empower the warshard and allow her to devastate the Isgeri countryside in Urgathoa’s name.

牧师领域法术 2专注点，DC 27，+19；6环 恶性滋养（玩家 Core 380）、不死之触（玩家 Core 380）
仪式 DC 29；创造不死生物

苍白瘟疫（疾病、神圣、剧毒）
豁免：DC 27强韧；
阶段1 携带者（3天）；阶段2 3d8虚无伤害与注定1（1天）；阶段3 3d8虚无伤害、注定1与 drained 1（1天）；阶段4 4d8虚无伤害、注定2与 drained 1（1天）；阶段5 4d8虚无伤害、注定3与 drained 2（1天）；阶段6 死亡。感染苍白瘟疫而死亡的生物会起身成为尸妖（特征）。

收割 2动作 伊尔凯娜进行一次“收割者之叹”打击，并将该次攻击掷骰结果分别与两名敌人的AC比较；两名敌人都必须处于她的近战触及内。只掷一次伤害，并将其分别应用于每个命中的生物。“收割”在计算伊尔凯娜的多重攻击减值时视为两次攻击。

唤醒死者 2动作（神圣）
频率：每分钟1次；
需求：伊尔凯娜与一名在过去1分钟内死亡的生物相邻；
效果：伊尔凯娜以手掌轻触，使尸体活动起来。该生物必须成功通过一次DC 29意志豁免，否则将起身成为一名尸妖（特征）。这些尸妖会自动效忠伊尔凯娜，并将独立地以她的利益行事、遵从她的命令，直到被摧毁为止。

## Page 245
暴乱煽动者
破狱者联盟的领袖

阿尔塞奥在厄戈里安与他的精灵母亲一同长大。她深情地追忆着斯戎崛起之前的岁月，并悄悄教导他那时的生活。那些教诲将他引向密拉妮；后来，他建立了一个地下网络，帮助人们逃离切利亚斯。然而，他的行动在光辉复国期间暴露无遗，于是他向东逃亡——菲比就是在那里遇见他的。

菲比曾是伊斯嘉军队的军官。她在地精血战期间意识到军队并未保护平民，于是选择逃兵。之后她勉强靠当佣兵为生，只接那些符合自己道德准则的活计。在她从一群追捕的多塔里手中救下阿尔塞奥之后，阿尔塞奥雇她在前往安多安的途中担任护卫。两人一路向东——既要应对几乎不间断的危险，又要避开科内里卡海峡以摆脱追踪——他们发现彼此配合默契且有许多共同点。当他们抵达伊斯嘉东部边境时，两人已坠入爱河，并决定留在这片土地上，携手帮助这里的人民。

战役职责
自4722 AR创立以来，阿尔塞奥与菲比一直领导着破狱者联盟。他们在本《冒险路径》中大多扮演背景角色。他们看到了PC们成为未来破狱者联盟领袖的潜力，也希望给予PC们自由，让其成长为能够承担该角色的人选。从第4章开始，当他们与PC产生直接接触时，阿尔塞奥与菲比会以各自的风格为PC提供指引与鼓励：阿尔塞奥以振奋人心的言辞鼓舞众人，而菲比则致力于增强他们的武艺与战斗本领。

Alceo grew up in Egorian with his elven mother, who 
fondly remembered and quietly taught him about life 
before the Thrune Ascendancy. Those lessons led him 
to Milani, and he eventually formed an underground 
network to help people escape from Cheliax. But 
his efforts were discovered during the Glorious 
Reclamation, and he fled east. That’s where Phoebe 
met him.
A former Isgeri army officer, Phoebe deserted 
during the Goblinblood Wars when she realized the 
military wasn’t protecting citizens. She then made a 
meager living as a mercenary, taking jobs she felt met 
her moral code. After she saved Alceo from a group 
of pursuing dottari, he hired her to protect him as he 
made his way to Andoran. As the two traveled east—
dealing with near-constant danger while avoiding the 
Conerica Straits to throw off pursuit—they realized 
they worked well together and had much in common. 
By the time they reached Isger’s eastern border, they 
were in love and decided to remain in the country to 
help its people together. 
Campaign Role
Alceo and Phoebe have led the Hellbreakers League 
since its founding in 4722 ar. They largely play a 
background role in this Adventure Path. They see 
the PCs’ potential to be the future leaders of the 
Hellbreakers League and want to give the PCs the 
freedom to grow into that role. When they’re in direct 
contact, starting in Chapter 4, Alceo and Phoebe offer 
guidance and encouragement to the PCs, each in their 
own style: Alceo with stirring words, while Phoebe 
seeks to bolster their martial prowess.

The Riotmongers
Leaders of the Hellbreakers League

Alceo grew up in Egorian with his elven mother, who fondly remembered and quietly taught him about life before the Thrune Ascendancy. Those lessons led him to Milani, and he eventually formed an underground network to help people escape from Cheliax. But his efforts were discovered during the Glorious Reclamation, and he fled east. That’s where Phoebe met him.

A former Isgeri army officer, Phoebe deserted during the Goblinblood Wars when she realized the military wasn’t protecting citizens. She then made a meager living as a mercenary, taking jobs she felt met her moral code. After she saved Alceo from a group of pursuing dottari, he hired her to protect him as he made his way to Andoran. As the two traveled east—dealing with near-constant danger while avoiding the Conerica Straits to throw off pursuit—they realized they worked well together and had much in common. By the time they reached Isger’s eastern border, they were in love and decided to remain in the country to help its people together.

Campaign Role
Alceo and Phoebe have led the Hellbreakers League since its founding in 4722 ar. They largely play a background role in this Adventure Path. They see the PCs’ potential to be the future leaders of the Hellbreakers League and want to give the PCs the freedom to grow into that role. When they’re in direct contact, starting in Chapter 4, Alceo and Phoebe offer guidance and encouragement to the PCs, each in their own style: Alceo with stirring words, while Phoebe seeks to bolster their martial prowess.

## Page 247
维罗·阿哈拉
复仇的地狱骑士侍从

维罗·阿哈拉出生于埃戈里安的一个商人家庭。家境殷实，却也谈不上富得离谱。他在成长过程中享有诸多优势：良好的教育、美味的食物，以及大量可供从事运动或学术爱好的闲暇时光。他活成了切里亚斯特权的典型样貌——师从优秀（但并非顶尖）的家庭教师，衣食无缺。

维罗九岁那年，第一次亲眼见到地狱女皇阿布罗盖尔·斯戎二世。当时他一家参加了公开处决：几名胆敢抗议主人命令的傲慢半身人仆役将被处死。阿布罗盖尔·斯戎也现身于场，她站在广场上方一处高耸阳台的安全位置俯瞰全场。即使相距甚远，维罗仍能感受到她那不容置疑的威权；当她抬手准备宣判罪犯的裁决时，所有在场者都陷入了死寂……直到抗议者开始高喊。

一小群埃戈里安市民对这场处决愤怒不已，叫嚷着这“太不公平”“太野蛮”。在他们看来，半身人的罪行微不足道——不过是一点公民不服从——根本不该判死。抗议持续不到五分钟，一对身着重型护甲的地狱骑士便推开人群冲入其间，迅速将抗议者打至昏迷。阿布罗盖尔轻轻一点头，那些人便被粗暴地拖上广场的刑台，与半身人一同被草草处决。

就在那一刻，维罗·阿哈拉明白了自己此生想做什么。

他知道自己永远无法攀至地狱女皇那般的权势巅峰——家族的地位与血脉已注定如此——但成为她手中挥出的铁拳，却深深吸引着年少的他。他用接下来的十年锤炼心智与身体。他阅读能找到的每一本关于地狱骑士历史与其试图效法的地狱秩序结构的书籍，翻遍卷帙与手稿，并从中找到大量值得敬仰之处。他很快便如此确信：“世界就该如此运转。最聪明、最强大者应当统治，其余人应当感激这种监管。”

不读书时，维罗便锻炼体魄、磨练武艺。他知道自己必须强壮到足以穿上地狱骑士诸骑士团标志性的厚重板甲。他的家人全力支持这项努力，因为他们同样是狂热的斯戎忠诚派。

最终，维罗通过了考验，加入刑架骑士团，成为一名地狱骑士侍从。那是他一生中最自豪的日子，哪怕这意味着他必须迁往西冠城附近的里瓦德堡。又训练一年后，他开始令上级刮目相看，并被派驻埃戈里安，与同袍一同待命，随时准备镇压任何可能在帝国首都滋生的异见。

Viro Ahala was born in Egorian to a successful, but 
not ridiculously wealthy, merchant family. He was 
afforded quite a few advantages growing up: good

of Chelaxian privilege, studying under very good (but

When Viro was nine, he saw Her Infernal Majestrix

family was attending the public execution of several 
impudent halfling servants who’d dared protest 
against their masters. Abrogail Thrune also made 
an appearance, from the safety of a high balcony 
overlooking the square. Even from a distance, 
Viro could sense her imperious power; all those in 
attendance fell silent when she raised her hand to 
pronounce judgment on the criminals… until the 
protesters began to shout.
A small group of Egorian citizens were incensed 
at this execution, yelling that it was “unfair” and 
“barbaric.” The halflings’ crimes were minor—just a 
little civil disobedience—and they didn’t deserve death, 
according to the protesters. Their demonstration lasted 
less than five minutes, as a pair of heavily armored

quickly beat the protesters into unconsciousness. With 
a nod from Abrogail, they were unceremoniously 
dragged onto the square’s dais and summarily executed 
alongside the halflings.

with his life.

Viro Ahala
Vengeful Hellknight Armiger

Viro Ahala was born in Egorian to a successful, but not ridiculously wealthy, merchant family. He was afforded quite a few advantages growing up: good schooling, delicious food, and copious free time for athletic or academic hobbies. He lived as the epitome of Chelaxian privilege, studying under very good (but not the best) tutors and lacking nothing.

When Viro was nine, he saw Her Infernal Majestrix Abrogail Thrune II in person for the first time. His family was attending the public execution of several impudent halfling servants who’d dared protest against their masters. Abrogail Thrune also made an appearance, from the safety of a high balcony overlooking the square. Even from a distance, Viro could sense her imperious power; all those in attendance fell silent when she raised her hand to pronounce judgment on the criminals… until the protesters began to shout.

A small group of Egorian citizens were incensed at this execution, yelling that it was “unfair” and “barbaric.” The halflings’ crimes were minor—just a little civil disobedience—and they didn’t deserve death, according to the protesters. Their demonstration lasted less than five minutes, as a pair of heavily armored Hellknights pushed their way through the crowd and quickly beat the protesters into unconsciousness. With a nod from Abrogail, they were unceremoniously dragged onto the square’s dais and summarily executed alongside the halflings.

Right then, Viro Ahala knew what he wanted to do with his life.

He knew he would never rise to the same heights of power as Her Infernal Majestrix—his family’s station and lineage saw to that—but being the ironclad fist wielded by such a person appealed to his young mind. He spent the next decade training his mind and his body. He read every book he could get his hands on about the history of the Hellknights and the ordered structure of Hell they sought to emulate. He found a lot to admire in those tomes and scrolls. “This is the way the world should be,” he soon thought. “The smartest and strongest should rule, and the rest should be grateful for such oversight.”

When not studying, Viro exercised and practiced his martial prowess. He knew he would have to grow strong enough to wear the massive plate armor that’s iconic to the Hellknight orders. His family fully supported this endeavor, as they too were ardent Thrune loyalists.

Eventually, Viro passed the trial to become a Hellknight armiger with the Order of the Rack. It was the proudest day of his life, even if it meant moving to Citadel Rivad near Westcrown. After another year of training, he began to impress his superiors and was stationed with other members of the order in Egorian, ready to crush any dissidence

## Page 248
……任何可能在国都出现的异见。如今，维罗已经能像十多年前他亲眼目睹其行动的那些地狱骑士一样。

一切顺利地持续了数月，直到神雨降临，以及阿布罗盖尔·斯戎二世为夺取战神戈鲁姆陨落的躯体碎片——被称为“战碎片”（warshards）——而展开的搜寻。起初，神雨对地狱骑士几乎没有影响。当谣言传出：伊斯嘉有一支叛军派系正在布雷奇希尔镇附近收集这些神器时，刑架骑士团被指派进驻该地并铲除那些战碎片。维罗被编入这支部队，并冷酷无情地摧垮布雷奇希尔居民的意志。他对对平民动用暴力或威胁其生计毫无顾忌；毕竟他们只是普通市民，而他自认高于其上。随着他不断表现出色，他知道自己很快就会成为正式地狱骑士。

维罗也在雷金纳德·科莫斯的处决现场，不过挥下刀刃的荣誉属于一名资深地狱骑士。此时，维罗确信任何反抗的精神都已被碾碎；当鹰骑士向该镇进军、点燃“地狱骑士山之战”时，他同样感到意外。维罗与战友并肩奋战，并在阿尔塔雷林要塞被攻占时就在其外。令他懊恼的是，他的军团被一支与“破狱者同盟”结盟的勇敢士兵部队击溃——而这正是他的骑士团奉命前往伊斯嘉要消灭的组织。他与另外几名地狱骑士逃离此地，却遭到同盟游侠的追击。维罗靠蜷缩在一处废弃的獾穴里才苟活下来。

他出来后，发现自己的一名上级的尸体面朝下伏在附近的小溪中。复仇的念头令他心火灼烧；维罗剥下尸体的护甲，据为己有。它并不合身——对他来说过大且僵硬——而且它刮擦着他的脖颈，仿佛在告诉他：他尚不配穿戴它。他告诉自己，唯有碾碎破狱者同盟，才能赢得穿上它的资格；但眼下，他会利用其权威来施行一个阴险的计划。

【战役定位】
与“金色艾瑞妮丝姐妹会”合作，维罗·阿哈拉是第2章与第3章的主要反派。在地狱骑士山之战中落败的刺痛仍纠缠着他，而他将其归咎于破狱者同盟。他们的傲慢必须受罚。而还有什么方式能比召唤一名魔鬼来协助他施行复仇更好？

多亏姐妹会协助他找到的一本古籍，维罗获得了施行某个仪式的许可；该仪式能召唤一名强大的魔鬼，为他注入力量，以便最终彻底终结破狱者。按照他的计划，他将深入“喋喋林”（Chitterwood）；那里“雄鹿瀑洞窟”（Stagfall Caves）中有一处原初魔法的源头，是进行魔法仪式的完美设定。

PC们会在第2章末尾得知他的涉入，并必须在第3章中穿越喋喋林追踪他。到PC们探索完雄鹿瀑洞窟时，他们很可能已经杀死了维罗——他狂热到不会在战斗中投降，尤其当他的计划近在咫尺之时。然而，这不一定就是PC们最后一次见到维罗。一旦他的灵魂接受审判，他会在本冒险后续章节中以一名恶魔系反派的身份回归，并被赐予凯托·武劳内克斯。届时，他对复仇的渴望只会愈发强烈——而现在，PC们将成为他怒火的主要目标！

AC 21（举盾时23）；强韧 +15，反射 +9（对抗区域效果时+12），意志 +12

盾牌格挡[反应动作]（Shield Block）
触发 维罗已举盾且受到一次物理攻击的伤害；
效果 维罗将盾牌猛地就位以偏斜打击。盾牌使维罗免受8点伤害。维罗与盾牌各自承受任何剩余伤害，可能使盾牌破损或摧毁。

速度 20尺
近战[单动作] 长剑 +15（多用P），伤害 1d8+7 挥砍
近战[单动作] 护手铠 +15（灵巧、徒手），伤害 1d4+7 钝击
远程[单动作] 弩 +11（射程增量120尺），伤害 1d8+2 穿刺

惩戒劈斩[双动作]（Punishing Cut）
维罗进行一次长剑打击。这次攻击在计算多重攻击减值时视为两次攻击。若该打击命中，则额外造成1个武器伤害骰，并造成1d4 持续流血伤害。

举盾冲锋[双动作]（Shielded Charge）
需求 维罗正持用一面盾牌；
效果 维罗举起盾牌，然后疾行两次。若他在移动结束时邻接一名敌人，则该敌人在维罗本回合结束前，对维罗的打击处于措手不及状态。

that might arise in the nation’s capital. Now, Viro 
could be just like those Hellknights he witnessed in 
action over a decade ago.
All was well for months until the Godsrain and 
Abrogail Thrune’s quest to claim any fallen pieces of 
Gorum’s body, known as warshards. The Godsrain did 
little to affect the Hellknights at first. When rumors 
arose that a faction of rebels in Isger were gathering 
these very artifacts near the town of Breachill, the 
Order of Rack was assigned to occupy the area and 
root out those warshards. Viro was assigned to that 
company and worked ruthlessly to crush the spirits 
of Breachill’s residents. He had no qualms about 
using violence against civilians or threatening their 
livelihoods; they were, after all, simple citizens, while 
he was someone above them. As he continued to 
distinguish himself, he knew he would soon become 
a full Hellknight.
Viro was present at the execution of Reginald 
Cormoth, though a veteran Hellknight had the honor 
of wielding the blade. At this point, Viro was certain 
that the spirit of any resistance was crushed and was 
surprised as any when Eagle Knights marched on 
the town, igniting the Battle of Hellknight Hill. Viro 
fought fervently alongside his comrades and was 
outside Citadel Altaerein when it was captured. To his 
chagrin, his regiment was routed by a troop of plucky 
soldiers allied with the Hellbreakers League, the very 
group his order was sent to Isger to eliminate. He and 
a few other Hellknights fled the area but were pursued 
by League rangers. Viro survived by cowering within 
an abandoned badger den.
When he emerged, Viro discovered the body of one 
of his superiors face down in a nearby stream. His 
mind afire with thoughts of vengeance, Viro stripped 
the corpse of its armor, taking it for himself. It didn’t 
fit perfectly, too large and unyielding to his form, and 
it scratched at his neck as if telling him he wasn’t yet 
worthy of it. He told himself he would earn the right 
to wear it by crushing the Hellbreakers League, but for 
now, he would use its authority to enact a devious plan.
Campaign Role
Working with the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys, 
Viro Ahala serves as the main antagonist for Chapters 
2 and 3. The sting of losing at the Battle of Hellknight 
Hill remains with him, and he blames the Hellbreakers 
League. Their impudence must be punished. And what 
better way to do so than to summon a devil to help 
him enact his revenge?
Thanks to a tome he finds with the help of the 
sisters, Viro has access to a ritual that can summon a 
powerful devil to empower him to finally put an end 
to the Hellbreakers. His plans have him moving deep 
into the Chitterwood, where a source of primal magic 
in the Stagfall Caves makes the perfect setting for a 
magic ritual.
The PCs learn of his involvement by the end of 
Chapter 2 and must track him through the Chitterwood 
in Chapter 3. By the end of their exploration of Stagfall 
Caves, the PCs have likely slain Viro, who’s too much 
of a zealot to surrender in a fight, especially with his 
plan so close to fruition.
However, that doesn’t have to be the last the PCs see 
of Viro. Once his soul has been judged, he returns as a 
diabolic antagonist granted to Caeto Vulaunex in the 
later chapters of the adventure. At this point, his thirst 
for vengeance has only intensified, but now the PCs 
are the main focus of his ire!

that might arise in the nation’s capital. Now, Viro could be just like those Hellknights he witnessed in action over a decade ago.

All was well for months until the Godsrain and Abrogail Thrune’s quest to claim any fallen pieces of Gorum’s body, known as warshards. The Godsrain did little to affect the Hellknights at first. When rumors arose that a faction of rebels in Isger were gathering these very artifacts near the town of Breachill, the Order of Rack was assigned to occupy the area and root out those warshards. Viro was assigned to that company and worked ruthlessly to crush the spirits of Breachill’s residents. He had no qualms about using violence against civilians or threatening their livelihoods; they were, after all, simple citizens, while he was someone above them. As he continued to distinguish himself, he knew he would soon become a full Hellknight.

Viro was present at the execution of Reginald Cormoth, though a veteran Hellknight had the honor of wielding the blade. At this point, Viro was certain that the spirit of any resistance was crushed and was surprised as any when Eagle Knights marched on the town, igniting the Battle of Hellknight Hill. Viro fought fervently alongside his comrades and was outside Citadel Altaerein when it was captured. To his chagrin, his regiment was routed by a troop of plucky soldiers allied with the Hellbreakers League, the very group his order was sent to Isger to eliminate. He and a few other Hellknights fled the area but were pursued by League rangers. Viro survived by cowering within an abandoned badger den.

When he emerged, Viro discovered the body of one of his superiors face down in a nearby stream. His mind afire with thoughts of vengeance, Viro stripped the corpse of its armor, taking it for himself. It didn’t fit perfectly, too large and unyielding to his form, and it scratched at his neck as if telling him he wasn’t yet worthy of it. He told himself he would earn the right to wear it by crushing the Hellbreakers League, but for now, he would use its authority to enact a devious plan.

Campaign Role
Working with the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys, Viro Ahala serves as the main antagonist for Chapters 2 and 3. The sting of losing at the Battle of Hellknight Hill remains with him, and he blames the Hellbreakers League. Their impudence must be punished. And what better way to do so than to summon a devil to help him enact his revenge?

Thanks to a tome he finds with the help of the sisters, Viro has access to a ritual that can summon a powerful devil to empower him to finally put an end to the Hellbreakers. His plans have him moving deep into the Chitterwood, where a source of primal magic in the Stagfall Caves makes the perfect setting for a magic ritual.

The PCs learn of his involvement by the end of Chapter 2 and must track him through the Chitterwood in Chapter 3. By the end of their exploration of Stagfall Caves, the PCs have likely slain Viro, who’s too much of a zealot to surrender in a fight, especially with his plan so close to fruition.

However, that doesn’t have to be the last the PCs see of Viro. Once his soul has been judged, he returns as a diabolic antagonist granted to Caeto Vulaunex in the later chapters of the adventure. At this point, his thirst for vengeance has only intensified, but now the PCs are the main focus of his ire!

让你的世界充满角色！

现已发售！

神祇的虔信者、狡黠的佣兵、热爱玩乐的表演者、精明的工程师、阴险的反派，等等——在《Pathfinder NPC Core》中都能在你的游戏里找到他们的位置！本书收录了超过250个NPC数据块，你可以将各式各样的角色直接加入你的游戏：从商人和农夫，到精通魔法与武艺的大师，应有尽有。这些NPC旨在提供有趣且易用的体验，并配有一套调整选项，能让你快速改变他们的族裔、等级等内容。

你还会找到大量专为非人族裔准备的NPC，例如矮人将军、地精小团伙，以及狗头人护蛋者。每个NPC章节都围绕主题编排，并包含背景设定、自定义规则与随机表，为你的游戏增添风味。再也不用临时瞎编属性数据了——你需要的一切都在《Pathfinder NPC Core》！
